data.10TH_ANNIV_CHAR_WELCOME_LIGHTSPEED_INFO:
[c][F0FF23]MERGE UNITS[-][/c]

Units included in the Lightspeed Bundle are upgraded according to a predetermined set of upgrade criteria (listed below). The Lightspeed Bundle does not directly grant character shards / ship blueprints or resources used in merge upgrades. The upgrade criteria are evaluated against your existing roster, and your units are set to the greater of the two values.

Each unit will first be evaluated for existing shards or star rarity against the bundle upgrade criteria. A unit at lower star rarity (or unactivated with less cumulative shards/blueprints) than the bundle upgrade criteria will be upgraded and activated. Units that exceed the star rarity (or cumulative shards/blueprints) will be activated (if unactivated) and then evaluated for additional attributes (gear tier, ability tier, etc). Any surplus shards/blueprints over the bundle upgrade criteria will be retained.

If your previously unlocked units meet or exceed the bundle upgrade criteria for other attributes, any surplus value will be retained.

[b]CHARACTERS[/b]
- 5 Stars
- Level 10

data.AAT_CHANGES_INBOX_MESSAGE:
The Tank Takedown Raid has been rebalanced for normal difficulty. All phases of the fight have had the damage, boss health, minion health, and speed reduced. In addition to this, Jedi will have their critical strike chance increased by 20% during all phases of the Raid. We hope this makes for a better experience when participating in the Tank Takedown Raid!

If your guild currently has a Tank Takedown Raid in progress it will either need to be finished or abandoned for the latest changes to take effect.

Here are 50 salvage items of each gear piece that are found only in the Tank Takedown Raid. Enjoy, and go check out the new changes today!

data.ADMIRAL_TRENCH_LIGHTSPEED_BUNDLE_INFO:
[b]MERGE UNITS[/b]

Units included in the Lightspeed Bundle are upgraded according to a predetermined set of upgrade criteria (listed below). The Lightspeed Bundle does not directly grant character shards / ship blueprints or resources used in merge upgrades. The upgrade criteria are evaluated against your existing roster, and your units are set to the greater of the two values.

Each unit will first be evaluated for existing shards or star rarity against the bundle upgrade criteria. A unit at lower star rarity (or unactivated with less cumulative shards/blueprints) than the bundle upgrade criteria will be upgraded and activated. Units that exceed the star rarity (or cumulative shards/blueprints) will be activated (if unactivated) and then evaluated for additional attributes (gear tier, ability tier, etc). Any surplus shards/blueprints over the bundle upgrade criteria will be retained.

If your previously unlocked units meet or exceed the bundle upgrade criteria for other attributes, any surplus value will be retained.

[b]CHARACTERS[/b]
- 7 Stars
- Level 85
- Relic Level 6
- Ability Tier 8

data.ALL_HANS_ON_DECK_LIGHTSPEED_INFO:
[c][F0FF23]MERGE UNITS[-][/c]

Units included in the Lightspeed Bundle are upgraded according to a predetermined set of upgrade criteria (listed below). The Lightspeed Bundle does not directly grant character shards / ship blueprints or resources used in merge upgrades. The upgrade criteria are evaluated against your existing roster, and your units are set to the greater of the two values.

Each unit will first be evaluated for existing shards or star rarity against the bundle upgrade criteria. A unit at lower star rarity (or unactivated with less cumulative shards/blueprints) than the bundle upgrade criteria will be upgraded and activated. Units that exceed the star rarity (or cumulative shards/blueprints) will be activated (if unactivated) and then evaluated for additional attributes (gear tier, ability tier, etc). Any surplus shards/blueprints over the bundle upgrade criteria will be retained.

If your previously unlocked units meet or exceed the bundle upgrade criteria for other attributes, any surplus value will be retained.

[c][AFFFFFFF]CHARACTERS[-][/c]
- 7 Stars
- Level 85
- Relic Level 6
- Ability Tier 7

data.BAD_BATCH_LIGHTSPEED_BUNDLE_INFO:
[c][F0FF23]MERGE UNITS[-][/c]

Units included in the Lightspeed Bundle are upgraded according to a predetermined set of upgrade criteria (listed below). The Lightspeed Bundle does not directly grant character shards / ship blueprints or resources used in merge upgrades. The upgrade criteria are evaluated against your existing roster, and your units are set to the greater of the two values.

Each unit will first be evaluated for existing shards or star rarity against the bundle upgrade criteria. A unit at lower star rarity (or unactivated with less cumulative shards/blueprints) than the bundle upgrade criteria will be upgraded and activated. Units that exceed the star rarity (or cumulative shards/blueprints) will be activated (if unactivated) and then evaluated for additional attributes (gear tier, ability tier, etc). Any surplus shards/blueprints over the bundle upgrade criteria will be retained.

If your previously unlocked units meet or exceed the bundle upgrade criteria for other attributes, any surplus value will be retained.

[b]CHARACTERS[/b]
- 7 Stars
- Level 85
- Relic Level 5
- Ability Tier 7

data.BARRISS_OFFEE_UPDATE_MESSAGE: Our team has identified an issue with Barriss Offee in which allies were still recovering 20% Max Health whenever they were critically hit even after Barriss was no longer present in the battle. This has been flagged as a bug as her Zeta ability was not meant to persist after death. Today, we will be removing the Zeta upgrade and granting them back to each respective player via inbox message in order to allow them the ability to choose whether or not they want to invest in this character again. We apologize for any inconvenience!

data.BASICABILITY_GLHONDO_TIER_01_DESC:
Deal Physical damage to target enemy and gain 1 stack of Profit. If this ability scores a critical hit, all Pirate allies also gain a stack of Profit.

If it is Pirate King Hondo Ohnaka's turn and the target enemy is Jedi or Sith, remove 2% Turn Meter for each buff and debuff on them. If any Turn Meter was removed, Hondo gains 3% Ultimate Charge.

If Pirate King Hondo had 10 or more stacks of Profit at the start of his turn, this ability is guaranteed to critically hit if able.
data.BASICABILITY_GLHONDO_TIER_02_DESC:
Deal Physical damage to target enemy and gain 1 stack of Profit. If this ability scores a critical hit, all Pirate allies also gain a stack of Profit.

If it is Pirate King Hondo Ohnaka's turn, call a random Pirate Attacker and a random other Pirate ally to assist dealing 2% more damage for each stack of Profit on all 3 allies and if the target enemy is Jedi or Sith, remove 2% Turn Meter for each buff and debuff on them. If any Turn Meter was removed, Hondo gains 3% Ultimate Charge.

If Pirate King Hondo had 10 or more stacks of Profit at the start of his turn, this ability is guaranteed to critically hit if able.

data.BASICABILITY_GLLEIA_TIER_02_DESC:
Deal Physical damage to target enemy. Rebel allies gain Retribution for 2 turns.

On Leia's turn, deal bonus True damage to target enemy equal to 10% of the damage other Rebel allies received since her last turn and deal additional effects based on the target enemy's role:

- [c][B5E7F5]Attackers:[-][/c] Dispel all buffs on target enemy and reduce their Speed by 5 (max 200) per buff dispelled until the end of the encounter
- [c][B5E7F5]Healers and Supports:[-][/c] Dispel all debuffs on all Rebel allies, equalize Leia's Health and Protection with the weakest other Rebel ally, then recover 20% Health and Protection
- [c][B5E7F5]Tanks:[-][/c] Call all other Rebel allies to assist (limit once per turn) and reduce the target enemy's Max Health by 5% per Rebel ally until the end of the encounter

data.BASICABILITY_RANCORDOORFUNCTIONAL_DESC:
When this device is disabled, the pit door will close on the Rancor, Toppling it for 1 turn and granting attacking units a Morale bonus:

Morale I: All attacking units gain 100% Critical Chance.
Morale II: If the Rancor has 50% Health or less in its current phase, all attacking units gain 25% Speed.
Morale III: All attacking units that have more than 50% Health when the Rancor becomes Toppled gain 50% Offense.

data.BATTLE_OF_HOTH_LIGHTSPEED_INFO:
[c][F0FF23]MERGE UNITS[-][/c]

Units included in the Lightspeed Bundle are upgraded according to a predetermined set of upgrade criteria (listed below). The Lightspeed Bundle does not directly grant character shards / ship blueprints or resources used in merge upgrades. The upgrade criteria are evaluated against your existing roster, and your units are set to the greater of the two values.

Each unit will first be evaluated for existing shards or star rarity against the bundle upgrade criteria. A unit at lower star rarity (or unactivated with less cumulative shards/blueprints) than the bundle upgrade criteria will be upgraded and activated. Units that exceed the star rarity (or cumulative shards/blueprints) will be activated (if unactivated) and then evaluated for additional attributes (gear tier, ability tier, etc). Any surplus shards/blueprints over the bundle upgrade criteria will be retained.

If your previously unlocked units meet or exceed the bundle upgrade criteria for other attributes, any surplus value will be retained.

[c][AFFFFFFF]CHARACTERS[-][/c]
- 7 Stars
- Level 85
- Relic Level 5
- Ability Tier 7

data.BAYLANSKOLL_GUIDE_DESCRIPTION: Baylan Skoll was once a Jedi Knight and Jedi General who served in the Clone Wars alongside such notable Jedi as Anakin Skywalker. Baylan would survive Order 66 and the extinction of the Jedi carried out shortly thereafter. His time between then and when the New Republic rose to reclaim the galaxy is shrouded in mystery, but eventually he took on an apprentice, Shin Hati. The pair acted as mercenaries as he trained her in the ways of the Force. They would eventually find themselves employed by Morgan Elsbeth, whose mission to find and recover Grand Admiral Thrawn would bring Baylan to the ancient planet of Peridea. Here, Baylan and Shin went their separate ways, following different destinies. On Peridea, Baylan found himself one step closer to his ultimate goal.

data.BB_8_LIGHTSPEED_BUNDLE_INFO:
[c][F0FF23]MERGE UNITS[-][/c]

Units included in the Lightspeed Bundle are upgraded according to a predetermined set of upgrade criteria (listed below). The Lightspeed Bundle does not directly grant character shards / ship blueprints or resources used in merge upgrades. The upgrade criteria are evaluated against your existing roster, and your units are set to the greater of the two values.

Each unit will first be evaluated for existing shards or star rarity against the bundle upgrade criteria. A unit at lower star rarity (or unactivated with less cumulative shards/blueprints) than the bundle upgrade criteria will be upgraded and activated. Units that exceed the star rarity (or cumulative shards/blueprints) will be activated (if unactivated) and then evaluated for additional attributes (gear tier, ability tier, etc). Any surplus shards/blueprints over the bundle upgrade criteria will be retained.

If your previously unlocked units meet or exceed the bundle upgrade criteria for other attributes, any surplus value will be retained.

[c][AFFFFFFF]CHARACTERS[-][/c]
- 7 Stars
- Level 85
- Relic Level 5
- Ability Tier 7

data.BO_KATAN_MANDALOR_LIGHTSPEED_INFO:
[b]MERGE UNITS[/b]

Units included in the Lightspeed Bundle are upgraded according to a predetermined set of upgrade criteria (listed below). The Lightspeed Bundle does not directly grant character shards / ship blueprints or resources used in merge upgrades. The upgrade criteria are evaluated against your existing roster, and your units are set to the greater of the two values.

Each unit will first be evaluated for existing shards or star rarity against the bundle upgrade criteria. A unit at lower star rarity (or unactivated with less cumulative shards/blueprints) than the bundle upgrade criteria will be upgraded and activated. Units that exceed the star rarity (or cumulative shards/blueprints) will be activated (if unactivated) and then evaluated for additional attributes (gear tier, ability tier, etc). Any surplus shards/blueprints over the bundle upgrade criteria will be retained.

If your previously unlocked units meet or exceed the bundle upgrade criteria for other attributes, any surplus value will be retained.

[b]CHARACTERS[/b]
- 7 Stars
- Level 85
- Relic Level 7
- Ability Tier 7

data.BOMBAD_GENERAL_UNIQUEABILITY_B1BATTLEDRO:
B1 gains an additional 180 stacks of Droid Battalion. At the start of every 2 turns from any character, gain 1 stack of [c][f0ff23]All Units, Advance![-][/c] (max 10) at the start of this character's turn. Lose 1 stack of [c][f0ff23]All Units, Advance![-][/c] whenever 48 stacks of Droid Battalion have been removed.

B1 can't score critical hits or be revived. B1 has no Protection, 1 Health, and 20 stacks of Droid Battalion, and can't be defeated or destroyed while they have Droid Battalion. When all stacks of Droid Battalion expire, B1 is immediately destroyed. B1 is immune to Damage Over Time, and their Max Health and Max Protection can't be increased.

When B1 takes damage, they dispel all debuffs on themselves and lose 8 stacks of Droid Battalion. At the start of B1's turn, they gain 3 stacks of Droid Battalion.

B1 is immune to damage from Lord of Betrayal in the Sith Triumvirate Raid.

[c][f0ff23]Droid Battalion:[-][/c] Each stack grants B1 +2% Offense and all Separatist allies +0.5% Tenacity and Critical Avoidance
data.BOMBAD_GENERAL_UNIQUEABILITY_DROIDEKA01_:
Gain 3 stacks of Resilient Defense at the start of the encounter and when summoned. Gain 1 additional stack of Charge whenever an enemy begins their turn and remove 1 stack of Charge whenever a buff is dispelled. Whenever Droideka loses Damage Immunity, remove 5 stacks of Charge and gain 50 Speed and Stun Immunity until the next time it uses Destructive Armament. If Droideka begins its turn with Damage Immunity, it gains 10 stacks of Charge.

Droideka gains 2% Turn Meter and 1 stack of [c][f0ff23]Charge[-][/c] for 1 turn whenever an enemy takes a turn. Droideka has +50% Speed unless it has Damage Immunity. If Droideka has Damage Immunity, it has -50% Speed.

[c][f0ff23]Charge:[-][/c] +5% Offense per stack
data.BOMBAD_GENERAL_UNIQUEABILITY_MAUL01_DESC:
Darth Maul takes reduced damage from percent Health damage effects, ignores Taunt, and gains 15% Turn Meter at the end of each enemy's turn. Whenever Darth Maul has 6 or more dispellable debuffs, he dispels all debuffs on himself and gains a bonus turn.

Darth Maul gains 20% Max Health, gains Max Health equal to 10% of the damage he deals, and Potency equal to 0.3% of his Max Health. Whenever an enemy is defeated, Darth Maul gains bonuses for the rest of the encounter.

First Enemy: 25% Critical Chance
Second Enemy: 25% Evasion
Third Enemy: 25% Max Health recovery on hitting with an attack
data.BOMBAD_GENERAL_UNIQUEABILITY_NUTEGUNRAY0:
Nute Gunray no longer revives when defeated, takes reduced damage from percent Health damage effects and gains 15% Turn Meter at the end of each enemy's turn. The first time Nute Gunray's Health is reduced to 1%, he gains 100% Health, Protection, and Turn Meter, Stealths for 2 turns, his cooldowns are reset, and he summons a Droideka to the battle. Nute grants the Extortion ability on a random enemy at the start of his turn.

Enemies with Extortion have -15% Speed and Offense.

The first time Nute Gunray is defeated, he is revived with 100% Health and Turn Meter. Every time Nute Gunray is revived, he Stealths for 2 turns.
data.BOMBAD_GENERAL_UNIQUEABILITY_STAP01_DESC:
STAP gains 3 stacks of Overcharge at the start of battle. Whenever an enemy attacks out of turn, they lose 3% Max Protection for the rest of the encounter. While STAP has 3 or more stacks of Overcharge, it has +100% counter chance, and debuff immunity.

STAP gains 10 Speed for each stack of Overcharge on them.

Whenever STAP uses an ability other than We Need To Recharge!, they lose a stack of Overcharge.

Whenever STAP or an allied Separatist Droid Tank takes True damage from an enemy, all Separatist Droid allies lose 15% Turn Meter (limit once per enemy per turn)

data.C_3PO_LIGHTSPEED_BUNDLE_II_INFO:
[b]MERGE UNITS[/b]

Units included in the Lightspeed Bundle are upgraded according to a predetermined set of upgrade criteria (listed below). The Lightspeed Bundle does not directly grant character shards / ship blueprints or resources used in merge upgrades. The upgrade criteria are evaluated against your existing roster, and your units are set to the greater of the two values.

Each unit will first be evaluated for existing shards or star rarity against the bundle upgrade criteria. A unit at lower star rarity (or unactivated with less cumulative shards/blueprints) than the bundle upgrade criteria will be upgraded and activated. Units that exceed the star rarity (or cumulative shards/blueprints) will be activated (if unactivated) and then evaluated for additional attributes (gear tier, ability tier, etc). Any surplus shards/blueprints over the bundle upgrade criteria will be retained.

If your previously unlocked units meet or exceed the bundle upgrade criteria for other attributes, any surplus value will be retained.

[b]CHARACTERS[/b]
- 7 Stars
- Level 85
- Relic Level 7
- Ability Tier 7

data.CHAMPIONSHIP_INFO_LEAGUE_DESCRIPTION_V2: [ACFEFF]There are[-] [FFED8D]five leagues[-][ACFEFF] in Grand Arena Championships, and [FFED8D]each league contains five divisions[-][ACFEFF]. At the end of each Grand Arena round, players can move to a higher or lower division depending on their performance within the round.\n\nAt the end of each Grand Arena season, players who finish in Division 1 of their league are promoted to the next league up, and players who finish in Division 5 are relegated to the next league down.[-]
data.CHAMPIONSHIP_INFO_MATCHMAKING_DESCRIPTIO: [ACFEFF]Matchmaking looks only at a player's[-] [FFED8D]skill rating[-][ACFEFF], and at the beginning of each Grand Arena event, groups of 8 players with similar skill ratings are created. During each round in an event, players are paired by win-loss record within the event.[-]
data.CHAMPIONSHIP_INFO_STRUCTURE_DESCRIPTION_:
[ACFEFF]A Grand Arena season consists of[-] [FFED8D]three 1-week-long events[-][ACFEFF]. A match-made group of[-] [FFED8D]8 players[-][ACFEFF] competes in each weekly event.

Each event has a 24-hour Join phase, and players may only join the event during this phase. Afterwards, there are 3 rounds, each consisting of two 24-hour phases: the Defense phase and the Attack phase.

Players are matched against new opponents in each round. Players earn round rewards at the end of each round, event rewards at the end of each event, and season rewards at the end of the season.[-]

data.CHEWBACCA_LIGHTSPEED_INFO:
[c][F0FF23]MERGE UNITS[-][/c]

Units included in the Lightspeed Bundle are upgraded according to a predetermined set of upgrade criteria (listed below). The Lightspeed Bundle does not directly grant character shards / ship blueprints or resources used in merge upgrades. The upgrade criteria are evaluated against your existing roster, and your units are set to the greater of the two values.

Each unit will first be evaluated for existing shards or star rarity against the bundle upgrade criteria. A unit at lower star rarity (or unactivated with less cumulative shards/blueprints) than the bundle upgrade criteria will be upgraded and activated. Units that exceed the star rarity (or cumulative shards/blueprints) will be activated (if unactivated) and then evaluated for additional attributes (gear tier, ability tier, etc). Any surplus shards/blueprints over the bundle upgrade criteria will be retained.

If your previously unlocked units meet or exceed the bundle upgrade criteria for other attributes, any surplus value will be retained.

[c][AFFFFFFF]CHARACTERS[-][/c]
- 7 Stars
- Level 85
- Relic Level 5

data.COLISEUM_INFO_FEATURE_INFO_BODY:
The [c][ffffff]Coliseum[-][/c] is a daily Event where you use your Era Units to defeat a [c][ffffff]Coliseum Boss[-][/c] encounter! Only [c][ffffff]Era Units[-][/c] can be used in the Coliseum. There are 4 different Coliseum Bosses each Era, and which one you face rotates each day.

Each boss has several [c][ffffff]difficulty tiers[-][/c]. All players start at Tier 1 difficulty for each boss. Fully depleting a Coliseum Boss' health bar wins the difficulty tier and unlocks the next one. Beware that bosses become more deadly and durable as their health is depleted! Dealing damage to the boss earns points, and reaching certain score thresholds for the first time in each tier will also grant one-time rewards!

Your score on the [c][ffffff]Coliseum Leaderboard[-][/c] is determined by the tier of the boss you faced and the score you earned. Tier progress and top score is saved per boss across the entire Era, but the leaderboard resets each day. You may attempt the Coliseum up to 5 times each day, and your leaderboard placement is based on your best Coliseum attempt that day. At the end of each day you'll receive Coliseum rewards based on your leaderboard position.

The highest tier has an [c][ffffff]overtime phase[-][/c]. Players who get to 100% on this tier get extra time to deal as much damage as they can to increase their score on the leaderboard.

data.COMMANDER_AHSOKA_LIGHTSPEED_INFO:
[c][F0FF23]MERGE UNITS[-][/c]

Units included in the Lightspeed Bundle are upgraded according to a predetermined set of upgrade criteria (listed below). The Lightspeed Bundle does not directly grant character shards / ship blueprints or resources used in merge upgrades. The upgrade criteria are evaluated against your existing roster, and your units are set to the greater of the two values.

Each unit will first be evaluated for existing shards or star rarity against the bundle upgrade criteria. A unit at lower star rarity (or unactivated with less cumulative shards/blueprints) than the bundle upgrade criteria will be upgraded and activated. Units that exceed the star rarity (or cumulative shards/blueprints) will be activated (if unactivated) and then evaluated for additional attributes (gear tier, ability tier, etc). Any surplus shards/blueprints over the bundle upgrade criteria will be retained.

If your previously unlocked units meet or exceed the bundle upgrade criteria for other attributes, any surplus value will be retained.

[b]CHARACTERS[/b]
- 7 Stars
- Level 85
- Relic Level 5
- Ability Tier 7

data.CONTEXTUALMSG_CHAR_DIALOG_ONBOARDING_01_: This hero has the highest Speed so he takes the first turn. \nClick his Basic Ability icon to attack.
data.CONTEXTUALMSG_CHAR_DIALOG_ONBOARDING_01a: Take out that first droid!\n\nUse Anakin's [f0ff23]BASIC ATTACK[-].

data.CONTEXTUALMSG_CHAR_DIALOG_ONBOARDING_ENE: Hmm. Looks like the [f0ff23]B2 SUPER BATTLE DROID[-] boss is getting healed by the weaker droid.\n\nClick to [f0ff23]TARGET[-] the healer, and then attack it first.
data.CONTEXTUALMSG_CHAR_DIALOG_ONBOARDING_TAU: That unit just used a [f0ff23]TAUNT[-] ability!\n\nNow all of their opponents must target them!
data.CONTEXTUALMSG_CHAR_DIALOG_ONBOARDING_TU3: [f0ff23]ANAKIN SKYWALKER[-] and [f0ff23]AHSOKA TANO[-] are now in your roster! These heroes of the Clone Wars faced dangerous foes like the Dark Side apprentice Asajj Ventress!
data.CONTEXTUALMSG_CHAR_DIALOG_STORY_MID01_IN: We are looking for two droids, they would have been wandering the Jundland Wastes.
<Ah, yes! We recovered those droids yesterday. Perhaps we can interest you in...>
Sir, we have followed one of the droids' tracks to this point. It looks like it was picked up by a large vehicle.
Sir! There's a group of Tusken Raiders over the ridge, heading this way.
Raiders... Get ready men. We'll deal with those scavenging Jawas after we're done with this lot.
data.CONTEXTUALMSG_CHAR_DIALOG_STORY_MID01_OU: Well done, men. Where are the droids?!
<We sold them to a moisture farmer... by the name of Lars!  Please, we are only scavengers...>
Thank you for your cooperation.  Men, make this look like the Tusken Raiders were here.  Let's go find that moisture farm.
data.CONTEXTUALMSG_CHAR_DIALOG_STORY_MIL01_IN: Jedi Knight Secura, failing the Western Front is. Pushed back it must be.
Yes, Master Yoda, We'll attack now. Let's go, squad!
data.CONTEXTUALMSG_CHAR_DIALOG_STORY_MIL01_OU: The Western Front has been secured, Master Yoda.
Good, very good. Find Kit Fisto. Alongside him next you must fight.

data.CONTEXTUALMSG_FEATUREINTRO_MODACQUIRED_0: Well done, you've just earned a [f0ff23]MOD[-]!\n\nLet's go assign it to a character.
Tap here to view your collection of Characters eligible for Mods.
Click here to view your collection of Characters eligible for Mods.
Characters must be level 50 or higher to have Mods assigned.\n\nOnly qualified characters will be displayed here.
Let's assign the Mod you just earned to this Character.
Every character has six Mod slots. Each of which requires Mods that fit that slot.
Only Transmitters (Square Shaped Mods) fit in this slot.\n\nLet's assign it now.
Now tap here to select the Transmitter.
Now click here to select the Transmitter.
data.CONTEXTUALMSG_FEATUREINTRO_MODACQUIRED_1: Assigning a Mod to an empty slot is a trivial task for me.\n\nRemoving them is a bit more difficult.
Mods are very powerful augments to your Characters and there are many more you can win throughout the Cantina.

data.CONTEXTUALMSG_FEATUREINTRO_MODMAXLEVEL_0: Congratulations!\n\nThis Mod is now at its maximum level.

data.CONTEXTUALMSG_FEATUREINTRO_MODSETCOMPLET: You just completed your first Mod Set!
Mod Sets provide a huge boost to a Character's stats.
There are numerous types of Mod Sets, each providing a unique boost.
Tap here to learn more about Mod Set Bonuses.
Click here to learn more about Mod Set Bonuses.
Some sets require two of the same Mod Type whereas others require four.
That means you're able to combine the effects of a single four piece set with that of a two piece.
Or you're able to fashion together three complete, two piece sets!
You're also able to complete multiples of the same set and their bonuses will all apply.
This allows you to have three completions of the Health Mod Set resulting in a massive amount of Health!
Mod Set Bonuses gain additional power once all its included Mods reach level 15 but I'll explain more about that later.
Every character is unique, so experiment with various sets to discover the best strategy.\n\nGood luck!

data.CONTEXTUALMSG_FTUE_RAIDS_TU32_NONLEGACY_: Ah, your Guild has unlocked Raids beyond the Sith Triumvirate! These Raids are limited by faction, and each Guild Member has a limited number of Raid attempts. Characters used in an attempt, as well as the number of attempts, do not refresh each day.

The Raid Points you earn are added to both a [f0ff23]GUILD REWARDS[-] track and a [f0ff23]PERSONAL REWARDS[-] track. Guild Rewards are granted to all participants at the end of the Raid. Personal Rewards are based on your own contributions, and can be claimed as soon as you earn them!
Attempting higher [f0ff23]DIFFICULTY LEVELS[-] is the best way to earn more points, and more rewards! You can choose the Difficulty Level you want with each attempt you make.
Here are all the Difficulty Levels you can choose for this Raid. Higher difficulties make it harder for your squads to survive, but also apply a [f0ff23]MULTIPLIER[-] to the points you earn!
Each of your attempts in this Raid have a [f0ff23]MAXIMUM[-] number of points they can earn. Higher Difficulty Levels also increase this maximum, for more potential points earned!

Difficulty Levels often have requirements. If they do, every character in your squad must satisfy the Gear or Relic requirement of the selected Difficulty Level in order to make an attempt at that level.

When you select a Difficulty Level, it also applies the modifiers of all previous levels, so make sure you know what you're getting into! Remember, you can change your selected Difficulty Level before every one of your attempts at the Raid.

data.CONTEXTUALMSG_OFFICER_GUILD_START_RAID_T: Each Raid is launched with [f0ff23]RAID TICKETS[-]. Guild members can maximize tickets earned by spending up to 600 Energy a day.
Once a [f0ff23]RAID[-] is started, Guild Members join the raid automatically. In Non-Heroic raids there is a 3-day time limit and characters refresh daily to be used again in Raid attempts.
In [f0ff23]HEROIC RAIDS[-] characters do not refresh daily and the time limit is shortened to 2 days.
Only a Guild Leader or Officer can use Raid Tickets to start a Raid. Schedule Raids to be started automatically by using RAID SETTINGS!
data.CONTEXTUALMSG_PRESTIGIOUS_QUESTS_TEXT_01: You've unlocked [f0ff23]PRESTIGIOUS QUESTS[-]! Activate a quest to earn [f0ff23]TITLES[-] and other rewards!
data.CONTEXTUALMSG_PROGRESSIONEVENT_COMPLETIO: Congratulations!\n\nYour Grand Master Yoda may now reach Seven Stars. This is quite the Achievement!
data.CONTEXTUALMSG_PROGRESSIONEVENT_INTRO_GRA: A new [f0ff23]Limited Time Event[-] is available!

This Limited Time Event is [f0ff23]Grand Master's Training[-].\n\nIt's highly sought after as it's the [f0ff23]ONLY[-] place to Activate and Promote one of the most notable of Heroes... Grand Master Yoda!
Each Tier of difficulty requires a full Squad of Jedi at a specific Rarity Requirement.
Complete enough of the Battles and earn enough Character Shards to Activate the Grand Master himself.
Complete ALL of the Battles and Promote him to 7-Star Rarity!
Even though it's a Limited Time Event, don't worry... [f0ff23]it will come back[-] in the near future.
So get going, earn some Jedi, and try your best against Grand Master Yoda!\n\nAlthough Yoda would say, "Do. Or do not. There is no try."

data.CONTEXTUALMSG_TB_JABBA_GEONOSISMISSION_M: We've discovered a new recording concerning Jabba the Hutt's involvement in this Territory Battle! Let's take a listen.
You know, Jabba and I once fought Kenobi, Skywalker, and his apprentice on Geonosis. One could say we were the champions of the Petranaki arena.
...and that was the first of many, many victories over the Jedi. They really could learn a thing or two from me.
That's not how Ahsoka tells it. I don't think she was even at the Battle of Geonosis.
Well, what does she know. Come along, that's enough chit chat.
data.CONTEXTUALMSG_TB_JABBA_HOTHMISSION_MESSA: We've discovered a new recording concerning Jabba the Hutt's involvement in this Territory Battle! Let's take a listen.
Why just let me tell you about the time I helped Jabba capture the notorious criminal, Han Solo...
Oh, this ought to be good.
...and THAT is how we brought Solo to justice. Before Jabba the Hutt's untimely demise, of course.
Uh huh. You know it was Boba Fett who captured Han, right? My friend Han. Who I rescued.
That's ridiculous. Anyway, it's your turn to deal.

data.CONTRABAND_INJECTOR_BUNDLE_DESC:
This bundle contains some of the key salvage needed to create Characters' G12 Injectors, including Kyrotechs and all forms of Injector Salvage!

Each Bundle contains 25 each of: Injector Cell Salvage, Injector Head Salvage, and Injector Handle Salvage.

Additionally, each Bundle awards a varying number of Mk 7 Kyrotech Shock Prod Prototype Salvage and Mk 9 Kyrotech Battle Computer Prototype Salvage. The number of each item awarded is determined separately. There is a [b]20% chance[/b] to obtain 15 of the Item, a [b]45% chance[/b] to obtain 25 of the Item, a [b]30% chance[/b] to obtain 50 of the Item, and a [b]5% chance[/b] to obtain 100 of the Item!

Purchase today and upgrade your Gear before this valuable deal disappears from the store!

[i]Please note: Once crafted, Power Cell Injectors are unique and can only be equipped to the character they are crafted for.[/i]

Purchase limit: 2

data.CUP_LIGHTSPEED_BUNDLE_INFO:
[c][F0FF23]MERGE UNITS[-][/c]

Units included in the Lightspeed Bundle are upgraded according to a predetermined set of upgrade criteria (listed below). The Lightspeed Bundle does not directly grant character shards / ship blueprints or resources used in merge upgrades. The upgrade criteria are evaluated against your existing roster, and your units are set to the greater of the two values.

Each unit will first be evaluated for existing shards or star rarity against the bundle upgrade criteria. A unit at lower star rarity (or unactivated with less cumulative shards/blueprints) than the bundle upgrade criteria will be upgraded and activated. Units that exceed the star rarity (or cumulative shards/blueprints) will be activated (if unactivated) and then evaluated for additional attributes (gear tier, ability tier, etc). Any surplus shards/blueprints over the bundle upgrade criteria will be retained.

If your previously unlocked units meet or exceed the bundle upgrade criteria for other attributes, any surplus value will be retained.

[b]CHARACTERS[/b]
- 7 Stars
- Level 85
- Relic Level 9
- Ability Tier 7

data.DAILY_GUILD_CONTRIBUTION_CHANGE_DESC:
The Daily Activity “Personal Guild Contribution” has been removed and a new way to contribute Guild Bank Coins has been implemented! Track your personal contribution to your guild in the new Guild Activities section in the Guild area of the Cantina.

Due to this change, we are going to grant some Guild Bank Coins to offset any loss of Coins accrued. In addition, we know that last week there was a server bug where Guilds completed a Raid with a single individual doing an extraordinary amount of damage. Due to this bug, we've decided to increase the amount of Guild Bank Coins your Guild will receive, from 15,000 to 75,000.

All Guilds will receive 75,000 Guild Bank Coins when the Guild Leader logs in.

data.DARK_MOFF_GIDEON_LIGHTSPEED_INFO:
[b]MERGE UNITS[/b]

Units included in the Lightspeed Bundle are upgraded according to a predetermined set of upgrade criteria (listed below). The Lightspeed Bundle does not directly grant character shards / ship blueprints or resources used in merge upgrades. The upgrade criteria are evaluated against your existing roster, and your units are set to the greater of the two values.

Each unit will first be evaluated for existing shards or star rarity against the bundle upgrade criteria. A unit at lower star rarity (or unactivated with less cumulative shards/blueprints) than the bundle upgrade criteria will be upgraded and activated. Units that exceed the star rarity (or cumulative shards/blueprints) will be activated (if unactivated) and then evaluated for additional attributes (gear tier, ability tier, etc). Any surplus shards/blueprints over the bundle upgrade criteria will be retained.

If your previously unlocked units meet or exceed the bundle upgrade criteria for other attributes, any surplus value will be retained.

[b]CHARACTERS[/b]
- 7 Stars
- Level 85
- Relic Level 6
- Ability Tier 8

data.DARTH_VADER_LIGHTSPEED_INFO:
[c][F0FF23]MERGE UNITS[-][/c]

Units included in the Lightspeed Bundle are upgraded according to a predetermined set of upgrade criteria (listed below). The Lightspeed Bundle does not directly grant character shards / ship blueprints or resources used in merge upgrades. The upgrade criteria are evaluated against your existing roster, and your units are set to the greater of the two values.

Each unit will first be evaluated for existing shards or star rarity against the bundle upgrade criteria. A unit at lower star rarity (or unactivated with less cumulative shards/blueprints) than the bundle upgrade criteria will be upgraded and activated. Units that exceed the star rarity (or cumulative shards/blueprints) will be activated (if unactivated) and then evaluated for additional attributes (gear tier, ability tier, etc). Any surplus shards/blueprints over the bundle upgrade criteria will be retained.

If your previously unlocked units meet or exceed the bundle upgrade criteria for other attributes, any surplus value will be retained.

[b]CHARACTERS[/b]
- 4 Stars
- Level 19
- Gear Level 6
- Ability Tier 1

data.DATACRON_CHARACTER_C3POCHEWBACCA_001_DES: Threepio & Chewie are immune to Daze. Whenever they use a Basic ability, they gain 5% Offense (stacking) and all Rebel allies gain Protection Up (50%) for 1 turn. Whenever a Rebel ally scores a critical hit, dispel all debuffs on them.
data.DATACRON_CHARACTER_CALKESTIS_001_DESC: Cal Kestis has +100% Potency and all other Light Side or Dark Side Unaligned Force Users gain half that amount. The weakest enemy is Stunned at the start of the encounter for 1 turn, which can't be resisted, and then gains a bonus turn. Whenever Cal applies a debuff, Light Side and Dark Side Unaligned Force Users allies gain 3% Turn Meter. Whenever an enemy attacks a Light Side or Dark Side Unaligned Force User ally with Protection Up, they are inflicted with Speed Down for 1 turn.
data.DATACRON_CHARACTER_CANDEROUSORDO_001_DES: If Canderous Ordo has an Old Republic ally in the Leader slot at the start of battle, whenever a Damage Over Time effect expires on an enemy, they regain Damage Over Time for 2 turns and Canderous Ordo recovers 10% Health and Protection.
data.DATACRON_CHARACTER_CAPTAINDROGAN_001_DES: At the start of battle, all Rebel allies gain Keen Stratagem and Captain Drogan takes a bonus turn. All Rebel allies gain 200% Max Health and are immune to Ability Block and Fear until the end of their first turn.
data.DATACRON_CHARACTER_CAPTAINENOCH_001_DESC: At the start of battle and if Captain Enoch is in the Leader slot, all other Imperial Remnant allies are immune to critical hits until he is defeated, and he gains 50% Max Health and Protection. Whenever Captain Enoch is critically hit, Tank allies Taunt for 1 turn.
data.DATACRON_CHARACTER_CAPTAINPHASMA_001_DES: During Captain Phasma's turn, she dispels all debuffs on all allies. If debuffs are dispelled this way, they gain Advantage for 2 turns.\n\nAt the start of each encounter, if Captain Phasma is in the Leader slot: All allies gain 100% Max Health and Max Protection and 200% Defense. Whenever another ally uses an ability during their turn, Rey (Scavenger) assists if she has no debuffs. Whenever an ally attacks out of turn, they remove 15% Turn Meter from the target enemy and inflict Protection Disruption for 2 turns, which can't be resisted.
data.DATACRON_CHARACTER_CAPTAINREX_001_DESC: At the start of battle, Clone Trooper and Phoenix allies gain 7,567 Max Health and 30 Speed. Whenever another Clone Trooper or Phoenix ally is inflicted with Ability Block or Daze, they dispel it and inflict 2 stacks of Damage Over Time on all enemies for 3 turns, which can't be evaded or resisted.
data.DATACRON_CHARACTER_CAPTAINSILVO_001_DESC: Whenever Captain Silvo removes Turn Meter from an enemy, he recovers 20% Health and Protection, and resets the cooldown of a random Pirate ally.
data.DATACRON_CHARACTER_CARADUNE_001_DESC: Whenever Cara Dune removes Turn Meter from an enemy, she deals damage to them equal to 25% of their Max Health.
data.DATACRON_CHARACTER_CARTHONASI_001_DESC:
Carth Onasi has +100% Max Health, Max Protection, and Potency and he gains 15% Turn Meter whenever another character ends their turn. Whenever he uses his Basic ability, he attacks two more times.

Whenever an Old Republic ally resists a debuff, they dispel all debuffs on themselves and gain 10% Tenacity (stacking) until the end of battle. Whenever an Old Republic ally is Dazed, they dispel it. When they dispel Daze, they gain 15% Turn Meter.

Whenever Carth uses a Special ability, he triggers the damage of all Damage Over Time debuffs on enemies.

Whenever an enemy is defeated, Carth gains 25% Offense (stacking) and Critical Damage (stacking) until the end of the battle, his cooldowns are reset, and he gains 100% Turn Meter.
data.DATACRON_CHARACTER_CHIEFNEBIT_001_DESC: Whenever Chief Nebit calls allies to assist, he recovers 10% Health and Protection for each ally that assists, and other Jawa allies recover 5% Health and Protection.\nWhenever an enemy is inflicted with Thermal Detonator, there is a 50% chance to inflict an additional Thermal Detonator for 2 turns.
data.DATACRON_CHARACTER_CHIEFNIBET_001_DESC: At the start of battle, if all other allies are Jawa, Kuiil, or IG-11, all allies gain the Droid, Jawa, and Scoundrel tag for the rest of battle. Whenever Chief Nebit Taunts, he dispels it, grants Taunt to IG-11 for 2 turns, and gains a bonus turn.
data.DATACRON_CHARACTER_CHIRRUTIMWE_001_DESC: If the allied leader is a Rebel Fighter: Whenever an ally gains a stack of Heal Over Time, Chirrut Îmwe and Baze Malbus gain 10% Offense (stacking) until the end of battle. Chirrut also gains 5% Turn Meter (limit once per turn). Whenever he uses a Basic ability, Baze Malbus is called to assist.
data.DATACRON_CHARACTER_CHOPPER_001_DESC: Whenever a Phoenix ally takes damage, all Phoenix allies gain 30% Max Health (stacking) and 30% Offense for 1 turn. Chopper ignores Taunt. Whenever Chopper takes damage while Taunting, Chopper recovers 50% Protection and all Phoenix allies gain 30% Turn Meter until the end of 2 turns.
data.DATACRON_CHARACTER_CLONEWARSCHEWBACCA_00: While Clone Wars Chewbacca has Taunt, all Wookiee allies deal True damage. While Clone Wars Chewbacca has Defense Up, all Wookiee allies have +100% Counter Chance.\n\nWhenever Clone Wars Chewbacca loses Taunt, he gains Protection Up (15%, stacking) for 2 turns, and reduces the cooldown of all Wookiee allies by 1.
data.DATACRON_CHARACTER_COMMANDERLUKESKYWALKE: Whenever Commander Luke Skywalker has Call to Action and an ally uses an ability on their turn, Commander Luke Skywalker assists (limit once per turn).
data.DATACRON_CHARACTER_CORUSCANTUNDERWORLDPO:
Whenever Coruscant Underworld Police uses a Special ability, Shock all enemies for 2 turns which can't be evaded or resisted.

The first time Coruscant Underworld Police reaches 50% Health he gains Damage Immunity for 3 turns.

At the start of Coruscant Underworld Police's turn, he gains 15% Offense per active ally, his attacks ignore Protection, and a random ally recovers 100% Protection, until the end of his turn.

Whenever Coruscant Underworld Police uses a Special ability call all allies to assist and the target enemy loses 10% Max Health until end of the encounter.
data.DATACRON_CHARACTER_COUNTDOOKU_001_DESC: Count Dooku has +200% Critical Chance and Critical Damage while he is inflicted with a debuff. Whenever a Separatist ally uses a Special ability on their turn, Count Dooku assists and dispels all buffs on the target enemy.\n\nAt the end of his turn, Count Dooku is inflicted with Disarm until the start of his next turn. Whenever Count Dooku takes damage during his turn, the weakest enemy is dealt 200% of that damage, which can't defeat them.
data.DATACRON_CHARACTER_CROSSHAIRS3_001_DESC:
Whenever Crosshair (Scarred) loses a stack of Shaken, he loses another stack of Shaken.

Whenever Crosshair (Scarred) doesn't score a critical hit, he inflicts Buff Immunity on target enemy for 2 turns, which can't be evaded or resisted.

Whenever Crosshair (Scarred) deals damage to an enemy, the weakest ally without Stealth recovers 10% Health and Protection.
data.DATACRON_CHARACTER_CT7567_001_DESC_V2:
At the start of the battle, if the ally in the Leader slot is CT-7567 "Rex", all allies gain 200% Defense for the rest of the battle. Whenever any other ally uses a Special Ability, CT-7567 "Rex" assists. Whenever an ally is inflicted with a debuff, all allies gain 10% Turn Meter.

During CT-7567 "Rex" turn, if an ally is inflicted with Daze, Stun, or Ability Block, dispel it, and inflict Protection Disruption for 2 turns on all enemies, which can't be evaded, dispelled, or resisted.

Whenever an ally loses a stack of Protection Over Time, they gain Foresight for 1 turn.
data.DATACRON_CHARACTER_CUP_002_DESC:
At the start of battle, if there are no Galactic Legend allies, Coruscant Underworld Police gains the following effects:

Whenever Coruscant Underworld Police attacks a Stunned enemy, remove 100% Turn Meter from that enemy, which can't be evaded or resisted, and a random attacker ally gains a bonus turn.

Whenever Coruscant Underworld Police gains Turn Meter, he removes the same amount of Turn Meter from a random enemy.

Galactic Republic allies remove 20% Turn Meter whenever they damage an enemy, which can't be resisted.
data.DATACRON_CHARACTER_DARTHBANE_001_DESC: At the start of Darth Bane's turn, all enemies gain Accuracy Up, Advantage, and Health Steal Up for 1 turn or until they receive damage, and summon a Sith Trooper in the allied ally slot if it is available and there are no other Sith Trooper allies. Darth Bane gains a stack of Siphon whenever he is critically hit. Whenever Darth Bane uses Essence of Dominance, also Siphon Critical Damage. Deceived enemies deal 25% reduced damage to Darth Bane.
data.DATACRON_CHARACTER_DARTHMALGUS_001_DESC: We Have Returned grants an additional 10% Critical Damage and Offense and 15% Defense Penetration.
data.DATACRON_CHARACTER_DARTHNIHILUS_001_DESC:
Whenever Darth Nihilus reduces his cooldowns, he gains 75% Offense and 20% Turn Meter for 1 turn.

Whenever Darth Nihilus defeats an enemy, Expose all enemies for 2 turns, which can't be evaded.

Whenever Darth Nihilus inflicts Damage Over Time on an enemy, all allies gain 3 stacks of Heal Over Time for 2 turns.

If there is another Sith Support ally at the start of the encounter, Darth Nihilus gains 100% Max Health for the rest of the encounter.
data.DATACRON_CHARACTER_DARTHNIHILUS_002_DESC:
At the start of each encounter, if there is another Support ally, Darth Nihilus gains 100% Max Health and Max Protection for the rest of the encounter.

Whenever Darth Nihilus reduces his cooldowns, for each cooldown reduced, he gains 25% Turn Meter and 50% Offense (stacking) for the rest of the encounter.

Whenever Darth Nihilus defeats an enemy, Expose all enemies for 2 turns, which can't be evaded or resisted.

Whenever Darth Nihilus inflicts Damage Over Time on an enemy, all allies gain 3 stacks of Heal Over Time for 2 turns.

Whenever Darth Nihilus attacks out of turn, his cooldown for Annihilate reduces by 1.
data.DATACRON_CHARACTER_DARTHSIDIOUS_001_DESC:
If there are no other active allies at the start of battle:
- Darth Sidious gains 200% Defense, Health Steal, Max Health and Max Protection, 100% counter chance and Critical Chance, and 100 Speed
- He is immune to Daze and Stun
- At the start of his turn, dispel all debuffs on himself and reset all cooldowns
- Whenever he uses his Basic ability, inflict a stack of Damage Over Time for 1 turn, which can't be resisted, and whenever he uses a Special ability, dispel all buffs on all enemies
- Enemies can't assist or attack again if he is targeted
- At the start of each enemy's turn, if they have at least 5 stacks of Damage Over Time they are instantly defeated
- Whenever an enemy is defeated, he recovers 100% Health and Protection
data.DATACRON_CHARACTER_DASHRENDAR_001_DESC: Whenever Dash Rendar critically hits an enemy or inflicts a debuff on an enemy, he gains 8% Max Health, Potency, and Offense (stacking) until the end of battle.
data.DATACRON_CHARACTER_DENGAR_001_DESC: At the start of each encounter, Dengar inflicts Doubt on all enemies for 2 turns, which can't be evaded, dispelled, or resisted.\n\nWhenever an enemy evades Dengar's attack or resists a debuff, all enemies are inflicted with a stack of Damage Over Time and Thermal Detonator for 2 turns, which can't be evaded or resisted.
data.DATACRON_CHARACTER_DIRECTORKRENNIC_002_D: If Director Krennic is in the Leader slot, all allies are immune to Daze and whenever an enemy is inflicted with Ability Block, all allies recover 20% Protection, all allied Tanks Taunt for 2 turns, and Krennic gains a stack of Insight until the end of the encounter (max 10). If an allied Imperial Probe Droid is present, Krennic gains an additional stack of Insight.\n\nIf Krennic has 10 stacks of Insight, whenever an enemy is inflicted with Ability Block, they are inflicted with Ability Block until the end of the encounter, which can't be copied, dispelled, prevented, or resisted.
data.DATACRON_CHARACTER_DOCTORAPHRA_001_DESC: At the end of any Droid ally's turn, Doctor Aphra takes a bonus turn and recovers 5% Health and Protection.
data.DATACRON_CHARACTER_DOCTORAPHRA_002_DESC: Doctor Aphra can't be targeted by enemies if there are active Dark Side Droid allies, and she revives all Dark Side Scoundrel allies when she uses Dangerous Tech. Aphra, Krrsantan, Darth Vader, and Dark Side Droids are immune to Thermal Detonators.
data.DATACRON_CHARACTER_EETHKOTH_001_DESC_V2:
At the start of battle, Galactic Republic Jedi allies gain 100% Offense and 20 Speed, and are immune to Buff Immunity. Eeth gains 100% Max Health and Protection.

If the Leader is a Galactic Republic Jedi, whenever they take damage, Eeth Taunts and gains Foresight until he evades.

Whenever Eeth evades an attack, he gains 10% Turn Meter and all Galactic Republic Jedi allies recover 20% Health and Protection.

Whenever Eeth uses a Special ability, he gains 10% Turn Meter, Blinds all enemies for 2 turns, which can't be evaded, and all Galactic Republic Jedi allies recover 20% Health and Protection and gain Protection Up (50%) for 2 turns.

Whenever Eeth uses a Basic ability, Daze target enemy for 2 turns, which can't be evaded.

Whenever a Galactic Republic Jedi ally gains Foresight, if they didn't already have it, all Galactic Republic Jedi allies gain 20% Turn Meter and recover 20% Health and Protection.
data.DATACRON_CHARACTER_EMBO_001_DESC: At the start of Battle, 90% of Embo's Health is converted to Protection. If Embo has Protection at the start of a turn, he can't be defeated that turn.
data.DATACRON_CHARACTER_ENFYSNEST_001_DESC_V2:
Enfys Nest is immune to Max Health reduction.

Whenever Nest inflicts a debuff on an enemy she gains 20% Critical Damage (stacking) until the end of the encounter.

Whenever Nest uses a Special ability, she attacks again dealing an additional 20% damage as True damage.

Whenever Nest attacks out of turn, she Exposes the target enemy for 2 turns.

At the start of her turn Nest's damage is increased by 10% (stacking) for every enemy turn taken before this turn until the end of her turn and will assist the next other ally to take a turn.
data.DATACRON_CHARACTER_ENFYSNEST_002_DESC_V2:
Enfys Nest is immune to Max Health reduction.

Whenever an ally takes a turn, Enfys Nest assists.

Whenever Enfys Nest inflicts a debuff, she gains 20% Critical Damage (stacking) until end of the encounter.

Whenever Enfys Nest uses a Special ability, she attacks again dealing 20% bonus True damage.

Whenever Enfys Nest attacks out of turn, she Exposes the target enemy for 2 turns.

Whenever an enemy takes a turn, Enfys Nest gains 5% Offense (stacking) until the end of her turn.
data.DATACRON_CHARACTER_EZRABRIDGER_001_DESC: Whenever Ezra Bridger dispels a buff from an enemy during his attack, he deals True Damage to that enemy, which can't be evaded.
data.DATACRON_CHARACTER_FENNECSHAND_001_DESC: Fennec Shand calls a random Bounty Hunter ally to assist whenever she uses a basic ability. At the start of Fennec's turn, she gains a stack of Loyal Hand (max 20 stacks) until the end of the encounter. If Boba Fett, Scion of Jango is in the Leader slot, Fennec also gains a stack of Loyal Hand at the start of his turns, and the benefits she gains from Loyal Hand are also granted to him.
data.DATACRON_CHARACTER_FENNECSHAND_002_DESC: Whenever a Bounty Hunter ally attacks out of turn, Fennec Shand gains Tenacity Up for 1 turn.\n\nWhenever Fennec Shand damages an enemy with Armor Shred, she deals bonus True damage equal to 3% of their Max Health to the target enemy, recovers 5% Protection, and dispels buffs from all enemies.
data.DATACRON_CHARACTER_FIFTHBROTHER_001_DESC: Fifth Brother deals 10% more damage with The Kill Is Mine for each buff he dispels with it.
data.DATACRON_CHARACTER_FINN_001_DESC: If Finn is in the Leader slot, the first time each turn a Resistance ally inflicts Expose on an enemy or has their Expose resisted, they inflict Expose for 2 turns on all enemies, which can't be evaded or resisted.
data.DATACRON_CHARACTER_FIRSTORDERTROOPER_002: At the start of encounter, First Order Storm Trooper gains 100% Max Health and Max Protection, and the allied Leader gains 50% Armor Penetaration and Offense. Whenever Stun expires or is dispelled from an enemy, First Order Storm Trooper gains 10% Defense and Tenacity (stacking), and the ally in the Leader slot gains 10% Critical Damage (stacking) until the end of encounter.\n\nWhenever another First Order ally is critically hit, First Order Storm Trooper gains Protection Up (25%, stacking) and Taunts for 2 turns. Whenever First Order Storm Trooper uses The Order Relentless, he also dispels all debuffs from all First Order allies and they recover 50% Health.
data.DATACRON_CHARACTER_FOSITHTROOPER_001_DES: Whenever Sith Trooper critically hits an enemy, he gains Stealth for 1 turn. Whenever he loses Stealth, he gains 30% Defense Penetration and 50% Offense for 1 turn.
data.DATACRON_CHARACTER_FULCRUMAHSOKA_001_DES: Whenever Ahsoka Tano (Fulcrum) gains a buff, all Light and Dark Unaligned Force User allies recover 2% Health and Protection.\n\nIf Ahsoka has 4 or more buffs at the start of her turn, she ignores Taunt effects and enemies defeated by Ahsoka can't be revived.
data.DATACRON_CHARACTER_GAMORREANGUARD_001_DE: The max cooldown of Muscle In is reduced by 2. If the ally in the Leader slot is Hutt Cartel and not Gamorrean Guard, whenever they use an ability, Gamorrean Guard assists. Whenever Gamorrean Guard inflicts Damage Over Time on an enemy, there is a 50% chance to inflict an additional Damage Over Time for 3 turns and Hutt Cartel allies gain 10% Max Health (max 50%) and Max Protection (max 50%) (once per turn).
data.DATACRON_CHARACTER_GAMORREANGUARD_002_DE:
At the start of encounter, Gamorrean Guard gains 5 stacks of My Kind of Scum, 100% Potency, 50 Speed. Then he gains 20% Counter Chance for each Hutt Cartel ally.

Whenever Gamorrean Guard inflicts a stack of Damage Over Time, he gains Riposte for 2 turns.

While Taunting, he takes 30% reduced damage from enemies with a stack of Damage Over Time or Thermal Detonators.

Whenever Gamorrean Guard removes Turn Meter from an enemy, reduce the cooldown of his abilities by 1.
data.DATACRON_CHARACTER_GARSAXON_001_DESC:
Whenever Gar Saxon inflicts Speed Down on an enemy he also inflicts Vulnerable, which can't be copied, dispelled, evaded, or resisted to all enemies for 1 turn and his cooldowns are reset.

Whenever Gar Saxon attacks out of turn he Blinds the enemy for 1 turn.

If Imperial Super Commando is an active ally, Gar Saxon assists whenever Imperial Super Commando uses a Special ability.
data.DATACRON_CHARACTER_GENERALHUX_001_DESC: If Supreme Leader Kylo Ren is in the allied Leader slot and all allies are First Order at the start of battle (excluding summoned allies), General Hux gains Dominance at the start of each encounter and at the start of each of his turns if he didn't already have it.\n\nDominance expires at the end of the turn whenever General Hux is critically hit.
data.DATACRON_CHARACTER_GENERALKENOBI_001_DES:
At the start of battle, if there are no Galactic Legend allies, whenever General Kenobi Taunts, all allies gain Protection Over Time (75%) for 2 turns, and whenever he loses Taunt, all allies recover 15% Health and Protection, and gain Defense Up for 1 turn.

Whenever General Kenobi attacks during his turn, if he has Foresight, call all other allies to assist, dealing 50% more damage to the target enemy.

The first time another ally falls below 50% Health for the first time, General Kenobi Taunts for 2 turns. If he was already taunting, he gains Damage Immunity for 1 turn.

data.DATACRON_CHARACTER_GLREY_001_DESC: Heir to the Jedi deals 75% more damage for each other active ally.
data.DATACRON_CHARACTER_GRANDADMIRALTHRAWN_00: Whenever Thrawn resists a debuff, all allies recover 10% Health and Protection, and gain 20% Health Steal (stacking) until the end of battle.\n\nWhenever Thrawn attacks out of turn, he ignores Protection, and if the enemy is inflicted with Burning, Thrawn deals 100% bonus damage and removes 100% Turn Meter, which can't be evaded or resisted.
data.DATACRON_CHARACTER_GRANDINQUISITOR_001_D: While Grand Inquisitor is active, Inquisitorius allies are immune to Fear and Stun and whenever an ally or enemy is defeated, Inquisitorius allies gain 50% Turn Meter, Damage Immunity for 1 turn which can't be copied, and their cooldowns are reset.
data.DATACRON_CHARACTER_GRANDMASTERLUKE_001_D: Whenever a Jedi ally gains a stack of Jedi Lessons, that ally gains 25% Turn Meter and deals +50% more damage (stacking, max 150%) until the end of battle.
data.DATACRON_CHARACTER_GRANDMASTERYODA_001_D: If Grand Master Yoda is in the Leader slot and there are no Galactic Legend allies, Galactic Republic Jedi allies gain Foresight at the start of each turn. While Galactic Republic Jedi allies have Foresight (excluding Galactic Legends), they deal 200% more damage.
data.DATACRON_CHARACTER_GRANDMOFFTARKIN_001_D: Whenever Grand Moff Tarkin damages an enemy, Shock that enemy for 2 turns, which can't be evaded or resisted.
data.DATACRON_CHARACTER_GREATMOTHERS_001_DESC:
At the start of battle, Nightsister allies gain 200% Defense and 100% Health and Protection, and are immune to Daze and Fear.

Whenever an enemy attacks out of turn:
- they take damage equal to 35% of their Max Health, which can't be evaded and this damage can't defeat enemies
- Attacker allies gain Retribution for 1 turn
- all Nightsister allies recover 30% Health and Protection

Whenever an enemy is inflicted with Doomed, they can't counter attack until they are defeated, are Stunned for 1 turn, and have -20% Offense for the rest of the encounter. Whenever this Stun expires, they gain a bonus turn and Speed Up for 2 turns which can't be evaded, dispelled, prevented, or resisted.

While an ally has Blessed they and Great Mothers take -35% reduced damage and they deal bonus True damage to target enemy, which can't be evaded, whenever they use an ability.

Whenever an enemy is defeated, they can't be revived.
data.DATACRON_CHARACTER_HERASYNDULLA_001_DESC: At the start of the encounter Hera Syndulla and Kanan Jarrus gain Guard until they are defeated. Whenever an ally is defeated, if there are no other allies with Guard, Hera applies Guard to the strongest other Phoenix ally.
data.DATACRON_CHARACTER_HERMITYODA_001_DESC: Whenever Hermit Yoda uses his Basic ability, he reduces his cooldowns by 1 and gains 7% Max Health (stacking, max 210%) for the rest of the encounter. Whenever Hermit Yoda gains a stack of Jedi Lessons, all Jedi allies gain a stack of Jedi Lessons.
data.DATACRON_CHARACTER_HK47_001_DESC:
At the start of encounter, HK-47 gains 15 Speed for each Droid or Scoundrel ally.

At the start of HK-47's turn, he inflicts Evasion Down on all enemies for 1 turn, which can't be resisted.

Whenever an enemy is inflicted with Burning or Torture HK-47's Ability Cooldowns are reset.

Whenever HK-47 uses Assassination Protocol, HK-47 inflicts Ability Block on target enemy for 2 turns, which can't be resisted.

Whenever an enemy is inflicted with Tenacity Down, they are also inflicted with Fear for 1 turn, which can't be resisted.
data.DATACRON_CHARACTER_HK47_002_DESC:
At the start of encounter, HK-47 gains 75 Speed.

If HK-47 is in the Leader slot, at the start of his turn, he inflicts Evasion Down on all enemies for 1 turn, which can't be evaded or resisted.

Whenever an enemy is inflicted with Burning or Torture, HK-47's Ability Cooldowns are reset.

Whenever HK-47 uses Assassination Protocol, HK-47 inflicts Ability Block on target enemy for 2 turns, which can't be evaded or resisted.

Whenever an enemy is inflicted with Tenacity Down, they are also inflicted with Fear for 1 turn, which can't be copied, dispelled or resisted.
data.DATACRON_CHARACTER_HONDO_001_DESC: Whenever Hondo Ohnaka uses a Basic ability, he gains 9 additional stacks of Ransom, Protection Up (100%, stacking) for 2 turns, and reduces his cooldowns by 1.
data.DATACRON_CHARACTER_HUNTERS3_001_DESC_V2: At the start of the encounter, Hunter (Mercenary) gains 30 Speed and all other Mercenary allies gain 10 Speed for each Mercenary ally, till the end of the encounter or until Hunter (Mercenary) is defeated for the first time. Hunter (Mercenary) is immune to Ability Block, Cooldown Increase, and Turn Meter reduction.\n\nIf all allies are Mercenaries, Marked enemies deal 50% less damage. Whenever a Marked enemy deals damage to a Mercenary ally, dispel all debuffs on that Mercenary ally and they recover 15% Protection. Whenever Hunter (Mercenary) inflicts Marked on an enemy, dispel it and inflict Marked on them for 3 turns, which can't be dispelled, evaded, or resisted, and call all Mercenary allies with Soldier of Fortune to assist. Whenever a Mercenary ally takes a turn, the cooldown of Hunter's This Will Hurt is reduced by 1.
data.DATACRON_CHARACTER_HUYANG_001_DESC: Whenever Huyang uses a Special ability: If General Syndulla, Padawan Sabine, and Ezra Bridger (Exile) are allies, they each gain +40% Offense, +40% Critical Damage, and +40% Defense Penetration for 2 turns, and they each assist. If Ahsoka Tano(GL) is in the Leader slot, she gains +25% Turn Meter and Offense Up for 2 turns. Whenever Huyang gains History of the Galaxy, all allies gain 15% Critical Chance (stacking, max 45%) and 20% Offense (stacking, max 60%) until the end of the battle.
data.DATACRON_CHARACTER_IDENVERSIO_001_DESC_V: At the start of the encounter Iden Taunts, which can't be dispelled or prevented until she is defeated.\n\nWhenever another non-Droid Imperial Trooper is defeated she Taunts, which can't be dispelled or prevented until she is defeated.
data.DATACRON_CHARACTER_IG12_001_DESC: At the start of battle, IG-12 & Grogu loses all Protection and gains that much Max Health. IG-12 & Grogu gains Grit until the end of battle, which can't be copied, dispelled, or prevented.\n\nWhenever IG-12 & Gogu uses a Special ability, an additional Light Side Mandalorian ally is called to assist.
data.DATACRON_CHARACTER_IG86_001_DESC: Whenever IG-86 critically hits an enemy, IG-86 gains Damage Immunity for 1 turn, 25% Turn Meter, and inflicts Deathmark on the target enemy for 2 turns, which can't be dispelled, evaded, or resisted. If the enemy was already Deathmarked, IG-86 gains Protection Up (50%, stacking), Retribution, and Speed Up for 2 turns.
data.DATACRON_CHARACTER_IG88_001_DESC: If HK-47 is in the Leader slot, whenever an ally damages an enemy with Ability Block or Fear, IG-88 assists, Shocks that enemy, which can't be evaded or resisted, and inflicts them with Torture for 1 turn, which can't be copied, dispelled, evaded, or resisted, and all allies gain Offense Up for 2 turns.
data.DATACRON_CHARACTER_IG88_003_DESC_V2:
If all allies are Bounty Hunters or Scoundrels and if there were no Galactic Legend allies at the start of battle:

- All allies gain 50% Critical Chance, Critical Damage, and 20% Turn Meter at the start of encounter
- All allies are immune to Ability Block, Fear, Turn Meter reduction, and cooldown increases
- Whenever an ally scores a critical hit, inflict a stack of Damage Over Time for 2 turns to all enemies, which can't be dispelled, evaded, or resisted
data.DATACRON_CHARACTER_IG90_001_DESC: Whenever IG-90 is dealt damage, reflect 50% of the damage dealt back onto the weakest enemy as True damage, which can't be evaded and inflicts Target Lock for 2 turns, which can't be resisted. This damage can't defeat enemies.\n\nWhenever IG-90 attacks an enemy with Target Lock, the healthiest enemy is inflicted with 2 stacks of Damage Over Time for 2 turns.
data.DATACRON_CHARACTER_IMPERIALPROBEDROID_00: At the start of battle, Imperial Probe Droid loses all Protection and gains that much Max Health. Imperial Probe Droid can be revived after using Self-Destruct and ignores Taunt.  Whenever Imperial Probe Droid uses Self-Destruct, the target enemy takes additional True damage equal to 50% of Imperial Probe Droid's Max Health, which can't be evaded.
data.DATACRON_CHARACTER_INQUISITORBARRISS_001: At the start of each encounter, if Ninth Sister and Second Sister are allies, whenever Purge is dispelled or expires on an enemy, all Inquisitor allies gain 5% Turn Meter, and that enemy takes True Damage equal to 5% of their Max Health. This damage can't defeat enemies.\n\nWhile an Inquisitorius ally has Taunt, when an enemy targets an ally without Taunt, inflict Fear on that enemy for 2 turns (can't be evaded or resisted), and all enemies take True Damage equal to 25% of their Max Health.
data.DATACRON_CHARACTER_ITHANO_001_DESC: Whenever a Pirate ally uses an ability on their turn, Captain Ithano assists and Steals Defense Penetration Up, Offense Up, and Speed up from all enemies. If any buffs were stolen, grant them to all Pirate allies and reset their duration.
data.DATACRON_CHARACTER_JABBATHEHUTT_001_DESC: When Hired Muscle is dispelled from an ally, they gain 20% Turn Meter and Offense Up for 2 turns and Jabba gains 10% Ultimate Charge.
data.DATACRON_CHARACTER_JARJAR_001_DESC:
Whenever Jar Jar Binks inflicts a debuff or is inflicted with a debuff, he gains 10% Turn Meter.

Whenever a Gungan ally assists Jar Jar Binks, they Shock the target enemy for 1 turn if they are inflicted with Plasma Residue. Otherwise, apply a stack of Frustration for 1 turn. At the start of each other Gungan ally's turn, they inflict Accuracy Down and Evasion Down on the healthiest enemy for 1 turn.

If all allies are Gungan at the start of battle: whenever Jar Jar Binks evades an attack, a random enemy's cooldowns are increased by 1 and a random Gungan ally's cooldowns are decreased by 1.
data.DATACRON_CHARACTER_JAWA_001_DESC: At the start of each enemy's turn, Jawa gains Foresight for 2 turns, which can't be prevented. Whenever Jawa loses Foresight, they gain Evasion Up for 1 turn, which can't be prevented.
data.DATACRON_CHARACTER_JAWASCAVENGER_001_DES: Jawa Scavenger always critically hits if able. The first time Jawa Scavenger is defeated while there are any active allies, they revive with 100% Health and gain Stealth for 3 turns.\n\nWhenever an enemy is inflicted with Thermal Detonators, Jawa allies gain 10% Defense (stacking) for 1 turn and there is a 50% chance to inflict an additional Thermal Detonator for 2 turns.
data.DATACRON_CHARACTER_JEDICONSULAR_002_DESC:
While Jedi Consular is active, all allies are immune to Healing Immunity.

Whenever Jedi Consular uses an ability, all allies recover 15% Health and Protection, and the weakest ally recovers an additional 10% Health and 10% Protection.

Whenever Jedi Consular uses Jedi Healing, revive all defeated allies at 100% Health and 100% Protection.
data.DATACRON_CHARACTER_JEDIKNIGHTCAL_001_DES: At the start of battle, Jedi Knight Cal Kestis gains 15 stacks of Impetuous. Whenever Jedi Knight Cal Kestis gains stacks of Impetuous, grant Jedi allies Speed Up for 2 turns.
data.DATACRON_CHARACTER_JEDIKNIGHTCAL_002_DES:
Whenever Jedi Knight Cal Kestis gains a Configuration, he gains 5 stacks of Impetuous (max 30), until the end of the encounter.
Whenever Jedi Knight Cal Kestis uses Impetuous Assault, he gains 50% Defense Penetration and 100% Offense for 2 turns.

Whenever Jedi Knight Cal Kestis gains a buff, he gains 10% Defense (stacking, max 100%), until the end of the encounter.
data.DATACRON_CHARACTER_JEDIKNIGHTCONSULAR_00:
While Jedi Consular is active all Jedi allies are immune to Healing Immunity.

Whenever Jedi Consular uses his Basic ability, reduce his cooldowns by 1 and he gains 7% Max Health (stacking, Max 210%) for the rest of the encounter.

Whenever Jedi Consular heals an ally, dispel all debuffs on them and they gain Jedi's Will for 2 turns.

Whenever Jedi Consular uses Jedi Healing, revive all non-Jedi allies with 100% Max Health and Max Protection.

Whenever Jedi Consular uses Attack as Defense deal bonus True damage equal to 50% his Max Health, which can't be evaded.

The first time Jedi Consular falls below 25% Health, he gains 100% Evasion for 2 turns.
data.DATACRON_CHARACTER_JEDIKNIGHTLUKE_001_DE: Whenever Jedi Knight Luke uses a Special Ability he gains a Bonus Turn.
data.DATACRON_CHARACTER_JEDIMASTERKENOBI_001_: While Jedi Master Kenobi has High Ground, all allies ignore Protection.
data.DATACRON_CHARACTER_KANANJARRUS_001_DESC: If there are no Galactic Legends at the start of the encounter, Kanan Jarrus is immune to instant defeat effects, and other Phoenix allies cannot be defeated while Kanan is active.
data.DATACRON_CHARACTER_KELLERANBEQ_001_DESC: Kelleran Beq has +100000 Max Protection. Whenever Kelleran Beq uses a Basic ability, he deals additional True damage equal to 5% of his Max Protection, which can't be evaded. If there are no Galactic Legend allies, at the start of his turn, all other Galactic Republic Jedi gain 10 stacks (max 100) of Padawan Lessons.
data.DATACRON_CHARACTER_KITFISTO_001_DESC: Kit Fisto has +100% Health Steal. At the start of the battle, grant Guard to all other Galactic Republic Jedi allies until Kit Fisto is defeated.
