Whenever Kit Fisto uses a Special ability all Galactic Republic Jedi gain Retribution for 2 turns. Whenever he uses his Basic ability, dispel all buffs on the target enemy.
data.DATACRON_CHARACTER_KIX_001_DESC: Whenever another Pirate ally recovers Health or Protection, Kix also recovers that much amount. Whenever a Pirate ally gains or loses a stack of Profit, they reduce the cooldowns of their abilities by 1.
data.DATACRON_CHARACTER_KRRSANTAN_001_DESC: If all other allies are Doctor Aphra, Darth Vader, or Dark Side Droids: Krrsantan's abilities trigger as though all allies were Hutt Cartel. Krrsantan reduces all ally cooldowns by 1 whenever he inflicts Disarm.
data.DATACRON_CHARACTER_L337_001_DESC: Whenever L3-37 deals damage, she deals additional Physical damage equal to 25% of her Max Health. Whenever L3-37 gains Prepared, she gains 15% Turn Meter.
data.DATACRON_CHARACTER_LANDOUNDERCOVER_001_D: Whenever Skiff Guard (Lando Calrissian) gains a stack of Deep Cover, he recovers 10% Health and Protection and all allies gain 5% Turn Meter.
data.DATACRON_CHARACTER_LORDVADER_001_DESC: Whenever an enemy is inflicted with Damage Over Time, Lord Vader gains 4% Mastery (stacking) until the end of battle.
data.DATACRON_CHARACTER_LUMINARAUNDULI_001_DE: Whenever an enemy attacks out of turn, all enemies are inflicted with Protection Disruption for 2 turns, which can't be dispelled, evaded, or resisted, and all allies gain a stack of Heal Over Time and Protection Over Time for 2 turns.\n\nAt the start of Luminara Unduli's turn, all allies with less than 50% Health gain 2 stacks for Heal Over Time for 2 turns.
data.DATACRON_CHARACTER_LUTHENRAEL_001_DESC:
Whenever Luthen summons a Rebel Trooper:

- Axis Bonus: Whenever an ally takes a turn, enemies lose a stack of Explosive Trap. Whenever Explosive Trap detonates, inflict all enemies with Protection Disruption for 2 turns, which can't be copied, dispelled, or prevented.

- Curator Bonus: Whenever a Rebel Trooper ally is summoned, all Rebel Figher allies gain Riposte until the Rebel Trooper has been defeated.

Whenever an ally attacks out of turn, they deal 35% more damage.
data.DATACRON_CHARACTER_MANDALOREBOKATAN_001_: If all allies are Light Side Mandalorians: At the start of battle, Bo-Katan (Mand'alor) takes a bonus turn, which can't be prevented and a random non-Galactic Legend enemy loses 100% Protection.\n\nWhenever Bo-Katan (Mand'alor) uses her Basic ability on her turn, if the target enemy is not a Galactic Legend and has no Protection, they are instantly defeated. Whenever an enemy is defeated, Bo-Katan (Mand'alor) takes a bonus turn, which can't be prevented.
data.DATACRON_CHARACTER_MARAJADE_001_DESC: At the start of any other non-Emperor Palpatine ally's turn, Mara Jade gains a stack of Loyal Hand. Whenever an ally with less than 100% Turn Meter gains bonus Turn Meter they gain 3% Critical Chance and Critical Damage (stacking) for 1 turn. Whenever an enemy is inflicted with Shock, they take damage equal to 10% of their Max Health.
data.DATACRON_CHARACTER_MARAJADE_002_DESC: At the start of each other ally's turn, Mara Jade gains an additional stack of Loyal Hand until the end of encounter. Whenever an ally with less than 100% Turn Meter gains bonus Turn Meter, they gain 2% Critical Chance and Critical Damage (stacking, max 100%) until the end of encounter. Whenever an enemy is inflicted with Shock, they take damage equal to 5% of their Max Health. This damage can't defeat enemies.
data.DATACRON_CHARACTER_MAULHATEFUELED_001_DE:
Whenever an enemy takes damage from Bleed, Maul gains 2 stacks of Edge of Madness and 5% Turn Meter.

If Maul has 50 or more stacks of Edge of Madness, whenever he uses his Basic Ability, he inflicts Ability Block on target enemy for 1 turn, which can't be resisted.

Whenever he gains a stack of Edge of Madness, he also gains 1% Max Health (stacking) until the end of battle. At 100 stacks of Edge of Madness, Maul's Basic attacks inflict Buff Immunity for 1 turn.
data.DATACRON_CHARACTER_MERRIN_001_DESC: Whenever an ally is defeated or revived, Merrin gains 20% Offense (stacking, max 200%) until the end of the encounter and inflicts 2 stacks of Plague on all enemies for 3 turns.
data.DATACRON_CHARACTER_MOBENFORCER_001_DESC_:
If the ally in the Leader slot is Hutt Cartel, whenever they use an ability, Mob Enforcer assists, dealing 50% more damage.

At the start of Mob Enforcer's turn, all enemies inflicted with Thermal Detonators are inflicted with Buff Immunity for 1 turn.

Whenever Mob Enforcer attacks out of turn, she always scores a critical hit, if able.

Whenever an enemy critically hits Mob Enforcer, that enemy is inflicted with a stack of Thermal Detonator for 2 turns, which can't be evaded or resisted.
data.DATACRON_CHARACTER_MOFFGIDEONS1_001_DESC:
Whenever Moff Gideon is inflicted with a debuff or gains a buff, he gains a stack of Insight and Stealths for 1 turn. Whenever he gains 4 stacks of Insight, he gains 100% Turn Meter, once every 4 turns.
Whenever an Imperial Remnant ally is inflicted with a debuff, they recover 10% Health and Protection.

Whenever an enemy is inflicted with Armor Shred, Blind all enemies for 1 turn, which can't be evaded or resisted.

Whenever he uses Subversive Volley, he deals bonus Massive Damage to all enemies, which can't be evaded.
data.DATACRON_CHARACTER_MOFFGIDEONS3_001_DESC: At the start of battle and whenever Dark Trooper Moff Gideon uses a Special ability, if the allied slot is available and there is no ally Dark Trooper, summon a Dark Trooper. Otherwise, a summoned ally Dark Trooper gains a stack of Dark Trooper Squad.\n\nWhenever an ally uses a Special ability, all Moff Gideons gain a stack of Insight. Imperial Remnant allies have +15% Defense and Offense for each stack of Insight on Moff Gideons.
data.DATACRON_CHARACTER_MOFFGIDEONS3_002_DESC:
At the start of battle, Dark Trooper Moff Gideon gains 15% Accuracy and 15% Potency for 2 turns.

Whenever Dark Trooper Moff Gideon gains a stack of insight, he gains 20% Offense (max 100%, stacking) until the end of the encounter and 10% Turn Meter and he ignores taunt.

Whenever Dark trooper Moff Gideon Stuns on an enemy, All Imperial Remnant allies gain 30% Critical Chance and 30% Critical Damage for 2 Turns 

Whenever Dark Trooper Moff Gideon uses a Special ability, he gains 1 Insight stack.
data.DATACRON_CHARACTER_MONMOTHMA_001_DESC: When Mon Mothma uses special ability Field Promotion and no Rebel Commander ally is present, Mon Mothma will gain a Bonus Turn and the cooldown of Field Promotion is reset.
data.DATACRON_CHARACTER_MOTHERTALZIN_001_DESC: Allies revived by The Great Mother are not defeated after assisting.
data.DATACRON_CHARACTER_NIGHTSISTERINITIATE_0: At the start of battle, Nightsister Initiate gains Protection Up (500%) until the end of battle, which can't be dispelled or prevented. Whenever Nightsister Initiate is resisted by an enemy, she has an 80% chance to inflict a Damage Over Time effect for 1 turn on that enemy, which can't be evaded or resisted. Whenever Nightsister Initiate inflicts a debuff on an enemy, she gains 100% Armor Penetration and 50% Physical Damage (stacking) until the end of battle and 45% Turn Meter. Nightsister Initiate is immune to Daze and Stun.
data.DATACRON_CHARACTER_NIGHTSISTERZOMBIE_001: Whenever Nightsister Zombie Taunts, she gains 10% Defense (stacking) until the end of encounter, and all Nightsister allies gain Offense Up and Tenacity Up for 2 turns.\n\nWhenever Nightsister Zombie is defeated, inflict all enemies with Healing Immunity and Buff Immunity for 2 turns, which can't be evaded.
data.DATACRON_CHARACTER_NIGHTTROOPER_001_DESC:
At the start of battle, Night Trooper gains 75% Potency and 25 Speed until the end of the encounter.

Whenever an enemy is inflicted with a stack of Blight they inflict themselves with another stack, which can't be copied or evaded, until the end of the encounter or until they fully recover their Health.

Whenever an enemy that already had Blight is inflicted with another stack of Blight by an ally, inflict Blight on another random enemy that doesn't have it, which can't be copied, evaded, or resisted, until the end of the encounter or until they fully recover their Health.

Whenever Night Trooper uses Shambling Shot, they gain an additional 3 stacks of Blight which can't be copied or evaded, until the end of the encounter.

Whenever an ally or an enemy gains or is inflicted with Blight, Night Trooper recovers 20% Health and gains 25% Offense per stack for 2 turns.
data.DATACRON_CHARACTER_NINTHSISTER_002_DESC_:
At the start of encounter, all Inquisitorius allies have +200% Max Health and are immune to Ability Block.

Ninth Sister deals 20% bonus True damage based on her Max Health with her Basic ability if the target enemy is inflicted with Purge.

If any enemy has 6 stacks of Purge when Ninth Sister is defeated for the first time, she consumes all stacks of Purge from a random enemy with 6 stacks of Purge, revives with 100% Max Health and Max Protection, and removes 50% Turn Meter from all enemies.
data.DATACRON_CHARACTER_PADAWANOBIWAN_001_DES: At the start of the encounter, Padawan Obi-Wan gains 100% counter chance until the end of the encounter. Whenever he evades an attack, he recovers 20% Health and Protection. Whenever he attacks out of turn, he deals True damage to the target enemy, which can't be evaded. While he has Discipline, he is immune to Daze and Stun.\n\nWhenever Turn Meter is removed from an enemy, Padawan Obi-Wan gains Foresight for 1 turn. At the start of each Galactic Republic ally's turn, if Padawan Obi-Wan has a stack of Heal Over Time, he gains 20% Offense; and if he has a stack of Protection Over Time, he gains 20% Defense penetration for 1 turn, doubled if there is an active Handmaiden Decoy.
data.DATACRON_CHARACTER_padmeamidala_001_DESC:
Whenever a Galactic Republic ally with Courage or Protection Up uses an ability, if there are no enemies with Provoke, a random enemy is inflicted with Provoke for 1 turn. Whenever another Galactic Republic ally recovers Health or Protection, Padmé recovers double that amount.

Whenever an enemy targets a Non-Galactic Legend Galactic Republic ally with Protection Up while attacking out of turn, the damage they receive is reduced to 1 and the attacking enemy is Exposed for 1 turn.

Whenever a Non-Galactic Legend Galactic Republic ally resists a debuff, they gain a stack of Courage, and whenever they are inflicted with a debuff, they gain Protection Up (10%, stacking) and Tenacity Up for 2 turns.
data.DATACRON_CHARACTER_PAO_001_DESC:
At the start of battle, all allies gain 100% Max Health and Max Protection and are immune to Healing Immunity.

Whenever Pao assists, he deals bonus massive damage, which can't be evaded, and all allies recover 10% Health.

Whenever Pao uses Special ability, he Shocks all enemies for 2 turns, which can't be evaded.

Whenever Pao uses a Basic ability on his turn, he Stealths and gains Defense Penetration Up for 1 turn and inflicts target enemy with Offense Down for 1 turn, which can't be evaded.
data.DATACRON_CHARACTER_PLOKOON_001_DESC:
At the start of Battle, Plo gains 100% Defense and Max Health and Protection.

Whenever Plo Koon uses his Basic ability, he deals 25% bonus True damage based on his Max Health, which can't be evaded. Whenever another ally uses an ability while buffed on their turn, Plo assists.
Whenever Plo uses a Special ability, Stun all enemies for 1 turn, which can't be evaded.

Whenever Plo gains Defense Up, he also gains 5% Max Health (stacking) until the end of encounter. Whenever Defense Up expires, he Taunts and gains Damage Immunity for 1 turn and inflicts Ability Block to all enemies for 2 turns, which can't be evaded.
data.DATACRON_CHARACTER_POEDAMERON_001_DESC: At the start of each encounter, Poe inflicts Fear on all enemies, which can't be copied, dispelled, evaded, prevented, or resisted, and Exposes them for 2 turns, which can't be evaded or resisted. Whenever Taunt expires on Poe, all enemies are inflicted with Fear for 1 turn, which can't be copied or dispelled, and all allies gain 20% Turn Meter. Whenever Poe Dameron is critically hit while Taunting, he gains Protection Up (50%) for 1 turn. Whenever a buff expires on another ally, Poe Taunts for 1 turn.
data.DATACRON_CHARACTER_POGGLETHELESSER_001_D: Geonosian allies have +20% Max Health and Max Protection. Whenever Poggle evades an attack, all Geonosian allies gain 20% Max Health. Whenever another Geonosian ally evades an attack, all Geonosian allies recover 20% Health. Whenever an enemy gains a buff, Poggle gains Evasion Up for 1 turn. Whenever a Geonosian ally is inflicted with a debuff, dispel all debuffs on Poggle then he gains 5% Turn Meter and lowers the cooldown of Warlord's Resolve by 1.
data.DATACRON_CHARACTER_POGGLETHELESSER_002_D: Each time Poggle the Lesser inflicts Ability Block, he also inflicts Burning for 2 turns on the target enemy, {0} gains 10% Turn Meter, and all allies gain 20% Offense (stacking) until the end of battle.
data.DATACRON_CHARACTER_PRINCESSKNEESAA_001_D: Ewoks have +10% Offense (stacking) for each buff on them, and Kneesaa gains 2% Critical Damage (stacking, max 100%) whenever she attacks out of turn.\n\nThe first time each Ewok is defeated, they are revived with 100% Health and Protection.
data.DATACRON_CHARACTER_QIRA_001_DESC: Qi'ra has +100% Critical Chance and other Smuggler allies have half that amount. Prepared allies are immune to Turn Meter reduction and apply Healing Immunity for 1 turn when they use a Basic ability. At the start of her turn, Qi'ra gains Prepared. Whenever Qi'ra gains Prepared, all other Smuggler allies gain Prepared and gain 5% Turn Meter.
data.DATACRON_CHARACTER_QIRA_002_DESC_V2: At the start of the encounter, Qi'ra gains Damage Immunity for 2 turns, which can't be copied, dispelled or prevented.\nAt the start of her turn, Qi'ra gains Prepared. Whenever Mercenary ally attacks, she assists (once per turn) if she has Health Steal Up. Whenever she loses Prepared, she gains 5 stacks of Soldier of Fortune and 20% Potency (stacking, max 100%) until the end of encounter. The first time she uses a Special ability, when she has 20 stacks of Soldier of Fortune, she inflicts Healing Immunity and Protection Disruption for 3 turns on target enemy, which can't be dispelled, evaded, or resisted.
data.DATACRON_CHARACTER_R2D2_001_DESC: Whenever R2-D2 uses a Basic ability, R2-D2 gains Protection Up (50%, stacking) for 2 turns and 50% Turn Meter. Whenever R2-D2 damages an enemy using a Special ability, inflict Fear for 1 turn on that enemy, which can't be evaded or resisted.
data.DATACRON_CHARACTER_RESISTANCETROOPER_001: Whenever Resistance Trooper uses his Basic ability on his turn, he Exposes the target enemy for 2 turns. Whenever Resistance Trooper attacks an Exposed enemy, all other allies gain 20% Turn Meter, Resistance Trooper has a 50% chance to attack again and Expose a random enemy for 1 turn.\n\nWhenever Resistance Trooper falls below 50% for the first time, he gains Damage Immunity and Health Steal Up for 2 turns and all other allies gain Evasion Up for 2 turns.
data.DATACRON_CHARACTER_REY_001_DESC: Whenever an ally takes a bonus turn, all allies recover 20% Health and Protection, and {0} gains 10% Offense (stacking, max 160%) until the end of battle.
data.DATACRON_CHARACTER_ROSETICO_001_DESC_V2: Whenever Rose uses Dauntless Bravery, inflict Expose on the target enemy for 2 turns, which can't be evaded or resisted. Whenever Rose uses Shock Prod Strike, when the Stun is dispelled or expires inflict Deathmark for 1 turn, which can't be evaded or resisted. Whenever Rose uses a Basic ability on an enemy with Expose, dispel all buffs on the enemy and debuffs on herself, recover 100% Protection, and gain 5% Critical Damage (stacking, max 200%).
data.DATACRON_CHARACTER_SANASTARROS_001_DESC: The first time each turn Rebel allies or Sana deal damage more than once there is a 20% chance to increase all enemies' cooldowns by 1.
data.DATACRON_CHARACTER_SANASTARROS_002_DESC_:
At the start of encounter, all allies (excluding summoned units) gain 100% Max Health, 50% Max Protection and 25 Speed for the rest of encounter, and Defense Up for 2 turns, which can't be dispelled.
Whenever Sana Starros gains Turn Meter, all allies gain 25% Offense (stacking) for 3 turns.
Whenever an enemy is inflicted with Vulnerable, they are also Target Locked for 1 turn if they didn't already have it.

Whenever a Scoundrel ally uses a Special ability, the target enemy loses 40% Turn Meter, which can't be resisted.
Whenever a Rebel or Scoundrel ally attacks an enemy with Target Lock, they gain Retribution for 2 turns.
The first time each ally is defeated, Captain Han Solo gains a bonus turn, his cooldown resets, and all allies recover 50% Health and Protection.
data.DATACRON_CHARACTER_SCOUTTROOPER_V3_001_D: Whenever Scout Trooper inflicts a debuff, Scout Trooper's Imperial Precision ability gains 6% bonus damage (stacking, max 300%) until the end of battle. Imperial Precision grants Imperial Trooper allies Potency Up for 1 turn and Imperial Remnant allies Offense Up for 1 turn.
data.DATACRON_CHARACTER_SECONDSISTER_001_DESC: Second Sister gains all 3 bonuses from Everyone is Expendable whenever an enemy or Empire ally is defeated.
data.DATACRON_CHARACTER_SECONDSISTER_002_DESC: Whenever an enemy is inflicted with Purge, Second Sister gains 5% Offense and 5% Health Steal (stacking, max 120%), and 10 Speed (stacking, max 200) for the rest of the encounter.\n\nWhenever Second Sister defeats an enemy with Purge, she recovers 100% Health and Protection, and Ninth Sister gains Retaliate for 2 turns.
data.DATACRON_CHARACTER_SEVENTHSISTER_001_DES: Seventh Sister is immune to Ability Block, Fear, and Stun. Whenever Seventh Sister uses [c][ffff33]ID9 Enemy Intelligence[-][/c], grant target ally a bonus turn. Whenever Seventh Sister uses [c][ffff33]ID9 Electro Shock-Prod[-][/c], inflict Protection Disruption for 2 turns on target enemy, which can't be resisted, and reset the cooldown of [c][ffff33]ID9 Enemy Intelligence[-][/c].
data.DATACRON_CHARACTER_SHORETROOPER_001_DESC: At the start of the battle, if all allies are Empire or Imperial Trooper, all allies gain 50% Health Steal, Max Health, and Max Protection. Shoretrooper gains Defense Up and Taunt for 2 turns.\n\nWhenever Shoretrooper loses Taunt, he recovers 20% Health and Protection.
data.DATACRON_CHARACTER_SITHPALPATINE_001_DES: At the start of battle, Sith Eternal Emperor gains 20% Ultimate Charge for each other Sith ally. If all allies were Sith at the start of battle, when Sith Eternal Emperor uses I Am All The Sith he takes a bonus turn.
data.DATACRON_CHARACTER_SITHTROOPER_001_DESC: While Sith Empire Trooper has Defense Up, he also has 30% Defense Penetration and 100% Offense. When Defense Up expires on Sith Empire Trooper, he gains 10% Tenacity (stacking, max 100%) until the end of the encounter.
data.DATACRON_CHARACTER_STAP_001_DESC: Whenever another Separatist ally uses an ability against an enemy with Target Lock, STAP assists (once per turn). Whenever STAP uses a Basic ability against a Pinned enemy, gain two stacks of Overcharge (stacking, max 5) at the end of the turn. Whenever STAP loses a stack of Overcharge, STAP gains 10% Turn Meter.
data.DATACRON_CHARACTER_STARCK_001_DESC: At the start of battle, if Darth Vader is in the Leader slot, he gains the Imperial Trooper tag for the rest of the battle and Colonel Starck gains 100% Defense, Max Health, and Max Protection until the end of battle.
data.DATACRON_CHARACTER_STORMTROOPERHAN_001_D:
Whenever Stormtrooper Han gains Taunt all allies gain Protection Up (50%) for 3 turns. While Stormtrooper Han is Taunting, he gains 100% counter chance and Defense, and is immune to critical hits.

Whenever Stormtrooper Han removes Turn Meter from an enemy reset Draw Fire's cooldown.

All allies have +50% Offense while Stormtrooper Han's Health is above 50%, and all allies gain 70% Defense when his Health is below 50%.
data.DATACRON_CHARACTER_STORMTROOPERLUKE_001_: At the start of each encounter, Princess Leia gains Offense Up for 2 turns, and Stormtrooper Han gains Defense Up for 2 turns.\n\nWhenever an enemy is Distracted, Princess Leia resets her cooldown and gains a bonus turn (once per turn). If an enemy is defeated while Distracted, all allies recover 50% Health and Protection, Attacker allies gain 25% Offense (stacking), and Tank allies gain 25% Max Health (stacking) until the end of battle.
data.DATACRON_CHARACTER_STRANGER_001_DESC:
Whenever The Stranger is healed by an ally or attacks out of turn, he gains 5 Speed (stacking, max 100).

Whenever The Stranger uses his Basic ability and damages a Stunned or Shocked enemy, reduce the cooldown of Was That Its Name? by 1.

The Stranger is immune to Daze.
data.DATACRON_CHARACTER_SUNFAC_001_DESC:
Sun Fac has +100% counter chance and is immune to Daze and Stun.

Whenever Sun Fac attacks out of turn, he dispels all debuffs on himself, Sun Fac deals bonus True damage equal to 15% of their Max Health to the enemy.

For each debuff dispelled this way, Geonosian allies gain 5% Defense, Max Health, and Max Protection until the end of battle.
data.DATACRON_CHARACTER_SUPREMELEADERKYLOREN_: If Supreme Leader Kylo Ren is in the Leader slot, then whenever a First Order ally gains Advantage, Supreme Leader Kylo Ren gains 3% Offense (stacking) until the end of the encounter.

Whenever Supreme Leader Kylo Ren has 100 or more stacks of Siphon, he ignores Stealth and Taunt during his turn. For every 20 stacks of Siphon he has, First Order allies gain 10% Defense and 10% Health Steal (stacking, max 200%) until the end of the encounter.
data.DATACRON_CHARACTER_TARFULL_001_DESC: At the start of battle, if Tarfful is in the leader slot, Wookiee allies gain 25% Offense until the end of battle. Whenever a Wookiee ally is defeated, all Wookiee allies' cooldowns are refreshed and they recover 100% Health and Protection. Whenever a buff is dispelled on an enemy, all Wookiee allies gain 5% Tenacity (stacking).
data.DATACRON_CHARACTER_TARONMALICOS_001_DESC: At the start of battle, Taron Malicos gains 5 stacks of Edge of Madness and 3 stacks of Resilient Defense which can't be copied, dispelled, or prevented.\n\nThe first time Taron Malicos gains 20 stacks of Edge of Madness, he gains a bonus turn and his cooldowns are reset.
data.DATACRON_CHARACTER_THEMANDALORIANBESKARA: After using Disciplined Set Up, until he uses Swift Takedown, The Mandalorian (Beskar Armor) can't be defeated and is immune to Fear, Stun, and Turn Meter reduction. Swift Takedown deals 20% more damage for each stack of Whistling Birds The Mandalorian (Beskar Armor) had at the start of the turn.
data.DATACRON_CHARACTER_THIRDSISTER_001_DESC: Whenever any character is defeated, Third Sister gains Hatred for the rest of the battle or until she is defeated. While Third Sister has Hatred, she also has +100% counter chance and +50% Critical Damage.\n\nAt the start of Third Sister's turn, all Inquisitorius allies with Taunt dispel all debuffs on themselves, recover 20% Max Health and Max Protection, and gain 20 speed for 2 turns.
data.DATACRON_CHARACTER_TIEFIGHTERPILOT_002_D: First Order SF TIE Pilot has +100% Potency. While allied Supreme Leader Kylo Ren is active, First Order SF TIE Pilot can't be defeated. While First Order allies have Advantage, they ignore Taunt.\n\nWhenever the ally in the Leader slot or First Order SF TIE Pilot is damaged while they have Advantage, Stun that enemy for 1 turn, which can't be resisted. Whenever an enemy is Stunned, First Order SF TIE Pilot's abilities gain 5% bonus damage (stacking, max 200%), he and the ally in the Leader slot gain 10% Max Health  until the end of the encounter, and if the ally in the Leader slot is Supreme Leader Kylo Ren, he gains 5% Ultimate Charge. Whenever a Stunned enemy is defeated, they can't be revived, the ally in the Leader slot gains a bonus turn, and the allied Leader and First Order SF TIE Pilot recover 100% Health and Protection.
data.DATACRON_CHARACTER_TRENCH_001_DESC_V2: Non-Droid Separatist allies start the encounter with Tactical Supremacy for 2 turns. Whenever Separatist allies gain a stack of Heal Over Time they gain 5% Critical Chance (stacking, max 200%) for the rest of the encounter. Whenever Separatist allies gain a stack Protection Over Time they gain 5% Defense (stacking, max 200%) for the rest of the encounter. Whenever Admiral Trench uses his Basic ability on his turn, call all other allies with Riposte to assist. Whenever Trench Shocks an enemy, he gains Protection Up (25%) for 1 turn.
data.DATACRON_CHARACTER_TRIPLEZERO_001_DESC: While BT-1 is active, 0-0-0 is immune to Daze and Stun. Whenever 0-0-0 damages a Target Locked enemy, he gains Protection Up (100%, stacking) for 2 turns, 50% Turn Meter, and inflicts Protection Disruption for 2 turns, which can't be resisted.
data.DATACRON_CHARACTER_TRIPLEZERO_002_DESC: While BT-1 is active, 0-0-0 is immune to Daze and Stun. Whenever 0-0-0 damages a Target Locked enemy, he gains Protection Up (20%, stacking) for 2 turns, 25% Turn Meter, and inflicts Protection Disruption for 1 turn, which can't be resisted.
data.DATACRON_CHARACTER_TUSKENCHIEFTAIN_001_D: Whenever another Tusken ally uses an ability, Tusken Chieftain assists.\n\nWhenever an enemy is inflicted with Damage Over Time, inflict an additional Damage Over Time for 2 turns, which can't be evaded or resisted.
data.DATACRON_CHARACTER_TUSKENHUNTRESS_001_DE: Tusken Warrior starts the encounter with 10 stacks of Momentum for 3 turns. Whenever Tusken Warrior gains Momentum, she also gains 2% Critical Damage and Defense Penetration per stack for the rest of the encounter. Whenever Finishing Strikes defeats an enemy, they can't be revived and then revive all Tusken allies at the end of the turn if there is at least one Tusken ally active.
data.DATACRON_CHARACTER_TUSKENRAIDER_001_DESC: For each Tusken ally at the start of the encounter, Tusken Raider gains an additional 25% Offense. Whenever Tusken Raider uses Tusken Ambush, dispel all buffs on the enemy and deal 20% more damage per buff dispelled. Whenever a Tusken ally assists during Tusken Raider's turn, they recover 100% Protection.
data.DATACRON_CHARACTER_UGNAUGHT_001_DESC:
At the Start of the Battle, Uganught has +30% Evasion.

At the start of each encounter, inflict Breach and Health Down for 2 turns on all enemies, which can't be evaded or resisted. For each Droid enemy, Ugnaught has 20% counter Chance, Critical Chance, Defense, Health Steal, Max Health, and Max Protection.

At the start of his turn, Ugnaught dispels all debuffs on himself and resets all of his cooldowns.

Whenever Ugnaught evades an attack, all enemies lose 10% Max Protection, which can't be resisted, doubled for Droids.

Whenever he damages a stunned enemy, he inflicts 2 stacks of Damage Over Time for 2 turns. Whenever he damages an enemy with more than 5 buffs, dispel all the buffs from target enemy, and all enemies are inflicted with 2 stacks of Damage Over Time, doubled against Droid enemies.
data.DATACRON_CHARACTER_VADER_001_DESC: Percent Health damage enemies receive is increased by 300%.
data.DATACRON_CHARACTER_VADER_002_DESC_V2:
At the start of battle, if the only active allies that Darth Vader has consist of any number of the following allies: Admiral Piett, Colonel Starck, General Veers, or Snowtrooper, then the following effects are active:

- Darth Vader can't be defeated while he has active allies

- Whenever an ally is defeated, Darth Vader dispels all debuffs on himself, resets all of his cooldowns, and takes a bonus turn
data.DATACRON_CHARACTER_VADER_003_DESC_V3: At the start of battle, if there are no Galactic Legend allies, Darth Vader can't be defeated until all the other allies are defeated or Captured. The first time each ally is defeated, Darth Vader dispels all debuffs on himself, resets all of his cooldowns, and takes a bonus turn.\n\nDuring his turn, Darth Vader has +50% Health Steal for each defeated ally.
data.DATACRON_CHARACTER_VADERDUELSEND_001_DES:
Whenever an enemy attacks out of turn, Vader (Duel's End) takes a bonus turn (once per turn).

Vader (Duel's End) can't be defeated if Emperor Palpatine is active.

At the start of his turn, if Darth Vader (Duel's End) has less than 25% Health, he gains 10% Defense Penetration, Health Steal, and Offense for each active ally until the end of his turn.
data.DATACRON_CHARACTER_VANGARDTEMPLEGUARD_00: Whenever Temple Guard is inflicted with a debuff, they Taunt for 2 turns. Whenever Temple Guard Taunts, all Jedi Vanguard allies gain a stack of Courage, which can't be copied, dispelled or prevented.
data.DATACRON_CHARACTER_VEERS_001_DESC: Whenever an enemy is inflicted with a Damage Over Time stack, Ruthless Assault gains 2% bonus damage (stacking) until the end of battle and all allies recover 5% Turn Meter.
data.DATACRON_CHARACTER_VISASMARR_001_DESC: Whenever Visas Marr revives an ally, she resets the cooldowns of all other allies, Deathmark the weakest enemy for 2 turns, which can't be resisted, and if Maul (Hate-Fueled) is an active ally, he takes a bonus turn.
data.DATACRON_CHARACTER_WAMPA_001_DESC_V2: If there are no other active allies at the start of battle, Wampa's omicron ability is active in Territory Wars, Wampa gains 100% Defense, Max Health, and Max Protection, is immune to Daze and Stun, and whenever Wampa attacks out of turn, ignores Protection.
data.DATACRON_CHARACTER_YODACHEWBACCA_001_DES: Whenever Yoda & Chewie gain Foresight, they also gain +20% Turn Meter and Protection Up (20%) for 2 turns.\n\nWhenever a non-Tank Wookiee ally is critically hit, Wookiee Tanks Taunt for 1 turn. Whenever a Wookiee Taunts, the weakest ally gains 2 stacks of Bulwark for 1 turn.
data.DATACRON_CHARACTER_ZAALBAR_001_DESC_V2: Zaalbar gains +20% Defense for each Old Republic ally. Whenever another Old Republic ally uses a Special ability, Zaalbar recovers 20% Health and Protection and inflicts a stack of Damage Over Time for 2 turns on all enemies, which can't be evaded.
data.DATACRON_CHARACTER_ZAALBAR_002_DESC: At the start of his turn, Zaalbar gives Taunt for 1 turn to all Tank allies, and Tank allies are immune to Buff Immunity and Stun while he is active. Once per turn when Zaalbar inflicts Armor Shred on an enemy, he inflicts it on all other enemies until the end of the encounter.
data.DATACRON_CHARACTER_ZAMWESELL_001_DESC: Zam always critically hits if able. The first time Zam is defeated while there are any active allies, Zam revives with 100% Health and Stealths for 3 turns.\n\nWhenever Zam inflicts an enemy with Thermal Detonators, she gains 10% Defense and Offense (stacking) for the rest of the encounter, and there is a 50% chance to inflict an additional Thermal Detonator for 2 turns.
data.DATACRON_CHARACTER_ZORIIBLISSV2_001_DESC: If Stealth is dispelled on a Resistance or Smuggler ally, they gain a bonus turn. While Resistance or Smuggler allies are Stealthed, they have +100% Health Steal and their Basic abilities apply Tenacity Down to target enemy for 1 turn. Whenever a Resistance or Smuggler ally gains Damage Immunity or Stealth, they recover 100% Health and gain 20% Defense (stacking, max 200%).
data.DATACRON_CHARACTER_ZUCKUSS_001_DESC: Whenever Zuckuss uses a Special ability, all Bounty Hunter allies gain Protection Up for 2 turns. Zuckuss calls a random Bounty Hunter ally to assist. All allies gain Foresight for 2 turns.

data.DATACRON_FACTION_BADBATCH_001_DESC: Bad Batch allies can ignore Taunt to target an enemy that was damaged previously by a Bad Batch ally on their turn.\n\nWhenever an ally is defeated, dispel Stealth from the strongest ally, they gain 200% Defense for 2 turns, and recover 100% Health and Protection.
data.DATACRON_FACTION_BADBATCH_002_DESC:
While a Bad Batch ally is Stealthed, they gain 20% Critical Chance and 20% Critical Damage.

Whenever a Bad Batch ally uses an ability on a Marked enemy, they gain 25% Turn Meter.

While a Bad Batch ally is Captive, Bad Batch allies deal an additional instance of damage to the target enemy on their turn.

Whenever a Bad Batch ally defeats an enemy, they reset their cooldown and gain 25% Offense stacking (max 150%) until the end of encounter.

Whenever a Bad Batch ally assists, they gain +20% Offense (stacking, max +80%) and +20% Turn Meter until the end of the encounter.
data.DATACRON_FACTION_BOUNTYHUNTER_001_DESC: Whenever a Bounty Hunter inflicts a debuff on an enemy, they have a 50% chance to also inflict Damage Over Time.
data.DATACRON_FACTION_BOUNTYHUNTER_002_DESC: Whenever an enemy is defeated, Bounty Hunter allies gain Bounty Hunter's Resolve

data.DATACRON_FACTION_DROID_004_DESC: Whenever a Droid ally dispels a buff or debuff, all Droid allies gain Critical Damage Up and Offense Up for 3 turns, which can't be dispelled.\n\nWhenever a Droid ally gains Stealth, other weakest non-Stealthed Droid ally gains 100% Defense and Max Protection for 2 turns.
data.DATACRON_FACTION_EMPIRE_001_DESC: Whenever Empire allies inflict a debuff, they reduce their cooldowns by 1 (limit once per turn per enemy and ally).
data.DATACRON_FACTION_EMPIRE_002_DESC: Whenever an enemy loses Turn Meter, {0} allies gain Protection Up (stacking, 10%) for 2 turns.  Whenever an ally loses Protection Up they gain 10% Turn Meter.
data.DATACRON_FACTION_EWOK_001_DESC: Whenever an Ewok ally attacks out of turn, each Ewok ally gains 2% Offense (stacking, max 100%) until the end of battle.
data.DATACRON_FACTION_FIRSTORDER_001_DESC: Whenever First Order allies are critically hit they gain 10% Critical Damage (stacking) until the end of the encounter.
data.DATACRON_FACTION_FIRSTORDER_002_DESC:
Whenever a First Order ally scores a critical hit, the Leader gains 10% Offense (stacking, max 200%) until the end of encounter. If the Leader scores a critical hit, they gain an additional 10% Offense, and all other First Order allies recover 15% Health and Protection.

Whenever the Leader uses an ability, remove 1% Turn Meter from all other First Order allies. Whenever a First Order ally loses Turn Meter, they gain 10% Critical Damage (stacking) for 2 turns.

Whenever a First Order ally attacks a Stunned enemy, they deal 10% Max Health damage to that enemy. This damage can't defeat enemies.

Whenever the Leader is not damaged during the enemy's turn, if there are no allies with Damage Immunity, a random First Order ally gains Damage Immunity for 1 turn.
data.DATACRON_FACTION_FIRSTORDER_003_DESC: If all allies are First Order at the start of battle, First Order allies gain Damage Immunity for 2 turns. Whenever a First Order ally is critically hit, all First Order allies gain 10% Critical Damage (stacking, max 50%) until the end of the encounter. Whenever a First Order ally attacks out of turn, all First Order allies gain 10% Offense (stacking, max 50%) until the end of the encounter.
data.DATACRON_FACTION_GALACTIC_REPUBLIC_002_D: Whenever a Galactic Republic ally with Protection Up assists, if there are no enemies with Protection Disruption, inflict it for 1 turn on the target enemy, which can't be dispelled, evaded, or resisted.\n\nWhile Galactic Republic allies have Protection Up they have +50% Accuracy, counter chance, Critical Chance, Critical Damage, and they ignore Taunt.
data.DATACRON_FACTION_GALACTICREPUBLIC_001_DE: Whenever a Galactic Republic ally is critically hit, they recover 12% Health.

data.DATACRON_FACTION_GUNGAN_001_DESC:
Whenever a Gungan ally is damaged or the allied Shield Generator loses a stack of Plasma Shielding, remove 1 stack of Recharge from the allied Shield Generator.

Whenever the allied Shield Generator uses Plasma Pulse, dispel all debuffs from all Gungan allies and inflict Plasma Residue on all enemies for 1 turn, which can't be resisted. If an enemy is already inflicted with Plasma Residue, remove 100% Turn Meter, Daze, Stagger, and Stun them for 1 turn.

Whenever a Gungan ally deals damage to a debuffed enemy, they also deal 5% Max Health damage to that enemy. This damage can't defeat enemies.
data.DATACRON_FACTION_HUTTCARTEL_001_DESC: The first time each Hutt Cartel ally falls below 50% Health, they gain Damage Immunity for 1 turn, which can't be copied, dispelled, or prevented.\n\nWhenever an enemy takes damage from a Thermal Detonator expiring, Hutt Cartel allies recover 5% Health and Protection, gain 5% Turn Meter, and there is a 50% chance that enemy is inflicted with a Thermal Detonator for 2 turns, which can't be dispelled, prevented, or resisted.
data.DATACRON_FACTION_HUTTCARTEL_002_DESC: Whenever an enemy takes damage from a Thermal Detonator, all Hutt Cartel allies gain 5% Offense (stacking), until the end of encounter.\nWhile an enemy is inflicted with Thermal Detonator, they are immune to Health and Protection recovery.\nWhenever a Hutt Cartel ally uses a Basic ability during their turn, all Hutt Cartel allies gain 10% Turn Meter (once per turn).
data.DATACRON_FACTION_IMPERIALREMNANT_001_DES: Whenever an allied Imperial Remnant uses a Special ability, they gain Alert for 2 turns.\n\nWhenever an enemy is inflicted with a stack of Blight, all Imperial Remnant allies gain 10% Turn Meter, and 5% Critical Chance and Critical Damage (stacking) until the end of encounter.
data.DATACRON_FACTION_IMPERIALREMNANT_002_DES:
At the start of battle, all Imperial Remnant allies gain 45% Accuracy, 45% Potency, and 20 Speed until the end of encounter.

Whenever an Imperial Remnant ally uses a Special ability, all Imperial Remnant allies gain Alert for 2 turns.

Whenever an Imperial Remnant ally defeats an enemy, all Imperial Remnant allies gain 40% Offense (max +120%) until the end of encounter.

Whenever an Imperial Remnant ally is inflicted with a debuff, they recover 10% Health and Protection.

Whenever an enemy is inflicted with Armor Shred all Imperial Remnant allies gain 30% Critical Chance and Critical Damage (stacking) until the end of encounter.
data.DATACRON_FACTION_IMPERIALTROOPER_001_DES: Whenever an Imperial Trooper ally inflicts a debuff on an enemy, all Imperial Trooper allies gain 4% Critical Damage (stacking, max 80%) until the end of battle.
data.DATACRON_FACTION_INQUISITORIUS_001_DESC: The first time each turn Inquisitor allies inflict Purge on an enemy, they recover 5% Protection and inflict 1 stack of Purge (max 6) on target enemy until the end of the encounter, which can't be evaded. At the end of each turn, for each Purge dispelled from an enemy, that enemy has a 50% chance to gain 1 stack of Purge (max 6) until the end of the encounter.
data.DATACRON_FACTION_INQUISITORIUS_002_DESC_: Inquisitorius allies gain 100% Potency. At the start of each Inquisitorius ally's turn, dispel all buffs on enemies inflicted with Purge and then inflict Health Down on them for 2 turns, which can't be evaded or resisted.
data.DATACRON_FACTION_INQUISITORIUS_003_DESC_:
Whenever an Inquisitorius ally inflicts a stack of Purge, they gain 5% Defense, Offense, and Tenacity (stacking) for 1 turn.

Whenever a stack of Purge is consumed or dispelled on an enemy Expose them for 1 turn.

Whenever an Inquisitorius ally uses a Basic ability against an enemy inflicted with a stack of Purge, a random other Inquisitorius ally assists, dealing 5% bonus damage per stack of Purge and then they inflict a stack of Purge (max 6) on target enemy, which can't be evaded.
data.DATACRON_FACTION_JAWA_001_DESC_V2: At the start of battle, Jawa allies gain 100% bonus Protection until the end of the encounter and all enemies are inflicted with Provoked for 2 turns, which can't be evaded or resisted.\n\nWhenever an enemy takes damage from a Thermal Detonator expiring, Jawa allies recover 5% Health and Protection, gain 5% Turn Meter, and there is an 80% chance that enemy is inflicted with a Thermal Detonator for 1 turn, which can't be dispelled, prevented, or resisted.
data.DATACRON_FACTION_JAWA_002_DESC: At the start of battle, Jawa allies gain 100% bonus Protection until the end of the encounter and all enemies are inflicted with Provoked for 2 turns, which can't be evaded or resisted. Whenever a Jawa ally inflicts a debuff on an enemy, all Jawa allies gain Foresight for 1 turn. Whenever an enemy is inflicted with Thermal Detonators, Jawa allies gain 10% Defense and Offense (stacking, max 300%). At the start of each turn, if a Jawa ally has 50% or less Health, damage they receive is reduced by 75% (excluding percent health damage and massive damage) until the end of the turn.\n\nWhenever an enemy takes damage from a Thermal Detonator expiring, which can't be evaded, Jawa allies recover 5% Health and Protection, gain 5% Turn Meter, and that enemy is inflicted with an aditional Thermal Detonator for 1 turn, which can't be dispelled, evaded, or resisted.

If all allies are Jedi Vanguard at the start of battle, they gain Protection Up (100%) for 1 turn at the end of their turn, and additional bonuses based on their role:

- [c][B5E7F5]Attackers:[-][/c] Ignore Taunt during their turn

Whenever an enemy dispels a buff from a Jedi Vanguard ally they are inflicted with Provoked for 2 turns. Whenever a Jedi Vanguard ally is attacked out of turn, their cooldowns are reduced by 1.

Whenever a Nightsister ally gains Foresight or Stealth, all Nightsister allies gain 5% Turn Meter and Critical Damage (stacking) until the end of encounter.

data.DATACRON_HELP_1_BODY: Datacrons are an effective way of improving the power of an entire squad in the Grand Arena and Territory War game modes.\n\nAll Datacrons have multiple upgrade levels, each including bonus stats that affect your entire squad or powerful bonus mechanics that apply to specific units.
data.DATACRON_HELP_2_BODY:
Unlocked Datacron levels have additional requirements. Every member of a squad with a Datacron assigned must meet the minimum requirements for each level in order for the squad to gain the benefits of that level. If any member of the squad does not satisfy the minimum requirement of a Datacron level, then that level’s benefit is not applied to any member of the squad.

For example, a Datacron level requiring Relic 5 units only applies its benefits if all members of the squad are Relic 5 or higher. If any unit is Relic 4 or below, then that level’s benefits are not applied to any member of the squad.

However, if a bonus mechanic applies only to a single, specific character in a squad, then only that character must satisfy the requirement of that Datacron level to receive its benefits, provided that the requirements of all previous bonus mechanics in that Datacron have been met.
data.DATACRON_HELP_3_BODY: Upgrading Datacrons requires a variety of materials; pay attention to what's needed to upgrade yours! When a Datacron is upgraded, it selects a random bonus. Each level of the Datacron specifies if this will be a bonus stat or mechanic. Bonus mechanics are only rolled within the scope of previous bonus mechanics on the Datacron.\n\nFor example, if a Datacron's first bonus mechanic is specific to Light Side characters, its later bonus mechanics are always specific to Light Side factions and characters. As another example, a Datacron with a bonus mechanic specific to the First Order will not roll a later bonus mechanic specific to the Empire or Nightsisters; it remains focused on the First Order faction and characters.
data.DATACRON_HELP_4_BODY_V2:
Datacron bonus mechanics can be re-rolled on most Datacrons for a cost in materials. However, Focused Datacrons can't be re-rolled at all.

Each re-roll on a Datacron increases in cost. Only the most recent unlocked bonus mechanic on a Datacron can be re-rolled until the Datacron has been maximally upgraded. Once a higher-level bonus mechanic has been unlocked, previous ones become locked. Bonus stats initially cannot be re-rolled.

Once a Datacron is fully upgraded, all of its levels can then be re-rolled, including both bonus stats and mechanics. However, a Datacron's bonus mechanics still cannot re-roll outside the locked scope of all bonus mechanics on the Datacron.

For example, a Datacron with bonus mechanics affecting Light Side, Resistance, and BB-8 cannot have its Light Side ability re-rolled to a Dark Side mechanic. However, it can be re-rolled to a different Light Side mechanic.
data.DATACRON_HELP_5_BODY_V2: Datacrons have a set lifespan. When a Datacron set reaches the end of its lifespan, all owned Datacrons within that set are automatically dismantled.\n\nMost unwanted Datacrons can be dismantled at any time, creating materials that can be used to upgrade other Datacrons. However, Focused Datacrons can't be dismantled until the set expires.

data.DATACRON_ROLE_ATTACKER_001_DESC: Whenever an Attacker critically hits they attack again(limit once per turn) Otherwise, they gain 10% Defense Penetration (stacking).\n\nWhenever an Attacker attacks out of turn they deal bonus True damage which can't be evaded.
data.DATACRON_ROLE_ATTACKER_002_DESC_V2:
Whenever an ally inflicts a debuff on an enemy, all Attacker allies gain Accuracy Up for 1 turn and 5% Offense (stacking, max 120%) until the end of battle. Whenever an Attacker ally attacks out of turn, they deal bonus True damage, which can't be evaded, and gain 5% Defense Penetration (stacking, max 120%) until the end of battle.

Whenever an Attacker ally uses a Special ability, damage they deal to enemies that turn is increased by 5% for each buff on that enemy.

During Attacker allies' turns, they ignore Stealth and Taunt if they have no debuff on them.
data.DATACRON_ROLE_HEALER_001_DESC:
Whenever a character is healed by an allied Healer they reduce their cooldowns by 1.

Whenever an ally Healer is critically hit they recover 10% Health and gain 10 Speed (stacking, max 100) for the rest of the encounter.

Whenever an ally is revived on an ally Healer's turn all allies recover 100% Max Health and Max Protection.

The first time each Healer ally is defeated they are revived and recover 100% Max Health.
data.DATACRON_ROLE_HEALER_002_DESC: At the start of their turn, {0} allies inflict Healing Immunity on all enemies for 2 turns, which can't be dispelled or resisted. Whenever a non-Healer character is healed by an allied Healer, they reduce their cooldowns by 1.\n\nWhenever an ally falls below 25% Health for the first time, all allies recover 50% Health and 100% Protection. The first time an ally is defeated, revive them with 50% Health and 2 stacks of Heal Over Time for 2 turns. Whenever {0} is critically hit, recover 15% Health and Protection and grant a stack of Heal Over Time to the weakest ally for 2 turns.
data.DATACRON_ROLE_SUPPORT_001_DESC:
Whenever a Support ally starts their turn dispel Tenacity Up from all enemies and then reduce their Tenacity by 100% until the end of the turn.

Whenever a Support inflicts debuff on an enemy all allies get benefits based on their roles for the rest of the encounter:

- [c][B5E7F5]Attackers:[-][/c] +10% Critical Damage
- [c][B5E7F5]Healers:[-][/c] +5% Tenacity
- [c][B5E7F5]Supports:[-][/c] +10% Potency
- [c][B5E7F5]Tanks:[-][/c] +5% Defense

Whenever a Support grants a buff to another ally they also inflict Buff Immunity for 1 turn on all enemies.
data.DATACRON_ROLE_SUPPORT_002_DESC:
At the start of each encounter, grant all allies Evasion Up and Tenacity Up for 2 turns and inflict Tenacity Down and Evasion Down on all enemies for 2 turns, which can't be evaded or resisted.

Whenever a non-support ally is critically hit, grant them Protection Up (20%, stacking, max 100%) for 2 turns.

At the start of their turn, {0} allies dispel all buffs on all enemies. If Evasion Up, Health Steal Up, Potency Up, or Tenacity Up were dispelled, inflict the opposite debuff on all enemies for 2 turns, which can't be evaded or resisted.

Whenever a {0} is critically hit or inflicted with a debuff, they Stealth for 1 turn.
data.DATACRON_ROLE_TANK_001_DESC_V2: At the start of their turn Tanks gain 20% of their Max Health as Max Protection. The first time they lose all of their Protection, they recover 100% Protection and gain 50% Max Protection.\n\nWhenever Tanks are inflicted with a debuff they Taunt for 2 turns. While Taunting they receive 50% less damage from out of turn attacks and assist whenever allies use a Special ability.
data.DATACRON_ROLE_TANK_002_DESC:
The first time a Tank ally is defeated, revive them with 100% Health and Protection, and they gain a bonus turn. Limit once per battle.

{0} allies Taunt for 1 turn, whenever another ally is inflicted with a debuff. Whenever {0} allies Taunt, they gain Defense Up for 1 turn and 5% Crit Avoidance (stacking) until the end of battle.

Whenever a {0} is critically hit while Taunting, they recover 15% Health and Protection. Whenever a non-tank ally uses a Special ability, {0} allies assist, if the enemy was Taunting, deal 250% bonus damage.

data.DEATHMATCH_MODIFIER_DESC_V2:
At the start of battle, one random non-Leader ally and one random non-Leader enemy gain [c][ffff33]Duelist[-][/c]. Characters without Duelist may not gain Turn Meter, buffs, or debuffs, be damaged, or be targeted. When a Duelist is defeated, the remaining Duelist gains [c][ffff33]Victor[-][/c] until the end of battle and Duelist is dispelled. Then, another random non-Leader ally and random non-Leader enemy gain Duelist. If there are no non-Leader counterparts for a Duelist, they are granted Victor by default.

If all non-Leader characters have Victor, the allied and enemy Leaders gain Duelist. When one of the Leaders is defeated, whichever team has more Victors wins.

Summoned units and pacifists flee immediately. General Skywalker may not be used. No characters can be revived.

[c][ffff33]Duelist:[-][/c] Enemies will target this character; defeating this character grants Victor

[c][ffff33]Victor:[-][/c] Defeated an enemy with Duelist

data.DOCTOR_APHRA_LIGHTSPEED_BUNDLE_INFO:
[c][F0FF23]MERGE UNITS[-][/c]

Units included in the Lightspeed Bundle are upgraded according to a predetermined set of upgrade criteria (listed below). The Lightspeed Bundle does not directly grant character shards / ship blueprints or resources used in merge upgrades. The upgrade criteria are evaluated against your existing roster, and your units are set to the greater of the two values.

Each unit will first be evaluated for existing shards or star rarity against the bundle upgrade criteria. A unit at lower star rarity (or unactivated with less cumulative shards/blueprints) than the bundle upgrade criteria will be upgraded and activated. Units that exceed the star rarity (or cumulative shards/blueprints) will be activated (if unactivated) and then evaluated for additional attributes (gear tier, ability tier, etc). Any surplus shards/blueprints over the bundle upgrade criteria will be retained.

If your previously unlocked units meet or exceed the bundle upgrade criteria for other attributes, any surplus value will be retained.

[b]CHARACTERS[/b]
- 7 Stars
- Level 85
- Relic Level 5
- Ability Tier 7
data.DOCTOR_APHRA_LIGHTSPEED_BUNDLE_TEXT: Unlock 7-Star and Relic 5 Hondo Ohnaka, 0-0-0, BT-1, and Sana Starros with this Doctor Aphra Lightspeed Bundle! Pick up this RARE offer to gain immediate access to [b]Doctor Aphra's[/b] Journey Guide event!
data.DOCTORAPHRA_GUIDE_DESCRIPTION: Archaeologist, opportunist, droid savant – Doctor Aphra is many things, though some question the legitimacy of her doctorate. As Vader's assistant, Aphra built a droid army to defeat the Imperial cyberneticist, Cylo. Escaping Vader, she returned to a life of adventure, retrieving the Ordu Aspectu's Rur crystal, kidnapping Hera Syndulla, and serving time at Accresker Jail. At the end of the day, Doctor Aphra relies on ingenuity and luck to get by, and it works… most of the time.
data.DOCTORAPHRA_T1_TO_T6: Potency allows Doctor Aphra to deliver potent debuffs while providing critical benefits for her team. Health allows her to withstand any traps the enemy has lying in wait.

data.DYNAMICDESC_LAYOUT_AAT_DIFF01_PHASE01_TE: [23C8F5]On one of the many battlefields of the Clone Wars, the nefarious General Grievous has made a rare appearance to personally direct the battle. Defeating him here would surely turn the tide of the war![-]
data.DYNAMICDESC_LAYOUT_AAT_DIFF01_PHASE02_TE: [23C8F5]Grievous's patience has worn thin--he orders one of his dreaded AATs to cover his retreat. With nigh-impervious armor and a small arsenal of anti-personnel weaponry, it is one of the deadliest weapons on the battlefield.[-]
data.DYNAMICDESC_LAYOUT_AAT_DIFF01_PHASE03_TE: [23C8F5]The AAT has been disabled, but the battle is far from over--Grievous summons a squad of B1 Battle Droids, led by one of his special B2 Rocket Troopers, to hold the line while the AAT is repaired.[-]
data.DYNAMICDESC_LAYOUT_AAT_DIFF01_PHASE04_TE: [23C8F5]Grievous has ordered an all-out offensive, deploying additional B2 Super Battle Droids to support the AAT, as well as granting clearance for air strikes to crush any opposition.[-]
data.DYNAMICDESC_LAYOUT_GRANTEDABILITY_DARK_H: [23C8F5]All of your Dark Side path Rise of the Empire Heroes (Director Krennic, Gar Saxon, Grand Inquisitor, Lord Vader, Second Sister, Third Sister) gain the following ability:[-]

data.DYNAMICDESC_LAYOUT_RANCOR_DIFF01_PHASE01: [23C8F5]Pig-like brutes known as Gamorreans stand as the first line of defense toward the inner sanctum of The Pit. Their captain, heavily guarded by his seemingly-endless waves of reinforcements, must be defeated to breach the sanctum door.[-]
data.DYNAMICDESC_LAYOUT_RANCOR_DIFF01_PHASE02: [23C8F5]The terror residing within the inner sanctum has been unleashed. Riled from the sounds of battle, the Rancor's enduring defenses are nearly impenetrable. Beware of its insatiable appetite![-]
data.DYNAMICDESC_LAYOUT_RANCOR_DIFF01_PHASE03: [23C8F5]Taking on a more aggressive nature, the Rancor is more susceptible to damage. Sometimes, however, the best defense is a strong, debilitating offense.[-]
data.DYNAMICDESC_LAYOUT_RANCOR_DIFF01_PHASE04: [23C8F5]Wounded but not tiring, the Rancor's rage during its final stand is unquestionable.[-]
data.DYNAMICDESC_LAYOUT_SITHRAID_PHASE01_TEXT: [23C8F5]At the doors to the Trayus Academy, the Lord of Hunger makes an appearance. The Sith Lord Nihilus has come to drain the force of those who wish to enter the Academy. Defeat Nihilus here to find the Core.[-]
data.DYNAMICDESC_LAYOUT_SITHRAID_PHASE02_TEXT: [23C8F5]As Nihilus retreats into the depths of the Academy, a new foe shows his face in the Sparring Room. The seemingly unkillable Lord of Pain is now on the offensive and seeks to destroy all who would try to stand in his way.[-]
data.DYNAMICDESC_LAYOUT_SITHRAID_PHASE03_TEXT: [23C8F5]Darth Sion is seemingly defeated, left lying in the Sparring Room. Inside of the Trayus Academy Core, the Master of the previous Sith lurks in the shadows. The Lord of Betrayal, Darth Traya, comes forward to destroy those who would defy her.[-]
data.DYNAMICDESC_LAYOUT_SITHRAID_PHASE04_TEXT: [23C8F5]Darth Nihilus and Darth Sion rejoin the fight alongside Darth Traya. Face the deadly Sith Triumvirate all at once![-]
data.DYNAMICDESC_LAYOUT_TERRITORYBATTLE_GEONO: [23C8F5]The Galactic Republic has amassed some of its best fighting forces in its onslaught on Geonosis. Be on the lookout for Elite characters – not only are they much stronger than normal characters, but they also have powerful Elite abilities![-]

[23C8F5]The Separatists have dug in with some of their deadliest fighting forces in defense of Geonosis. Be on the lookout for Elite characters – not only are they much stronger than normal characters, but they also have powerful Elite abilities![-]
data.DYNAMICDESC_LAYOUT_TERRITORYBATTLE_HOTH_: [23C8F5]The Rebel Alliance utilizes a myriad of seasoned soldiers well-equipped for combat in Hoth's harsh icy environment. data.EPISODE_TRACK_INFO_DESC:
Complete Quests during an Episode to advance along the Episode Track. Earn rewards on the Free Track for each milestone you reach, and purchase the Episode Pass to earn premium rewards on the Episode Track!

[b][EEC33B]Episode Pass:[-][/b] Purchase unlocks premium rewards on the Episode Track for the duration of the current Episode. Episode Track rewards are earned through gameplay, and unclaimed rewards are sent to the inbox after the Episode ends.

[b][EEC33B]Episode Pass+:[-][/b] Purchase unlocks premium rewards on the Episode Track and grants a bonus 50,000 Episode Points (EP). Pass+ rewards are automatically redeemed. Further Episode Track rewards are earned through gameplay, and unclaimed rewards are sent to the inbox after the Episode Ends.

[b][EEC33B]Pass+ Only:[-][/b] Available to purchase as an upgrade to Pass+ if the base Episode Pass is purchased. Purchase grants a bonus 50,000 EP. Pass+ rewards are automatically redeemed. Further Episode Track rewards are earned through gameplay, and unclaimed rewards are sent to the inbox after the Episode Ends.

data.EVENT_AHSOKATANA_GALACTICLEGEND_T01_DESC:
[c][ACFEFF][c][23C8F5]Victory Counts:[-][/c]
- Unlimited (4x rewards only)

[c][23C8F5]Required:[-][/c]
- Ahsoka Tano (Snips)
- Commander Ahsoka Tano
- CT-7567 "Rex"

[c][ACFEFF][c][23C8F5]Lore:[-][/c]
- Anakin trained Ahsoka by pitting her against a most formidable enemy: the very clones she would fight alongside during the Clone Wars

[c][23C8F5]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]
- Ahsoka Tano (Snips), CT-7567 "Rex", or Commander Ahsoka Tano being defeated will result in immediate loss
data.EVENT_AHSOKATANO_GALACTICLEGEND_T02_DESC:
[c][ACFEFF][c][23C8F5]Victory Counts:[-][/c]
- Unlimited (4x rewards only)

[c][23C8F5]Required:[-][/c]
- Ahsoka Tano (Snips)
- Barriss Offee
- Asajj Ventress

[c][ACFEFF][c][23C8F5]Lore:[-][/c]
- A pivotal moment for Ahsoka came as she was betrayed by Barriss Offee, a fellow Jedi Padawan she fought alongside during the Clone Wars; Barriss framed Ahsoka, and with the assistance of Bounty Hunter Asajj Ventress and the faith of her master Anakin she was able to finally clear her name with the Jedi Order

[c][23C8F5]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]
- Ahsoka Tano (Snips) being defeated will result in immediate loss
data.EVENT_AHSOKATANO_GALACTICLEGEND_T03_DESC:
[c][ACFEFF][c][23C8F5]Victory Counts:[-][/c]
- Unlimited (4x rewards only)

[c][23C8F5]Required:[-][/c]
- Commander Ahsoka Tano

[c][ACFEFF][c][23C8F5]Lore:[-][/c]
- Commander Ahsoka Tano has just learned of Maul's insidious plans to take down Anakin Skywalker in attempt to deprive Sidious of his new apprentice
data.EVENT_AHSOKATANO_GALACTICLEGEND_T04_DESC:
[c][ACFEFF][c][23C8F5]Victory Counts:[-][/c]
- Unlimited (3x rewards only)

[c][23C8F5]Required:[-][/c]
- Ahsoka Tano (Fulcrum)
- Ezra Bridger

[c][ACFEFF][c][23C8F5]Lore:[-][/c]
- Ahsoka assisted the crew of the Ghost on Malachor IV; it was here she would have her first confrontation against Darth Vader, the new incarnation of her former Jedi Master, Anakin Skywalker

[c][23C8F5]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]
- Ahsoka Tano (Fulcrum) being defeated will result in immediate loss
- Ezra Bridger's stats have been modified for this battle
- Darth Vader cannot be defeated in the first encounter
- At the start of battle, Darth Vader will gain Dramatic Entrance, which can't be copied, dispelled, or prevented
data.EVENT_AHSOKATANO_GALACTICLEGEND_T05_DESC:
[c][ACFEFF][c][23C8F5]Victory Counts:[-][/c]
- Unlimited (3x rewards only)

[c][23C8F5]Required:[-][/c]
- Commander Ahsoka Tano

[c][ACFEFF][c][23C8F5]Lore:[-][/c]
- Ahsoka Tano's quest to find Grand Admiral Thrawn would take her to Seatos, where she would confront Baylan Skoll, a former Jedi-turned-Mercenary; this confrontation would turn out to be a chrysalis in Ahsoka's life....

[c][23C8F5]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]
- Face off against Baylan Skoll, and to obtain victory, attempt to survive 10 turns!
- Baylan Skoll can't be defeated
- Commander Ahsoka's abilities and appearance has been modified for this battle

[c][F0FF23]Note:[-][/c] This version of Commander Ahsoka Tano has been modified and isn't obtainable, and can't be used outside of this battle.[-][/c]
data.EVENT_AHSOKATANO_GALACTICLEGEND_T06_DESC:
[c][ACFEFF][c][23C8F5]Victory Counts:[-][/c]
- Unlimited (10x rewards only)

[c][23C8F5]Required:[-][/c]
- Ahsoka Tano
- Padawan Sabine Wren

[c][23C8F5]Borrowed:[-][/c]
- Ezra Bridger (Exile)

[c][ACFEFF][c][23C8F5]Lore:[-][/c]
- Reunited with Ezra Bridger, Ahsoka and her Padawan, Sabine Wren, made one final attempt to stop Grand Admiral Thrawn from returning to the galaxy, only to be confronted by his forces; forces that proved loyal even in death

[c][23C8F5]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]
- Ezra Bridger (Exile) will be loaned to you for this event
- Ahsoka Tano being defeated will result in immediate loss
- Ahsoka Tano will not have access to her Ultimate ability for this battle and her abilities have been modified

[c][F0FF23]Note:[-][/c] This version of Ahsoka Tano has been modified and isn't obtainable, and can't be used outside of this battle.[-][/c]

data.EVENT_BADBATCHPROMO_TIER01_DESC:
[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]
- 1 per tier (1x rewards only)

[c][24ccf4]Borrowed:[-][/c]
[c]- Hunter[-][/c]
[c]- Wrecker[-][/c]
[c]- Echo[-][/c]
[c]- Tech[-][/c]
[c]- Omega[-][/c]

[c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]
- [c][ffff33]Combat Prowess[-][/c] deals Physical damage to target enemy and inflicts Expose; when fully upgraded, if the target enemy is debuffed, Hunter will attack again.
- [c][ffff33]Shrouded Approach[-][/c] gives Evasion Up and Stealth to Clone Trooper allies, then deals damage to all enemies.
- [c][ffff33]Finish What We Started[-][/c] inflicts Expose on target enemy and grants Turn Meter to a targeted Clone Trooper ally; when fully upgraded, if the ally target is Bad Batch, they ignore Taunt and inflict Stun on their target enemy, which can't be evaded.
- [c][ffff33]A Different Path[-][/c] buffs Bad Batch allies' Max Health, Max Protection, and Potency; when fully upgraded, when using an ability against a Target Locked enemy, Bad Batch allies can't be countered, and when Bad Batch allies use an ability, while they have Defense Up, they deal True damage to all enemies.
data.EVENT_BADBATCHPROMO_TIER02_DESC:
[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]
- 1 per tier (1x rewards only)

[c][24ccf4]Borrowed:[-][/c]
[c]- Hunter[-][/c]
[c]- Wrecker[-][/c]
[c]- Echo[-][/c]
[c]- Tech[-][/c]
[c]- Omega[-][/c]

[c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]
- [c][ffff33]Call the Shot[-][/c] inflicts Target Lock on Tech's target, with a chance to also inflict Target Lock on the healthiest enemy who doesn't already have it.
- [c][ffff33]Delicate Operation[-][/c] keeps Tech and his allies on their feet, recovering their Health plus applying Stealth and Translation.
- [c][ffff33]Brilliant Idea[-][/c] is a powerful ability that can turn the tide of battle. It dispels debuffs from Tech's allies, with a chance to Stun enemies that are Dazed or Target Locked.
- [c][ffff33]Clone Interpreter[-][/c] makes Tech even better at giving Translation to his Clone Trooper allies, who gain a stack every time they use a Special ability; when fully upgraded, Clone Interpreter boosts Tech's Speed, and at the start of battle, if all allies are Clone Troopers, Tech gains Stealth.
data.EVENT_BADBATCHPROMO_TIER03_DESC:
[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]
- 1 per tier (1x rewards only)

[c][24ccf4]Borrowed:[-][/c]
[c]- Hunter[-][/c]
[c]- Wrecker[-][/c]
[c]- Echo[-][/c]
[c]- Tech[-][/c]
[c]- Omega[-][/c]

[c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]
- [c][ffff33]Dauntless Commando[-][/c] gives Wrecker the ability to gain stacks of [c][ffff33]Fury[-][/c] by taking damage or using certain abilities, at max stacks of Fury, Wrecker becomes [c][ffff33]Furious[-][/c], which gives his activated abilities additional effects.
- [c][ffff33]The Cavalry[-][/c] deals damage to a single enemy. If Wrecker is Furious, he uses this ability again.
- [c][ffff33]I Hate That Word[-][/c] dispels Stealth from all enemies, and Clone Trooper allies recover Protection. If Wrecker is Furious, Bad Batch allies recover additional Protection.
- [c][ffff33]Wrecking Ball[-][/c] deals damage to all enemies and grants Wrecker Taunt while Clone Trooper allies gain Defense Up and Tenacity Up; if Wrecker is Furious, he will inflict Stun on all enemies.
data.EVENT_BADBATCHPROMO_TIER04_DESC:
[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]

[c][24ccf4]Borrowed:[-][/c]

[c]- Wrecker[-][/c]

[c]- Tech[-][/c]
[c]- Omega[-][/c]

[c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]
- [c][ffff33]Daring Defense[-][/c] damages the target enemy and gives a chance to grant Defense Up and Evasion Up (chance to avoid an enemy attack) to weakened Clone Trooper allies.
- [c][ffff33]One Step Ahead[-][/c] inflicts Buff Immunity on target enemy, and Expose on all enemies. Then, it dispels all debuffs on target other Clone Trooper ally who is then called to assist.
- [c][ffff33]Never Any Doubt[-][/c] gives all Clone Trooper allies Evasion Up and dispels all buffs on all enemies. For each buff dispelled, Clone Trooper allies gain additional Offense until the end of their next turn.
- With [c][ffff33]One That Survives[-][/c] whenever a Clone Trooper ally gains or loses a buff, they recover Health and Protection.
data.EVENT_BADBATCHPROMO_TIER05_DESC:

[c]- Omega[-][/c]

[c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]
- [c][ffff33]Disarming Shot[-][/c] deals damage to an enemy, and if Omega has Evasion Up, can Blind and Daze them.
- [c][ffff33]Adaptive Learner[-][/c] deals damage to an enemy, and if the enemy is Exposed, will inflict them with Target Lock, and remove Turn Meter.
- [c][ffff33]Empathy First[-][/c] dispels debuffs on Omega and gives her Stealth, Bad Batch allies gain Protection Up, Defense Penetration, and Turn Meter.
- [c][ffff33]Part of the Squad[-][/c] gives Omega additional bonuses while Stealthed and bonuses to Offense if all of her allies are Bad Batch.

[c][ACFEFF][c][23C8F5]Victory Counts:[-][/c]

[c][23C8F5]Recommended:[-][/c]
- Mods rarity Mk VI
- Zeta ability upgrades

[c][23C8F5]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]
- The events on Coruscant sent ripples of change across the galaxy.
- Prevent Bad Batch enemies from completing their rescue objectives to keep the battle in your favor.

data.EVENT_BESET_ON_ALL_SIDES_TIER02_DESC:
[c][ACFEFF][c][23C8F5]Victory Counts:[-][/c]
- Unlimited (1x rewards only)

[c][23C8F5]Required:[-][/c]
- Depa Billaba (Relic Level 5 or higher)

[c][23C8F5]Recommended:[-][/c]
- Mods rarity Mk VI
- Zeta ability upgrades

[c][23C8F5]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]
- Once the Padawan of Mace Windu, this fearless Jedi Master helped ignite the spark that would one day fuel a galactic rebellion.
- Depa starts the battle with 60 stacks of [c][F0FF23]Caleb's Escape[-][/c]. When she reaches 0 stacks, the battle ends in victory.
- When Depa ends her turn, she loses 1 stack of Caleb's Escape. Whenever she defeats an enemy, she loses 5 stacks.
- Depa's Clone Troopers will respawn and trigger additional effects when defeated.
- CC-10/994 "Grey" can inflict Speed Down which enables additional effects for his team and prevents Depa from counterattacking. Dispelling this through strategic play will help secure victory.
- Depa being defeated before reaching 0 stacks of Caleb's Escape will result in immediate loss.[-][/c]
data.EVENT_BESET_ON_ALL_SIDES_TIER03_DESC:
[c][ACFEFF][c][23C8F5]Victory Counts:[-][/c]
- Unlimited (1x rewards only)

[c][23C8F5]Required:[-][/c]
- Temple Guard (Relic Level 5 or higher)

[c][23C8F5]Recommended:[-][/c]
- Mods rarity Mk VI
- Zeta ability upgrades

[c][23C8F5]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]
- A Jedi Master's guidance echoes through their Padawan's actions long after their time together has passed.
- Kanan gains a stack of Kanan's Will whenever he uses a Special ability and Temple Guard's cooldowns are refreshed.
- When Kanan has 10 stacks of [c][F0FF23]Kanan's Will[-][/c] at the start of his turn, the battle ends in victory.
- Kanan's Tenacity is doubled whenever he has Taunt. Dispelling it will be crucial.
- At the end of each of his turns, Kanan is inflicted with Ability Block. Temple Guard's first Special ability, [c][F0FF23]Fear Leads to Anger[-][/c] dispels it and all buffs on Kanan
- Temple Guard's Basic ability recovers 10% Health and Protection for each instance of damage dealt.
- Temple Guard's second Special ability, [c][F0FF23]Stoic Determination[-][/c] inflicts Daze, which stops Kanan from counterattacking.[-][/c]
data.EVENT_BESET_ON_ALL_SIDES_TIER04_DESC:
[c][ACFEFF][c][23C8F5]Victory Counts:[-][/c]
- Unlimited (1x rewards only)

[c][23C8F5]Borrowed:[-][/c]
- Jedi Master Mace Windu

[c][23C8F5]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]
- Jedi Master Mace Windu finds himself beset by Separatist forces. But enough is enough; Mace has had it with their incursion and will show them the folly of their programming.
- Jedi Master Mace Windu will be loaned to you for this battle at Relic 5.
- Whenever an enemy ends their turn or whenever Jedi Master Mace Windu is damaged, Mace has a chance to gain 100% Turn Meter.
- Whenever Jedi Master Mace Windu defeats an enemy, his cooldowns are reset and he has a chance to gain 100% Turn Meter.[-][/c]

data.EVENT_HONDOOHNAKA_GALACTICLEGEND_T01_DES:
[c][ACFEFF][c][23C8F5]Victory Counts:[-][/c]
- Unlimited (4x rewards only)

[c][23C8F5]Required:[-][/c]
- General Kenobi
- Hondo Ohnaka

[c][23C8F5]Borrowed:[-][/c]
- CC-2224 "Cody"

[c][23C8F5]Hondo Says:[-][/c]
Ahh, the Utapau affair! Now that is a tale worth telling over a drink you didn't pay for. You see, General Kenobi and I — well, we've crossed paths more times than I've double-crossed warlords. Which is to say...often.

Now, yes, I am a Pirate, but even I know when the galaxy needs a little Hondo heroism. So there I was — charm in one hand, distraction in the other — helping old Kenobi outmaneuver that walking scrap heap, Grievous.

A little chaos here, a "misplaced" shipment there, some very expensive tactical advice...and bam! Victory. You're welcome, Republic.

Of course, I may have had one or two completely unrelated personal interests in the matter, but who's counting? Certainly not the Jedi. And now, thanks to my efforts, Kenobi owes me a favor. Or three. And that, my friend, is the true profit.

[c][23C8F5]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]
- General Grievous can't be defeated or targeted in this battle
- You must defeat all of General Grievous' squad to be victorious.
- Hondo Ohnaka will have his appearance and abilities altered for this battle.
data.EVENT_HONDOOHNAKA_GALACTICLEGEND_T02_DES:
[c][ACFEFF][c][23C8F5]Victory Counts:[-][/c]
- Unlimited (4x rewards only)

[c][23C8F5]Required:[-][/c]
- Hondo Ohnaka

[c][23C8F5]Borrowed:[-][/c]
- Kelleran Beq

[c][23C8F5]Hondo Says:[-][/c]
Ahhh... Order 66. Nasty, nasty business, my friend. You know, I was there. Yes—me. Right in the middle of it. Jedi Temple in flames, clone troopers everywhere, chaos thick in the air like the smell of a bad deal going worse. And scared little younglings? Ohhh, so many. Poor things didn’t even know who to trust. Lucky for them, they had me.

While a very skilled, very glowstick-happy Jedi kept the troopers busy, I slipped in and did what I do best – navigated the chaos, calmed the little ones, and secured their escape.

Did I have my reasons? Always.

[c][23C8F5]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]
- The youngling can't gain Turn Meter, or be damaged, debuffed, or defeated.
- The youngling is not obtainable and can't be used in any other event or game mode.
- The Dark Side clouds everything and all Jedi will lose Foresight when Clone Troopers use their abilities.
- Hondo Ohnaka will have his appearance and abilities altered for this battle.
data.EVENT_HONDOOHNAKA_GALACTICLEGEND_T03_DES:
[c][ACFEFF][c][23C8F5]Victory Counts:[-][/c]
- Unlimited (4x rewards only)

[c][23C8F5]Required:[-][/c]
- Hondo Ohnaka
- Ezra Bridger

[c][23C8F5]Borrowed:[-][/c]
- Ahsoka Tano (Fulcrum)

[c][23C8F5]Hondo Says:[-][/c]
Ahhh, Malachor. What a disaster! Ancient Sith traps, spooky ruins, a brooding Darth Vader, and a very intense Togruta with two lightsabers—yes, that one.

And there I was, as always, offering my unmatched strategic brilliance. Some say she teamed up with a Hutt—who am I to confirm or deny? I just know I was the one thinking clearly while everyone else was swinging lightsabers and screaming.

It was my quick thinking that helped them survive. No need to thank me. Actually... no, wait—yes, there is.

[c][23C8F5]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]
- Ahsoka Tano (Fulcrum) or Hondo Ohnaka being defeated will result in immediate loss.
- At the start of battle, Darth Vader will gain Dramatic Entrance, which can't be copied, dispelled, or prevented.
- Hondo Ohnaka will have his appearance and abilities altered for this battle.
data.EVENT_HONDOOHNAKA_GALACTICLEGEND_T04_DES:
[c][ACFEFF][c][23C8F5]Victory Counts:[-][/c]
- Unlimited (3x rewards only)

[c][23C8F5]Required:[-][/c]
- Hondo Ohnaka

[c][23C8F5]Borrowed:[-][/c]
- Captain Han Solo
- Rebel Officer Leia Organa
- C-3PO
- Chewbacca

[c][23C8F5]Hondo Says:[-][/c]
AAhhh yes, Hoth! Cold. Miserable. Absolutely crawling with Imperials—and, as it happens, adventure!

Chewbacca—furry, loud, surprisingly graceful in a blizzard—and a few of his less memorable friends were in desperate need of an exit. Who answered the call? Hondo Ohnaka, of course. No charge! Well... no upfront charge.

Together, we dashed through frozen corridors, fended off snowtroopers, and just barely avoided a hallway conversation with Darth Vader. Close one.

But thanks to my quick thinking and Chewie’s excellent growling, everyone escaped intact—and with all fingers and fur accounted for.

[c][23C8F5]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]
- Each time an enemy takes a turn, Vader gets closer to entering the battle.
- Hondo Ohnaka will have his appearance and abilities altered for this battle.
data.EVENT_HONDOOHNAKA_GALACTICLEGEND_T05_DES:
[c][ACFEFF][c][23C8F5]Victory Counts:[-][/c]
- Unlimited (5x rewards only)

[c][23C8F5]Required:[-][/c]
- Pirate King Hondo Ohnaka

[c][23C8F5]Borrowed:[-][/c]
- Jedi Knight Luke Skywalker

[c][23C8F5]Hondo Says:[-][/c]
Ahhh, the Battle of Endor! Now that was a party. Forests, firepower, fuzzy warriors with sharp sticks—it had everything! And right at the heart of it? Me. And... young Skywalker, of course.

He was on his way to confront Darth Vader and that wrinkly lightning enthusiast, and I—being the responsible, deeply strategic individual that I am—insisted on coming along. You know, to keep him out of trouble. And alive. Mostly alive.

With my guidance—and the occasional perfectly timed suggestion—the boy practically danced through every obstacle. Even the ones hurled at him by the Force.

Some say the galaxy was saved by hope, destiny, and redemption. I say... a little Pirate insight didn’t hurt either.

[c][23C8F5]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]
- Jedi Knight Luke Skywalker being defeated will result in immediate loss.
- The Emperor's overconfidence is his weakness.
- In the final encounter, Darth Vader is immune to damage and all effects and can't be targeted.
data.EVENT_HONDOOHNAKA_GALACTICLEGEND_T06_DES:
[c][ACFEFF][c][23C8F5]Victory Counts:[-][/c]
- Unlimited (5x rewards only)

[c][23C8F5]Required:[-][/c]
- Pirate King Hondo Ohnaka
- Rey (Scavenger)

[c][23C8F5]Borrowed:[-][/c]
- Finn

[c][23C8F5]Hondo Says:[-][/c]
Ah yes, Starkiller Base! Cold place. Bad energy. Even worse company. And yes, I was there—when young Rey and that very enthusiastic ex-stormtrooper confronted the ever-brooding Kylo Ren.

He’d just murdered his own father, you know. Terrible family dynamic. Poor Chewbacca—absolutely devastated. And who was there to help hold it all together? Me. That’s who.

Now, I don’t like to take credit where it’s not due... but thankfully, it is. If I hadn’t been on that base—offering timely distraction, a bit of tactical brilliance, and possibly detonating something by accident—who knows if those two would’ve survived?

So in a way… you have me to thank for the state of the galaxy. You’re welcome.

[c][23C8F5]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]
- Fight Kylo Ren to escape Starkiller Base!
- Pirate King Hondo Ohnaka will start this battle with 75% Ultimate Charge.
- Rey (Scavenger) and Finn gain the Pirate tag for this battle.
- Victory will be achieved when Kylo Ren reaches 1% Health.
- Rey (Scavenger) will have her appearance and abilities altered for this battle.

data.EVENT_KENOBI_GALACTICLEGEND_SUMMARY: Jedi Master Kenobi is one of few Jedi who survived Order 66. He reluctantly fought his former student, Anakin Skywalker, on the lava planet of Mustafar, after discovering that Anakin led the attack on the Jedi Temple on Coruscant.
data.EVENT_KEYXP_SUMMARY: Earn Training Droids every Battle with chances at high rarity versions! Use Training Droids to quickly level up characters.
data.EVENT_KRRSANTAN_NAME: Krrsantan is available on Cantina Battle nodes!
data.EVENT_KRRSANTAN_SUMMARY: For a limited time, [b]Krrsantan[/b] has been added to [b]Cantina Battle nodes[/b] as bonus drops! During this event, the drop rate on each node has been scaled to Cantina Energy.\n\nCantina Battles are rewarding bonus drops from 12/21/2022 through 12/22/2022.
data.EVENT_KUIIL_IG11_NAME: Kuiil and IG-11 are on Cantina Nodes!
data.EVENT_KUIIL_IG11_SUMMARY: For a limited time, Kuiil and IG-11 have been added to all Cantina Nodes as bonus drops. During this event, these characters' drop rate on each node has been scaled to Cantina Energy.\n\nFollowing the end of this event, both characters will move to their more permanent drop locations.
data.EVENT_KYLE_KATARN_NAME: Kyle Katarn is available on Fleet Battle nodes!
data.EVENT_KYLE_KATARN_SUMMARY: For a limited time, [b]Kyle Katarn[/b] has been added to [b]all Fleet Battle nodes[/b] as bonus drops! During this event, this unit's drop rate on each node has been scaled to Energy.\n\nFleet Battles are rewarding bonus drops from 12/6 through 12/7.

data.EVENT_LORDVADER_ENCOUNTER01_MESSAGE01: Tell me the sequence to disarm the bomb!
data.EVENT_LORDVADER_ENCOUNTER01_MESSAGE02: Never, Dooku would kill me for losing Anaxes.
data.EVENT_LORDVADER_ENCOUNTER02_MESSAGE01: My powers have doubled since the last time we met, Count.
data.EVENT_LORDVADER_ENCOUNTER02_MESSAGE02: Good. Twice the pride, double the fall.
data.EVENT_LORDVADER_ENCOUNTER03_MESSAGE01: You have done well, my new apprentice. Now, Lord Vader, go and bring peace to the Empire.
data.EVENT_LORDVADER_GALACTICLEGEND_SUMMARY: Lord Vader's descent into the dark side is nearly complete after his attack on the Jedi Temple on Coruscant. Blinded by hatred, he confronts his former friend and Master, Obi-Wan Kenobi, on the lava planet of Mustafar.

data.EVENT_MARK_VI_INTERCEPTOR_SUMMARY:
The [b]Mark VI Interceptor[/b] has arrived!

For a limited time, Mark VI Interceptor blueprints are available as bonus rewards on all Fleet Battle nodes. Head over and start earning blueprints for this powerful Sith Empire ship! During this event, Mark VI Interceptor blueprint's drop rate on each node has been scaled to Ship Energy.

Fleet Battles are rewarding bonus drops from 6/9 through 6/17.

[c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]
- 4-LOM's Basic ability, [c][F0FF23]Destructive Rotation[-][/c], inflicts Defense Down and all Dark Side Bounty Hunter Attackers Stealth during 4-LOM's turn.
- 4-LOM's potential shines through his [c][F0FF23]Payout[-][/c]. He gains Potency, and whenever he inflicts [c][ffaa00]Corrupted Translation[-][/c], he also inflicts an extra stack.
- His Unique, [c][F0FF23]Override Programming[-][/c], grants 4-LOM Potency and lets him assist once per turn when a Bounty Hunter ally attacks out of turn. 4-LOM reduces his cooldowns by attacking enemies with Accuracy Down. Whenever an enemy has their Turn Meter manipulated while having Corrupted Translation on them, 4-LOM gains bonus Turn Meter.

data.EVENT_MARQUEE_APPO_M01_DESC:
[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]
- Are [c][F0FF23]NOT SHARED[-][/c] between tiers
