[c][24ccf4]Borrowed:[-][/c]
- Grand Moff Tarkin
- Death Trooper
- Scout Trooper
- Stormtrooper
- CC-1119 "Appo"

[c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]
- Appo's Basic ability, [c][F0FF23]Imperial March[-][/c], offers offensive boosts, with added effectiveness when used on his turn.
- His first Special ability, [c][F0FF23]Knightfall[-][/c], utilizes buff dispels to keep enemies at a disadvantage while providing assists and buffs to his allies.
- [c][F0FF23]No Witnesses[-][/c], his second Special ability, gains additional value when enemies are affected by Damage Over Time and has strong synergy with Galactic Legend Lord Vader.
- His Unique ability, [c][F0FF23]Vader’s Fist[-][/c], enhances Appo, Dark Side Clone Troopers, and Lord Vader with a range of powerful buffs, gaining extra power through his Omicron in Territory Battles.
- His summoned ally, [c][F0FF23]Knightfall Trooper[-][/c], is a formidable attacker while also making Appo more resilient through several unique synergies.

data.EVENT_MARQUEE_B1BATTLEDROIDV2_BONUS_DESC: [B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n In this event, you will face a determined team of Jedi! These formidable warriors once led the clone armies of the Galactic Republic. \n Successfully eliminating General Kenobi is the key to being free to attack Anakin and Ahsoka.
data.EVENT_MARQUEE_B1BATTLEDROIDV2_M01_DESC: [B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n[c][F0FF23]DROID BATTALION[-][/c] - B1s can't score critical hits. B1s have 1 Health and you start with a number of B1s at your disposal. B1s gain Offense while Separatist allies gain Tenacity and Critical Hit Avoidance for each B1 on the battlefield. When B1s are destroyed, Separatist allies gain Turn Meter.
data.EVENT_MARQUEE_B1BATTLEDROIDV2_M02_DESC: [B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n[c][F0FF23]B1 BARRAGE[-][/c] - Deals Physical damage to target enemy. If the damaged enemy is Target Locked, all Droid allies recover Health and Protection.
data.EVENT_MARQUEE_B1BATTLEDROIDV2_M03_DESC: [B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n[c][F0FF23]BLAST THEM![-][/c] - Deals Physical damage to all enemies and inflicts Target Lock on the selected target. Target ally recovers Health and Protection for each B1 remaining.
data.EVENT_MARQUEE_B1BATTLEDROIDV2_M04_DESC: [B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n[c][F0FF23]ROGER ROGER[-][/c] - Whenever another Separatist ally attacks an enemy with their Basic ability, the B1s assist with reduced damage. When another Droid uses a Special ability, the B1s gain Turn Meter.
data.EVENT_MARQUEE_B1BATTLEDROIDV2_M05_DESC: [B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n B1 Battle Droids are best with Droid or Separatist allies; deploy them with those factions to maximize the potential of the droid army! \n In this battle, you will be using B1 in a full Separatist squad. Enjoy!
data.EVENT_MARQUEE_B1BATTLEDROIDV2_SUMMARY: Join forces with [c][F0FF23]B1 BATTLE DROID[/c][-] to wage war against the Galactic Republic!

 [c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]
- Batcher's Basic ability, [c][ffff33]Crushing Assault[-][/c], grants her Speed Up. If used during her turn and the enemy was Marked, she inflicts Off Balance and Defense Down.
- Her first Special ability, [c][ffff33]Piercing Howl[-][/c], grants her Bad Batch allies Offense Up and inflicts Marked on the target enemy. It also inflicts Offense Down, and Ability Block onto all enemies with Off Balance.
- [c][ffff33]Ferocious Bite[-][/c], her second Special ability, deals damage to the target enemy and inflicts them with 2 stacks of Bleed (max 6) and Pinned.
- Bleed is a debuff that lowers the enemy's Speed and Tenacity, and deals damage at the start of their turn. It lasts until the end of the encounter, and can't be dispelled unless the enemy recovers Health.
- Her Unique ability, [c][ffff33]LH-201[-][/c], lets Batcher ignore Stealth and Taunt during her turn, and she gets bonuses when a Bad Batch ally is Captive.

data.EVENT_MARQUEE_BH_00_CONTRACTS_SUMMARY: \nControl a powerful Bounty Hunter squad and learn about the new [c][F0FF23]CONTRACT[-][/c] system.
data.EVENT_MARQUEE_BH_01_BOSSK_M00_DESC: [B5E7F5]Contracts Tutorial:[-]\n - Learn about the new Bounty Hunter [c][F0FF23]CONTRACTS[-][/c] with a powerful Bounty Hunter squad.
data.EVENT_MARQUEE_BH_01_BOSSK_M01_DESC: [B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][F0FF23]PREY ON THE WEAK[-][/c] deals Physical damage and will Critically Hit the weakest enemy if they are the target
data.EVENT_MARQUEE_BH_01_BOSSK_M02_DESC: [B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][F0FF23]HUNTING PARTY[-][/c] Stuns the target and calls Bounty Hunters to assist for reduced damage
data.EVENT_MARQUEE_BH_01_BOSSK_M03_DESC: [B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][F0FF23]PREDATOR INSTINCTS[-][/c] dispels all Debuffs on Bossk and grants him Taunt and Frenzy
data.EVENT_MARQUEE_BH_01_BOSSK_M04_DESC: [B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][F0FF23]ON THE HUNT[-][/c] grants all Bounty Hunters bonus Tenacity and Protection
data.EVENT_MARQUEE_BH_01_BOSSK_M05_DESC: [B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][F0FF23]TRANDOSHAN RAGE[-][/c] grants Bossk Health and Defense while Taunting, and Offense and Health Steal while attacking buffed enemies
data.EVENT_MARQUEE_BH_01_BOSSK_M06_DESC: [B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - This is a Practice Tier. Bossk will be forced into the Leader position. Use this mission to perfect your strategy with Bossk!
data.EVENT_MARQUEE_BH_01_BOSSK_M07_DESC: [B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - This Bonus Tier features powerful enemies and requires careful strategy.
data.EVENT_MARQUEE_BH_01_BOSSK_SUMMARY: \nJoin forces with [c][F0FF23]BOSSK[-][/c] and track down elusive bounties.
data.EVENT_MARQUEE_BH_02_HOUNDSTOOTH_BONUS_DE: This Bonus tier features powerful enemies and will require careful strategy to complete.
data.EVENT_MARQUEE_BH_02_HOUNDSTOOTH_M01_DESC: [B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][F0FF23]TOOTH AND NAIL[-][/c] deals Physical damage to the target enemy and dispels all debuffs from Hound's Tooth\n - Hound's Tooth recovers Health and Protection if it has Taunt
data.EVENT_MARQUEE_BH_02_HOUNDSTOOTH_M02_DESC: [B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][F0FF23]DEVOURER OF PREY[-][/c] deals Physical damage to the target enemy and inflicts Breach, then Hound's Tooth gains Taunt\n - [c][F0FF23]BREACH[-][/c] reduces Speed and Defense
data.EVENT_MARQUEE_BH_02_HOUNDSTOOTH_M03_DESC:
[B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]
 - [c][F0FF23]TRANDOSHAN BARRICADE[-][/c] grants Hound's Tooth Protection Up (stacking) whenever it takes damage from an enemy
 - While not Taunting, Hound's Tooth has increased Tenacity and gains Turn Meter whenever an ally takes damage from an enemy
 - When Hound's Tooth loses Taunt, it gains Taunt if an enemy is Breached
 - While Hound's Tooth is active, Breached enemies have reduced Evasion
data.EVENT_MARQUEE_BH_02_HOUNDSTOOTH_M04_DESC: [B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][F0FF23]SECURE THE HUNT[-][/c] is a Reinforcement Ability that grants all allies Tenacity\n - Additionally, all Bounty Hunter allies gain Counter Chance (stacking) whenever they Resist a detrimental effect
data.EVENT_MARQUEE_BH_02_HOUNDSTOOTH_PRACTICE: This is a Practice Tier. Hound's Tooth and the Executrix will be forced units, and you do not need to bring a full fleet in order to experiment with different strategies.
data.EVENT_MARQUEE_BH_02_HOUNDSTOOTH_SUMMARY: Join forces with the [c][F0FF23]HOUND'S TOOTH[-][/c] and hunt an elusive bounty across the galaxy!
data.EVENT_MARQUEE_BH_03_EMBO_BONUS_DESC: [B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - This Bonus Tier features powerful enemies and will require careful strategy to complete.
data.EVENT_MARQUEE_BH_03_EMBO_M01_DESC: [B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][F0FF23]DISMANTLING SHOT[-][/c] dispels all buffs from the target enemy and deals Physical damage
data.EVENT_MARQUEE_BH_03_EMBO_M02_DESC: [B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][F0FF23]KYUZO WAR HELMET[-][/c] deals bonus damage based on Embo's Max Protection, then Embo loses 50% Protection
data.EVENT_MARQUEE_BH_03_EMBO_M03_DESC: [B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][F0FF23]THE QUIET ASSASSIN[-][/c] grants Bounty Hunter allies Counter Chance and Health Steal when Embo is in the Leader slot\n - When fully upgraded, Bounty Hunter allies gain Offense Up when they score Critical Hits
data.EVENT_MARQUEE_BH_03_EMBO_M04_DESC:
[B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]
 - [c][F0FF23]WAY OF THE KYUZO[-][/c] grants different bonuses based on whether or not Embo has Protection
 - When Embo receives damage from an attack and has no Protection, he gains Foresight
 - When fully upgraded, Embo can't be Critically Hit
data.EVENT_MARQUEE_BH_03_EMBO_M05_DESC:
[B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]
 - Embo's [c][F0FF23]CONTRACT[-][/c] is active when he is in the Leader slot, and not the Ally slot
 - Damage enemies without Buffs to complete the Contract (only Bounty Hunter allies can contribute)
 - When completed, Embo gains a chance to take a bonus turn after scoring a Critical Hit and all Bounty Hunter allies gain Offense and deal bonus damage based on the target's Max Protection
data.EVENT_MARQUEE_BH_03_EMBO_M06_DESC: [B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - When fully upgraded, [c][F0FF23]EMBO'S PAYOUT[-][/c] grants Embo the Special Ability [c][F0FF23]ELUSIVE STRIKES[-][/c] when a Bounty Hunter Contract is completed\n - [c][F0FF23]ELUSIVE STRIKES[-][/c] ignores Protection, deals Physical damage, and recovers Protection equal to the damage dealt
data.EVENT_MARQUEE_BH_03_EMBO_PRACTICE_DESC: [B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - This is a Practice Tier. Embo will be forced into the Leader slot. Use this mission to perfect your strategy with Embo!
data.EVENT_MARQUEE_BH_03_EMBO_SUMMARY: Join forces with [c][F0FF23]EMBO[-][/c] and track bounties across the galaxy!
data.EVENT_MARQUEE_BH_04_IG2000_BONUS_DESC: This Bonus tier features powerful enemies and will require careful strategy to complete.
data.EVENT_MARQUEE_BH_04_IG2000_M01_DESC: [B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][F0FF23]EXPLOIT IDENTIFIED[-][/c] deals Physical damage to target enemy\n - If the enemy is Breached, the IG-2000 attacks again
data.EVENT_MARQUEE_BH_04_IG2000_M02_DESC: [B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][F0FF23]INERTIAL DAMPENERS DISABLED[-][/c] deals Physical damage to target enemy and inflicts Stun and Target Lock \n - Deals more damage to Breached enemies
data.EVENT_MARQUEE_BH_04_IG2000_M03_DESC:
[B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]
 - [c][F0FF23]RECONSTRUCT PROTOCOL[-][/c] recovers the IG-2000's Health at the start of each turn
 - The IG-2000 gains Offense for each debuffed enemy
 - While the IG-2000 is active, Breached enemies have lowered Critical Chance
data.EVENT_MARQUEE_BH_04_IG2000_M04_DESC:
[B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]
 - [c][F0FF23]INITIATE SLICE SEQUENCE[-][/c] is a Reinforcement Ability that grants a random Attacker ally Offense Up
 - All enemies are inflicted with Critical Chance Down
 - Additionally, Target Lock is inflicted on the highest and lowest Health enemies
data.EVENT_MARQUEE_BH_04_IG2000_PRACTICE_DESC: This is a Practice Tier. The IG-2000 and the Executrix will be forced units, and you do not need to bring a full fleet in order to experiment with different strategies.
data.EVENT_MARQUEE_BH_04_IG2000_SUMMARY: Join forces with the [c][F0FF23]IG-2000[-][/c] to propagate cold, metal, and evil across the galaxy!
data.EVENT_MARQUEE_BH_05_XANADU_BONUS_DESC: This Bonus Tier features powerful enemies and will require careful strategy to complete.
data.EVENT_MARQUEE_BH_05_XANADU_M01_DESC: [B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][F0FF23]HULL BREACH[-][/c] deals damage and inflicts [c][F0FF23]BREACH[-][/c]\n - Breach lowers enemy Defense and Speed by 25%
data.EVENT_MARQUEE_BH_05_XANADU_M02_DESC: [B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][F0FF23]ROGUE MANEUVER[-][/c] deals damage to all enemies, inflicts Target Lock on the weakest enemy, then calls a targeted ally to assist\n - If any enemy is already Target Locked, they are inflicted with Breach
data.EVENT_MARQUEE_BH_05_XANADU_M03_DESC: [B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][F0FF23]CLOAK AND DAGGER[-][/c] grants Stealth at the start of an Encounter or when a Scoundrel ally suffers a critical hit, and lowers the Offense of Breached enemies\n - When fully upgraded, Bounty Hunter allies will also deal additional damage when attacking a Breached enemy
data.EVENT_MARQUEE_BH_05_XANADU_M04_DESC: [B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][F0FF23]INTO THE BREACH[-][/c] inflicts Breach on the target enemy when Xanadu Blood enters from Reinforcement\n - When fully upgraded, Scoundrel allies also gain Retribution when Xanadu Blood enters from Reinforcement and all enemies gain Defense Down
data.EVENT_MARQUEE_BH_05_XANADU_PRACTICE_DESC: This is a Practice Tier. Xanadu Blood and Executrix will be forced allies. Experiment with different team compositions and strategies to learn the power of the Xanadu Blood.
data.EVENT_MARQUEE_BH_05_XANADU_SUMMARY: Form a fleet and battle with Cad Bane’s [c][F0FF23]XANADU BLOOD[-][/c]!
data.EVENT_MARQUEE_BH_06_JANGO_BONUS_BOUNTY_0: [c][B5E7F5]Requirements:[-][/c] Bounty Hunters\n\n  A member of one of the criminal cartels has information that could jeopardize our plan. You will eliminate this criminal and ensure nobody interferes.

[c][B5E7F5]Requirements:[-][/c] Bounty Hunters\n\n  An opportunity has arisen to eliminate a high ranking Jedi Temple Guard who has left Coruscant for unknown reasons. Use extreme caution and eliminate the target and any Jedi present.
[c][B5E7F5]Requirements:[-][/c] Bounty Hunters\n\n  A group of witches has been isolated on Dathomir. This is a rare opportunity to eliminate some potential competition, so see to it.
data.EVENT_MARQUEE_BH_06_JANGO_M01_DESC: [B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][F0FF23]UNSCRUPULOUS GUNFIRE[-][/c] deals damage which increases for each debuff the enemy is suffering from\n - When fully upgraded, Jango will attack again if the enemy is debuffed
data.EVENT_MARQUEE_BH_06_JANGO_M02_DESC: [B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][F0FF23]SHRAPNEL BLAST[-][/c] deals damage to the primary target and another random enemy, in addition to applying Healing Immunity\n - When fully upgraded, enemies are also inflicted with Stagger
data.EVENT_MARQUEE_BH_06_JANGO_M03_DESC: [B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][F0FF23]CONFLAGRATION[-][/c] inflicts BURNING and deals damage, which can't be Evaded\n - [c][F0FF23]BURNING[-][/c] minimizes Evasion chance on afflicted units and deals damage over time
data.EVENT_MARQUEE_BH_06_JANGO_M04_DESC:
[B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]
 - [c][F0FF23]ANYTHING TO GET AHEAD[-][/c] grants Scoundrel allies Speed, lowers enemies Tenacity, and has other beneficial effects
 - When fully upgraded it adds a Contract ability to damage Debuffed enemies with a Basic or Special ability
 - When Jango fulfills his Leadership Contract, all allies gain [c][F0FF23]BOUNTY HUNTER'S RESOLVE[-][/c] and increased Critical Chance
data.EVENT_MARQUEE_BH_06_JANGO_M05_DESC: [B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][F0FF23]NOTORIOUS REPUTATION[-][/c] grants Jango bonus Defense Penetration and Health, and prevents enemies he defeats from being Revived\n - When fully upgraded, Jango Fett has 100% Defense Penetration making him extremely powerful against high Defense targets
data.EVENT_MARQUEE_BH_06_JANGO_M06_DESC: [B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - Jango Fett's [c][F0FF23]CONTRACT[-][/c] grants Jango a large Offense boost\n - When fully upgraded, Jango gains Damage Immunity briefly once his Contract is fulfilled
data.EVENT_MARQUEE_BH_06_JANGO_NAME: THE TEMPLATE IN THE TEMPEST\n[c][FFC891]Marquee Event[-][/c]
data.EVENT_MARQUEE_BH_06_JANGO_PRACTICE_DESC: [B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - This is a Practice Tier. Jango Fett will be placed into the Leader slot, and you can bring as little as a single unit in order to experiment with different strategies.
data.EVENT_MARQUEE_BH_06_JANGO_SUMMARY: Join forces with [c][F0FF23]JANGO FETT[-][/c] and evaluate the new Clone Troopers. Then hunt important targets across the Galaxy with other [c][F0FF23]BOUNTY HUNTERS[-][/c] before the Jedi uncover your mission.

- Crosshair is at his best when he loses the [c][F0FF23]Shaken[-][/c] debuff. Utilize Target Practice to help dispel this effect.
- Keep the debuffs rolling with his Basic ability, [c][F0FF23]A Hit or A Miss[-][/c], which has benefits even if Crosshair misses his shot.
- Further remove Shaken or call your Bad Batch allies to assist with his first Special ability, [c][F0FF23]I Will Handle It[-][/c], which grows more powerful the more Relic Amplifier levels you invest into Crosshair.
- Utilize his second Special ability, [c][F0FF23]Target Secured[-][/c], after your opponent has taken multiple turns as this will empower its damage up to a maximum bonus of 500%!
- Pair Crosshair alongside his Bad Batch companions to gain the full benefits of his Unique ability, [c][F0FF23]It's In My Head[-][/c], which will help him remove Shaken alongside many other stat synergies.
- Crosshair is vulnerable to focused fire from your enemy, so do your best to keep him safe so he can reliably deal damage throughout the battle.

If they were already stunned or had Ability Block, and his allies are all Dark Side Clone Troopers and / or Lord Vader, it inflicts Order 66.
- Ruse is a buff that lets Disguised Clone Trooper's abilities gain additional effects. Disguised Clone Trooper gains it from his Unique ability, [c][F0FF23]Clever Ruse[-][/c], when he is Stealthed at the start of his turn. However, it gets dispelled at the end of his turn.
- His first Special ability, [c][F0FF23]Well-Executed Ambush[-][/c], deals additional damage if the target has Damage Over Time. It also gains additional effects if the enemy is Light Side, Galactic Republic, or Jedi.
- [c][F0FF23]Clever Ruse[-][/c] is his first Unique ability and it grants him buffs if he's Stealthed. It also grants him and his allies buffs whenever an enemy starts their turn if Disguised Clone Trooper is Stealthed.
- His second Unique ability, [c][F0FF23]Decoy Squad Five[-][/c], grants him Offense at the start of battle, and Stealth if there was a Galactic Republic enemy. He also gains Stealth if he didn't already have Ruse. When attacking, he does massive damage to Jedi and Light Side Unaligned Force User enemies inflicted with Order 66.

[c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]
- Kelleran Beq's best offense is a good defense. For every 10,000 Protection he has, he gains a stack of [c][ffff33]Padawan Lessons[-][/c] through his Unique, [c][ffff33]The Sabered Hand[-][/c] (max 100). This new status effect provides Defense Penetration and Offense per stack, so increasing Kelleran's Protection through mods and pairing him with characters like Ki-Adi-Mundi ensures that Kelleran can achieve maximum damage.
- The Sabered Hand also sacrifices a portion of Kelleran's Health for an even larger amount of additional Protection, further increasing the maximum stacks of Padawan Lessons.
- In addition, The Sabered Hand provides Kelleran Beq guaranteed counter attacks when attacked and a chance to attack again whenever he uses his Basic ability, [c][ffff33]Saber Stability[-][/c], while Kelleran Beq has Protection.
- Saber Stability grants Foresight to random allies and will attack again when using this ability on his turn.
- His second Special ability, [c][ffff33]Jedi Bravery[-][/c], also benefits from Protection as it deals bonus damage based off of a percentage of his total Protection. It will also dispel all debuffs on all allies.

[c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]
- [c][ffff33]Lightsaber Training[-][/c], Kelleran Beq's first Special ability, provides Offense Up to all allies, then calls all Galactic Republic allies to attack the selected target. Until the end of the turn, a percentage of the damage dealt is converted back into healing for Kelleran Beq's team.
- Kelleran Beq's Leader Ability, [c][ffff33]By The Will Of The Council[-][/c], provides other allies stacks of Padawan Lessons equal to the number of stacks that he acquired at the start of battle and some helpful stats like Defense, Tenacity, and Speed.
- His Omicron ability further increases the offensive and defensive capabilities of his team by providing extra Offense per stack of Padawan Lessons, calling allies to assist when any ally uses an ability on their turn, and a significant boost to Defense that allows the team to survive even the most ferocious enemies.

data.EVENT_MARQUEE_KOTOR_06_ZAALBAR_M01_DESC: [B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][F0FF23]STALWART ALLY[-][/c] deals Physical damage and Zaalbar recovers Health\n - When fully upgraded, the target is also inflicted with Damage Over Time
data.EVENT_MARQUEE_KOTOR_06_ZAALBAR_M02_DESC: [B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][F0FF23]POWER BLAST[-][/c] deals Physical damage to all enemies and Zaalbar gains Taunt\n - When fully upgraded, Critical Hits inflict Armor Shred
data.EVENT_MARQUEE_KOTOR_06_ZAALBAR_M03_DESC: [B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][F0FF23]WOOKIEE TOUGHNESS[-][/c] grants Defense (stacking) whenever Zaalbar takes damage until the end of his next turn
data.EVENT_MARQUEE_KOTOR_06_ZAALBAR_M04_DESC: [B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][F0FF23]MISSION'S GUARDIAN[-][/c] Zaalbar and Mission gain additional Critical Avoidance and Zaalbar gains Taunt and Retribution when any ally drops below Max Health\n - When fully upgraded, they recover Health and Protection for each Damage over Time effect on enemies
data.EVENT_MARQUEE_KOTOR_06_ZAALBAR_M05_DESC: [B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - Zaalbar and Mission have strong ally synergy thanks to [c][F0FF23]MISSION'S GUARDIAN[-][/c] and [c][F0FF23]ME AND BIG Z FOREVER[-][/c] \n - When paired together, they strongly complement one another and enable powerful strategies
data.EVENT_MARQUEE_KOTOR_06_ZAALBAR_NAME: LEGENDS OF THE OLD REPUBLIC V\n[c][FFC891]Marquee Event[-][/c]
data.EVENT_MARQUEE_KOTOR_06_ZAALBAR_PRACTICE_: [B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - This is a Practice Tier. Zaalbar will be placed into the Ally slot, and you can bring as little as a single unit in order to experiment with different strategies.
data.EVENT_MARQUEE_KOTOR_06_ZAALBAR_SUMMARY: Join forces with [c][F0FF23]ZAALBAR[/c][-] in the sewers of Taris!
data.EVENT_MARQUEE_KOTOR_07_SITHBOMBER_BONUS_: This Bonus tier features powerful enemies and will require careful strategy to complete.
data.EVENT_MARQUEE_KOTOR_07_SITHBOMBER_M01_DE: [B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][F0FF23]LASER BARRAGE[-][/c] deals Physical damage and the B-28 has a chance to gain Defense Up on a Critical Hit\n - When fully upgraded, the B-28 has a 100% chance to gain Defense Up on a Critical Hit
data.EVENT_MARQUEE_KOTOR_07_SITHBOMBER_M02_DE: [B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][F0FF23]BOMBING RUN[-][/c] deals Physical damage to all enemies and places Concussion Mines on them\n - [c][F0FF23]CONCUSSION MINES[-][/c] deal 10% Max Health damage and Daze the target when they explode
data.EVENT_MARQUEE_KOTOR_07_SITHBOMBER_M03_DE: [B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][F0FF23]HIGH-VALUE TARGET[-][/c] grants the B-28 Taunt the first time other Sith allies take damage and any time other Sith allies drop below 100% Health, and the B-28 recovers Protection any time a Concussion Mine explodes\n - When fully upgraded, the B-28 gains Critical Avoidance while Taunting, and any time a Sith ally takes damage or evades an attack from an enemy, there is a chance to place a Concussion Mine on that enemy
data.EVENT_MARQUEE_KOTOR_07_SITHBOMBER_M04_DE: [B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][F0FF23]BOMBER BACKUP[-][/c] is a Reinforcement Ability that places Concussion Mines on all enemies when the B-28 enters battle\n - When fully upgraded, Sith allies recover Protection any time a Concussion Mine explodes (while the B-28 is active) and an additional Concussion Mine is placed on all enemies when the B-28 enters battle
data.EVENT_MARQUEE_KOTOR_07_SITHBOMBER_NAME: OUT OF THE BLACK II\n[c][FFC891]Marquee Event[-][/c]
data.EVENT_MARQUEE_KOTOR_07_SITHBOMBER_SUMMAR: Deploy your fleet and join forces with the [c][F0FF23]B-28 EXTINCTION-CLASS BOMBER[-][/c]!
data.EVENT_MARQUEE_KOTOR_09_CARTH_BONUS_DESC: [B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - Face a squad of deadly Raiders! These powerful foes terrorized the Old Republic, and now wreak havoc on the peaceful world of Dantooine. Use all Carth Onasi's tricks to defeat his enemies and make the galaxy a safer place.\n - Raider attacks are more effective against enemies suffering from Armor Shred. Only the Raider Marshal can apply Armor Shred in this mission.
data.EVENT_MARQUEE_KOTOR_09_CARTH_M01_DESC: [B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][F0FF23]RAPID SHOT[-][/c] deals damage and inflicts Damage Over Time\n - When upgraded fully, this ability also deals more damage for each Damage Over Time effect on the target enemy
data.EVENT_MARQUEE_KOTOR_09_CARTH_M02_DESC: [B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][F0FF23]JUST KEEP SHOOTING[-][/c] deals damage to all enemies and grants Carth Offense Up\n - When upgraded fully, Carth gains bonus Turn Meter for each critical hit
data.EVENT_MARQUEE_KOTOR_09_CARTH_M03_DESC: [B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][F0FF23]SOLDIER OF THE OLD REPUBLIC[-][/c] grants Potency, Tenacity, and Critical Avoidance to Old Republic allies as well as a chance to call another Old Republic ally to assist\n - When upgraded fully, allied Old Republic characters recover Health and Protection when an enemy is afflicted with a Damage Over Time effect
data.EVENT_MARQUEE_KOTOR_09_CARTH_M04_DESC: [B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][F0FF23]SOLDIER'S TRAINING[-][/c] grants Carth Offense for each enemy and Old Republic ally, and also gives him other bonuses when he defeats an enemy\n - This ability gains maximum potential when Carth is paired with a squad of Old Republic allies
data.EVENT_MARQUEE_KOTOR_09_CARTH_M05_DESC: [B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - Carth is best paired with Old Republic allies that can inflict Damage Over Time such as Mission Vao and Zaalbar.
data.EVENT_MARQUEE_KOTOR_09_CARTH_NAME: LEGENDS OF THE OLD REPUBLIC IX\n[c][FFC891]Marquee Event[-][/c]
data.EVENT_MARQUEE_KOTOR_09_CARTH_SUMMARY: \nJoin forces with [c][F0FF23]CARTH ONASI[-][/c] and battle the enemies of the Old Republic!
data.EVENT_MARQUEE_KOTOR_BASTILASHANDARK_BONU: [B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - This Bonus tier features powerful enemies and will require careful strategy to complete.
data.EVENT_MARQUEE_KOTOR_BASTILASHANDARK_M01_: [B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][F0FF23]SITH ASSAULT[-][/c] deals Special damage and inflicts Ability Block\n - When fully upgraded, this ability gains Damage and Critical Chance for each active Sith ally
data.EVENT_MARQUEE_KOTOR_BASTILASHANDARK_M02_: [B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][F0FF23]WILD LIGHTNING[-][/c] deals Special damage and Shocks an enemy\n - When fully upgraded, this ability deals bonus Special damage to all enemies, which can't be countered if the target was already Shocked
data.EVENT_MARQUEE_KOTOR_BASTILASHANDARK_M03_: [B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][F0FF23]FEAR[-][/c] Stuns the target then inflicts multiple debuffs when that Stun expires\n - When fully upgraded, this ability has a chance to Stun a random second enemy
data.EVENT_MARQUEE_KOTOR_BASTILASHANDARK_M04_: [B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][F0FF23]CORRUPTED BATTLE MEDITATION[-][/c] reduces Turn Meter and debuffs enemies at the start of Bastila's turns\n - This debuff lowers Critical Hit Chance and Counter Chance, and the effect is doubled against non-Jedi, non-Sith enemies
data.EVENT_MARQUEE_KOTOR_BASTILASHANDARK_M05_: [B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][F0FF23]SITH APPRENTICE[-][/c] grants Defense, Tenacity and stacking Offense to Bastila and her leader whenever an enemy is inflicted with Deathmark, Marked or Shock\n - When fully upgraded, Bastila and her leader gain Foresight at the start of battle
data.EVENT_MARQUEE_KOTOR_BASTILASHANDARK_NAME: LEGENDS OF THE OLD REPUBLIC VI\n[c][FFC891]Marquee Event[-][/c]
data.EVENT_MARQUEE_KOTOR_BASTILASHANDARK_SUMM: Join forces with [c][F0FF23]BASTILA SHAN (FALLEN)[/c][-] to battle enemies of the Sith!
data.EVENT_MARQUEE_KOTOR_CANDEROUS_BONUS_DESC: [B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - This Bonus tier features powerful enemies and will require careful strategy to complete.
data.EVENT_MARQUEE_KOTOR_CANDEROUS_M01_DESC: [B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][F0FF23]INTERMINABLE ASSAULT[-][/c] deals damage to target enemy and Canderous attacks a second time\n - When fully upgraded, this ability allows Canderous to attack an enemy a third time if the enemy had any Protection before the attack
data.EVENT_MARQUEE_KOTOR_CANDEROUS_M02_DESC: [B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][F0FF23]OVERWHELMING FIREPOWER[-][/c] deals damage to all enemies and inflicts Offense Down\n - When fully upgraded, this attack ignores Armor
data.EVENT_MARQUEE_KOTOR_CANDEROUS_M03_DESC: [B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - With [c][F0FF23]I LIKE A CHALLENGE[-][/c], Canderous deals more damage with Interminable Assault and Overwhelming Firepower to enemies who have taunting effects. Canderous gains buffs when an enemy gains Taunt, Deathmark or Marked\n - When an enemy with a Damage Over Time effect is damaged by an attack, Canderous gains Turn Meter
data.EVENT_MARQUEE_KOTOR_CANDEROUS_M04_DESC: [B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][F0FF23]MANDALORIAN VETERAN[-][/c] grants Canderous bonus Health Steal and Potency for each Old Republic and Scoundrel ally\n - When Canderous damages an enemy, he inflicts a Damage Over Time effect
data.EVENT_MARQUEE_KOTOR_CANDEROUS_NAME: LEGENDS OF THE OLD REPUBLIC VII\n[c][FFC891]Marquee Event[-][/c]
data.EVENT_MARQUEE_KOTOR_CANDEROUS_SUMMARY: Join forces with [c][F0FF23]CANDEROUS ORDO[/c][-] and escape Taris!
data.EVENT_MARQUEE_KOTOR_JUHANI_BONUS_DESC:
[B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]
 - In this event, you will face an elite team of Raiders! These powerful foes once terrorized the Old Republic.
 - Raider attacks are more effective against enemies suffering from Armor Shred.
 - Only the Raider Marshal can apply Armor Shred in this mission, so make him a priority target!
data.EVENT_MARQUEE_KOTOR_JUHANI_M01_DESC: [B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][F0FF23]RAGING STRIKE[-][/c] deals Physical damage to the target enemy, dealing more damage for each debuffed enemy
data.EVENT_MARQUEE_KOTOR_JUHANI_M02_DESC: [B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][F0FF23]BOASTFUL PROVOCATION[-][/c] causes Juhani to Taunt with a chance to Stun the target enemy\n - When fully upgraded, Juhani will dispel all debuffs from Jedi and Old Republic allies before Taunting, and the Stun chance becomes 100%
data.EVENT_MARQUEE_KOTOR_JUHANI_M03_DESC: [B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][F0FF23]REMORSEFUL THRASH[-][/c] deals Physical damage to all enemies and provides Juhani with Health and Protection recovery for each Critical Hit\n - When fully upgraded, this ability Staggers all enemies if Juhani is Stealthed when she uses it
data.EVENT_MARQUEE_KOTOR_JUHANI_M04_DESC: [B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][F0FF23]CATHAR RESILIENCE[-][/c] provides Juhani with Health recovery at the beginning of each of her turns and increased Counter Chance while Taunting\n - When fully upgraded, any time Juhani drops below 100% Health she recovers Protection for each active Jedi or Old Republic ally, and gains Offense Up, Health Steal Up and Stealth
data.EVENT_MARQUEE_KOTOR_JUHANI_M05_DESC: [B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - Juhani’s abilities are most effective when she enters battle with [c][F0FF23]JEDI[-][/c] or [c][F0FF23]OLD REPUBLIC[-][/c] allies, so take her into battle with these factions to get the most out of her abilities!\n - In this battle, you will be using Juhani in a full Old Republic squad. Enjoy!

data.EVENT_MARQUEE_KOTOR_JUHANI_SUMMARY: \nJoin forces with [c][F0FF23]JUHANI[-][/c] in her struggle against the dark side!

- It also grants stacking Critical Damage to Rebel Fighter allies who attack out of turn
- While in Territory Battles Kyle grants Bonus Protection to his allies and stops enemies from gaining bonus Turn Meter

data.EVENT_MARQUEE_MARAJADE_SUMMARY: Play as [c][F0FF23]MARA JADE, THE EMPEROR'S HAND[/c][-] as you deal with Palpatine's political adversaries as well as hunt down rogue Jedi.
data.EVENT_MARQUEE_MARROK_M01_DESC:
[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]
- Are [c][F0FF23]NOT SHARED[-][/c] between tiers

[c][24ccf4]Rewards:[-][/c]
- Features first time and repeatable rewards
- Refreshes daily until event ends

[c][24ccf4]Borrowed:[-][/c]
- Dash Rendar
- Shin Hati
- Marrok

 [c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]
- Marrok's Basic ability, [c][ffff33]Spinning Slash[-][/c], deals Special damage. He also gives out Defense Up to all Mercenary allies.

 [c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]
- Omega's Basic ability, [c][ffff33]Energy Crossbow[-][/c], progresses all Captive Bad Batch allies rescue objective by 5. If there are no Captive Bad Batch allies, it instead grants Critical Avoidance Up to the healthiest ally without Stealth.
- [c][ffff33]Big Sister[-][/c], her first Special ability, dispels all debuffs from Bad Batch allies and recovers the targeted ally's Protection. If they have full Protection, it instead recovers their Health. If their Health is also full, their cooldowns are reduced by 1.
- Her second Special ability, [c][ffff33]Our Way Out[-][/c], removes Stealth from the healthiest ally, and grants Stealth to everyone else. Allies that are already Stealthed, gain Turn Meter. It also grants additional buffs depending on if they're Stealthed or Bad Batch.
- Her Leader ability, [c][ffff33]Learn by Watching[-][/c], grants Bad Batch allies Critical Damage and Offense. At the start of the encounter, all Bad Batch allies aside from the healthiest gain Stealth. While Stealthed, they can't be critically hit and recover Health and Protection. They also gain Target Practice when damaging any enemy that was damaged in the previous Bad Batch ally's turn.
- Her Unique ability, [c][ffff33]Odd Little Clone[-][/c], grants her Speed. It also allows specific Bad Batch allies to be inflicted with Captive instead of being defeated the first time they would be defeated. All Bad Batch allies can contribute to the rescue objective.

- Paz generates stacks of [c][ffff33]Heat[-][/c] by using his Basic, [c][ffff33]Stalwart Barrage[-][/c], and first Special ability, [c][ffff33]Ancestral Broadside[-][/c]; this buff improves his Potency and also adds different effects to these abilities.

[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]

[c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]
- Princess Kneesaa is an Attacker Ewok who thrives on critical hits for her Basic ability, [c][ffff33]Rock Sling[-][/c]. She can attack up to an additional 2 times if she scores a critical hit. When she uses this ability on her turn, she gains Offense Up. When she uses her Basic and it's not her turn, she deals more damage and inflicts an enemy with Potency Down.

- Use Princess Kneesaa's first Special ability, [c][ffff33]Dangar, Ewoks![-][/c] (this is an Ewokese phrase) when Ewoks are being punished with debuffs or low on Health. This ability calls another Ewok ally to assist on a target enemy and inflicts them with Speed Down. This ability also dispels all debuffs on all Ewok allies and recovers Health and grants them Critical Chance Up.

- Princess Kneesaa's second Special ability, [c][ffff33]Yub Nub[-][/c] is a good way to punish enemies! She deals damage to all enemies while Stunning a target enemy and reducing their Turn Meter. This also grants her Critical Damage Up, so she can deal more damage every time she scores a critical hit!

- Kneesaa's Unique ability, [c][ffff33]Bright Tree Village[-][/c], grants her and Ewok allies Defensive, Offensive, Health, Tenacity, and Potency stat increases. It also calls Kneesaa to assist every time an Ewok ally uses a Special ability. Ewok allies punish enemies by dealing True damage and inflicting enemies with a stack of Damage Over Time when they attack out of turn. Kneesaa also gains buffs and Turn Meter every time an enemy attacks an ally. Kneesaa is also able to protect Ewok allies when they are Dazed or Stunned by granting them additional Defense, and protective buffs like Foresight and Protection Up.

[c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]
- Scout Trooper's attacks have additional effects while she has Accuracy Up and / or Stealth, and she performs best when working under an Imperial Trooper or Imperial Remnant Leader.
- Scout Trooper's Basic ability, [c][ffff33]Prepared Shot[-][/c], inflicts Accuracy Down and is guaranteed to critically hit if she is Stealthed. If it's her turn, all Imperial Trooper allies gain Potency Up.
- Scout Trooper's first Special ability, [c][ffff33]Imperial Precision[-][/c], deals damage, dispels all buffs, and inflicts Speed Down on the target enemy. This Speed Down can't be evaded if she is Stealthed, and can't be resisted if she has Accuracy Up.
- Scout Trooper's second Special ability, [c][ffff33]Strategic Assessment[-][/c], calls an ally to assist and supports her allies by gaining Stealth and granting Imperial Trooper allies Critical Damage Up. Additionally, she inflicts all enemies with Expose and Stagger, and Dazes the target enemy.
- Scout Trooper's Unique ability, [c][ffff33]Imperial Vanguard[-][/c], boosts her survivability by Stealthing and healing whenever she is critically hit. While active, she also grants Imperial Trooper allies Critical Chance and Imperial Remnant allies Speed.
-[c][ffff33]NOTE:[-][/c]For demonstrative purposes, the enemy Wampa will have her Omicron ability activated.

[c][23C8F5]Victory Counts:[-][/c]

Unlimited (1x rewards only)

[c][24ccf4]Required:[-][/c]
- STAP (5 Stars or above)

[c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]

data.EVENT_MARQUEE_STAP_M01_DESC:
[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]

5 per tier (1x rewards only)

[c][24ccf4]Borrowed:[-][/c]

[c]- General Grievous[-][/c]
[c]- B1 Battle Droid[-][/c]
[c]- B2 Super Battle Droid[-][/c]
[c]- IG-100 MagnaGuard[-][/c]
[c]- STAP[-][/c]

[c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]

- The STAP's Basic ability [c][ffff33]Checkpoint Secure![-][/c] applies Target Lock if the enemy does not have it. If the enemy already has Target Lock, it instead applies a new debuff called [c][ffff33]Pinned[-][/c]. Enemies inflicted with Pinned can't gain bonus Turn Meter and have reduced Speed, but it does not stack with Breached or Speed Down.
- [c][ffff33]Die Jedi Dogs![-][/c] is the STAP's first Special ability, which is an attack that affects all enemies and can't be evaded by Jedi! This ability will also inflict Provoked on all enemies and will deal double damage to any enemies who are Pinned.
- Using [c][ffff33]We Need to Recharge![-][/c] will recover Health and Protection for the STAP and grant it five stacks of Overcharge, which lasts for the entire battle. The STAP and an ally will then assist each other in attacking the targeted enemy.
- Using any ability besides We Need to Recharge! will cause the STAP to dispel one stack of Overcharge from itself, so be sure to use this ability as often as possible to keep your Overcharge stacks up!
data.EVENT_MARQUEE_STAP_M02_DESC:
[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]

5 per tier (1x rewards only)

[c][24ccf4]Borrowed:[-][/c]

[c]- General Grievous[-][/c]
[c]- B1 Battle Droid[-][/c]
[c]- B2 Super Battle Droid[-][/c]
[c]- IG-100 MagnaGuard[-][/c]
[c]- STAP[-][/c]

[c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]

- [c][ffff33]Single Trooper Aerial Platform[-][/c], isn't just an acronym, it's also the STAP's unique ability! In addition to the extra Defense and Offense Overcharge provides, the STAP will also gain additional Speed with each Overcharge stack.
- If put on a team with all Separatist Droids, whenever an ally inflicts Pinned or Target Lock on an enemy, they will deal additional damage.
- The Omicron ability grants the STAP a bonus turn at the start of the battle, and an additional bonus turn the first time each enemy takes their first turn. Additionally, every time the STAP gains a stack of Overcharge, all allies gain extra Health and recover Health and Protection.

[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]

[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]

data.EVENT_MARQUEE_THEMANDALORIAN_M03_DESC:
[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]
- 5 per tier (1x rewards only)

[c][24ccf4]Borrowed:[-][/c]
- The Mandalorian

[c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]
- The Mandalorian's Leader ability, [c][F0FF23]Asset Acquisition[-][/c], gives all Scoundrel allies Speed, Tenacity and Critical Chance.
- If the Mandalorian is in the Leader slot, his Contract is active.
- Bounty Hunter allies who score critical hits while buffed contribute to the Mandalorian's Contract.
- After Contract completion: While a Bounty Hunter ally is attacking, they have bonus Offense and Health Steal for each buffed ally.
data.EVENT_MARQUEE_THEMANDALORIAN_M04_DESC:
[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]
- 5 per tier (1x rewards only)

[c][24ccf4]Borrowed:[-][/c]
- The Mandalorian

[c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]

- When fully upgraded, each time the Mandalorian scores a critical hit, other Bounty Hunter allies gain half the amount of bonus Turn Meter.
data.EVENT_MARQUEE_THEMANDALORIAN_M05_DESC:
[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]
- 5 per tier (1x rewards only)

[c][24ccf4]Borrowed:[-][/c]
- The Mandalorian

[c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]
- Whenever the Mandalorian receives a Reward from a Contract, he also gains his Payout which grants him Critical Damage and the Special ability [c][F0FF23]Disintegrate[-][/c] until the end of battle.
- If the Mandalorian does not have Critical Chance Up or Critical Damage Up at the start of his turn, [c][F0FF23]Disintegrate[-][/c] can't be used.
- [c][F0FF23]Disintegrate[-][/c] instantly defeats the target enemy, which can't be evaded. Enemies defeated by this ability can't be revived.
- Each time the Mandalorian scores a critical hit while buffed, the cooldown of [c][F0FF23]Disintegrate[-][/c] is reduced.

[c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]
- Vane's Basic ability, [c][F0FF23]We Just Want the Credits[-][/c], inflicts Offense Down, and if he has 4+ stacks of Profit, also Dazes the target. He gains Defense per Profit stack for the turn, reinforcing his durability for the entire turn.
- With his first Special ability, [c][F0FF23]Put It Down, Little One[-][/c], if Vane's current Health is equal to or higher than the target’s, he Stuns them and gains a stack of Profit. If his Health is lower, he instead recovers Health and gains Evasion Up.
- [c][F0FF23]It Must Be Fake[-][/c], his second Special ability, allows him to dispel all debuffs from other Pirate allies and takes the same debuffs onto himself. If Defense Down, Evasion Down, or Tenacity Down are dispelled this way, all other Pirate allies gain the opposite buff. He also gains Max Health for each debuff on him.
- His Unique, [c][F0FF23]Myth of the Outer Rim[-][/c], allows him to Taunt whenever a Pirate ally gains a stack of Profit. If all allies are Pirates, Vane gains Max Health and Max Protection at the start of battle. While Taunting, he supports the weakest ally by equalizing Health and Protection when another Pirate ally takes damage, and Vane gains stacks of Bulwark. Whenever another Pirate ally scores a critical hit while Vane is Taunting, he recovers Health and Protection. Vane also gains Critical Avoidance for each debuff on him, and Protection Up whenever a debuff is dispelled.

data.EVENT_MECHANICS_GLLUKE_TIER01_DESC:
You will only be able to use Jedi Knight Luke Skywalker and R2-D2 in the first encounter.

You will only be able to use Han Solo, Lando Calrissian, and Chewbacca in the final encounter.

Chewbacca can only use his Basic ability in the final encounter.

Han Solo has Carbonite Sickness and is inflicted with Blind for 13 turns at the start of the final encounter.

Victory is achieved by defeating Boba Fett in the final encounter.
data.EVENT_MECHANICS_GLLUKE_TIER04_DESC:
Jedi Master Luke Skywalker begins the encounter with 100% Ultimate Charge (even if you have not unlocked his Ultimate ability) and must use Heroic Stand during his first turn.

Supreme Leader Kylo Ren has Blinding Rage and starts Blind for 1 turn. Whenever he loses Blind, he gains Rage for 1 turn. Whenever he loses Rage, he gains Blind for 1 turn.

You will lose this battle if Jedi Master Luke Skywalker is defeated.
data.EVENT_MECHANICS_GLLUKE_TIER05_DESC:
Jedi Master Luke Skywalker begins the encounter with 100% Ultimate Charge (even if you have not unlocked his Ultimate ability) and must use Heroic Stand during his first turn.

Supreme Leader Kylo Ren has Blinding Rage and starts Blind for 1 turn. Whenever he loses Blind, he gains Rage for 2 turns. Whenever he loses Rage, he gains Blind for 1 turn.

You will lose this battle if Jedi Master Luke Skywalker is defeated.
data.EVENT_MECHANICS_GLLUKE_TIER06_DESC:
Jedi Master Luke Skywalker begins the encounter with 100% Ultimate Charge (even if you have not unlocked his Ultimate ability) and must use Heroic Stand during his first turn.

Supreme Leader Kylo Ren has Blinding Rage and starts Blind for 1 turn. Whenever he loses Blind, he gains Rage for 3 turns. Whenever he loses Rage, he gains Blind for 1 turn.

After each ally who is not Jedi Master Luke Skywalker takes a turn, they are defeated.

You will lose this battle if Jedi Master Luke Skywalker is defeated.
data.EVENT_MECHANICS_GLPALP_TIER01_DESC_V2:
Whenever Mace Windu uses an ability, he will gain one stack of Shatterpoint for each Galactic Republic Jedi ally. When Mace Windu has 20 or more stacks of Shatterpoint, his next Smite will deal double massive damage.

Mace Windu cannot be defeated in this encounter.

Defeat Agen Kolar, Kit Fisto, and Saesee Tiin to be victorious.
data.EVENT_MECHANICS_GLPALP_TIER02_DESC_V2: Whenever Mace Windu uses an ability, he will gain one stack of Shatterpoint. When Mace Windu has 5 or more stacks of Shatterpoint, his next Smite will deal double massive damage.
data.EVENT_MECHANICS_GLPALP_TIER03_DESC:
You will only use Darth Vader in the first encounter.

You will only use Emperor Palpatine in the final encounter.

Bring Jedi Knight Luke Skywalker below 25% health in the first encounter to proceed to the final encounter.
data.EVENT_MECHANICS_GLPALP_TIER04_DESC:
While Ben Solo is active, Rey can't be defeated.

Rey has leadership bonuses granted to her by several of the Jedi spirits who came to her in her hour of need: General Kenobi, Jedi Knight Anakin, Luminara Undulli, Mace Windu, Aayla Secura, Grand Master Yoda, Qui-Gon Jinn, Ahsoka Tano, Obi-Wan Kenobi, and Jedi Knight Luke Skywalker.

Sith Eternal Emperor has access to his Ultimate ability (even if you have not unlocked it) and gains 10% Ultimate Charge whenever Ben Solo or Rey take damage, and 34% at the end of each of his turns. (NOTE: This is different from the player-obtainable version)
data.EVENT_MECHANICS_GLPALP_TIER05_DESC:
While Ben Solo is active, Rey can't be defeated.

Ben Solo cannot be defeated while Rey is over 50% health.

Rey has leadership bonuses granted to her by several of the Jedi spirits who came to her in her hour of need: General Kenobi, Jedi Knight Anakin, Luminara Undulli, Mace Windu, Aayla Secura, Grand Master Yoda, Qui-Gon Jinn, Ahsoka Tano, Obi-Wan Kenobi, and Jedi Knight Luke Skywalker.

Sith Eternal Emperor has access to his Ultimate ability (even if you have not unlocked it) and gains 10% Ultimate Charge whenever Ben Solo or Rey take damage, and 34% at the end of each of his turns. (NOTE: This is different from the player-obtainable version)
data.EVENT_MECHANICS_GLPALP_TIER06_DESC:
While Ben Solo is active, Rey can't be defeated.

Ben Solo cannot be defeated while Rey is over 50% health.

If Sith Eternal Emperor's turn begins with Ben Solo defeated, at the end of the turn Ben Solo revives with 51% of his Max Health.

Rey has leadership bonuses granted to her by several of the Jedi spirits who came to her in her hour of need: General Kenobi, Jedi Knight Anakin, Luminara Undulli, Mace Windu, Aayla Secura, Grand Master Yoda, Qui-Gon Jinn, Ahsoka Tano, Obi-Wan Kenobi, and Jedi Knight Luke Skywalker.

Sith Eternal Emperor has access to his Ultimate ability (even if you have not unlocked it) and gains 10% Ultimate Charge whenever Ben Solo or Rey take damage, and 34% at the end of each of his turns. (NOTE: This is different from the player-obtainable version)

data.EVENT_MOTHER_TALZIN_SUMMARY: For a limited time, [b]Mother Talzin[/b] has been added to [b]Light Side Battle nodes[/b] as bonus drops! During this event, the drop rate on each node has been scaled to Energy.\n\nLight Side Battles are rewarding bonus drops from 04/14/2023 through 04/18/2023.
data.EVENT_MYTHIC_BB8_SUMMARY:
[c][B5E7F5]Recommended Level:[-][/c] 85

The [c][F0FF23]FIRST ORDER’s[-][/c] nefarious plans hinge on a lost galactic map held in part by the droid [c][F0FF23]BB-8[-][/c]. Assemble your forces and capture the droid or join forces with BB-8 and battle the First Order!

Succeed and earn rare rewards!
data.EVENT_MYTHIC_EMPERORS_DEMISE_SUMMARY:
[c][B5E7F5]Recommended Level:[-][/c] 85

Gather [c][F0FF23]REBELS[-][/c] and face [c][F0FF23]EMPEROR PALPATINE[-][/c], or join forces with the Emperor and crush the Rebels!

Succeed and earn rare rewards!
data.EVENT_MYTHIC_R2D2_SUMMARY:
Recommended Level: 85 

Gather your [c][F0FF23]EMPIRE[/c][-] characters and defeat R2-D2 or form a squad of R2-D2 and his [c][F0FF23]REBEL[/c][-] allies and defeat the Empire to Escape!

Action counts are per tier in this event. Refreshing a tier refreshes only that tier.
data.EVENT_MYTHIC_THRAWN_SUMMARY: [c][B5E7F5]Recommended Level:[-][/c] 85\n\nGather [c][F0FF23]PHOENIX SQUADRON[-][/c] characters and launch a daring attack against [c][F0FF23]GRAND ADMIRAL THRAWN[-][/c] or bring the Grand Admiral and his forces to bear and crush the Rebellion on Atollon!
data.EVENT_MYTHIC_YODA_SUMMARY:
Recommended Level: 85 
Gather your [c][F0FF23]JEDI[/c][-] characters and train with [c][F0FF23]GRAND MASTER YODA[/c][-]. Once training is complete use the Grandmaster and his pupils to face ancient foes!

Victory Counts are per tier in this event. Refreshing a tier refreshes only that tier.
data.EVENT_NEGOTIATOR_NAME: Negotiator is available on all Mod Battle nodes!

data.EVENT_OUTRIDER_SUMMARY:
The [b]Outrider[/b] has arrived!

For a limited time, [b]Outrider[/b] blueprints are available as bonus rewards on all Cantina nodes. Head over and start earning blueprints for this Rebel support ship! During this event, Outrider blueprint's drop rate on each node has been scaled to Cantina Energy.

Cantina Battles are rewarding bonus drops from 4/8 through 4/12.

data.EVENT_PHOENIX_PROMO_DESC: Collect Ahsoka Tano (Fulcrum) and the Phoenix Squad!
data.EVENT_PHOENIX_PROMO_SUMMARY: Collect Ahsoka Tano (Fulcrum) and the Phoenix Squad!\n\nNote: You must have less than 100 shards of Ahsoka Tano (Fulcrum) to unlock her event tier and you must have less than 145 shards of each Phoenix character in order to unlock their event tiers

[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]
- 1 per tier (1x rewards only)

[c]- Ahsoka Tano (Fulcrum)[-][/c]

The [b]Raven's Claw[/b] has arrived!

For a limited time, Raven's Claw blueprints are available as bonus rewards on all Cantina nodes. Head over and start earning blueprints for this Rebel support ship! During this event, the drop rate for Raven's Claw blueprints on each node has been scaled to Cantina Energy.

Cantina Battles are rewarding bonus drops from 7/8 through 7/12.

data.EVENT_WEB_OF_HATE_TIER01_ERA_DESC_V2:
[c][ACFEFF][c][23C8F5]Victory Counts:[-][/c]
- Unlimited (1x rewards only)

[c][23C8F5]Required:[-][/c]
- Stormtrooper Luke (Era Level 45)

[c][23C8F5]Borrowed:[-][/c]
- Chewbacca
- Stormtrooper Han

[c][23C8F5]Recommended:[-][/c]

[c][23C8F5]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]
- Han and Luke have infiltrated the Death Star and have stolen the armor of Stormtroopers on a mission to save the Princess.
- Take on Imperial Officers and Stormtrooper enemies and inflict Distracted 10 times to achieve victory.
- Whenever Stormtrooper Luke uses an ability, Distract a random enemy who didn't already have it for 1 turn, which can't be evaded or resisted.
- Whenever an enemy Taunts, they gain a stack of [c][F0FF23]Focusing[-][/c], and whenever an enemy is defeated, all other enemies gain a stack of [c][F0FF23]Focusing[-][/c].
- Whenever an enemy is defeated, a new one will take its place.
- Stormtrooper Luke being defeated will result in immediate loss.

[c][F0FF23]Focusing:[-][/c] +25% Offense and +15 Speed per stack until the end of battle[-][/c]
data.EVENT_WEB_OF_HATE_TIER02_DESC:
[c][ACFEFF][c][23C8F5]Victory Counts:[-][/c]
- Unlimited (1x rewards only)

[c][23C8F5]Required:[-][/c]
- Yoda & Chewie (Era Level 55)

[c][23C8F5]Borrowed:[-][/c]
- Tarfful
- Clone Scout Trooper

[c][23C8F5]Recommended:[-][/c]

[c][23C8F5]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]
- Defeating the enemy in the second encounter as quickly as possible is the key to victory.
- Tarfful or Yoda & Chewie being defeated will result in immediate loss.
- Clone Scout Trooper allies can't be defeated.
- The Clone Scout Troopers are not obtainable and can't be used in any other event or game mode.
data.EVENT_WEB_OF_HATE_TIER03_DESC:
[c][ACFEFF][c][23C8F5]Victory Counts:[-][/c]
- Unlimited (1x rewards only)

[c][23C8F5]Required:[-][/c]
- Darth Vader (Duel's End) (Era Level 70)

[c][23C8F5]Recommended:[-][/c]

[c][23C8F5]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]
- Obi-Wan can't be defeated and he will start the battle with High Ground. Each time he attacks out of turn, he gains 2 Speed (stacking) and 2% Offense (stacking) until the end of battle and he increases Darth Vader (Duel's End)'s Special ability, [c][ffff33]You Will Always Lose[-][/c] to max.
- Whenever Vader inflicts Damage over Time, he gains a stack of [c][ffff33]Vendetta.[-][/c]
- Whenever Vader uses [c][ffff33]Your Weakness Still Remains[-][/c], he recovers 10% Health. Whenever he uses [c][ffff33]Then You Will Die[-][/c], he dispels all buffs from Obi-Wan.
- Whenever Vader gains 10 stacks of Vendetta, he removes High Ground off Obi-Wan and he gains it himself.
- Whenever Vader begins his turn with High Ground, he resets the cooldown of his Special ability, [c][ffff33]You Will Always Lose[-][/c].
- Once Vader uses his Special ability, [c][ffff33]You Will Always Lose[-][/c], victory will be achieved.
- Both Obi-Wan and Vader are immune to Ability Block for this event.
- Darth Vader (Duel's End) being defeated will result in immediate loss.

[c][F0FF23]Vendetta:[-][/c] +20% Max Health and Potency, and at 10 stacks, gain High Ground

data.EVENTVIEW_GUILDRAID_INFO_MESSAGE:
Guild raids are feats of strength where Guilds work together toward victory. These epic battles are against some of the most imposing opponents throughout the galaxy. Bolster your collection of Characters and help your Guild toward being the best, most powerful, and wealthiest within the Cantina!

- Only Guild Leaders and Guild Officers may start a Guild Raid
- Starting a Guild Raid requires Raid Tickets
- Raid Tickets are produced through "Personal Guild Contribution" Daily Activity
- At raid end, all guild members receive the same Guild Rewards, delivered via Inbox
- Guild Rewards are determined by progress on the guild reward track
- Individual player rewards are determined by progress on the personal reward track
- Guild Raids have multiple Difficulty Tiers or Difficulty Levels (not both)
- Difficulty Tiers or Levels may have different settings; pay careful attention to these
- For raids with Difficulty Tiers, the tier is chosen by Guild Leaders or Officers when the raid starts
- For raids with Difficulty Levels, the level is selected by the player before each raid attempt
- Higher Difficulty Levels apply a multiplier to the total Raid Points earned in that attempt
- Raid Point progress persists for the entire Guild
- Boss ability cooldowns persist per individual player

Good luck!

data.FEATUREINTRO_MOD_TU30_BATCH_01: [f0ff23]Batch Manage[-] allows you to sell and upgrade many mods all at once. Use a saved Filter to speed up your mod workflow.
data.FEATUREINTRO_MOD_TU30_BATCH_UPGRADE_01: [f0ff23]Reveal All Secondary Stats[-] will automatically upgrade mods to the minimum level that identifies all four secondary stats. This is particularly useful when upgrading multiple mods of different rarities.
data.FEATUREINTRO_MOD_TU30_ENHANCE_01: Enhance Mod is a one-stop location for all your mod tinkering needs. Here you can upgrade, slice, calibrate, and sell an individual mod.
data.FEATUREINTRO_MOD_TU30_ENHANCE_02: Remember, mod slicing is only available on Mk V and VI mods. Mod calibration requires a MK VI mod.
data.FEATUREINTRO_MOD_TU30_FILTERS_01: Mod Filters help you find mods that meet your exact stat and attribute needs.
data.FEATUREINTRO_MOD_TU30_FILTERS_02: Besides the basic options, you can also filter for mods that [f0ff23]include or exclude[-] specific stats, mods that have all [f0ff23]secondary stats revealed[-], and mods with a preferred [f0ff23]slice count[-] or [f0ff23]slice quality[-].
data.FEATUREINTRO_MOD_TU30_FILTERS_03: Additionally, you can [f0ff23]save mod filters[-]. This handy function allows you to quickly retrieve mods when equipping, selling, or upgrading.
data.FEATUREINTRO_MOD_TU30_REROLL_01: Aha! It's time for some advanced mod alteration techniques. [f0ff23]Mod Calibration[-] will let you [f0ff23]transfer a slice[-] between secondary stats.
data.FEATUREINTRO_MOD_TU30_REROLL_02: You start by selecting a stat for [f0ff23]slice removal[-]. It's best to [f0ff23]choose a stat you don't want[-] on this mod.
data.FEATUREINTRO_MOD_TU30_REROLL_03: Once you've selected a stat, tap this button to start. Calibration will [f0ff23]remove[-] a random slice from your selected stat and [f0ff23]apply a new slice[-] to a random stat.
data.FEATUREINTRO_MOD_TU30_REROLL_03_PC: Once you've selected a stat, click this button to start. Calibration will [f0ff23]remove[-] a random slice from your selected stat and [f0ff23]apply a new slice[-] to a random stat.
data.FEATUREINTRO_MOD_TU30_REROLL_04: Calibration is a [f0ff23]volatile[-] process. When a slice is reapplied, it could go back to the same stat you remove it from.
data.FEATUREINTRO_MOD_TU30_REROLL_05: Don't forget, you'll need [f0ff23]Micro Attenuators[-] to perform a calibration.
data.FEATUREINTRO_MOD_TU30_REROLL_06: There's also a [f0ff23]limit[-] on the number of times a mod can be calibrated. Earn more [f0ff23]calibration attempts[-] by slicing the mod.
data.FEATUREINTRO_MOD_TU30_SLICE_01: Slicing a mod always make it stronger, but how much stronger you ask? The details matter!
data.FEATUREINTRO_MOD_TU30_SLICE_02: Each secondary stat visualizes its [f0ff23]slices[-] here. The bigger the bar, the closer the slice is to its [f0ff23]maximum possible[-] value.
data.FEATUREINTRO_MOD_TU30_SLICE_03: Additionally, [f0ff23]slice quality[-] will average together all the slices for a stat and give you a percentage value. Higher values mean the stat is closer to [f0ff23]peak performance[-].
data.FEATUREINTRO_SQUADTOURNAMENT_01_TEXT: Welcome back, Galactic Champion!\n\nHave you heard about Squad Tournaments?
data.FEATUREINTRO_SQUADTOURNAMENT_02_TEXT: They're a new addition to the Cantina where you compete with other Galactic Champions to earn [c][f0ff23]extremely rare rewards[-][/c]!
data.FEATUREINTRO_SQUADTOURNAMENT_03_TEXT: Would you like to go to the Squad Tournament now?
data.FEATUREINTRO_SQUADTOURNAMENT_MATCHMAKING: Looks like you've set your Defensive Squad and you're almost ready to go!
Scoring within a Squad Tournament is different than other locations within the Cantina.
Tournament Ranking Points are earned for defeating each of your opponent's Characters.
You also earn them for each of your surviving Characters.
Go ahead and choose your opponent now.
data.FEATUREINTRO_SQUADTOURNAMENT_PREBATTLE_0: At the start of a Squad Tournament, all of your Characters are granted a status of [c][99ff33]READY![-][/c]
A Character with a [c][99ff33]READY![-][/c] status means they are able to enter Battle freely.
Each Character participating in a Battle will consume their [c][99ff33]READY![-][/c] status, requiring a refresh for additional Battles.
Characters requiring a refresh may still Battle for a specified cost. You'll be asked to confirm your selection if any cost is involved.
The displayed Roster Refresh countdown is to notify you of when all of your Characters will be granted the [c][99ff33]READY![-][/c] status again.
Once you've configured your desired Squad, you'll immediately be taken into the Battle.
Good luck and may you be victorious!

data.FINALIZER_LIGHTSPEED_BUNDLE_INFO:
[c][F0FF23]MERGE UNITS[-][/c]

Units included in the Lightspeed Bundle are upgraded according to a predetermined set of upgrade criteria (listed below). The Lightspeed Bundle does not directly grant character shards / ship blueprints or resources used in merge upgrades. The upgrade criteria are evaluated against your existing roster, and your units are set to the greater of the two values.

Each unit will first be evaluated for existing shards or star rarity against the bundle upgrade criteria. A unit at lower star rarity (or unactivated with less cumulative shards/blueprints) than the bundle upgrade criteria will be upgraded and activated. Units that exceed the star rarity (or cumulative shards/blueprints) will be activated (if unactivated) and then evaluated for additional attributes (gear tier, ability tier, etc). Any surplus shards/blueprints over the bundle upgrade criteria will be retained.

If your previously unlocked units meet or exceed the bundle upgrade criteria for other attributes, any surplus value will be retained.

- 7 Stars
- Level 85
- Relic Level 5
- Ability Tier 7

- 7 Stars
- Level 85

data.FTUE_CONQUEST_05: You must fight your way across the map, picking whichever path you think you can overcome! Besides combat nodes, there are [c][f0ff23]SCAVENGERS[/c][-] and [c][f0ff23]DATA DISK STOCKPILES[/c][-] that offer powerful items to help you progress.
data.FTUE_CONQUEST_06: Earn [c][f0ff23]CONQUEST KEYCARDS[/c][-] through victories in combat and by completing [c][f0ff23]FEATS[/c][-]! The more you earn, the more spoils you can collect on the way, and the better your reward at the end of the event.
data.FTUE_CONQUEST_07: [c][f0ff23]DATA DISKS[/c][-] can help you overcome difficult battles, but you must stay within your [c][f0ff23]DATA CAPACITY[/c][-] limit! Data Disks disappear once the event ends, so be sure to equip them and try out different builds!
data.FTUE_CONQUEST_08: [c][f0ff23]CONSUMABLES[/c][-] are powerful items of limited duration. You can have one of each category active at a time, and your stockpile of them expires at the end of the Conquest event. Don't hold back!
data.FTUE_CONQUEST_09: After each victory, your allies lose [c][f0ff23]STAMINA[/c][-], reducing their stats. Stamina refills over time, and you can use [c][f0ff23]STIM PACKS[/c][-] from Conquest Shipments to recover faster!
data.FTUE_DARKSIDE_BATTLES_01: Are you ready for [c][f0ff23]DARK SIDE BATTLES[/c][-]? This campaign allows only Dark Side characters, but advancing in each campaign is key to building your collection!
data.FTUE_ERA_UNIT_DETAILS_01: Instead of separate level, gear, and ability upgrades, Spotlight Units have a single [f0ff23]SPOTLIGHT LEVEL[-] that is faster and easier to upgrade with [f0ff23]SPOTLIGHT MATERIALS[-]!
data.FTUE_ERA_UNIT_DETAILS_01_V2: Instead of separate level, gear, and ability upgrades, Era Units have a single [f0ff23]ERA LEVEL[-] that is faster and easier to upgrade with [f0ff23]ERA LEVEL MATERIALS[-]!
data.FTUE_ERA_UNIT_DETAILS_02: When the Era ends, they move to your [f0ff23]FULL COLLECTION[-] with legacy upgrade systems while keeping any upgrades you've given them! Take advantage of their time in the spotlight for more efficient progress!
data.FTUE_ERA_UNIT_INVENTORY_01_V2: [f0ff23]ERAS[-] are thematic celebrations of stories across the history of the galaxy. Your [f0ff23]ERA INVENTORY[-] highlights new and upcoming units on the holotables in the current Era!
data.FTUE_ERA_UNIT_INVENTORY_02_V2: You receive [f0ff23]ERA UNITS[-] automatically as they arrive, just by logging in while the Era is running!\n\nUse them in battles on Era-exclusive tables like the [f0ff23]COLISEUM[-].
data.FTUE_ERA_UNIT_INVENTORY_03: You can see other characters you have acquired, as well as all the characters you have yet to unlock, in the [f0ff23]CHARACTERS[-] tab.
data.FTUE_GALACTIC_WAR_01: This is the [c][f0ff23]GALACTIC WAR[/c][-] table, where you play a series of battles against other players' squads. Here, your characters' health persists between battles.
data.FTUE_GALACTIC_WAR_02: It will start easy and gradually get more difficult, but fear not! If you are unable to reach the end, you can reset the table each day to try again!
data.FTUE_GEAR_EQUIP_01: Unlike Era Units, legacy characters are upgraded with [c][f0ff23]GEAR[/c][-].\n\nThe green icon indicates you have gear to equip right now!
data.FTUE_INTRO_VIDEO_L03: These battles between the dark and light have always persisted…
data.FTUE_INTRO_VIDEO_L07: Where competitors collect the galaxy’s greatest heroes and ships…
data.FTUE_INTRO_VIDEO_L09: Now, it’s your time to leave a legacy.
data.FTUE_INTRO_VIDEO_L10: How will you shape the fate of the galaxy?
data.FTUE_JOURNEY_GUIDE_01: You're ready now for the [c][f0ff23]JOURNEY GUIDE[/c][-], where you can unlock [c][f0ff23]LEGENDARY[/c][-] characters for your collection.
data.FTUE_JOURNEY_GUIDE_09: Select [c][f0ff23]BEGIN JOURNEY[/c][-] to set a goal, and you're off! Units required for the Journey will be marked in your Collection.
data.FTUE_LEADER_SYNERGY_01: Your squad is benefitting from a Leader ability! The character in the first squad slot, or [c][f0ff23]LEADER SLOT[/c][-], grants bonuses to other allies.
data.FTUE_LEADER_SYNERGY_02: This icon shows which characters in your squad benefit from the Leader ability, and by how much. A full circle means full benefits!
data.FTUE_RELIC_AMPLIFIERS_01: It's about time you gained access to a [c][F0FF23]RELIC AMPLIFIER[-][/c]! These empower innate traits in your characters with a new stat called [c][F0FF23]MASTERY[-][/c].
data.FTUE_RELIC_AMPLIFIERS_02: You need [c][F0FF23]SIGNAL DATA[-][/c] and [c][F0FF23]SCRAP[-][/c] to upgrade Relic Amplifiers. That rude little Jawa in the Cantina can help you get the scrap you need. I suppose I can translate for you, if I must.
data.FTUE_SCAVENGER_01: [c]"You look like you've got a bantha-load of gear you don't need. Gimme a piece you don't want and I'll smash it apart for scrap."[/c]
data.FTUE_SCAVENGER_02: [c]"That's a good start, but we're gonna need more gear to get anything done here. Tap the quantity button to increase how many you grab at once."[/c]
data.FTUE_SCAVENGER_02_PC: [c]"That's a good start, but we're gonna need more gear to get anything done here. Click the quantity button to increase how many you grab at once."[/c]
data.FTUE_SCAVENGER_03: [c]"All right, now we're talkin'. Remember, once we crush this junk, it's not comin' back. Don't worry, I'll add any excess gear to your next piece of scrap."[/c]
data.FTUE_SHIPMENTS_01: You've just unlocked [c][f0ff23]SHIPMENTS[/c][-]! Featured Shipments refresh every few hours, while Episode Shipments refresh once a week.\n\nKeep checking back as you unlock more shipments!
data.FTUE_SHIPS_COMBAT_TARGETLOCK_M02: [f0ff23]TARGET LOCKED[-] ships are more susceptible to attacks.\n\nSome abilities gain bonuses against [f0ff23]TARGET LOCKED[-] ships.
data.FTUE_SHIPS_COMBAT_TARGETLOCK_M03: Remember [f0ff23]TARGET LOCK[-] can afflict your ships as well.
data.FTUE_SOCIALPACKOPENING_01: Your first hero!\n\nIt's a Jedi with the [f0ff23]HEAL[-] ability!
data.FTUE_SQUAD_INVENTORY_01: Saved Squads are now available to view in your inventory!
data.FTUE_SQUAD_INVENTORY_02: These are recommended squads for various events and unlocking special characters. You can also create, save, and organize your own squads for easy access.
data.FTUE_SQUAD_SUGGESTIONS_01: [c][f0ff23]SQUAD SUGGESTIONS[/c][-] let you know which allies work well with this character.
data.FTUE_SQUAD_SUGGESTIONS_02: If you want to work towards any of these squads, you can save it to your squad list with the [c][f0ff23]COPY[/c][-] button.
data.FTUE_TERRITORYTOURNAMENT_DEFENSE_TEMPLAT: This board shows your saved [c][F0FF23]DEFENSE[-][/c] for Grand Arena. Here, you can freely add and remove Squads to defend your zones, even if no Grand Arena is running.

Each Round in Grand Arena has a 24-hour [c][F0FF23]SETUP PHASE[-][/c], when you can see your opponent's roster and adjust your Defense. At the end of this Phase, your Defense is deployed automatically.
data.FTUE_TU36_EPISODETRACK_01_V2: You've unlocked the [c][f0ff23]EPISODE TRACK[/c][-]! Earn progress and rewards by getting [c][f0ff23]EPISODE POINTS[/c][-] (EP) from Quests and the Coliseum!
data.FURY_CLASS_INTERCEPTOR_LIGHTSPEED_DESC: Born from the heart of the Sith Empire, the Fury-Class Interceptor embodies speed, precision, and devastation. Instantly upgrade this legendary vessel to [b]7 Stars, Level 85, and Ability Tier 7,[/b] and if you already command [b]Darth Malgus[/b] at 7 Stars, ascend him to [b]Relic Level 5[/b], unleashing his full dominion over the skies!\n\nPurchase limit: 1
data.FURY_CLASS_INTERCEPTOR_LIGHTSPEED_INFO:
[c][F0FF23]MERGE UNITS[-][/c]

Units included in the Lightspeed Bundle are upgraded according to a predetermined set of upgrade criteria (listed below). The Lightspeed Bundle does not directly grant character shards / ship blueprints or resources used in merge upgrades. The upgrade criteria are evaluated against your existing roster, and your units are set to the greater of the two values.

Each unit will first be evaluated for existing shards or star rarity against the bundle upgrade criteria. A unit at lower star rarity (or unactivated with less cumulative shards/blueprints) than the bundle upgrade criteria will be upgraded and activated. Units that exceed the star rarity (or cumulative shards/blueprints) will be activated (if unactivated) and then evaluated for additional attributes (gear tier, ability tier, etc). Any surplus shards/blueprints over the bundle upgrade criteria will be retained.

If your previously unlocked units meet or exceed the bundle upgrade criteria for other attributes, any surplus value will be retained.

[b]CHARACTERS[/b]
- 7 Stars
- Level 85
- Relic Level 5
- Ability Tier 7

[b]SHIP[/b]
- 7 Stars
- Level 85
- Ability Tier 7
data.FURY_CLASS_INTERCEPTOR_LIGHTSPEED_TEXT: A weapon of precision and fear, the Fury-Class Interceptor embodies the might of the Dark Side. Instantly bring this iconic Sith vessel to 7 Stars, Level 85, and Ability Tier 7 and Darth Malgus to Relic 5! Command the skies with the power once reserved for the Empire’s elite.

data.GALACTIC_BUNDLE_EXCHANGE_VIEW_SUBTITLE: You have received a Hyperdrive Token. Unlock the Hyperdrive Bundle and make the jump to hyperspace!
data.GALACTIC_BUNDLE_INFO:
[c][F0FF23]HYPERDRIVE QUESTS[-][/c]
Purchase of the Hyperdrive Bundle grants access to a series of Hyperdrive quest chains.

[c][F0FF23]MERGE UNITS[-][/c]
Units included in the Hyperdrive Bundle are upgraded according to a predetermined set of upgrade criteria (listed below). The Hyperdrive Bundle does not directly grant character shards, ship blueprints, or resources used in merge upgrades. The upgrade criteria are evaluated against your existing roster, and your units are set to the greater of the two values.

Each unit will first be evaluated for existing shards or star rarity against the bundle upgrade criteria. A unit at lower star rarity (or unactivated with less cumulative shards/blueprints) than the bundle upgrade criteria will be upgraded and activated. Units that exceed the star rarity (or cumulative shards/blueprints) will be activated (if unactivated) and then evaluated for additional attributes (gear tier, ability tier, etc). Any surplus shards/blueprints over the bundle upgrade criteria will be retained.

If your previously unlocked units meet or exceed the bundle upgrade criteria for other attributes, any surplus value will be retained.

- Ability Tier 5

[c][AFFFFFFF]SHIPS[-][/c]

NOTE: The Hyperdrive Bundle grants additional resources beyond those used for the upgrade of units.

Specified ability ranks can be viewed by tapping on a unit in the corresponding Hyperdrive Bundle screen.

[c][F0FF23]ACTIVITY UNLOCKS[-][/c]
Purchase of the Hyperdrive Bundle allows for the specified holotable nodes to be completed using Sim Tickets.

data.GALATIC_AHSOKA_RUSH_I_INFO:
[c][F0FF23]MERGE UNITS[-][/c]

Units included in the Lightspeed Bundle are upgraded according to a predetermined set of upgrade criteria (listed below). The Lightspeed Bundle does not directly grant character shards / ship blueprints or resources used in merge upgrades. The upgrade criteria are evaluated against your existing roster, and your units are set to the greater of the two values.

Each unit will first be evaluated for existing shards or star rarity against the bundle upgrade criteria. A unit at lower star rarity (or unactivated with less cumulative shards/blueprints) than the bundle upgrade criteria will be upgraded and activated. Units that exceed the star rarity (or cumulative shards/blueprints) will be activated (if unactivated) and then evaluated for additional attributes (gear tier, ability tier, etc). Any surplus shards/blueprints over the bundle upgrade criteria will be retained.

If your previously unlocked units meet or exceed the bundle upgrade criteria for other attributes, any surplus value will be retained.

[b]CHARACTERS[/b]
- 7 Stars
- Level 85
- Relic Level 1
- Ability Tier 7

data.GENERAL_SKYWALKER_LIGHTSPEED_BUNDLE_INFO:
[c][F0FF23]MERGE UNITS[-][/c]

Units included in the Lightspeed Bundle are upgraded according to a predetermined set of upgrade criteria (listed below). The Lightspeed Bundle does not directly grant character shards / ship blueprints or resources used in merge upgrades. The upgrade criteria are evaluated against your existing roster, and your units are set to the greater of the two values.

Each unit will first be evaluated for existing shards or star rarity against the bundle upgrade criteria. A unit at lower star rarity (or unactivated with less cumulative shards/blueprints) than the bundle upgrade criteria will be upgraded and activated. Units that exceed the star rarity (or cumulative shards/blueprints) will be activated (if unactivated) and then evaluated for additional attributes (gear tier, ability tier, etc). Any surplus shards/blueprints over the bundle upgrade criteria will be retained.

If your previously unlocked units meet or exceed the bundle upgrade criteria for other attributes, any surplus value will be retained.

data.GLAHSOKA_GUIDE_DESCRIPTION: Always fighting for what she believed in, Ahsoka Tano is a former Jedi Knight who fought alongside clones and other Jedi during the Clone Wars. data.GLHONDO_GUIDE_DESCRIPTION_V2: Clever, unpredictable, and unburdened by a traditional moral compass, Hondo Ohnaka carved out his legacy as the flamboyant leader of the Ohnaka Gang during the Clone Wars. A Weequay pirate from Florrum, Hondo thrived amidst shifting galactic powers—betraying the Separatists one day and striking deals with the Jedi the next. His reputation for survival is unmatched, often escaping situations that destroyed far more powerful figures. Even as the Empire rose and fell, Hondo resurfaced time and again, inserting himself into conflicts not out of loyalty, but opportunity. Though few would call him trustworthy, many found themselves relying on his expertise when it mattered most. Hondo built his fortune—and his myth—not with the Force or an army, but with instinct, improvisation, and impeccable timing.

data.GLLEIA_GUIDE_DESCRIPTION_V2: Princess Leia Organa was a Senator and key leader of the Rebellion. data.GRAND_INQUISITOR_LIGHTSPEED_INFO:
[b]MERGE UNITS[/b]

Units included in the Lightspeed Bundle are upgraded according to a predetermined set of upgrade criteria (listed below). The Lightspeed Bundle does not directly grant character shards / ship blueprints or resources used in merge upgrades. The upgrade criteria are evaluated against your existing roster, and your units are set to the greater of the two values.

Each unit will first be evaluated for existing shards or star rarity against the bundle upgrade criteria. A unit at lower star rarity (or unactivated with less cumulative shards/blueprints) than the bundle upgrade criteria will be upgraded and activated. Units that exceed the star rarity (or cumulative shards/blueprints) will be activated (if unactivated) and then evaluated for additional attributes (gear tier, ability tier, etc). Any surplus shards/blueprints over the bundle upgrade criteria will be retained.

If your previously unlocked units meet or exceed the bundle upgrade criteria for other attributes, any surplus value will be retained.

data.HAPPY_ONE_YEAR_ANNIVERSARY_INBOX_MESSAGE:
Greetings, galactic heroes!

Today marks the one year anniversary of the game’s worldwide launch. Please join us in celebrating this august occasion and enjoy these free gifts!

On behalf of the entire Capital Games team, we want to express our gratitude to you and the millions of other players around the world who have played and supported the game. Without your enthusiasm, passion, and contributions this game would not be possible.

This past year has been a whirlwind of updates, new features, and new content. That being said, we want you to know that we are just getting started.

Thank you!
The Capital Games Team

data.I_WILL_FACE_HIM_ALONE_MODIFIER_DESC:
All characters gain the Granted Abilities [c][ffff33]Boulder Throw[-][/c] and [c][ffff33]Shatter Earth[-][/c]. These abilities are on a shared cooldown between all allies and are immune to cooldown manipulation.
While any other allies are active, the boss Darth Vader can't be defeated. When Darth Vader is the only active ally remaining, he gains 100% Critical Damage, Defense, and Max Health, recovers 100% Health and Protection, which can't be prevented, and dispels all debuffs from himself, and the cooldowns for Boulder Throw and Shatter Earth are refreshed for all characters.

[c][ffff33]Boulder Throw (Cooldown 3)[-][/c]: Deal Physical damage to target enemy and Stun them for 1 turn, which can't be evaded or resisted.
[c][ffff33]Shatter Earth (Cooldown 7)[-][/c]: Deal Physical damage to all enemies and inflict Stagger for 2 turns.

data.INBOX_10TH_ANNIVERSARY_MESSAGE:
Greetings, Holotable Heroes!

Ten years. A full decade of strategy, triumph, and unforgettable battles across the galaxy far, far away. From the first clash on the holotables to the countless victories that followed, you have been the heart and soul of Galaxy of Heroes.

Together, we have faced galactic wars, united guilds, forged legends, and built a community stronger than the armor of a Mandalorian. Through every update, event, and thrilling moment, your passion and dedication have kept the Force alive and blazing brighter than ever.

As we celebrate this monumental 10th Anniversary, we want to thank every player who has made this journey possible. You’ve turned Galaxy of Heroes into more than a game, it’s a legacy.

Please accept these special anniversary gifts as a token of our deepest gratitude. Here’s to the next chapter in our shared saga, to new heroes, greater challenges, and the adventures yet to come.

Thank you for an incredible decade. The Force will always be with you, Holotable Heroes!

On behalf of the entire Capital Games team, we want you to know how humbled and grateful we are for the opportunity to work on this game. We strive every day to make the game better so we may earn your continued support and participation.

Please enjoy these free gifts as a celebration of our first two years together and we look forward to many more exciting years with you in the Cantina!

Thank you!
The Capital Games Team
