data.INBOX_CHEWIE_LOYAL_FRIEND_MESSAGE:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

We were deeply saddened to learn of Peter Mayhew’s recent passing. As one of the most beloved characters in Star Wars, his portrayal of Chewbacca resonated worldwide as the stalwart friend we always wanted – and all without saying a word we could understand.

To commemorate his tremendous impact on the Star Wars universe and to keep him alive in our hearts, we have given all players a special Title and Portrait of Chewbacca.

Title: Loyal Friend
Portrait: Chewie

May the Force be with us all

data.INBOX_DEATHMARK_UPDATE_MESSAGE:
We have made some changes to Deathmark and how it interacts with Taunt and Marked. Previously, Taunt and Marked took priority over Deathmark, and now Deathmark has equal priority.

For example, in prior battles, if you Marked one enemy and Deathmarked another enemy, you had to target the Marked character. Now, you can choose to target either the Marked or Deathmarked character.

Please note that a character who “ignores Taunt” has always also ignored Deathmark and Marked. This will not be affected by the changes above.

data.INBOX_FINN_REBALANCE_MESSAGE:
Based on player feedback, Finn has been updated and is the Daily Log in character for January!

Finn now deals more bonus damage with "Crack Shot," and has increased chances to Expose and Stun his enemies with "Takedown."

"Hold the Line" now grants increased healing, and shares that healing with Poe Dameron. Additionally, the Omega upgrade for this ability now gives Finn the ability to dispel all debuffs from all allies!

"Balanced Tactics" has been reworked to grant more Offense, and much more Defense. This ability also gains a brand new Zeta upgrade, giving your Resistance allies more synergy with Foresight and Expose.

Unlock Finn and revisit your Resistance squad today!

data.INBOX_GAC_CUSTOMER_SUPPORT_GRANT_MESSAGE:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

Due to issues with the Grand Arena Championship exhibition over the weekend that prevented many players from completing the Grand Arena event, we will be resetting all players' Grand Arena Championship Score and Lifetime Score. data.INBOX_IMPROVEMENTS_TO_SQUAD_TOURNAMENT_0:
Greetings,

We recently made some changes to the ways that tournaments function, including the way Ally Points are now used to refresh your characters.

Here are some additional Ally Points to help you out in the latest tournament, good luck!
data.INBOX_IMPROVEMENTS_TO_SQUAD_TOURNAMENT_M:
Thanks for playing in the last Squad Tournament! Another Tournament is starting soon, so we want to let you know about a few improvements we made.

[1] We fixed the bug causing the character refresh to occur at the wrong time
[2] To mitigate an unintended behavior, the defensive squad can only be set once per Tournament and matchmaking has been improved. If you're interested in more details, please check out our forums in Allies->Forums
[3] We changed the cost of refreshing characters from Crystals to Ally Points to create a more inclusive experience

Here are some Ally Points to get you started, have fun!

data.INBOX_KYLOREN_REBALANCE_MESSAGE:
Based on player feedback, Kylo Ren has been updated and is the Daily Login character for February!

"Lash Out" now grants an additional turn of Retribution and grants Turn Meter to First Order allies.

"Outrage" now Stuns the target while Kylo has full Health, and deals even more damage while he is damaged.

"Unstoppable" now grants him stacking Offense and Defense whenever he takes damage, and greatly reduces the damage he takes from Percent Health damage effects such as Damage Over Time.

Unlock Kylo Ren and revisit your First Order squad today!

data.INBOX_LUCASFILM_50TH_ANNIVERSARY_MESSAGE:
Hi, Holotable Heroes!

Today, we celebrate a grand achievement with Lucasfilm's 50th Anniversary!

For the past half century, Star Wars has resonated with our hearts, inspired our imaginations, and become a part of who we are. From movie theaters and living rooms, to weddings and theme parks, a Galaxy Far, Far Away has felt like home and ingrained itself into the zeitgeist of our culture.

We are honored to take part in this phenomenon with not only our partners at Lucasfilm and Disney, but most importantly, you - our incredible community of players!

So, let's raise a glass of blue milk and make a toast in celebration of the magic, wonder, and grandeur the Star Wars experience has created over the past five decades!

Be sure to collect your [b]FREE Lucasfilm 50th Anniversary Rewards Calendar[/b] from the Store!

data.INBOX_SITH_RAID_CHANGES_MESSAGE:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

We are reworking the Sith Triumvirate Raid to make non-Heroic tiers faster and increase the rewards in the upper tiers. Rewards for Tier 6 and above now include Mod Salvage and a better chance to get the gear you need to progress to the next tier. We are removing some of the Challenge gear from rewards that has been stacking up in your inventory because you’re already earning it in Daily Challenges.

Both Nihilus' Annihilate and Traya's lightsabers are hard to anticipate, so we are adjusting these mechanics to be more predictable.

- Nihilus' Basic attack no longer reduces cooldowns in any tier, including Heroic

- Traya's lightsabers no longer dispel or apply debuffs in Tiers 1-6 (this mechanic is still active in the Heroic Tier)

We're also reducing Raid boss health across the board in every tier except Heroic. As guilds work their way up to Heroic, they will be able to beat the raids they're already doing faster and get a bit of encouragement to give the next tier a shot.

Find the full details on the official Star Wars Galaxy of Heroes Forums!

data.INBOX_SWGOH_MESSAGE_MESSAGE:
Hello Holotable Heroes!

I’m so pleased to be able to thank you all for being with us on the three year anniversary of Star Wars: Galaxy of Heroes. This game would not have made it to its third year without you, and we are excited about where the next three (and beyond) will take us. We have many more Star Wars stories to tell, and we want to give you all the tools to play competitively and collaboratively, both individually and as guilds and communities.

This year we have made an effort to connect more with the community, and our vision for the future of this game is a lot about continuing to widen those touchpoints, and find more ways to grow this game together.

I recognize this is exceptionally sappy, but you make up one of the most hardcore and passionate communities that exist in all of gaming, and I’m proud that you are a part of our game. We can only endeavor to be worthy of your investments, and look forward to exploring new paths together.

As always, I’ll see you on the holotables,
Carrie Gouskos
Senior Producer

data.JABBAS_ENTOURAGE_LIGHTSPEED_BUNDLE_INFO:
[c][F0FF23]MERGE UNITS[-][/c]

Units included in the Lightspeed Bundle are upgraded according to a predetermined set of upgrade criteria (listed below). The Lightspeed Bundle does not directly grant character shards / ship blueprints or resources used in merge upgrades. The upgrade criteria are evaluated against your existing roster, and your units are set to the greater of the two values.

Each unit will first be evaluated for existing shards or star rarity against the bundle upgrade criteria. A unit at lower star rarity (or unactivated with less cumulative shards/blueprints) than the bundle upgrade criteria will be upgraded and activated. Units that exceed the star rarity (or cumulative shards/blueprints) will be activated (if unactivated) and then evaluated for additional attributes (gear tier, ability tier, etc). Any surplus shards/blueprints over the bundle upgrade criteria will be retained.

If your previously unlocked units meet or exceed the bundle upgrade criteria for other attributes, any surplus value will be retained.

[b]CHARACTERS[/b]
- 7 Stars
- Level 85
- Relic Level 5
- Ability Tier 7

[c][F0FF23]MERGE UNITS[-][/c]

Units included in the Lightspeed Bundle are upgraded according to a predetermined set of upgrade criteria (listed below). The Lightspeed Bundle does not directly grant character shards / ship blueprints or resources used in merge upgrades. The upgrade criteria are evaluated against your existing roster, and your units are set to the greater of the two values.

Each unit will first be evaluated for existing shards or star rarity against the bundle upgrade criteria. A unit at lower star rarity (or unactivated with less cumulative shards/blueprints) than the bundle upgrade criteria will be upgraded and activated. Any surplus shards/blueprints over the bundle upgrade criteria will be retained.

data.JEDI_KNIGHT_REVAN_LIGHTSPEED_BUNDLE_INFO:
[b]MERGE UNITS[/b]

Units included in the Lightspeed Bundle are upgraded according to a predetermined set of upgrade criteria (listed below). The Lightspeed Bundle does not directly grant character shards / ship blueprints or resources used in merge upgrades. The upgrade criteria are evaluated against your existing roster, and your units are set to the greater of the two values.

Each unit will first be evaluated for existing shards or star rarity against the bundle upgrade criteria. A unit at lower star rarity (or unactivated with less cumulative shards/blueprints) than the bundle upgrade criteria will be upgraded and activated. Units that exceed the star rarity (or cumulative shards/blueprints) will be activated (if unactivated) and then evaluated for additional attributes (gear tier, ability tier, etc). Any surplus shards/blueprints over the bundle upgrade criteria will be retained.

If your previously unlocked units meet or exceed the bundle upgrade criteria for other attributes, any surplus value will be retained.

[b]CHARACTERS[/b]
- 7 Stars
- Level 85
- Relic Level 3
- Ability Tier 7

data.JEDIKNIGHTCAL_GUIDE_DESCRIPTION: Saved from Order 66 by his master, Jaro Tapal, Padawan Cal Kestis hides from the Empire on Bracca. When he uses the Force to save a fellow worker, Cal becomes the target of the Inquisitors, who seek to stamp out all remaining Jedi. Cal and former Jedi Master, Cere Junda, discover a holocron listing force-sensitive children in an ancient vault on Bogano and seek to keep the information safe from the ruthless Inquisitorius.\n\nThough Cal and team have drifted apart in the five years since securing the holocron, the young Jedi Knight continues to fight the Empire as the galaxy descends further into darkness.
data.JEDIKNIGHTCAL_T1_TO_T6: Health and Speed allows Jedi Knight Cal Kestis to survive and reach maximum stacks of Impetuous
data.JEDIKNIGHTCAL_T7_AND_UP: Health and Speed allows Jedi Knight Cal Kestis to survive and reach maximum stacks of Impetuous
data.JEDIKNIGHTLUKE_GUIDE_DESCRIPTION: Luke Skywalker understands that to truly become a Jedi, he has to eventually face down his father, Darth Vader. Father and son eventually cross blades in a ferocious lightsaber duel, ending when Darth Vader redeems himself and Luke earns his title of Jedi Knight. Jedi Knight Luke is a powerful Jedi Leader that boosts his Jedi allies with a new buff, Jedi's Will, which provides a variety of bonuses. Jedi Knight Luke Skywalker is especially equipped to defeat faster enemies by lowering their speed to his own to control the pace of the battle.
data.JEDIKNIGHTREVAN_GUIDE_DESCRIPTION: Revan was a Jedi Knight who was influential in shaping the history of the Jedi Order, and was part of many pivotal battles to stop the growing threat of the Sith. This warrior of legend is an influential Jedi leader and tactician who controls the battlefield through the use of synchronized attacks, a devastating saber throw, and the ability to single out high value targets and subvert the enemy's strategies.
data.JEDIMASTERGUARDIAN_BASIC_TIER07_DESC: Deal Physical damage to target enemy and recover 30% Health. If this attack deals any damage, reduce the cooldowns of Jedi Master Guardian's other abilities by 1.
data.JEDIMASTERGUARDIAN_SPECIAL01_TIER07_DESC: Another target ally assists. Heal that ally for 30% of Jedi Master Guardian's Max Health, then all other Jedi allies recover half that amount.
data.JEDIMASTERGUARDIAN_SPECIAL02_TIER07_DESC: Dispel all debuffs on target ally and they recover 40% Health. Then, revive all defeated Jedi allies at 80% Health and grant those allies Critical Hit Immunity for 5 turns.
data.JEDIMASTERKENOBI_T1_TO_T6: Critical Damage and Health mods help Jedi Master Kenobi deal more damage and increase his survivability.
data.JEDIMASTERKENOBI_T7_AND_UP: Critical Damage and Health mods help Jedi Master Kenobi deal more damage and increase his survivability.
data.JEDIMASTERMACEWINDU_GUIDE_DESCRIPTION: The formidable Jedi Master and Investigator Mace Windu held a seat on the Jedi Council for decades and was a front-line General during the Clone Wars. His signature amethyst blade stood out on the battlefield, rallying his troops and tripping the fear-circuits in the droid armies he fought so hard against. In the waning days of the Clone Wars, Windu would find himself back on Coruscant and heading up an arrest squad to take in the Chancellor of the Republic. A Chancellor who was recently revealed to be the Sith Mastermind behind both sides of the Clone Wars.
data.JEDIMASTERMACEWINDU_T1_TO_T6: Health mods provide the resilience Mace needs and Speed mods keep him one step ahead of his opponents.

data.KI_ADI_MUNDI_LIGHTSPEED_INFO:
[c][F0FF23]MERGE UNITS[-][/c]

Units included in the Lightspeed Bundle are upgraded according to a predetermined set of upgrade criteria (listed below). The Lightspeed Bundle does not directly grant character shards / ship blueprints or resources used in merge upgrades. The upgrade criteria are evaluated against your existing roster, and your units are set to the greater of the two values.

Each unit will first be evaluated for existing shards or star rarity against the bundle upgrade criteria. A unit at lower star rarity (or unactivated with less cumulative shards/blueprints) than the bundle upgrade criteria will be upgraded and activated. Units that exceed the star rarity (or cumulative shards/blueprints) will be activated (if unactivated) and then evaluated for additional attributes (gear tier, ability tier, etc). Any surplus shards/blueprints over the bundle upgrade criteria will be retained.

If your previously unlocked units meet or exceed the bundle upgrade criteria for other attributes, any surplus value will be retained.

[c][AFFFFFFF]CHARACTERS[-][/c]
- 7 Stars
- Level 85
- Relic Level 5
- Ability Tier 7

data.LEADERABILITY_BAYLANSKOLL_TIER_04_DESC:
At the start of battle, Baylan Skoll gains 30% Offense and all Mercenary allies +20% Tenacity, and 1 stack of Soldier of Fortune for each active Mercenary ally.

Whenever a Mercenary ally gains a stack of Ransom, all Mercenary allies gain 1% Defense (stacking) until the end of encounter and recover 5% Health and Protection.

 Whenever a Mercenary ally has Health Steal Up, they gain 25% Critical Damage and Protection Up (50%) until Health Steal Up expires.
data.LEADERABILITY_BAYLANSKOLL_TIER_05_DESC_V:
At the start of battle, Baylan Skoll gains 30% Offense and all Mercenary allies gain 20% Tenacity, and 1 stack of Soldier of Fortune for each active Mercenary ally.

Whenever a Mercenary ally gains a stack of Ransom, all Mercenary allies gain 1% Defense (stacking) until the end of encounter and recover 5% Health and Protection.

 Whenever a Mercenary ally has Health Steal Up, they gain 25% Critical Damage and Protection Up (50%) until Health Steal Up expires.

Whenever a Mercenary ally is Dazed or Stunned, they dispel it and all Mercenary allies recover 25% Health and Protection.

If there are no enemy Galactic Legends, whenever a Mercenary ally is inflicted with Fear:

- All Mercenary allies gain 50% bonus Max Protection and Offense (stacking), until the end of encounter
- Dispel all debuffs on all Mercenary allies and they recover 50% Health and Protection
- Deal True damage to all enemies, which can't be evaded or defeat them, Blind them for 1 turn, which can't be evaded or resisted, and inflict them with Healing Immunity for 1 turn, which can't be dispelled, evaded, or resisted
data.LEADERABILITY_BAYLANSKOLL_TIER_06_DESC_V:
At the start of battle, Baylan Skoll gains 30% Offense and all Mercenary allies gain 20% Tenacity, and 1 stack of Soldier of Fortune for each active Mercenary ally. Then, Mercenary allies double their current stacks of Soldier of Fortune.

Whenever a Mercenary ally gains a stack of Ransom, all Mercenary allies gain 1% Defense (stacking) until the end of encounter and recover 5% Health and Protection.

Whenever a Mercenary ally has Health Steal Up, they gain 25% Critical Damage and Protection Up (50%) until Health Steal Up expires.

Whenever a Mercenary ally is Dazed or Stunned, they dispel it and all Mercenary allies recover 25% Health and Protection.

If there are no enemy Galactic Legends, whenever a Mercenary ally is inflicted with Fear:

- All Mercenary allies gain 50% bonus Max Protection and Offense (stacking), until the end of encounter
- Dispel all debuffs on all Mercenary allies and they recover 50% Health and Protection
- Deal True damage to all enemies, which can't be evaded or defeat them, Blind them for 1 turn, which can't be evaded or resisted, and inflict them with Healing Immunity for 1 turn, which can't be dispelled, evaded, or resisted

Whenever a Mercenary ally assists or attacks out of turn, they gain 2 stacks of Soldier of Fortune. The first time each other Mercenary ally falls below 50% Health, Baylan Skoll Taunts for 2 turns, which can't be dispelled or prevented.

While Taunting, Baylan has +50% Defense, +30% Tenacity and Retribution until Taunt expires.
data.LEADERABILITY_BAYLANSKOLL_TIER_07_DESC_V:
At the start of battle, Baylan Skoll gains 30% Offense and all Mercenary allies gain 20% Tenacity, and 1 stack of Soldier of Fortune for each active Mercenary ally. Then, Mercenary allies double their current stacks of Soldier of Fortune.

Whenever a Mercenary ally gains a stack of Ransom, all Mercenary allies gain 1% Defense (stacking) until the end of encounter and recover 5% Health and Protection.

Whenever a Mercenary ally has Health Steal Up, they gain 25% Critical Damage and Protection Up (50%) until Health Steal Up expires.

Whenever a Mercenary ally is Dazed or Stunned, they dispel it and all Mercenary allies recover 25% Health and Protection.

If there are no enemy Galactic Legends, whenever a Mercenary ally is inflicted with Fear:
- All Mercenary allies gain 50% bonus Max Protection and Offense (stacking), until the end of encounter
- Dispel all debuffs on all Mercenary allies and they recover 50% Health and Protection
- Deal True damage to all enemies, which can't be evaded or defeat them, Blind them for 1 turn, which can't be evaded or resisted, and inflict them with Healing Immunity for 1 turn, which can't be dispelled, evaded, or resisted

Whenever a Mercenary ally assists or attacks out of turn, they gain 2 stacks of Soldier of Fortune. The first time each other Mercenary ally falls below 50% Health, Baylan Skoll Taunts for 2 turns, which can't be dispelled or prevented.

While Taunting, Baylan has +50% Defense, +30% Tenacity and Retribution until Taunt expires.

[c][E7E7E7]While in Grand Arenas:[-][/c] At the start of battle, Baylan Taunts for 2 turns.

If there is a non-Galactic Legend Ahsoka enemy, Mercenary allies ignore Protection, are immune to critical hits and Healing Immunity, and they Expose all enemies and inflict them with Healing Immunity for 1 turn, which can't be evaded or resisted at the start of each of their turns.

If there are no Galactic Legend enemies, whenever Baylan Taunts, he inflicts all enemies with Doubt for 1 turn.

If Baylan is not Taunting, whenever an enemy takes a bonus turn they are inflicted with Healing Immunity for 3 turns, which can't be dispelled.

Whenever an enemy gains Foresight, they dispel it and are inflicted with Buff Immunity for 2 turns instead.

Whenever an enemy gains Inspire, reduce all enemy's Evasion by 50% (stacking) until the end of encounter, and all Mercenary allies gain 80% Defense (stacking) and 50% bonus Protection (stacking) until the end of encounter.

Defeated enemies can't be revived and Mercenary allies can't be instantly defeated.

data.LEADERABILITY_BOSSNASS_TIER_06_DESC:
Gungan allies have +30% Max Protection, and Offense, and +30 Speed.

Whenever a Gungan ally attacks out of turn, they inflict Speed Down for 1 turn. The first time each Gungan ally drops below 50% Health, they gain 50% bonus Protection for 2 turns.

If there is an ally Shield Generator, whenever it loses a stack of Recharge, Gungan allies gain 1% Max Protection (max 50%) until the end of the encounter. data.LEADERABILITY_CAPTAINENOCH_DESC:
Imperial Remnant allies have +10% Critical Avoidance.

At the start of battle, if all allies are Imperial Remnant and no other allies are Empire with the Leader tag, whenever another non-Droid Imperial Remnant ally would be reduced to 1% Health from a non-critical hit, if they have less than 9 stacks of [c][ffff33]Decay[-][/c], they recover 100% of their Health and Protection and gain a stack of Decay (max: 9) until the end of battle which can't be copied, dispelled, or prevented.

During his turn, whenever he uses Die Well, if an Imperial Remnant ally has less than 3 stacks of Decay and less than 50% Health, he deals True damage to them equal to 100% of their Max Health, which can't be evaded.

[c][ffff33]Decay:[-][/c] -10% Health limit per stack; can't Health Steal

data.LEADERABILITY_CARTHONASI_TIER08_DESC:
Old Republic allies gain 30% Potency, Tenacity and Critical Avoidance. Whenever an enemy is inflicted with a Damage Over Time effect, all Old Republic allies recover 3% Health and Protection.

When an Old Republic ally uses their Basic ability during their turn, they have an 80% chance to call another Old Republic ally to assist, dealing 50% less damage (limit once per turn).

Whenever an ally dispels a buff, they recover 15% Health and Protection and at the end of their turn, they gain Foresight for 2 turns.

data.LEADERABILITY_DARTHBANE_DESC:
Sith allies have +10% Offense and +10 Speed. Sith allies can't be revived.

At the start of battle, allies gain Defense Up, Evasion Up, and Health Up for 2 turns.

Whenever a Sith ally is defeated, Bane's cooldowns are reset, he recovers 50% Health and gains 50% Turn Meter.

While Bane is active: At the end of each of his turns, the weakest other Sith ally takes damage equal to 15% of Bane's Max Health and Bane gains 5% Max Health for each other Sith ally for the rest of the battle. The first time each other non-Galactic Legend Sith ally above 30% Health would be reduced to 30% or less Health, they are granted a bonus turn and defeated at the start of that bonus turn, then Bane gains 5% Max Health, Max Protection, and Offense, and 5 Speed, and an additional 5% Max Health, Max Protection, and Offense and 5 Speed for each Relic Amplifier level that the defeated Sith ally had.

The first time each other Jedi ally falls below 100% Health, they dispel all debuffs on themselves and gain Critical Hit Immunity, Defense Up, and Tenacity Up for 2 turns. Then, Luke Taunts for 2 turns, which can't be copied, dispelled, or prevented.

At the start of battle, Jedi allies gain the granted ability [c][ffff33]Inherited Teachings[-][/c].

[c][ffff33]Inherited Teachings[-][/c]: Gain Jedi Lessons for 3 turns and call target other Light Side ally to assist, dealing 90% less damage. Then, they deal true damage to the target enemy based on 60% of Jedi Master Luke Skywalker's base Max Protection, which can't be evaded.

If that ally is a Jedi, they gain Jedi Lessons for 3 turns and 15% Turn Meter, recover Protection equal to 5% of Luke's base Max Protection, and reduce the cooldown of their [c][ffff33]Inherited Teachings[-][/c] ability by 1.

This ability can't be used if there are no other Jedi allies. (Cooldown: 2)

data.LEADERABILITY_GREATMOTHERS_DESC:
Nightsister allies gain 10% Defense, Max Health, and 5 Speed. If all allies are Nightsister at the start of battle, at the start of each encounter and end of each turn, if there are no enemies inflicted with [c][ffff33]Doomed[-][/c], Great Mothers removes Ability Block from themselves, gains the granted ability [c][ffff33]Fate Weaving[-][/c], and takes a bonus turn. During this bonus turn, Great Mothers can only use Fate Weaving. Great Mothers can't use Fate Weaving two times in a row.

If all allies are Nightsister at the start of battle, at the end of each turn, if there are no other allies with [c][ffff33]Blessed[-][/c], Great Mothers removes Ability Block from themselves, gains the granted ability [c][ffff33]Gift of Shadows[-][/c], and takes a bonus turn. During this bonus turn, Great Mothers can only use Gift of Shadows. Doomed enemies can always be targeted by Blessed allies and Great Mothers.

[c][ffff33]Fate Weaving: [-][/c]Target enemy is inflicted with a stack of Damage Over Time for 1 turn and [c][ffff33]Doomed[-][/c] for the rest of the encounter, which can't be copied, dispelled, or resisted.

[c][ffff33]Doomed:[-][/c] Protection is disabled and can't Stealth; lose 20% Max Health whenever this character ends their turn until the end of the encounter; can't revive (raid bosses and Galactic Legends: -5% Defense)

[c][ffff33]Gift of Shadows: [-][/c]Target other Nightsister ally gains [c][ffff33]Blessed[-][/c] for the rest of the encounter or until defeated, which can't be copied, dispelled, or prevented.

[c][ffff33]Blessed:[-][/c] +20% Max Health and Offense; immune to instant defeat effects, Stun, and turn meter reduction; assist whenever another Nightsister ally uses a Special ability on their turn, dealing 40% less damage

data.LEADERABILITY_LORDVADER_DESC:
Dark Side allies have +20 Speed, +20% Mastery, and +15% Max Health, doubled for Empire or Dark Side Unaligned Force User allies.

At the start of battle, other Empire and Dark Side Unaligned Force User allies lose all Protection and gain that much Max Health. If all allies are Dark Side at the start of battle, Empire and Dark Side Unaligned Force User allies are immune to Fear, Empire Tanks gain Taunt for 2 turns, and when an Empire ally loses Taunt, they are inflicted with Marked for 1 turn, which can't be dispelled, prevented, or resisted.

Whenever a debuffed Dark Side ally takes damage, Lord Vader gains 2% Ultimate Charge, increased to 3% if that ally was an Unaligned Force User.

Empire and Dark Side Unaligned Force User allies have +35% Critical Chance and Critical Damage when targeting a Galactic Republic enemy.

While Empire and Dark Side Unaligned Force User allies are at certain Health thresholds, they gain different benefits.

- [c][ffff33]While above 35% Health:[-][/c] During an enemy's attack they are immune to Max Health reduction and other damage that is based on Max Health
- [c][ffff33]While above 50% Health:[-][/c] They are immune to Damage Over Time and Thermal Detonator effects
- [c][ffff33]While below 80% Health:[-][/c] Can't be critically hit
data.LEADERABILITY_LORDVADER_RAID_DESC_V2:
Other Empire allies have +40 Speed, +40% Mastery, and +30% Max Health.

Whenever a Dark Side ally loses a buff, Empire allies gain 1% Mastery (stacking) until the end of battle. Whenever a debuffed Dark Side ally takes damage, they gain 20 Speed for 1 turn.

Empire allies have +35% Critical Chance and Critical Damage when targeting a Galactic Republic enemy. Whenever an enemy critically hits an Empire ally, that enemy has -30% Critical Damage (stacking) for 3 turns.

While Empire allies are at certain Health thresholds, they gain different benefits:
- While above 35% Health: Empire allies are immune to Turn Meter reduction
- While above 50% Health: They are immune to Damage Over Time and cooldown increase
- While below 80% Health: Can't be critically hit

At the start of battle if Maul is in the Leader slot and not the ally slot, Mandalorians in the Leader slot gain 1 stack of [c][ffff33]Mand'alor[-][/c] (stacking, max 2) until they are defeated, which can't be copied, dispelled, or prevented. When a character with Mand'alor is defeated, the character that defeated them gains Mand'alor until they're defeated. There can't be more than two Mand'alor effects in battle.

Mandalorian allies deal 20% more damage when they target an enemy with Mand'alor. While there are two Mand'alor buffs on allied characters, all Mandalorian allies deal 50% more damage during their turn.

[c][ffff33]Mand'alor:[-][/c] Mandalorian allies assist dealing 50% less damage when this character uses an ability during their turn; at the start of every turn, dispel all debuffs on the healthiest Mandalorian ally without Mand'alor and that ally gains Taunt and +100% Defense until the end of that turn; defeating this character will grant Mand'alor to the character that defeated them; if this character is defeated by a status effect, Mand'alor will not be granted to anyone

data.LEADERABILITY_MAZKANATA_DESC: At the start of each encounter and if there were no Galactic Legend allies, all Pirate and Smuggler allies gain Foresight for 1 turn.
data.LEADERABILITY_MAZKANATA_TIER_01_DESC_V2: At the start of each encounter and if there were no Galactic Legend allies, all Pirate and Smuggler allies gain Foresight for 1 turn and whenever an enemy uses a Basic ability, all Pirate allies gain 2% Turn Meter.
data.LEADERABILITY_MAZKANATA_TIER_02_DESC_V2: At the start of each encounter and if there were no Galactic Legend allies, all Pirate and Smuggler allies gain Foresight for 1 turn and whenever an enemy uses a Basic ability, all Pirate allies gain 5% Turn Meter.
data.LEADERABILITY_MAZKANATA_TIER_03_DESC_V2:
At the start of each encounter and if there were no Galactic Legend allies:

- All Pirate and Smuggler allies gain Foresight for 1 turn
- All Pirate and Smuggler allies are immune to Fear
- Whenever an enemy uses a Basic ability, all Pirate allies gain 5% Turn Meter
data.LEADERABILITY_MAZKANATA_TIER_04_DESC_V2:
At the start of each encounter and if there were no Galactic Legend allies:

- All Pirate and Smuggler allies are immune to Fear and they gain Foresight for 1 turn
- Whenever a Pirate ally with Retribution uses a Basic ability, they ignore that enemy's Protection
- Whenever an enemy uses a Basic ability, all Pirate allies gain 5% Turn Meter
data.LEADERABILITY_MAZKANATA_TIER_05_DESC_V2:
At the start of each encounter and if there were no Galactic Legend allies:

- All Pirate and Smuggler allies are immune to Fear and they gain Foresight for 1 turn
- Whenever a Pirate ally with Retribution uses a Basic ability, they ignore that enemy's Protection
- Whenever an enemy uses a Basic ability, all Pirate allies gain 5% Turn Meter
- Whenever Maz gains a stack of Profit, all other Pirate allies gain 1 stack of Profit until the end of the encounter
data.LEADERABILITY_MAZKANATA_TIER_06_DESC_V2:
At the start of each encounter and if there were no Galactic Legend allies:

- All Pirate and Smuggler allies are immune to Fear and they gain Foresight for 1 turn
- Whenever a Pirate ally with Retribution uses a Basic ability, they ignore that enemy's Protection
- Whenever an enemy uses a Basic ability, all Pirate allies gain 5% Turn Meter
- Whenever Maz gains a stack of Profit, all other Pirate allies gain 1 stack of Profit until the end of the encounter
- If there were no Galactic Legend enemies at the start of battle: If there is an enemy Sith, Pirate allies take reduced damage from percent Health effects, and whenever they target an enemy Sith with an ability, they deal 300% more damage and ignore Protection, and at the start of each Sith enemy's turn, all Pirate allies gain Foresight for 1 turn
data.LEADERABILITY_MAZKANATA_TIER_07_DESC_V2:
At the start of each encounter and if there were no Galactic Legend allies:

- All Pirate and Smuggler allies are immune to Fear and they gain Foresight for 1 turn
- Whenever Maz gains a stack of Profit, all other Pirate allies gain 1 stack of Profit until the end of the encounter
- Whenever a Pirate ally with Retribution uses a Basic ability, they ignore that enemy's Protection
- Whenever an enemy uses a Basic ability, all Pirate allies gain 5% Turn Meter
- If there were no Galactic Legend enemies at the start of battle: If there is an enemy Sith, Pirate allies take reduced damage from percent Health effects, and whenever they target an enemy Sith with an ability, they deal 300% more damage and ignore Protection, and at the start of each Sith enemy's turn, all Pirate allies gain Foresight for 1 turn

[c][E7E7E7]While in Grand Arenas and there are no Galactic Legend allies:[-][/c] Pirate and Smuggler allies gain 30% Max Health and Max Protection, and 30 Speed.

Whenever a Pirate ally scores a critical hit, they gain 5% Tenacity (stacking) until the end of encounter.

If a Pirate ally is instantly defeated by a non-Galactic Legend enemy, that enemy is Deathmarked for 1 turn, which can't be copied, dispelled, or prevented. If a Pirate ally uses an ability on their turn against an enemy with this Deathmark, they instantly defeat them.

The condition of no Galactic Legend enemies at the start of battle is removed on this ability.

[c][E7E7E7]While in Grand Arenas if there are no Galactic Legends and all allies are Bad Batch:[-][/c] Whenever an ally is damaged by Expose or by an enemy with bonus Protection, all enemies receive damage equal to 1% of their Max Health for each stack of Target Practice on all allies. This damage can't be evaded and can't defeat enemies. Stealthed allies are immune to Damage Over Time and Plague, enemies they defeat can't be revived, and they take a bonus turn whenever they are Stunned or another ally falls below 100% Health.

data.LEADERABILITY_SATELESHAN_TIER_04_DESC:

Whenever an enemy resists a debuff from Old Republic allies, inflict Tenacity Down on them for 2 turns. Whenever an enemy is inflicted with a debuff from Old Republic allies, also inflict Speed Down on them for 2 turns (once per turn).

Old Republic Jedi allies with Legendary Battle Meditation are immune to Daze. While Old Republic allies have Fearless, they are immune to Doubt.
data.LEADERABILITY_SATELESHAN_TIER_05_DESC:
Old Republic allies have +50% Max Protection and Offense, doubled for Old Republic Jedi allies. Whenever a Marked enemy damages an Old Republic ally, that ally recovers Protection equal to the damage received.

While Satele is Taunting, whenever another Old Republic ally is damaged, that ally gains High Morale for 3 turns.

Whenever an enemy resists a debuff from Old Republic allies, inflict Tenacity Down on them for 2 turns. Whenever an enemy is inflicted with a debuff from Old Republic allies, also inflict Speed Down on them for 2 turns (once per turn).

Old Republic Jedi allies with Legendary Battle Meditation are immune to Daze. Whenever an Old Republic Jedi ally ends their turn and if no other allies have Legendary Battle Meditation, allied Bastila Shan takes a bonus turn. While Old Republic allies have Fearless, they are immune to Doubt.
data.LEADERABILITY_SATELESHAN_TIER_06_DESC:
Old Republic allies have +50% Max Protection and Offense, doubled for Old Republic Jedi allies. Whenever a Marked enemy damages an Old Republic ally, that ally recovers Protection equal to the damage received.

While Satele is Taunting, whenever another Old Republic ally is damaged, that ally gains High Morale for 3 turns.

Whenever Old Republic allies attack out of turn, they reduce their cooldowns by 1. If the target enemy is Marked, reduce their cooldowns by 2 instead.

Whenever an enemy resists a debuff from Old Republic allies, inflict Tenacity Down on them for 2 turns. Whenever an enemy is inflicted with a debuff from Old Republic allies, also inflict Speed Down on them for 2 turns (once per turn).

Old Republic Jedi allies with Legendary Battle Meditation are immune to Daze. Whenever an Old Republic Jedi ally ends their turn and if no other allies have Legendary Battle Meditation, allied Bastila Shan takes a bonus turn. While Old Republic allies have Fearless, they are immune to Doubt.
data.LEADERABILITY_SATELESHAN_TIER_07_DESC:
Old Republic allies have +50% Max Protection and Offense, doubled for Old Republic Jedi allies. Whenever a Marked enemy damages an Old Republic ally, that ally recovers Protection equal to the damage received at the end of their turn.

While Satele is Taunting, whenever another Old Republic ally is damaged, that ally gains High Morale for 3 turns.

Whenever Old Republic allies attack out of turn, they reduce their cooldowns by 1. If the target enemy is Marked, reduce their cooldowns by 2 instead.

Whenever an enemy resists a debuff from Old Republic allies, inflict Tenacity Down on them for 2 turns. Whenever an enemy is inflicted with a debuff from Old Republic allies, also inflict Speed Down on them for 2 turns (once per turn). While Old Republic allies have Fearless, they are immune to Doubt.

Old Republic Jedi allies with Legendary Battle Meditation are immune to Daze. Whenever an Old Republic Jedi ally ends their turn and if no other allies have Legendary Battle Meditation, allied Bastila Shan takes a bonus turn.

data.LEADERABILITY_TRENCH_TIER_06_DESC:
Separatist allies have +30% Max Health, Max Protection, and Potency and they have +10% Speed (excludes Galactic Legend allies) for each ally with Tech and each enemy with Extortion.

Whenever a Separatist ally inflicts a debuff on an enemy, they gain 20% Offense for 3 turns (stacking, limit once per turn). While a Separatist ally has a Tech, they have +100% Potency. When a non-Geonosian Separatist ally gains Baktoid Shield Generator Tech, they dispel Stealth from themselves and while they have Baktoid Shield Generator Tech, they are immune to Stealth and gain 100% Critical Avoidance and Defense.

While a Separatist ally has a Heal Over Time, they have +30% Counter Chance, and while they have a Protection Over Time, they have +30% Defense Penetration. While an enemy has Burning, they can't assist, counter attack, or gain bonus Turn Meter.
data.LEADERABILITY_TRENCH_TIER_07_DESC:
Separatist allies have +30% Max Health, Max Protection, and Potency and they have +10% Speed (excludes Galactic Legend allies) for each ally with Tech and each enemy with Extortion.

Whenever a Separatist ally inflicts a debuff on an enemy, they gain 20% Offense for 3 turns (stacking, limit once per turn). While a Separatist ally has a Tech, they have +100% Potency. When a non-Geonosian Separatist ally gains Baktoid Shield Generator Tech, they dispel Stealth from themselves and while they have Baktoid Shield Generator Tech, they are immune to Stealth and gain 100% Critical Avoidance and Defense.

While a Separatist ally has a Heal Over Time, they have +30% Counter Chance, and while they have a Protection Over Time, they have +30% Defense Penetration. While an enemy has Burning, they can't assist, counter attack, or gain bonus Turn Meter.

[c][e7e7e7]While in Territory Wars:[-][/c] Non-Droid Separatist allies have +50% Mastery, and +75% Max Health and Max Protection. Separatist allies with Tech can't have their turn meter reduced. Enemies with Extortion will be critically hit if able.

Whenever an enemy dispels a debuff, Separatist allies gain 10% turn meter (limit once per turn). The first time each enemy is reduced below 100% Health (excluding summons), Separatist allies gain 20% Offense (stacking) and +5 Speed (stacking) until the end of the battle.

data.LEADERABILITY_TUSKENCHIEFTAIN_TIER_07_DE:
Whenever an enemy gains bonus Turn Meter, grant Tusken allies 1 stack of Momentum for 3 turns. At the end of each turn, Tusken allies gain 20% Defense and Tenacity for each stack of Momentum on them until the end of the next turn.

Whenever a Tusken ally is targeted by an enemy and they have at least 10 stacks of Momentum, remove all stacks of Momentum, Stun all attacking enemies for 1 turn, which can't be resisted, and the targeted Tusken ally takes a bonus turn. For each stack of Momentum removed this way, there is a 20% chance (+5% per Relic Amplifier level, max 50% total) to inflict a stack of Damage Over Time on each attacking enemy for 2 turns.

data.LEIAS_REBEL_RENEGADE_LIGHTSPEED_INFO:
[b]MERGE UNITS[/b]

Units included in the Lightspeed Bundle are upgraded according to a predetermined set of upgrade criteria (listed below). The Lightspeed Bundle does not directly grant character shards / ship blueprints or resources used in merge upgrades. The upgrade criteria are evaluated against your existing roster, and your units are set to the greater of the two values.

Each unit will first be evaluated for existing shards or star rarity against the bundle upgrade criteria. A unit at lower star rarity (or unactivated with less cumulative shards/blueprints) than the bundle upgrade criteria will be upgraded and activated. Units that exceed the star rarity (or cumulative shards/blueprints) will be activated (if unactivated) and then evaluated for additional attributes (gear tier, ability tier, etc). Any surplus shards/blueprints over the bundle upgrade criteria will be retained.

If your previously unlocked units meet or exceed the bundle upgrade criteria for other attributes, any surplus value will be retained.

[b]CHARACTERS[/b]
- 7 Stars
- Level 85
- Relic Level 7
- Ability Tier 7

data.LORD_OF_THE_SITH_LIGHTSPEED_INFO:
[c][F0FF23]MERGE UNITS[-][/c]

Units included in the Lightspeed Bundle are upgraded according to a predetermined set of upgrade criteria (listed below). The Lightspeed Bundle does not directly grant character shards / ship blueprints or resources used in merge upgrades. The upgrade criteria are evaluated against your existing roster, and your units are set to the greater of the two values.

Each unit will first be evaluated for existing shards or star rarity against the bundle upgrade criteria. A unit at lower star rarity (or unactivated with less cumulative shards/blueprints) than the bundle upgrade criteria will be upgraded and activated. Units that exceed the star rarity (or cumulative shards/blueprints) will be activated (if unactivated) and then evaluated for additional attributes (gear tier, ability tier, etc). Any surplus shards/blueprints over the bundle upgrade criteria will be retained.

If your previously unlocked units meet or exceed the bundle upgrade criteria for other attributes, any surplus value will be retained.

[b]CHARACTERS[/b]
- 7 Stars
- Level 85
- Relic Level 7
- Ability Tier 7

[b]SHIP[/b]
- 7 Stars
- Level 85
- Ability Tier 7

data.MANDALORBOKATAN_GUIDE_DESCRIPTION: Dissident by choice, leader by nature, Bo-Katan Kryze has always put the Mandalorian people and heritage first. After the Clone Wars, Bo-Katan served as intermittent leader of the Mandalorians until the Night of a Thousand Tears, during which she surrendered control of the planet, and the Darksaber, to Moff Gideon – a choice that would haunt her for years to come. She later joined forces with Din Djarin and Grogu, fighting to reunite the Mandalorian clans. Though the Darksaber was destroyed in a final confrontation with Moff Gideon, the clans recognized Bo-Katan as Mand'alor with the reignition of the Great Forge.

Unleash the power of [b]The Mandalorian (Beskar Armor)[/b] now and upgrade The Mandalorian, IG-11, Cara Dune, Kuiil, and Greef Karga to 7-stars AND Relic 5! Each offer propels your units forward, granting you immediate access to The Mandalorian (Beskar Armor)'s event!

Purchase limit: 1
data.MANDALORIAN_BESKAR_LIGHTSPEED_BUNDLE_INF:
[c][F0FF23]MERGE UNITS[-][/c]

Units included in the Lightspeed Bundle are upgraded according to a predetermined set of upgrade criteria (listed below). The Lightspeed Bundle does not directly grant character shards / ship blueprints or resources used in merge upgrades. The upgrade criteria are evaluated against your existing roster, and your units are set to the greater of the two values.

Each unit will first be evaluated for existing shards or star rarity against the bundle upgrade criteria. A unit at lower star rarity (or unactivated with less cumulative shards/blueprints) than the bundle upgrade criteria will be upgraded and activated. Units that exceed the star rarity (or cumulative shards/blueprints) will be activated (if unactivated) and then evaluated for additional attributes (gear tier, ability tier, etc). Any surplus shards/blueprints over the bundle upgrade criteria will be retained.

If your previously unlocked units meet or exceed the bundle upgrade criteria for other attributes, any surplus value will be retained.

[c][AFFFFFFF]CHARACTERS[-][/c]

- 7 Stars
- Level 85
- Relic Level 5
- Ability Tier 7

data.MANDALORIAN_CONSUMABLE_OVERCHARGED_DESC_:
Whenever a Mandalorian ally takes damage, all Mandalorian allies gain a stack of [c][FFFF33]Clan Loyalty[-][/c], which can't be copied, dispelled, or prevented. If there is exactly one non-Mandalorian ally at the start of battle, that ally also gains [c][FFFF33]Clan Loyalty[-][/c] if they are not in the Leader slot. Allies with [c][FFFF33]Clan Loyalty[-][/c] have a 50% chance to assist when another ally attacks during an enemy's turn (limit once per turn), dealing 95% less damage.

[c][FFFF33]Clan Loyalty:[-][/c] +1% Max Protection and counter chance, -1% damage penalty when assisting
Max Duration: 1 battle

data.MAP_GEONOSIS_DESC: Geonosis is a desert world and home to the insectoid Geonosians. During the twilight of the Galactic Republic, this planet was one of the first to join the Confederacy of Independent Systems. Geonosis housed great droid factories and the Battle of Geonosis was the first major conflict of the Clone Wars.
data.MAP_HOTH_DESC: Hoth is an ice world in a remote sector of the Outer Rim. After the Battle of Yavin, the Rebel Alliance established a hidden base there. Their stay was cut short when they were discovered by an Imperial probe droid, thereby triggering the Battle of Hoth.
data.MAP_TATOOINE_DESC: A desert world in the binary Tatoo star system within the Anoat sector.\n\nHome planet of both Anakin and Luke Skywalker.

data.MASTER_KENOBI_LIGHTSPEED_I_INFO:
[c][F0FF23]MERGE UNITS[-][/c]

Units included in the Lightspeed Bundle are upgraded according to a predetermined set of upgrade criteria (listed below). The Lightspeed Bundle does not directly grant character shards / ship blueprints or resources used in merge upgrades. The upgrade criteria are evaluated against your existing roster, and your units are set to the greater of the two values.

Each unit will first be evaluated for existing shards or star rarity against the bundle upgrade criteria. A unit at lower star rarity (or unactivated with less cumulative shards/blueprints) than the bundle upgrade criteria will be upgraded and activated. Units that exceed the star rarity (or cumulative shards/blueprints) will be activated (if unactivated) and then evaluated for additional attributes (gear tier, ability tier, etc). Any surplus shards/blueprints over the bundle upgrade criteria will be retained.

If your previously unlocked units meet or exceed the bundle upgrade criteria for other attributes, any surplus value will be retained.

[b]CHARACTERS[/b]
- 7 Stars
- Level 85
- Relic Level 5
- Ability Tier 7

data.MAY4TH_ALL_DOUBLE_DROP_DAY_DESC:
Greetings, 

Happy May the 4th! Today’s rewards will be doubled (excluding XP, Crystals and first time rewards) for all Galactic War Chests, Light Side Hard battles, Dark Side Hard battles, and Squad Cantina battles. 

Double drops will end May 5th between 9:30 – 10:30AM PST.
data.MAY4TH_CANTINA_DOUBLE_DROP_DAY_DESC:
Greetings, 

May the 4th is almost here! We’re celebrating this special Star Wars ™ holiday by doubling rewards from different game modes every day between April 30th and May 5th. 

Today, rewards (excluding XP, Crystals and first time rewards) will be DOUBLED from all Squad Cantina Battles. This includes Credits, Ability Materials, Training Droids, Sim Tickets, Cantina Credits and character Shards! 

Check back tomorrow to see which game mode will be the next to offer double rewards. Double drops will switch between 9:30 – 10:30AM PST every day.

data.MILLENNIUMFALCON_GUIDE_DESCRIPTION: She may not look like much, but you would be hard-pressed to find a more legendary ship than Han’s Millennium Falcon, which has eluded Star Destroyers, bested Darth Vader, and destroyed a Death Star -- all with a somewhat unpredictable hyperdrive. The Falcon is a Rebel Attacker that strengthens Home One and the Rebel fleet as a whole by enabling relentless assist calls. Piloted by Han Solo and Chewbacca, the Falcon also Outmaneuvers its enemies with extra Evasion, and can't be targeted while other allies are present.

data.MISSION_BATTLE_FOR_MANDALORE_TIER01_DESC:
[c][23C8F5]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]
- Grogu can't gain Turn Meter, or be damaged, debuffed, or defeated.
- Grogu is not obtainable and can't be used in any other event or game mode.
- The 501st Veteran will sacrifice everything to protect his team; removing him from the field will be crucial to your success.
- Be cautious of the 501st Captain's high damage potential.
- The Dark Side clouds everything and all Jedi will lose Foresight when Clone Troopers use their abilities.
data.MISSION_BATTLE_FOR_MANDALORE_TIER02_DESC:
[c][23C8F5]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]
- The Weequay Pirates will stealth frequently; defeat them quickly when the opportunity arises.
- The Nikto Bruisers and Nikto Thugs will heal and assist each other, so thinning their ranks will ease the battle.
data.MISSION_BATTLE_FOR_MANDALORE_TIER03_DESC:
[c][23C8F5]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]
- IG-12 & Grogu or The Mandalorian (Beskar Armor) being defeated will result in immediate loss.
- The Granted ability, [c][FFFF33]Lower the Gate, Arfive[-][/c], allows all allies to fully recover their Health and Protection, gain 100% Turn Meter, and reset their cooldowns.
- However, using Lower the Gate, Arfive, before The Mandalorian (Beskar Armor) completes his fifth turn while fighting against Imperial Armored Commando - Wave 1 and Wave 3 will increase the Max Health, Max Protection, and Offense by 40% per remaining turn for the Imperial Armored Commando - Wave 2 and Wave 4 respectively.
data.MISSION_BATTLE_FOR_MANDALORE_TIER04_DESC:
[c][23C8F5]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]
- Bo-Katan (Mand'alor) will be loaned to you for this tier.
- Bo-Katan (Mand'alor), IG-12 & Grogu, or The Mandalorian (Beskar Armor) being defeated will result in immediate loss.
- Dark Trooper Moff Gideon can only receive True damage unless he is inflicted with Armor Shred, then any damage type will work.
- Dark Trooper Moff Gideon is immune to Ability Block and whenever he uses a Special ability, he removes Armor Shred, dispels all debuffs on himself, and uses his Basic ability.

data.MISSION_CLASH_ON_KAMINO_TIER01_DESC_V3:
[c][ACFEFF][c][23C8F5]Required:[-][/c]
7-Star, 40,000+ Power
- Anakin's Eta-2 Starfighter
(See [c][F0FF23]note[-][/c] below)
- Galactic Republic Capital Ship
- Galactic Republic Ships

[c][23C8F5]Recommended:[-][/c]
- 50,000+ Power
- Crew Relic Level 3
- Crew Mods rarity Mk VI

[c][23C8F5]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]
- The Soulless One will inflict [c][F0FF23]Marked[-][/c] on the weakest other Droid ally at the start of each ship's turn, making itself difficult to target.
- Use [c][F0FF23]Taunt[-][/c] effectively in order to weather the storm of Buzz Droids from enemy Vulture Droids.
- Make effective use of attacks that damage all enemies to avoid being overwhelmed.

[c][F0FF23]Note:[-][/c] Anakin's Delta-7B Starfighter will replace your version of Anakin's Eta-2 Starfighter in this battle.
- This version of Anakin's Delta-7b has the same abilities as Anakin's Eta-2 and will inherit its stats from the version of Anakin's Eta-2 you bring into battle.
- This ship is not obtainable and can't be used in any other event or game mode.[-][/c]
data.MISSION_CLASH_ON_KAMINO_TIER02_DESC_V4:
[c][ACFEFF][c][23C8F5]Required:[-][/c]
7-Star, 17,700+ Power
- Ahsoka Tano (Snips)
- C-3PO
- General Kenobi
- Padmé Amidala
- Shaak Ti

[c][23C8F5]Recommended:[-][/c]
- 22,000+ Power
- Relic Level 3
- Mods rarity Mk VI
- Zeta ability upgrades

[c][23C8F5]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]
- General Grievous can't be targeted until both Droidekas have been defeated.
- While the Droidekas' shields are active, they have [c][F0FF23]Damage Immunity[-][/c].
- Defeat IG-100 MagnaGuards in order to drop the Droidekas' shields, allowing your squad to damage and defeat them. New MagnaGuards will appear when the Droidekas redeploy their shields.
- Defeating the Droidekas efficiently will be key to victory; the longer the fight goes on, the more Max Health Grievous gains from his Unique ability.[-][/c]
data.MISSION_CLASH_ON_KAMINO_TIER03_DESC_V2:
[c][ACFEFF][c][23C8F5]Borrowed:[-][/c]
- General Skywalker

[c][23C8F5]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]
- General Skywalker's Special abilities work in tandem. Use these combinations to maintain an edge over Asajj Ventress in this one-on-one duel.[-][/c]
data.MISSION_CLASH_ON_KAMINO_TIER04_DESC_V3:
[c][ACFEFF][c][23C8F5]Required:[-][/c]
7-Star, 17,700+ Power
- Asajj Ventress
- B1 Battle Droid
- B2 Super Battle Droid
- Droideka
- IG-100 MagnaGuard

[c][23C8F5]Recommended:[-][/c]
- 22,000+ Power
- Relic Level 3
- Mods rarity Mk VI
- Zeta ability upgrades

[c][23C8F5]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]
- The 501st Clone Troopers can't lose Health while General Skywalker is [c][F0FF23]Advancing[-][/c], but they can lose Protection.
- General Skywalker and the 501st can punish attacks from your squad that damage all enemies; use these attacks wisely.
- Determining the best order of defeating the clones when General Skywalker is in [c][F0FF23]Cover[-][/c] is key to victory.[-][/c]

data.MISSION_EVENT_HEROJOURNEY_JEDIKNIGHTREVA:
[c][ACFEFF][c][23C8F5]Requirements:[-][/c]
- Mission Vao (2-stars),
- Zaalbar (2-stars)

[c][23C8F5]Recommended Gear Level:[-][/c] 6+

Stranded on the Sith-occupied world of Taris, Revan teamed up with the street-smart Mission Vao and her friend Zaalbar. Together they embarked on a mission to rescue a captive Jedi, but before they could reach her, a fearsome foe barred their way.[-][/c]

[c][ACFEFF][c][23C8F5]Requirements:[-][/c]
- Mission Vao (3-stars),
- Zaalbar (3-stars),
- Bastila Shan (3-stars)

[c][23C8F5]Recommended Gear Level:[-][/c] 6+

After defeating the Rancor, Revan and the companions found the criminals that had abducted the Jedi Bastila Shan. Before Revan could free her, Bastila escaped from her captors. Together they faced the gangs that had held her.[-][/c]

[c][ACFEFF][c][23C8F5]Requirements:[-][/c]
- Mission Vao (4-stars),
- Zaalbar (4-stars),
- Bastila Shan (4-stars),
- T3-M4 (4-stars)

[c][23C8F5]Recommended Gear Level:[-][/c] 7+

After acquiring a modified droid named T3-M4, Revan and the companions infiltrated a Sith base on Taris. There, they hoped to steal the codes necessary to escape the planet. But first they would have to face the forces stationed within the base.[-][/c]

[c][ACFEFF][c][23C8F5]Requirements:[-][/c]
- Mission Vao (5-stars),
- Zaalbar (5-stars),
- Bastila Shan (5-stars),
- T3-M4 (5-stars),
- Jolee Bindo (5-stars)

[c][23C8F5]Recommended Gear Level:[-][/c] 7+

Joined by the Jedi Jolee Bindo, Revan and the companions wound up on Tatooine. There a group of miners were being attacked by the native Sand People. Faced with the choice of defending the defenseless or letting them be taken captive, Revan moved to face the Sand People aggressors.[-][/c]

[c][ACFEFF][c][23C8F5]Requirements:[-][/c]
- Mission Vao (6-stars),
- Zaalbar (6-stars),
- Bastila Shan (6-stars),
- T3-M4 (6-stars),
- Jolee Bindo (6-stars)

[c][23C8F5]Recommended Gear Level:[-][/c] 8+

On the Sith world of Korriban, Revan heard stories of the tomb of an ancient Sith Lord. Within were said to be dark secrets and a terrible evil, so the Sith of Korriban sought to plunder the tomb for themselves. Revan resolved to explore the tomb, not knowing that deep within would lie a great test...[-][/c]

[c][ACFEFF][c][23C8F5]Requirements:[-][/c]
- Mission Vao (7-stars),
- Zaalbar (7-stars),
- Bastila Shan (7-stars),
- T3-M4 (7-stars),
- Jolee Bindo (7-stars)

[c][23C8F5]Recommended Gear Level:[-][/c] 9+

After defeating the Sith that sought to plunder the tomb, Revan turned to leave the dark place behind. However the fierce battle between force users had attracted something evil and hungry...[-][/c]

Having successfully escaped Taris, Revan's team made for Dantooine. In a hidden Jedi Enclave there, Revan was retrained in the ways of the Force. As a test, the Jedi Masters sent Revan out to find a Padawan who was in danger of falling to the dark side.[-][/c]

After much effort, Revan's team managed to find what they had been searching for: a fragment of a lost galactic Star Map. But as they exited the cave of the krayt dragon, they ran into the bounty hunter Calo Nord, who had been hired to stop them.[-][/c]

During their journey, Bastila had been abducted by Revan's nemesis, Darth Malak. Unable to endure the endless torment, Bastila was broken and fell to the dark side. Revan and the Jedi companions sought to tie up this loose end and potentially regain their useful ally.[-][/c]

The stage was set. Revan had journeyed across the galaxy and recovered all the fragments of the ancient Star Map. Before traveling to the Sith's secret weapon, the star forge, and facing Darth Malak, Revan knew a final battle was coming. Jedi fools and the other loyalists to the Republic would either have to be turned to the dark side… or crushed by its power.[-][/c]
data.MISSION_EVENT_JOURNEY_JEDIKNIGHTCAL_TIER:
[c][ACFEFF][c][23C8F5]Required:[-][/c]
Cal Kestis (Gear XII+)

The Inquisitors investigate Bracca where they find Cal Kestis, a Jedi Padawan in hiding.

[c][23C8F5]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]
- Use the granted ability [c][ffff33]Dodge Roll[-][/c] to remove all stacks of Purge
- At the start of Second Sister's turn Cal gains a stack of Purge
- Second Sister begins the battle with 100% Turn Meter[c][F0FF23]

[c][ACFEFF][c][23C8F5]Required:[-][/c]
Cal Kestis (Gear XII+)
Saw Gerrera (Gear XII+)
Tarfful (Gear XII+)

[c][23C8F5]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]
- Use the granted ability [c][ffff33]Quick Parry[-][/c] to avoid damage and counter attack, stunning the attacker
- If Cal is defeated the battle ends in defeat[c][F0FF23]

[c][ACFEFF][c][23C8F5]Required:[-][/c]
Cal Kestis (Gear XII+)

Cal searches Zeffo for clues to opening the ancient vault.

[c][23C8F5]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]
- Cal has the granted abilities [c][ffff33]Dodge Roll[-][/c] and [c][ffff33]Quick Parry[-][/c]
- Cal begins the final battle with 4 stacks of Purge and at the start of Second Sister's turn gains a stack of Purge
Second Sister is immune to Stun
- Tomb Guardian can only be defeated while Stunned[c][F0FF23]

The Rebels' Echo Base has been struck by the Empire and is being invaded by troopers. Vader is somewhere in the base, and the group must escape before he finds them!

[c][23C8F5]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]
- Each time an enemy takes a turn, Vader gets closer to entering the battle.[-][/c]

[c][ACFEFF][c][23C8F5]Required:[-][/c]
7-Star
- ANY Capital Ship (see [c][F0FF23]note[-][/c] below)
- Han's Millennium Falcon
- Wedge Antilles's X-wing

[c][23C8F5]Recommended:[-][/c]
- Crew Relic Level 5
- Crew Mods rarity Mk VI
- Crew Zeta ability upgrades
- Fully upgraded ships

After escaping Hoth on the Millennium Falcon, Luke's friends attempt to evade the Imperial Fleet through hyperspace.

[c][23C8F5]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]
- Jump to hyperspace with all of your ships as soon as you can.
- Han's Millennium Falcon will not be able to activate the [c][F0FF23]Jump to Hyperspace[-][/c] ability until it's the last ship on your side.
- If any allied ship is defeated it will end the battle as a loss.

[c][F0FF23]Note:[-][/c] A GR-75 and Rebel Y-wing will be granted to you in this tier. The GR-75 replaces your Capital Ship, is not obtainable, and can't be used in any other event or game mode.[-][/c]

[c][F0FF23]Note:[-][/c] Rebel Officer Leia Organa will have her name and appearance altered for this battle. Chewbacca & C-3PO are required for this tier but will not be used in battle. They will be replaced by another character whose stats are scaled based on Chewbacca's stats, including mods.[-][/c]

[c][ACFEFF][c][23C8F5]Required:[-][/c]

- Gear level V+
- Ability upgrades level 2+

The Mandalorian's search for his bounty leads him to the planet of Arvala-7 where he confronts a group of thugs with some assistance from the bounty hunter droid, IG-11.

[c][23C8F5]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]
- IG-11's Speed stat is doubled in this battle.
- Careful use of IG-11's abilities will help you control the battlefield.
- If the Mandalorian is defeated it will end the battle as a loss.

[c][F0FF23]Note:[-][/c] IG-11 will have his name and appearance altered for this battle. IG-11's special ability, [c][F0FF23]Nurse Droid Protocol[-][/c], will be replaced with a different ability that scales based on your IG-11's [c][F0FF23]Nurse Droid Protocol[-][/c] investment. IG-11 will not have access to his unique ability, [c][F0FF23]Child's Favor[-][/c], in this tier. This character is not obtainable and can't be used in any other event or game mode.[-][/c]

[c][F0FF23]Note:[-][/c] The Mandalorian will have his name and appearance altered for this battle. This character is not obtainable and can't be used in any other event or game mode.[-][/c]

[c][F0FF23]Note:[-][/c] The Mandalorian will have his name and appearance altered for this battle. His special ability, [c][F0FF23]Wonder of the Force[-][/c], will be maxed out in this tier and will not start on cooldown.[-][/c]

[c][23C8F5]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]
- The enemy will utilize powerful attacks after Spotting your units.
- If any allied character is defeated it will end the battle as a loss.

[c][F0FF23]Note:[-][/c] The Mandalorian will have his name and appearance altered for this battle. These characters are not obtainable and can't be used in any other event or game mode.[-][/c]

As the threat of Imperial power continues to escalate on Nevarro, Kuiil attempts to fend off Imperial Troopers and protect his charge.

[c][23C8F5]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]
- [c][FFFF33]Devoted Protector[-][/c] is a granted ability given to Kuiil during this battle.
- Prioritize Potency for your Kuiil to inflict more debuffs.
- Inflicting debuffs lowers the cooldown of [c][FFFF33]Devoted Protector[-][/c].[-][/c]

- Mods rarity Mk V+

The Mandalorian makes his stand alongside his allies as Moff Gideon and his Imperial forces close in for the kill.

[c][23C8F5]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]
- Try to always have a [c][F0FF23]Taunt[-][/c] active during Moff Gideons turn.
- Moff Gideon will summon Stormtroopers at the end of his turn.
- Your victory is achieved when Moff Gideon reaches 1% Health.
- If the Mandalorian is defeated it will end the battle as a loss.

[c][F0FF23]Note:[-][/c] The Mandalorian will have his name and appearance altered for this battle. His special ability, [c][F0FF23]Wonder of the Force[-][/c], will be maxed out in this tier and will not start on cooldown. Greef Karga will have both of his Special abilities altered for this battle. This character is not obtainable and can't be used in any other event or game mode.[-][/c]

Requires 7-star. 

[c]-Strategy Tips:[/c] Remember to inflict [c][f0ff23]DAZE[-][/c] to stop enemies from assisting, gaining bonus turn meter, or counter attacking.

data.MISSION_GUILDRAIDS_KRAYTDRAGON_DETAIL_DE: [23c8f5]Tusken nomads tell tales to their children of the legendary Krayt Dragon of Tatooine, which swims through the dunes of the desert as if they were water. It's cavernous gullet and acidic venom have been the end of many moisture farmers, Jawas, and Tuskens alike.\n\nHero Units: The Mandalorian (Beskar Armor)[-]
data.MISSION_GUILDRAIDS_NABOO_DETAIL_DESC_V2: The Trade Federation has landed its armies on the peaceful planet of Naboo. Engage their forces both on land and in space as you weather the seemingly endless hordes of droid combatants. Making the correct tactical decisions is key to buying your fighters enough time to destroy the Droid Control Ship and seize victory.
data.MISSION_GUILDRAIDS_ORDER66_DETAIL_DESC_V: Operation Knightfall has commenced and Lord Vader has begun his extermination of the Jedi. Fight through the Dark Side Clone Troopers blocking your path. Attempt to interrupt his onslaught before Order 66 is completed.
data.MISSION_GUILDRAIDS_SPEEDERBIKE_DETAIL_DE: Two of the Empire's elite Scout Troopers evade their enemies at breakneck speed through the forests of Endor. They throw caution to the wind as they weather your forces' attempts to damage, distract, and sideswipe them. The Scout Troopers will attempt to call powerful allies to help shake you off their tails, so you'll need to jam their comlinks to weaken these reinforcements.
