data.MODIFIER_ABILITY_MED_STATION_DESC: At the start of battle, all characters are inflicted with a stack of [c][FFFF33]Brain Worms[-][/c] until the end of battle, which can't be dispelled or prevented, and gain the granted ability [c][FFFF33]Brain Freeze[-][/c].\n\n[c][FFFF33]Brain Worms:[-][/c] Lose 5% Health per stack at the start of turn; is immune to allied dispels; this damage ignores Protection; inflict a stack of Brain Worms on target enemy when this character uses a Special ability, which can't be prevented
data.MODIFIER_ABILITY_REST_DESC_V2: Remove two stacks of Overheat and Frostbite from target ally. (Cooldown:3)
data.MODIFIER_ABILITY_SHATTER_EARTH_DESC: Deal Physical damage to all enemies and inflict Stagger for 2 turns.
data.MODIFIER_ACTIVATETHEEDROIDS_DESC:
At the start of battle and when summoned, the allied leader gains a random team modifier. The allied leader can't be defeated while there are other active allies. Whenever all allies have been defeated, summon 4 B1 Battle Droids and an OOM Command Droid. Allies summon with +2% Defense, Max Health, Max Protection, Offense, and Speed for each previously defeated ally.

All enemies gain the granted ability Get Out Of Here.

[c][ffff33]Get Out of Here:[-][/c] End the battle. Gain a star for every 20 enemies defeated. If less than 20 enemies have been defeated, the battle ends in defeat.
data.MODIFIER_BADBATCH_DESC:
Whenever a Stealthed Bad Batch ally attacks out of turn, they dispel all debuffs on themselves and Blind target enemy for 1 turn. Whenever a non-Stealthed Bad Batch ally attacks out of turn, they gain Health Up, Potency Up, and Protection Up (50%) for 2 turns.

Whenever an enemy has a buff dispelled, they take damage equal to 5% of their Max Health per buff dispelled. This damage can't defeat them.

Whenever a Bad Batch ally is rescued, their cooldowns are refreshed and they take a bonus turn. During this turn, they deal Massive damage to target enemy.
data.MODIFIER_BESPIN_DESC_V2:
At the start of the battle, all characters have their Accuracy reduced by 15%.

Gain a stack of [c][FFFF33]Collected Wealth[-][/c] whenever a character damages an enemy. This effect can't be copied, dispelled, or prevented. Lose all stacks of Collected Wealth when damaged.

[c] [F0FF23]Collected Wealth:[-][/c] +10% Critical Chance and Critical Damage (stacking, max 10)
data.MODIFIER_BESPIN_SPACE_DESC: Player: At the start of battle, target ally gains Stealth for 2 turns and [c][FFFF33]Contraband[-][/c] which can't be copied, dispelled, or prevented.\n\n[c][FFFF33]Contraband:[-][/c] Disable Protection and increase Speed by 35; If this ship is defeated, the battle ends in defeat
data.MODIFIER_BESPIN_SPACE_GRANTED_ABILITY_DE: Disable Protection and increase Speed by 35; if this ship is defeated, the battle ends in defeat
data.MODIFIER_BOUNTYHUNTER_DESC_V2: All Bounty Hunter allies gain 9 stacks of [c][FFFF33]True Defense[-][/c] at the start of battle, which can't be copied, dispelled, or prevented. Whenever a Bounty Hunter gains their payout, they also gain Frenzy for 1 turn, 100% increased damage, and their cooldowns are reset.\n\n[c][FFFF33]True Defense:[-][/c] 10% reduced damage taken per stack; lose one stack of True Defense when receiving damage
data.MODIFIER_BOUNTYHUNTER_SHIPS_DESC: All Bounty Hunter allies deal 10% more damage to debuffed enemies and gain 25% turn meter whenever you attack a debuffed enemy.
data.MODIFIER_BRACCA_SHIPS_DESC: The first time a ship is reduced to 1% Health (excluding summoned ships), it recovers 100% Health and Protection, and gains [c][FFFF33]Decommissioned[-][/c] until the end of the encounter, which can't be dispelled or prevented. If a ship is inflicted with Decommissioned at the start of its turn, it is destroyed, and all other allies gain 20% Max Health, Max Protection, and Offense (stacking) until the end of the encounter.\n\n[c][FFFF33]Decommissioned:[-][/c] -50% Speed; can't assist, counter attack, gain bonus Turn Meter or buffs
data.MODIFIER_CLONETROOPER_DESC_V3: Whenever a Clone Trooper gains a buff that can be dispelled, they also gain a stack of [c][FFFF33]Dauntless Courage[-][/c] until the end of battle, which can't be copied or dispelled.\n\n[c][FFFF33]Dauntless Courage:[-][/c] +5% Offense, Critical Chance, Critical Damage, and +1% Health Steal
data.MODIFIER_CORELLIA_DESC: At the start of battle, a random enemy gains Coaxium, which can't be prevented or dispelled. Whenever a character with Coaxium is attacked, the attacking character gains Coaxium.\n\n[c][ffff33]Coaxium:[-][/c] +25% Critical Damage and Speed; -15% Accuracy; will be critically hit if able; enemies can ignore Taunt to target this character; if this character is defeated by a status effect, Coaxium will not be granted to anyone
data.MODIFIER_CORELLIA_SPACE_DESC: At the beginning of battle, each side summons a random Corellian Engineering Cargo Ship. At the start of their turn, Cargo Ships gain Protection Over Time (10%) for 1 turn.
data.MODIFIER_CORUSCANT_DESC: Defeating the enemy Leader wins the battle. When your Leader is defeated, you lose the battle.
data.MODIFIER_CORUSCANT_SHIPS_DESC: At the start of battle, a random ship is inflicted with Marked until they take damage. Whenever a ship inflicted with Marked is attacked, (except by true damage and the enemy Capital Ship,) it loses Marked, and the attacking ship is inflicted with Marked until they take damage. The attacking ship also gains 10% Offense (stacking, max 200%), and if they critically hit the Marked target, they gain 10% Critical Damage (stacking, max 200%).\n\nMarked ships have -50% Defense and +50% Offense. Ships with Taunt have +50% Defense and -50% Offense. Whenever a ship with Taunt is attacked, they lose 10% Defense.
data.MODIFIER_CORUSCANT_SHIPS_NAME: This is Where the Fun Begins
data.MODIFIER_CORUSCANT_V2_DESC_V2: All characters (excluding summons) gain the [c][ffff33]Democracy[-][/c] granted ability which starts at 0%. Whenever an ally gains a buff or inflicts a debuff on an enemy, increase all ally's energy by 5%. At the start of the encounter, both Leaders gain 100% Potency and Tenacity, 100 Speed, and are immune to Fear. The enemy leader is immune to destroy effects and can't fall below 1% Health while an ally is present. Energy is reset at the start of each encounter.
data.MODIFIER_CORUSCANT_V2_GRANTEDABILITY_DES:
Set Democracy's charge to 0% for all allies. Inflict 1 stack of [c][ffff33]No Confidence[-][/c] on the enemy Leader, which can't be copied, dispelled, or prevented, and Stun them for 1 turn, which can't be evaded or resisted. When the enemy Leader reaches 3 stacks of No Confidence, they are instantly defeated (including Galactic Legends), all allies no longer gain charge, and all allies (excluding summons) gain [c][ffff33]Thunderous Applause[-][/c] for the rest of the encounter, which can't be copied, dispelled, or prevented.

[c][ffff33]Thunderous Applause:[-][/c] When this character uses a Special ability, all other allies with this buff assist

[c][ffff33]No Confidence:[-][/c] -50% Potency and Tenacity, and -50 Speed per stack
data.MODIFIER_DATHOMIR_DESC: Every 10 turns, all defeated characters are revived at 50% Health.
data.MODIFIER_DEATHSTAR_DESC_V4: At the start of battle all units (excluding summoned allies) gain the [c][ffff33]Superlaser Blast[-][/c] ability which starts at 0% energy.
data.MODIFIER_DEATHSTAR_GRANTEDABILITY_DESC: When a unit with this ability starts their turn, this ability gains 5% energy. Units with this ability deal increased damage equal to the amount of energy present. If this ability is fully energized at the start of a unit's turn, they may activate it to expend all energy and destroy target enemy, which can't be evaded. Units defeated by this ability can't be revived.
data.MODIFIER_DEATHSTAR_SHIPS_DESC: The cooldown of Call Reinforcement on both Capital Ships is reduced by 1. Whenever a Light Side unit is reinforced, they gain [c][ffff33]Dramatic Entrance[-][/c] for 2 turns, which can't be prevented or dispelled, and inflict Offense Down on target enemy for 2 turns. Whenever a Dark Side unit is reinforced, they gain [c][ffff33]Outmaneuver[-][/c] for 2 turns, which can't be copied, and inflict Evasion Down on target enemy for 2 turns.
data.MODIFIER_DESTROYED_DEATHSTAR_DESC: At the start of battle, all characters (excluding summoned allies) gain 10 stacks of [c][FFFF33]Unstable Energy[-][/c] for the rest of the encounter. When a character reaches 0 or 30 stacks of Unstable Energy, deal 85% Max Health and 100% Max Protection damage to that character, which can't be evaded, and that character gains 10 stacks of Unstable Energy. This damage can't defeat characters.\n\n[c][FFFF33]Unstable Energy:[-][/c] Gain 1 stack whenever this character gains a buff; lose 3 stacks at the end of turn
data.MODIFIER_DROID_DESC: Droid allies have +30% Offense. Whenever a Droid ally scores a critical hit during their turn, they inflict Target Lock on target enemy for 2 turns if that enemy didn't already have it. Whenever a Droid ally damages an enemy with Target Lock, that ally recovers 10% Protection.
data.MODIFIER_DROID_DESC_SHIPS: Droid allies have +10% Offense. Whenever a Droid ally scores a critical hit during their turn, they inflict Target Lock on target enemy for 2 turns if that enemy didn't already have it. Whenever a Droid ally damages an enemy with Target Lock, that ally recovers 10% Protection.
data.MODIFIER_EMPIRE_DESC_V2: If there is an Empire ally in the Leader slot, they gain +30% Max Health and Max Protection. Whenever an Empire ally in the Leader slot uses a Special ability during their turn, all Empire allies increase the damage they deal by 10% until the end of the encounter, and then all other Empire allies are called to assist.\n\nIf no summon is present at the start of the encounter, summon a Snowtrooper Operative if the ally slot is available.
data.MODIFIER_EMPIRE_SHIPS_DESC_V2: Whenever an Empire capital ship uses a Special ability (except Call Reinforcement) during their turn, all active Empire allies gain 10% Offense (stacking) until the end of the encounter. Whenever an Empire ally is defeated, reduce cooldown of Call Reinforcement on allied Capital Ship by 1.
data.MODIFIER_EMPIRE_V2_DESC_V3: If there is an Empire ally in the Leader slot, they gain 30% Max Health and Max Protection, and the strongest ally Taunts for 2 turns at the start of the encounter. Whenever an Empire ally (excluding summons) uses a Special Ability during their turn, all Empire allies increase the damage they deal by 10% until the end of the encounter, and then all other Empire allies are called to assist. Whenever an Empire ally (excluding summons) attacks on their turn, if there is an active Empire ally, summon an Imperial Probe Droid with Taunt for 1 turn if the allied slot is available.
data.MODIFIER_ENDOR_DESC:
All characters gain the [c][FFFF33]Rally the Tribe[-][/c] ability.

[c][FFFF33]Rally the Tribe:[-][/c] Each ally gains an effect based on this character's role. This ability is on a shared cooldown between all allies and is immune to cooldown manipulation (Cooldown: 8).

[c][B5E7F5]- Attacker:[-][/c] All allies gain Defense Penetration Up for 2 turns and assist dealing 50% less damage
[c][B5E7F5]- Healer or Support:[-][/c] All allies gain Protection Over Time (20%) for 2 turns and 30% Turn Meter
[c][B5E7F5]- Tank:[-][/c] All allies gain Critical Hit Immunity and Foresight for 2 turns; Tanks Taunt for 2 turns
data.MODIFIER_ENDOR_GRANTED_ABILITY_DESC:
Each ally gains an effect based on this character's role. This ability is on a shared cooldown between all allies and is immune to cooldown manipulation (Cooldown: 8).

[c][B5E7F5]- Attacker:[-][/c] All allies gain Defense Penetration Up for 2 turns and assist dealing 50% less damage
[c][B5E7F5]- Healer or Support:[-][/c] All allies gain Protection Over Time (20%) for 2 turns and 30% Turn Meter
[c][B5E7F5]- Tank:[-][/c] All allies gain Critical Hit Immunity and Foresight for 2 turns; Tanks Taunt for 2 turns
data.MODIFIER_EWOK_DESC: Ewok allies have +50% Counter Chance and +20% Speed. Whenever an enemy targets an Ewok ally while attacking out of turn, that enemy is Stunned for 1 turn at the end of the turn (limit once per turn per enemy), which can't be evaded or resisted.
data.MODIFIER_EXTREMIST_DESC: Whenever an ally is defeated, the allied leader takes a bonus turn. At the start of the allied leader's bonus turn, inflict 5 stacks of Explosive trap on all enemies.
data.MODIFIER_FELUCIA_DESC: At the start of each character's turn, they gain Heal Over Time (10%) for 2 turns. While a character has Heal Over Time, they have +25% Defense and are immune to Buff Immunity. Whenever a Heal Over Time expires, the character gains Offense Up for 1 turn. Recovery effects are increased by 20%.
data.MODIFIER_FELUCIA_SHIPS_DESC: At the start of each ship's turn, they gain Protection Over Time (10%) for 1 turn. While a ship has Protection Over Time, they have +25% Defense and are immune to Buff Immunity. Whenever a Protection Over Time expires, the character gains Offense Up for 1 turn. Recovery effects are increased by 20%.
data.MODIFIER_FIRSTORDER_DESC: Whenever a First Order ally gains Advantage, they lose 20% Critical Chance and gain 35% Critical Damage (stacking) until the end of battle. If a First Order unit does not score at least 1 critical hit during their turn, they gain Advantage for 2 turns at the end of that turn if they did not already have it.
data.MODIFIER_FIRSTORDER_SHIPS_DESC: Whenever a First Order ally scores a critical hit, they gain Protection Up (25%) for 2 turns. Hunted enemies deal 50% less damage to First Order allies. If a First Order ally defeats a Hunted enemy, that ally recovers 100% Health and Protection.
data.MODIFIER_GALACTICREPUBLIC_DESC_SHIPS_V2: Whenever a Galactic Republic ally takes damage from an enemy, they reflect 100% of that damage back at that enemy. The damage of this ability is increased by 10% for each time this ally has dealt damage this way. The reflected damage can't be avoided or prevented, and defeat enemies.
data.MODIFIER_GALACTICREPUBLIC_DESC_V4: Whenever a Galactic Republic ally receives damage from an enemy, they deal true damage to that enemy equal to 100% of the damage received. The damage dealt by this ability is increased by 10% for each time that ally has dealt damage this way. This damage can't be evaded and can't defeat enemies.
data.MODIFIER_GALACTICREPUBLIC_EASY_DESC_V3: Whenever a Galactic Republic ally receives damage from an enemy, they deal true damage to that enemy equal to 20% of the damage received. The damage dealt by this ability is increased by 10% for each time that ally has dealt damage this way. This damage can't be evaded and can't defeat enemies.
data.MODIFIER_GEONOSIS_DESC: Whenever a unit uses a Special ability, they gain a stack of [c][FFFF33]Entertainment[-][/c] which can't be copied, dispelled, or prevented.\n\n[c][FFFF33]Entertainment:[-][/c] +10% Max Health, Offense and Potency per stack
data.MODIFIER_GEONOSIS_SHIPS_DESC: Whenever a ship is inflicted with Target Lock, it also gains Foresight and Stealth for 2 turns, which can't be dispelled.
data.MODIFIER_GUNGAN_DESC_V3: Whenever Gungans start their turn with 100% Protection they gain Critical Damage Up and Offense Up for 2 turns. Whenever an allied Shield Generator uses Plasma Pulse, it gains a stack of plasma shielding and all Gungan allies gain a stack of [c][FFFF33]Whizbooma[-][/c] (max 5), which cannot be copied, dispelled or prevented. Whenever Gungan allies inflict debuffs on enemies, for each debuff inflicted remove 2 stacks of Recharge from the allied Shield Generator. If there is no allied Shield Generator, whenever Gungan allies inflict 10 debuffs on enemies, all Gungan allies gain a stack of Whizbooma (max 5). Whenever Gungans have 5 stacks of Whizbooma, on their next Special ability, dispel all buffs, remove 100% Turn Meter and inflict Daze on all enemies for 1 turn, which can't be dispelled, evaded, or resisted, and inflict Protection Disruption on target enemy for 3 turns, which can't be dispelled, evaded, or resisted, then dispel all Whizbooma stacks from all Gungan allies.\n\n[c][FFFF33]Whizbooma:[-][/c] +20% Potency per stack
data.MODIFIER_HOTH_DESC_V3:
All units gain the [c][FFFF33]Thermoregulate[-][/c] ability. At the start of each unit's turn, they are inflicted with [c][FFFF33]Frostbite[-][/c] until they are defeated, which can't be resisted.

[c][FFFF33]Frostbite:[-][/c] -2% Critical Chance, Potency, and Speed per stack; this unit is defeated upon reaching 10 stacks

[c][FFFF33]Thermoregulate:[-][/c] Remove two stacks of Overheat and Frostbite from target ally (Cooldown: 3).
data.MODIFIER_HOTH_SPACE_DESC: At the end of every other turn, all units are inflicted with Damage Over Time until defeated, which can't be resisted.
data.MODIFIER_HOTH_V2_DESC:
All units gain the [c][ffff33]Smells Bad on the Outside[-][/c] ability. At the start of battle, all units are inflicted with [c][ffff33]Deadly Storm,[-][/c] which can't be copied, dispelled, or resisted. The first time an ally would be defeated, they instead dispel all debuffs on themselves and remove Deadly Storm, recover 100% Health and Protection, gain Damage Immunity and Stun for 1 turn. These status effects can't be copied or dispelled.

[c][ffff33]Deadly Storm:[-][/c] -100% Critical Chance, -50% Offense, -25% Speed, and characters take damage at the start of their turn equal to 10% of their Max Health

[c][ffff33]Smells Bad on the Outside:[-][/c] Remove Deadly Storm from self and gain Critical Chance Up, Offense Up, and Speed Up for 2 turns. (Cooldown: 5)
data.MODIFIER_HUTT_CARTEL_DESC: If at the start of battle all allies are Hutt Cartel, then allies can't fall below 1% Health until the first time the ally in the Leader slot loses 100% of their Protection. If this condition has not been met and an ally is instantly defeated, active Hutt Cartel allies gain 300% Critical Chance, Critical Damage, and Offense the first time this occurs. Whenever a Hutt Cartel ally inflicts a Thermal Detonator on an enemy, the ally in the Leader slot recovers 10% Protection. Whenever a Thermal Detonator on the enemy detonates, Hutt Cartel allies gain Protection Up (stacking, 20%) for 2 turns.
data.MODIFIER_I_FEAR_NOTHING_DESC: At the start of battle, all Rebel Fighter allies gain 50% Max Health and Max Protection, 60% Offense, 25 Speed, and all enemies are inflicted with Buff Immunity and Healing Immunity for 2 turns which can't be evaded or resisted. The first time an enemy falls below 50% Health, they are Exposed for 2 turns and lose 100% Turn Meter, which can't be evaded or resisted. The first time an ally would be defeated, they recover 30% Health and Protection, gain 2 stacks of Heal Over Time and Retribution for 2 turns, and the ally in the Leader slot gains a bonus turn.
data.MODIFIER_ILUM_DESC_V2:
All units are inflicted with 10 stacks of [c][F0FF23]Hesitation[-][/c] at the start of the battle, which persists through defeat and can't be resisted, dispelled, or prevented. Whenever a character uses a special ability, dispel 1 stack of [c][F0FF23]Hesitation[-][/c]. At 0 stacks, recover 50% Health and gain [c][F0FF23]Clarity[-][/c], which persists through defeat and cannot be copied, dispelled, or prevented.

[c][F0FF23]Hesitation:[-][/c] -5% Offense and -5% Tenacity per stack. Can't assist or gain bonus Turn Meter.
[c][F0FF23]Clarity:[-][/c] +50% Tenacity and +30% Offense. Whenever a debuff is resisted, gain 5% Critical Chance and 5% Critical Damage (stacking) for the rest of the battle.
data.MODIFIER_IMPERIALREMNANTAFFAIRS_DESC: Imperial Remnant allies have +40% Critical Chance, Critical Damage, and Defense, and +20% Potency and Tenacity. Whenever Moff Gideon uses a Basic ability, he calls a random Imperial Remnant ally to assist, dealing 90% less damage. Whenever an Imperial Remnant ally is attacked out of turn, they recover 10% Health and Protection and gain Advantage for 2 turns and 5% Turn Meter. Whenever an Imperial Remnant ally is defeated, all Imperial Remnant allies gain Foresight, Health Steal Up, and Protection Up (50%) for 2 turns, and 20% Turn Meter.
data.MODIFIER_IMPERIALREMNANTAFFAIRS_DESC_EZR: Imperial Remnant allies have +40% Critical Chance, Critical Damage, and Defense, and +20% Potency and Tenacity. Whenever Captain Enoch uses a Basic ability, he calls a random Imperial Remnant ally to assist, dealing 90% less damage. Whenever an Imperial Remnant ally is attacked out of turn, they recover 10% Health and Protection and gain Advantage for 2 turns and 5% Turn Meter. Whenever an Imperial Remnant ally is defeated, all Imperial Remnant allies gain Foresight, Health Steal Up, and Protection Up (50%) for 2 turns, and 20% Turn Meter.
data.MODIFIER_IMPERIALTROOPER_v2_DESC: Imperial Troopers have +15% Max Health and Max Protection. The first time each non-Droid Imperial Trooper not in the Leader slot is defeated, they revive with 100% Health and 75% Protection. Whenever an Imperial Trooper revives, inflict all enemies with Stagger and Vulnerable for 1 turn, which can't be resisted. Whenever an Imperial Trooper with less than 100% Turn Meter gains bonus Turn Meter, they recover 5% Health and Protection and gain 10% Critical Damage (stacking) for 1 turn. Whenever an Imperial Trooper attacks out of turn, they gain 2% Bonus Protection (stacking) for 1 turn.
data.MODIFIER_IMPERIALTROOPER01_OPPONENTSIDE_: At the start of battle, Imperial Troopers gain 1 stack of [c][ffff33]Endless Ranks[-][/c] for each Imperial Trooper ally (max 3 stacks).\n\n[c][ffff33]Endless Ranks[-][/c]: When defeated, remove 1 stack of Endless Ranks from all Imperial Trooper allies and revive with 30% Health and Protection, which can't be prevented
data.MODIFIER_IMPERIALTROOPER01_PLAYERSIDE_DE: At the start of battle, Imperial Troopers gain 1 stack of [c][ffff33]Endless Ranks[-][/c] for each Imperial Trooper ally (max 3 stacks).\n\n[c][ffff33]Endless Ranks[-][/c]: When defeated, remove 1 stack of Endless Ranks from all Imperial Trooper allies and revive with 60% Health and Protection
data.MODIFIER_IMPERIALTROOPER01_TB3_PLAYERSID: At the start of battle, Imperial Troopers gain 1 stack of [c][ffff33]Endless Ranks[-][/c] for each Imperial Trooper ally.\n\n[c][ffff33]Endless Ranks[-][/c]: When defeated, remove 1 stack of Endless Ranks from all Imperial Trooper allies and revive with 60% Health and Protection
data.MODIFIER_IMPERIALTROOPER02_OPPONENTSIDE_: Imperial Troopers have +20% Health and Offense. At the start of battle, Imperial Troopers gain 1 stack of [c][ffff33]Never-ending Ranks[-][/c] for each Imperial Trooper ally (max 5 stacks).\n\n[c][ffff33]Never-ending Ranks:[-][/c] When defeated, remove 1 stack of Never-ending Ranks from all Imperial Trooper allies and revive with 70% Health and Protection, which can't be prevented.
data.MODIFIER_INQUISITORIUS_DESC:
If the allied leader is Inquisitorius, whenever they use an ability during their turn they inflict a stack of Purge (max 6) on the target enemy. Whenever Purge expires from an enemy, they gain a stack of [c][ffff33]Fatigue[-][/c] (max 20) which can't be copied, dispelled, or resisted. Whenever an ally defeats an enemy, all enemies are inflicted with 5 stacks of Fatigue. At 20 stacks of Fatigue, Inquisitorius allies gain [c][ffff33]Coup De Grâce[-][/c], which can't be copied, dispelled, or prevented.

[c][ffff33]Fatigue:[-][/c] -2 Speed and -2% Tenacity

[c][ffff33]Coup De Grâce:[-][/c] On the next Special attack, deal true damage equal to 100% of the target's Max Health and dispel Coup De Grâce from all Inquisitorius allies and dispel Fatigue from all enemies
data.MODIFIER_JAKKU_DESC:
All units gain the [c][FFFF33]Thermoregulate[-][/c] ability. At the start of each unit's turn, they are inflicted with [c][FFFF33]Overheat[-][/c] until they are defeated, which can't be resisted.

[c][FFFF33]Overheat:[-][/c] -10% Max Health per stack. This unit is defeated upon reaching 10 stacks

[c][FFFF33]Thermoregulate:[-][/c] Remove two stacks of Overheat and Frostbite from target ally.
data.MODIFIER_JAKKU_SPACE_DESC_V2: Whenever a ship's Protection reaches 0%, they gain Retribution for 1 turn. Whenever a ship falls below 50% Health, they gain Defense Up for 1 turn. The first time each ship falls below 25% Health, that ship gains Damage Immunity for 1 turn.
data.MODIFIER_JAWA_DESC: Jawa allies have +100% Protection. Whenever a Thermal Detonator deals damage, Jawa allies recover 100% Protection and gain 5% Speed, to a maximum of +100%. At the end of each turn, if a Jawa ally was damaged by a debuffed enemy that turn, inflict a Thermal Detonator for 2 turns on each enemy, which can't be evaded or resisted. This effect occurs for each time a Jawa ally was damaged by a debuffed enemy that turn.
data.MODIFIER_JEDI_DESC_V3: If any enemy buffs are dispelled or expire during a Jedi ally's ability, that Jedi gains Advantage for 2 turns and 25% Critical Damage (stacking) until the end of battle.
data.MODIFIER_KAMINO_DESC:
At the start of battle, all units have their current Max Health, Max Protection, Offense, Defense, and Critical Chance reduced by 80%. Additionally, they gain the [c][FFFF33]Superior Training[-][/c] ability.

[c][FFFF33]Superior Training:[-][/c] This unit gains [c][FFFF33]Superiority[-][/c] (stacking) until they are defeated, which can't be copied, dispelled, or prevented.

[c][FFFF33]Superiority:[-][/c] +20% current Max Health, Max Protection, Offense, Defense, and Critical Chance
data.MODIFIER_KAMINO_V2_DESC_V2:
Whenever the character in the Leader slot ends their turn, all allies gain a stack of [c][FFFF33]Morale[-][/c], which can't be copied, dispelled, or prevented, for each active ally. Whenever a character deals damage to an enemy or recovers Health, they gain a stack of Morale. Whenever a character is inflicted with a debuff or receives damage, they lose a stack of Morale. Whenever a character defeats an enemy, that character gains all of the stacks of Morale of the defeated enemy.

Whenever a character starts their turn with 10 or more stacks of Morale they gain Advantage for 1 turn. Whenever a character ends their turn with 15 or more stacks of Morale they gain Protection Up (50%) for 1 turn.

[c][FFFF33]Morale:[-][/c] +3% Critical Damage, Defense, Max Health, Potency, and Tenacity per stack
data.MODIFIER_KASHYYYK_DESC_V2:
Whenever a unit takes damage, they gain 20% Critical Damage (stacking) until they score a critical hit.

Whenever a unit is debuffed, they recover 10% Protection.

Whenever a unit is defeated, another random ally takes a bonus turn.
data.MODIFIER_KASHYYYK_SHIPS_DESC: At the start of the encounter, increase the cooldown of Call Reinforcements by 1 on all Capital Ships.
data.MODIFIER_KESSEL_DESC:
Whenever a character uses a Special ability, they gain a stack of [c][ffff33]Confuse[-][/c] (max 3) until the end of the encounter. All characters gain the granted ability [c][ffff33]Clear Head[-][/c] at the start of battle.

[c][ffff33]Confuse:[-][/c] Detrimental effects build based on the cumulative number of stacks:
1. Can't gain buffs
2. Can't counter, assist, or gain bonus Turn Meter (Raid bosses and Galactic Legends: -30% Counter Chance)
3. When this unit uses their Basic ability, increase their cooldowns by 1, which can't be resisted (Raid bosses and Galactic Legends: -50% Defense, does not stack with Defense Down)
data.MODIFIER_KESSEL_SHIPS_DESC:
Whenever a ship uses a Special ability, they gain a stack of [c][ffff33]Confuse[-][/c] (max 3) until the end of the encounter. All ships gain the granted ability [c][ffff33]Recompute[-][/c] at the start of battle.

[c][ffff33]Confuse (Ships):[-][/c] Detrimental effects build based on the cumulative number of stacks:
1. Can't gain buffs
2. Can't counter, assist, or gain bonus Turn Meter
3. When this ship uses their Basic ability, increase their cooldowns by 1, which can't be resisted
data.MODIFIER_LETTHEPASTDIE_DESC: First Order allies have +50% Max Health and Protection, +40% Defense, +35% Critical Chance, and +20 Speed. Whenever a First Order ally is critically hit, they gain Offense Up, Retribution and Tenacity Up for 1 turn. Whenever a First Order ally is inflicted with a debuff, they gain Critical Chance Up and Critical Damage Up for 1 turn. Whenever a First Order ally gains a buff, they gain 5% Offense and Potency (stacking) until the end of the battle.
data.MODIFIER_LOTHAL_DESC: Whenever an ally uses a special ability during their turn, call a random other ally to assist. Whenever a character attacks out of turn, they gain a stack of [c][F0FF23]Rebellious[-][/c], which can't be copied, dispelled, or prevented. At 20 stacks of Rebellious, they gain an additional 30% Offense.\n\n[c][F0FF23]Rebellious:[-][/c] +2% Critical Chance and Critical Damage (stacking, max 20)
data.MODIFIER_LOTHAL_SPACE_DESC_V2: Whenever a ship has 4 or more buffs, they are inflicted with Breach and Expose for 1 turn. These effects can't be resisted.
data.MODIFIER_MALACHOR_ABILITY_DESC_V1: All other allies lose 25% Max Health and Max Protection. Gain 5% Offense per ally affected this way (stacking). Then, gain a bonus turn.
data.MODIFIER_MALACHOR_DESC_V1: Characters in the Leader slot gain the [c][FFFF33]Drain Essence[-][/c] ability at the start of the encounter.\n\n[c][FFFF33]Drain Essence:[-][/c] All other allies lose 25% Max Health and Max Protection. Gain 5% Offense per ally affected this way (stacking). Then, gain a bonus turn.
data.MODIFIER_MANDALORE_DESC: At the start of each encounter, the healthiest character on each side gains Boon of the Mythosaur until the end of the encounter.  Whenever an ally falls below 50% Health, the ally with Boon of the Mythosaur takes a bonus turn and gains Taunt for 2 turns.\n\n[c][ffff33]Boon of the Mythosaur:[-][/c] This character has 200% Health and Protection, 50% Offense, and they gain Retribution while they have Taunt. They lose 50% Defense and 20% Speed
data.MODIFIER_MANDALORE_SHIP_DESC_V2: Non-Capital Ships gain 20% Defense and Offense (stacking, max 140%) and 10 Speed (stacking, max 70) for each defeated ally, excluding defeated summons.
data.MODIFIER_MANDALORIAN_DESC_V3: Whenever a Mandalorian ally takes damage, all Mandalorian allies gain a stack of [c][FFFF33]Clan Loyalty[-][/c], which can't be copied, dispelled, or prevented. If there is exactly one non-Mandalorian ally at the start of battle, that ally also gains [c][FFFF33]Clan Loyalty[-][/c] if they are not in the Leader slot. Allies with [c][FFFF33]Clan Loyalty[-][/c] have a 50% chance to assist when another ally attacks during an enemy's turn (limit once per turn), dealing 95% less damage.\n\n[c][FFFF33]Clan Loyalty:[-][/c] +1% Max Protection and counter chance, -1% damage penalty when assisting
data.MODIFIER_MED_STATION_DESC: Stun target ally, which can't be prevented and remove all stacks of Brain Worms.
data.MODIFIER_MERCENARY_DESC: At the start of their turn, if a Mercenary ally has more than 4 buffs, all Mercenary allies gain 10 stacks of Soldier of Fortune. At the start of turn if an enemy has more than 4 buffs, all Mercenary allies lose 25 stacks of Soldier of Fortune. Whenever a Mercenary ally gains 100 stacks of Soldier of Fortune, the next Special ability will instantly defeat the target enemy and consume all stacks of Soldier of Fortune from the Mercenary ally. Whenever an enemy is defeated, Mercenary allies gain 25% Critical Chance, Defense Penetration and Retribution for 1 Turn. Whenever the Health of a Mercenary ally with more than 20 stacks of Soldier of Fortune is reduced to 1% for the first time, consume all stacks of Soldier of Fortune and recover 100% Health and Protection.
data.MODIFIER_MUSTAFAR_DESC: Whenever a character uses an ability, inflict Burning on them for 1 turn, which can't be evaded or resisted.
data.MODIFIER_MUSTAFAR_SHIPS_DESC: Whenever a ship uses an ability, inflict Burning on them for 1 turn, which can't be evaded or resisted.
data.MODIFIER_NABOO_DESC_V2: At the start of the encounter, a random character (excluding summoned units), not in the Leader slot will receive the [c][FFFF33]Big Fish[-][/c] buff, which can't be copied, dispelled, or prevented, until the end of the encounter. If no characters have the Big Fish buff at the start of a turn, then a random character will gain the buff. Whenever a character with the Big Fish buff is defeated, Big Fish transfers to the character that defeated them.\n\n[c][FFFF33]Big Fish:[-][/c] Remove Damage Immunity, Protection Up, and Stealth; +150% Critical Avoidance, Critical Chance, Critical Damage, Max Health, Max Protection, and Offense; this unit can't recover Health or Protection and can't gain bonus Protection, Damage Immunity, Protection Up, or Stealth
data.MODIFIER_NEVARRO_DESC: Whenever a character inflicts a debuff, they gain a stack of [c][FFFF33]Imperial Rule[-][/c], which can't be copied, dispelled, or prevented.\n\n[c][FFFF33]Imperial Rule:[-][/c] +2% Offense and Potency per stack
data.MODIFIER_NIGHTSISTER_DESC_V2: Whenever an ally is revived, all other Nightsister allies gain Ichor (stacking), which can't be copied, dispelled, or prevented.\n\n[c][FFFF33]Ichor:[-][/c] +5% Max Health, Max Protection, Offense, and Speed
data.MODIFIER_NIGHTSISTER_v2_DESC: Whenever an enemy is inflicted with Doomed, they have -20% Offense, all Nightsister allies gain 20% Defense, and the ally in the Leader slot recovers 20% Health and Protection. Whenever an enemy attacks out of turn they take True damage, which can't be evaded (this damage can't defeat enemies).
data.MODIFIER_OLDREPUBLIC_DESC: Old Republic allies are immune to Tenacity Down. At the start of battle, Old Republic allies gain 20% Tenacity for each Old Republic ally. Whenever an Old Republic ally resists a detrimental effect, all Old Republic allies gain 4% Turn Meter. Whenever an Old Republic ally uses a Basic ability, they also deal True damage to all enemies, which can't be evaded.
data.MODIFIER_PHOENIX_DESC:
Whenever Phoenix allies attack out of turn or receive damage, all Phoenix allies gain a stack of [c][ffff33]Play it by Ear[-][/c], which can't be copied, dispelled or prevented. Whenever a Phoenix ally receives 100 stacks of Play it by Ear, they lose all stacks, reset their cooldowns and gain [c][ffff33]Improvised Plan[-][/c] for the rest of the encounter, which can't be copied, dispelled or prevented.

[c][ffff33]Play it by Ear:[-][/c] +1% Accuracy, +1% Health Steal and +1% Offense per stack 

[c][ffff33]Improvised Plan:[-][/c] +100% Accuracy, +100% Health Steal and +100% Offense; this character ignores Taunt effects on their turn, deals 20% more damage whenever they attack out of turn and inflicts Vulnerable on target enemy for 1 turn, which can't be resisted, whenever they use a Special ability
data.MODIFIER_PIRATE_DESC: Whenever a Pirate ally scores a critical hit, the enemy loses 10% Protection. While a Pirate ally has Profit, they recover 10% Health whenever they gain a buff and 10% Protection whenever they are inflicted with a debuff. Whenever a Pirate ally's Health falls below 75%, they dispel all debuffs on themselves and inflict those debuffs on the weakest enemy. If the Pirate ally does not have any debuffs, instead inflict Armor Shred on the strongest enemy until the end of the encounter which can't be resisted.
data.MODIFIER_REBEL_FIGHTER_DESC_V3:
Whenever a Rebel Fighter ally uses a Special ability and no enemies have Pinpoint, inflict [F0FF23]Pinpoint[-] for 2 turns on target enemy, which can't be dispelled, prevented, or resisted.

Enemies with Pinpoint have their Max Health reduced by 2% whenever they receive damage from a Rebel Fighter ally. Whenever a Rebel Fighter ally uses a Basic ability against an enemy with Pinpoint, they gain a stack of Heal Over Time for 2 turns. Whenever they use a Special ability against an enemy with Pinpoint, call all other Rebel Fighter allies with Heal Over Time to assist.

Whenever a Rebel Fighter ally defeats an enemy with Pinpoint, they take a bonus turn, and all Rebel Fighter allies gain Advantage, Critical Damage Up, and Speed Up for 2 turns. Whenever a Rebel Fighter ally with at least 10 stacks of Heal Over Time is defeated, they revive with 50% Health and Protection.

[F0FF23]Pinpoint:[-] Enemy attacks gain bonus effects. When Pinpoint expires recover 100% Health.
data.MODIFIER_REBELS_DESC: Whenever a Rebel ally scores a critical hit during their turn, they have a 100% chance to attack again. This chance is reduced to 25% for bonus attacks beyond the first. Rebel allies gain 50% Health Steal and can't be countered.
data.MODIFIER_REBELS_SHIPS_DESC_V3: Whenever a Rebel ally scores a critical hit during their turn, they have a 100% chance to attack again. This chance is reduced to 10% for bonus attacks beyond the first. Rebel allies can't be countered.
data.MODIFIER_REBELS_V2_DESC_V4: Rebel allies gain 50% Health Steal and can't be countered. Whenever a Rebel's Health drops below 90%, they are inflicted with [c][F0FF23]Cornered[-][/c]. When a Rebel ally's Health is above 95%, Cornered is removed, and they gain 10% Offense (stacking, max 50%) for the rest of the encounter.\n\n[c][F0FF23]Cornered:[-][/c] +30% Defense, Health Steal, and Speed; call a random Rebel ally to assist when using an ability on their turn (once per turn).
data.MODIFIER_RESISTANCE_DESC: Whenever an enemy resists a detrimental effect from a Resistance ally, that ally gains Heal Over Time for 1 turn. Whenever a Resistance ally gains a buff, they also gain 5% Potency, Critical Chance, and Critical Damage (stacking) until end of battle, and 10% Turn Meter.
data.MODIFIER_RESISTANCE_SHIPS_DESC: Whenever an enemy resists a detrimental effect from a Resistance ally, that ally gains Heal Over Time for 1 turn. Whenever a Resistance ally gains a buff, they also gain 3% Potency, Critical Chance, and Critical Damage (stacking) until end of battle, and 10% Turn Meter.
data.MODIFIER_RING_OF_KAFRENE_DESC: At the start of the encounter, one random ally and enemy is secretly granted the [c][ffff33]Informant[-][/c] effect (excluding summons). Critical hits against the Informant reveal them. The first time an Informant is defeated, if there is an active Informant remaining, that Informant and their allies gain 50% Armor Penetration and Critical Chance, 25% Critical Damage, and 20 Speed. Then, Informant is dispelled from all characters.\n\n[c][FFFF33]Informant:[-][/c] Defeat this character to gain buffs for your team
data.MODIFIER_SCARIF_LAND_DESC: Every 10 turns, all characters take massive damage, which can't be evaded.
data.MODIFIER_SCARIF_SPACE_DESC: At the start of battle and whenever a Capital Ship uses their Call Reinforcement ability, reduce the cooldown of Call Reinforcement by 2.
data.MODIFIER_SCOUNDREL_DESC_V2: Whenever a Scoundrel ally deals damage to their target enemy, for each buff that enemy has, that ally gains that buff for 3 turns (except Taunt). Then, dispel all buffs on target enemy.
data.MODIFIER_SCOUNDREL_V3_DESC: Scoundrel allies gain +30% Max Health, +20 Speed, and are immune to Buff Immunity. Whenever Scoundrel allies take damage while buffed, they take 30% less damage, have +50% counter chance, and inflict Defense Down for 2 turns when attacked, which can't be resisted. While debuffed, Scoundrel allies gain +10 Speed.
data.MODIFIER_SEPARATIST_DESC: Summoned Separatist allies have +25% Speed, Max Health, and Max Protection, and damage they deal is increased by 25%. All other Separatist allies gain half of these bonuses.
data.MODIFIER_SEPARATIST_RANK_2_DESC: Summoned Separatist allies have +50% Speed, Max Health, and Max Protection, and damage they deal is increased by 50%. All other Separatist allies gain half of these bonuses.\n\nIf there is a Separatist in the Leader slot and no summon is present at the start of the encounter, summon a Sniper Droid to the ally slot.
data.MODIFIER_SHIPS_ATTACKER_DESC_V3: At the start of each Attacker's turn they gain Speed Up for 1 turn. Whenever an Attacker is targeted by an enemy, if they have Speed Up, they lose Speed Up and gain Chaff for 1 turn.
data.MODIFIER_SHIPS_CARGO_DESC: At the start of each Cargo Ship's turn, they gain Evasion Up for 2 turns and gain a stack of [c][FFFF33]Primed Thrusters[-][/c] which cannot be copied, dispelled, or prevented. Whenever a Cargo Ship takes damage or is inflicted with a debuff, they gain a stack of [c][FFFF33]Primed Thrusters[-][/c] which cannot be copied, dispelled, or prevented.\n\n[c][FFFF33]Primed Thrusters:[-][/c] Whenever a Cargo Ship uses a Special ability, remove all stacks of Primed Thrusters and gain 10% Turn Meter for each stack removed.
data.MODIFIER_SHIPS_SUPPORT_DESC_V2: At the start of each Support's turn, inflict Target Lock on a random enemy for 2 turns. Whenever a Target Locked enemy is attacked, there is a 50% chance to call an Ally to assist.
data.MODIFIER_SHIPS_TANK_DESC: At the start of each Tank's turn, they gain Potency Up for 1 turn. Whenever a Tank is critically hit, they gain Protection Up (15%) for 2 turns.
data.MODIFIER_SITH_DESC: Whenever a Sith ally is defeated, all Sith allies gain 50% Max Health and Offense (stacking) until end of battle, gain 50% Turn Meter, and recover 50% Health. Whenever a Sith ally defeats an enemy, they gain [c][FFFF33]Dark Ascension[-][/c] (stacking), which can't be copied, dispelled, or prevented.\n\n[c][FFFF33]Dark Ascension:[-][/c] Damage received decreased by 15% and damage dealt increased by 30%
data.MODIFIER_SITH_EASY_DESC: Whenever a Sith ally is defeated, all Sith allies gain 20% Max Health and Offense (stacking) until end of battle and recover 25% Health. Whenever a Sith ally defeats an enemy, they gain [c][FFFF33]Dark Ascension[-][/c] (stacking), which can't be copied, dispelled, or prevented.\n\n[c][FFFF33]Dark Ascension:[-][/c] Damage received decreased by 15% and damage dealt increased by 30%
data.MODIFIER_SMUGGLER_DESC: At the start of the encounter, all Smugglers gain Critical Damage Up and Protection up (20%) for 2 turns, and are Prepared.
data.MODIFIER_SMUGGLER_OVERCHARGED_DESC_V2: At the start of the encounter, all Smugglers gain Critical Damage Up and Protection up (20%) for 2 turns, and are Prepared.\nMax Duration: 1 battle
data.MODIFIER_SUMMON_MALGUS_DESC: At the start of battle, summon Darth Malgus if the allied slot is available.
data.MODIFIER_TAKODANA_DESC_V2: While no characters are Deathmarked, when a character deals damage to an enemy, they are inflicted with Deathmark until the end of battle, which can't be copied, dispelled, or resisted.
data.MODIFIER_TATOOINE_DESC: At the end of every other turn, all units are inflicted with Damage Over Time until defeated, which can't be resisted.
data.MODIFIER_TATOOINE_SHIPS_DESC: The first time a non-Capital Ship uses a Special ability each turn, it gains Ability Block for 1 turn, which cannot be prevented, and takes a bonus turn.
data.MODIFIER_trueempire_DESC: Imperial Remnant allies have +40% Critical Chance, Critical Damage, and Defense, and +20% Potency and Tenacity. Whenever an Imperial Remnant uses a Special ability, they call a random another Imperial Remnant ally to assist, dealing 90% less damage. Whenever an Imperial Remnant ally is attacked out of turn, they recover 10% Health and Protection and gain Advantage for 2 turns and 5% Turn Meter. Whenever an Imperial Remnant ally is defeated, all Imperial Remnant allies gain Foresight, Health Steal Up, and Protection Up (50%) for 2 turns, and 20% Turn Meter.
data.MODIFIER_TUSKEN_OPPONENT_DESC: Tusken allies gain 30% Critical Damage and Offense. At the start of battle, the allied Tusken Leader gains 100% Turn Meter and all Tusken allies gain 5 stacks of [c][FFFF33]Single File[-][/c], which can't be copied, dispelled, or prevented. Whenever a Tusken ally is defeated, reset the cooldown of all Tusken allies.\n\n[c][FFFF33]Single File:[-][/c] When defeated, remove 1 stack of [c][ffff33]Single File[-][/c] from all Tusken allies and revive with 100% Health and Protection, which can't be prevented
data.MODIFIER_TUSKEN_PLAYER_DESC: Tusken allies gain 30% Critical Damage and Offense. At the start of battle, the allied Tusken Leader gains 100% Turn Meter and all Tusken allies gain 5 stacks of [c][FFFF33]Single File[-][/c], which can't be copied, dispelled, or prevented. Whenever a Tusken ally is defeated, reset the cooldown of all Tusken allies.\n\n[c][FFFF33]Single File:[-][/c] When defeated, remove 1 stack of [c][ffff33]Single File[-][/c] from all Tusken allies and revive with 100% Health and Protection
data.MODIFIER_TUSKEN_V2_DESC: Tusken allies gain 50% Max Health and Defense, and 20 Speed. At the start of the encounter, the weakest enemy is inflicted with [c][FFFF33]Ambushed![-][/c] until defeated and the healthiest ally gains Taunt for 3 turns. Whenever a Tusken ally damages an enemy with Ambushed!, all Tusken allies gain 2 stacks of Momentum for 3 turns. Whenever an enemy with Ambushed! is defeated, the weakest enemy is inflicted with Ambushed! until defeated. If Taunt is dispelled during the enemy's turn, Tusken allies gain 15 stacks of Momentum, their cooldowns are refreshed, and they gain 100% Turn Meter. Tusken allies gain 1% Offense, Defense, Critical Damage for the rest of the encounter whenever they gain Momentum.\n\n[c][FFFF33]Ambushed!:[-][/c] Tusken allies can ignore Taunt to target this enemy.
data.MODIFIER_VANDOR_DESC: At the end of each character's turn, they have a 50% chance to gain Health Up (35%) or Health Down (35%) for 2 turns. If a buff or debuff was gained in this way, dispel all other Health Up or Health Down effects.
data.MODIFIER_VANDOR_SHIPS_DESC: All ships have +100% counter chance. Whenever a ship uses a Special ability, a random enemy gains 15% Turn Meter.
data.MODIFIER_ZEFFO_DESC: At the start of each encounter, or if no character has it at the start of a turn, the healthiest character gains Ancient Power Core, which can't be copied or dispelled. When a character with Ancient Power Core is damaged by an attack, they lose it and the attacking character gains Ancient Power Core.\n\n[c][ffff33]Ancient Power Core:[-][/c] Attacking this character Stuns them, which can't be prevented if this character has less than 10% health. The attacker then takes a Bonus Turn.
data.MODIFIER_ZEFFO_SPACE_DESC: Whenever a ship uses a Special Ability, (including Capital Ships,) increase the cooldown of its other Special Abilities by 1. When a Capital Ship uses Call Reinforcement, the reinforcing ship is inflicted with Shield Disruption for 2 turns, which can't be avoided.
data.MODIFIERABILITY_GETMESSY_DESC: Allies with no debuffs have -25% Offense. Allies with debuffs have +50% Offense for each debuff they have.
data.MODIFIERABILITY_GRIT_DESC: Allies have no Protection, but have +50% Max Health, and gain +200% Defense while below half Health.
data.MODIFIERABILITY_HYPERDRIVE_DESC: All units have -50% Offense. Whenever any unit uses a Special ability, all other units gain 20% Turn Meter and +10% Offense (stacking) for the rest of the battle.
data.MODS_BATCH_SELL_ERROR_MESSAGE: You can only sell unlocked and unequipped mods
data.MODS_BATCH_UPGRADE_ERROR_MESSAGE: All selected mods are already at max level
data.Mods_Battles_Table_1_QUEST_DESC: Complete Mod battles to unlock additional Mod stages and get better Mods.\n\nI'll keep all the good mods for myself, get your own!
data.Mods_Battles_Table_1_QUEST_REWARDS_V2: Mods will increase your success in Holobattles all over the Cantina.
data.Mods_Battles_Table_2_QUEST_DESC: Select Mods to boost various stats, check the stats to match them to your Characters!\n\nI just experiment until I find the right combinations.
data.Mods_Battles_Table_2_QUEST_REWARDS: Switch mods to rearrange them into the best configurations.
data.Mods_Battles_Table_3_QUEST_DESC: Complete stages in Mod battles to gain additional Mods.\n\nRemember, secondary Mod stats vary quite a bit, so chase your favorites!
data.Mods_Battles_Table_3_QUEST_REWARDS: Have you tried putting together Speed Mods and Speed secondary stats?\n\nThey make a winning combination!
data.Mods_Battles_Table_4_QUEST_DESC: I'll let you in on a Mod secret, match Mod sets of two or four to activate bonuses. \n\nFind combinations that complement your Characters.
data.Mods_Battles_Table_4_QUEST_REWARDS: Maybe you'll be giving me tips on Mods someday.
data.Mods_Battles_Table_9_ABC_QUEST_REWARDS: Each battle in Stage 9 Mod Battles has a different possible Slicing material.
data.Mods_Battles_Table_9_DEF_QUEST_REWARDS: Remember, you can view recommendations on which Mod sets to use on your characters!

data.Mods_Fulcrum_Agent_1_QUEST_DESC: Fulcrum was a codename used by various Rebel operatives.\n\nIf you want to understand them, you'll need to start with studying Ahsoka Tano (Fulcrum)!
data.Mods_Fulcrum_Agent_1_QUEST_REWARDS: Great start! After the Empire came to power, Ahsoka joined Bail Organa's Rebels and adopted the codename Fulcrum, where she provided intel to Rebels.
data.Mods_Fulcrum_Agent_1_TASK_DESC_1: Get Ahsoka (Fulcrum) to Gear Tier XII
data.Mods_Fulcrum_Agent_1_TASK_DESC_3: Defeat 1,000 Empire enemies with Ahsoka (Fulcrum) present
data.Mods_Fulcrum_Agent_2_QUEST_DESC: Alright, now we need to contact another Fulcrum--Cassian Andor!\n\nThey say he was part of Rogue One...
data.Mods_Fulcrum_Agent_2_QUEST_REWARDS: Great work! And you probably know this already, but not all Imperial Security Droids are so friendly...
data.Mods_Fulcrum_Agent_2_TASK_DESC_1: Get Cassian Andor to Gear tier XII
data.Mods_Fulcrum_Agent_2_TASK_DESC_2: Finish off 200 enemies with Cassian Andor
data.Mods_Fulcrum_Agent_2_TASK_DESC_3: Win 5 Territory War attacks with Cassian Andor
data.Mods_Fulcrum_Agent_5_QUEST_DESC: You can't exactly recruit rebels in the open, not while the Empire is watching.\n\nThat's why Cassian adopted the Fulcrum name while recruiting on Wecacoe.
data.Mods_Fulcrum_Agent_5_QUEST_REWARDS: Cassian's undercover work led him to become a great hero of the Rebellion.\n\nKeep working like this and you'll follow in his footsteps as FULCRUM!

data.MODS_PACK_DESC:
Guarantees between 5 and 8 Mods of any set: Health, Defense, Critical Damage, Critical Chance, Tenacity, Offense, Potency, Speed

Mods augment your character's abilities. Will you choose to make a strength even stronger or overcome a weakness?

[c][99FF33]Health[-][/c] - increases the amount of damage your character can take before being defeated
[c][99FF33]Defense[-][/c] - decreases the amount of damage your character takes from an enemy’s attack
[c][99FF33]Critical Damage[-][/c] - Increases the amount of damage dealt when your character lands a Critical Hit on an enemy
[c][99FF33]Critical Chance[-][/c] - Increases the chance your character lands a Critical Hit on an enemy
[c][99FF33]Tenacity[-][/c] - Decreases the likelihood of an enemy landing a negative status effect on your character
[c][99FF33]Offense[-][/c] - increases the amount of damage your character inflicts on an enemy during an attack
[c][99FF33]Potency[-][/c] - Increases the chance your player successfully applies a negative status effect to an enemy
[c][99FF33]Speed[-][/c] - Increases the rate at which your character takes a turn

Maximum 5 purchases per day.

data.MORALEABILITY_RANCOR01_DESC:
When the Rancor becomes Toppled, attacking units gain a Morale bonus:

Morale I: All attacking units gain 100% Critical Chance.
Morale II: If the Rancor has 50% Health or less in its current phase, all attacking units gain 25% Speed.
Morale III: All attacking units that have more than 50% Health when the Rancor becomes Toppled gain 50% Offense.

Morale bonuses are lost when the Rancor is no longer Toppled.

data.MSG_CONQUEST_16_BOSS_S1-1: Too long... too long in the cold and the dark. I am disturbed again? Tell me, do the Sith still thrive?
data.MSG_CONQUEST_16_BOSS_S2-1: Ladies and gentlemen, come with me now on a journey to the savage days of years gone by.
data.MSG_CONQUEST_16_BOSS_S2-2: They're illegal, they're banned, they've been outlawed for nearly ten years – a good, old-fashioned death match!
data.MSG_CONQUEST_16_BOSS_S4-1: Only the weak choose fear as their weapon.
data.MSG_CONQUEST_16_BOSS_S5-1: The Emperor is dead. Long live the new Emperor.
data.MSG_CONQUEST_16_MINIBOSS_S2-1: Not bad for an amateur. I'm tempted to step back into the ring to face you.
data.MSG_CONQUEST_16_MINIBOSS_S5-1: Assessment: You have been exceedingly sporting during our hunt.
data.MSG_CONQUEST_VOL7_BOSS_S1-1: I must stop the destruction, pain, and death that you will bring.
data.MSG_CONQUEST_VOL7_BOSS_S3-1: Leave here with me. Come home. We miss you.
data.MSG_CONQUEST_VOL7_MINIBOSS_S4-1: It's not too late for redemption.
data.MSG_CONQUEST_VOL8_BOSS_S3-1: I am what you made me.
data.MSG_CONQUEST_VOL8_BOSS_S5-1: You should have killed me when you had the chance.
data.MSG_ERA_BATTLE_CRIMES_AGAINST_THE_REPUBL: Are you threatening me, Master Jedi?
data.MSG_EVENT_4LOM_1-1: A cold and calculating protocol droid turned Bounty Hunter, I’m excited to bring the relentless 4-LOM to the holotables!
data.MSG_EVENT_4LOM_1-2: 4-LOM is known for his ruthless efficiency, cold logic, and relentless pursuit of bounties.
data.MSG_EVENT_50RT_1-1: A tactical droid pulled from the smoldering ruins of a battlefield, she was reprogrammed by a slicer with a penchant for gambling. I'm honored to welcome 50R-T to the holotables!
data.MSG_EVENT_50RT_1-2: 50R-T's Basic attack, [c][ffff33]Calculated Odds[-][/c], deals Physical damage to target enemy. If the target was inflicted with Target Lock (certain abilities have improved interactions against Target Lock), this attack will critically hit if able.
data.MSG_EVENT_50RT_1-3: If all allies are Droids and this attack critically hits, 50R-T grants the next ally to take a turn Advantage (the next attack is guaranteed to critically hit if able) for 2 turns at the start of their turn.
data.MSG_EVENT_50RT_2-1: 50R-T's Special ability, [c][ffff33]Sabacc Shuffle[-][/c], deals damage to all enemies 3 times and inflicts Defense Down (reduced Defense stat) for 2 turns. At the start of battle if all allies are non-Separatist Droids, this attack has a chance to inflict Target Lock and will remove Turn Meter from all enemies with each strike. Additionally, allies gain stacking Offense (increases ability damage) until the end of the encounter each time this ability is used.
data.MSG_EVENT_50RT_2-2: Allies gain Turn Meter for each debuff inflicted by this ability.
data.MSG_EVENT_50RT_3-1: 50R-T's Special ability, [c][ffff33]Tactical Advantage[-][/c], dispels debuffs from the weakest ally and grants them Advantage, Health Steal Up (increased health recovery from dealing damage), and Speed Up (takes turns more often) for 2 turns.
data.MSG_EVENT_50RT_3-2: If the ally was a non-Separatist Droid, they gain Offense Up (increases ability damage) and Tenacity Up (increased chance to resist debuffs) for 2 turns, and if any debuffs were dispelled this way, inflict Target Lock and Speed Down (takes turns less often) on the weakest enemy for 2 turns.
data.MSG_EVENT_50RT_4-1: Droid allies have increased Defense (increased Defense stat, which reduces incoming damage), Speed, and gain [c][ffff33]Spare Parts[-][/c], which can't be copied, dispelled, or prevented.  At the start of battle, if all allies are Droids, 50R-T gains Max Health and additional Speed.
data.MSG_EVENT_50RT_4-2: Spare Parts increases Critical Chance and Offense; if the buffed character is defeated, they are revived with 100% Health, gain Foresight (the next incoming attack will be evaded if able) and Protection Up (grants bonus Protection) for 2 turns, and this buff is removed from all allies.
data.MSG_EVENT_50RT_4-3: While in Conquest, if all allies are non-Separatist Droids, the first time in battle the first enemy to take a turn is defeated, if there are other active enemies (excluding summons), all allies are revived with 60% Health, and gain Damage Immunity (can't be damaged) and Instant Defeat Immunity (can't be instantly defeated) for 2 turns.
data.MSG_EVENT_50RT_5-1: At the start of battle, the weakest other ally gains [c][ffff33]VIP[-][/c]. Whenever the VIP is damaged, they gain Stealth (can't be targeted by enemies, unless only Stealthed targets are available) for 2 turns and 50R-T recovers Health and Protection.
data.MSG_EVENT_50RT_5-2: Whenever 50R-T is damaged, allies with VIP recover Health and Protection equal to 5% of 50R-T's Max Health and Protection and they gain Offense Up for 2 turns, and 50R-T gains Defense Up and Protection Up for 2 turns.
data.MSG_EVENT_50RT_5-3: If all allies are Droids at the start of battle, 50R-T and the VIP are immune to Turn Meter reduction.
data.MSG_EVENT_ADMIRALPIETT_1-1: [c][F0FF23]Admiral Piett[-][/c] is an Imperial Support who works best alongside other Empire units by providing unique buffs and assist calls while plotting their eventual demise.
data.MSG_EVENT_ADMIRALPIETT_1-2: [c][F0FF23]Intensified Firepower[-][/c] deals damage to the target enemy and calls another Empire ally to assist.
data.MSG_EVENT_ADMIRALPIETT_2-1: With [c][F0FF23]Imperial Ambition[-][/c] all allies gain Offense Up, Piett gains Stealth, and target ally is inflicted with Marked and Inevitable Failure.
data.MSG_EVENT_ADMIRALPIETT_2-2: When an ally with Inevitable Failure is defeated, Piett gains bonuses based on that unit's stats and the number of Inevitable Failure stacks they had until the end of battle.
data.MSG_EVENT_ADMIRALPIETT_3-1: [c][F0FF23]Suborbital Strike[-][/c] deals damage to all enemies and dispels buffs on Light Side enemies. Allies with Inevitable Failure gain stacks.
data.MSG_EVENT_ADMIRALPIETT_4-1: [c][F0FF23]Zealous Commander[-][/c] provides Empire allies with Offense and Potency. It also reduces the Tenacity and Speed of Light Side enemies.
data.MSG_EVENT_ADMIRALPIETT_5-1: [c][F0FF23]The Emperor's Trap[-][/c] gives Piett counter chance. He also gains Turn Meter whenever another Empire ally is damaged.
data.MSG_EVENT_ADMIRALRADDUS_1-1: Greetings Holotable Heroes! I am pleased to announce that Admiral Raddus, the brilliant Admiral who helped secure the first major Rebel victory against the Empire at the Battle of Scarif, has arrived to the Holotables!
data.MSG_EVENT_ADMIRALRADDUS_1-2: Admiral Raddus's Basic attack, [c][ffff33]Protective Shot[-][/c], deals Special damage to target enemy and grants the weakest ally Protection Up (grants bonus Protection).
data.MSG_EVENT_ADMIRALRADDUS_2-1: Admiral Raddus's Special ability, [c][ffff33]Inspiring Maneuver[-][/c], grants all Rebel allies Protection Up and Protection Recovery, grants all Tank allies Taunt (enemies must target this character), and calls all Rogue One allies to assist. If Admiral Raddus's target is Dark Side and they are debuffed, their cooldowns are increased by 1. In addition, Inspiring Maneuver grants all Rogue One allies Spark of Rebellion.
data.MSG_EVENT_ADMIRALRADDUS_3-1: [c][ffff33]Blue Squadron Air Support[-][/c] dispels all debuffs from all Light Side allies and deals Special damage to all enemies. If Admiral Raddus is in the Leader slot, all allies gain 5% Upload progress, and if this ability defeats an enemy, they gain an additional 8% Upload progress.
data.MSG_EVENT_ADMIRALRADDUS_4-1: For each Rogue One ally at the start of battle, Rogue One allies gain Health, Potency (ally debuffs are harder to resist), Speed, and Tenacity.
data.MSG_EVENT_ADMIRALRADDUS_4-2: When an Empire enemy gains bonus Turn Meter, they are inflicted with Daze (can't assist, counter attack, or gain bonus Turn Meter). If a Rogue One ally is critically hit by an enemy, that enemy gains Expose.
data.MSG_EVENT_ADMIRALRADDUS_4-3: While in Grand Arenas, Rogue One allies gain Protection and Spark of Rebellion at the start of battle. When Spark of Rebellion is dispelled from an ally, they gain Critical Chance Up (increases chance of an attack being a critical hit), Critical Damage Up, (increases the damage of critical hits), Defense Up, Health Up, Offense Up, Potency Up, and Protection Up.
data.MSG_EVENT_ADMIRALRADDUS_5-1: Admiral Raddus's Unique ability, [c][ffff33]Transmission from Scarif[-][/c], gains additional Defense (reduces incoming damage) and Tenacity (enemy debuffs are harder to inflict). If Jyn Erso is an ally, she gains the new buff [c][ffff33]Spark of Rebellion[-][/c] at the start of the encounter, and when she loses Spark of Rebellion, she regains it. While Admiral Raddus is active, Jyn Erso can't be defeated.
data.MSG_EVENT_ADMIRALRADDUS_5-2: [c][ffff33]Spark of Rebellion[-][/c] grants Offense (increases damage) and Speed (takes turns more often), Health and Protection recovery on attack, and any Empire enemies defeated by this character can't be revived. If Spark of Rebellion is dispelled, the owner of the buff gains bonus Turn Meter (determines how quickly a character can take another turn) and Protection Up.
data.MSG_EVENT_ADMIRALRADDUS_5-3: If Admiral Raddus is in the Leader slot, all allies gain the granted ability [c][ffff33]Hope[-][/c], which will revive all allies and all allies recover 100% Health and Protection, then deal true damage and inflict Protection Disruption (Protection is temporarily disabled) and Healing Immunity (immune to Health and Protection recovery) to all enemies. Hope requires 100% Upload progress to activate and can be used one per battle.
data.MSG_EVENT_ADMIRALRADDUS_5-4: Gain Upload progress by resisting debuffs, damaging enemies with Expose (receives additional damage from attacks), and using Special abilities. Jyn Erso gains additional Upload progress when she uses any ability. Additionally, all allies gain Upload progress when Spark of Rebellion is dispelled. At 100% Upload progress, Admiral Raddus gains a bonus turn and Hope is dispelled from all other allies.
data.MSG_EVENT_APHRA_LEGACY-4: Start by disabling the astromech then eliminate the Princess. Next, take out the protocol droid followed by Skywalker. Then, defeat the Wookiee, saving the smuggler for last.
data.MSG_EVENT_APPO_1-1: I am excited to announce the arrival of CC-1119 "Appo" to the holotables!
data.MSG_EVENT_APPO_1-2: Clone Commander Appo was a steadfast soldier who fought alongside the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars. When Order 66 was issued, he joined Lord Vader in his assault on the Jedi Temple, playing a crucial role in paving the way for the rise of the Galactic Empire.
data.MSG_EVENT_ARMORER_1-1: [c][F0FF23]The Armorer[-][/c] is a fierce Mandalorian Support who works best with other Mandalorians. She equips her squad in the finest Mandalorian armor as long as she possesses the Beskar Ingots to craft it.
data.MSG_EVENT_ARMORER_1-2: [c][F0FF23]Earn Your Signet[-][/c] requires stacks of Beskar Ingots to activate and grants a stacking buff that becomes more powerful with every Beskar Ingot The Armorer consumes.
data.MSG_EVENT_ARMORER_2-1: With [c][F0FF23]Both Hunter and Prey[-][/c] The Armorer gains a stack of Beskar Ingot the first time another ally falls under 60% Health and grants them Protection.
data.MSG_EVENT_ARMORER_2-2: [c][F0FF23]Tempered Strike[-][/c] pummels enemies twice and grants a stack of Beskar Ingot if the enemy had Armor Shred.
data.MSG_EVENT_ARMORER_3-1: [c][F0FF23]Our Survival is our Strength[-][/c] grants a powerful defensive buff to Mandalorian allies at the start of battle.
data.MSG_EVENT_ARMORER_3-2: [c][F0FF23]This is the Way[-][/c] inflicts Armor Shred to an enemy and then calls all Mandalorian allies and allies with the Beskar Armor buff to assist.
data.MSG_EVENT_ARMORER_4-1: Use [c][F0FF23]Earn Your Signet[-][/c]  at the right time to maximize Beskar Armor's potent bonuses.
data.MSG_EVENT_ARMORER_5-1: Be sure to use [c][F0FF23]Earn Your Signet[-][/c] when The Armorer has Beskar Ingots. Consider granting Beskar Armor to allies in need of Protection and defensive buffs.
data.MSG_EVENT_ASAJJDARKDISCIPLE_1-1: I am happy to announce the arrival of Asajj Ventress (Dark Disciple) to the holotables!
data.MSG_EVENT_ASAJJDARKDISCIPLE_1-2: Tasked with an assassination that could end the war, Ventress was forced to confront not only her former master but the darkness within herself.
data.MSG_EVENT_AURRASING_1-1: Use [c][F0FF23]WEAKENING SHOT[-][/c] to deal damage with a chance to inflict Stun
data.MSG_EVENT_AURRASING_2-1: When [c][F0FF23]HUSTLE[-][/c] is used, Aurra Sing gains offensive buffs and she takes a bonus turn if she's Stealthed
data.MSG_EVENT_AURRASING_3-1: Use [c][F0FF23]SNIPERS EXPERTISE[-][/c] on Toppled enemies to deal more damage and reset this ability's cooldown (Only Raid Bosses can be Toppled.)
data.MSG_EVENT_AURRASING_4-1: [c][F0FF23]GAME PLAN[-][/c] gives Bounty Hunter and Scoundrel allies more Offense while Stealthed
data.MSG_EVENT_AURRASING_5-1: [c][F0FF23]RELENTLESS KILLER[-][/c] grants Aurra Sing a Critical Damage boost that is doubled while Stealthed
data.MSG_EVENT_AURRASING_6-1: When fully upgraded, [c][F0FF23]AURRA SING'S PAYOUT[-][/c] grants Aurra Sing a boost to her Offense, Health Steal, and when she uses a Special ability she gains Stealth
data.MSG_EVENT_B1BATTLEDROIDV2_1-1: The B1 has the ability Droid Battalion, which represents an army of Battle Droids. When B1 takes any damage you will lose 8 Battle Droids, but you regain some at the start of B1's turn.
data.MSG_EVENT_B1BATTLEDROIDV2_1-2: [c][F0FF23]DROID BATTALION[-][/c]\nEach B1 has 1 Health and the number of B1s at your command is displayed above the B1.
data.MSG_EVENT_B1BATTLEDROIDV2_2-1: [c][F0FF23]B1 BARRAGE[-][/c] deals damage and Droid allies recover Health if the damaged enemy is Target Locked.
data.MSG_EVENT_B1BATTLEDROIDV2_3-1: [c][F0FF23]BLAST THEM![-][/c] deals damage to all enemies and Target Locks the target. A target ally is healed based on the remaining number of B1s.
data.MSG_EVENT_B1BATTLEDROIDV2_4-1: [c][F0FF23]ROGER ROGER[-][/c] has B1s assist when a Separatist ally attacks, and gain Turn Meter when another Droid uses a Special ability.
data.MSG_EVENT_BADBATCHECHO_1-1: [c][F0FF23]Echo[-][/c] provides support for Clone Troopers allies, especially Bad Batch allies, by using his advanced cybernetics. He accomplishes this by buffing his allies and debuffing his enemies.
data.MSG_EVENT_BADBATCHECHO_1-2: [c][F0FF23]Daring Defense[-][/c] damages the target enemy and gives a chance to grant Defense Up (reduces damage taken from attacks) and Evasion Up (chance to avoid enemy attacks) to the weakest Clone Trooper ally.
data.MSG_EVENT_BADBATCHECHO_2-1: [c][F0FF23]One Step Ahead[-][/c] inflicts Buff Immunity on target enemy and Expose (receives additional damage from attacks) on all enemies. Then, it dispels all debuffs on target other Clone Trooper ally and then calls them to assist.
data.MSG_EVENT_BADBATCHECHO_3-1: [c][F0FF23]Never Any Doubt[-][/c] gives all Clone Trooper allies Evasion Up and dispels all buffs on all enemies. For each buff dispelled, Clone Trooper allies gain additional Offense until the end of their next turn.
data.MSG_EVENT_BADBATCHECHO_4-1: [c][F0FF23]One That Survives[-][/c], whenever a Clone Trooper ally gains or loses a buff from a Bad Batch ally's ability, they recover Health and Protection.
data.MSG_EVENT_BADBATCHHUNTER_1-1: [c][F0FF23]Hunter[-][/c] is the leader and shot caller of Clone Force 99. He supports his Clone Trooper allies, distributing buffs across the team.
data.MSG_EVENT_BADBATCHHUNTER_1-2: [c][F0FF23]Combat Prowess[-][/c] deals Physical damage to target enemy and inflicts Expose.
data.MSG_EVENT_BADBATCHHUNTER_2-1: [c][F0FF23]Shrouded Approach[-][/c] gives Evasion Up (chance to avoid an enemy attack) and Stealth (can't be targeted by enemies, unless everyone on the team has Stealth) to Clone Trooper allies, then deals damage to all enemies.
data.MSG_EVENT_BADBATCHHUNTER_2-2: When fully upgraded, if Hunter is already Stealthed, all Bad Batch allies gain Critical Chance Up (increases chance to critically hit) and Offense Up (increases attack damage).
data.MSG_EVENT_BADBATCHHUNTER_3-1: [c][F0FF23]Finish What We Started[-][/c] inflicts Expose (receives additional damage from attacks) on target enemy and grants Turn Meter (determines how quickly a character can take another turn) to a targeted Clone Trooper ally.
data.MSG_EVENT_BADBATCHHUNTER_3-2: If the target ally was Bad Batch, when fully upgraded, they ignore Taunt (which causes focused targeting) and inflict Stun (prevents the character from taking their next turn) on their target enemy, which can't be evaded.
data.MSG_EVENT_BADBATCHHUNTER_4-1: [c][F0FF23]A Different Path[-][/c] buffs Bad Batch allies' Max Health, Max Protection and Potency. When fully upgraded, when using an ability against a Target Locked (certain abilities have improved interactions against Target Lock) enemy, Bad Batch allies can't be countered.
data.MSG_EVENT_BADBATCHHUNTER_4-2: When Bad Batch allies use an ability while they have Defense Up (reduces Physical and Special damage taken), they deal true damage (ignores Defense but can't critically hit) to all enemies.
data.MSG_EVENT_BADBATCHOMEGA_1-1: [c][F0FF23]Omega[-][/c] is a clever and empathetic attacker who utilizes buffs, debuffs, and the presence of her Bad Batch allies to take out her foes.
data.MSG_EVENT_BADBATCHOMEGA_1-2: [c][F0FF23]Disarming Shot[-][/c] deals damage to an enemy, and if Omega has Evasion Up (chance to avoid an enemy attack), can Blind (miss the next attack) and Daze (can't assist, counter attack, or gain bonus Turn Meter) them.
data.MSG_EVENT_BADBATCHOMEGA_2-1: [c][F0FF23]Adaptive Learner[-][/c] deals damage to an enemy, and if the enemy is Exposed (receives additional damage from attacks), will inflict them with Target Lock (certain abilities have improved interactions against Target Lock) and remove Turn Meter (determines how quickly a character can take another turn).
data.MSG_EVENT_BADBATCHOMEGA_3-1: [c][F0FF23]Empathy First[-][/c] dispels debuffs on Omega and gives her Stealth (can't be targeted by enemies, unless only Stealthed targets are available). Bad Batch allies gain Protection Up, Defense Penetration (ignores some of a target's Defense stat), and Turn Meter.
data.MSG_EVENT_BADBATCHOMEGA_4-1: [c][F0FF23]Part of the Squad[-][/c] gives Omega additional bonuses while Stealthed and bonuses to Offense if all of her allies are Bad Batch.
data.MSG_EVENT_BADBATCHTECH_1-1: [c][F0FF23]Tech[-][/c] is a reserved member of Clone Force 99 with a brilliant mind, who works best with his fellow Bad Batch squadmates.
data.MSG_EVENT_BADBATCHTECH_1-2: [c][F0FF23]Call the Shot[-][/c] inflicts Target Lock on Tech's target, with a chance to also inflict Target Lock on the healthiest enemy who doesn't already have it.
data.MSG_EVENT_BADBATCHTECH_2-1: [c][F0FF23]Delicate Operation[-][/c] keeps Tech and his allies on their feet, recovering their health plus applying Stealth and [c][F0FF23]Translation[-][/c].
data.MSG_EVENT_BADBATCHTECH_2-2: [c][F0FF23]Translation[-][/c] can be stacked up to three times, providing additional benefits for each stack.
data.MSG_EVENT_BADBATCHTECH_3-1: [c][F0FF23]Brilliant Idea[-][/c] is a powerful ability that can turn the tide of battle. It clears debuffs from Tech's allies, with a chance to Stun enemies that are Target Locked or Dazed.
data.MSG_EVENT_BADBATCHTECH_4-1: [c][F0FF23]Clone Interpreter[-][/c] makes Tech even better at giving [c][F0FF23]Translation[-][/c] to his Clone Trooper allies, who gain a stack of Translation every time they use a Special ability.
data.MSG_EVENT_BADBATCHTECH_4-2: When fully upgraded, [c][F0FF23]Clone Interpreter[-][/c] boosts Tech's Speed, and at the start of battle, if all allies are Clone Troopers, Tech gains Stealth.
data.MSG_EVENT_BADBATCHWRECKER_1-1: [c][F0FF23]Wrecker[-][/c] is a resilient and loyal member of Clone Force 99. He protects his allies with buffs while dishing out some damage of his own.
data.MSG_EVENT_BADBATCHWRECKER_1-2: [c][F0FF23]Dauntless Commando[-][/c] gives Wrecker the ability to gain stacks of [c][F0FF23]Fury[-][/c] by taking damage or using certain abilities.
data.MSG_EVENT_BADBATCHWRECKER_1-3: At max stacks of Fury, Wrecker becomes [c][F0FF23]Furious[-][/c], which gives his activated abilities additional effects.
data.MSG_EVENT_BADBATCHWRECKER_2-1: [c][F0FF23]The Cavalry[-][/c] deals damage to a single enemy. If Wrecker is Furious, he uses this ability again.
data.MSG_EVENT_BADBATCHWRECKER_3-1: [c][F0FF23]I Hate That Word[-][/c] dispels Stealth (can't be targeted by enemies, unless only Stealthed targets are available) from all enemies, and Clone Trooper allies recover Protection. If Wrecker is Furious, Bad Batch allies recover additional Protection.
data.MSG_EVENT_BADBATCHWRECKER_4-1: [c][F0FF23]Wrecking Ball[-][/c] deals damage to all enemies and grants Wrecker Taunt (causes focused targeting) while Clone Trooper allies gain Defense Up (reduces Physical and Special damage taken) and Tenacity Up (improves chance to resist detrimental effects). If Wrecker is Furious, he will inflict Stun (prevents the character from taking their next turn) on all enemies.
data.MSG_EVENT_BASIC_TRAINING_EMPIRE_01_ZETA: Let's look at the Zeta abilities of Darth Vader and Grand Admiral Thrawn.
data.MSG_EVENT_BASIC_TRAINING_EMPIRE_02_ZETA: Grand Admiral Thrawn's Unique ability, [c][F0FF23]EBB AND FLOW[-][/c], interacts with the [c][F0FF23]FRACTURE[-][/c] debuff.
data.MSG_EVENT_BASIC_TRAINING_EMPIRE_03_ZETA: If an Empire ally uses a Special ability while Thrawn is active, the foe that has the [c][F0FF23]FRACTURE[-][/c] debuff will lose Turn Meter.
data.MSG_EVENT_BASIC_TRAINING_EMPIRE_04_ZETA: Meanwhile, the Zeta level of Darth Vader's Leader ability, [c][F0FF23]INSPIRING THROUGH FEAR[-][/c], will reapply Damage Over Time for 2 turns whenever Damage Over Time expires on your enemies.
data.MSG_EVENT_BASIC_TRAINING_EMPIRE_05_ZETA: Continue the fight and observe the power behind Zeta abilities.
data.MSG_EVENT_BASIC_TRAINING_EMPIRE_T1_01: You're outnumbered in this fight. But don't worry.
data.MSG_EVENT_BASIC_TRAINING_EMPIRE_T1_02: Darth Vader and Emperor Palpatine can debuff the opposition and escalate their attacks to finish off an enemy. Let me show you.
data.MSG_EVENT_BASIC_TRAINING_EMPIRE_T1_03: Use Emperor Palpatine's [c][F0FF23]POWER OF THE DARK SIDE[-][/c] to attack and Stun your enemies. You'll also grant Offense Up to Darth Vader.
data.MSG_EVENT_BASIC_TRAINING_EMPIRE_T1_04: Now follow up with Darth Vader's [c][F0FF23]FORCE CRUSH[-][/c] to deal more AoE damage and apply debuffs.
data.MSG_EVENT_BASIC_TRAINING_EMPIRE_T1_05: Use [c][F0FF23]LET THE HATE FLOW[-][/c] to give Health Steal Up to Darth Vader.
data.MSG_EVENT_BASIC_TRAINING_EMPIRE_T1_06: Attack with [c][F0FF23]CULLING BLADE[-][/c] which will deal extra damage for each debuff it dispels.
data.MSG_EVENT_BASIC_TRAINING_EMPIRE_T1_07: Even when outnumbered, you overwhelmed your enemies by using a combination of AoE attacks and debuffs, which lead to a huge strike.
data.MSG_EVENT_BASIC_TRAINING_EMPIRE_T1_08: Continue to use Darth Vader and Emperor Palpatine to crush your foes!
data.MSG_EVENT_BASIC_TRAINING_EMPIRE_T2_01: Grand Admiral Thrawn is a formidable ally that provides your team with a variety of combat and support abilities.
data.MSG_EVENT_BASIC_TRAINING_EMPIRE_T2_02: Let's use [c][F0FF23]GRAND ADMIRAL'S COMMAND[-][/c] to exchange Turn Meter with TIE Fighter Pilot and clear both their debuffs.
data.MSG_EVENT_BASIC_TRAINING_EMPIRE_T2_03: Use this opportunity to attack with [c][F0FF23]TIE STRIKE[-][/c] to deal AoE damage and debuff the enemy.
data.MSG_EVENT_BASIC_TRAINING_EMPIRE_T2_04: [c][F0FF23]FRACTURE[-][/c] is a debuff that prevents an enemy from gaining buffs, bonus Attacks, bonus Turn Meter, and prevents them from taking turns for a short while.
data.MSG_EVENT_BASIC_TRAINING_EMPIRE_T2_05: So let's attack with [c][F0FF23]FRACTURE[-][/c] and debuff the target enemy.
data.MSG_EVENT_BASIC_TRAINING_EMPIRE_T2_06: Thanks to Grand Admiral Thrawn's Leader ability, [c][F0FF23]LEGENDARY STRATEGIST[-][/c], all allies can use [c][F0FF23]MANEUVER[-][/c].
data.MSG_EVENT_BASIC_TRAINING_EMPIRE_T2_07: [c][F0FF23]MANEUVER[-][/c] allows an ally to Dispel all their debuffs and gain Turn Meter.
data.MSG_EVENT_BASIC_TRAINING_EMPIRE_T2_08: Using Grand Admiral Thrawn effectively will strengthen an Empire team with his array of powerful moves.
data.MSG_EVENT_BASIC_TRAINING_EMPIRE_T2_09: Now go and finish the fight!
data.MSG_EVENT_BASIC_TRAINING_EMPIRE_T3_01: Let's see how well a full Empire squad works together against the Rebels.
data.MSG_EVENT_BASIC_TRAINING_EMPIRE_T3_02: Use [c][F0FF23]GRAND ADMIRAL'S COMMAND[-][/c] to exchange Turn Meter with Emperor Palpatine.
data.MSG_EVENT_BASIC_TRAINING_EMPIRE_T3_03V2: Attack with [c][F0FF23]POWER OF THE DARK SIDE[-][/c] to damage and Stun all enemies. Your allies will also gain Offense Up.
data.MSG_EVENT_BASIC_TRAINING_EMPIRE_T3_04: Strike with [c][F0FF23]FRACTURE[-][/c] to debuff Commander Luke Skywalker.
data.MSG_EVENT_BASIC_TRAINING_EMPIRE_T3_05: Use [c][F0FF23]LET THE HATE FLOW[-][/c] to grant Health Steal Up to your party.
data.MSG_EVENT_BASIC_TRAINING_EMPIRE_T3_06: Continue the assault with [c][F0FF23]FORCE CRUSH[-][/c] to deal more AoE damage and apply debuffs.
data.MSG_EVENT_BASIC_TRAINING_EMPIRE_T3_07: Have Shoretrooper use [c][F0FF23]REGROUP[-][/c] to reapply Taunt and grant Critical Hit Immunity to your team.
data.MSG_EVENT_BASIC_TRAINING_EMPIRE_T3_08: Finally, top it off with an AoE attack from [c][F0FF23]TIE STRIKE[-][/c].
data.MSG_EVENT_BASIC_TRAINING_EMPIRE_T3_09: By unifying the abilities of your Empire squad, you managed to overwhelm the Rebels.
data.MSG_EVENT_BASIC_TRAINING_EMPIRE_T3_10: Now the rest is up to you. Good luck!
data.MSG_EVENT_BASIC_TRAINING_FIRSTORDER_01_Z: Let's look over the Zeta abilities of units from the First Order.
data.MSG_EVENT_BASIC_TRAINING_FIRSTORDER_02_Z: First Order TIE Pilot has a chance to gain Foresight for 2 turns when he loses Advantage, thanks to the Unique ability, [c][F0FF23]KEEN EYE[-][/c].
data.MSG_EVENT_BASIC_TRAINING_FIRSTORDER_03_Z: First Order Stormtrooper can call a random ally to assist and grants them Advantage for 2 turns if they were [c][F0FF23]FIRST ORDER[-][/c] because of the Unique ability [c][F0FF23]RETURN FIRE[-][/c].
data.MSG_EVENT_BASIC_TRAINING_FIRSTORDER_04_Z: Finally, Kylo Ren's Special ability, [c][F0FF23]OUTRAGE[-][/c], recovers Protection equal to the damage he dealt.
data.MSG_EVENT_BASIC_TRAINING_FIRSTORDER_05_Z: Continue the fight and win the battle by utilizing the Zeta abilities of your First Order units.
data.MSG_EVENT_BASIC_TRAINING_FIRSTORDER_T1_0: [c][F0FF23]ADVANTAGE[-][/c] is a buff that guarantees a Critical Hit on your next attack. Let me show you how to use it.
Use First Order Officer's Special ability, [c][F0FF23]MARCHING ORDERS[-][/c].
Now select First Order TIE Pilot to gain 100% Turn Meter, Offense Up, and [c][F0FF23]ADVANTAGE[-][/c].
First Order TIE Pilot now has [c][F0FF23]ADVANTAGE[-][/c].
Use the Special ability, [c][F0FF23]GUN DOWN[-][/c], to attack an enemy!
First Order TIE Pilot dealt a powerful strike and can inflict debuffs with [c][F0FF23]GUN DOWN[-][/c] by utilizing [c][F0FF23]ADVANTAGE[-][/c].
Use Captain Phasma's [c][F0FF23]VICTORY MARCH[-][/c] to grant all your allies [c][F0FF23]ADVANTAGE[-][/c] and gain the upper hand in this fight.
data.MSG_EVENT_BASIC_TRAINING_FIRSTORDER_T2_0: I'll show you how to utilize First Order abilities to change the flow of battle.
Use First Order Stormtrooper's [c][F0FF23]THE ORDER RELENTLESS[-][/c] to gain buffs and grant Turn Meter to Kylo Ren.
Use Kylo Ren's Special ability, [c][F0FF23]LASH OUT[-][/c], to deal damage and grant Turn Meter to First Order Trooper.
Now attack with First Order Stormtrooper's Basic ability, [c][F0FF23]HINDERING SHOT[-][/c].
The ebb and flow of battle is always in constant flux.
