Granting Turn Meter to your allies with First Order Trooper and Kylo Ren is a great step towards achieving victory.
data.MSG_EVENT_BASIC_TRAINING_FIRSTORDER_T3_0: Thanks to Captain Phasma's Leader ability, [c][F0FF23]FIRE AT WILL[-][/c], all First Order Allies start the encounter with [c][F0FF23]ADVANTAGE[-][/c].
Start by using First Order Officer's Basic ability, [c][F0FF23]CAPITALIZE[-][/c], to utilize the guaranteed critical hit.
Next, use First Order TIE Pilot's Special ability, [c][F0FF23]GUN DOWN[-][/c], to inflict debuffs thanks to having [c][F0FF23]ADVANTAGE[-][/c].
Now use Captain Phasma's [c][F0FF23]FUSILLADE[-][/c] ability to deal critical damage to the enemy team and slow them down.
Then have Kylo Ren use [c][F0FF23]LASH OUT[-][/c] to damage all enemies and increase the Turn Meter of First Order allies.
Use [c][F0FF23]THE ORDER RELENTLESS[-][/c] to gain buffs and grant Turn Meter to all First Order allies.
Always keep [c][F0FF23]ADVANTAGE[-][/c] up on your First Order allies and use Turn Meter gain to change the flow of battle.
Now you're on your own for the rest of the fight. Good luck!
data.MSG_EVENT_BASIC_TRAINING_REBEL_01_ZETA: Let's take a look at the Zeta abilities of your Rebel team.
data.MSG_EVENT_BASIC_TRAINING_REBEL_02_ZETA: R2-D2's Unique ability, [c][F0FF23]COMBAT ANALYSIS[-][/c], allows Light Side allies to dispel their debuffs whenever they score a Critical Hit.
data.MSG_EVENT_BASIC_TRAINING_REBEL_03_ZETA: The Zeta level of Han Solo's Unique, [c][F0FF23]SHOOTS FIRST[-][/c], will have Han attack again if he uses his Basic attack first on his turn.
data.MSG_EVENT_BASIC_TRAINING_REBEL_04_ZETA: The Zeta level for Princess Leia's Unique, [c][F0FF23]AGAINST ALL ODDS[-][/c], allows her to recover Protection and Health.
data.MSG_EVENT_BASIC_TRAINING_REBEL_05_ZETA: Now combine the Zeta abilities of your Rebel squad to win this fight!
data.MSG_EVENT_BASIC_TRAINING_REBEL_T1_01: A good defense leads to a great offense. I'll show you how.
data.MSG_EVENT_BASIC_TRAINING_REBEL_T1_02: Use Obi-Wan Kenobi's ability, [c][F0FF23]DEVOTED PROTECTOR[-][/c], to gain Taunt and provide Defense Up to allies.
data.MSG_EVENT_BASIC_TRAINING_REBEL_T1_03: Now use Princess Leia's [c][F0FF23]REBEL TACTICS[-][/c] to increase her offensive power with Stealth and Critical Damage Up.
data.MSG_EVENT_BASIC_TRAINING_REBEL_T1_04: Thanks to [c][F0FF23]DEVOTED PROTECTOR[-][/c] from Obi-Wan Kenobi, your team received minimal damage.
data.MSG_EVENT_BASIC_TRAINING_REBEL_T1_05: Fire away with Princess Leia's Basic ability, [c][F0FF23]HAIR TRIGGER[-][/c]!
data.MSG_EVENT_BASIC_TRAINING_REBEL_T1_06: Finish this sequence by using Obi-Wan Kenobi's ability, [c][F0FF23]MIND TRICKS[-][/c], to inflict debuffs on the enemy team.
data.MSG_EVENT_BASIC_TRAINING_REBEL_T1_07: By combining the strengths of Princess Leia and Obi-Wan Kenobi, you were able to change the combat in your favor.
data.MSG_EVENT_BASIC_TRAINING_REBEL_T1_08: Continue to utilize the powerful synergy between these two Rebel allies to win this fight!
data.MSG_EVENT_BASIC_TRAINING_REBEL_T2_01: Han Solo can act first at the start of each encounter, thanks to his Unique ability, [c][F0FF23]SHOOTS FIRST[-][/c].
data.MSG_EVENT_BASIC_TRAINING_REBEL_T2_02: Begin by using [c][F0FF23]QUICK DRAW[-][/c] to Stun the enemy.
data.MSG_EVENT_BASIC_TRAINING_REBEL_T2_03: Use Commander Luke Skywalker's ability, [c][F0FF23]USE THE FORCE[-][/c], to attack and dispel Taunt from Stormtrooper.
data.MSG_EVENT_BASIC_TRAINING_REBEL_T2_04: Enhance Han Solo's next attack by using [c][F0FF23]NEVER TELL ME THE ODDS[-][/c].
data.MSG_EVENT_BASIC_TRAINING_REBEL_T2_05: Use [c][F0FF23]DEADEYE[-][/c] to deal significant damage and gain Turn Meter.
data.MSG_EVENT_BASIC_TRAINING_REBEL_T2_06: Now you can follow up with another attack by using [c][F0FF23]QUICK DRAW[-][/c].
data.MSG_EVENT_BASIC_TRAINING_REBEL_T2_07: You've gained a huge lead on this encounter by disrupting the enemy lineup. Now go and finish the fight!
data.MSG_EVENT_BASIC_TRAINING_REBEL_T3_01: R2-D2 can become a phenomenal ally in battle when used effectively.
data.MSG_EVENT_BASIC_TRAINING_REBEL_T3_02: Start by using the Special ability, [c][F0FF23]SMOKE SCREEN[-][/c].
data.MSG_EVENT_BASIC_TRAINING_REBEL_T3_03: Now select Obi-Wan Kenobi to gain Foresight and Advantage.
data.MSG_EVENT_BASIC_TRAINING_REBEL_T3_04: Meanwhile, all other allies received Stealth, which will greatly benefit Princess Leia.
data.MSG_EVENT_BASIC_TRAINING_REBEL_T3_05: Using [c][F0FF23]REBEL TACTICS[-][/c] will now provide her with Offense Up, Foresight, and double Turn Meter gain.
data.MSG_EVENT_BASIC_TRAINING_REBEL_T3_06: With such minimal setup, she can use [c][F0FF23]Hair Trigger[-][/c] at maximum potential right away.
data.MSG_EVENT_BASIC_TRAINING_REBEL_T3_07: Using [c][F0FF23]DEVOTED PROTECTOR[-][/c] will work really well with Foresight and Advantage from earlier.
data.MSG_EVENT_BASIC_TRAINING_REBEL_T3_08: R2-D2 is not without attacking abilities.
data.MSG_EVENT_BASIC_TRAINING_REBEL_T3_09: Use [c][F0FF23]IMPROVISE[-][/c] to deal damage and apply the Burning debuff.
data.MSG_EVENT_BASIC_TRAINING_REBEL_T3_10: With the effective use of R2-D2, you're well on your way to winning this fight!
data.MSG_EVENT_BASIC_TRAINING_REBEL_T4_01: Let's use the lessons of your basic training and combine the abilities of the Rebel squad.
data.MSG_EVENT_BASIC_TRAINING_REBEL_T4_02: Start by using [c][F0FF23]QUICK DRAW[-][/c] to Stun the enemy.
data.MSG_EVENT_BASIC_TRAINING_REBEL_T4_03: Now use [c][F0FF23]SMOKE SCREEN[-][/c] and select Obi-Wan Kenobi.
data.MSG_EVENT_BASIC_TRAINING_REBEL_T4_04: Enhance the attack of your allies with [c][F0FF23]NEVER TELL ME THE ODDS[-][/c].
data.MSG_EVENT_BASIC_TRAINING_REBEL_T4_05: Boost Princess Leia's offensive capabilities further with [c][F0FF23]REBEL TACTICS[-][/c].
data.MSG_EVENT_BASIC_TRAINING_REBEL_T4_06: Attack the enemy with [c][F0FF23]HAIR TRIGGER[-][/c] to deal some damage.
data.MSG_EVENT_BASIC_TRAINING_REBEL_T4_07: Then strike with [c][F0FF23]USE THE FORCE[-][/c] and dispel Taunt from Stormtrooper.
data.MSG_EVENT_BASIC_TRAINING_REBEL_T4_08: Use [c][F0FF23]DEADEYE[-][/c] to deal significant damage and gain Turn Meter.
data.MSG_EVENT_BASIC_TRAINING_REBEL_T4_09: Follow up the next attack with [c][F0FF23]QUICK DRAW[-][/c].
data.MSG_EVENT_BASIC_TRAINING_REBEL_T4_10: Damage the enemy team with [c][F0FF23]IMPROVISE[-][/c] and apply the Burning debuff.
data.MSG_EVENT_BASIC_TRAINING_REBEL_T4_11: Finally, protect your squad by using Obi-wan Kenobi's [c][F0FF23]DEVOTED PROTECTOR[-][/c].
data.MSG_EVENT_BASIC_TRAINING_REBEL_T4_12: The Rebel team is a formidable squad that combines offense, defense, supportive abilities, and disruptive attacks.
data.MSG_EVENT_BASIC_TRAINING_REBEL_T4_13: Now use these abilities together to ensure your victory in this battle!
data.MSG_EVENT_BASIC_TRAINING_RESISTANCE_01: Enemies suffering from the [c][F0FF23]EXPOSE[-][/c] debuff will take additional damage when they are attacked. Let me show you how to use it.
data.MSG_EVENT_BASIC_TRAINING_RESISTANCE_01_T: Let's utilize the buffs that BB-8, Finn and Poe can grant to your team. Then we'll strike and debuff your opponents.
Let's see what Zeta ability upgrades do for the Resistance faction.
Let's combine the abilities of your [c][F0FF23]RESISTANCE[-][/c] team to defeat the enemy.
data.MSG_EVENT_BASIC_TRAINING_RESISTANCE_02: Start by using Rey's Special ability, [c][F0FF23]LEVERAGE[-][/c], to deal damage and gain Foresight.
data.MSG_EVENT_BASIC_TRAINING_RESISTANCE_02_T: Use [c][F0FF23]COVERT DATA TRANSFER[-][/c] to apply [c][F0FF23]SECRET INTEL[-][/c] to both BB-8 and a random ally to increase their Potency.
BB-8's [c][F0FF23]ROLL WITH THE PUNCHES[-][/c] Unique ability Zeta calls a Resistance ally to assist when he attacks out of turn.
Use [c][F0FF23]COVERT DATA TRANSFER[-][/c] to apply [c][F0FF23]SECRET INTEL[-][/c] to both BB-8 and a random ally to increase their Potency.
data.MSG_EVENT_BASIC_TRAINING_RESISTANCE_03: Now have Resistance Trooper use [c][F0FF23]FLUSH OUT[-][/c] to deal damage and apply [c][F0FF23]EXPOSE[-][/c].
data.MSG_EVENT_BASIC_TRAINING_RESISTANCE_03_T: Use Finn's [c][F0FF23]HOLD THE LINE[-][/c] to gain Advantage, Defense Up, Taunt, and Determination.
Rey's [c][F0FF23]FOCUSED STRIKES[-][/c] Unique ability Zeta lets her inflict [c][F0FF23]DAZE[-][/c] when she uses a Special ability.
Deal damage with [c][F0FF23]LEVERAGE[-][/c] and buff Rey.
data.MSG_EVENT_BASIC_TRAINING_RESISTANCE_04: Next, have Rey use [c][F0FF23]FLURRY OF BLOWS[-][/c] to deal significant damage.
data.MSG_EVENT_BASIC_TRAINING_RESISTANCE_04_T: Use [c][F0FF23]RESISTANCE BRAVADO[-][/c] to gain Taunt and apply [c][F0FF23]EXPOSE[-][/c] to your enemies.
Finn's Leader ability Zeta allows Resistance allies to take turns sooner and use Special abilities more often when damaging enemies with [c][F0FF23]EXPOSE[-][/c].
Use [c][F0FF23]RESISTANCE BRAVADO[-][/c] to gain Taunt and apply [c][F0FF23]EXPOSE[-][/c] to your enemies.
data.MSG_EVENT_BASIC_TRAINING_RESISTANCE_05: [c][F0FF23]EXPOSE[-][/c] expires once an enemy receives a hit. So it's important to reapply the debuff as much as possible.
data.MSG_EVENT_BASIC_TRAINING_RESISTANCE_05_T: Now attack with BB-8's [c][F0FF23]ARC WELDER[-][/c] to deal damage and inflict Tenacity Down.
Taking the time to upgrade your abilities to the Zeta tier will increase your team's effectiveness. Now test their Zeta abilities out in this training battle.
Attack with [c][F0FF23]OPPORTUNE STRIKE[-][/c] to deal damage and dispel the enemy's buff.
data.MSG_EVENT_BASIC_TRAINING_RESISTANCE_06: Have Poe use [c][F0FF23]RESISTANCE BRAVADO[-][/c] to gain Taunt and apply [c][F0FF23]EXPOSE[-][/c] to the enemy team.
data.MSG_EVENT_BASIC_TRAINING_RESISTANCE_06_T: Use [c][F0FF23]CHALLENGING SHOT[-][/c] to deal damage with a chance to apply Offense Down.
Use Finn's [c][F0FF23]HOLD THE LINE[-][/c] to gain Advantage, Defense Up, Taunt, and Determination.
data.MSG_EVENT_BASIC_TRAINING_RESISTANCE_07: Finally, use [c][F0FF23]OPPORTUNE STRIKE[-][/c] to deal damage and dispel the enemy's buff.
data.MSG_EVENT_BASIC_TRAINING_RESISTANCE_07_T: Then strike with [c][F0FF23]TAKEDOWN[-][/c] to damage the enemy, apply Expose, and Stun them.
Damage the enemy with [c][F0FF23]ARC WELDER[-][/c] and inflict Tenacity Down.
data.MSG_EVENT_BASIC_TRAINING_RESISTANCE_08: Continue the fight by reapplying [c][F0FF23]EXPOSE[-][/c] and attacking them for extra damage. This will be the key to win this encounter.
data.MSG_EVENT_BASIC_TRAINING_RESISTANCE_08_T: Keep utilizing buffs to strengthen your [c][F0FF23]RESISTANCE[-][/c] team and attack to inflict debuffs on the enemy side.
Finally, use [c][F0FF23]FLURRY OF BLOWS[-][/c] to deal significant damage.
data.MSG_EVENT_BASIC_TRAINING_RESISTANCE_09_T: Continue to utilize the abilities of your [c][F0FF23]RESISTANCE[-][/c] team to win this fight!
data.MSG_EVENT_BASIC_TRAINING_RESISTANCE_DETE: Determination is a defensive effect that grants Taunt to Finn whenever any Resistance ally falls below 50% Health.
If that ally was Taunting it is dispelled, and when Determination expires Finn gains Retribution. Now let's continue.
data.MSG_EVENT_BASIC_TRAINING_RESISTANCE_FINN: In addition, Resistance allies that attack enemies with [c][F0FF23]EXPOSE[-][/c] will also reduce their Turn Meter.
data.MSG_EVENT_BASTILA_1-1: [c][F0FF23]JEDI ASSAULT[-][/c] deals damage, inflicts Ability Block, and deals more damage and has more Potency for each allied Jedi.
data.MSG_EVENT_BASTILA_2-1: [c][F0FF23]RALLY[-][/c] dispels Debuffs from Bastila and a target ally, then they both gain Offense and Defense up, and finally that ally is called to assist.
data.MSG_EVENT_BASTILA_3-1: [c][F0FF23]SUBVERT DEFENSES[-][/c] deals damage and dispels all Buffs on the target enemy.
data.MSG_EVENT_BASTILA_4-1: [c][F0FF23]LEGENDARY BATTLE MEDITATION[-][/c] grants other allies Turn Meter and Potency and Counter chance for one turn.
data.MSG_EVENT_BASTILA_5-1: [c][F0FF23]INITIATIVE[-][/c] grants Jedi allies powerful first-turn buffs and bonuses including Turn Meter and Protection Up.
data.MSG_EVENT_BASTILASHANDARK_1-1: [c][F0FF23]SITH ASSAULT[-][/c] deals damage, inflicts Ability Block, and deals more damage and has higher Critical Chance for each allied Sith.
data.MSG_EVENT_BASTILASHANDARK_2-1: [c][F0FF23]WILD LIGHTNING[-][/c] deals damage and inflicts Shock or bonus damage if the target was already Shocked.
data.MSG_EVENT_BASTILASHANDARK_3-1: [c][F0FF23]FEAR[-][/c] applies a Stun which inflicts multiple debuffs when it expires.
data.MSG_EVENT_BASTILASHANDARK_4-1: [c][F0FF23]CORRUPTED BATTLE MEDITATION[-][/c] reduces enemy Turn Meter, Critical Chance and Counter Chance while recovering Bastila's Protection.
data.MSG_EVENT_BASTILASHANDARK_5-1: [c][F0FF23]SITH APPRENTICE[-][/c] grants Defense, Tenacity, and Foresight to Bastila and her leader. If that leader is Sith, they both gain stacking Offense whenever an enemy is inflicted with Deathmark, Marked or Shock.
data.MSG_EVENT_BATCHERS3_1-1: I am pleased to announce the arrival of Batcher, the faithful companion of Omega and her allies to the holotables!
data.MSG_EVENT_BATCHERS3_1-2: Charge forward and pin enemies down to set your teammates up for success!
data.MSG_EVENT_BESET_ON_ALL_SIDES_1-1: I know the girl is here. Until she's turned over to me, your island will burn.
data.MSG_EVENT_BESET_ON_ALL_SIDES_3-1: Try to fight, and you will fail. The rebellion will be destroyed. You will die. Your apprentice will become a servant of evil.
data.MSG_EVENT_BESET_ON_ALL_SIDES_4-1: I have dismantled and destroyed over one hundred thousand of you type one Battle Droids.
data.MSG_EVENT_BESET_ON_ALL_SIDES_4-2: I'm giving you an opportunity to peacefully lay down your weapons, so that you may be reprogrammed to serve a better purpose than spreading the mindless violence and chaos which you have inflicted upon the galaxy.
data.MSG_EVENT_BOKATAN_1-1: [c][F0FF23]Bo-Katan Kryze[-][/c] is an inspiring Mandalorian Leader who works best with other Mandalorians.
data.MSG_EVENT_BOKATAN_1-2: [c][F0FF23]Practiced Aim[-][/c] inflicts Vulnerable on her target. If she attacks out of turn, she instead deals 50% more damage.
data.MSG_EVENT_BOKATAN_2-1: [c][F0FF23]Crippling Strike[-][/c] is great for dispelling buffs on the enemy and dazing them so they are unable to attack out of turn.
data.MSG_EVENT_BOKATAN_3-1: [c][F0FF23]Unite the Clans[-][/c] calls other Mandalorian allies to assist whenever a Mandalorian ally uses a Basic ability during their turn.
data.MSG_EVENT_BOKATAN_3-2: It also grants stacking Critical Damage to Mandalorian allies who attack out of turn
data.MSG_EVENT_BOKATAN_4-1: [c][F0FF23]Stronger Together[-][/c] grants Max Protection to Mandalorian allies for each Mandalorian ally, while also allowing them to recover Health whenever a Mandalorian attacks out of turn.
data.MSG_EVENT_BOKATAN_5-1: [c][F0FF23]Unite the Clans[-][/c] grants all Mandalorian allies the ability [c][F0FF23]Ancestral Armor[-][/c], allowing them to dispel all debuffs from themselves and gain Defense Up, Taunt, and Tenacity Up.
data.MSG_EVENT_BOOMADIER_1-1: As a member of the Gungan Grand Army, this brave soldier stood against the Trade Federation during the Invasion of Naboo.
data.MSG_EVENT_BOOMADIER_1-2: I am happy to introduce to the Holotables, the Gungan Boomadier!
data.MSG_EVENT_BOSSK_0-1: Bounty Hunters have [c][F0FF23]CONTRACTS[-][/c] which grant huge bonuses when Activated.
data.MSG_EVENT_BOSSK_0-2: Fulfill the Contract according to the [c][F0FF23]CONTRACT CONDITIONS[-][/c]. These are determined by the Squad leader.
data.MSG_EVENT_BOSSK_0-3: Fulfill Bossk's Contract by attacking the [c][F0FF23]WEAKEST[-][/c] enemy (lowest combined current Health and Protection) [c][F0FF23]TEN[-][/c] times with any Bounty Hunter.
data.MSG_EVENT_BOSSK_0-4: Bounty Hunters with an activated Contract Ability gain their [c][F0FF23]PAYOUT[-][/c] bonuses when any Contract is Fulfilled.
data.MSG_EVENT_BOSSK_1-1: [c][F0FF23]PREY ON THE WEAK[-][/c] deals Physical damage and will Critically Hit the weakest enemy if they are the target.
data.MSG_EVENT_BOSSK_2-1: [c][F0FF23]HUNTING PARTY[-][/c] Stuns the target and calls Bounty Hunters to assist for reduced damage.
data.MSG_EVENT_BOSSK_3-1: [c][F0FF23]PREDATOR INSTINCTS[-][/c] dispels all Debuffs on Bossk and grants him Taunt and Frenzy.
data.MSG_EVENT_BOSSK_4-1: [c][F0FF23]ON THE HUNT[-][/c] grants all Bounty Hunters bonus Protection and Tenacity.
data.MSG_EVENT_BOSSK_5-1: [c][F0FF23]TRANDOSHAN RAGE[-][/c] grants Bossk Health and Defense while Taunting, and Offense and Health Steal while attacking buffed enemies.
data.MSG_EVENT_BOSSNASS_1-1: I am pleased to announce the addition of the boisterous Boss of Otoh Gunga, Boss Nass to the holotables!
data.MSG_EVENT_BOSSNASS_1-2: Rugor Nass was a respected and eccentric Ankura Gungan who served as Boss of the Gungan people and helped establish peace between the Naboo and Gungans during the invasion of their homeworld by the Trade Federation.
data.MSG_EVENT_BOUSHH_1-1: I am pleased to announce that we are bringing to the holotables the Bounty Hunter Boushh!
data.MSG_EVENT_BOUSHH_1-2: For a time, Boushh was a disguise donned by Leia Organa in the Rebels' attempt to rescue Han Solo from Jabba the Hutt.
data.MSG_EVENT_BOUSHH_1-3: The Bounty Hunter was known for their bargaining tactics and use of Thermal Detonators, and these aspects were key factors in Leia's deception.
data.MSG_EVENT_BOUSHH_1-4: Boushh (Leia Organa)'s Basic Ability is [c][ffff33]Ambidextrous Assault[-][/c]. With this attack Boushh will inflict damage on her target while at the same time inflicting them with a Thermal Detonator (an undispellable debuff that inflicts damage after a number of turns have elapsed).
data.MSG_EVENT_BOUSHH_1-5: Boushh's Thermal Detonators will explode on their own after two turns of them existing on the target, dealing additional damage.
data.MSG_EVENT_BOUSHH_1-6: If the Leader of Boushh's squad has the tags Bounty Hunter, Hutt Cartel, and/or Smuggler, this ability gains additional effects!
data.MSG_EVENT_BOUSHH_2-1: Boushh is renowned for the use of Thermal Detonators and with the ability [c][ffff33]Inventive[-][/c], Boushh (Leia Organa) can prematurely detonate all Thermal Detonators on all opponents. Then she'll inflict an additional Thermal Detonator on everyone on the opposing side.
data.MSG_EVENT_BOUSHH_3-1: Boushh's Unique ability, [c][ffff33]Fearless[-][/c], makes her immune to Fear and will start her off with the buff [c][ffff33]My Kind of Scum[-][/c], giving her increased Defense and Max Health.
data.MSG_EVENT_BOUSHH_3-2: Additionally she will put the effect [c][ffff33]Deadly Bluff[-][/c] on all her opponents. While under this effect, enemies who receive any Thermal Detonators will be inflicted with an additional one at the end of the turn.
data.MSG_EVENT_BOUSHH_3-3: If all allies were Hutt Cartel at the start of battle, Deadly Bluff prevents out of turn attacks and lowers the Speed of any opponents inflicted with a Thermal Detonator.
data.MSG_EVENT_BOUSHH_4-1: Boushh (Leia Organa) wears [c][ffff33]Ubese Ogygian Cloak[-][/c] armor, giving her additional bonus stats, and if her entire squad is Hutt Cartel, makes her immune to Stun (can't assist or counter attack and miss their next turn) and Ability Block (can't use Special abilities during their turn).
data.MSG_EVENT_BOUSHH_4-2: Light Side Smuggler allies will also gain these bonuses as well as an increased chance to critically hit.
data.MSG_EVENT_BOUSHH_4-3: With her Omicron active, she will gain the following effects in Guild Raids: Reduce the cooldown of Inventive, and whenever Fearless inflicts an additional Thermal Detonator, if the ally in the Leader slot is Hutt Cartel, all Hutt Cartel allies gain bonus stats that last until the end of battle.
data.MSG_EVENT_BOUSHH_5-1: Boushh (Leia Organa)'s Leader ability gives her Bounty Hunter allies additional Max Health and Max Protection, and Deadly Bluff lowers the Tenacity of her opponents.
data.MSG_EVENT_BOUSHH_5-2: Additionally, at the end of any turn where an enemy has both Deadly Bluff and a Thermal Detonator, dispel all buffs on them.
data.MSG_EVENT_BOUSHH_5-3: Completing her Contract involves defeating an enemy from the damage of Thermal Detonator, which will then reward all Bounty Hunter allies with immunity to Stun and defeated enemies can no longer be revived.
data.MSG_EVENT_BOUSHH_5-4: Boushh's payout will inflict multiple Thermal Detonators on all enemies, and all of her abilities inflict an additional Thermal Detonator until the end of battle. If all allies were Hutt Cartel at the start of battle, the cooldown of Inventive is immediately refreshed and reduced until the end of battle.
data.MSG_EVENT_BRUTUS_1-1: I am excited to announce that we are adding the mutinous Pirate Brutus to the holotables.
data.MSG_EVENT_BRUTUS_1-2: Brutus is a bold and cunning Shistavanen Pirate Captain who has forged his legend across the untamed reaches of the Outer Rim.
data.MSG_EVENT_BT1000_1-1: Doctor Aphra was infamous for her two droids, Triple Zero and BT-1, and now we've got both of them on the holotables!
data.MSG_EVENT_BT1000_1-2: BT-1's [c][ffff33]Overcharged Laser[-][/c] will fire three shots and inflict the target with a Damage Over Time effect (inflicts damage at the start of their turn).
data.MSG_EVENT_BT1000_1-3: 0-0-0's Basic ability [c][ffff33]Fatal Shock[-][/c] deals damage and inflicts Shock (can't heal, gain buffs, or gain bonus turn meter). If the target is a non-Droid and already had Shock, it will Stun them instead.
data.MSG_EVENT_BT1000_1-4: Defeating an enemy with this ability will give 0-0-0 a stack of Translation (a variety of bonuses based on how many stacks a character has).
data.MSG_EVENT_BT1000_2-1: 0-0-0's Special ability [c][ffff33]Specialized in Torture[-][/c] deals damage and inflicts Torture (take additional damage, reduced Defense, and can't gain bonus Turn Meter) on the target.
data.MSG_EVENT_BT1000_2-2: If the target already had Torture, deal damage to all enemies and all Dark Side allies gain a stack of Translation.
data.MSG_EVENT_BT1000_2-3: BT-1's Special ability [c][ffff33]Agent of Destruction[-][/c] will deal damage to all enemies, inflict Expose (receives additional damage from attacks) and a stack of Damage Over Time.
data.MSG_EVENT_BT1000_2-4: If the primary target had Target Lock (certain abilities have improved interactions against Target Lock), they will receive another stack of Damage Over Time as well as Burning (deals damage each turn and decreases chance to evade attacks).
data.MSG_EVENT_BT1000_3-1: 0-0-0's Unique ability [c][ffff33]Interrogation Protocol[-][/c] will grant Dark Side allies Critical Damage (increases the damage of critical hits).
data.MSG_EVENT_BT1000_3-2: And whenever a Dark Side ally uses an ability on an enemy with Torture, they will gain 1 stack of Translation (max 3). Those same allies will gain Potency (debuffs on enemies are harder to resist) for each stack of Translation on them (doubled for Droids).
data.MSG_EVENT_BT1000_3-3: BT-1's Unique ability [c][ffff33]Homicidal Counterpart[-][/c] gives him bonus Critical Damage (increases the damage of critical hits) for Droid allies, Potency for Dark Side allies, and Speed (takes turns more often) for Scoundrel allies. When 0-0-0 is an active ally, BT-1 will assist whenever 0-0-0 uses a Special ability, and gains a new ability named [c][ffff33]Kill Them All[-][/c].
data.MSG_EVENT_BT1000_3-4: Kill Them All will deal damage to all enemies and call 0-0-0 to assist.
data.MSG_EVENT_BT1000_4-1: BT-1's other Unique ability is [c][ffff33]Blastomech Prototype[-][/c], which increases his Offense (increases ability damage).
data.MSG_EVENT_BT1000_4-2: In addition, whenever BT-1 defeats an enemy he gets a bonus turn where he must activate [c][ffff33]Haywire[-][/c], damaging all other characters, including your own (this damage can't defeat them).
data.MSG_EVENT_BT1000_4-3: 0-0-0's second Unique ability is [c][ffff33]Drain Organics[-][/c], which will see that whenever 0-0-0 or BT-1 gains Translation, the other receives it as well.
data.MSG_EVENT_BT1000_4-4: Additionally, at the start of 0-0-0's turn, a random non-Droid enemy without Target Lock gets Target Lock, and when defeating an enemy the attacking ally gains Health and Protection, and additional bonuses if that ally is a Dark Side Droid or BT-1.
data.MSG_EVENT_BT1000_5-1: Both BT-1 and 0-0-0 have Omicrons that are active in the 3v3 Grand Arena game mode.
data.MSG_EVENT_BT1000_5-2: 0-0-0's Specialized Torture will extend how long Torture lasts as well as recovering Health and Protection for himself and BT-1. If this ability defeats an enemy, Dark Side allies gain Offense, doubled for Droids.
data.MSG_EVENT_BT1000_5-3: BT-1's Unique ability Homicidal Counterpart also has additional effects in 3v3 Grand Arena with the Omicron tier activated.
data.MSG_EVENT_BT1000_5-4: If either droid defeats an enemy, their cooldowns are refreshed and they both recover Turn Meter (determines how quickly a character can take another turn).
data.MSG_EVENT_BWINGREBEL_1-1: I am pleased to announce that the heavy-hitting Rebel B-wing is here, ready to break through Imperial lines on the holotables!
data.MSG_EVENT_BWINGREBEL_1-2: The Rebel B-wing is a heavy assault starfighter, famed for its firepower and key role in Rebel victories.
data.MSG_EVENT_C3POCHEWBACCA_1-1: [c][F0FF23]Threepio & Chewie[-][/c] are a Rebel Attacker duo that can distract their enemies with Blind and deal significant damage to all enemies in multi-encounter battles.
data.MSG_EVENT_C3POCHEWBACCA_1-2: [c][F0FF23]Frantic Shot[-][/c] deals damage and inflicts Evasion Down on the target enemy.
data.MSG_EVENT_C3POCHEWBACCA_2-1: [c][F0FF23]Shining Distraction[-][/c] dispels all debuffs from Threepio & Chewie, Rebel allies recover Protection and gain Advantage, and dispels all buffs from all enemies with a chance to Blind them.
data.MSG_EVENT_C3POCHEWBACCA_3-1: [c][F0FF23]Chewie's Rage[-][/c] deals damage to all enemies. Threepio & Chewie gain a stacking Offense bonus whenever this ability defeats an enemy.
data.MSG_EVENT_C3POCHEWBACCA_3-2: When fully upgraded, this ability deals damage multiple times based on the number of defeated enemies.
data.MSG_EVENT_C3POCHEWBACCA_4-1: [c][F0FF23]I Must Tell The Others[-][/c] grants Threepio & Chewie and other Rebels a percentage of a Rebel leader's stats and Rebel allies gain additional Critical Avoidance.
data.MSG_EVENT_C3POCHEWBACCA_4-2: This ability also reduces enemies' Tenacity and prevents them from attacking out of turn while Blinded.
data.MSG_EVENT_CALKESTIS_1-1: Cal Kestis was an elusive young Padawan who fled to the scrapper planet of Bracca in the wake of Order 66. I'm pleased to bring him out of hiding and onto the holotables!
data.MSG_EVENT_CALKESTIS_1-2: Cal's Basic ability, [c][ffff33]Overhead Slash[-][/c], deals Physical damage to target enemy and inflicts Defense Down (reduced Defense stat) and Speed Down (takes turns less often). Cal performs additional attacks as his Health gets lower.
data.MSG_EVENT_CALKESTIS_2-1: [c][ffff33]Help Me, BD-1[-][/c] dispels debuffs on Cal's target ally and recovers Health or, if they are at full Health, recovers Protection instead. If the ally has full Health and Protection, they gain Critical Hit Immunity (can't be critically hit) for 2 turns instead.
data.MSG_EVENT_CALKESTIS_2-2: If Cal's ally is Light Side, they gain Accuracy Up (increased chance of landing an attack on an enemy) for 2 turns.
data.MSG_EVENT_CALKESTIS_3-1: Use Cal's Special ability, [c][ffff33]Not So Fast[-][/c], to control the flow of battle by inflicting Defense Down, Evasion Down (lower chance to avoid an enemy attack), and Speed Down on all enemies.
data.MSG_EVENT_CALKESTIS_3-2: If an enemy was already inflicted with Speed Down, Cal will Stun them (can't assist or counter attack and miss their next turn).
data.MSG_EVENT_CALKESTIS_4-1: Cal gains stacks of [c][ffff33]Persistence[-][/c] (max 30) whenever an ally or enemy uses a Special ability. If an enemy takes the first turn in battle, Cal gains 15 stacks of Persistence.
data.MSG_EVENT_CALKESTIS_4-2: At the start of his turn, Cal will grant buffs to his allies or inflict debuffs on his enemies depending on how many stacks of Persistence he has.
data.MSG_EVENT_CALKESTIS_4-3: While in Territory Wars and if there is an allied Ahsoka Tano (Fulcrum) with an Omicron: Ahsoka's full Omicron benefits are no longer disabled by having allies present.
data.MSG_EVENT_CANDEROUS_1-1: Use [c][F0FF23]Interminable Assault[-][/c] to attack an enemy multiple times.
data.MSG_EVENT_CANDEROUS_2-1: [c][F0FF23]Overwhelming Firepower[-][/c] deals damage to all enemies and inflicts Offense Down on them. This attack ignores Armor.
data.MSG_EVENT_CANDEROUS_3-1: [c][F0FF23]I Like a Challenge[-][/c] allows Canderous to deal additional damage to taunting enemies and gain buffs when an enemy gains a Taunt effect.
data.MSG_EVENT_CANDEROUS_4-1: With [c][F0FF23]Mandalorian Veteran[-][/c], Canderous inflicts Damage Over Time effects on enemies when he damages them.
data.MSG_EVENT_CAPTAINDROGAN_1-1: I am pleased to announce the arrival of Captain Drogan to the holotables! Fennro Drogan was a native of the planet Ghorman who had a limb difference and served as a member of the Ghorman Front prior to joining the Rebel Alliance.
data.MSG_EVENT_CAPTAINDROGAN_1-2: When the Rebellion called for stalwart soldiers, Drogan was quick to answer and lend his talents to the cause. An expert tactician, technician, and member of Bitter Pill Company, Drogan served the Rebellion with pride and helped bring Imperial forces to heel across multiple engagements.
data.MSG_EVENT_CAPTAINENOCH_1-1: I am pleased to announce the arrival of the captain of the guard for Grand Admiral Thrawn, Captain Enoch to the holotables!
data.MSG_EVENT_CAPTAINENOCH_1-2: Ominous and intensely loyal to his superior, Captain Enoch served Thrawn on the planet of Peridea, commanding his troopers and helping oversee and execute Thrawn's strategies during his time there.
data.MSG_EVENT_CAPTAINREX_1-1: An old-hand when it comes to battle, Captain Rex was a Clone Trooper whose dedication to his men and his beliefs continually pushed him to fight first against the Separatists and then against the Empire. I am honored to bring such a storied and experienced veteran to the holotables!
data.MSG_EVENT_CAPTAINSILVO_1-1: A cunning Pirate Captain with a taste for chaos, I'm thrilled to bring this unpredictable menace, Captain Silvo to the holotables!
data.MSG_EVENT_CAPTAINSILVO_1-2: Captain Silvo was known for his manipulative nature, ruthless ambition, and strategic mind.
data.MSG_EVENT_CAPTAINTARPALS_1-1: The fearless Captain Tarpals is added to the holotables!
data.MSG_EVENT_CAPTAINTARPALS_1-2: Captain Tarpals was a Gungan warrior who served in the Gungan Grand Army during the Invasion of Naboo and played a key role in defeating the Trade Federation.
data.MSG_EVENT_CARADUNE_1-1: Cara Dune is a resilient Tank who has synergy with Rebel or Scoundrel leaders.
data.MSG_EVENT_CARADUNE_1-2: [c][F0FF23]Bar Room Brawler[-][/c] deals damage to the target enemy and Cara Dune gains Stealth if a Scoundrel is in the leader slot or Taunt if a Rebel is.
data.MSG_EVENT_CARADUNE_2-1: [c][F0FF23]Improvised Strategy[-][/c] deals damage to all enemies, removes enemy Turn Meter, gives Cara Dune Potency Up and stuns Empire enemies.
data.MSG_EVENT_CARADUNE_3-1: [c][F0FF23]Infiltrator[-][/c] gives Cara Dune Critical Chance and Critical Damage Up while she is Stealthed.
data.MSG_EVENT_CARADUNE_3-2: When Cara Dune loses Taunt, she gains Stealth at the start of her next turn.
data.MSG_EVENT_CARADUNE_4-1: [c][F0FF23]Ex-Rebel Shock Trooper[-][/c] gives Cara Dune Critical Hit Immunity and bonus Turn Meter whenever an enemy is defeated.
data.MSG_EVENT_CARADUNE_4-2: If Cara Dune is defeated while she has Potency Up, she is revived and gains Potency Up.
data.MSG_EVENT_CARTH_1-1: [c][F0FF23]RAPID SHOT[-][/c] deals damage and inflicts Damage Over Time.
data.MSG_EVENT_CARTH_2-1: [c][F0FF23]JUST KEEP SHOOTING[-][/c] deals damage to all enemies and grants Carth Offense Up.
data.MSG_EVENT_CARTH_3-1: [c][F0FF23]SOLDIER OF THE OLD REPUBLIC[-][/c] grants Potency, Tenacity, and Critical Avoidance to Old Republic allies.
data.MSG_EVENT_CARTH_4-1: [c][F0FF23]SOLDIER'S TRAINING[-][/c] grants Carth Offense for each enemy and Old Republic ally, and also gives him other bonuses when he defeats an enemy.
data.MSG_EVENT_CEREJUNDA_1-1: Cere Junda, the resilient former Jedi, has joined the holotables!
data.MSG_EVENT_CEREJUNDA_1-2: A survivor of Order 66, Cere lived in seclusion for many years and traveled the stars aboard the Stinger Mantis while maintaining her secret mission to rebuild the Jedi Order.
data.MSG_EVENT_CEREJUNDA_1-3: Her Basic ability, [c][ffff33]Keep Fighting[-][/c], deals damage and provides all allies with Accuracy Up (increased chance of landing an attack on an enemy) and any Unaligned Force User allies with Tenacity Up (increased chance to resist debuffs).
data.MSG_EVENT_CEREJUNDA_2-1: Use [c][ffff33]Force Barrier[-][/c] to give your allies bonus Protection (grants bonus Protection) and any Unaligned Force User allies Defense Up (increased Defense stat, which reduces incoming damage). The weakest Dark Side or other Light Side Unaligned Force User ally gains Damage Immunity (can't be damaged).
data.MSG_EVENT_CEREJUNDA_3-1: [c][ffff33]Determined Assault[-][/c] deals more damage the more turns an enemy has taken during an encounter. It additionally provides any Unaligned Force User allies with Defense Penetration Up (ignores some of a target's Defense stat) and the weakest other Light Side Unaligned Force User ally recovers 50% Health.
data.MSG_EVENT_CEREJUNDA_4-1: [c][ffff33]Rekindle[-][/c] punishes very fast enemy teams who take a lot of turns by providing any of her Unaligned Force User allies with additional stats whenever enemies take turns until the first time one of Cere's allies takes a turn.
data.MSG_EVENT_CEREJUNDA_4-2: With her Omicron active in the Grand Arenas game mode, this ability provides additional benefits for any Unaligned Force User ally who dispels buffs or debuffs and gives them extra Max Health and Max Protection.
data.MSG_EVENT_CEREJUNDA_5-1: With her Unique ability, [c][ffff33]Unity Through Adversity[-][/c], Cere gains different stacking stat increases for each Dark Side and Light Side Unaligned Force User ally and for each Jedi ally.
data.MSG_EVENT_CEREJUNDA_5-2: If all allies are Light Side or Dark Side Unaligned Force Users or Jedi and there are no Galactic Legend allies at the start of battle, Cere reduces her ability cooldowns whenever an enemy takes a turn, but will increase her own cooldowns when she ends her turn.
data.MSG_EVENT_CINTA_1-1: I am excited to announce the covert partisan [c][ffff33]Cinta Kaz[-][/c] is joining the holotables.
data.MSG_EVENT_CINTA_1-2: Cinta Kaz, a disciplined partisan fighter, blends into any environment as she stalks her targets, striking with precision to dismantle the Empire from within.
data.MSG_EVENT_CROSSHAIRS3_1-1: I am thrilled to announce the arrival of Crosshair (Scarred) to the holotables!
data.MSG_EVENT_CROSSHAIRS3_1-2: Crosshair served on the side of the Empire when Order 66 was first issued. Though his decisions during this time continue to haunt him, he found his way back home with Clone Force 99.
data.MSG_EVENT_DARKTROOPER_1-1: The Dark Troopers are droid soldiers utilized by the infamous Moff Gideon and now we've got them on the holotables.
data.MSG_EVENT_DARKTROOPER_1-2: Dark Troopers are deployed in squads of four, and this is represented by the [c][ffff33]Dark Trooper Squad[/c][-] status effect showing how many Dark Troopers remain in your squad.
data.MSG_EVENT_DARKTROOPER_2-1: [c][ffff33]Pneumatic Punch[/c][-] deals damage to the target a number of times equal to the amount of Dark Troopers in the [c][ffff33]Dark Trooper Squad[/c][-].
data.MSG_EVENT_DARKTROOPER_3-1: When fully upgraded [c][ffff33]Bombarding Reinforcements[/c][-] will not only deal damage to the entire enemy side, but add one to the [c][ffff33]Dark Trooper Squad[/c][-] if it is below three stacks.
data.MSG_EVENT_DARKTROOPER_4-1: [c][ffff33]Perfect Soldiers[/c][-] grants Turn Meter to Imperial Trooper allies and Offense Up to Imperial Remnant allies.
data.MSG_EVENT_DARTHREVAN_CONTEXT_01: I've done some more digging into Revan's history. There's credible evidence that Revan may have actually been a Sith Lord. Can you believe that?
data.MSG_EVENT_DARTHREVAN_CONTEXT_02: I've put together something new for you based on what might have happened if Revan wasn't the hero we thought, but was instead a villain. I call it [c][F0FF23]Scourge of the Old Republic[-][/c].
data.MSG_EVENT_DARTHTALON_1-1: [c][ffff33]Darth Talon[-][/c] is a Sith Lord that strengthens Sith teams with her swift and lethal attacks. Her loyalty to her leader is without question.
data.MSG_EVENT_DARTHTALON_1-2: [c][ffff33]Talon's Strike[-][/c] deals damage and inflicts Ability Block (can't use Special abilities during their turn) to her enemy. If her target was already debuffed, [c][F0FF23]Dark Frenzy's[-][/c] cooldown is lowered by 1.
data.MSG_EVENT_DARTHTALON_2-1: Darth Talon's ability, [c][ffff33]Ordered Assassination[-][/c], deals damage and grants her Stealth (can't be targeted by enemies unless only Stealthed targets are available).
data.MSG_EVENT_DARTHTALON_2-2: If [c][F0FF23]Ordered Assassination[-][/c] defeats an enemy, Darth Talon gains 100% Turn Meter (determines how quickly a character can take another turn).
data.MSG_EVENT_DARTHTALON_3-1: [c][ffff33]Dark Frenzy[-][/c] is a devastating attack that starts on cooldown. Attacking a debuffed target deals additional damage to all enemies.
data.MSG_EVENT_DARTHTALON_3-2: Attack debuffed enemies with [c][ffff33]Talon's Strike[-][/c] to lower the cooldown of [c][ffff33]Dark Frenzy[-][/c]!
data.MSG_EVENT_DARTHTALON_4-1: If all allies are Sith, [c][ffff33]Proven Loyalty[-][/c] prevents the allied leader from being defeated the first time they suffer fatal damage, and deals damage to Darth Talon. She also gains Stealth, 3 stacks of Loyal Hand, and the cooldown of [c][ffff33]Dark Frenzy[-][/c] is refreshed.
data.MSG_EVENT_DARTHTALON_4-2: In Grand Arenas, [c][ffff33]Sith Cruelty[-][/c] gives Darth Talon's attacks additional effects when attacking enemies inflicted with Isolate and Pain.
data.MSG_EVENT_DARTHTALON_4-3: If target enemy is inflicted with Isolate, Darth Talon's attacks will lower the cooldown of Dark Frenzy by 1, and grant 2 stacks of Loyal Hand.
data.MSG_EVENT_DARTHTALON_4-4: If target enemy is inflicted with Pain, Darth Talon's attacks will heal her allies based on the damage dealt, inflict Buff Immunity (immune to most buff effects) to all enemies when using [c][ffff33]Dark Frenzy[-][/c], grant 1 stack of Loyal Hand, and increase her speed for the rest of the encounter.
data.MSG_EVENT_DASHRENDAR_1-1: I'm excited to bring the legendary smuggler Dash Rendar to the holotables!
data.MSG_EVENT_DASHRENDAR_1-2: Dash gives Scoundrel allies extra Health, Offense (increases ability damage), and Potency (their debuffs are harder to resist). Additionally, if they have the Prepared status and land a critical hit, all Prepared allies gain Turn Meter.
data.MSG_EVENT_DASHRENDAR_1-3: Dash's [c][F0FF23]Fearless Advance[-][/c] deals damage three times to the target, and for each critical hit from this attack calls a random ally with the Prepared status to assist, dealing 70% less damage.
data.MSG_EVENT_DASHRENDAR_2-1: Dash's ability [c][F0FF23]Stop Right There![-][/c] will deal damage to the target, dispel all buffs on them, and attempt to Stun them (they can't counter-attack or assist and miss their next turn).
data.MSG_EVENT_DASHRENDAR_3-1_V2: [c][F0FF23]Seeker Missiles[-][/c] will deal multiple instances of damage, as well as inflicting Daze (can't counter-attack or assist), Defense Down (takes more damage from attacks), and Critical Damage Down (critical hits deal less damage).
data.MSG_EVENT_DASHRENDAR_4-1: When Dash is in the Leader slot Scoundrel allies enter the battle with Prepared and gain bonuses based on their role. If the battle is taking place in the Grand Arena mode, when any ally loses Prepared they gain Prepared!
data.MSG_EVENT_DEATHTROOPERPERIDEA_1-1: Recently resurrected and marching towards the holotable, please welcome Death Trooper (Peridea)!
data.MSG_EVENT_DEATHTROOPERPERIDEA_1-2: Resurrected via the Great Mothers' Majik, these elite soldiers of the Imperial Remnant attempted to foil the escape of Sabine Wren and Ezra Bridger during the battle of Peridea.
data.MSG_EVENT_DEDRAMEERO_1-1: I am excited to announce the arrival of a rising ISB supervisor, [c][ffff33]Dedra Meero[-][/c], to the holotables.
data.MSG_EVENT_DEDRAMEERO_1-2: Zealous and calculating, Dedra Meero embodies the Empire's ideology, using every resource to crush the Rebellion and enforce Imperial order across the galaxy.
data.MSG_EVENT_DEPABILLABA_1-1: I am delighted to welcome the arrival of Depa Billaba to the holotables!
data.MSG_EVENT_DEPABILLABA_1-2: Depa Billaba was a Jedi Master who served on the Jedi Council in the final years of the Republic. A former Padawan of Mace Windu, she later trained Caleb Dume as her own. Though she gave her life during Order 66, the legacy of her guidance and resilience lived on through Kanan Jarrus and Ezra Bridger.
data.MSG_EVENT_DISGUISEDCLONETROOPER_1-1: I am happy to announce the arrival of Disguised Clone Trooper to the holotables!
data.MSG_EVENT_DISGUISEDCLONETROOPER_1-2: Carry out Palpatine's orders by lying in wait to ambush the returning Jedi!
data.MSG_EVENT_DROIDEKA_1-1: The Droideka is a powerful Separatist Droid attacker that relies on Charge, which grants it 5% Offense per stack, and enhances its ability to destroy its enemies.
data.MSG_EVENT_DROIDEKA_1-2: [c][F0FF23]DEFLECTOR SHIELD GENERATOR[-][/c] grants the Droideka Turn Meter and Charge when enemies take a turn, and alters its Speed and other stats based on whether or not it has Damage Immunity.
data.MSG_EVENT_DROIDEKA_2-1: [c][F0FF23]TWIN BLASTER CANNONS[-][/c] deals damage to an enemy, and deals increasing true damage to targets with higher Speed.
data.MSG_EVENT_DROIDEKA_3-1: [c][F0FF23]DESTRUCTIVE ARMAMENT[-][/c] inflicts Target Lock and deals damage to an enemy, dealing additional true damage for each stack of Charge.
data.MSG_EVENT_DROIDEKA_4-1: [c][F0FF23]RECONSTRUCTIVE REVOLUTION[-][/c] dispels all debuffs on the Droideka, recovers Protection based on Charge, and grants Damage Immunity and Tenacity Up.
data.MSG_EVENT_EIGHTHBROTHER_1-1: Cruel and impulsive, this cunning assassin often charged into battle with reckless abandon. I'm pleased to welcome the fierce Inquisitor, Eighth Brother, to the holotables!
data.MSG_EVENT_EIGHTHBROTHER_1-2: Eighth Brother's Basic attack, [c][ffff33]Whirling Strike[-][/c], deals Physical damage to target enemy and inflicts a stack of Purge if the target is a Jedi, which can't be resisted. If Eighth Brother did not have Stealth (can't be targeted by enemies, unless only Stealthed targets are available) this turn, he gains Stealth for 3 turns.
data.MSG_EVENT_EIGHTHBROTHER_1-3: Purge can be applied up to 6 times to a target enemy. Those stacks are then consumed by Inquisitorius to apply different effects.
data.MSG_EVENT_EIGHTHBROTHER_2-1: Eighth Brother's Special ability, [c][ffff33]Photon Grenades[-][/c], deals Physical damage to all enemies and inflicts Accuracy Down (decreased chance of landing an attack on an enemy) and Burning (deals damage each turn and decreases chance to evade attacks) for 2 turns.
data.MSG_EVENT_EIGHTHBROTHER_2-2: If Eighth Brother did not have Stealth this turn, he gains Stealth for 3 turns.
data.MSG_EVENT_EIGHTHBROTHER_3-1: Eighth Brother's Special ability, [c][ffff33]Bladed Hilt[-][/c], deals Physical damage and consumes up to 5 stacks of Purge. For each stack of Purge consumed this way after the first, deal Physical damage again. If Eighth Brother did not have Stealth this turn, he gains Stealth for 3 turns.
data.MSG_EVENT_EIGHTHBROTHER_4-1: Empire allies gain Accuracy (increased chance of landing an attack on an enemy) and Potency (their debuffs are harder to resist) with Eighth Brother's Leader ability, [c][ffff33]More Than Enough[-][/c]. Inquisitorius allies gain additional Accuracy and Potency.
data.MSG_EVENT_EIGHTHBROTHER_4-2: Other Inquisitorius allies have a 30% chance to inflict a stack of Purge when using a Basic ability, which can't be copied or resisted. Jedi enemies that gain Foresight (the next incoming attack will be evaded if able) from Jedi Unique abilities also gain Blind (miss the next attack).
data.MSG_EVENT_EIGHTHBROTHER_4-3: While in Territory Wars, Jedi enemies that gain Taunt from Jedi Unique abilities take damage equal to 20% of their Max Health. This ability can't defeat enemies. Jedi enemies that gain Critical Hit Immunity (can't be critically hit) from Jedi Unique abilities dispel Critical Hit Immunity and are instead inflicted with Vulnerable (will be critically hit if able) for 1 turn.
data.MSG_EVENT_EIGHTHBROTHER_5-1: At the start of battle, Eighth Brother gains Stealth for 3 turns. If Eighth Brother starts his turn and is Stealthed, when he uses an ability he loses Stealth and gains Accuracy Up and Potency Up for 2 turns. Additionally, if he uses Whirling Strike or Photon Grenades and was Stealthed at the start of his turn, he inflicts 1 stack of Purge on any enemy damaged by those abilities.
data.MSG_EVENT_EIGHTHBROTHER_5-2: When Eighth Brother gains Stealth, he recovers Health and Protection.
data.MSG_EVENT_ELITE_01_COMMANDO_1-1: [c][F0FF23]SEIZE THE ADVANTAGE[-][/c] can inflict Offense Down
data.MSG_EVENT_ELITE_01_COMMANDO_1-2: [c][F0FF23]SUPERIOR TACTICS[-][/c] dispels all buffs on target enemy and inflicts Buff Immunity
data.MSG_EVENT_ELITE_01_COMMANDO_1-3: [c][F0FF23]UPPER HAND[-][/c] grants Counter Chance and bonus Offense per enemy with no buff
data.MSG_EVENT_ELITE_01_COMMANDO_1-4_1: [c][F0FF23]SEIZE THE ADVANTAGE[-][/c] can now attack again on target with less Turn Meter
data.MSG_EVENT_ELITE_01_COMMANDO_1-4_2: [c][F0FF23]SUPERIOR TACTICS[-][/c] also dispels all buffs if the target is debuffed
data.MSG_EVENT_ELITE_02_GARSAXON_1-1: [c][F0FF23]ON THE HUNT[-][/c] can inflict Speed Down on target enemy
data.MSG_EVENT_ELITE_02_GARSAXON_1-2: [c][F0FF23]CALCULATED AMBUSH[-][/c] deals AoE damage with bonus effects based on enemy's Turn Meter
data.MSG_EVENT_ELITE_02_GARSAXON_1-3: [c][F0FF23]MANDALORIAN RETALIATION[-][/c] gives Defense and Counter Chance for Empire allies
data.MSG_EVENT_ELITE_02_GARSAXON_1-4: With [c][F0FF23]VICEROY'S VENGEANCE[-][/c], Gar Saxon can assist allies when they counter attack
data.MSG_EVENT_ELITE_03_GAUNTLET_1-1: Use [c][F0FF23]GAUNTLET ASSAULT[-][/c] on a target locked enemy to grant an ally Turn Meter
data.MSG_EVENT_ELITE_03_GAUNTLET_1-2: Use [c][F0FF23]REINVIGORATE[-][/c] to dispel all ally debuffs and gain Protection Up
data.MSG_EVENT_ELITE_03_GAUNTLET_1-3: Try using [c][F0FF23]PROTON MISSILE LAUNCHER[-][/c] to inflict Buff Immunity on an enemy
data.MSG_EVENT_ELITE_03_GAUNTLET_1-4: [c][F0FF23]SUPERIOR MANEUVERABILITY[-][/c] gives speed to the Gauntlet Starfighter and gives Defense to allies
data.MSG_EVENT_ELITE_COMMANDO_ENC03_T1: Ezra gains bonus Offense, Defense, and Speed when he is not debuffed
data.MSG_EVENT_ELITE_COMMANDO_ENC03_T3: Kanan gains bonus Offense, Defense, and Speed when he is buffed
data.MSG_EVENT_ELITE_COMMANDO_ENC03_T4: Use dispel and negative effects to remove buffs on Ezra and Kanan
data.MSG_EVENT_ELITE_GARSAXON_ENC03: These Rebels have extra Health, Defense, and Tenacity on enemy’s turn but take bonus damage when being counter attacked
data.MSG_EVENT_EMBO_1-1: [c][F0FF23]DISMANTLING SHOT[-][/c] dispels all buffs from the target enemy and deals Physical damage.
data.MSG_EVENT_EMBO_2-1: [c][F0FF23]KYUZO WAR HELMET[-][/c] deals bonus damage based on Embo's Max Protection, then Embo loses 50% Protection.
data.MSG_EVENT_EMBO_3-1: [c][F0FF23]THE QUIET ASSASSIN[-][/c] grants Bounty Hunter allies Counter Chance and Health Steal when Embo is in the Leader slot.
data.MSG_EVENT_EMBO_4-1: [c][F0FF23]WAY OF THE KYUZO[-][/c] grants different bonuses based on whether or not Embo has Protection.
data.MSG_EVENT_EMBO_5-1: When his [c][F0FF23]CONTRACT[-][/c] is completed, Embo gains a chance to take a bonus turn after scoring a Critical Hit and Bounty Hunter allies gain Offense Up and deal bonus damage based on the target's Max Protection.
data.MSG_EVENT_EMBO_6-1: [c][F0FF23]ELUSIVE STRIKES[-][/c] ignores Protection, deals Physical damage, and recovers Protection equal to the damage dealt.
data.MSG_EVENT_EPIXFINN_1-1: Finn is a Resistance Attacker who provides high damage and powerful buffs to allies.
data.MSG_EVENT_EPIXFINN_1-2: [c][F0FF23]Mending Fire[-][/c] deals Special damage to the target enemy and restores Health and Protection to the weakest Resistance ally.
data.MSG_EVENT_EPIXFINN_2-1: [c][F0FF23]Strength of Will[-][/c] deals Special damage to target enemy twice and Finn becomes Inspired.
data.MSG_EVENT_EPIXFINN_2-2: It also swaps Turn Meter with another Resistance ally, and has additional Defense Penetration and Critical Damage for each Inspired ally.
data.MSG_EVENT_EPIXFINN_3-1: [c][F0FF23]Rallying Call[-][/c] dispels debuffs from all allies and Rallies them, and deals Special damage to all enemies.
data.MSG_EVENT_EPIXFINN_3-2: Rallied characters act based on their role.
data.MSG_EVENT_EPIXFINN_4-1: With [c][F0FF23]Spark of Resistance[-][/c], Finn has increased Counter Chance, Defense, and Tenacity while Inspired, and shares these bonuses with other Resistance allies.
data.MSG_EVENT_EPIXFINN_4-2: While Inspired, Resistance Hero Finn also recovers allies' Health, Protection, and Turn Meter when they are prevented from using an ability on their turn.
data.MSG_EVENT_EPIXPOE_1-1: Resistance Hero Poe is a high damage Resistance Attacker that cripples enemies with debuffs.
data.MSG_EVENT_EPIXPOE_1-2: [c][F0FF23]Flinching Shot[-][/c] deals Special damage and inflicts Vulnerable if Resistance Hero Poe is Inspired.
data.MSG_EVENT_EPIXPOE_2-1: [c][F0FF23]Optic Onslaught[-][/c] deals Special damage and inflicts Daze and Stagger, it also inflicts Damage Over Time debuffs if Resistance Hero Poe is Inspired.
data.MSG_EVENT_EPIXPOE_3-1: [c][F0FF23]Blaster Bravado[-][/c] deals Special damage and inflicts Stun for 2 turns.
data.MSG_EVENT_EPIXPOE_4-1: [c][F0FF23]Spark of Resistance[-][/c] allows Resistance allies to deal bonus damage if they are Inspired and enemies buffs are dispelled if they critically hit an Inspired Resistance ally.
data.MSG_EVENT_EPIXPOE_4-2: When Resistance Hero Poe is Inspired and uses a Special ability during his turn, he can also Inspire another Resistance ally.
data.MSG_EVENT_EXECUTIONER_1-1: [c][F0FF23]JUDGEMENT[-][/c] deals physical damage and grants First Order Executioner Health Up
data.MSG_EVENT_EXECUTIONER_2-1: [c][F0FF23]DEATH SENTENCE[-][/c] deals physical damage and dispels all Buffs on the target
data.MSG_EVENT_EXECUTIONER_3-1: [c][F0FF23]TOTAL ORDER[-][/c] grants First Order Executioner bonus health until the end of the encounter
data.MSG_EVENT_FALCON_1: Try using [c][ffff33]DOUBLE DOWN[-][/c] to deal damage with a chance to gain Defense Penetration Up
data.MSG_EVENT_FALCON_2: Use [c][ffff33]BUCKLE UP[-][/c] against a debuffed target to deal more damage
data.MSG_EVENT_FALCON_3: Use [c][ffff33]CALCULATED ENHANCEMENT[-][/c] to Dispel all buffs on an enemy and gain stacking Offense for each buff Dispelled
data.MSG_EVENT_FALCON_4: [c][ffff33]COIN TOSS[-][/c] grants Lando's Millennium Falcon a chance to apply positive effects to allies and negative effects to enemies at the start of its turn
data.MSG_EVENT_FALCON_5_1: Let's try using Lando's Millennium Falcon's reinforcement ability
data.MSG_EVENT_FALCON_5_2: [c][ffff33]ALL IN[-][/c] allows Lando's Millennium Falcon to copy all buffs on all ships and take additional turns for each ship that reinforced from the allied Capital Ship this encounter
data.MSG_EVENT_FENNECSHAND_1-1: [c][F0FF23]Fennec[-][/c] is a dangerous assassin and Bounty Hunter.
data.MSG_EVENT_FENNECSHAND_1-2: Fennec synergizes well with The Mandalorian (Beskar Armor). Try using his Disciplined Set Up ability.
data.MSG_EVENT_FENNECSHAND_1-3: Everytime an enemy is damaged until his next turn, The Mandalorian (Beskar Armor) will gain more Whistling Birds to use with his next attack.
data.MSG_EVENT_FENNECSHAND_1-4: [c][F0FF23]Crushing Strike[-][/c] deals multiple instances of damage to the target enemy.
data.MSG_EVENT_FENNECSHAND_2-1: [c][F0FF23]I Don't Miss[-][/c] deals damage to all enemies and the weakest enemy takes more damage.
data.MSG_EVENT_FENNECSHAND_2-2: All Dark Side Scoundrel allies will gain [c][F0FF23]Overconfident[-][/c] (reduced Defense and increased Evasion, Offense, and Speed). If all Dark Side Scoundrels have Overconfident, then all Scoundrel allies gain it instead.
data.MSG_EVENT_FENNECSHAND_3-1: When [c][F0FF23]Fennec Shand's Payout[-][/c] is activated, she gains additional Critical Chance and Critical Damage. She also gains [c][F0FF23]Seasoned Veteran[-][/c] until the end of the battle.
data.MSG_EVENT_FENNECSHAND_4-1: [c][F0FF23]Lone Fox[-][/c] grants Fennec huge stat bonuses that are reduced for each other ally. Try taking her into battle with fewer allies sometimes.
data.MSG_EVENT_FENNECSHAND_5-1: [c][F0FF23]Making an Impression[-][/c] grants Fennec Turn Meter whenever an ally loses Overconfident. She also gains Offense (stacking) whenever she gains Tenacity Up.
data.MSG_EVENT_FIFTHBROTHER_1-1: A ruthless and powerful brute, Fifth Brother entered each mission with the focus of a natural hunter. I'm pleased to welcome the savage Inquisitor to the holotables!
data.MSG_EVENT_FIFTHBROTHER_1-2: Fifth Brother's Basic attack, [c][ffff33]I Shall Go Alone[-][/c], deals Special damage to target enemy and inflicts a stack of Purge on debuffed enemies, which can't be resisted. Then inflict Tenacity Down (lowered chance to resist debuffs) for 2 turns.
data.MSG_EVENT_FIFTHBROTHER_1-3: Purge can be applied up to 6 times to a target enemy. Those stacks are then consumed by Inquisitorius to apply different effects.
data.MSG_EVENT_FIFTHBROTHER_2-1: Fifth Brother's Special ability, [c][ffff33]The Kill is Mine[-][/c], deals Special damage and dispels all buffs while inflicting Defense Down (reduced Defense stat) for 2 turns on all enemies.
data.MSG_EVENT_FIFTHBROTHER_2-2: Additionally, inflict a stack of Purge on all enemies, which can't be evaded or resisted. If the target already has Purge, inflict Expose (receives additional damage from attacks) for 2 turns, which can't be resisted.
data.MSG_EVENT_FIFTHBROTHER_3-1: Deal Special damage and inflict Vulnerable (will be critically hit if able) on the target enemy for 2 turns with Fifth Brother's Special ability, [c][ffff33]Shrouded in Darkness[-][/c].
data.MSG_EVENT_FIFTHBROTHER_3-2: For each stack of Purge on the target enemy, grant all Inquisitorius allies Protection Up (grants bonus Protection).
data.MSG_EVENT_FIFTHBROTHER_4-1: Empire and Inquisitorius allies gain Defense and Max Health from Fifth Brother's Leader ability, [c][ffff33]I Sense Those We Seek[-][/c].
data.MSG_EVENT_FIFTHBROTHER_4-2: If the enemy Leader is a Jedi, Jedi Leader abilities that grant bonus Speed (takes turns more often) to non-Jedi allies remove Speed, and whenever a non-Jedi enemy gains Retribution (will counter attack when damaged), dispel Retribution and instead inflict Expose for 2 turns, which can't be resisted.
data.MSG_EVENT_FIFTHBROTHER_5-1: Fifth Brother gains Health and Protection whenever an enemy attacks out of turn with his Unique ability, [c][ffff33]A New Target[-][/c]. If the enemy leader is a Jedi, whenever a non-Jedi enemy gains bonus Turn Meter (determines how quickly a character can take another turn), inflict [c][ffff33]Provoked[-][/c] on them for 1 turn, which can't be resisted.
data.MSG_EVENT_FIFTHBROTHER_5-2: Provoked is a new debuff which inflicts +100% counter chance. Characters inflicted with Provoked deal 90% less damage when attacking out of turn. Whenever characters with Provoked attack out of turn they take damage equal to 15% of their Max Health. This damage can't defeat this character.
data.MSG_EVENT_FOSFTIE_1-1: [c][F0FF23]L-s9.6 LASER CANNONS[-][/c] inflict Target Lock on a Critical Hit
data.MSG_EVENT_FOSFTIE_2-1: [c][F0FF23]DOUBLE OFFENSIVE[-][/c] does AoE damage and removes Turn Meter
data.MSG_EVENT_FOSFTIE_3-1: [c][F0FF23]CONCUSSION MISSILE[-][/c] inflicts Ability Block and calls an ally to assist; assisting First Order allies gain Advantage
data.MSG_EVENT_FOSFTP_1-1: [c][F0FF23]RECIPROCATION[-][/c] inflicts Defense Down and gives Advantage to First Order SF TIE Pilot
data.MSG_EVENT_FOSFTP_2-1: [c][F0FF23]DRUMFIRE[-][/c] does AoE damage and inflicts Defense Down on critically hit enemies
data.MSG_EVENT_FOSFTP_3-1: [c][F0FF23]OPPRESSIVE BURST[-][/c] calls an ally to assist; assisting First Order allies gain Advantage
data.MSG_EVENT_FOSITHTROOPER_1-1: Sith Trooper is a powerful Attacker who provides damage and utility for First Order and Sith squads.
data.MSG_EVENT_FOSITHTROOPER_1-2: [c][F0FF23]Sith Strike[-][/c] deals damage to the target enemy and Sith Trooper gains Critical Hit Immunity on a critical hit.
data.MSG_EVENT_FOSITHTROOPER_2-1: [c][F0FF23]Vengeant Blast[-][/c] deals damage to all enemies, dealing more damage for each currently defeated First Order or Sith ally.
data.MSG_EVENT_FOSITHTROOPER_3-1: [c][F0FF23]Resurgent Power[-][/c] dispels all debuffs on all First Order and Sith allies with a chance to grant them Advantage.
data.MSG_EVENT_FOSITHTROOPER_3-2: Sith Trooper has a chance to assist if he already had Advantage.
data.MSG_EVENT_FOSITHTROOPER_4-1: With [c][F0FF23]Emperor's Legacy[-][/c], Sith Trooper gains Advantage at the start of the battle if the Leader is First Order or Sith.
data.MSG_EVENT_FOSITHTROOPER_4-2: While Sith Trooper has Advantage, he deals increased Critical Damage.
data.MSG_EVENT_GENERALHUX_1-1: General Hux is a high-utility First Order support whose abilities gain bonus effects when they are used with Advantage.
data.MSG_EVENT_GENERALHUX_1-2: [c][F0FF23]Commanding Shot[-][/c] deals damage to the target enemy and General Hux gains Advantage on a critical hit.
data.MSG_EVENT_GENERALHUX_2-1: [c][F0FF23]Oppressive Fire[-][/c] grants General Hux Turn Meter and calls all other First Order allies to assist.
data.MSG_EVENT_GENERALHUX_3-1: [c][F0FF23]Devious Scheme[-][/c] dispels all debuffs on General Hux and target other ally and grants that ally Turn Meter.
data.MSG_EVENT_GENERALHUX_4-1: [c][F0FF23]Bow to the First Order[-][/c] boosts the Basic attack damage of all First Order allies.
data.MSG_EVENT_GENERALHUX_4-2: When fully upgraded, General Hux gains the new effect [c][F0FF23]Dominance[-][/c], which prevents enemy counterattacks and grants First Order allies 100% counter chance.
data.MSG_EVENT_GENERALHUX_4-3: Maintain General Hux's [c][F0FF23]Dominance[-][/c] by reducing his chance to get critically hit.
data.MSG_EVENT_GENERALHUX_5-1: [c][F0FF23]Boundless Ambition[-][/c] gives General Hux a chance to gain Advantage at the start of each encounter.
data.MSG_EVENT_GENERALSYNDULLA_1-1: I am pleased to announce the rebellious General Syndulla to the holotables!
data.MSG_EVENT_GENERALSYNDULLA_1-2: As a General in the New Republic, Hera Syndulla was entrusted with safeguarding the galaxy's peace and upholding the ideals of freedom that she and her allies had fought hard to achieve.
data.MSG_EVENT_GREATMOTHERS_1-1: I am pleased to announce the arrival of the ancient Nightsister trio, the Great Mothers to the holotables!
data.MSG_EVENT_GREATMOTHERS_1-2: Dictate the enemy's fate with the Threads of Destiny and doom all those who oppose you.
data.MSG_EVENT_GREEFKARGA_1-1: Greef Karga is a cunning Light Side Bounty Hunter who can benefit from enemy Bounty Hunter payout completion.
data.MSG_EVENT_GREEFKARGA_1-2: [c][F0FF23]Dual Shot[-][/c] deals damage to the target enemy twice, inflicts Daze.
data.MSG_EVENT_GREEFKARGA_2-1: [c][F0FF23]Bring Them in Cold[-][/c] will dispel all buffs on the target enemy and call all Bounty Hunter allies to assist.
data.MSG_EVENT_GREEFKARGA_3-1: [c][F0FF23]Sweeten the Deal[-][/c] gives all Bounty Hunter allies Retribution and they recover Health and Protection. Doubled if they have an active Payout. Allies with active Payouts gain bonus Turn Meter.
data.MSG_EVENT_GREEFKARGA_4-1: [c][F0FF23]Loyalty Pays[-][/c] gives Bounty Hunter allies more Max Protection.
data.MSG_EVENT_GREEFKARGA_4-2: Greef Karga's Contract: Bounty Hunter allies who attack out of turn contribute to Greef Karga's Contract and gain Critical Chance and Offense once completed.
data.MSG_EVENT_GREEFKARGA_5-1: [c][F0FF23]Boss of the Guild[-][/c] gives Greef Karga stealth at the start of encounter.
data.MSG_EVENT_GREEFKARGA_5-2: When a Bounty Hunter earns their Payout, Greef Karga gains Counter Chance, Critical Avoidance and Max Health.
data.MSG_EVENT_GUNGANPHALANX_1-1: I am excited to announce the addition of the shield holding hero, Gungan Phalanx, to the holotables!
data.MSG_EVENT_GUNGANPHALANX_1-2: Courageous Gungans who served in the Gungan Grand Army, known for using their defensive tactics against the Trade Federation during the Invasion of Naboo.
data.MSG_EVENT_HOLDO_1-1: [c][F0FF23]MEASURED SHOT[-][/c] deals damage and grants the least healthy Resistance ally Foresight.
data.MSG_EVENT_HOLDO_2-1: [c][F0FF23]BUNKER BUSTER[-][/c] deals area damage and inflicts Daze on all enemies
data.MSG_EVENT_HOLDO_3-1: [c][F0FF23]REPRIEVE[-][/c] dispels all debuffs on the target ally and recovers some of their health
data.MSG_EVENT_HOLDO_4-1: [c][F0FF23]QUIET CONFIDENCE[-][/c] grants Holdo Taunt when Foresight expires on a Resistance ally. When Holdo doesn't have Tuant, she gains bonus speed
data.MSG_EVENT_HONDO_1-1: With the holotables welcoming Hondo Ohnaka, I finally have a use for some of these old holo-recordings I inherited.
data.MSG_EVENT_HONDO_1-2: Hondo was known for his tall tales and, you know what, I'll just play the recordings...
data.MSG_EVENT_HONDO_1-3: Have I told you about the time me and my crew took down two Mandalorians? The corridors of Cloud City were never quite the same after that encounter.
data.MSG_EVENT_HONDO_1-4: Hondo's Basic Attack, [c][ffff33]I Smell Profit[-][/c], deals damage to the target and also gives Hondo a stack of [c][ffff33]Ransom[-][/c] (Gain Max Health and Tenacity). If the target is Light Side, Hondo removes Turn Meter from them. If the target is Dark Side, Hondo gains Turn Meter himself.
data.MSG_EVENT_HONDO_2-1: Let me tell you about the time I faced off against a Sith Lord while fighting beside the greatest Jedi of all time...
data.MSG_EVENT_HONDO_2-2: Hondo can make most opponents his [c][ffff33]Captive[-][/c] through his Special Ability, [c][ffff33]I Don't Want to Kill You Per Se[-][/c].
data.MSG_EVENT_HONDO_2-3: The Captive's Speed is set to 0 and they can't gain bonus Turn Meter or perform out of turn attacks.
data.MSG_EVENT_HONDO_2-4: The Captive is freed at the start of Hondo's second turn, when the enemy squad gains 25 buffs, or if Hondo is defeated.
data.MSG_EVENT_HONDO_3-1: Of course, the Imperial Inquisitors once thought I was harboring a Jedi. Which I was, but she was paying me a lot of credits so it is completely beside the point.
data.MSG_EVENT_HONDO_3-2: Hondo can call an ally to attack using the Special Ability [c][ffff33]Insolence? We are Pirates[-][/c]. This ability will also cleanse debuffs from Scoundrel allies and has additional effects based on the alignment of the unit called to assist.
data.MSG_EVENT_HONDO_3-3: Hondo will also gain Defense Up (increased Defense stat, which reduces incoming damage) and Offense (increases ability damage) for the rest of the encounter for each stack of Ransom he has when he uses this ability.
data.MSG_EVENT_HONDO_4-1: And then there was that time on Endor that I rescued the famous Luke Skywalker and his friends from the native Ewoks who thought they would make a delicious meal!
data.MSG_EVENT_HONDO_4-2: [c][ffff33]That's Just Good Business[-][/c] is Hondo's Unique ability that gives him bonuses to his Health Steal (health recovery from dealing damage), and the ability to gain Ransom when he evades an attack.
data.MSG_EVENT_HONDO_4-3: Hondo also gains bonuses based on how many stacks of Ransom he has. If the Captive target is defeated before Hondo has 10 stacks of Ransom, Hondo will flee.
data.MSG_EVENT_HONDO_5-1: During the Clone Wars, I kidnapped the fabled Separatist leader Count Dooku! He... never quite forgave me for that little transgression.
data.MSG_EVENT_HONDO_5-2: Hondo's second Unique ability, [c][ffff33]I Guess We Won't Be Friends[-][/c], gives him benefits in reaction to other characters gaining buffs, bonus Turn Meter, or when they are called to assist.
data.MSG_EVENT_HONDO_5-3: Additionally, if Hondo had two or more other allies at the start of the encounter and is the last character remaining on his side, he gains several stats and 100% Turn Meter.
data.MSG_EVENT_HONDO_BONUS-1: As a pirate, I would often run afoul of the system authorities. Usually a handshake containing credits is all it takes, but there was one time that I happened to encounter some of the Empire's most incorruptible officers.
data.MSG_EVENT_HONDO_LEGACY-1: Finally, there was my encounter with Jabba the Hutt, his Majordomo, and I am pretty sure even Boba Fett was there!
data.MSG_EVENT_HOUNDSTOOTH_1-1: [c][F0FF23]TOOTH AND NAIL[-][/c] deals Physical damage to the target enemy and dispels all debuffs on Hound's Tooth. Hound's Tooth recovers Health and Protection if it has Taunt.
data.MSG_EVENT_HOUNDSTOOTH_2-1: [c][F0FF23]DEVOURER OF PREY[-][/c] deals Physical damage to the target enemy and inflicts Breach, then Hound's Tooth gains Taunt.
data.MSG_EVENT_HOUNDSTOOTH_3-1: [c][F0FF23]TRANDOSHAN BARRICADE[-][/c] grants Hound's Tooth Protection Up when it takes damage. When Hound's Tooth loses Taunt, it gains Taunt if an enemy is Breached.
data.MSG_EVENT_HOUNDSTOOTH_4-1: When Hound's Tooth enters battle from Reinforcement, [c][F0FF23]SECURE THE HUNT[-][/c] grants all allies Tenacity and grants Bounty Hunter allies Counter Chance when they Resist a detrimental effect.
data.MSG_EVENT_HUNTERS3_1-1: I am pleased to announce the arrival of Hunter (Mercenary), a key member of the Bad Batch and ally to Omega (Fugitive) and Batcher!
data.MSG_EVENT_HUNTERS3_1-2: Mark targets and hit them with a devastating Electro-staff!
data.MSG_EVENT_HUYANG_1-1: I am pleased to welcome the arrival of Huyang, the Mark IV architect droid professor, to the holotables!
data.MSG_EVENT_HUYANG_1-2: Support and guide his allies towards victory with his vast knowledge of the galaxy.
data.MSG_EVENT_IDENVERSIOEMPIRE_1-1: Play as Iden Versio, the daring commander of the Imperial Special Forces unit, Inferno Squad, and lead your team of Imperial Troopers to victory!
data.MSG_EVENT_IDENVERSIOEMPIRE_1-2: Deal Physical damage to target enemy. If the attack is a critical hit, Iden will recover Health and Protection.
data.MSG_EVENT_IDENVERSIOEMPIRE_2-1: Deal Physical damage to all enemies and inflict Vulnerable (will be critically hit if able) for 2 turns. Dispel all buffs on target enemy and inflict Healing Immunity (immune to Health and Protection recovery) for 2 turns and Stun (can't assist or counter attack and miss their next turn) for 1 turn. When fully upgraded, these effects can't be resisted by Rebel enemies.
data.MSG_EVENT_IDENVERSIOEMPIRE_2-2: If no other allies have the Leader tag, Iden calls all other non-Droid Imperial Trooper allies to assist, dealing less damage.
data.MSG_EVENT_IDENVERSIOEMPIRE_3-1: Dispel all debuffs on Imperial Trooper allies. Iden gains Protection Up (100%) for 2 turns, and all other Imperial Trooper allies gain Protection Up (50%). Imperial Trooper allies recover Protection.
data.MSG_EVENT_IDENVERSIOEMPIRE_3-2: When fully upgraded, if no other allies have the Leader tag, all non-Droid Imperial Trooper allies gain the [c][ffff33]We Adapt, Or Die[-][/c] buff for 3 turns, which can't be copied.
data.MSG_EVENT_IDENVERSIOEMPIRE_3-3: We Adapt, Or Die increases Critical Chance (increases chance of an attack being a critical hit), Offense (increases ability damage), Speed (takes turns more often), and if the buffed character is defeated, they revive with 70% Health. If this buff is dispelled, the buffed character recovers Health, gains Turn Meter (determines how quickly a character can take another turn), and can't be critically hit for 2 turns.
data.MSG_EVENT_IDENVERSIOEMPIRE_4-1: Imperial Trooper allies have increased Critical Chance, Offense, and Speed. At the start of battle, if no other allies have the Leader tag, all non-Droid Imperial Trooper allies gain Critical Damage Up (increases the damage of critical hits) for 2 turns at the start of each encounter and increased counter chance. Additionally, while enemies are Vulnerable, they have reduced Speed.
data.MSG_EVENT_IDENVERSIOEMPIRE_4-2: When fully upgraded, at the start of battle, if no other allies have the Leader tag, whenever a non-Droid Imperial Trooper ally attacks out of turn, they gain 2% Offense (stacking) until the end of the encounter.
data.MSG_EVENT_IDENVERSIOEMPIRE_4-3: When fully upgraded and in the Grand Arena game mode, at the start of battle, if no other allies have the Leader tag, Imperial Trooper allies also gain increased Max Health and Max Protection and whenever an enemy attacks out of turn, Imperial Trooper allies recover Health and Protection and gain Turn Meter.
data.MSG_EVENT_IDENVERSIOEMPIRE_5-1: If no other allies have the Leader tag, and all allies are non-Droid Imperial Troopers, Iden gains Turn Meter at the start of each encounter. While Iden has Protection Up, she also has increased Potency (debuffs are harder to resist). While she is active, Imperial Trooper allies have increased Offense.
data.MSG_EVENT_IDENVERSIOEMPIRE_5-2: When fully upgraded, if no other allies have the Leader tag and all allies are non-Droid Imperial Troopers, then whenever Iden is defeated she revives with full Health and Protection if there is another active Imperial Trooper ally.
data.MSG_EVENT_IG12_1-1: At long last, I welcome IG-12 & Grogu to the holotables. Restructured from the Droid known as IG-11 who self-destructed on Nevarro, is now piloted by the adorable Grogu, and is sure to cause trouble everywhere he goes!
data.MSG_EVENT_IG2000_1-1: [c][F0FF23]EXPLOIT IDENTIFIED[-][/c] deals Physical damage to target enemy. If that enemy is Breached, attack again.
data.MSG_EVENT_IG2000_2-1: [c][F0FF23]INERTIAL DAMPENERS DISABLED[-][/c] deals Physical damage to the target enemy and inflicts Stun and Target Lock. This attack deals more damage to Breached enemies.
data.MSG_EVENT_IG2000_3-1: The IG-2000 recovers Health at the start of each turn and gains Offense for each debuffed enemy thanks to [c][F0FF23]RECONSTRUCT PROTOCOL[-][/c].
data.MSG_EVENT_IG2000_4-1: When the IG-2000 enters battle from Reinforcement, [c][F0FF23]INITIATE SLICE SEQUENCE[-][/c] grants another random Attacker ally Offense Up and inflicts Critical Chance Down on all enemies. The highest and lowest Health enemies are also inflicted with Target Lock.
data.MSG_EVENT_IG90_1-1: I am pleased to announce the arrival of IG-90, the ruthless assassin droid, to the holotables!
data.MSG_EVENT_IG90_1-2: IG-90, recruited for high-risk missions and a galaxy-wide bounty hunt, is an expert in eliminating targets with precision.
data.MSG_EVENT_INQUISITORBARRISS_1-1: I am excited to announce the unyielding Force adept [c][ffff33]Inquisitor Barriss[-][/c] is joining the holotables.
data.MSG_EVENT_INQUISITORBARRISS_1-2: Barriss Offee, once a gifted Jedi healer, was recruited into the Inquisitorius and now twists the Force through the dark side to punish her enemies and strengthen her allies.
data.MSG_EVENT_ITHANO_1-1: I am pleased to announce the arrival of Captain Ithano to the holotables!
data.MSG_EVENT_ITHANO_1-2: Get up close and personal with your enemies and teach them a lesson they won't forget.
data.MSG_EVENT_JANGO_1-1: [c][F0FF23]UNSCRUPULOUS GUNFIRE[-][/c] deals damage which increases for each debuff the enemy is suffering from.
data.MSG_EVENT_JANGO_2-1: [c][F0FF23]SHRAPNEL BLAST[-][/c] deals damage to the primary target and another random enemy.
data.MSG_EVENT_JANGO_3-1: [c][F0FF23]CONFLAGRATION[-][/c] deals damage and inflicts BURNING and can't be Evaded.
data.MSG_EVENT_JANGO_4-1: [c][F0FF23]ANYTHING TO GET AHEAD[-][/c] grants Scoundrel allies Speed, lowers enemies Tenacity, and has other beneficial effects.
data.MSG_EVENT_JANGO_5-1: [c][F0FF23]NOTORIOUS REPUTATION[-][/c] grants Jango bonus Defense Penetration and Health, and prevents enemies he defeats from being Revived, as well as giving him BOUNTY HUNTER'S RESOLVE.
data.MSG_EVENT_JANGO_6-1: Jango Fett's [c][F0FF23]CONTRACT[-][/c] grants Jango a large Offense boost and temporary Damage Immunity when a Contract is fulfilled.
data.MSG_EVENT_JANGO_BOUNTY_01_1-1: We’re looking for someone who stuck their nose where it didn’t belong.
data.MSG_EVENT_JANGO_BOUNTY_01_1-2: Be quick and discreet. This is Jedi territory.
data.MSG_EVENT_JANGO_BOUNTY_02_2-1: We’re being paid to take out a group of Jedi in these caves. Don’t mess it up.
data.MSG_EVENT_JANGO_BOUNTY_03_3-1: These witches are powerful, be alert for surprises.
data.MSG_EVENT_JANGO_CONTEXT_01: I’ve been going through my old military tomes and I found something about a Bounty Hunter named “[c][F0FF23]JANGO FETT[-][/c]".
data.MSG_EVENT_JANGO_CONTEXT_02: It seems like he was an important guy right before the outbreak of the Clone Wars so I added a little something extra to the events for you.
data.MSG_EVENT_JEDISTARFIGHTERANAKIN_1-1: [c][F0FF23]LOCKED ON[-][/c] deals Physical damage and inflicts Target Lock. If the enemy was already Target Locked, grant a random ally Valor.
data.MSG_EVENT_JEDISTARFIGHTERANAKIN_2-1: [c][F0FF23]IMPEDING ASSAULT[-][/c] deals Physical damage to all enemies and inflicts Healing Immunity and Buff Immunity on the target enemy, and Anakin's Starfighter gains Protection Up for each Critical Hit.
data.MSG_EVENT_JEDISTARFIGHTERANAKIN_3-1: [c][F0FF23]SURGE ALL POWER[-][/c] grants all Jedi and Clone allies Offense, and Anakin's Starfighter gains Turn Meter and Bonus Damage whenever an ally is defeated or falls below 100% Health.
data.MSG_EVENT_JEDISTARFIGHTERANAKIN_4-1: When Anakin's Eta-2 Starfighter enters battle from Reinforcement, [c][F0FF23]AGGRESSIVE APPROACH[-][/c] grants all allies Accuracy Up, Galactic Republic allies Offense Up, and inflicts Expose on all enemies.
data.MSG_EVENT_JOLEE_1-1: [c][F0FF23]NO OTHER OPTIONS[-][/c] deals Physical damage and heals Jolee.
data.MSG_EVENT_JOLEE_2-1: [c][F0FF23]EH, YOU DO IT[-][/c] calls a target Ally to assist.
data.MSG_EVENT_JOLEE_3-1: [c][F0FF23]THAT LOOKS PRETTY BAD[-][/c] heals a targeted ally and dispels any debuffs on them.
data.MSG_EVENT_JOLEE_4-1: [c][F0FF23]DON'T INTERRUPT ME[-][/c] grants Jolee immunity to Turn Meter Reduction effects and bonus Tenacity.
data.MSG_EVENT_JOLEE_5-1: [c][F0FF23]EXPERIENCE AND WISDOM[-][/c] increases Jolee's Max Health.
data.MSG_EVENT_JOURNEY_JEDIKNIGHTCAL_TIER01-1: No time, keep moving. We'll pick you up when we can.
data.MSG_EVENT_JOURNEY_JEDIKNIGHTCAL_TIER02-1: Someone who just brought an AT-AT to the table. Who are you?
data.MSG_EVENT_JOURNEY_JEDIKNIGHTCAL_TIER02-3: What's this? A Bracca scrap rat playing Jedi?
data.MSG_EVENT_JOURNEY_JEDIKNIGHTCAL_TIER04-2: I was only a child when they attacked. An armored warrior brandishing one of those cut down my people.
Having a lightsaber isn't what makes you a Jedi.
data.MSG_EVENT_JOURNEY_JEDIKNIGHTCAL_TIER04-3: I want to rebuild the Jedi Order.
data.MSG_EVENT_JOURNEY_JEDIKNIGHTCAL_TIER04-4: Get up Cal Kestis. You're not dead yet.
data.MSG_EVENT_JOURNEY_JEDIKNIGHTCAL_TIER05-2: It's not too late to let go.
Let go? I'm stronger now because of the pain.
data.MSG_EVENT_JOURNEY_JEDIKNIGHTCAL_TIER05-3: You would have made an excellent Inquisitor.
data.MSG_EVENT_JOURNEY_MAUL_HATE_FUELED_TIER0: Goodbye Tarfful, goodbye Chewbacca. Miss you I will.
data.MSG_EVENT_JUHANI_1-1: [c][F0FF23]RAGING STRIKE[-][/c] deals Physical damage to the target enemy, dealing more damage for each debuffed enemy.
data.MSG_EVENT_JUHANI_2-1: [c][F0FF23]BOASTFUL PROVOCATION[-][/c] causes Juhani to Taunt with a chance to Stun the target enemy.
data.MSG_EVENT_JUHANI_3-1: [c][F0FF23]REMORSEFUL THRASH[-][/c] deals Physical damage to all enemies and provides Juhani with Health and Protection recovery for each Critical Hit.
data.MSG_EVENT_JUHANI_4-1: [c][F0FF23]CATHAR RESILIENCE[-][/c] provides Juhani with Health recovery at the beginning of each of her turns and increased Counter Chance while Taunting.
data.MSG_EVENT_KANAN_1-1: Kanan's basic, [c][F0FF23]DISARMING STRIKE[-][/c], inflicts Offense Down and can't be resisted on a Critical Hit
data.MSG_EVENT_KANAN_1-2: Use [c][F0FF23]INTERVENE[-][/c] to clear any debuffs on an ally. Gain Taunt and bonus Tenacity on Kanan.
data.MSG_EVENT_KANAN_1-3: [c][F0FF23]TOTAL DEFENSE[-][/c] dispels all debuffs from Kanan and grants himself and a selected ally Protection Up
data.MSG_EVENT_KANAN_1-4: [c][F0FF23]CLEAR MIND[-][/c] grants Kanan Counter Chance and Health Recovery whenever he gets a debuff
data.MSG_EVENT_KELLERANBEQ_1-1: Known as the Sabered Hand for his talent with a lightsaber, this Jedi Master used his expertise to train younglings before the fall of the Galactic Republic.
data.MSG_EVENT_KELLERANBEQ_1-2: Among many of his achievements, he notably rescued the youngling Grogu from the Jedi Temple on Coruscant during Order 66. By the will of the council, Kelleran Beq has joined the holotables!
data.MSG_EVENT_KIX_1-1: I am happy to announce the arrival of Clone Trooper Kix to Ithano's Pirate Crew.
data.MSG_EVENT_KIX_1-2: After having fought alongside General Skywalker in the 501st Legion, he was frozen in stasis until Captain Ithano rescued him.
data.MSG_EVENT_KIX_1-3: Kix served as the chief medic for Ithano's pirate crew as he acclimated to a very different galaxy than the one he knew.
data.MSG_EVENT_KLEYA_1-1: I am pleased to announce the arrival of Kleya Marki to the holotables.
data.MSG_EVENT_KLEYA_1-2: Kleya Marki was an expert in subterfuge, communication, and related devices, who helped run a covert rebel network against the Galactic Empire.
data.MSG_EVENT_KRRSANTAN_1-1: Greetings Holotable Heroes! I am pleased to announce that the Wookiee bounty hunter turned pit fighter turned mercenary Krrsantan has arrived on the holotables!
data.MSG_EVENT_KRRSANTAN_1-2: Krrsantan's Basic ability [c][ffff33]Knuckle Duster[-][/c] will inflict Potency Down (debuffs are harder to inflict) and has a small chance to Shock (can't heal, gain buffs, or gain bonus Turn Meter) the target.
data.MSG_EVENT_KRRSANTAN_1-3: If all of Krrsantan's allies are Hutt Cartel at the start of battle, Shock will apply with every strike.
data.MSG_EVENT_KRRSANTAN_2-1: Krrsantan's first Special ability, [c][ffff33]Ferocious Fusillade[-][/c], deals damage to the target while giving him Defense Up (increased Defense stat, which reduces incoming damage) and Taunt (enemies must target this character) for 2 turns.
data.MSG_EVENT_KRRSANTAN_2-2: If all of Krrsantan's allies are Hutt Cartel at the start of battle, they'll gain Health and Protection for each other Hutt Cartel ally and Krrsantan gains Protection Up (grants bonus Protection).
data.MSG_EVENT_KRRSANTAN_3-1: Krrsantan's second Special ability is [c][ffff33]Dismember[-][/c].
