This will inflict [c][ffff33]Disarm[-][/c] on the target which will hinder their Critical Damage and Offense and whenever they use a Basic ability they are inflicted with Damage Over Time (inflicts damage at the start of their turn).
data.MSG_EVENT_KRRSANTAN_3-2: If all of Krrsantan's allies are Hutt Cartel at the start of battle, this will also increase their cooldowns by 1, inflict Ability Block (can't use Special abilities during their turn) and increase Krrsantan's Max Health.
data.MSG_EVENT_KRRSANTAN_4-1: Krrsantan gains Defense and Max Health at the start of battle with his Unique ability [c][ffff33]Champion of the Fighting Pits.[-][/c] Additionally he recovers Health and Protection whenever he loses Taunt.
data.MSG_EVENT_KRRSANTAN_4-2: If all of Krrsantan's allies were Hutt Cartel at the start of battle, he gains Taunt and Speed Up at the start of each encounter and Taunts whenever he loses it if the allied Leader has more than 50% Protection. In Grand Arenas he is immune to Ability Block and cooldown increase, and he will Taunt and recover the allied Leader's Protection the first time they drop below 50% Protection.
data.MSG_EVENT_KRRSANTAN_4-3: When fully upgraded, if Krrsantan is defeated he will revive once per battle at the end of the allied Leader's next turn.
data.MSG_EVENT_KRRSANTAN_5-1: While he is the Leader, Krrsantan brings [c][ffff33]Formidable Ferocity[-][/c], giving Scoundrel allies Health Steal, Max Health, and Max Protection.
data.MSG_EVENT_KRRSANTAN_5-2: Krrsantan's Bounty Hunter Contract requires you to defeat the enemy Leader, and allied Scoundrels can contribute to this contract. This will give additional Health Steal and Max Health to his Bounty Hunter and Scoundrel allies.
data.MSG_EVENT_KRRSANTAN_5-3: Krrsantan gains the following whenever a Bounty Hunter Contract is completed: Critical Avoidance (reduces chance of being critically hit), Taunt for 2 turns, and recovers Health and Protection. Additionally, if the allied Leader is both a Galactic Legend and Hutt Cartel, he gains Damage Immunity (can't be damaged) for 2 turns and Tenacity (increased chance to resist debuffs).
data.MSG_EVENT_KYLEKATARN_1-1: Legends speak of a renowned Rebel and Jedi named Kyle Katarn, and I'm excited to bring him to the holotables!
data.MSG_EVENT_KYLEKATARN_1-2: [c][ffff33]Kyle Katarn[-][/c] is a Force sensitive Rebel that empowers Rebel Fighter teams with a variety of buffs. The more he attacks out of turn, the greater his connection to the Force becomes until he is a fully empowered Jedi Knight. \n\n[c][ffff33]This Should Be Interesting[-][/c] deals damage twice and inflicts Ability Block (can't use Special abilities during their turn) to his enemy, If he attacks out of turn, he instead deals damage a third time.
data.MSG_EVENT_KYLEKATARN_2-1: Kyle's ability [c][ffff33]Just a Guy With a Lightsaber[-][/c] deals damage twice and grants his allies Critical Chance Up (increases chance of an attack being a critical hit) and Potency Up (debuffs are harder to resist). If his target has [c][ffff33]Force Influence[-][/c] (they can't assist, counter attack, or gain buffs), then the second hit will deal bonus damage.
data.MSG_EVENT_KYLEKATARN_2-2: If Kyle has [c][ffff33]Jedi Knight[-][/c], all Rebel Fighter allies will recover 50% Health and Protection and the first time this ability deals damage each turn, it deals bonus damage.
data.MSG_EVENT_KYLEKATARN_3-1: [c][ffff33]Power of the Valley[-][/c] removes all debuffs from Rebel Fighter allies and grants them Defense Up (increased Defense stat, which reduces incoming damage), Speed Up (takes turns more often), deals damage to all enemies, and inflicts [c][ffff33]Force Influence[-][/c] on target enemy.
data.MSG_EVENT_KYLEKATARN_3-2: If Kyle has [c][ffff33]Jedi Knight[-][/c], he instead inflicts [c][ffff33]Force Influence[-][/c] on all enemies.
data.MSG_EVENT_KYLEKATARN_4-1: [c][ffff33]Blue Milk Run[-][/c] grants Kyle a stack of [c][ffff33]Force Connection[-][/c] (deal more damage with attacks and take less damage from enemy attacks) whenever he attacks out of turn. When he gains 10 stacks, he will dispel them all and gain [c][ffff33]Jedi Knight[-][/c] (Rebel Fighter allies deal more damage with attacks and take less damage from enemy attacks).
data.MSG_EVENT_KYLEKATARN_4-2: While in Territory Battles, enemies will be unable to gain bonus Turn Meter, all Jedi and Rebel Fighter allies will begin each encounter with Bonus Protection (bonus protection that takes damage), and Kyle will also gain an additional stack of [c][ffff33]Force Connection[-][/c] when he attacks out of turn. Kyle gains several other bonuses in Territory Battles.
data.MSG_EVENT_KYLORENTLJ_1-1: [c][F0FF23]AGGRESSIVE STRIKE[-][/c] inflicts Tenacity Down and, if the enemy was already debuffed, Kylo gains Taunt
data.MSG_EVENT_KYLORENTLJ_2-1: [c][F0FF23]HALT[-][/c] dispels the target’s buffs, stuns them, and Kylo gains Taunt; this is unresistable and cannot be evaded
data.MSG_EVENT_KYLORENTLJ_3-1: [c][F0FF23]FOCUSED RAGE[-][/c] deals double damage if the target is Stunned, and Kylo is healed equal to the damage dealt
data.MSG_EVENT_KYLORENTLJ_4-1: [c][F0FF23]MERCILESS PURSUIT[-][/c] grants Speed and Critical Hit for First Order allies; they also gain Health and Protection when receiving status effects
data.MSG_EVENT_KYLORENTLJ_5-1: [c][F0FF23]SCARRED[-][/c] grants Kylo numerous bonuses; when he takes damage he is healed and a random First Order ally gains Advantage
data.MSG_EVENT_L3_37_0-2: [c][F0FF23]PREPARED[-][/c] is a special effect that adds bonus beneficial effects to certain Scoundrel abilities.
data.MSG_EVENT_L3_37_0-3: This battle starts off with your Scoundrel team being [c][F0FF23]PREPARED[-][/c]. Let's observe its full potential.
data.MSG_EVENT_L3_37_0-4: Use Qi'ra's Special ability [c][F0FF23]JOINT OPERATION[-][/c] which has an added affect to call all [c][F0FF23]PREPARED[-][/c] allies to assist and grant them buffs.
data.MSG_EVENT_L3_37_0-5: This is just a sample of what [c][F0FF23]PREPARED[-][/c] can do to amplify your Scoundrel team.
data.MSG_EVENT_L3_37_0-6: Now you're on your own to experiment with other [c][F0FF23]PREPARED[-][/c] Scoundrels. Good luck!
data.MSG_EVENT_L3_37_1-1: [c][F0FF23]DARING ADVANCE[-][/c] deals damage and inflicts Defense Down.
data.MSG_EVENT_L3_37_1-2: If L3-37 is [c][F0FF23]PREPARED[-][/c], she gains stacking Max Health until the end of encounter.
data.MSG_EVENT_L3_37_2-1: [c][F0FF23]SPARK OF HOPE[-][/c] deals damage to target enemy, and L3-37 gains Taunt. If L3-37 is [c][F0FF23]PREPARED[-][/c], she heals all Scoundrel and Droid allies.
data.MSG_EVENT_L3_37_2-2: In addition for spending it, all [c][F0FF23]PREPARED[-][/c] allies gain Tenacity Up, and this ability's cooldown will be reduced by 1 if any other allies are [c][F0FF23]PREPARED[-][/c].
data.MSG_EVENT_L3_37_2-3: Now let's see [c][F0FF23]SPARK OF HOPE[-][/c] in action!
data.MSG_EVENT_L3_37_3-1: If L3-37 takes damage from an attack, her Unique ability, [c][F0FF23]FOR THE DROIDS[-][/c], will dispel debuffs from a random Scoundrel ally at the end of the turn.
data.MSG_EVENT_L3_37_3-2: Whenever another Droid or Scoundrel ally takes damage from an attack, L3-37 gains +15% Turn Meter.
data.MSG_EVENT_L3_37_3-3: Go ahead and use [c][F0FF23]SPARK OF HOPE[-][/c] to gain Taunt and observe what happens with the debuff on Qi'ra.
data.MSG_EVENT_L3_37_4-1: [c][F0FF23]SELF MODIFICATION[-][/c] grants L3-37 a new Special ability called [c][F0FF23]ENHANCE[-][/c] which amplifies her combat capabilities.
data.MSG_EVENT_L3_37_4-2: The Omega level of this Special ability can be used up to 3 times per battle. Each successive use upgrades this Special ability from Enhance MK I to MK II, and Enhance MK II to MK III.
data.MSG_EVENT_L3_37_4-3: Now use [c][F0FF23]ENHANCE MK I[-][/c] and observe its effects.
data.MSG_EVENT_LOGRAY_1-1: [c][F0FF23]MYSTICAL STRIKE[/c][-] attacks an enemy and grants Logray Tenacity Up
data.MSG_EVENT_LOGRAY_2-1: [c][F0FF23]HYPNOTIZE[/c][-] removes all buffs from the target enemy, and inflicts Daze on all enemies
data.MSG_EVENT_LOGRAY_3-1: [c][F0FF23]PROPHETIC VISIONS[/c][-] grants Turn Meter to allies, and also gives allied Ewoks Foresight
data.MSG_EVENT_LOGRAY_4-1: [c][F0FF23]SHAMAN'S INSIGHT[/c][-] grants Logray Turn Meter whenever an allied Ewok inflicts a critical hit
data.MSG_EVENT_MARAJADE_1-1: Play as the Hand of the Emperor, hunting down Jedi and bringing support to your dark side team! We have added Mara Jade, the Emperor’s Hand to the holotables!
data.MSG_EVENT_MARAJADE_1-2: Other units begin with [c][ffff33]Useful Pawn[-][/c] if Emperor Palpatine is not in the Leader slot.
data.MSG_EVENT_MARAJADE_1-3: On Mara Jade's turn, Emperor Palpatine will assist on her Basic attack, but if he is not present, a random ally with Useful Pawn will assist instead.
data.MSG_EVENT_MARAJADE_2-1: Mara Jade's Special Ability, [c][ffff33]Ultimate Predator[-][/c], will dispel buffs and inflict Stun (can't assist or counter attack and miss their next turn) and Vulnerable (will be critically hit if able) on the target, as well as Tenacity Down (lowered chance to resist debuffs) on all enemies. Shocked enemies (as well as Jedi) take double damage from this ability.
data.MSG_EVENT_MARAJADE_3-1: Both Mara Jade and Emperor Palpatine will gain bonus Turn Meter (determines how quickly a character can take another turn) when inflicting debuffs with her [c][ffff33]Infiltrate and Disrupt[-][/c] Special ability, and Mara Jade will gain Stealth (can't be targeted by enemies, unless only Stealthed targets are available) for 2 turns.
data.MSG_EVENT_MARAJADE_4-1: Mara Jade gains a stack of [c][ffff33]Loyal Hand[-][/c] at the start of her and Emperor Palpatine's turns. Additionally, Empire and Sith allies gain bonuses if Emperor Palpatine is in the Leader slot.
data.MSG_EVENT_MARAJADE_4-2: In Territory Wars, whenever an enemy unit is defeated, inflict Vulnerable on a random enemy and allies gain Max Protection.
data.MSG_EVENT_MARAUDER_1-1: [c][F0FF23]STRENGTH THROUGH PASSION[-][/c] deals damage and inflicts Offense Down
data.MSG_EVENT_MARAUDER_2-1: [c][F0FF23]VICTORY THROUGH POWER[-][/c] deals damage and grants allies Potency Up
data.MSG_EVENT_MARAUDER_3-1: [c][F0FF23]THE FORCE SHALL FREE ME[-][/c] grants Sith Marauder buffs based on the total number of Buffs and Debuffs active in battle
data.MSG_EVENT_MARQUEE_FULCRUM_1-1: [c][F0FF23]BALANCED STRIKE[-][/c] grants Protection Up for Ahsoka and a random ally
data.MSG_EVENT_MARQUEE_FULCRUM_1-2: Use [c][F0FF23]MEDITATE[-][/c] to copy all ally buffs (except Taunt and unique buffs) to Ahsoka and gain Turn Meter
data.MSG_EVENT_MARQUEE_FULCRUM_1-3: Use [c][F0FF23]WHIRLWIND[-][/c] to consume Ahsoka's buffs for an additional hit per type of buff
data.MSG_EVENT_MARQUEE_FULCRUM_1-4: [c][F0FF23]PERSEVERANCE[-][/c] makes Ahsoka immune to Damage Over Time effects, clears all debuffs at the cost of health, and grants health for each buff on her, every turn
data.MSG_EVENT_MARROK_1-1: I am excited to announce the arrival of the Jedi hunter Marrok to the holotables!
data.MSG_EVENT_MARROK_1-2_V2: Marrok is a force sensitive Mercenary who was hired by Morgan Elsbeth to liberate Grand Admiral Thrawn.
data.MSG_EVENT_MASTERQUIGON_1-1: It is my pleasure to announce that Master Qui-Gon, a Jedi Master who aided in halting the Trade Federation's plans to invade the planet of Naboo, has arrived at the holotables!
data.MSG_EVENT_MASTERQUIGON_1-2: This Jedi maverick declined a position on the Jedi Council in order to forge his own path centered around the living Force and was the Master of the legendary Obi-Wan Kenobi!
data.MSG_EVENT_MERRIN_1-1: Merrin was a Nightsister who lived alone on her home planet of Dathomir after General Grievous decimated her coven.
data.MSG_EVENT_MERRIN_1-2: Merrin's Basic ability, [c][ffff33]Ichor Bolt,[-][/c] inflicts the target enemy with Plague (lose Health at start of turn and can't be dispelled by allies).
data.MSG_EVENT_MERRIN_2-1: [c][ffff33]Shadow Stride[-][/c] inflicts Plague on all enemies and Nightsister allies recover Health and Protection.
data.MSG_EVENT_MERRIN_2-2: Then, Merrin gains Magick Stealth, which makes her unable to be targeted or damaged.
data.MSG_EVENT_MERRIN_2-3: The next time one of Merrin's allies is debuffed or defeated, Merrin loses Magick Stealth, all allies' debuffs are dispelled, and a random ally is revived.
data.MSG_EVENT_MERRIN_3-1: [c][ffff33]Dathomir Will Be Your Grave[-][/c] Stuns (can't assist or counter attack and miss their next turn) target enemy and dispels buffs from all enemies with 2 or more stacks of Plague.
data.MSG_EVENT_MERRIN_3-2: If this ability defeats the target, inflict all enemies with 4 stacks of Plague.
data.MSG_EVENT_MERRIN_4-1: [c][ffff33]Last of the Nightsisters[-][/c] grants Merrin Turn Meter (determines how quickly a character can take another turn) whenever an ally is defeated or revived.
data.MSG_EVENT_MERRIN_4-2: While Merrin has active allies her Speed is set to 0.
data.MSG_EVENT_MERRIN_4-3: In the Grand Arenas game mode, Merrin gains additional Turn Meter whenever an ally is defeated or revived.
data.MSG_EVENT_MERRIN_5-1: [c][ffff33]Vengeful Bond[-][/c] also grants Merrin Turn Meter when allies are debuffed.
data.MSG_EVENT_MERRIN_5-2: Furthermore, when an enemy is damaged, Nightsister allies recover Protection, and when an ally is revived, all enemies are inflicted with Plague and all allies gain Instant Defeat Immunity.
data.MSG_EVENT_MISSIONVAO_1-1: [c][F0FF23]DON'T BLINK[-][/c] deals damage and can inflict Daze.
data.MSG_EVENT_MISSIONVAO_2-1: [c][F0FF23]STREET SMARTS[-][/c] grants Mission Stealth, Turn Meter, Dispels all debuffs, and Blinds the target enemy.
data.MSG_EVENT_MISSIONVAO_3-1: [c][F0FF23]NOW YOU SEE ME[-][/c] grants Mission Potency and inflicts a DoT on the target enemy when Mission uses an ability.
data.MSG_EVENT_MISSIONVAO_4-1: [c][F0FF23]ME AND BIG Z FOREVER[-][/c] grants Mission bonuses if Zaalbar is present and causes Mission to assist Zaalbar.
data.MSG_EVENT_MOFFGIDEONS1_1-1: [c][ffff33]Moff Gideon[/c][-] led a faction of Imperial Remnants and now we've got him on the holotables.
data.MSG_EVENT_MOFFGIDEONS1_1-2: Moff Gideon wields the Darksaber and can perform a [c][ffff33]Darksaber Lunge[/c][-]. This will inflict a permanent [c][ffff33]Armor Shred[/c][-] effect on the enemy.
data.MSG_EVENT_MOFFGIDEONS1_2-1: [c][ffff33]Disruptive Shot[/c][-] gives Moff Gideon stacks of [c][ffff33]Insight[/c][-].
data.MSG_EVENT_MOFFGIDEONS1_2-2: When at 4 stacks of Insight, Moff Gideon gains the Special ability [c][ffff33]Subversive Volley[/c][-], damaging and inflicting Daze on all enemies, which can't be resisted by enemies with the Leader tag (even if they are not in the Leader slot).
data.MSG_EVENT_MOFFGIDEONS1_3-1: [c][ffff33]Know Your Adversaries[/c][-] inflicts [c][ffff33]Demoralized[/c][-] on enemies. This debuff will remain on them until the end of the battle or until they or Moff Gideon are defeated.
data.MSG_EVENT_MOFFGIDEONS1_4-1: [c][ffff33]Tactical Deployment[/c][-] grants all allies Max Health and Max Protection if Moff Gideon's squad consists of one Dark Side Tank, two Dark Side Attackers, and one other Dark Side Support.
data.MSG_EVENT_MOFFGIDEONS1_5-1: If it looks like his enemies are going to get the drop on Moff Gideon, he can use [c][ffff33]Control the Situation[/c][-] to reduce all Turn Meters to 0, and then your allies gain turn meter helping you act before your opponents.
data.MSG_EVENT_MONMOTHMA_1-1: [c][ffff33]Mon Mothma[-][/c] is a Rebel Leader that can summon and greatly boost her allies' stats.
data.MSG_EVENT_MONMOTHMA_1-2: [c][ffff33]Advocate For Peace[-][/c] dispels debuffs and recovers Health and Protection for Rebel allies.
data.MSG_EVENT_MONMOTHMA_2-1: [c][ffff33]Restore Our Republic[-][/c] can revive defeated Rebel Fighter allies. It also equalizes Health among Rebel allies and rallies Rebel Fighter allies.
data.MSG_EVENT_MONMOTHMA_3-1: [c][ffff33]Field Promotion[-][/c] summons a Rebel Trooper ally to aid Mon Mothma. Activating it after the summon is already present will upgrade Rebel Trooper's abilities.
data.MSG_EVENT_MONMOTHMA_3-2: When fully upgraded, Rebel Trooper provides notable damage and support to Mon Mothma and Rebel Fighter allies.
data.MSG_EVENT_MONMOTHMA_4-1: [c][ffff33]Alliance Chancellor[-][/c] grants stats to Mon Mothma and Rebel Fighter allies based on their combined base stats.
data.MSG_EVENT_MONMOTHMA_4-2: This ability also enables Mon Mothma and Rebel Fighter allies to assist each other whenever they use an ability during their turn.
data.MSG_EVENT_MONMOTHMA_5-1: [c][ffff33]This Is Our Rebellion[-][/c] grants Mon Mothma additional Speed and can prevent her from being targeted.
data.MSG_EVENT_MORGANELSBETH_1-1: I am excited to announce the arrival of the powerful Nightsister Morgan Elsbeth to the holotables!
data.MSG_EVENT_MORGANELSBETH_1-2: Wield the blade of Talzin while becoming a blessed agent of the Peridea Great Mothers, holding off the enemies through skills and a desire for revenge.
data.MSG_EVENT_NEST_1-1: [c][F0FF23]CUT THROUGH[-][/c] deals damage, dispels Defensive Buffs, and can't be Evaded.
data.MSG_EVENT_NEST_2-1: [c][F0FF23]SUDDEN IMPACT[-][/c] deals damage and inflicts Buff Immunity. If the target has Protection it deals more damage and ignores Armor.
data.MSG_EVENT_NEST_3-1: [c][F0FF23]KINETITE CHARGE[-][/c] deals damage to all enemies, inflicts Daze, and removes Turn Meter from enemies with full Health.
data.MSG_EVENT_NEST_4-1: [c][F0FF23]FIGHTING INSTINCT[-][/c] grants Nest Counter Attack chance, bonus Protection, and Critical Chance when she takes damage until the end of her next turn.
data.MSG_EVENT_NIGHTTROOPER_1-1: I am excited to announce the arrival of the dark and foreboding Night Trooper to the holotables!
data.MSG_EVENT_NIGHTTROOPER_1-2: Inhumanly persistent and reanimated through the sinister majik of the Great Mothers of Peridea, these once loyal soldiers of the Empire march onwards, an unending horde of shambling destruction. They could benefit from an air freshener though...
data.MSG_EVENT_NIHILUS_1-1: Sith Empire Trooper's basic attack, [c][F0FF23]DISRUPTOR BLAST[-][/c], has a chance to inflict [c][F0FF23]DEFENSE DOWN[-][/c]
data.MSG_EVENT_NIHILUS_1-2: [c][F0FF23]CRIMSON BARRAGE[-][/c] is a powerful AoE that bypasses enemy protection
data.MSG_EVENT_NIHILUS_1-3: [c][F0FF23]VAIKEN’S LEGACY[-][/c] is a passive ability that triggers extra buffs when Sith allies use their abilities
data.MSG_EVENT_NIHILUS_2-1: Sith Assassin's basic attack, [c][F0FF23]EXPLOIT WEAKNESS[-][/c], has a chance to inflict [c][F0FF23]EVASION DOWN[-][/c]
data.MSG_EVENT_NIHILUS_2-2: [c][F0FF23]DARK SHROUD[-][/c] grants [c][F0FF23]STEALTH[-][/c]. When stealthed the Sith Assassin is very deadly
data.MSG_EVENT_NIHILUS_2-3: [c][F0FF23]ELECTROCUTE[-][/c] deals more damage for each buff consumed off Sith Assassin. It can also [c][F0FF23]STUN[-][/c] enemies
data.MSG_EVENT_NIHILUS_3-1: Darth Nihilus' basic attack, [c][F0FF23]CEASELESS CRAVING[-][/c], will [c][F0FF23]DISPEL[-][/c] all buffs on his target
data.MSG_EVENT_NIHILUS_3-2: Use [c][F0FF23]DRAIN FORCE[-][/c] against debuffed enemies to decrease the cooldown on [c][F0FF23]ANNIHILATE[-][/c]
data.MSG_EVENT_NIHILUS_3-3: [c][F0FF23]ANNIHILATE[-][/c] is a very powerful ability that [c][F0FF23]INSTANTLY DEFEATS[-][/c] a single enemy. It starts on cooldown
data.MSG_EVENT_NIHILUS_3-4: Darth Nihilus’ leader ability, [c][F0FF23]LORD OF HUNGER[-][/c], makes Sith allies extremely survivable
data.MSG_EVENT_NINTHSISTER_1-1: She survived torture, betrayal, and loss to rise again as a powerful instrument of the Empire. I'm thrilled to bring the relentless and durable Inquisitor, Ninth Sister, to the holotables!
data.MSG_EVENT_NINTHSISTER_1-2: Ninth Sister's Basic attack,[c][ffff33] Too Easy[-][/c], deals Physical damage to target enemy 2 times and inflicts a stack of Purge. If the target is a Jedi, this inflicts a second stack of Purge and can't be resisted.
data.MSG_EVENT_NINTHSISTER_1-3: Purge can be applied up to 6 times to a target enemy. Those stacks are then consumed by Inquisitorius to apply different effects.
data.MSG_EVENT_NINTHSISTER_2-1: Ninth Sister's Special ability,[c][ffff33] Not Worth My Time[-][/c], will consume stacks of Purge on a target enemy, deal Physical damage, apply an equal number of Damage Over Time effects (inflicts damage at the start of their turn) for 1 turn, and grant Ninth Sister an equal number of Heal Over Time effects (recovers Health at the start of their turn) for 1 turn.
data.MSG_EVENT_NINTHSISTER_2-2: If the target enemy is also a Jedi, Ninth Sister will dispel all of their buffs.
data.MSG_EVENT_NINTHSISTER_3-1: Ninth Sister's Special ability, [c][ffff33]Ground Pound[-][/c], deals Physical damage to all enemies, and inflicts Daze (can't assist, counter attack, or gain bonus Turn Meter), Potency Down (debuffs are harder to inflict), and Defense Down (reduced Defense stat) for 2 turns, which can't be resisted by Jedi.
data.MSG_EVENT_NINTHSISTER_3-2: Ninth Sister then gains Taunt for 2 turns. For each enemy inflicted with Purge and damaged by this ability, Ninth Sister gains 10% Defense (stacking, max 50%) for 2 turns.
data.MSG_EVENT_NINTHSISTER_4-1_V2: Inquisitorius allies are immune to Speed limiting effects. Any time an opponent gains bonus Turn Meter (determines how quickly a character can take another turn), all Inquisitorius allies gain 2% Potency (debuffs are harder to resist) and 2% Tenacity (increased chance to resist debuffs) (stacking) for the rest of the encounter. If that enemy is a Jedi, they have a 50% chance to gain a stack of Purge (max 6).
data.MSG_EVENT_NINTHSISTER_4-2: While in Territory Wars, all Empire allies gain 20% Defense and all Inquisitorius allies are immune to Ability Block (can't use Special abilities during their turn) and Stun (can't assist or counter attack and miss their next turn).
data.MSG_EVENT_NINTHSISTER_5-1: For each other Empire ally present at the start of battle, Ninth Sister gains 5% Defense, Max Health, and Tenacity; these effects are doubled for Inquisitorius allies.
data.MSG_EVENT_NINTHSISTER_5-2: Each time another Empire ally is damaged by a critical hit, she gains Taunt and 50% Critical Avoidance for 1 turn, and her allies gain 20% Critical Avoidance for 1 turn. If the ally is also Inquisitorius, Ninth Sister recovers 5% Health.
data.MSG_EVENT_OMEGAS3_1-1: I am pleased to announce the arrival of Omega (Fugitive), the new leader of the Bad Batch to the holotables!
data.MSG_EVENT_OMEGAS3_1-2: Defeat your enemies with both old and new allies that she has met throughout her journey.
data.MSG_EVENT_OPERATIVE_1-1: I am happy to announce the arrival of CX-2 to the holotables!
data.MSG_EVENT_OPERATIVE_1-2: CX-2 operated from the shadows alone, he was a loyal and specialized clone tasked to locate and capture Omega after she escaped Mount Tantiss.
data.MSG_EVENT_PADAWANOBIWAN_1-1: I am excited to announce the arrival of Padawan Obi-Wan to the holotables!
data.MSG_EVENT_PADAWANOBIWAN_1-2: Skilled with a lightsaber and, at times, a bit unorthodox in his methods, Obi-Wan honed his skills under the tutelage of the wisest Jedi Masters of his time, and grew to become a hero of legend in his own right.
data.MSG_EVENT_PADAWANSABINE_1-1: I am pleased to announce that the Mandalorian warrior and Padawan of the storied Ahsoka Tano, Padawan Sabine Wren, is coming to the holotables!
data.MSG_EVENT_PADAWANSABINE_1-2: Sabine was charged by Ezra Bridger to watch over Lothal while he was gone, just moments before taking what he thought was a one-way trip to another galaxy.
data.MSG_EVENT_PAPLOO_1-1: [c][F0FF23]VIGILANT STRIKE[/c][-] attacks an enemy and grants Paploo Defense Up
data.MSG_EVENT_PAPLOO_2-1: [c][F0FF23]DIVERSION[/c][-] inflicts Speed Down, grants Paploo Taunt, and then Speed Up when Taunt expires
data.MSG_EVENT_PAPLOO_3-1: [c][F0FF23]GALVANIZE[/c][-] removes all debuffs from Paploo and target ally and, if the ally was an Ewok, they gain Turn Meter
data.MSG_EVENT_PAPLOO_4-1: Instead of gaining Stealth, [c][F0FF23]DON'T HOLD BACK[/c][-] will grant Paploo Taunt instead
data.MSG_EVENT_PAZVIZSLA_1-1: I am excited to announce the arrival of Paz Vizsla to the holotables! Paz Vizsla was a stalwart warrior clad in resilient beskar armor and a descendant of a long line of leaders from the esteemed House Vizsla.
data.MSG_EVENT_PHOENIX_EZRA_1-1: Ezra's basic, [c][F0FF23]RUSHING STRIKE[-][/c], has a chance to attack a second time
data.MSG_EVENT_PHOENIX_EZRA_1-2: [c][F0FF23]FLOURISH[-][/c] can dispel all buffs on an enemy but also provide benefits when the target has no buffs
data.MSG_EVENT_PHOENIX_EZRA_1-3: [c][F0FF23]WATCH AND LEARN[-][/c] calls an assist from an ally and grants both a bonus effect based on the ally’s class
data.MSG_EVENT_PHOENIX_EZRA_1-4: Ezra's Phoenix passive, [c][F0FF23]PUSH THROUGH[-][/c], gives stacking offense buffs
data.MSG_EVENT_PHOENIX_EZRA_ENC03: Now use Ezra Bridger's abilities to defeat Kanan Jarrus in a training duel!
data.MSG_EVENT_PHOENIX_GHOST_T1_01: Use Hera's [c][F0FF23]BACKUP PLAN[-][/c] ability on a taunting ally such as Kanan or Chopper. If they are defeated while Backup Plan is active, they will be immediately revived.
data.MSG_EVENT_PHOENIX_GHOST_T2_01: Use Ezra's [c][F0FF23]WATCH AND LEARN[-][/c] ability on an attacker such as Sabine and they will both critically strike.
data.MSG_EVENT_PHOENIX_GHOST_T3_01: Use Hera's [c][F0FF23]PLAY TO STRENGTHS[-][/c] ability on Zeb to have him inflict Daze outside his turn. When his turn comes around, he can stun the enemy faster since they are already Dazed.
data.MSG_EVENT_PHOENIX_HERA_1-1: If you damage the Healthiest enemy with Hera's basic attack, [c][F0FF23]OUTWIT[-][/c], will inflict Expose on target enemy.
data.MSG_EVENT_PHOENIX_HERA_1-2: [c][F0FF23]PLAY TO STRENGTHS[-][/c] calls an ally to assist with increased damage and Potency
data.MSG_EVENT_PHOENIX_HERA_1-3: Ally with [c][F0FF23]BACKUP PLAN[-][/c] will recover Health each turn and revive if they are defeated
data.MSG_EVENT_PHOENIX_HERA_1-4: [c][F0FF23]RISE TOGETHER[-][/c] lets Phoenix Squadron allies share their passive abilities with each other and gain Turn Meter whenever they use a special ability
data.MSG_EVENT_PHOENIX_SABINE_1-1: Sabine's basic, [c][F0FF23]BLASTERS AKIMBO[-][/c], hits multiple times on debuffed targets with low Turn Meter
data.MSG_EVENT_PHOENIX_SABINE_1-2: Use [c][F0FF23]DARKSABER STRIKE[-][/c] on high armor targets to permanently reduce their armor
data.MSG_EVENT_PHOENIX_SABINE_1-3: [c][F0FF23]DEMOLISH[-][/c] applies Expose and Stagger on target enemy
data.MSG_EVENT_PHOENIX_SABINE_1-4: [c][F0FF23]TAKE IT BACK[-][/c], Sabine's passive Phoenix ability, grants her additional Critical Chance and Critical Damage
data.MSG_EVENT_PHOENIX_SABINE_ENC04: Use Sabine's [c][F0FF23]DARKSABER STRIKE[-][/c] to reduce TIE Fighter's Armor!
data.MSG_EVENT_PHOENIX_ZEB_1-1: Zeb's basic, [c][F0FF23]BASH[-][/c], inflicts Daze and can also Stun under certain conditions
data.MSG_EVENT_PHOENIX_ZEB_1-2: Use [c][F0FF23]STAGGERING SWEEP[-][/c] to setup turn meter manipulation on dangerous enemies
data.MSG_EVENT_PHOENIX_ZEB_1-3: [c][F0FF23]HONOR GUARD[-][/c] is useful for bolstering the defenses of weaker allies
data.MSG_EVENT_PHOENIX_ZEB_1-4: Zeb's passive, [c][F0FF23]SHRUG OFF[-][/c], increases survivability and provides additional benefits under debuffs
data.MSG_EVENT_princesskneesaa_1-1: Daughter of Chief Chirpa and Ewok warrior of Bright Tree Village, Princess Kneesaa has joined the Holotables! She fought alongside the Rebel Alliance in the Battle of Endor.
data.MSG_EVENT_PUNISHINGONE_1-1: I am excited to announce the arrival of Punishing One to the holotables!
data.MSG_EVENT_PUNISHINGONE_1-2: The Punishing One is a modified JumpMaster 5000, designed and manufactured by the Corellian Engineering corporation and is the personal starship of bounty hunter Dengar.
data.MSG_EVENT_QIRA_0-1: Qi'ra, Young Han Solo, and Vandor Chewbacca can become [c][F0FF23]PREPARED[-][/c].
data.MSG_EVENT_QIRA_0-2: [c][F0FF23]PREPARED[-][/c] is a special effect that adds bonus beneficial effects to some of their abilities.
data.MSG_EVENT_QIRA_0-3: Each character gains [c][F0FF23]PREPARED[-][/c] and uses it differently.
data.MSG_EVENT_QIRA_0-4: Qi’ra, for example, gains [c][F0FF23]PREPARED[-][/c] if a single enemy is critically hit more than once, before the next turn.  Qi’ra can use [c][F0FF23]PREPARED[-][/c] to call on the assistance of all other [c][F0FF23]PREPARED[-][/c] allies.
data.MSG_EVENT_QIRA_0-5: When Vandor Chewbacca is [c][F0FF23]PREPARED[-][/c], he can revive a fallen ally.
data.MSG_EVENT_QIRA_0-6: When Young Han Solo is [c][F0FF23]PREPARED[-][/c], he can give [c][F0FF23]PREPARED[-][/c] to another ally and restore his Protection.
data.MSG_EVENT_QIRA_1-1: [c][F0FF23]DEADLY DOUBLE[-][/c] deals damage and inflicts Offense Down
data.MSG_EVENT_QIRA_2-1: [c][F0FF23]SCATTERING BLAST[-][/c] dispels all buffs on the target enemy, and damages and Staggers all enemies
data.MSG_EVENT_QIRA_3-1: [c][F0FF23]JOINT OPERATION[-][/c] deals damage to an enemy and calls an ally to assist
data.MSG_EVENT_QIRA_4-1: [c][F0FF23]TOOLS OF THE TRADE[-][/c] increases Scoundrel allies Critical Chance and gives them bonuses when they score a critical hit
data.MSG_EVENT_QIRA_5-1: [c][F0FF23]INSULT TO INJURY[-][/c] grants Qi'ra bonus Potency or Critical Chance when attacking depending on if her target is debuffed, and Qi'ra can become [c][F0FF23]PREPARED[-][/c] if a single enemy is Critically hit more than once
data.MSG_EVENT_QUIGGOLD_1-1: I am pleased to announce that the First Mate of the Meson Martinet, Quiggold, has arrived on the holotables.
data.MSG_EVENT_QUIGGOLD_1-2: Quiggold is a Tank for the brand new Pirate faction, he is known for his unwavering loyalty to Captain Ithano.
data.MSG_EVENT_REVAN_1-0: Revan was quite the character. Here you see that Revan, Mission Vao, and Zaalbar teamed up to infiltrate a criminal hideout in order to rescue someone named "Bastila Shan." And that hideout, it turns out, was guarded by a Rancor!
data.MSG_EVENT_REVAN_1-2: It's okay, Big Z. We've got our new friend. We can do this!
data.MSG_EVENT_REVAN_2-0: After they infiltrated the criminal hideout, Revan and the companions freed Bastila Shan, bravely facing the criminals and other seedy types. Records are inconclusive, but it seems like it happened deep in the bowels of the Taris undercity.
data.MSG_EVENT_REVAN_2-1: They've come to rescue the Jedi! Stop them!
data.MSG_EVENT_REVAN_2-2: The Jedi has “rescued” herself, thank you very much.
data.MSG_EVENT_REVAN_3-0: Ahh yes, this is one of my favorites. In order to get off of Taris, Revan and the companions had to fight their way through a Sith base to obtain orbital defense system codes!
data.MSG_EVENT_REVAN_4-0: At one point, it seems like Revan was on Tatooine. According to this, part of it was to save some miners who were under attack from Sand People. I wonder what they were on Tatooine for?
data.MSG_EVENT_REVAN_4-1: I wonder why they are called Sand People. Do you think they’re made of sand?
data.MSG_EVENT_REVAN_4-3: I hadn’t thought of that, you might be onto something.
data.MSG_EVENT_REVAN_4-4: They're attacking! Miners, get into the crawler! Everyone else, defend it!
data.MSG_EVENT_REVAN_5-0: Oh, this sounds fascinating! Revan and the companions were on the planet… Korriban? I’ve never heard of that one. Interesting. It looks like they did a lot while they were there, including a trip into the depths of a Sith tomb where they met a… Sith spirit? What a wild story
data.MSG_EVENT_REVAN_5-1: I'll destroy you and the treasures of this tomb will be mine! Soldiers, attack these interlopers!
data.MSG_EVENT_REVAN_5-2: I sense a strange presence in this tomb. There's something here far more powerful than these Sith.
data.MSG_EVENT_REVAN_5-3: I see a great… light… could it be… Jedi, here?
data.MSG_EVENT_REVAN_5-4: It's a Sith spirit? Wow, you don't see one of those every day. Or ever, really.
data.MSG_EVENT_REVAN_5-5: The spirit's dark power will be mine! Die, Jedi!
data.MSG_EVENT_REVAN_5-6: Your heroism and sacrifice have shown me the light I had so long been blind to...
data.MSG_EVENT_REVAN_5-7: I had regretted for so long... all that I had done...
data.MSG_EVENT_REVAN_5-8: If... If I could return to the light...
data.MSG_EVENT_REVAN_5-9: I held on to that darkness for so long. Now I am free... Thank you, Hero.
data.MSG_EVENT_REVAN_6-0: Ahh, and I rather like this one: On the way out of the Tomb Revan faced a vicious Terentatek! These things are deadly apex predators that are rumored to have a preference for Force users...
data.MSG_EVENT_REVAN_6-1: I've heard about these things, it's a Terentatek.
data.MSG_EVENT_REVAN_6-2: They feed on Force-sensitive beings, be careful.
data.MSG_EVENT_REVAN_CONTEXT_01: I've been dusting off my old military texts and I've come across an interesting story from the Old Republic era. Have you ever heard of REVAN?
data.MSG_EVENT_REVAN_CONTEXT_02: The details of Revan's story are clouded in mystery but I've come up with something I think you'll enjoy. It's called "Legend of the Old Republic".
data.MSG_EVENT_ROGUEONESHIP_1-1: They stole a shuttle, named it Rogue One, and changed the galaxy. Now it’s your turn! I am pleased to announce the arrival of this iconic ship to the holotables.
data.MSG_EVENT_ROGUEONESHIP_1-2: Rogue One was a versatile transport and gunship used by the Rebel Alliance. An Imperial cargo shuttle, Rogue One slipped past enemy lines and helped spark one of the Rebellion’s greatest victories.
data.MSG_EVENT_ROSE_1-1: [c][F0FF23]COURAGEOUS SHOT[-][/c] deals damage and grants Tenacity Up to a random Resistance ally.
data.MSG_EVENT_ROSE_2-1: [c][F0FF23]DAUNTLESS BRAVERY[-][/c] grants Resistance allies Defense Up and Rose gains Turn Meter based on the types of allies and foes
data.MSG_EVENT_ROSE_3-1: [c][F0FF23]SHOCK PROD STRIKE[-][/c] deals damage and Stuns the target, then inflicts Daze when Stun expires
data.MSG_EVENT_ROSE_4-1: [c][F0FF23]VALIANT SPIRIT[-][/c] grants Rose stacking bonus Offense for each Exposed enemy
data.MSG_EVENT_RT_1-1: [c][F0FF23]TAKE AIM[-][/c] deals damage and if Range Trooper is buffed, it deals 30% more damage!
data.MSG_EVENT_RT_2-1: [c][c][F0FF23]STEADY[-][/c] grants all Empire allies Protection Up and then Range Trooper and a random ally attack the selected target. Imperial Troopers also gain other beneficial effects.
data.MSG_EVENT_RT_3-1: [c][c][F0FF23]POWER IN NUMBERS[-][/c] grants Range Trooper bonus Tenacity while buffed and while Range Trooper is active, buffed Imperial Troopers have a 50% chance to call another Imperial Trooper to assist when they use an ability.
data.MSG_EVENT_SANASTARROS_1-1: Sana Starros, Doctor Aphra's sometimes partner, sometimes rival, is headed to the Holotables!
data.MSG_EVENT_SANASTARROS_1-2: Sana was a smuggler and mercenary who found herself working for the Rebellion more than once, but has a penchant for leading Scoundrels during her more interesting jobs.
data.MSG_EVENT_SANASTARROS_1-3: Sana Starros' Basic attack, [c][ffff33]Cheap Shot[-][/c], will inflict Vulnerable (will be critically hit if able) on the target. If they already had Vulnerable, then all enemies are inflicted with it instead.
data.MSG_EVENT_SANASTARROS_2-1: Sana's Special ability, [c][ffff33]Lessons in Coercion[-][/c], will dispel debuffs on non-Tank Rebel allies, as well as herself.
data.MSG_EVENT_SANASTARROS_2-2: It will also give those allies Critical Chance Up (increases chance of an attack being a critical hit) and Stealth (can't be targeted by enemies, unless only Stealthed targets are available), and finally call all Stealthed allies to assist.
data.MSG_EVENT_SANASTARROS_2-3: Rebel Scoundrel Tanks, however, will instead recover 20% Protection when Sana uses this ability.
data.MSG_EVENT_SANASTARROS_3-1: Sana's second Special ability, [c][ffff33]Smart-targeting Scatterblaster[-][/c], will deal damage to all enemies and inflict them with Tenacity Down (lowered chance to resist debuffs).
data.MSG_EVENT_SANASTARROS_3-2: Enemies who were Target Locked (certain abilities have improved interactions against Target Lock) are dealt damage again, and Staggered (lose 100% Turn Meter if damaged by an attack).
data.MSG_EVENT_SANASTARROS_4-1: Sana's Unique ability, [c][ffff33]A Professional I Can Trust...ish[-][/c], gives her counter chance and Critical Chance (increases chance of an attack being a critical hit). Additionally she will assist non-Attacker Rebel Scoundrels who use a Special ability, and recover Protection when doing so.
data.MSG_EVENT_SANASTARROS_4-2: Sana gains Turn Meter whenever an enemy is Target Locked. At the start of Rebel ally's turns, as well as whenever Sana evades an attack or attacks out of turn, non-Scoundrel allies are inflicted with [c][ffff33]Suspicious[-][/c].
data.MSG_EVENT_SANASTARROS_4-3: Suspicious allies lose Speed, but gain 100% Critical Chance.
data.MSG_EVENT_SANASTARROS_5-1: As a Leader, her [c][ffff33]Rebel Sympathizer[-][/c] ability makes Rebel Scoundrel Tanks gain multiple stats, and they may gain Turn Meter (determines how quickly a character can take another turn) when their allies are damaged. Allies may gain bonus stats when they gain bonus Turn Meter.
data.MSG_EVENT_SANASTARROS_5-2: Rebel Scoundrels who remove Turn Meter from enemies will also make them lose Max Health. When Rebel allies and Sana deal damage more than once in a turn, they gain Max Health, and whenever they critically hit, they inflict Target Lock and can reduce Rebel Scoundrel Tanks' cooldowns by 1.
data.MSG_EVENT_SANASTARROS_5-3: In [c][ffff33]Territory Wars[-][/c], Sana's Omicron tier will give immunity to Daze (can't assist, counter attack, or gain bonus Turn Meter), and, at the start of battle, have Rebel Scoundrel Tanks Taunt (enemies must target this character). Scoundrels start with Tenacity Up, and Sana's Target Lock can't be resisted.
data.MSG_EVENT_SANASTARROS_5-4: Additionally her Omicron makes it so whenever Rebel allies and Sana deal damage multiple times in a turn (to one or multiple targets), dispel all buffs on all enemies and inflict Healing Immunity (immune to Health and Protection recovery) on them.
data.MSG_EVENT_SAWGERRERA_1-1: Saw Gerrera, the ruthless militant and eventual leader of the Partisans, has joined the Holotables!
data.MSG_EVENT_SAWGERRERA_1-2: Saw made it his life-long goal to take down the Empire with any method and at any cost.
data.MSG_EVENT_SAWGERRERA_1-3: His Basic ability, [c][ffff33]Critical Shot[-][/c], deals Physical damage to target enemy and inflicts Defense Down (reduced Defense stat). If all allies are Rebel Fighter, the cooldown of [c][ffff33]RPS-6 Rocket Launcher Blast[-][/c] is reduced by 1.
data.MSG_EVENT_SAWGERRERA_2-1: Saw Gerrera's Special ability, [c][ffff33]RPS-6 Rocket Launcher Blast[-][/c], deals Physical damage to all enemies and inflicts Blind (miss the next attack).
data.MSG_EVENT_SAWGERRERA_2-2: This attack decreases the enemy's Offense until the start of Saw's next turn, and heals allies for each Heal Over Time (recovers Health at the start of their turn) dispelled from allies.
data.MSG_EVENT_SAWGERRERA_3-1: Saw Gerrera's Unique ability, [c][ffff33]Adapt and Survive[-][/c], gives Rebel Fighter allies bonuses when they fall below 50% Health. They gain additional bonuses when they recover back to full Health or when their buffs are dispelled.
data.MSG_EVENT_SAWGERRERA_4-1: Saw Gerrera's Leader ability, [c][ffff33]Freedom Isn't Free[-][/c], grants Saw [c][ffff33]Set Explosive Trap[-][/c], a very powerful one time use Granted ability. Saw also grants his Rebel Fighter allies buffs at the cost of their Health at the end of his turn. Additionally, Rebel Fighter allies gain bonuses depending on how much Health they have.
data.MSG_EVENT_SAWGERRERA_4-2: With his Omicron active in the Grand Arenas game mode, Saw increases all enemy cooldowns by 1 and gains a bonus turn when using Set Explosive Trap. Allies also inflict Defense Down on the weakest enemy at the start of their turn, and Marked (enemies must target this character) if there's an enemy with Taunt (enemies must target this character) and Explosive Trap has detonated.
data.MSG_EVENT_SCORCH_1-1: I am happy to announce the arrival of RC-1262 "Scorch" to the holotables!
data.MSG_EVENT_SCORCH_1-2: A sturdy Dark Side Clone Trooper Tank, Scorch pursued the members of Clone Force 99 under orders from Dr. Royce Hemlock.
data.MSG_EVENT_SCOUTTROOPER_1-1: Masters of stealth and reconnaissance, I welcome Scout Trooper to the holotables! They protected the mighty Death Star's generator during the Battle of Endor and were experts at navigating any terrain with speeder bikes.
data.MSG_EVENT_SECONDSISTER_1-1: Tenacious and cunning, this servant of the Empire will stop at nothing to see the last of the Jedi purged from the galaxy. I'm pleased to say that Second Sister, an Inquisitor for the Empire, has arrived at the Holotables!
data.MSG_EVENT_SECONDSISTER_1-2: Second Sister's Basic ability, [c][ffff33]So Much Fear[-][/c], deals Special damage and has a chance to inflict a stack of [c][ffff33]Purge[-][/c] on her target. If the target is a Jedi, this inflicts a second stack of Purge and can't be resisted.
data.MSG_EVENT_SECONDSISTER_1-3: Purge is a new debuff that stacks up to six times. These stacks are consumed by Inquisitorius abilities for extra effects.
data.MSG_EVENT_SECONDSISTER_2-1: Second Sister's ability [c][ffff33]Shall I End This?[-][/c] deals Special damage to target enemy and has extra Defense Penetration (ignores some of a target's Defense stat). If her target is inflicted with any stacks of Purge, this attack also gains increased Critical Chance (increases chance of an attack being a critical hit) and Critical Damage (increases the damage of critical hits).
data.MSG_EVENT_SECONDSISTER_3-1: Second Sister's ability [c][ffff33]Can't Run Forever[-][/c] deals Special damage to target enemy and consumes up to 5 stacks of Purge, removing Turn Meter (determines how quickly a character can take another turn) per stack consumed (20% per stack, up to 100%) from her target, and gaining Turn Meter for herself per stack consumed (10% per stack, up to 50%).
data.MSG_EVENT_SECONDSISTER_3-2: If any stacks of Purge are consumed, this ability has a chance to inflict Stun (can't assist or counter attack and miss their next turn). When 5 stacks of Purge are consumed, the Stun can't be resisted.
data.MSG_EVENT_SECONDSISTER_4-1: Second Sister's Unique Ability, [c][ffff33]Everyone is Expendable[-][/c] grants her permanent buffs whenever an enemy or Empire ally is defeated. She also gains additional Critical Damage and her Special abilities can't be evaded when her target is inflicted with Purge.
data.MSG_EVENT_SECONDSISTER_5-1: Second Sister grants her Empire and Inquisitorius allies increased Offense (increases ability damage). Other Inquisitorius allies have a chance to inflict a stack of Purge on an enemy target with their Basic abilities.
data.MSG_EVENT_SECONDSISTER_5-2: When fully upgraded and in Territory Wars, all enemies start with 2 stacks of Purge at the beginning of battle and Jedi enemies can't recover Health or Protection from Jedi Unique abilities (Excluding Galactic Legends).
data.MSG_EVENT_SEVENTHSISTER_1-1: Despite surviving Order 66, she would become an Imperial assassin, one who was all too eager to hunt down her former allies. Welcome to the Holotables the ruthless and cunning Inquisitor, Seventh Sister!
data.MSG_EVENT_SEVENTHSISTER_1-2: Seventh Sister's Basic ability, [c][ffff33]There You Are[-][/c], deals Physical damage, inflicts Offense Down (decreases ability damage), and inflicts 1 stack of Purge if the target doesn't have any.
data.MSG_EVENT_SEVENTHSISTER_1-3: Purge can be applied up to 6 times to a target enemy. Those stacks are then consumed by Inquisitorius to apply different effects.
data.MSG_EVENT_SEVENTHSISTER_2-1: Seventh Sister's Special ability, [c][ffff33]ID9 Electro Shock-Prod[-][/c], deals Physical damage to target enemy, dispels all buffs, and removes Turn Meter (determines how quickly a character can take another turn).
data.MSG_EVENT_SEVENTHSISTER_2-2: This ability also inflicts Ability Block (can't use Special abilities during their turn), Daze (can't assist, counter attack, or gain bonus Turn Meter), 1 stack of Purge, and 1 additional stack of Purge for each buff dispelled by this ability.
data.MSG_EVENT_SEVENTHSISTER_3-1: Seventh Sister's Special ability, [c][ffff33]ID9 Enemy Intelligence[-][/c], recovers Health and Protection on target ally. Additionally, this ability consumes 1 stack of Purge from each enemy, and target ally recovers additional Health and Protection for each stack of Purge consumed this way.
data.MSG_EVENT_SEVENTHSISTER_3-2: All allies also recover Health and Protection and gain Critical Hit Immunity (can't be critically hit) and Evasion Up (chance to avoid an enemy attack). Inquisitorius allies gain Foresight (the next incoming attack will be evaded if able) and if the target ally is Inquisitorius, this ability's cooldown is reduced by 1.
data.MSG_EVENT_SEVENTHSISTER_4-1: Seventh Sister's Leader ability, [c][ffff33]Guess Again[-][/c], grants Empire allies increased Evasion. When Inquisitorius allies evade, they recover Health and Protection and gain Advantage (the next attack is guaranteed to critically hit if able).
data.MSG_EVENT_SEVENTHSISTER_4-2: While in Territory Wars, whenever an enemy Jedi gains Foresight, all Inquisitorius allies also gain Foresight. At the end of each turn, dispel all buffs on enemy Jedi that have Foresight. Whenever an enemy gains a buff, Seventh Sister has a 10% chance to inflict Purge on that enemy, increased to 20% if enemy is Jedi.
data.MSG_EVENT_SEVENTHSISTER_5-1: Seventh Sister will assist whenever another Inquisitorius ally uses an ability during their turn. Seventh Sister will also inflict debuffs on the target enemy based on how many stacks of Purge they have.
data.MSG_EVENT_SEVENTHSISTER_5-2: If Seventh Sister is in the Leader slot, whenever she assists an Inquisitorius ally, that ally also recovers Health and gains Offense Up.
data.MSG_EVENT_SHAAKTI_1-1: Shaak Ti is a powerful Leader who trains Clone Trooper allies to excel in combat.
data.MSG_EVENT_SHAAKTI_1-2: [c][F0FF23]Courageous Strike[-][/c] deals damage to the target enemy, dispels their buffs and grants all allies Offense Up for a turn.
data.MSG_EVENT_SHAAKTI_2-1: [c][F0FF23]Assault Team[-][/c] dispels all debuffs on allies and calls all Clone Trooper allies to attack.\n\nThe target ally gains buffs based on their role, and if they are a Clone Trooper, they also gain Turn Meter.
data.MSG_EVENT_SHAAKTI_3-1: [c][F0FF23]Training Exercises[-][/c] calls an ally to assist and they attack again if they're a Clone Trooper, then that ally and Shaak Ti recover Health and Protection.\n\nThe ally gains Critical Damage if they're a Clone Trooper or Tenacity if they're a Galactic Republic Jedi.
data.MSG_EVENT_SHAAKTI_4-1: [c][F0FF23]Unity Wins War[-][/c] gives Clone Trooper allies Speed, and Galactic Republic allies gain statistics for each Clone Trooper ally.\n\nClone Trooper allies recover Health and Protection when they attack out of turn.
data.MSG_EVENT_SHAAKTI_5-1: [c][F0FF23]Heightened Reflexes[-][/c] is especially effective when enemies attack Clone Trooper allies.\n\nWhenever Shaak Ti or a Clone Trooper ally takes damage from an attack, they gain Retribution and Shaak Ti gains Turn Meter.
data.MSG_EVENT_SHINHATI_1-1: I am excited to announce the arrival of the lightsaber combatant, and mercenary partner of Baylan Skoll, Shin Hati to the holotables!
data.MSG_EVENT_SHINHATI_1-2: Shin Hati is confident in her lightsaber skills, and her adept use of the Force amplifies her abilities. This allows her to anticipate and counter attacks with seamless fluidity.
data.MSG_EVENT_SION_1-1: [c][F0FF23]DARK RAGE[-][/c] deals Physical damage and inflicts [c][F0FF23]PAIN[-][/c].
data.MSG_EVENT_SION_2-1: [c][F0FF23]TORMENT[-][/c] deals AoE damage, dispels all buffs on enemies, and inflicts [c][F0FF23]PAIN[-][/c].
data.MSG_EVENT_SION_3-1: [c][F0FF23]BREAK WILL[-][/c] deals Physical damage and inflicts [c][F0FF23]PAIN[-][/c].
data.MSG_EVENT_SION_4-1: [c][F0FF23]HELD BY HATRED[-][/c] removes all debuffs on Sion and recovers some of his Health and Turn Meter. Sion then gains [c][F0FF23]HATRED[-][/c] which has many benefits.
data.MSG_EVENT_SION_5-1: [c][F0FF23]LORD OF PAIN[-][/c] grants Sion Defense and Tenacity against enemies afflicted with [c][F0FF23]PAIN[-][/c]. If an enemy has [c][F0FF23]PAIN[-][/c] at the start of their turn, Sion gains Taunt.
data.MSG_EVENT_SITHBOMBER_1-1: [c][F0FF23]LASER BARRAGE[-][/c] deals damage and the B-28 has a chance to gain Defense Up on a Critical Hit
data.MSG_EVENT_SITHBOMBER_2-1: [c][F0FF23]BOMBING RUN[-][/c] deals damage to all enemies and places Concussion Mines on them
data.MSG_EVENT_SITHBOMBER_3-1: [c][F0FF23]HIGH-VALUE TARGET[-][/c] grants the B-28 Taunt the first time Sith allies take damage and any time Sith allies drop below 100% Health, and the B-28 recovers Protection any time a Concussion Mine explodes
data.MSG_EVENT_SITHBOMBER_4-1: [c][F0FF23]BOMBER BACKUP[-][/c] places a Concussion Mine on all enemies when the B-28 enters battle
data.MSG_EVENT_SITHFIGHTER_1-1: [c][F0FF23]STIFLE[-][/c] deals damage and inflicts Healing Immunity
data.MSG_EVENT_SITHFIGHTER_2-1: [c][F0FF23]FIRST STRIKE[-][/c] deals damage, inflicts Health Down, and deals more damage to low health targets
data.MSG_EVENT_SITHFIGHTER_3-1: [c][F0FF23]SWARM TACTICS[-][/c] allows Sith fighter's attacks to bypass Protection on Debuffed enemies
data.MSG_EVENT_SITHFIGHTER_4-1: [c][F0FF23]EXTREME MANEUVERABILITY[-][/c] grants Foresight when entering battle from Reinforcement
data.MSG_EVENT_SMUGGLERCHEWIE_1-1: [c][F0FF23]EXPLOSIVE BOLTS[-][/c] deals damage and will DAZE the target enemy for 2 turns
data.MSG_EVENT_SMUGGLERCHEWIE_2-1: Use [c][F0FF23]FURIOUS BLOW[-][/c] to Stun your target. Speed Down will be applied to the remaining enemies.
data.MSG_EVENT_SMUGGLERCHEWIE_3-1: [c][F0FF23]PARTNER IN CRIME[-][/c] gives Critical Chance to Veteran Smuggler Chewbacca and stacking Critical Damage when Veteran Smuggler Han takes damage.
data.MSG_EVENT_SMUGGLERCHEWIE_4-1: At the start of an enemy turn, [c][F0FF23]LET THE WOOKIEE WIN[-][/c] gives Veteran Smuggler Chewbacca Offense. This effect will stack until he uses an ability.
data.MSG_EVENT_SMUGGLERHAN_1-1: [c][F0FF23]TRUESHOT[-][/c] has a chance to hit twice and inflict STAGGER. If the target is debuffed, the attack chance is doubled.[/c]
data.MSG_EVENT_SMUGGLERHAN_2-1: [c][F0FF23]CAN I TRY THAT?[-][/c] has a chance to Stun the primary target and inflict Ability Block on all enemies
data.MSG_EVENT_SMUGGLERHAN_3-1: [c][F0FF23]PARTNER IN CRIME[-][/c] gives Veteran Smuggler Han bonuses if Veteran Smuggler Chewbacca takes damage or is defeated
data.MSG_EVENT_SMUGGLERHAN_4-1: [c][F0FF23]SWINDLE[-][/c] gives Veteran Smuggler Han bonuses when enemies gain buffs and when he is inflicted with debuffs or gains buffs
data.MSG_EVENT_STAP_1-1: Standing for Single Trooper Aerial Platform, I'm pleased to introduce for the very first time on the Holotables, the STAP!
data.MSG_EVENT_STAP_1-2: Used for scouting missions, this quick repulsorcraft was an invaluable asset for both the Trade Federation and the Separatists during the Clone Wars.
data.MSG_EVENT_STORMTROOPERLUKE_1-1: I am pleased to announce the arrival of Stormtrooper Luke to the holotables.
data.MSG_EVENT_STORMTROOPERLUKE_1-2: Clad in Imperial armor, Stormtrooper Luke leads with courage and quick thinking, guiding his allies with the resolve of a true Rebel hero.
data.MSG_EVENT_T3M4_1-1: [c][F0FF23]DISABLE[-][/c] deals damage and inflicts Ability Block.
data.MSG_EVENT_T3M4_2-1: [c][F0FF23]REPAIR KIT[-][/c] dispels the target ally, and if they are a Droid they are Healed.
data.MSG_EVENT_T3M4_3-1: [c][F0FF23]CARBONITE PROJECTOR[-][/c] deals AoE damage and debuffs the enemy team.
data.MSG_EVENT_T3M4_4-1: [c][F0FF23]COMBAT LOGIC UPGRADE[-][/c] grants T3-M4 bonus stacking Potency and Critical Hit Chance.
data.MSG_EVENT_T3M4_5-1: [c][F0FF23]MASTER GEARHEAD[-][/c] grants T3-M4 bonus Defense Penetration and inflicts Target Lock on enemies.
data.MSG_EVENT_talzin_1-1: [c][F0FF23]ICHOR LIGHTNING[-][/c] deals Special Damage to the selected target, and all targets with [c][F0FF23]PLAGUE[-][/c]
data.MSG_EVENT_talzin_2-1: [c][F0FF23]DARK MAGICK[-][/c] deals Special Damage to all units and inflicts [c][F0FF23]PLAGUE[-][/c]
data.MSG_EVENT_talzin_3-1: [c][F0FF23]SPIRIT BLADE ASSAULT[-][/c] calls all Nightsister allies to assist
data.MSG_EVENT_talzin_4-1: [c][F0FF23]THE GREAT MOTHER[-][/c] grants Nightsister allies Potency, Speed, and causes their abilities to also inflict [c][F0FF23]PLAGUE[-][/c]
data.MSG_EVENT_talzin_5-1: [c][F0FF23]PLAGUEBEARER[-][/c] causes [F0FF23]PLAGUE[-][/c] to spread to other units if Mother Talzin is alive
data.MSG_EVENT_TARFFUL_1-1: Tarfful, chieftain of the Wookiees, who battled alongside Chewbacca and Jedi Master Yoda in the Battle of Kashyyyk has joined the Holotables!
data.MSG_EVENT_TARFFUL_1-2: Tarfful's Basic ability, [c][ffff33]DC-15S Blaster[-][/c], deals Physical damage to target enemy and dispels all buffs on them, while providing Wookiee allies with defensive buffs!
data.MSG_EVENT_TARFFUL_2-1: Tarfful's Special ability, [c][ffff33]Wookiee Fury[-][/c], gives Wookiee allies additional Defense (increased Defense stat, which reduces incoming damage) and calls them to assist, Stunning (can't assist or counter attack and miss their next turn) a target enemy.
data.MSG_EVENT_TARFFUL_2-2: After Wookiee allies assist, ally Attackers gain Critical Damage Up (increases the damage of critical hits), ally Healers and Supports gain Speed Up (takes turns more often), and ally Tanks Taunt (enemies must target this character).
data.MSG_EVENT_TARFFUL_3-1: Tarfful's Special ability [c][ffff33]Rrrruuuurrr[-][/c], dispels all debuffs on all allies, and then they gain Critical Damage Up. Wookiee allies gain Potency Up (debuffs are harder to resist), Tenacity Up (increased chance to resist debuffs), and Max Health. Then, inflict enemies with Provoked (increased counter chance, reduced damage from out of turn attacks, and receive damage when attacking out of turn).
data.MSG_EVENT_TARFFUL_4-1: Tarfful's Unique ability [c][ffff33]Better Together[-][/c] gives Tarfful Speed and Tenacity. When an ally has a buff dispelled, Tarfful gains Turn Meter (determines how quickly a character can take another turn).
data.MSG_EVENT_TARFFUL_4-2: If there are at least 3 ally Wookiees, all allies gain Speed when enemies attack out of turn. Whenever a Wookiee ally gains Health Up, all allies recover Health, Protection and gain Advantage (the next attack is guaranteed to critically hit if able). Whenever a Wookiee ally has Retribution (will counter attack when damaged), Wookiee allies apply a stack of Damage Over Time (takes damage each turn) when they use a Basic ability.
data.MSG_EVENT_TARFFUL_4-3: If Veteran Smuggler Chewbacca is an ally, when Tarfful uses [c][ffff33]Rrrruuuurrr[-][/c], Veteran Smuggler Han Solo also gains the effects.
data.MSG_EVENT_TARFFUL_5-1: Tarfful's Leader ability, [c][ffff33]It's All in the Fur[-][/c], gives Taunt to allied Wookiee Tanks and increases Defense and Max Health to all allies. Wookiee allies gain bonus Offense based on the amount of Defense they have! If there were no Galactic Legend enemies, when Wookiee allies are critically hit, they reflect a portion of that damage back to the enemy.
data.MSG_EVENT_TARFFUL_5-2: With Tarfful's Omicron active in the Territory Wars game mode, this ability provides additional Defense and buffs to Wookiee allies when they are critically hit. If a Wookiee is defeated in battle, Wookiee allies recover their Health and gain additional Offense.
data.MSG_EVENT_THEMANDALORIAN_1-1: The Mandalorian is a Light Side Bounty Hunter with a special granted ability once when he gains his Payout.
data.MSG_EVENT_THEMANDALORIAN_1-2: [c][F0FF23]Swift Shot[-][/c] deals Physical damage to target enemy and the Mandalorian gains Critical Chance Up.
data.MSG_EVENT_THEMANDALORIAN_2-1: [c][F0FF23]Transpierce[-][/c] deals Physical damage to target enemy and calls another target Bounty Hunter ally to assist.
data.MSG_EVENT_THEMANDALORIAN_3-1: [c][F0FF23]Asset Acquisition[-][/c] gives all Scoundrel allies Speed, Tenacity and Critical Chance.
data.MSG_EVENT_THEMANDALORIAN_3-2: The Mandalorian's Contract: Bounty Hunter allies who score critical hits while buffed contribute to the Mandalorian's Contract. Once completed, Bounty Hunter allies gain extra Offense and Health Steal for each buffed ally while attacking.
data.MSG_EVENT_THEMANDALORIAN_4-1: With [c][F0FF23]Disciplined Bounty Hunter[-][/c], each time the Mandalorian scores a critical hit, he gains bonus Turn Meter. At the start of encounter, the Mandalorian has Bounty Hunter's Resolve until he is defeated.
data.MSG_EVENT_THEMANDALORIAN_5-1: When the Mandalorian gains his Payout, he gains Critical Damage and the Special ability [c][F0FF23]Disintegrate[-][/c] until the end of battle. If the Mandalorian does not have Critical Chance Up or Critical Damage Up at the start of his turn, [c][F0FF23]Disintegrate[-][/c] can't be used.
data.MSG_EVENT_THEMANDALORIAN_5-2: [c][F0FF23]Disintegrate[-][/c] instantly defeats the target enemy, which can't be evaded. Enemies defeated by this ability can't be revived. Each time the Mandalorian scores a critical hit while buffed, the cooldown of [c][F0FF23]Disintegrate[-][/c] is reduced.
data.MSG_EVENT_TIESILENCER_1-1: [c][F0FF23]DISRUPTIVE ADVANCE[-][/c] deals damage and enemies with 50% Turn Meter, or higher, are Stunned
data.MSG_EVENT_TIESILENCER_2-1: [c] If the TIE silencer has Advantage, [c][F0FF23]OVERWHELMING ADVANTAGE[-][/c] does increased damage and grants Foresight if the opponent dies
data.MSG_EVENT_TIESILENCER_3-1: [c] If the TIE silencer is damaged, or damages an enemy with Target Lock, [c][F0FF23]FRENZIED RAGE[-][/c] grants Speed and Offense Up (stacking)
data.MSG_EVENT_TUSKENCHIEFTAIN_1-1: Tusken Chieftain, leader of the tribe of Tuskens that took in Boba Fett, has joined the Holotables!
data.MSG_EVENT_TUSKENCHIEFTAIN_1-2: A strong leader who seeks to protect their people from the encroachment of newcomers to Tatooine, such as the Pykes.
data.MSG_EVENT_TUSKENCHIEFTAIN_1-3: Their Basic ability, [c][ffff33]Ceremonial Dance[-][/c], calls an ally to assist, dealing bonus damage, and grants Tuskens 2 stacks of Momentum (abilities gain additional effects).
data.MSG_EVENT_TUSKENCHIEFTAIN_2-1: Chieftain's Special ability, [c][ffff33]Token of Respect[-][/c], dispels debuffs on Tusken allies, grants them Protection Up (grants bonus Protection), and lowers their cooldowns.
data.MSG_EVENT_TUSKENCHIEFTAIN_3-1: Chieftain's Unique ability, [c][ffff33]Ancestral Claim[-][/c], inflicts Damage Over Time (inflicts damage at the start of their turn) on enemies when they heal.
data.MSG_EVENT_TUSKENCHIEFTAIN_3-2: Whenever an enemy takes damage from Damage Over Time, Tusken allies recover Health.
data.MSG_EVENT_TUSKENCHIEFTAIN_4-1: Chieftain's Leader ability, [c][ffff33]Nomadic People[-][/c], grants Tusken allies stacks of Momentum when enemies gain bonus Turn Meter (determines how quickly a character can take another turn). Tusken allies gain Defense and Tenacity from stacks of Momentum.
data.MSG_EVENT_TUSKENCHIEFTAIN_4-2: Whenever a Tusken ally with 10 or more stacks of Momentum is targeted, that enemy is Stunned (can't assist or counter attack and miss their next turn) and gains stacks of Damage Over Time. The targeted ally then loses their stacks of Momentum.
data.MSG_EVENT_TUSKENCHIEFTAIN_4-3: With their Omicron active in the 3v3 Grand Arenas game mode, Tusken Chieftain makes Boba Fett, Scion of Jango, a member of the tribe. Boba counts as a Tusken and does not lose stacks of Momentum when targeted.
data.MSG_EVENT_TUSKENHUNTRESS_1-1: Tusken Warrior, a fierce fighter from the tribe of Tuskens that took in Boba Fett, has joined the Holotables!
data.MSG_EVENT_TUSKENHUNTRESS_1-2: She is a strong fighter who won't hesitate to protect her tribe from any threat.
data.MSG_EVENT_TUSKENHUNTRESS_1-3: Her Basic ability, [c][ffff33]Gaderffii Smack[-][/c], deals Physical damage to target enemy and inflicts Damage Over Time (inflicts damage at the start of their turn). If she has Momentum (abilities gain additional effects), she attacks again.
data.MSG_EVENT_TUSKENHUNTRESS_2-1: Tusken Warrior's Special ability, [c][ffff33]Tusken Charge[-][/c], grants Critical Damage Up (increases critical damage of attacks) and Momentum, then deals Physical damage, inflicts Defense Down (reduced Defense stat), and dispels all buffs on all enemies.
data.MSG_EVENT_TUSKENHUNTRESS_3-1: Tusken Warrior's Special Ability, [c][ffff33]Finishing Strikes[-][/c], deals Physical damage and inflicts Damage Over Time. Deal damage an additional time (up to 5 times, 50% less damage, and can't be countered) for each stack of Momentum removed from Tusken Warrior.
data.MSG_EVENT_TUSKENHUNTRESS_3-2: The ability has extra effects depending on how many Momentum stacks Tusken Warrior has.
data.MSG_EVENT_TUSKENHUNTRESS_4-1: Tusken Warrior's Unique ability, [c][ffff33]Centuries of Tradition[-][/c], grants her extra damage for each instance of Damage Over Time on all enemies, and all enemies lose Tenacity whenever Damage Over Time expires. Whenever Momentum is removed during an enemies turn, she gains 10 stacks of Momentum.
data.MSG_EVENT_TUSKENHUNTRESS_4-2: With her Omicron active in the Territory Wars game mode, Tusken Warrior dispels all debuffs on herself, the cooldown of Finishing Strikes is reset, and she gains a bonus turn once she reaches 15 stacks of Momentum.
data.MSG_EVENT_TUTORIAL_LORE_01: I asked Shar to add some [c][F0FF23]Lore[-][/c] entries for this event. Be sure to let him know if you enjoy them.
data.MSG_EVENT_UNDERCOVERLANDO_1-1: Greetings Holotable Heroes! I am pleased to introduce Skiff Guard (Lando Calrissian). This cunning scoundrel was able to infiltrate Jabba's Palace and earn the respect of the Hutt himself during a daring rescue operation on Tatooine, and now his skills are yours to command on the Holotables!
data.MSG_EVENT_UNDERCOVERLANDO_1-2: Skiff Guard (Lando Calrissian)'s Basic ability, [c][ffff33]Double Dealer[-][/c], deals Physical damage to target enemy and grants Skiff Guard (Lando Calrissian) a stack of [c][ffff33]Deep Cover[-][/c].
data.MSG_EVENT_UNDERCOVERLANDO_1-3: Deep Cover grants extra Defense Penetration (ignores some of the target's Defense stat) and Potency per stack (max 5).
data.MSG_EVENT_UNDERCOVERLANDO_2-1: Skiff Guard (Lando Calrissian)'s Special ability, [c][ffff33]Cutter vibro-ax[-][/c], deals Physical damage to the target enemy. This ability gains Defense Penetration and Offense for each stack of Deep Cover that Skiff Guard (Lando Calrissian) has.
data.MSG_EVENT_UNDERCOVERLANDO_2-2: When Skiff Guard (Lando Calrissian) uses this ability while he has 5 stacks of Deep Cover, he will inflict the target enemy with Armor Shred (reduced Defense stat) until the end of battle, multiple stacks of Damage Over Time (inflicts damage at the start of their turn), and this ability has a chance to refresh its cooldowns.
data.MSG_EVENT_UNDERCOVERLANDO_3-1: Skiff Guard (Lando Calrissian)'s Special ability, [c][ffff33]Covert Coordination[-][/c], dispels debuffs on the target ally and grants them stacks of Deep Cover equal to the amount on Skiff Guard (Lando Calrissian) along with a variety of buffs.
data.MSG_EVENT_UNDERCOVERLANDO_3-2: If the target ally is Light Side, they gain Potency Up (debuffs are harder to resist) and Stealth (can't be targeted by enemies, unless only Stealthed targets are available). If the target ally is Dark Side, they gain Defense Up (increased Defense stat, which reduces incoming damage) and Health Up (increases Max Health). If the target ally is Hutt Cartel, they also gain Speed Up (takes turns more often) and Retribution (will counter attack when damaged).
data.MSG_EVENT_UNDERCOVERLANDO_3-3: When Covert Coordination is used, the target ally will also be called to assist and they will gain a bonus turn.
data.MSG_EVENT_UNDERCOVERLANDO_4-1: Skiff Guard (Lando Calrissian) gains Defense Penetration with [c][ffff33]Agent On The Inside[-][/c], and grants Defense Penetration and Potency to any allies with any stacks of Deep Cover. At the start of Skiff Guard (Lando Calrissian)'s turn, he gains a stack of Deep Cover. If all allies were Hutt Cartel at the start of battle, Skiff Guard (Lando Calrissian) immediately gains 5 stacks of Deep Cover.
data.MSG_EVENT_UNDERCOVERLANDO_4-2: While Skiff Guard (Lando Calrissian) has 5 stacks of Deep Cover, he gains the granted ability [c][ffff33]Hutt's Favor[-][/c], which consumes all stacks of Deep Cover on Skiff Guard (Lando Calrissian) and deals Physical damage to the target enemy. This ability will deal more damage based on the number of debuffs the enemy has, and will grant Skiff Guard (Lando Calrissian) [c][ffff33]Trusted Agent[-][/c].
data.MSG_EVENT_UNDERCOVERLANDO_4-3: Skiff Guard (Lando Calrissian) gains Defense Penetration and Offense for each stack of Trusted Agent that he has. While Skiff Guard (Lando Calrissian) has at least one stack of Trusted Agent active, he will attack again when using his Basic attack.
data.MSG_EVENT_UNDERCOVERLANDO_4-4: While in Territory Wars, allies gain additional bonuses while they have Deep Cover, and whenever Skiff Guard (Lando Calrissian) gains a stack of Deep Cover, he grants a stack of Deep Cover to an ally that doesn't have it.
data.MSG_EVENT_VADERDUELSEND_1-1: Fueled by a burning rage, an unstoppable Sith Lord arrives. I'm thrilled to welcome Darth Vader (Duel's End) to the holotables!
data.MSG_EVENT_VADERDUELSEND_1-2: Feared across the galaxy for his ruthlessness, Darth Vader (Duel's End) marked the final transformation of Anakin - the Jedi hero, into 'Darth Vader'- the Empire's powerful enforcer.
data.MSG_EVENT_VANE_1-1: A ruthless Lieutenant, feared across the Outer Rim, I'm excited to bring the deadly Pirate, Vane to the holotables!
data.MSG_EVENT_VANE_1-2: Vane was notorious for his unshakable loyalty, sharp tongue, and deadly aim.
data.MSG_EVENT_VANGUARDTEMPLEGUARD_1-1: Picked discreetly from the ranks of the Jedi, these silent guardians stand ready against any foe. Join me in welcoming Temple Guard to the holotables!
data.MSG_EVENT_VANGUARDTEMPLEGUARD_1-2: Known for their double-bladed yellow lightsabers and distinctive face masks, the Temple Guards were Jedi Knights dedicated to the protection of the Jedi Temple.
data.MSG_EVENT_VCHEWBACCA_1-1: [c][F0FF23]UNCHAINED[-][/c] deals damage, grants Chewbacca Advantage, and ignores Defense.
data.MSG_EVENT_VCHEWBACCA_2-1: [c][F0FF23]FREEDOM FIGHTER[-][/c] deals damage to the enemy twice, target ally recovers health, and both Chewbacca and the Ally gain Protection Up. If Chewbacca is [c][F0FF23]PREPARED[-][/c] this Ability has bonus beneficial effects
data.MSG_EVENT_VCHEWBACCA_3-1: [c][F0FF23]THE BEAST[-][/c] reduces Chewbacca's maximum Protection, but increases his Maximum Health.
data.MSG_EVENT_VCHEWBACCA_4-1: [c][F0FF23]FEROCIOUS PROTECTOR[-][/c] grants Chewbacca counter chance when buffed, and allows him to recover Protection if allies took damage and he did not.
data.MSG_EVENT_VEL_1-1: I am excited to announce the arrival of a determined Rebel commander, [c][ffff33]Vel Sartha[-][/c], to the holotables.
data.MSG_EVENT_VEL_1-2: Measured and unyielding, Vel commands high-risk Rebel missions, knowing every victory against the Empire demands sacrifice.
data.MSG_EVENT_VISAS_1-1: [c][F0FF23]TELEKINETIC BLAST[-][/c] deals Physical damage and dispels all debuffs on Visas and another random debuffed ally.
data.MSG_EVENT_VISAS_2-1: [c][F0FF23]DARK HEALING[-][/c] deals Physical damage to all enemies. All allies gain Health Steal Up and recover some of their Health.
data.MSG_EVENT_VISAS_3-1: [c][F0FF23]PIERCING STRIKE[-][/c] deals Physical damage and grants all allies Defense Penetration Up.
data.MSG_EVENT_VISAS_4-1: [c][F0FF23]RETURNED TO THE LIGHT[-][/c] grants Visas Counter Chance when she isn’t debuffed.
data.MSG_EVENT_VULTUREDROID_1-1: The Vulture Droid is a nimble Separatist Attacker that hinders enemy ships with Buzz Droids and calls in backup when defeated.
data.MSG_EVENT_VULTUREDROID_1-2: [c][F0FF23]Unrelenting Attack[-][/c] deals damage to the target enemy. This damage doesn't remove Buzz Droids.
data.MSG_EVENT_VULTUREDROID_2-1: [c][F0FF23]Discord Missile[-][/c] deals damage to the target enemy and inflicts [c][F0FF23]Buzz Droids[-][/c]. Buzz Droids can't be copied or resisted.
data.MSG_EVENT_VULTUREDROID_2-2: A ship inflicted with Buzz Droids has lowered Defense and takes damage over time. They lose a Buzz Droid by taking damage.
data.MSG_EVENT_VULTUREDROID_3-1: With [c][F0FF23]Swarming Terror[-][/c], the Vulture Droid will assist every time a Separatist or Droid ally attacks an enemy inflicted with Buzz Droids.
data.MSG_EVENT_VULTUREDROID_3-2: If an enemy has at least 1 Buzz Droid on them at the start of their turn, the stack resets.
data.MSG_EVENT_VULTUREDROID_3-3: When fully upgraded, the first time the Vulture Droid is defeated, another is summoned if the allied Capital Ship is Separatist.
data.MSG_EVENT_VULTUREDROID_4-1: [c][F0FF23]Buzz Droid Barrage[-][/c] inflicts all enemies with Buzz Droids when the Vulture Droid reinforces.
data.MSG_EVENT_WICKET_1-1: [c][F0FF23]INQUISITIVE JAB[/c][-] attacks an enemy and grants Wicket Critical Chance Up
data.MSG_EVENT_WICKET_2-1: [c][F0FF23]FOREST AMBUSH[/c][-] attacks all enemies and also grants Turn Meter for each critical hit
data.MSG_EVENT_WICKET_3-1: [c][F0FF23]GUERILLA STRIKE[/c][-] grants Wicket and target Ewok ally Stealth
data.MSG_EVENT_WICKET_4-1: [c][F0FF23]FURTIVE TACTICS[/c][-] grants Wicket critical damage per Ewok or Stealthed ally, and give him a chance to act again
data.MSG_EVENT_WRECKERS3_1-1: I am pleased to announce the arrival of Wrecker (Mercenary) to the holotables!
data.MSG_EVENT_WRECKERS3_1-2: Get up close and personal with your enemies and teach them a lesson they won't forget.
data.MSG_EVENT_XANADU_2-1: [c][F0FF23]ROGUE MANEUVER[-][/c] deals damage to all enemies, Target Locks the weakest enemy, then calls an ally to assist.
data.MSG_EVENT_XANADU_3-1: [c][F0FF23]CLOAK AND DAGGER[-][/c] lowers the Offense of Breached enemies and gives Xanadu Blood Stealth at the start of an Encounter or when an ally is Critically hit.
data.MSG_EVENT_XANADU_4-1: [c][F0FF23]INTO THE BREACH[-][/c] inflicts BREACH on the target enemy when entering from Reinforcement.
data.MSG_EVENT_YHAN_1-1: [c][F0FF23]TRICK SHOT[-][/c] deals damage and inflicts Speed Down. If target is below 25% Turn Meter gain [c][F0FF23]PREPARED[-][/c]. [c][F0FF23]PREPARED[-][/c] is a special Effect that some characters can use to enhance their Abilities
data.MSG_EVENT_YHAN_2-1: [c][F0FF23]UPPER HAND[-][/c] grants Han Protection Up, Retribution, and stacking Speed.
data.MSG_EVENT_YHAN_3-1: [c][F0FF23]JUST IN TIME[-][/c] deals damage and 25% more damage for each Prepared ally. If Han has [c][F0FF23]PREPARED[-][/c] he grants it to target ally and all Prepared allies gain bonuses
data.MSG_EVENT_YHAN_4-1: [c][F0FF23]READY FOR ANYTHING[-][/c] grants Han stacking Offense and Critical Chance when starting a turn with Protection Up.
data.MSG_EVENT_YLANDO_1-1: [c][F0FF23]SILENT SHOT[-][/c] deals damage, inflicts Potency Down, and deals 25% more damage for each [c][F0FF23]PREPARED[-][/c] ally.
data.MSG_EVENT_YLANDO_2-1: [c][F0FF23]HOT HAND[-][/c] deals damage and inflicts Ability Block. For each debuffed enemy there is a 50% chance to reduce the cooldown of [c][F0FF23]HOT HAND[-][/c]
data.MSG_EVENT_YLANDO_3-1: [c][F0FF23]DEALER'S CHOICE[-][/c] dispels an ally, and Young Lando Calrissian gains Turn Meter. If Young Lando Calrissian is [c][F0FF23]PREPARED[-][/c] he grants it to that ally and all Prepared allies gain Speed Up
data.MSG_EVENT_YLANDO_4-1: Young Lando Calrissian's Unique ability, [c][F0FF23]PERFECT TIMING[-][/c], gives him a chance to become [c][F0FF23]PREPARED[-][/c] at the start of his turn, and grants Critical Chance and Critical Damage to himself if he is buffed or [c][F0FF23]PREPARED[-][/c].
data.MSG_EVENT_YODACHEWBACCA_1-1: I am happy to announce the arrival of Yoda & Chewie to the holotables!
data.MSG_EVENT_YODACHEWBACCA_1-2: Yoda & Chewie were legendary heroes who fought to defend the Republic during the Clone Wars and beyond.
data.MSG_EVENT_YWINGCLONEWARS_1-1: The Y-wing is a durable Galactic Republic Tank that has an activated Taunt on its Special ability and can withstand a high amount of damage.
data.MSG_EVENT_YWINGCLONEWARS_1-2: [c][F0FF23]Twin Laser Cannons[-][/c] deals Physical damage to the target enemy, dealing more damage for each ally with Valor.
data.MSG_EVENT_YWINGCLONEWARS_2-1: [c][F0FF23]Torpedoes Away![-][/c] deals Physical damage to the target enemy and weakest enemy, and can't be evaded.
data.MSG_EVENT_YWINGCLONEWARS_2-2: In addition, the Y-wing also gains Taunt and Protection Up for 2 turns.
data.MSG_EVENT_YWINGCLONEWARS_3-1: With [c][F0FF23]Astromech Advantage[-][/c], the Y-wing has increased Max Protection for each Galactic Republic ally, including reinforcements.
data.MSG_EVENT_YWINGCLONEWARS_3-2: The Y-wing also recovers Health when a Galactic Republic ally is critically hit, and Taunts when the effects of Unending Loyalty are triggered.
data.MSG_EVENT_YWINGCLONEWARS_4-1: [c][F0FF23]Backup Procedure[-][/c] grants the Y-wing Taunt when it reinforces.
data.MSG_EVENT_ZAALBAR_1-1: [c][F0FF23]STALWART ALLY[-][/c] damages target enemy and Zaalbar recovers Health.
data.MSG_EVENT_ZAALBAR_2-1: [c][F0FF23]POWER BLAST[-][/c] damages all enemies and grants Taunt.
data.MSG_EVENT_ZAALBAR_3-1: [c][F0FF23]WOOKIEE TOUGHNESS[-][/c] grants Defense (stacking) whenever Zaalbar takes damage until the end of his next turn.
data.MSG_EVENT_ZAALBAR_4-1: [c][F0FF23]MISSION'S GUARDIAN[-][/c] grants Critical Avoidance to Zaalbar and Mission. Zaalbar gains Taunt and Retribution when an ally falls below Max Health.
data.MSG_EVENT_ZAALBAR_5-1: Mission and Zaalbar start with Critical Avoidance thanks to [c][F0FF23]MISSION'S GUARDIAN[-][/c], while [c][F0FF23]WOOKIEE ENDURANCE[-][/c] will help Zaalbar to survive the onslaught.
data.MSG_EVENT_ZORIIBLISS_1-1: Zorii Bliss, the cunning head of the Spice Runners of Kijimi, has joined the Holotables!
data.MSG_EVENT_ZORIIBLISS_1-2: A scoundrel and smuggler who ran spice, she attempted to remain neutral despite the growing hostility of the First Order, but was forced to choose a side when an old acquaintance came to her for help.
data.MSG_EVENT_ZORIIBLISS_1-3: Her Basic ability, [c][ffff33]Twin E-851 Blasters[-][/c], deals damage to the target enemy with additional bonuses if Zorii is Stealthed (can't be targeted by enemies, unless only Stealthed targets are available).
data.MSG_EVENT_ZORIIBLISS_2-1: Zorii's Special ability, [c][ffff33]Captain's Medallion[-][/c], dispels debuffs on Resistance allies, provides benefits for those debuffs being dispelled, allows her to gain Stealth, and calls Resistance allies to assist.
data.MSG_EVENT_ZORIIBLISS_3-1: With Zorii's second Special ability, [c][ffff33]I've Done Worse For a Lot Less[-][/c], she will deal damage to an enemy target with extra damage for each Expose (receives additional damage from attacks) that was triggered. If an enemy was Exposed, Zorii Stuns (can't assist or counter attack and miss their next turn) them, and if she defeats an enemy with this ability, she Exposes all enemies.
data.MSG_EVENT_ZORIIBLISS_4-1: Zorii's first Unique ability, [c][ffff33]There's More of Us[-][/c], provides stat boosts for Resistance allies with different boosts based on the number of allies and enemies. Resistance allies gain Tenacity Up (increased chance to resist debuffs) when any of them gain it, and receive additional benefits while they have Tenacity Up.
data.MSG_EVENT_ZORIIBLISS_4-2: With her Omicron active in the Grand Arenas game mode, whenever Zorii is Stealthed at the start of her turn, all enemies who don't have Expose will become Exposed.
data.MSG_EVENT_ZORIIBLISS_5-1: [c][ffff33]Spice Runner Skills[-][/c] provides benefits for allies whenever they trigger an Expose on enemies. It also gives your allies Turn Meter and additional buffs the first time they fall below full Health.
data.MSG_EVENT_ZUCKUSS_1-1: I am excited to announce that the enigmatic Gand Bounty Hunter [c][ffff33]ZUCKUSS[-][/c] is joining the holotables.
data.MSG_EVENT_ZUCKUSS_1-2: Zuckuss is a prophetic Findsman and unyielding Bounty Hunter, using mystic visions to turn the tide of any hunt.
data.MSG_FOTF_DEVASTATOR_01: This event lets you use the ruthless Darth Vader to command his Capital Ship, the Devastator.
data.MSG_FOTF_DEVASTATOR_02: Vader's Devastator is similar to the Executrix, but provides its bonuses to all ships under your command and dispels all buffs on the target enemy when you call a reinforcement. Use this knowledge to your advantage!
data.MSG_FOTF_DEVASTATOR_03: Keep in mind that the Devastator is only available to you in this event, so you will not be able to obtain or use it in any other event or game mode.
data.MSG_GALACTIC_BOUNTY_INTRO_01: This is the new [c][F0FF23]GALACTIC BOUNTY[-][/c] event! The bounties are arranged from [c][F0FF23]EASY[-][/c] to [c][F0FF23]DEADLY[-][/c].
data.MSG_GALACTIC_BOUNTY_INTRO_02: Use your [c][F0FF23]BOUNTY HUNTERS[-][/c] to complete this event and earn character shards!
data.MSG_GALACTIC_BOUNTY_INTRO_03: Be careful with the [c][F0FF23]DEADLY[-][/c] bounties though. Only a very powerful squad will be able to complete those.
data.MSG_GALACTIC_BOUNTY_INTRO_04: You can capture [c][F0FF23]2[-][/c] bounties each time the event is live. Good Luck!
data.MSG_GLE_PIRATEKINGHONDO_4-1: I’ve escaped warlords, debt collectors, and the Jedi. Hoth? Please. That was just... inconvenient.
data.MSG_GLE_PIRATEKINGHONDO_5-1: They say legends were forged on Endor. I say...some of us were already legendary!
data.MSG_GLE_PIRATEKINGHONDO_6-1: So there I am—blizzards, blasters, a Wookiee howling in grief—and these two youngsters want to storm the base. I just came to steal a shuttle!
data.MSG_GLE_PIRATEKINGHONDO_6-2: They get the credit, I get the carbon scoring. Typical. Save the day, dodge the explosions, no statue!
data.MSG_GLEVENT_AHSOKA_1-1: Let's hope all that training pays off.
data.MSG_GLEVENT_AHSOKA_2-1: Back into the Order, you may come.
data.MSG_GLEVENT_AHSOKA_2-2: They're asking you back Ahsoka. I'm asking you back.
data.MSG_GLEVENT_AHSOKA_2-3: I'm sorry master, but I'm not coming back.
data.MSG_GLEVENT_AHSOKA_3-1: The Emperor will show you mercy, if you tell me where the remaining Jedi can be found.
data.MSG_GLEVENT_AHSOKA_3-2: Revenge is not the Jedi way.
data.MSG_GLEVENT_CINEMATIC_PALP_T4: Nothing will stop the return of the Sith.
data.MSG_GLEVENT_CINEMATIC_PALPLUKE_T3: Now, young Skywalker, you will die.
data.MSG_GLEVENT_JABBA_1-2: I'll pay you triple! You're throwing away a fortune here. Don't be a fool!
data.MSG_GLEVENT_JABBA_2-1: You will bring Captain Solo and the Wookiee to me.
data.MSG_GLEVENT_JABBA_2-2: Ya koo tocha ka poonoo nee sok nyee (Your mind powers will not work on me, boy.)
data.MSG_GLEVENT_JEDIMASTERLUKE_1-1: The great Jabba the Hutt will now listen to your pleas.
data.MSG_GLEVENT_JEDIMASTERLUKE_1-2: Threepio, you tell that slimy piece of worm-ridden filth he'll get no such pleasure from us.
data.MSG_GLEVENT_JEDIMASTERLUKE_1-5: Jabba, this is your last chance. Free us, or die.
data.MSG_GLEVENT_JEDIMASTERLUKE_2-1: Artoo where are you? We need you at the bunker right away.
