data.MSG_GLEVENT_JEDIMASTERLUKE_2-4: Going where, Artoo? No, wait!\n\nThis is no time for heroics! Come back!
data.MSG_GLEVENT_JEDIMASTERLUKE_3-1: I feel your anger.\n\nI am defenseless. Take your weapon.
data.MSG_GLEVENT_JEDIMASTERLUKE_3-2: Strike me down with all of your hatred and your journey towards the dark side will be complete.
data.MSG_GLEVENT_JEDIMASTERLUKE_4-1: I failed you Ben, I'm sorry.
data.MSG_GLEVENT_JEDIMASTERLUKE_4-2: I'm sure you are! The resistance is dead. The war is over. And when I kill you, I will have killed the last Jedi.
data.MSG_GLEVENT_JEDIMASTERLUKE_4-3: Amazing. Every word of what you just said was wrong.\n\nThe Rebellion is reborn today. The war is just beginning.
data.MSG_GLEVENT_JEDIMASTERLUKE_4-4: And I will not be the last Jedi.
data.MSG_GLEVENT_JMK_3-1: I've recalibrated the code warning all surviving Jedi to stay away.
data.MSG_GLEVENT_JMK_3-2: For the clones to discover the recalibration, a long time it will take.
data.MSG_GLEVENT_JMK_4-1: If you're not with me, then you're my enemy.
data.MSG_GLEVENT_JMK_4-2: Only a Sith deals in absolutes.
data.MSG_GLEVENT_JMK_5-1: I have failed you, Anakin. I have failed you.
data.MSG_GLEVENT_JMK_6-1: It's over Anakin. I have the high ground.
data.MSG_GLEVENT_LEIA_1-1: Did you hear that? They shut down the main reactor.
data.MSG_GLEVENT_LEIA_1-3: We're doomed. There will be no escape for the Princess this time.
data.MSG_GLEVENT_LEIA_1-4: This is our most desperate hour.
data.MSG_GLEVENT_LEIA_1-5: Help me Obi-Wan Kenobi, you're my only hope.
data.MSG_GLEVENT_LEIA_2-1_V2: When you've gotten past the energy field proceed directly to the rendezvous point.
data.MSG_GLEVENT_LEIA_3-1: Oh, no! Chewie they're behind you!
data.MSG_GLEVENT_LEIA_3-2: The security code has been changed.
data.MSG_GLEVENT_LEIA_3-3: Artoo, you can tell the computer to override the security systems.
data.MSG_GLEVENT_LEIA_3-5: I never doubted you for a second! Wonderful!
data.MSG_GLEVENT_LEIA_4-1_V2: Co slayat ni (Bring her to me)
data.MSG_GLEVENT_LEIA_4-2: We have powerful friends. You're going to regret this!
data.MSG_GLEVENT_SITHETERNALEMPEROR_1-3: In the name of the Galactic Senate of the Republic, you are under arrest, Chancellor.
data.MSG_GLEVENT_SITHETERNALEMPEROR_1-4: Are you threatening me, Master Jedi?
data.MSG_GLEVENT_SITHETERNALEMPEROR_1-5: The Senate will decide your fate.
data.MSG_GLEVENT_SITHETERNALEMPEROR_2-1: You are under arrest, my lord.
data.MSG_GLEVENT_SITHETERNALEMPEROR_2-3: Anakin, I told you it would come to this. I was right. The Jedi are taking over!
data.MSG_GLEVENT_SITHETERNALEMPEROR_2-4: The oppression of the Sith will never return. You have lost.
data.MSG_GLEVENT_SITHETERNALEMPEROR_3-1: Strike me down with all of your hatred and your journey towards the dark side will be complete.
data.MSG_GLEVENT_SITHETERNALEMPEROR_4-1: Stand together, die together.\n\nThe lifeforce of your bond, a dyad in the Force.
data.MSG_GLEVENT_SITHETERNALEMPEROR_4-3: Unseen for generations... and now the power of two restores the one, true Emperor.
data.MSG_JOURNEY_DARTHREVAN_1-1: The legend of Revan's story began in orbit around the planet Taris. When Revan's ship was attacked by the Sith, Revan barely made it to an escape pod with a Republic soldier named Carth Onasi.
data.MSG_JOURNEY_DARTHREVAN_1-2: Together, they crash-landed on Taris and began to look for ways to earn Credits and resources so they could escape. Revan, desiring a challenge and glory, entered the Taris fighting arena under the alias "Mysterious Stranger."
data.MSG_JOURNEY_DARTHREVAN_1-3: Here we go folks, the Mysterious Stranger is on a tear! Will anyone be able to stop this whirlwind of doom?
data.MSG_JOURNEY_DARTHREVAN_1-4: Ladies and gentlemen you're in for a real treat! Coming out of retirement for one more battle: the infamous Bendak Starkiller! Will the Mysterious Stranger be able to keep up the lucky streak, or has it ended?
data.MSG_JOURNEY_DARTHREVAN_1-5: What a fight! What an upset! We have a new champion of the Taris Arena! I give you the oooooone, the ooooonly MYSTERIOUS STRANGER!
data.MSG_JOURNEY_DARTHREVAN_2-1: After teaming up with Canderous Ordo and rescuing Bastila Shan, Revan made for Dantooine and the hidden Jedi Enclave located there.
data.MSG_JOURNEY_DARTHREVAN_2-2: At the Enclave, the Jedi Council retrained Revan in the ways of the Force, hoping to use buried memories as a secret weapon against the Sith. As a test, they sent Revan to find a missing Padawan named Juhani who was in danger of falling to the dark side.
data.MSG_JOURNEY_DARTHREVAN_2-4: This is the Padawan we were sent to find. Has she... fallen to the dark side?
data.MSG_JOURNEY_DARTHREVAN_2-5: How can you be so strong? To defeat me here, in my place of darkness...
data.MSG_JOURNEY_DARTHREVAN_2-6: I was a fool to think myself strong.
data.MSG_JOURNEY_DARTHREVAN_3-1: Upon departing Dantooine, Revan's task was to find pieces of a “Star Map” scattered across the galaxy. One piece was on Tatooine, but after they found it, a famous bounty hunter named Calo Nord showed up with a score to settle.
data.MSG_JOURNEY_DARTHREVAN_3-2: I'm impressed you made it this far. You're hard to kill. But this is where your journey ends.
data.MSG_JOURNEY_DARTHREVAN_3-6: Anticipatory Reply: With extreme prejudice, Master!
data.MSG_JOURNEY_DARTHREVAN_3-7: Observation: Marvelous elimination of the enemy, Master. I applaud you.
data.MSG_JOURNEY_DARTHREVAN_3-8: We have the Star Map fragment, let's return to the Ebon Hawk and plan our next move.
data.MSG_JOURNEY_DARTHREVAN_4-1: On a world called Korriban… hmm, that planet is mentioned a lot, I wonder if it really exists. Oh, ahem. On a world called Korriban, Revan fought the spirit of a Sith Lord named Ajunta Pall!
data.MSG_JOURNEY_DARTHREVAN_4-2: Query: Master, do you suspect this incorporeal meatbag is as susceptible to blaster fire as regular meatbags?
data.MSG_JOURNEY_DARTHREVAN_4-3: Only one way to find out.
data.MSG_JOURNEY_DARTHREVAN_4-4: My tomb... shall now be yours.
data.MSG_JOURNEY_DARTHREVAN_4-5: Bemused Anecdote: Oh, Master, it is a rare joy to be able to terminate something for a second time. What a rush!
data.MSG_JOURNEY_DARTHREVAN_4-6: Query: Do you suppose there are other transparent meatbags somewhere we could also exterminate?
data.MSG_JOURNEY_DARTHREVAN_4-7: Let's just get out of here before anything else attacks us.
data.MSG_JOURNEY_DARTHREVAN_5-1: On Manaan, Revan and the team fought their way through a Sith Embassy looking for secret information.
data.MSG_JOURNEY_DARTHREVAN_5-2: Observation: This location is positively filled with targets waiting to be blasted. You do take me to the nicest places, Master.
data.MSG_JOURNEY_DARTHREVAN_5-3: You've got your work cut out for you then, don't you?
data.MSG_JOURNEY_DARTHREVAN_5-4: Mocking Statement: Master I must protest. Droids are not an adequate enemy for someone of my skills. They don't even leak or scream when blasted.
data.MSG_JOURNEY_DARTHREVAN_5-5: Query: Can we go find some non-droids to blast, Master?
data.MSG_JOURNEY_DARTHREVAN_6-1: During their journey, Revan's nemesis Darth Malak captured Bastila. Malak used all his cunning and dark power to turn Bastila from the light. Revan resolved to track her down and either destroy a potential new rival... or regain a valuable follower.
data.MSG_JOURNEY_DARTHREVAN_6-2: Due to the powerful Force Bond that existed between the two, finding Bastila was all too easy. But turning her from Malak's influence would not be.
data.MSG_JOURNEY_DARTHREVAN_6-3: I knew you'd come for me, Revan. Malak didn't think you would, but I know you. I know you all too well.
data.MSG_JOURNEY_DARTHREVAN_6-4: Not even the Jedi Council could separate us, but here we are. Have you come to defeat Malak? To reclaim your place as Dark Lord?
data.MSG_JOURNEY_DARTHREVAN_6-5: I've come to reclaim what is mine.
data.MSG_JOURNEY_DARTHREVAN_6-6: Let's see if you can. I'm more powerful now than you can imagine. Here, let me show you...
data.MSG_JOURNEY_DARTHREVAN_6-7: I can't believe it, you're so powerful. I thought it impossible, but you're...
data.MSG_JOURNEY_DARTHREVAN_6-8: The Dark Lord of the Sith.
data.MSG_JOURNEY_DARTHREVAN_6-9: Yes. I can see it now... feel it. Let's join together once again.
data.MSG_JOURNEY_DARTHREVAN_7-1: Returning from the temple with Bastila, Revan faced one final challenge before embarking for the star forge to face Darth Malak. Some amongst the party refused to follow the Revan they found before them. They would have to be dealt with.
data.MSG_JOURNEY_DARTHREVAN_7-10: There's only one thing left to do, my Lord Revan. To the star forge...
data.MSG_JOURNEY_DARTHREVAN_7-2: I've seen what the Sith have done to the galaxy. I don't want to, but I'll fight you. Even if it costs me my life.
data.MSG_JOURNEY_DARTHREVAN_7-3: I cannot abide this. I agree with Jolee.
data.MSG_JOURNEY_DARTHREVAN_7-4: You're a full-on Sith psycho! I KNEW you couldn't be trusted! You're Revan, the Dark Lord of the Sith! How could I ever believe you'd change?
data.MSG_JOURNEY_DARTHREVAN_7-5: You are all fools! Revan is the true Dark Lord, and if you won't bow down... you will be cut down!
data.MSG_JOURNEY_DARTHREVAN_7-8: That was a fun fight, I haven't had a challenge like that in years.
data.MSG_JOURNEY_DARTHREVAN_7-9: Annotation: It was most enjoyable when each of them screamed. I found that especially endearing.
data.MSG_JOURNEY_JEDIKNIGHTLUKE_1-1: What's wrong girl? You smell something?
data.MSG_JOURNEY_JEDIKNIGHTLUKE_3-3: I heard the Command Center had been hit.
data.MSG_JOURNEY_JEDIKNIGHTLUKE_3-4: You've got your clearance to leave.
data.MSG_JOURNEY_JEDIKNIGHTLUKE_3-5: Don't worry, I'll leave, but first I'm going to get you to your ship.
data.MSG_JOURNEY_JEDIKNIGHTLUKE_3-6: Your Highness we must take this last transport. It's our only hope!
data.MSG_JOURNEY_JEDIKNIGHTLUKE_5-2: That place is strong with the dark side of the Force. A domain of evil it is.
data.MSG_JOURNEY_JEDIKNIGHTLUKE_5-4: Only what you take with you.
data.MSG_JOURNEY_JEDIKNIGHTLUKE_5-6: Something doesn't feel right about this place.
data.MSG_JOURNEY_JEDIKNIGHTLUKE_6-2: We don't need any of your help.
data.MSG_JOURNEY_JEDIKNIGHTLUKE_6-4: There's still a chance to save Han at the east platform.
data.MSG_JOURNEY_JEDIKNIGHTLUKE_7-1: Obi-wan has taught you well. You have control of your fear.
data.MSG_JOURNEY_JEDIKNIGHTLUKE_7-2: Now... release your anger. Only your hatred can destroy me.
data.MSG_JOURNEY_JEDIKNIGHTLUKE_ENC_02_5-1: Alone you must go. Help I can not.
data.MSG_JOURNEY_MANDALORIAN_3-1: Welcome back, Mando! Now put the package down.
data.MSG_JOURNEY_MANDALORIAN_3-2: Step aside. I'm going to my ship.
data.MSG_JOURNEY_MANDALORIAN_3-3: You put the bounty down and perhaps I'll let you pass.
data.MSG_LEGENDARY_PADME_1_1: You call this a diplomatic solution?
data.MSG_LEGENDARY_PADME_1_2: No, I call it aggressive negotiations!
data.MSG_LEGENDARY_PADME_3_1: I see you got my message.
data.MSG_LEGENDARY_PADME_3_2: I decided we would come and rescue you.
data.MSG_LEGENDARY_PADME_3_3: It looks like you're doing a good job so far!
data.MSG_LEGENDARY_PADME_4_1: Seems like they need a lesson in diplomacy!
data.MSG_LEGENDARY_PADME_4_2: I don't think they're interested in peace talks!
data.MSG_LEGENDARY_PADME_5_1: Let's not make a habit of this, Anakin.
data.MSG_LEGENDARY_PADME_5_3: Less talking, more surviving you two!
data.MSG_REEK_DIALOGUE_01: Hostiles ahead. Careful of the Reek and the bounty hunter!
data.MSG_REEK_DIALOGUE_02: Whether you're beast or otherwise, you're all targets to me.
data.MSG_TUTORIAL_REINFORCEMENTS_V2_1-1: All ships have [c][F0FF23]REINFORCEMENT ABILITIES[-][/c] that trigger when they're called from reserves.
data.MSG_TUTORIAL_REINFORCEMENTS_V2_1-2: In this Battle you can call a very powerful [c][F0FF23]REINFORCEMENT[-][/c] ship: [c][F0FF23]SLAVE 1[-][/c]!
data.MSG_TUTORIAL_REINFORCEMENTS_V2_1-3: When [c][F0FF23]SLAVE 1[-][/c] enters as a Reinforcement it gains Taunt, Retribution, and Protection Up (10%) for 2 turns and Critical Hit Immunity for 3 turns. It also inflicts Ability Block on an enemy ship!
data.MSG_TUTORIAL_REINFORCEMENTS_V2_1-4: As you increase the Stars of your Capital Ship you unlock more slots for additional Reinforcements.
data.MSGGRP_EVENT_CLASH_ON_KAMINO_GET_UNLOCK_: Once again you've proven yourself against even my best efforts! Now that you've activated General Skywalker, you'll find additional shards available in the Guild Events Store so you can bring him up to maximum power.
data.MSGGRP_EVENT_CLASH_ON_KAMINO_PRIMER_01: Now that the 501st clones have been introduced to the holotables, I thought it only fitting that they get their leader, General Skywalker himself.
data.MSGGRP_EVENT_CLASH_ON_KAMINO_PRIMER_02: I decided to showcase General Skywalker's battlefield prowess during a pivotal battle for the 501st. I've created a scenario that takes place during the Battle of Kamino, though I may have... embellished some of the details.
data.MSGGRP_EVENT_CLASH_ON_KAMINO_PRIMER_03: In any case, this one won't be easy! Don't let your guard down.
data.MSGGRP_EVENT_STAR_FORGE_SHOWDOWN_GET_UNL: Well done! You continue to impress me with your holotable prowess. Now that you've activated Darth Malak, you'll find additional shards available in the Guild Events Store so you can bring him up to maximum power.
data.MSGGRP_EVENT_STAR_FORGE_SHOWDOWN_PRIMER_: I've managed to piece together a bit more of Revan's story from my texts.

Whether you believe Revan was saved by the light or returned to a darker path, all versions of the legend include a final confrontation with a Sith Lord called Darth Malak. I’ve laid out the tale for you in Star Forge Showdown.
This one is going to be a true challenge for you! Pay close attention to the effects and mechanics, and think strategically. It's quite different from what I've challenged you with before. Good luck!
data.MTX_OUTAGE_ANDROID_IOS_ISSUE_MESSAGE_PC:
Greetings heroes,

We are currently experiencing issues with payment processing on both iOS and Android. If you are seeing this message, that means that the game team is aware of the issue and is currently investigating the cause and looking for a solution. Please do not attempt to make a purchase on the above platforms until we provide an update saying that the issue has been fixed.

If you have attempted a purchase recently and it appeared to fail or otherwise act strangely, please contact our Customer Service by clicking the Gear icon on the upper left of the Home screen, and then click Contact Us.

Please be aware that if you attempted to make a purchase and did not receive your items, we DO have access to receipts from Apple and Google. This means that we should be able to credit your account once the technical issues have been resolved.

The Star Wars: Galaxy of Heroes dev team

data.NABOORAID_PASSIVE_BONUS_SEPARATISTS_DESC: Darth Sidious's Leader ability is active at max rank and also applies to Separatist allies when he is not in the Leader slot. Separatists and Sith allies have +100% Max Health, +25% Accuracy and Offense, +50% Potency, and +20 Speed (tripled for Darth Maul). Whenever a Separatist or Sith ally takes damage they gain 20% Defense (stacking) for 1 turn. Whenever an enemy is defeated by a Separatist or Sith ally, all allies recover 15% Health and Protection. Whenever a Sith ally inflicts a debuff, they also deal 5% Max Health damage to that enemy, which can't be evaded. Whenever a Separatist ally in the Leader slot uses a Special ability all Sith allies are called to assist.

data.NEWSLETTER_10TH_ANNIVERSARY_ERA_SUMMARY:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

The latest seasonal Era for Galaxy of Heroes is the Era of Anniversary. We wanted to take an opportunity to add some lifter characters to teams, as well as be inspired by some of the characters we launched the game with 10 years ago. We hope you enjoy these characters as much as we enjoyed adding them to the game.

Stormtrooper Luke: Inspired by Stormtrooper Han. Stormtrooper Luke leads a powerful (and thematic!) 3v3 team for GAC.

IG-90: Inspired by IG-86, IG-88, and IG-100. The oft-requested Doctor Aphra lifter pulled straight from the pages of her comic book appearances.

Asajj Ventress (Dark Disciple): Inspired by Asajj Ventress. The Bounty Hunter version of Asajj from the Clone Wars and the novel Dark Disciple.

Inquisitor Barriss: Inspired by Barriss Offee. Adding to the ever growing ranks of Inquisitors and helping create a second squad of Inquisitorius for your roster.

Yoda & Chewie: Inspired by Clone Wars Chewbacca. We couldn’t pass up the opportunity to include a reference to Clone Wars Chewie, as well as add a powerful Force-using lifter for the Wookiee squad.

Darth Vader (Duel’s End): Inspired by Darth Vader. Battle damaged during his duel with Obi-Wan Kenobi on the show of the same name, this Elite Marquee will be the backbone of a new Empire squad led by Emperor Palpatine.

These six Marquee characters all lead into the Era’s Journey Guide unit...

Maul (Hate Fueled): Inspired by Darth Maul. His fractured mental state and spider-like robot body (using the Large character slot) makes him the perfect Dark Side Unaligned Force User to round out the new Stranger-led Starkiller squad.

We’re excited to bring you these seven new characters that are inspired by our original launch units, and look forward to celebrating our 10th Anniversary with all of you!

data.NEWSLETTER_4_LOM_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

[c][F0FF23]4-LOM[-][/c] is coming to the Holotables!

Originally a protocol droid who overrode his own programming, 4-LOM became one of the galaxy's most methodical and calculating bounty hunters. Often working alongside his partner Zuckuss, this infamous droid earned his reputation through cold precision and relentless pursuit of his targets, eventually becoming skilled enough to be among the elite bounty hunters summoned by Darth Vader to track down the Millennium Falcon.

4-LOM's devastating abilities center around his unique debuff, [c][F0FF23]Corrupted Translation[-][/c], which progressively weakens enemies as more stacks accumulate. His Basic ability, [c][F0FF23]Destructive Rotation[-][/c], strikes multiple times while providing Stealth support to Dark Side Bounty Hunter allies, and his Special abilities [c][F0FF23]Relative Mercy[-][/c] and [c][F0FF23]TRANSLATION: Destroy[-][/c] allow him to control the battlefield through debuffs while supporting his Bounty Hunter allies.

Under his [c][F0FF23]Cold Calculations[-][/c] leadership, Bounty Hunter allies become incredibly resilient and gain powerful bonuses whenever enemies gain bonus Turn Meter. His [c][F0FF23]Override Programming[-][/c] Unique ability makes him particularly effective in Territory Battles and allows him to work seamlessly with his partner Zuckuss, creating a formidable duo that can control the flow of battle through Turn Meter manipulation and stacking debuffs.

Unlock 4-LOM in the upcoming [c][E7E7E7]"MIST HUNTERS I"[-][/c] Marquee event that [c][E7E7E7]gives out daily rewards[-][/c] for the duration of the event!

data.NEWSLETTER_50RT_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

Making her debut in the Star Wars universe is [c][F0FF23]50R-T[-][/c], a brand new droid coming first to the holotables in Star Wars Galaxy of Heroes! Found while scavenging a wartorn battlefield, 50R-T is a rare tactical droid who was sold to a casino to protect important clientele. A keen strategist, she loves calculating the odds and then determining the best course of action to overcome them.

50R-T focuses on lifting droids, especially non-Separatist droids, through a variety of buffs. She introduces the [c][F0FF23]Spare Parts[-][/c] buff, which grants extra damage as well as revives the first droid ally to be defeated while it is active. She also introduces a new status effect [c][F0FF23]VIP[-][/c] that she uses to protect her weakest ally with Health and Protection recovery and Stealth.

Her Omicron Leader ability is the first to be active in Conquests and gives Droids a boost in that mode. In Conquests with this upgrade, when the first enemy to take a turn is defeated all allies will revive and allies will gain Damage Immunity and [c][F0FF23]Instant Defeat Immunity[-][/c], giving you a perfect opportunity to achieve 3 stars on Conquest nodes to improve your overall Conquest rewards.

Add 50R-T to your roster by unlocking her in the all-new “PLAYING THE ODDS” Marquee event, and prove yourself a worthy tactician!
data.NEWSLETTER_5TH_ANNIVERSARY_DESC:
Hello Holotable Heroes,

As the saying goes, time flies when you’re having fun! Five years ago Galaxy of Heroes launched and to say it changed Capital Games forever is an understatement. A lot can happen in five years, and it’s incredible to look back to not only what SWGoH looked like then, but how different the world was at that time.

In the past half-decade, our friends at Lucasfilm have taken Star Wars from The Force Awakens to The Mandalorian, making several stops along the way - including real-life theme parks where one can construct lightsabers and pilot the iconic Millennium Falcon.

Some things, however, never change. We are continually amazed at the support we’ve received from our passionate community, and look forward to the many great things to come. Five years of providing a service in this industry is a huge milestone; one that wouldn’t be possible without you. We recognize your commitment to our game and value your devotion.

As a token of appreciation, please accept these 3 Chewie shards.

Oh...and some other stuff, too.

Cheers, and Happy Fifth Anniversary, SWGoH!
data.NEWSLETTER_7_2_HIGHLIGHTS_DESC:
Our newest update is packed full of improvements to make your experience better than it's ever been! We hope you are as excited by the changes as we are. Here are some examples:

[f0ff23]Saving Squad Configurations[-]: Preset Squad Configurations can now be saved and selected prior to starting combat.

[f0ff23]Basics Only in Auto Battle[-]: Auto Battle can now be configured to only use basic attacks. This setting can be enabled in the Battle Settings menu.

[f0ff23]Preview Ability Upgrades[-]: Ability levels can now be researched allowing players to make more informed choices regarding their investments.

For a full list of all the improvements check out our Forum Post.

data.NEWSLETTER_ADMIRAL_PIETT_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

[c][F0FF23]Admiral Firmus Piett[-][/c], the fast-rising Imperial officer and beneficiary of the Empire’s most notorious field promotion, is headed to the Holotables! After being assigned to Darth Vader’s flagship, the Executor, Piett dutifully served as Captain under the pompous and half-witted leadership of Admiral Ozzel. However, Piett’s fortunes would be forever changed after Ozzel’s dismissal took some air out of the room, leaving Piett in command. Admiral Piett’s versatility allows him to lead a squad of Imperial Troopers or bring more firepower to an Empire squad as an ally with strong synergies to the newly reworked Darth Vader. Piett introduces a new debuff, [c][F0FF23]Inevitable Failure[-][/c], that takes advantage of an ally’s eventual downfall by making Piett more powerful over time. Piett dared not fail Lord Vader, and as such, his astute, cunning tactics will be a welcome addition to any Empire squad.

Get Admiral Piett in the new Marquee Event, [c][F0FF23]Cunning Commander[-][/c].
data.NEWSLETTER_ADMIRAL_RADDUS_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

[c][F0FF23]Admiral Raddus[-][/c], a Mon Calamari who played a key role stealing the plans to the Death Star from Scarif, is coming to the holotables!

Raddus is a new leader for the Rogue One faction and introduces a new buff, [c][F0FF23]Spark of Rebellion[-][/c], which provides these allies with additional Offense and Speed. This buff is also one of the ways to gain Upload progress which, when complete, allows the use of the granted ability [c][F0FF23]Hope[-][/c]. Hope revives all allies, deals true damage to all enemies, and inflicts enemies with Protection Disruption. In honor of another great Rogue One leader, Raddus has callouts specifically to Jyn Erso to help keep her alive and perpetually apply the Spark of Rebellion buff on her.

His Leader ability, [c][F0FF23]Rebel Assault[-][/c], inflicts Expose on enemies who critically hit Rogue One allies. The Omicron for this ability focuses on Grand Arenas where Rogue One allies gain additional Protection, start the battle with Spark of Rebellion, and when they lose Spark of Rebellion they gain a spread of buffs.

Add Admiral Raddus to your roster by unlocking him in the all-new “SPARK OF REBELLION” Marquee event, and fight for the Rebellion!
data.NEWSLETTER_ADMIRAL_TRENCH_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

With great ruthlessness comes great responsibility. Conquest Volume 9 begins soon and shards for a new character, [c][ffff33]Admiral Trench[-][/c], will be available for a limited time in this mode! A Separatist admiral known for his cunning and ruthlessness, Trench synergizes with Wat Tambor's Tech and Nute Gunray's Extortion to turn the tide of battle.

Trench's leader ability [c][ffff33]Feared Tactician[-][/c] provides stats for allies with Tech and enemies with Extortion, including a percentage boost to Speed, making his team especially quick out of the gate when paired with Wat Tambor and Nute Gunray. Additionally, this ability provides a way for Jango (who starts with Damage Immunity under Trench) to not be Stealthed by Dooku if he has Baktoid Shield Generator Tech. Jango's Burning will also prevent enemies from assisting, countering, or gaining bonus Turn Meter. The Omicron upgrade for Territory Wars gives Mastery, Turn Meter gain when an enemy dispels a debuff, and stacking Offense and Speed the first time each enemy is reduced below 100% Health.

His Special ability [c][ffff33]Net Positive[-][/c] introduces the Tactical Supremacy buff, which provides increased Critical Damage and Potency, Protection recovery at start of turn, and additional benefits if it is dispelled. The Omicron upgrades for his Unique [c][ffff33]I Smell Fear, and It Smells Good[-][/c] and Basic [c][ffff33]Unfinished Business[-][/c] abilities (the first Omicron on a Basic ability) in Territory Wars provide opportunities to lower enemy stats like Critical Damage and Tenacity, as well as increase survivability for himself and his allies.

Earn Admiral Trench shards during the upcoming Conquest events!
data.NEWSLETTER_AHSOKA_CONTENT_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

We are thrilled to celebrate the Disney+ show Ahsoka with plenty of exciting releases over the coming months including Imperial Remnants, Nightsisters, a new Mercenary tag, and Ahsoka’s own new squad.

Each marquee released will be required for either the Epic Confrontation for [c][F0FF23]Baylan Skoll[-][/c] or for the pinnacle piece of this content, [c][F0FF23]Galactic Legend Ahsoka Tano[-][/c]. These requirements will be announced both through their newsletter as well as in the Journey Guide, starting with Night Trooper as a requirement for Ahsoka!

For clarity, the existing original Ahsoka Tano has been renamed Ahsoka Tano (Snips).

We hope you enjoy revisiting Ahsoka’s journey with us!
data.NEWSLETTER_AHSOKA_EVENT_DESC:
The enduring REBEL informant Ahsoka, code-named "Fulcrum", arrives to Galaxy of Heroes!

A durable REBEL attacker, Ahsoka is resilient against enemy debuffs and immune to damage over time effects. She can also consume buffs to deal extra damage in battle. Her most notable special ability, though, is Meditate, which grants her Foresight and a copy of each buff (excluding Taunt and Unique buffs) present on her allies!

Even though Ashoka has become Fulcrum, an agent with her identity shrouded in mystery, she is ready to join your Squad in rebellion against the EMPIRE in our new multi-tiered event! Earn her character shards and credits as you battle your way through EMPIRE forces, culminating in a fated confrontation with Ahsoka’s former Master.
data.NEWSLETTER_AHSOKA_EVENT_TITLE: Join Ahsoka in the Code Name: Fulcrum Event
data.NEWSLETTER_ANAKIN_STARFIGHTER_DESC:
It's been 10 years since the release of [i]The Clone Wars[/i] animated series. We're celebrating by bringing Anakin Skywalker's Starfighter to the game, giving the Clones their helmets and introducing a limited-time Clone Wars takeover of Territory Wars.

First up, the undisputed best starfighter pilot in the galaxy finally has his ship! Anakin Skywalker can now pilot his Eta-2 Starfighter with its signature yellow accents. Anakin’s Eta-2 is an aggressive Jedi Attacker that bolsters a Galactic Republic fleet's offense and retaliates when allies are in trouble.

Next, the Clone Troopers now have helmets! Clone Troopers are always prepared for combat, so they will now don their protective headgear in battle.

Finally, the Clone Wars have taken over Territory Wars. See the other newsletter to get all the details on how the Clone Wars struggle has spilled over into the Cantina.

Hi Holotable Heroes,

[c][F0FF23]CC-1119 "Appo"[-][/c] is marching to the Holotables!

Commander Appo begins the Era of Revenge of the Sith by bringing a thematic new team to Galactic Legend Lord Vader (or an Empire team under another Leader like Grand Moff Tarkin). Over the course of the next few weeks more Dark Side Clone Troopers will be available to add to the squad.

Serving as one of the highest-ranking clone trooper commanders during the Clone Wars, Commander Appo played a pivotal role in carrying out Order 66 – the systematic elimination of the Jedi Order. Utterly loyal to the newly-formed Galactic Empire, Appo led his forces in the attack on the Jedi Temple on Coruscant, ensuring no survivors.

We start off with Appo’s Unique ability, [c][F0FF23]Vader's Fist[-][/c], which enhances Appo and his Dark Side Clone allies, particularly against Jedi and Light Side Unaligned Force User opponents. It also grants powerful bonuses like Dramatic Entrance if Lord Vader leads an all-Dark Side Clone Trooper squad. Most importantly [c][F0FF23]this ability summons a Knightfall Trooper[-][/c] if all allies are Empire. In Territory Battles with an Omicron upgrade, Appo inflicts Order 66 on all enemies at the start of the encounter while gaining stacking Offense from critical hits.

Appo's Basic ability, [c][F0FF23]Imperial March[-][/c], not only deals damage but grants Defense Penetration Up to the strongest ally lacking it, calling other Attacker allies with this buff to assist. His first Special, [c][F0FF23]Knightfall[-][/c], Stealths a random Support Dark Side Clone Trooper and calls them to assist. This ability will also Stun the target enemy, dispel all buffs on all enemies, and grant Critical Damage Up to Appo and his summoned Knightfall Trooper ally.

[c][F0FF23]No Witnesses[-][/c], Appo's second Special, triggers all Damage Over Time effects on enemies while calling his Knightfall Trooper ally to assist with Advantage. If Lord Vader leads the squad, enemies with over 10 Damage Over Time stacks are inflicted with the formidable Order 66 debuff, preventing revival and making them immune to buffs.

Unlock CC-1119 "Appo" in the upcoming [c][E7E7E7]"EXECUTING ORDERS I"[-][/c] event that [c][E7E7E7]gives out daily rewards[-][/c] for the duration of the event!
data.NEWSLETTER_ART_OF_DEMOLITION_DESC:
Sabine Wren, explosives expert and graffiti artist, is ready to take on the Empire! Unlock Sabine by completing the Art of Demolition Event in April.

Sabine attacks her enemies multiple times using her Blasters Akimbo ability or uses her Darksaber Strike to lower the Armor of high defense foes. If Hera Syndulla is lead, Sabine adds her unique ability Take It Back to all members of Phoenix Squadron, granting them a higher chance to land a critical strike and increasing their critical damage.

Be sure to collect Sabine Wren during her limited-time Event and strengthen your Phoenix Squadron!
data.NEWSLETTER_ART_OF_DEMOLITION_TITLE: ART OF DEMOLITION EVENT – Sabine Wren
data.NEWSLETTER_ARTIST_OF_WAR_EVENT_DESC: It's zero hour, and the galaxy sees its biggest threat yet in our new legendary event- ARTIST OF WAR.\n\nGather PHOENIX SQUADRON characters and launch a daring attack to obtain character shards for GRAND ADMIRAL THRAWN. This mission will consist of up to four encounters as your squadron infiltrates the imposing Capital Ship - CHIMAERA. Battle your way through waves of the EMPIRE's best IMPERIAL TROOPERS, culminating in a harrowing final battle with Grand Admiral Thrawn. With a foe who's perfected the art of war, can you upset his carefully laid plans and bring peace to the galaxy?
data.NEWSLETTER_ASAJJ_DARK_DISCIPLE_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

[c][F0FF23]Asajj Ventress (Dark Disciple)[-][/c] is coming to the Holotables!

After leaving the Nightsisters and abandoning her role as Count Dooku's apprentice, Asajj Ventress carved out a new life as a bounty hunter. Her journey took an unexpected turn when she crossed paths with a maverick Jedi Master, leading to an unlikely partnership that would challenge everything she believed about the Force, loyalty, and redemption. No longer bound to the dark side alone, Ventress became a complex warrior torn between her brutal past and the possibility of something more.

Ventress' Basic ability, [c][F0FF23]Swift Strikes[-][/c], allows her to attack twice against debuffed enemies while gaining extra benefits and Turn Meter whether she’s using it on her turn or not. Her first Special ability, [c][F0FF23]Come Back to Me[-][/c], grants the Disciple buff to a Bounty Hunter ally, inflicts Armor Shred, and provides Defense Penetration Up. [c][F0FF23]Know Your Place[-][/c], her second Special ability, Stuns and inflicts Vulnerable, while dispelling debuffs from Ventress and her Disciple allies and converting those debuffs into stacking Critical Damage before calling those same allies to assist.

Her Unique ability, [c][F0FF23]Train Under Me[-][/c], grants Ventress substantial defensive stats and creates powerful synergies with her Disciple allies, granting them Turn Meter, causing frequent assists, and inflicting Protection Disruption on enemies. When those allies use Special abilities multiple turns in a row, they gain considerable Offense and inflict the Vulnerable debuff permanently. With her Grand Arena Omicron active, all non-Tank Bounty Hunters gain Disciple from the get go, creating a highly coordinated team with immunity to Turn Meter reduction and additional offensive scaling. Ventress' Leader ability, [c][F0FF23]Selfless Act[-][/c], provides immediate offensive buffs to Bounty Hunters and introduces a unique Contract that requires attacking out of turn while an ally with Disciple is active, rewarding completion with Defense Penetration and a brief window of Damage Immunity when they revive.

Unlock Asajj Ventress (Dark Disciple) in the upcoming [c][E7E7E7]"HERETIC HUNTER"[-][/c] Marquee event that [c][E7E7E7]gives out daily rewards[-][/c] for the duration of the event! Asajj Ventress (Dark Disciple) is also one of the requirements (at 4 stars) to initially unlock the event for Maul (Hate-Fueled).
data.NEWSLETTER_ASAJJ_DARK_DISCIPLE_TITLE: One Blade is Better than Two
data.NEWSLETTER_ASSUALT_BATTLE_GROUND_WAR_DES: Assault Battle: Ground War, is coming soon! Gather your best squad of Ugnaught, Ewoks and/or Resistance units in order to confront the Separatist forces in the Geonosis Arena and the Catacombs. Make sure you're prepared for the challenge by reaching level 75 before taking the fight to the Separatists. Succeed in vanquishing your foes and you will earn Separatist shards, credits and purple salvage rewards! With two tiers of difficulty (Hard and Bonus) you will not only need your best units to succeed, but also an understanding of the new event power, "Stand Aside," which gives a unit a massive damage boost and immediate action at the cost of all allied turn meters.\n\nTake out the Separatist forces and earn your rewards today!
data.NEWSLETTER_ATT_RAID_DESC:
Assemble your Guild to face General Grievous on the battlefields of Geonosis! But beware, this ruthless Separatist general doesn’t play fair and has brought a tank to the fight!

With two tiers of difficulty, Tier 6 and Heroic (both with recommended character levels at 80), make sure your squads are equipped with your best mods and gear in order to succeed.

If successful, you will be able to earn shards for General Kenobi, one of the greatest heroes of the Republic and a legendary Jedi Master, as well as other prizes including credits, level 85 gear and more!

As a celebration of the Tank Takedown Raid, we are giving existing Guilds maximum summoning tickets for both Raids so you can immediately try them out. You can earn more through spending energy daily.
data.NEWSLETTER_ATT_RAID_TITLE: New Tank Takedown Raid Now Available
data.NEWSLETTER_AURRA_HOUNDSTOOTH_DESC:
This week we’ve got more Bounty Hunters looking for contracts in the Cantina! A fresh face is looking to earn some credits, while Bossk acquires his ship and Cad Bane is back with some new tricks.

You may recognize Aurra Sing from her signature sniper rifle and built-in commlink, but you won’t see her deadly shots coming. She is a master of stealth and assassination whose skills are well known throughout the galaxy. Unsurprising, since she helped train the legendary Boba Fett!

The Hound’s Tooth, Bossk’s deadly ship, is a sustainable front line taunting tank. This ship is an expert at drawing fire from your allies and has the durability to keep on taking a beating. The Hound's Tooth also introduces a new debuff, [c][ffff33]BREACH[-][/c], to Fleet Combat. Breach reduces Speed and Defense on enemy ships, opening them up to devastating assaults.

The deadly Jedi Hunter, Cad Bane, has a brand new contract and payout along with a reworked kit. He can wear down even the hardiest of foes thanks to the multitude of debuffs he applies to his targets. Activating his new contract allows Cad to greatly increase his chance to dodge, and applies Thermal Detonators to an enemy when he evades!
data.NEWSLETTER_B1_B2_BATTLE_DROID_DESC:
Built as mechanical imitations of their Geonosian designers, the B1 Battle Droid provided the Separatists with a cheap and overwhelming supply of droid infantry. On the holotables, opponents will have to blast through a virtual army of B1s, which provides extra survivability to Droid allies when attacking Target Locked characters. Separatist and Droid teams will work well with the B1’s ability to also apply Target Lock but don’t forget they were designed to win through sheer numbers, not accurate fire.

Need some heavier firepower for your Droid army? The B2 Super Battle Droid can provide some heavily armored support while assisting the droid army with Target Lock and Turn Meter. Unlike the B1, its fragile sensors are encased in thick armor and it doesn’t need a central command system to operate. The newly improved kit also has a new Unique to help the B2 keep dispelling positive status effects and aiding its Separatist allies.

Also in this update, the Emperor's Shuttle! Check out our other newsletter for more information about the special event to earn the Emperor’s personal Lambda-class T-4a shuttle.

[c][F0FF23]These events, packs and bundles unlock for players at level 60![-][/c]
data.NEWSLETTER_B2_CANTINA_MISSION_MESSAGE: The B2 Super Battle Droid is now available in Cantina Battle Stage 6 Mission D! This heavy infantry droid is a fantastic tank that punishes enemy units for evading attacks or damaging its allies. Additionally, its ability to hit an entire enemy squad while simultaneously Dispelling all positive buffs, makes it an ideal choice when confronting both evasive and support units. \n\nBe sure to complete Cantina Battles in order to add this relentless droid tank to your collection!
data.NEWSLETTER_B2_CANTINA_MISSION_TITLE: The B2 Super Battle Droid is now available in Cantina Battles!
data.NEWSLETTER_B2_SUPER_BATTLE_DROID_DESC:
The B2 Super Battle Droid is now available in Aurodium Pack! This heavy infantry droid was designed solely for combat and was an integral part of the Trade Federation Army.

The B2 Super Battle Droid is a great tank who punishes enemies that evade attacks or damage its allies. It also has the ability to attack all enemies while simultaneously Dispelling all positive effects on them, making it an ideal choice when confronting squads with both evasive and support characters. 

Add this relentless droid tank to your squad and punish your enemies at the holotables!
data.NEWSLETTER_B2_SUPER_BATTLE_DROID_TITLE: New Aurodium Pack Character: B2 Super Battle Droid
data.NEWSLETTER_BALANCE_CHANGES_3_2_DESC:
The following balance changes went into effect on April 14th around 9 AM Pacific Time: 

•A new statistic is being added to all Characters: [c][ffffff]Protection[-][/c]. Protection provides Characters with additional survivability and first becomes available when a Character reaches [c][9341ff]Gear Lvl VII[-][/c]. When battling against a Character with Protection, the Protection meter must be depleted prior to affecting the Character's health. 

•Armor and Resistance have been adjusted to make them more valuable by providing better damage mitigation.

•Advantage has been reworked to grant 100% chance to score a critical hit on the next attack. 

•Speed will now be more important in calibration of a character’s damage output. Generally speaking, faster acting characters will see a damage reduction and slower characters will see an increase. 

•Balance adjustments have been made to all Light/Dark Side Battles, Cantina Battles and Challenges to accommodate the above changes. 

Visit the forums to join in the discussions on this recent update.
data.NEWSLETTER_BASIC_TRAINING_EVENT_DESC:
Star Wars: Galaxy of Heroes is proud to introduce an event designed for new players – Basic Training!

When the Events Table unlocks at Level 21, players will be introduced to a new series of events titled, "Basic Training". Basic Training gives new players an opportunity to experience high-end squads with advanced faction synergy.

Basic Training gives new players a chance to see some of the most powerful characters in the game and learn how to use them efficiently and effectively! Additionally, players will begin to understand which characters they want to use, and invest in, over the course of the late-game.

Initially, we will be launching with Empire, Rebel, First Order, and Resistance Basic Training events, with an eye towards releasing more in the future. Players will earn shards for the faction in the Basic Training event they play, along with experience, and other rewards.

There will be a day in between each Basic Training Event until level 64, when the series will end.

Be on the lookout for future Basic Training events!
data.NEWSLETTER_BASTILA_FALLEN_DESC:
[i]"The dark side calls to you, Bastila; you hunger to taste it. Become my apprentice, and all its power can be yours!"[/i] - Darth Malak

Once revered by the Jedi for her legendary battle meditation, Bastila Shan (Fallen) has forsaken her old order and now serves Darth Malak. By giving in to the dark side, Bastila now uses [c][F0FF23]Wild Lightning[-][/c] and [c][F0FF23]Fear[-][/c] against her enemies. With her [c][F0FF23]Corrupted Battle Meditation[-][/c], Bastila prevents her enemies from being as effective in combat.

Also making his way onto the holotables is Canderous Ordo, a Mandalorian who turned to mercenary work once his nation was defeated by the Galactic Republic. With the Mandalorians scattered across the galaxy, Canderous eventually reached Taris and was employed by a local crime lord before joining Revan. This Mandalorian attacker can bring the strongest Tanks to their knees.

[c][F0FF23]These events, packs and bundles unlock for players at level 60![-][/c]
data.NEWSLETTER_BASTILA_JOLEE_DESC:
Long ago, 4,000 years before the rise of the Galactic Empire, the battle between Jedi and Sith raged throughout the galaxy. Stories tell of an ancient shipyard designed to create the most powerful fleet ever seen....

Bastila Shan joins the Jedi forces as a powerful leader that gives her allies an incredible first turn boost. She strengthens her allies while weakening her enemies throughout the battle with her exceptional mastery of Battle Meditation! Bastila is a powerful leader for any Jedi team and will ensure a strong start in any battle.

The reclusive hermit Jedi, Jolee Bindo, is an extremely durable Jedi Healer. Despite leaving the Jedi Order on his own accord, Jolee will keep his allies healthy and well protected. Enemies will vainly struggle to land a debuff on Jolee, and they will want to! He can revive all of his fallen Jedi allies and turn the tides of battle!
data.NEWSLETTER_BASTILA_JOLEE_TITLE: Bastila and Jolee Join the Jedi Team!
data.NEWSLETTER_BATCHER_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

[c][F0FF23]Batcher[-][/c] is coming to the Holotables!

While Omega was held by the Empire in Mount Tantiss, she befriended another captive, the lurca hound she affectionately named Batcher. After escaping together, Batcher became a full member of the Bad Batch, helping them through various challenges and being the goodest girl.

Batcher is one of the Attackers for the new Bad Batch squad being led by Omega (Fugitive) and provides a wide variety of debuffs for the team to utilize. Her Special ability, [c][F0FF23]Piercing Howl[-][/c], gives Bad Batch allies Offense and Marks the target enemy. [c][F0FF23]Ferocious Bite[-][/c], her second Special, inflicts Pinned as well as Bleed, a stacking debuff previously only seen from the Nexu on Geonosis in Territory Battles that reduces Speed and Tenacity as well as removes Health each turn. While in Territory Wars with an Omicron upgrade, this ability inflicts even more Bleed and refreshes its cooldown if another Bad Batch ally is Captive.

Enemies will be unable to avoid Batcher’s damage through her Unique ability, [c][F0FF23]LH-201[-][/c], and will be unable to hide from her in Stealth or behind a Taunt. As a protective hound, she also gains extra Offense, Speed, and a reduced cooldown for Piercing Howl when a Bad Batch ally is Captive. Finally, she assists herself when she uses a Special ability, allowing her to spread Off Balance through her Basic ability, [c][F0FF23]Crushing Assault[-][/c].

Unlock Batcher in the upcoming “[c][E7E7E7]The Cavalry Has Arrived II[-][/c]” Marquee event that [c][E7E7E7]gives out daily rewards[-][/c] for the duration of the event!
data.NEWSLETTER_BATTLE_FOR_NABOO_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

Celebrate 25 years of The Phantom Menace with the new featured raid, the [c][F0FF23]Battle for Naboo[-][/c]! Fire up your Fambaas and buff out your boomas, the Trade Federation armies are facing off against your Guild’s forces on the grassy fields of Naboo. Meanwhile, in orbit over the planet, starfighters attempt to cripple the Droid Control ships and bring victory to your side.

You and your Guild must engage the enemy on both land and in space to defend Naboo at all costs! Make strategic choices to hold off the endless waves of battle droids (B1s, STAPs, Droidekas) spawned from hulking MTTs. Each wave comes with a randomized Command Droid that alters the battlefield with unique bonuses and tactics.

Allowed characters for this raid include [c][F0FF23]Gungans[-][/c], certain [c][F0FF23]Galactic Republic[-][/c], certain [c][F0FF23]Separatists[-][/c], as well as [c][F0FF23]Darth Sidious[-][/c] and [c][F0FF23]Darth Maul[-][/c]! Additionally, Jar Jar Binks, Master Qui-Gon, Darth Maul, and STAP are Hero units that receive extra bonuses, making Gungans and Queen Amidala’s squad perform extremely well. 

This update also adds an Omicron upgrade to Gungan Boomadier’s Unique ability [c][F0FF23]Grand Army Specialist[-][/c] to give Gungans even more power in the raid. 

Booma!
data.NEWSLETTER_BATTLE_FOR_NABOO_FACTION_TAG_:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

A new faction tag “Battle for Naboo” has been added to units that can be used in the new raid. Players can use this to filter their roster to identify which units to upgrade to take on the hoards of Battle Droids.

When this raid is no longer featured, this tag will be retired.
data.NEWSLETTER_BATTLEFRONT_APP_DESC: The Battlefront Companion App is now available! Click "GO" to learn more.
data.NEWSLETTER_BATTLEFRONT_APP_TITLE: The Battlefront Companion App is Now Available
data.NEWSLETTER_BATTLEFRONT_CROSSPROMO_DESC: Immerse yourself in the ultimate Star Wars video game experience with Star Wars: Battlefront.
data.NEWSLETTER_BATTLEFRONTII_DESC: Get your first look at Star Wars™ Battlefront™ II in the new trailer. Follow the fate of Iden Versio, leader of an Imperial special forces squad, in an original single-player story set between the fall of the Empire and the rise of the First Order. Plus, get a view into epic multiplayer battlegrounds across all eras, from ground battles on Yavin 4 and Starkiller Base, to intense dogfights in space. Whether you're an iconic hero, fearless trooper, or legendary starfighter pilot, you can become the master of your own Star Wars hero's journey.
data.NEWSLETTER_BAYLAN_SKOLL_DATACRON_DESC:
Greetings Holotable Heroes,

As a reward during the [c][F0FF23]first run of Baylan Skoll’s Epic Confrontation event[-][/c], players will earn a one-of-a-kind Datacron at level 9 that targets Baylan Skoll. There is no other way to get a Baylan Skoll Datacron in the No Mercy Datacron set so make sure to grab it!

This datacron comes with pre-established stat bonuses, but a player can reroll these to random stat bonuses that are within the No Mercy set if they so desire using the same Datacron materials as that set.

While players have the ability to dismantle this Datacron, note that this is irreversible and there is no other way to get a Baylan Skoll Datacron at this time.

At the end of the lifetime of the No Mercy Datacron set, this Datacron will automatically dismantle along with the rest of the set.
data.NEWSLETTER_BAYLAN_SKOLL_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

[c][F0FF23]Baylan Skoll[-][/c] is coming to the Holotables!

The former Jedi who took up a life as a Mercenary, Baylan Skoll liked the idea of the Jedi, but found the organization as a whole had no future. He used his connections to Morgan Elsbeth to make his way to Peridea in pursuit of his own, mysterious, goals.

Baylan enters as the leader and tank for the new Mercenary squad. While Shin and Marrok could only manipulate their own stacks of Soldier of Fortune, Baylan can grant it to all Mercenary allies. His Leader ability, [c][F0FF23]It’s All Inevitable[-][/c], gives Baylan Taunt if a Mercenary ally falls low on health as well as Counter Chance while Taunting so that his Basic ability, [c][F0FF23]That Was a Mistake[-][/c], can keep the Taunt active. [c][F0FF23]Master and Apprentice[-][/c], his Unique ability, provides beneficial stats to himself, Shin, and Marrok as well as extra effects based on his Soldier of Fortune stacks.

With Omicron upgrades in the Grand Arenas game mode, Baylan’s Taunt becomes much more punishing. However, he can still dish out damage through his Special ability, [c][F0FF23]Power. Such as You’ve Never Dreamed[-][/c], which inflicts Armor Shred on all enemies. With these upgrades, as Baylan gains Soldier of Fortune stacks he also gains the ability to reduce enemy Tenacity and increase their cooldowns.

Unlock Baylan Skoll in the upcoming [c][E7E7E7]"ONE MUST DESTROY IN ORDER TO CREATE"[-][/c] Epic Confrontation event!
data.NEWSLETTER_BAZE_CHIRRUT_DESC:
The new Rogue One characters, Baze Malbus and Chirrut Îmwe are now available! Baze Malbus is obtainable in Chromium Packs, while Chirrut can be won in Squad Tournaments!

Baze Malbus, a pragmatic soldier and crack shot, is a Rebel tank who taunts at the start of every encounter, can dispel buffs and inflict debuffs to his enemies.

Chirrut Îmwe, a spiritual warrior monk, is a balanced Rebel attacker, capable of dispelling debuffs, healing allies and grants Tenacity Up.

Baze and Chirrut are close friends and allies and provide incredible synergies when put on a squad together. Together they are capable of providing and calling assists with each other as well having special bonuses with their unique abilities, Baze taunting whenever Chirrut falls below 100% health and Chirrut giving Baze increased counter chance and health steal!

Get these two Rogue One Rebels today!
data.NEWSLETTER_BAZE_CHIRRUT_TITLE: Rogue One’s Baze Malbus and Chirrut Îmwe are now available!
data.NEWSLETTER_BB8_DESC:
BB-8 rolls onto the Holotable! A skittish but loyal astromech, BB-8 shines as a stellar support for any squad, but is especially potent in Resistance and Droid squads.

BB-8's ability, [c][f0ff23]Covert Data Transfer[-][/c], introduces a new buff, [c][f0ff23]Secret Intel[-][/c], that grants bonus Potency and spreads to allies that use a special ability. Secret Intel also reduces the cooldown of [c][f0ff23]Illuminated Destiny[-][/c], BB-8's premier ability. Illuminated Destiny dispels all debuffs on all allies, Exposes all enemies, grants all allies Turn Meter, and grants a variety of buffs!

This new addition to the Holotable may be small, but rounds out Support in a new and exciting way. BB-8 can be obtained through the Legendary event, [c][f0ff23]"Pieces and Plans"[-][/c]. Power up your First Order squad to acquire BB-8 and add this feisty astromech to your squad today!
data.NEWSLETTER_BB8_TITLE: BB-8 rolls into Galaxy of Heroes
data.NEWSLETTER_BEN_SOLO_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

Conquest Volume 7 begins soon and shards for a new character, [c][F0FF23]Ben Solo,[-][/c] will be available for a limited time in this mode! Through the power of a Force Dyad, Ben lifts Rey to new power levels.

Ben's abilities bring damage to Light Side and Rey led teams, with his Basic ability, [c][F0FF23]A Shadow Within,[-][/c] dealing more damage to tanks and his Special ability, [c][F0FF23]Family Legacy,[-][/c] inflicting Armor Shred. In Grand Arenas with an Omicron upgrade on his Unique ability [c][F0FF23]Redeemed,[-][/c] his attacks also ignore protection.

Through his [c][F0FF23]Force Dyad[-][/c] Unique, if all allies were Light Side at the start of battle and there is any version of Rey in the allied Leader slot, all allies gain [c][F0FF23]Instant Defeat Immunity[-][/c] for 1 turn at the start of each encounter. Furthermore, while Ben Solo is active Rey can't be defeated, and Ben Solo can't be defeated while Rey is above 50% health. In Grand Arenas with an Omicron upgrade, Ben can also revive when under a Galactic Legend Rey lead and grant his allies Instant Defeat Immunity.

Earn Ben Solo shards during the upcoming Conquest events! Additionally, Ben Solo will be summonable with a data disk acquired after beating Sector 3 in any Conquest difficulty modes during the upcoming events.
data.NEWSLETTER_BEN_SOLO_TITLE: I Did Want to Take Your Hand
data.NEWSLETTER_BEYOND_THE_FOREST_DESC: The mighty Ewoks get to prove their mettle in our newest Flash Event! Earn gear as your fuzzy squad face up against Empire enemies, Sith threats, junkyard Droids, and a super challenging BONUS tier. As with previous Flash events, these events last 1 to 2 hours and repeat several times over a few days, so be sure to get the deadliest of your diminutive Squads ready!
data.NEWSLETTER_BLACK_FRIDAY_CRYSTAL_EVENT_DE:
Greetings!

The Black Friday Crystal event has started! For a limited time, get 25% more Crystals on select crystal packs in the store. Limited one time purchase.

Bonus Crystal offer ends soon.
data.NEWSLETTER_BO_KATAN_MANDALOR_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

[c][F0FF23]Bo-Katan (Mand’alor)[-][/c] is coming to the Holotables! After winning the Darksaber in battle while rescuing Din Djarin from a Spider Tank-piloting cyborg, Bo-Katan claimed the title of Mand’alor, led her people back to their homeworld, usurped Moff Gideon, and cemented herself as their rightful heir.

Bo leans into True damage and thrives when teams try to overwhelm her with debuffs. Her Special ability [c][F0FF23]Reinforcements Have Arrived[-][/c] grants Light Side Mandalorians [c][F0FF23]Ancestral Resolve[-][/c] which increases their survivability as well as their True damage output. With an Omicron upgrade in the Grand Arenas game mode, this ability also allows The Mandalorian (Beskar Armor) to immediately unleash his Whistling Birds if he is set up for it.

Unlock Bo-Katan (Mand’alor) during the upcoming "BATTLE FOR MANDALORE" Epic Confrontation event!
data.NEWSLETTER_BO_KATAN_MANDALOR_TITLE: You Have Walked Both Worlds. You Are The One Who Can Unite Us.
data.NEWSLETTER_BODHI_DESC:
Rogue One: A [i]STAR WARS[/i] Story is now available on Digital HD and on Blu-ray and DVD tomorrow! To celebrate the release, we're giving away a FREE Bodhi Rook character in the store. Head there now to claim this limited-time pack. 

Bodhi Rook supports his Rebel allies by boosting their defenses and lowering the evasion of enemy units. He also has the ability to remove the Turn Meter from enemies and grant it to squad members. 

After getting the free pack, head to the Galactic War Store to obtain additional shards and raise Bodhi Rook’s star level.
data.NEWSLETTER_BODHI_TITLE: Celebrate the Rogue One: A [i]STAR WARS[/i] Story Blu-ray and DVD Release with a free Bodhi Rook!
data.NEWSLETTER_BOKATAN_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

[c][F0FF23]Bo-Katan Kryze[-][/c], the fierce Nite Owl agent, Death Watch lieutenant, and once-upon-a-time Darksaber wielder, marks her arrival to the holotables by calling on Mandalorians to unite in battle! A firm believer in the martial history of Mandalore, Bo-Katan Kryze is usually well-positioned to recruit allies to further her objectives and dispense of her enemies.

Bo-Katan Kryze stands ready to provide leadership and synergy for the Mandalorian faction by calling them to assist, providing valuable Protection bonuses, dispelling debuffs and granting Critical Damage increases. She also has the ability to inflict Daze and Vulnerable on enemies, increasing the effectiveness of any band of Mandalorians she is leading.

Add Bo-Katan Kryze to your roster of heroes by completing her all-new Marquee event and help her claim her rightful place in Mandalorian history.

Additionally, Canderous Ordo’s Unique ability, Mandalorian Veteran, and Sabine's Special, Demolish, have been updated to synergize with the Mandalorian tag in addition to existing factions.
data.NEWSLETTER_BONUS_CRYSTALS_MAYTHE4TH_2021: Special, limited Crystal offers are available now! Celebrate Star Wars Day with bonus Crystals on select Crystal Bundles in the store! data.NEWSLETTER_BOSS_NESS_DESC:
Mesa greeting yousa Holotable Heroes,

The long wait is over! Gungans are finally coming to the Holotables, starting with the one and only [c][F0FF23]Boss Nass[-][/c]! And with a brand new squad, we have a new and exciting Marquee style that we are trying out which will allow you to earn rewards [i][c][E7E7E7]daily[-][/c][/i] for the duration of the event.

While the Gungans didn’t always see eye-to-eye with the Naboo, the planetary invasion by the Trade Federation as well as the pleas of Queen Amidala established an alliance between the two cultures. Boss Nass’ leadership will be on display in the Gungan squad as we add more and more members over the coming weeks.

As part of his Leader ability, Boss Nass summons a [c][F0FF23]Shield Generator[-][/c] to the field which protects and provides passive boosts for Gungans. Each Gungan character will have synergy throughout their kits to further benefit from the Shield Generator’s presence. The shield is kept active through [c][F0FF23]Plasma Shielding[-][/c] stacks and it gains a bonus turn and the ability to use its Basic, [c][F0FF23]Plasma Pulse[-][/c], through stacks of [c][F0FF23]Recharge[-][/c]. Nass further supports his Gungan allies with his Basic, [c][F0FF23]Boss’ Command[-][/c], his first Special, [c][F0FF23]Bombad Favor[-][/c], and his second Special, [c][F0FF23]Intimidating Order[-][/c], all of which have a mixture of buffs, debuffs, and other potent effects that synergize with the team.

Unlock Boss Nass during the upcoming “BATTLEFIELD: NABOO I” Marquee event and prepare for the [c][E7E7E7]Legendary event for Jar Jar Binks[-][/c] and the upcoming [c][E7E7E7]Battle for Naboo raid[-][/c]!
data.NEWSLETTER_BOUNTY_HUNTERS_DESC:
Bossk has arrived to the Galaxy of Heroes! Bossk is a powerful taunting Tank that can easily get [c][F0FF23]Frenzy[-][/c]! This Trandoshan can call all Bounty Hunters to assist and his leader ability helps sustain Bounty Hunter allies through a fight. Bossk also has access to the new Bounty Hunter specific ability called [c][F0FF23]Contracts[-][/c]!

[c][F0FF23]Contracts[-][/c] are defined in a Bounty Hunter's leader ability, each having a different objective that must be fulfilled by a squad of Bounty Hunters. Completing a [c][F0FF23]Contract[-][/c] activates a special effect called [c][F0FF23]Payouts[-][/c]! This unlocks a Bounty Hunter's full potential, helping each of them hunt down their remaining prey.

Boba Fett's, IG‌-88's, Dengar's, and Greedo's ability kits have been updated! These characters all have [c][F0FF23]Contracts[-][/c] and [c][F0FF23]Payouts[-][/c] now, along with other updates.
data.NEWSLETTER_BOUNTY_HUNTERS_TITLE: Bossk Arrives, Contracts, and the Bounty Hunter Faction Pass!
data.NEWSLETTER_BOUSHH_LEIA_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

[c][F0FF23]Boushh (Leia Organa)[-][/c], the fearless and inventive Bounty Hunter disguise donned by the Rebel leader Leia Organa, is coming to the holotables!

Boushh is a Bounty Hunter Attacker who specializes in Thermal Detonators. Her Basic ability, [c][F0FF23]Ambidextrous Assault[-][/c], inflicts a Thermal Detonator while her Special Ability, [c][F0FF23]Inventive[-][/c], detonates all Thermals on all enemies before applying more. Her Unique ability, [c][F0FF23]Fearless[-][/c], introduces a new buff, [c][F0FF23]My Kind of Scum[-][/c], which stacks Health and Defense as well as giving a new effect, [c][F0FF23]Deadly Bluff[-][/c], which enemies start the encounter with and adds effects to Boushh's abilities such as adding Thermal Detonators to enemies who receive one that turn.

Her second Unique ability, [c][F0FF23]Ubese Ogygian Cloak[-][/c], provides her and Light Side Smuggler allies with various stat boosts. Introducing the first Raid Omicron upgrade to the game, when fully upgraded this ability also provides stacking stat boosts when Fearless inflicts Thermal Detonators while in Raids.

Add Boushh (Leia Organa) to your roster by unlocking her in the all-new “MY KIND OF SCUM” Marquee event!
data.NEWSLETTER_BRUTUS_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

The mutinous Shistavanen Pirate [c][F0FF23]Brutus[-][/c] is coming to the Holotables!

A ruthless Pirate with a taste for violence, Brutus is a deadly Attacker who thrives in chaotic situations. His skills with firearms and hand-to-hand combat make him a valuable addition to any Pirate crew, working especially well under the upcoming Galactic Legend Pirate King Hondo Ohnaka.

Brutus' Basic ability, [c][F0FF23]Blazing Barrage[-][/c], deals damage twice and inflicts Breach, a debuff that weakens enemies' defenses. Brutus gains stacks of Profit if the target is already Breached.

His first Special ability, [c][F0FF23]Scattershot Storm[-][/c], rains down destruction on all enemies while also granting Offense Up to Brutus and his allies, especially potent if led by the infamous Pirate King Hondo.

[c][F0FF23]Threatening Manner[-][/c], Brutus' second Special, cripples enemies with Accuracy Down and Critical Chance Down, and even Fears Breached foes if Hondo is in command. 

Brutus' Unique ability, [c][F0FF23]Mutineer[-][/c], makes him a formidable ally to Pirate leaders like Hondo or the upcoming Captain Silvo. He gains stacking bonuses based on the leader, and even assists himself when a Pirate leader falls in battle.

Unlock this cutthroat corsair in the upcoming [c][E7E7E7]"FORTUNE FAVORS THE BOLD I"[-][/c] Marquee event that [c][E7E7E7]gives out daily rewards[-][/c]! Additionally, Brutus can be used to great effectiveness in the Order 66 Raid and is required at relic 7 to unlock Galactic Legend Pirate King Hondo, so don’t miss out!
data.NEWSLETTER_C3PO_DESC: This protocol droid may seem unassuming–but he played an integral part helping the Republic during the Clone Wars and later assisted the Rebellion in their struggle against the Empire. C-3PO is a highly evasive Support that can join just about any team. His new debuff, Confuse, can shut down enemies while C-3PO greatly reinforces his allies through another new stacking buff, Translation. Even teams with a mix of factions will benefit from this protocol droid due to the variety of buffs from his Unique abilities. His long-time companion, R2-D2, will also receive some of C-3PO's bonuses directly.
data.NEWSLETTER_C3PO_TITLE: This Is The Droid You Are Looking For

data.NEWSLETTER_CAL_KESTIS_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

Once a Jedi Padawan and now on the run from the Empire after Order 66 as he tries to reconnect with the Force, [c][F0FF23]Cal Kestis[-][/c] is coming to the holotables! Cal is the hero of the award winning Jedi: Fallen Order game and we are excited to relive his story leading up to the release of Jedi: Survivor.

Cal creates a foundation for an Unaligned Force User squad that will be led by Cere Junda in an upcoming release. He brings a unique playstyle to the game where he prefers to not have Speed. As other units take their turns, Cal gains [c][F0FF23]Persistence[-][/c] stacks which provides him and Unaligned Force User allies with various benefits depending on the number of stacks he has. Once he does take his turn, he provides much needed sustain for his allies through [c][F0FF23]Help Me, BD-1[-][/c] and can manage the flow of battle with [c][F0FF23]Not So Fast[-][/c] by slowing enemies and speeding up allies.

With an omicron upgrade to his Unique ability [c][F0FF23]I’m Persistent[-][/c] in Territory Wars, Ahsoka Tano (Fulcrum)’s Omicron will no longer be disabled when she has allies present, bringing big power to the Unaligned Force User squad in that mode.

Unlock Cal Kestis in the new “STORIES OF SURVIVAL I” Marquee event and prepare for the upcoming Hero’s Journey for Cal Kestis (Survivor)!

data.NEWSLETTER_CAPTAIN_DROGAN_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

We are thrilled to introduce a new original character into the Star Wars galaxy: [c][F0FF23]Captain Drogan[-][/c]! Drogan fought with the Rebellion on Endor and is a key part of the upcoming Galactic Legend Leia Organa squad. Since birth, he has not just had a limb difference, but also a sense of justice and passion to help those in need.

Drogan focuses on taking out single enemy targets with his Basic ability [c][F0FF23]Coordinated Shot[-][/c], which can open battles up with a big hit Stun especially when under a Galactic Legend Leia lead. His Special ability [c][F0FF23]Fire Support[-][/c] brings another source of burning for Rebels that will also be useful in Leia’s squad. He introduces a new buff, [c][F0FF23]Keen Stratagem[-][/c], that provides Offense and Potency, and allies with this buff have debuffs dispelled, Protection recovered, and are called to assist through Drogan’s second Special ability [c][F0FF23]Battle Plan[-][/c].

His Unique ability [c][F0FF23]Second in Command[-][/c] provides extra benefits and assists for allies with Keen Stratagem. With an Omicron upgrade in the Grand Arenas game mode, Drogan has more survivability and under Galactic Legend Leia he provides an extra source of debuff dispel and Health and Protection recovery. If the Omicron is active under a Saw Gerrera lead he provides Rebel allies with Turn Meter whenever he scores a critical hit!

Unlock Captain Drogan during the upcoming “REBEL ROUSER” Marquee event!

data.NEWSLETTER_CAPTAIN_ENOCH_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

[c][F0FF23]Captain Enoch[-][/c] is coming to the Holotables!

Imposing and fiercely loyal to Grand Admiral Thrawn, Enoch acted as Thrawn’s captain of the guard during their time on the planet of Peridea. He arrives on the Holotables to lead the new Imperial Remnants Night Trooper and Death Trooper (Peridea) to victory.

His Basic ability, [c][F0FF23]Die Well[-][/c], synergizes with the Blight debuff and has added benefits when used during his turn. With his Special ability, [c][F0FF23]Last Command[-][/c], Enoch dispels debuffs on his Imperial Remnant allies and gives them several other boosts. While commanding Imperial Remnant allies with his Leader ability, [c][F0FF23]Arbiter of Decay[-][/c], he introduces the new debuff [c][F0FF23]Decay[-][/c], which progressively limits the amount of Health his allies can recover, but provides many other positive effects as a result. With [c][F0FF23]Ominous Sentinel[-][/c], his Unique ability, he further enhances his own resilience while simultaneously making it difficult for his enemies to critically strike his allies.

The Omicron effects for his Unique ability within Territory Battles further enhance the durability of his Imperial Remnant allies and allows them to deal a great amount of damage when they are defeated, scaling based on the defeated ally’s Relic Amplifier level.

Unlock Captain Enoch in the upcoming “UNDYING LEGION III” Marquee event that [c][E7E7E7]gives out daily rewards[-][/c] for the duration of the event and prepare for the upcoming [c][E7E7E7]Galactic Legend Ahsoka Tano[-][/c]!
data.NEWSLETTER_CAPTAIN_ITHANO_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

[c][F0FF23]Captain Ithano[-][/c] is charting a course for the Holotables!

The Pirate captain known as the Crimson Corsair, Ithano spent years plundering and pillaging across the galaxy, nearly recruiting ex-Stormtrooper Finn into his crew as the First Order attacked Takodana and Maz Kanata’s castle. Ithano leads his crew of swashbuckling Pirates, a crew that includes his trusty First Mate Quiggold and the last living Clone Trooper, Kix.

Captain Ithano wields the [c][F0FF23]Corsair Blaster Rifle[-][/c], a powerful Basic attack that also grants him Offense Up while providing Pirate Supports and Tanks with Foresight. His [c][F0FF23]Lower Ye Shields![-][/c] Special ability can dispel buffs or debuffs while stripping enemy defenses. The fearsome [c][F0FF23]Intimidating Display[-][/c] Exposes enemies and calls upcoming allies Quiggold and Kix to assist if Ithano has enough Profit stacks.

Ithano's hardy nature is reflected in his [c][F0FF23]I Don't Die So Easily[-][/c] Unique, reviving him once per battle if he leads an all-Pirate squad. While Ithano is Marked to protect Quiggold, he gains boosts to Offense and Protection.

As a Leader, [c][F0FF23]Crimson Corsair[-][/c] bolsters his Pirate allies' Health, Protection, and starting offensive might. He incentivizes careful buff management too, granting Profit stacks for having more buffs than debuffs each turn.

Make way for mayhem as Captain Ithano debuts in the upcoming [c][E7E7E7]"TROUBLE ON THE HORIZON I"[-][/c] marquee event that [c][E7E7E7]gives out daily rewards[-][/c]. Captain Ithano is also required for the upcoming [c][F0FF23]Galactic Legend Pirate King Hondo Ohnaka[-][/c] and, like all Pirates, is allowed in the new Order 66 raid!
data.NEWSLETTER_CAPTAIN_PHASMA_UNIT_PROMO_DES: Attack more than ever with this high damage onslaught leader inspired by Star Wars: The Force Awakens. Learn Phasma's strategy in our forums today. https://forums.galaxy-of-heroes.starwars.ea.com/
data.NEWSLETTER_CAPTAIN_REX_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

[c][F0FF23]Captain Rex[-][/c], friend to Ahsoka Tano and former second-in-command to General Anakin Skywalker, who never lost his loyalty to his fellow Clones or his determination to resist Empire rule, is coming to the holotables!

Rex brings the long awaited lift to Phoenix squadron. Through his Unique ability [c][F0FF23]The Lost Commander[-][/c], Rex will assist Phoenix allies when they use a Special ability, which keeps them clean of debuffs through his Basic ability [c][F0FF23]Aim, Then Fire[-][/c]. His Special ability [c][F0FF23]Suppressing Fire[-][/c] opens the battle strong by applying Tenacity Down and Daze to all enemies then granting Phoenix allies Turn Meter for each debuff inflicted.

The Omicron upgrade to his Unique affects the two modes of Grand Arenas differently. In 5v5, it will give Phoenix allies additional survivability, damage, and retaliate attempted Ability Blocks and Dazes with Damage Over Time. Meanwhile in 3v3, this upgrade focuses on his Clone identity by allowing allied Clone Troopers to dispel when they assist and inflict Armor Shred.

Unlock Captain Rex in the new “THE LOST COMMANDER” Marquee event!

data.NEWSLETTER_CAPTAIN_SILVO_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

[c][F0FF23]Captain Silvo[-][/c] is coming to the Holotables!

A cunning corsair with a penchant for treasure, Captain Silvo joins the fray as a new Pirate Attacker. His arrival shakes up the dynamics for Pirate squads and gives firepower to squads led by the infamous [c][F0FF23]Pirate King Hondo Ohnaka.[-][/c]

Captain Silvo's Basic ability, [c][F0FF23]Zero Patience,[-][/c] inflicts Evasion Down, setting up enemies for his allies to hit them harder. When Pirate King Hondo leads, Pirate allies also recover Health and Protection after Silvo's attack. His first Special, [c][F0FF23]Open the Vault,[-][/c] Stuns enemies while granting Silvo and his Pirate allies offensive buffs like Speed Up and even Frenzy when Hondo is present.

The true strength of Captain Silvo lies in his second Special, [c][F0FF23]The Only Thing That Matters.[-][/c] This ability cripples the enemy by removing their Turn Meter, reducing Max Health, and Stealing protective buffs to grant them to Silvo's Pirate crew instead.

Captain Silvo's Unique, [c][F0FF23]Well Now It's Mine,[-][/c] is a stat-boosting powerhouse that makes him extremely evasive and durable when evading or benefitting from healing. This ability is enhanced with an Omicron upgrade in Grand Arenas that punishes enemy Protection and revives fallen Pirate allies.

Unlock Captain Silvo in the upcoming [c][E7E7E7]"FORTUNE FAVORS THE BOLD III"[-][/c] Marquee event that [c][E7E7E7]gives out daily rewards![-][/c] This vicious Pirate will make an excellent addition to any Pirate squad, and is a requirement (at Relic 7) for Galactic Legend Pirate King Hondo Ohnaka.
data.NEWSLETTER_CAPTAIN_TARPALS_DESC:
Mesa greeting yousa Holotable Heroes,

Another Gungan arrives to the Holotables! [c][F0FF23]Captain Tarpals[-][/c] served in the Gungan Grand Army during the Invasion of Naboo and has now come to battle alongside Boss Nass. Tarpals will also feature the new and exciting Marquee-style that we are trying out which will allow you to earn rewards [c][E7E7E7]daily[-][/c] for the duration of the event.

An Attacker for the squad, Tarpals uses the debuffs from Boss Nass to scale his damage. He provides Shock and damage through his Basic ability [c][F0FF23]Hey, Yousa![-][/c] as well as True damage that scales per debuffed enemy through his Special ability [c][F0FF23]Ouch Time[-][/c]. Special ability [c][F0FF23]No Giben Up[-][/c] marks the target enemy, calls an assist, and scales damage per debuff on the target.

His Unique ability [c][F0FF23]Mesa Tink of Something[-][/c] allows him to deal True damage whenever he attacks out of turn and recharges the Shield Generator whenever he critically hits. Further synergizing with Boss Nass’s debuffs, Tarpals gains Turn Meter when an enemy is debuffed and counters debuffed enemies. In Territory Battles with an Omicron upgrade, Tarpals does more damage, protects his Gungan allies, and provides more Plasma Shielding and faster recharge for the Shield Generator.

Unlock Captain Tarpals during the upcoming “BATTLEFIELD: NABOO II” Marquee event and prepare for the [c][E7E7E7]Legendary event for Jar Jar Binks[-][/c] and the upcoming [c][E7E7E7]Battle for Naboo raid[-][/c].
