data.NEWSLETTER_CERE_JUNDA_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

[c][F0FF23]Cere Junda[-][/c] is coming to the holotables from the acclaimed Jedi: Fallen Order game! Her Padawan Trilla Suduri eventually became the feared Inquisitor Second Sister, but even after this devastation Cere continued to fight by rescuing Cal Kestis from the clutches of her former pupil to try to restore the Jedi Order.

Though her Jedi Knight days are behind her, Cere still uses her connection to the Force to protect her allies with her Special ability, [c][F0FF23]Force Barrier[-][/c], providing them bonus Protection and Damage Immunity for the weakest Unaligned Force User ally. She also bides her time and lets an enemy’s strength become their downfall with her Leader ability, [c][F0FF23]Rekindle[-][/c], which provides her allies additional damage for each turn an enemy takes until one of her allies takes their first turn. Additionally, each time an enemy takes a turn her Special ability, [c][F0FF23]Determined Assault[-][/c], will deal more damage. Though the cooldown of Determined Assault is rather exceptional at first glance, her Unique ability, [c][F0FF23]Unity Through Adversity[-][/c], will reduce the cooldown of her abilities whenever an enemy takes a turn so long as certain conditions are met.

While in the Grand Arenas game mode, Cere’s Omicron further empowers her allies from enemy turns, giving some members of her squad exceptional burst damage potential. Ever the protector, her Omicron also increases the survivability of her allies through stats and immunity to Ability Block and Daze.

Unlock Cere Junda in the new "STORIES OF SURVIVAL II" Marquee event and prepare for the upcoming Hero’s Journey for Cal Kestis (Survivor)!
data.NEWSLETTER_CERE_JUNDA_TITLE: The Choice to Keep Fighting Makes Us Who We Are
data.NEWSLETTER_CHARACTER_CHANGES_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

Darth Vader, General Skywalker, Jedi Knight Luke Skywalker, and Wat Tambor will receive several changes to their kits in regards to ignoring Defense in an upcoming Update. We have returned the resources used to upgrade these units beyond Relic 7 to your inbox and reset these units to Relic 7.

We will also be updating several kits with Galactic Legends exceptions in addition to Raid Bosses exceptions in the near future. Related to this change, Dark Trooper has been reset to Relic 5. If you had upgraded Dark Trooper beyond this level and any resources used to upgrade Dark Trooper above Relic 5 have been returned to your inbox.

Please visit the Official Forums and find the Road Ahead: July 2021 post for more information.
data.NEWSLETTER_CHARACTER_CHANGES_TITLE: Resources Returned For Upcoming Character Changes
data.NEWSLETTER_CHEWBACCA_IG2000_DESC:
Chewbacca from the Original Trilogy is here! This powerful attacker Guards his weakest ally, preventing them from being Critically Hit, granting them immunity to Daze and Stun, and giving them additional Critical Chance. Don’t be caught on the wrong side of his bowcaster, earn this famous character in the special upcoming Bounty Hunter event!

Need another Bounty Hunter ship to round out your fleet? Look no further than IG-88’s ship, the IG-2000. This unusual ship packs quite a punch and does even more damage when battling Breached enemies. The IG-2000 can’t cause Breach itself, so IG-88 prefers to work with a Bounty Hunter fleet.

Finally, weekly Shipments will now be available for players level 70 to 85.
data.NEWSLETTER_CHIEF_CHIRPA_ANNOUNCEMENT_DES: Chief Chirpa, the chief of the Ewoks on the forest moon of Endor, is now available! He is a leader that improves the abilities of all his allies, but much more for Ewok squad members.\n\nChief Chirpa can be unlocked through Chromium Packs, or by collecting his character Shards from Cantina Battle 5-D.
data.NEWSLETTER_CHIMAERA_DESC: The Artist of War returns and introduces the first 7-Star Capital Ship to the Galaxy of Heroes. In our first ever Legendary Ship Event, band together with the heroes of Rebels(TM) and other pilots from the Rebellion to meet this Imperial challenge in Lothal space and earn blueprints of the Chimaera!\n\nCan you emerge victorious once more against Grand Admiral Thrawn?
data.NEWSLETTER_CHIRRUT_PVP_TOURNAMENT01_DESC:
A new character from Rogue One has arrived! Chirrut Îmwe shards are available exclusively in the STREETS OF JEDHA Squad Tournament starting this Friday. You will need to be at least level 30 in order to have a chance of unlocking this Rebel attacker for your collection.

Chirrut Îmwe, a spiritual warrior monk, is a balanced Rebel attacker, capable of dispelling debuffs from his allies and granting them both a Heal Over Time and Tenacity Up. His belief in the Force and its guidance helps guide his strikes granting him, "Strength of Purpose," giving him increased damage for each of his buffed allies, as well as calling his best friend, Baze Malbus (if Baze is in the squad), to Assist.

Dominate the STREETS OF JEDHA Squad Tournament leaderboard this weekend to add this Rogue One Rebel attacker to your squad!
data.NEWSLETTER_CHIRRUT_PVP_TOURNAMENT01_TITL: New Squad Tournament with Rogue One’s Chirrut Îmwe!
data.NEWSLETTER_CHROMIUM_UPDATE_BAZE_DESC:
A new selection of characters has now been rotated into Chromium Packs! These characters include the new Rogue One characters Baze Malbus, Shoretrooper and the Scarif Rebel Pathfinder as well as Dengar, Chief Nebit, Wedge Antilles and more!

For a full list of the changing Chromium Characters, check out the SWGOH forum (https://forums.galaxy-of-heroes.starwars.ea.com)

Add these characters to your collection today!
data.NEWSLETTER_CLONE_TROOPER_DESC:
[i]"It's been said that the 501st got the best of the war. We also got the worst."[/i] – 501st Journal

Your favorite Clone Troopers from the 501st are entering battle with renewed resolve. [c][F0FF23]Echo[-][/c], [c][F0FF23]Fives[-][/c], and [c][F0FF23]Rex[-][/c] have been reworked and proudly represent their legion with a new [c][F0FF23]501st[-][/c] faction tag!

Following the commands of a Jedi General, Clone Captain Rex leads the 501st into the heat of battle, and Rex’s reworked kit allows the new 501st faction to synergize even better with their clone brethren. Fives and Echo work well together, and their history in Domino Squad means Fives is willing to sacrifice anything to keep his Clone Trooper allies alive. Echo lays down a hail of blaster fire whenever his allies take aim and can now stun enemy Droids. Don’t underestimate this hard-hitting squad – their quick reflexes and counter attacks were the downfall of many droid armies and anyone else who stood against the Galactic Republic.
data.NEWSLETTER_CLONE_WAR_DESC: In honor of the upcoming new Territory Battle on Geonosis, General Kenobi, and Jedi Knight Anakin are getting touch-ups and Ahsoka Tano is getting a rework – just in time to take on the Separatists. This trio of Jedi criss-crossed the galaxy during the Clone Wars, foiling Separatist plots, matching wits with the enemy, and leading Clone Troopers in fierce battles. They bring their daring battle skills to the holotables as formidable Galactic Republic Jedi.\n\nThe touch-ups to General Kenobi and Jedi Knight Anakin strengthen their synergy and provide protective measures to defend their allies while taking down the enemy. Ahsoka Tano’s rework plays into that synergy and allows her to come to the rescue more often with regular assists and plenty of dispels.
data.NEWSLETTER_COMEUPPANCE_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

Strap in Spice Runners! Zorii Bliss’ modified BTA-NR2 Y-wing starfighter, christened the [c][F0FF23]Comeuppance[-][/c], is coming to the holotables! This is the ship that Zorii and Babu Frik used to escape Kijimi and later helped fight in the Battle of Exegol, securing the Resistance’s victory over the First Order.

Zorii Bliss’ Dramatic Entrance in Rise of Skywalker gives us the opportunity to include the same-named buff (last seen on Poe Dameron’s X-wing) to Zorii’s Reinforcement ability [c][F0FF23]Take a Guess, Spice Runner[-][/c]. This buff will increase a ship’s Offense and deal bonus True damage, with added bonuses if this damage defeats an enemy. The Comeuppance’s Basic ability [c][F0FF23]IX4-B Laser Cannons[-][/c] will also key off Dramatic Entrance, giving all Resistance allies Critical Chance Up and Critical Damage Up.

The Comeuppance’s Special ability [c][F0FF23]Want to Come With Me?[-][/c] will Expose an enemy and give all Resistance allies Foresight, with added effects if the target was already Exposed. Next, the Unique ability [c][F0FF23]Spice Running Tactics[-][/c] gives Resistance allies Turn Meter whenever they use their Basic ability on an enemy with Expose. The Comeuppance’s Unique ability [c][F0FF23]I Think You’re Okay[-][/c] gives the ship counter chance as well as added effects when Resistance allies attack out of turn.

Unlock the Comeuppance during the upcoming Galactic Chase event!

[i]NOTE: With the release of Comeuppance, all faction fleets now have a minimum of five ships available to them. Fleet-based Galactic Challenges will now require five ships for the full faction feat.[/i]
data.NEWSLETTER_COMMAND_SHUTTLE_DESC:
Kylo Ren’s Command Shuttle from the film [i]Star Wars[/i]™: The Force Awakens is now available!

This powerful First Order Support ship has the ability to grant bonus turn meter to allied ships. In addition to manipulating turn meter, this ship has the ability to dispel all buffs from enemy ships and inflict Healing Immunity on them.

To use this ship in your fleet you will need the following crew: Kylo Ren, Captain Phasma, and First Order Stormtrooper.

Add this ship to your collection and dominate the Fleet Arena today!
data.NEWSLETTER_COMMAND_SHUTTLE_TITLE: NEW SHIP – Kylo Ren’s Command Shuttle
data.NEWSLETTER_COMMANDER_AHSOKA_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes!

[c][F0FF23]Commander Ahsoka Tano[-][/c], one of the greatest heroes of the Clone Wars, and proud Togruta warrior joins the Holotables. This former padawan of Anakin Skywalker is an exceptional and agile Force user that leaps into battle often against overwhelming odds. Ahsoka’s mastery of the dual lightsaber technique and evasive combat style allows her to easily outmaneuver her foes with a level of skill that few opponents can match.

Though she was once a devout follower of the Jedi Order, Ahsoka's faith in the Jedi was shaken, causing her to walk away from the Order and follow her own path with the Force. This did not diminish her strong bond with her allies or her commitment to protecting those in need. Ahsoka rejoined the Grand Army of the Republic as a Commander during the Siege of Mandalore to support her friends and finally end the war that had engulfed the galaxy for most of her life.

Ahsoka also introduces a new "Unaligned Force User" faction tag. This tag will be retroactively given to Rey (Scavenger), Rey (Jedi Training), Rey, Commander Luke Skywalker, Visas Marr, Asajj Ventress, Kylo Ren, Kylo Ren (Unmasked), and Supreme Leader Kylo Ren.

Commander Ahsoka Tano will be available as a reward and from merchants in the upcoming Conquest.
data.NEWSLETTER_COMMANDER_CODY_DESC:
Commander Cody is now available in Chromium Packs! This Clone commander was a natural and practical leader in the Clone army, who earned respect from both his Jedi and Clone allies during the Clone Wars.

Commander Cody is a great leader for Clone squads, granting increased Critical Chance and gaining increased Defense for each Clone ally. His combat acumen also gives him the ability to call in tons of assists when he attacks, making sure that he and his Clone brothers focus fire to deal massive damage to a target.

Add this Clone Attacker to your Clone squad and watch him lead them to victory at the holotables!
data.NEWSLETTER_COMMANDER_CODY_TITLE: New Chromium Pack Character: Commander Cody
data.NEWSLETTER_COMMANDER_LUKE_DESC: Commander Luke Skywalker is arriving soon in Galaxy of Heroes. Commander Skywalker is the first character to have six abilities, three of which have Zeta upgrades! Commander Skywalker can dispel buffs and debuffs, inflict many debuffs, and allow his Rebel allies to counter attack. Additionally, Commander Skywalker can switch between offensive (ignores taunts, deals more damage) and defensive (counter attacks, takes less damage) modes! Finally, whenever Commander Skywalker inflicts a debuff, he and his allies gain turn meter. He is a powerful ally in any squad!\n\nCommander Luke Skywalker will unlock through the Hero's Journey event as a Seven Star character. To unlock Commander Skywalker, players will require a Seven Star Old Ben Kenobi, Princess Leia, Stormtrooper Han, Luke Skywalker (Farmboy), AND R2-D2. In celebration of the Hero's Journey event we've brought back R2-D2 so that players can improve their R2-D2 in preparation for the event. We will also be doing reworks soon for Old Ben Kenobi, Princess Leia, Stormtrooper Han, and Luke Skywalker (Farmboy) also arriving next week. Finally, Han Solo's ability kit has been updated as an added bonus!
data.NEWSLETTER_COMMANDER_LUKE_TITLE: Commander Luke Skywalker Arrives and R2-D2 Returns
data.NEWSLETTER_CONQUEST_10_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

Conquest returns to Galaxy of Heroes, and with it comes a whole host of changes to the mode. In honor of the new Boba Fett, Scion of Jango, Conquest 10, 11, and 12 will be Bounty Hunter themed! There are new Feats, and Bosses related to Bounty Hunters, along with new Data Disks and consumables to spice up the experience.

In addition, a new difficulty has been added to Conquest, [c][F0FF23]Easy Mode[-][/c]. Easy Mode is intended to open up Conquest to all Level 85 Players. Encounters and Feats have been reworked to create a fitting adventure for those players.

Furthermore, a new path has been added to the map. This path offers additional rewards for Players that choose to take this more challenging route.

Special Event Passes are available for Conquest 10. The [c][F0FF23]Conquest Pass[-][/c] includes an additional reward track containing even more rewards. The Upgraded Conquest Pass also grants bonuses to Stamina recharge rates and provides other benefits that will help you master this Conquest.

For this Conquest, the keycards required for each end of event reward crate in Easy and Normal difficulties are: 80, 130, 180, 235, 300, 390, and 495.

In Hard difficulty, the keycards required for each end of event reward crate are: 100, 165, 230, 365, 450, 530, and 630.

Ready to take on the galaxy? Conquest 10 begins November 1st!
data.NEWSLETTER_CONQUEST_7_DESC:
Conquest 7 is coming to the Holotables and ready to challenge your roster!

You will notice several big changes with this Conquest that shake up the experience, and make for a more challenging adventure. The most notable additions include: new bosses, special Data Disks, faction focused Consumables, and Feats. The map has also received some updates to it such as mini-bosses in the middle of each Sector! The combination of new bonuses and challenges creates a fresh and unique Conquest event for you to enjoy.

We hope you enjoy this upcoming Conquest and we will see you on the Holotables!
data.NEWSLETTER_COVEN_OF_SHADOWS_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

We’ve added a new event to the holotables: the Coven of Shadows.

On the distant planet of Peridea, the exiled Grand Admiral Thrawn finds an opportunity to return to the galaxy, but Sabine Wren and her allies stand in his way. Joined by Ezra Bridger, Sabine must face off against Night Troopers and Death Troopers to earn credits and Spectre shards. Meanwhile Ahsoka Tano duels Morgan Elsbeth one on one to earn Kyrotech Salvage and Relic materials.

This event will require Padawan Sabine Wren for Tiers 1 and 2, with Tier 2 requiring her at 7*, and Tier 3 will require a Relic 9 Ahsoka Tano Galactic Legend.
data.NEWSLETTER_CR10_BALANCE_CHANGES_CHANGELO:
Greetings, holotable heroes! Feel the force like never before with our newest update, featuring:

• Control your squad in PvP – Auto-battle is now optional in PvP, but be careful, we’ve improved defender AI too!

• Arena Rank Rewards – Win prizes every day based on your leaderboard rank. Climb higher to win better prizes

• Cantina Character Tutorials – Learn more about the denizens hanging around the cantina as they teach you more about their tables and game modes.

Thanks for playing Star Wars: Galaxy of Heroes. Don’t forget to let us know how we’re doing with a review!
data.NEWSLETTER_CREDIT_HEIST_EVENT_DESC: Assemble a team of scoundrels for a limited time Credit Heist Event! Available at levels 30, 50, 70 & 80, your squad of scoundrels will need to escape from the law in order to keep your stolen loot! Your squad will need to beat the pursuant police in 3 battles. Recommended for level 30+ select your team wisely and fight the law to claim your reward!\n\nThe Credit Heist Event only runs for 24 Hours and appears randomly between 6 and 12 days.
data.NEWSLETTER_CROSSHAIRS3_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

[c][F0FF23]Crosshair (Scarred)[-][/c] is coming to the Holotables!

An original member of Clone Force 99, Crosshair found himself at odds with his own team over Order 66. Eventually he came around to realize the Empire wasn’t everything it promised to be. Arrested for treason, he was experimented on by the Empire for their CX program. His unwavering loyalty and precision were corrupted, replaced by instability and inner turmoil which impaired his abilities to a point that had him questioning his role on the team.

Crosshair (Scarred) begins the battle with stacks of Shaken, which greatly reduces his Accuracy. His abilities have different ways to remove these stacks, restoring him to be the hard hitting sniper that the Bad Batch needs.

Crosshair's Basic ability, [c][F0FF23]A Hit or A Miss[-][/c], showcases his erratic state, inflicting Defense Down but, if he misses due to Shaken, will Expose enemies. His first Special, [c][F0FF23]I Will Handle It[-][/c], calls a Bad Batch ally to assist with offensive buffs while getting rid of Shaken if he selects himself as the targeted ally. [c][F0FF23]Target Secured[-][/c], his other Special, is a hard-hitting attack that grows in efficacy the longer the encounter drags on.

Crosshair's Unique, [c][F0FF23]It's In My Head[-][/c], represents his inner struggle, starting the battle with stacks of Shaken that are gradually removed by his allies' Target Practice. As Shaken fades, Crosshair regains his former prowess and gains Critical Damage. In the Grand Arenas game mode with an Omicron upgrade, Crosshair becomes even deadlier against non-Galactic Legend enemies.

Unlock Crosshair (Scarred) in the upcoming [c][E7E7E7]"The Cavalry Has Arrived V"[-][/c] Marquee event that [c][E7E7E7]gives out daily rewards[-][/c] for the duration of the event!
data.NEWSLETTER_CROSSHAIRS3_TITLE: I've Done Things. I've Made Mistakes.
data.NEWSLETTER_CRYSTAL_OFFERS_MAY_4TH_2022_D:
Celebrate Star Wars Day with bonus Crystals on select Crystal Bundles in the Store!

For a limited time, you can get 25% bonus Crystals on the [b]Box of Crystals[/b] and [b]Chest of Crystals![/b] During this period, you can also unlock a 50% bonus on your next purchase of the Box of Crystals offer!

This promotion is only running from 5/4 through 5/10, so act now before its gone!
data.NEWSLETTER_CT210408_ECHO_DESC:
Echo is now available in Chromium Packs! This ARC Trooper proved himself to be among the bravest of Clones and was an integral part of many battles during the Clone Wars.

Echo has great synergies with other Clones by assisting them when they attack. He also has the ability to dispel positive status effects from his enemies, giving his Clone brothers the edge they may need in battle.

Add this support character to your Clone squad and lead them to victory at the holotables!
data.NEWSLETTER_CX_2_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

The Clone Operative designated [c][F0FF23]CX-2[-][/c] is coming to the Holotables!

Fully conditioned by the execution of Order 66 and the experiments of Dr. Hemlock, Clone X trooper CX-2 was ordered to find and capture Omega after her escape from Mount Tantiss. A master of infiltration and assassination, CX-2’s skills, as well as his loyalty to the Empire, is without question.

In addition to being a powerful Support addition to any Dark Side Clone Trooper squad, CX-2 looks to shore up certain aspects of the Lord Vader squad. With CC-1119 “Appo” present, the Unique ability, [c][F0FF23]You Chose the Wrong Side[-][/c], gives the squad Instant Defeat Immunity, and they can ignore Taunts to target enemies with the new Order 66 debuff. CX-2 himself can bypass enemy Taunts and eventually inflict Order 66 on his own via his second Unique ability [c][F0FF23]Focused and Determined[-][/c].

CX-2 looks to control the battlefield with his Basic ability, [c][F0FF23]Infiltrate and Extract[-][/c], which gives him Stealth and deals damage while inflicting Speed Down. If the target enemy has the Order 66 debuff, Empire allies gain Turn Meter and recover Health. His Special, [c][F0FF23]Instruments of the Empire[-][/c], disarms enemies while providing potent offensive and defensive boosts to Empire allies based on their roles.

You Chose the Wrong Side’s capstone is the Omicron ability usable in 3v3 Grand Arenas. While alongside Appo, CX-2 can't be targeted by enemies, is immune to Taunt effects, and whenever an enemy dispels any amount of Damage Over Time effects, they instantly regain a stack. (Note: The Omicron Ability tier will only cost 10 Omicron materials because it is only active in 3v3 Grand Arenas, see the “Update to Certain Omicron Upgrades” Newsletter for more information).

Unlock CX-2 in the upcoming [c][E7E7E7]"Executing Orders II"[-][/c] Marquee event that [c][E7E7E7]gives out daily rewards[-][/c] for its duration, and use him as a requirement (at Relic 5) to unlock Jedi Master Mace Windu!
data.NEWSLETTER_DAILY_CANTINA_ENERGY_DESC: Starting with this update, every day at Noon, local time, when you collect your free normal 45 Energy, you will now get to collect 45 free Cantina Energy!\n\nWe hope that these changes give you more options to enjoy the game!
data.NEWSLETTER_DAILY_GUILD_CONTRIBUTION_CHAN:
The way you contribute to your Guild is changing! We have removed the Personal Guild Contributions (having to spend 600 energy a day) from the Daily Activity section and have implemented a new system now found in the Guild section of the Cantina under Guild Activities. Each guild member’s progress and their contribution of Guild Bank Coins will be displayed in this area. These Guild Bank Coins will be deposited in the Guild Bank once the Guild Activities reset every 24 hours.

Due to this change, we are going to grant some Guild Bank Coins to offset any loss of Coins accrued. In addition, we know that last week there was a server bug where Guilds completed a Raid with a single individual doing an extraordinary amount of damage. Due to this bug, we've decided to increase the amount of Guild Bank Coins your Guild will receive, from 15,000 to 75,000.

All Guilds will receive 75,000 Guild Bank Coins when the Guild Leader logs in.
Guild Contribution Changes and the Raid Bug
data.NEWSLETTER_DAILY_LOGIN_BISTAN_DESC: Login daily this month to unlock the latest character from Rogue One to be added to Star Wars: Galaxy of Heroes, Bistan! A wild Rebel attacker who utilizes a brand new buff, Frenzy, allowing him to gain 100% Turn Meter whenever an ally uses a Special ability (Frenzy's duration can be increased by upgrading the ability). An able gunner, Bistan, is able to utilize “Gunner Tactics” to both deal damage and remove Turn Meter from his target. By utilizing his abilities, Bistan is able to provide sustained bursts of damage while delaying his enemies.\n\nBe sure to add this Rebel hero to your collection by logging in during the month of November!
data.NEWSLETTER_DAILY_LOGIN_BISTAN_TITLE: November's Daily Login: Rogue One's Bistan
data.NEWSLETTER_DAILY_LOGIN_BOBA_FETT_DESC: Boba Fett returns as this month's daily login character! This legendary bounty hunter has undergone some changes to increase his effectiveness in hunting down and eliminating his targets. Boba Fett now comes equipped with his EE-3 Carbine Rifle and starts each battle with "Bounty Hunter's Resolve." This buff can't be dispelled, allows him to ignore Taunts, and enables him to revive upon defeat. He regains "Bounty Hunter's Resolve" each time he defeats an enemy. His "Execute" is now a special ability that will dispel all status effects on a target (dealing increased damage for each effect dispelled) and will prevent a target killed by it from being revived.\n\nAdd this feared bounty hunter to your squad and watch as he decimates your enemies!
data.NEWSLETTER_DAILY_LOGIN_SEP_15_DESCRIPTIO:
Log in every day this month to win Gear, Crystals, Training Droids, Ally Points, and Credits! Every day you log in, you'll receive the next reward in the list.

This month's featured character is Clone Wars Chewbacca. If you log in every day this month, you'll receive a total of 30 Shards that you can use to Upgrade this character!

Rewards will reset next month, and Shards from a different character will become available.
data.NEWSLETTER_DARK_TROOPER_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

The [c][F0FF23]Dark Trooper[-][/c], Moff Gideon’s menacing enforcer, is making its way to the Holotables! The foreboding and unrelenting droid trooper keeps the most skilled warrior’s hands full as it will stop at nothing to defeat its enemies and bring glory to the Empire. 

Dark Trooper will usher in the new "[c][F0FF23]Imperial Remnant[-][/c]" faction tag and bring the new Dark Trooper Squad buff to the holotables, which mimics the squad-based deployment seen in The Mandalorian. Dark Trooper can also dole out Advantage, Turn Meter and Offense Up to allies while giving itself increased Defense for more survivability during the fight.

Alongside Dark Trooper, Moff Gideon, Death Trooper and Stormtrooper will be given the “Imperial Remnant” tag, with the latter two receiving kit touch-ups to make them even more powerful within their new faction.

Add Dark Trooper to your roster via the all new Dark Trooper Marquee Event!
data.NEWSLETTER_DARK_TROOPER_MOFF_GIDEON_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

[c][F0FF23]Dark Trooper Moff Gideon[-][/c] is making his reappearance on the holotables from the final episodes of The Mandalorian season 3! After escaping New Republic custody, the Moff continued his quest to combine the best of Mandalorian technology with the Force through his secret cloning project.

Utilizing his iconic [c][F0FF23]Insight[-][/c] status effect, Dark Trooper Moff Gideon controls the battle through Turn Meter removal via his Special ability, [c][F0FF23]Strategic Onslaught[-][/c]. Insight also plays a role in allowing the Moff to sacrifice his weakest allies to stave off defeat in his Unique ability, [c][F0FF23]Dark Trooper Beskar Armor[-][/c]. His Leader ability, [c][F0FF23]Shadow Contingency[-][/c], allows Gideon to lead a full squad of Imperial Remnant allies effectively, and he can revive them and call assists with his second Special ability, [c][F0FF23]Unwavering Presence[-][/c]. Finally, several of Dark Trooper Moff Gideon’s abilities have synergy with Dark Side Mandalorians which, combined with the Imperial Super Commando kit touchup, allow for a new Dark Side Mandalorian team under Maul.

Earn Dark Trooper Moff Gideon shards during the upcoming Conquest events!
data.NEWSLETTER_DARK_TROOPER_TITLE: Let's See How Well You Do Against a Platoon
data.NEWSLETTER_DARTH_BANE_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

[c][F0FF23]Darth Bane[-][/c] is coming to the Holotables! An ancient and legendary Sith Lord, Bane was responsible for enacting the Sith rule of two, securing a future for only the strongest and most cunning among their kind.

A devastating Attacker, Bane gains stacks of Siphon from his Basic ability, [c][F0FF23]Soul Sever[-][/c], and his first Special ability, [c][F0FF23]Malevolent Whirlwind[-][/c]. With these stacks, he can Siphon Max Health with his second Special ability, [c][F0FF23]Essence of Dominance[-][/c]. His Leader ability, [c][F0FF23]Only The Strong Survive[-][/c], can take all manner of Sith and forge them into a lethal force to be reckoned with. And his Unique ability, [c][F0FF23]Rule of Two[-][/c], allows him and one other Sith ally to overcome otherwise overwhelming odds to defeat their foes.

Unlock Darth Bane during the upcoming Conquest events! Note that the first Conquest event (and only the first) featuring Darth Bane only will start two days later than usual.
data.NEWSLETTER_DARTH_BANE_TITLE: I'm Only Happy When It's Bane
data.NEWSLETTER_DARTH_MALAK_DESC:
[i]"You cannot hide from what you once were, Revan! Recognize that you were once the Dark Lord – and know that I have taken your place!"[/i] - Darth Malak

While [c][f0ff23]Darth Malak[-][/c] served as Apprentice to Darth Revan for a time, he ultimately betrayed Revan in a ruthless bid for mastery of the Sith Empire. In battle, Malak sustains himself by ripping the very Force out of his enemies. Taking down this Sith Tank won’t be easy, as you’ll be constantly tortured by Malak’s Shock, Stun, and Fear. When Malak is damaged, he will gain a new buff, [c][f0ff23]Dark Infusion[-][/c], that enables him to deal huge amounts of damage while he recovers his survivability.

Unlock Malak at 5 Stars in the Star Forge Showdown event, which is available to level 85 players. You'll need both Jedi Knight Revan and Darth Revan to enter the Showdown and follow their respective Light Path and Dark Path. Bring four of the companions from each of the previous Revan events to defeat Darth Malak. Each character will need to be at least 17,500 Power to participate. If you are able to complete the event and defeat Darth Malak, his shards will unlock in the Guild Events Store.
data.NEWSLETTER_DARTH_MALGUS_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

Conquest 16 begins soon and shards for a new character, [c][F0FF23]Darth Malgus[-][/c], will be available for a limited time in this mode! Darth Malgus proves difficult to take down as a leader for Sith Empire and a resilient tank whose Max Health grows and allows him to deal damage based off of it.

Darth Malgus also introduces two new effects, [c][F0FF23]Doubt[-][/c] and [c][F0FF23]We Have Returned[-][/c]. Doubt prevents enemies from gaining bonus Turn Meter and buffs and recovering Protection. Doubt expiring or being removed will grant Sith Empire allies extra Critical Damage and Offense through We Have Returned.

His Omicron upgrades increase his ability to spread Doubt among his enemies and further punish them if they dispel it. Additionally, his Omicron upgrades grant Mastery and Speed to Sith Empire allies and lay down a spread of debuffs while in the Grand Arenas game mode.

Earn Darth Malgus shards during the upcoming Conquest events! Furthermore, Darth Malgus will be playable at the end of Sector 5 in Conquest Hard mode during the upcoming events.
data.NEWSLETTER_DARTH_REVAN_ARRIVAL_DESC: The Scourge of the Old Republic event is live! Join Bastila Shan (Fallen), Canderous Ordo, Carth Onasi, Juhani, and a freshly reworked HK-47 on their journey with Darth Revan across the galaxy to the star forge.\n\nUnlocking Darth Revan will be no easy task. Complete your journey to the dark side by proving yourself in the fighting arena, combating old allies, battling merciless bounty hunters, and reliving the legends of the Old Republic.
data.NEWSLETTER_DARTH_REVAN_DESC:
[i]“When they left after the Mandalorian Wars ended, they were Jedi. When they returned… they were something else.”[/i] - Carth Onasi

Have you heard the tale of the Jedi who left to investigate the rumors of a Sith Empire and returned as a Sith Lord? After using the star forge to create a massive fleet, [c][f0ff23]Darth Revan[-][/c] has returned to crush the Republic and defeat the Jedi once and for all. Darth Revan is a powerful Leader who ruthlessly drives a team with a new debuff, [c][f0ff23]Ferocity[-][/c], which sacrifices Defense in favor of more Offense. Darth Revan is particularly adept at defeating enemy Leaders while striking a new debuff, [c][f0ff23]Fear[-][/c], into the hearts of enemies.

Are you ready to face the Old Republic with Darth Revan? You will need the following characters in the event:

-Bastila Shan (Fallen)
-Canderous Ordo
-Carth Onasi
-HK-47
-Juhani

Bundles and an event pack will be available for the characters above to help you prepare for this rare event.
data.NEWSLETTER_DARTH_REVAN_TITLE: Are you Ready to Claim the Sith Throne?
data.NEWSLETTER_DARTH_TALON_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

The fearsome Twi’lek assassin, [c][F0FF23]Darth Talon[-][/c], is bringing her unshakable Sith loyalty to the holotables! Darth Talon’s devotion to her master was as fierce as her skills in combat. Darth Talon was immersed within the dark side of the Force, and now she stands ready to fight alongside the Sith in Galaxy of Heroes.

Darth Talon strengthens her fellow Sith and makes them particularly powerful in Grand Arenas, where her Omicron increases her attacking power and heals Sith allies. Darth Talon’s commitment to the Sith is on full display as she sacrifices Health to keep allied Sith leaders alive via her Unique, [c][F0FF23]Proven Loyalty[-][/c]. She also brings the new effect “[c][F0FF23]Loyal Hand[-][/c]” to the game, which increases her Protection and Offense.

Make Darth Talon part of your Sith faction by unlocking her through an all-new marquee event!
data.NEWSLETTER_DARTH_VADER_DUELS_END_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

[c][F0FF23]Darth Vader (Duel's End)[-][/c] is coming to the Holotables!

Years after their battle on Mustafar, Obi-Wan Kenobi and the Sith Lord Darth Vader dueled once again. This battle saw Kenobi eventually overwhelm his former Padawan, but didn’t have it in him to take Anakin’s life. The man behind the now-battled damaged mask was quick to point out that the person who killed Anakin Skywalker was not Obi-Wan, but himself.

Vader's Basic ability, [c][F0FF23]Then You Will Die[-][/c], inflicts Ability Block and punishes enemies suffering from control debuffs by reducing his cooldowns and dramatically increasing his Offense. His first Special ability, [c][F0FF23]Your Weakness Still Remains[-][/c], calls an Attacker ally to assist, with Vader joining in when facing his former allies from the Galactic Republic, Jedi, or Inquisitorius, and guarantees Vader critically hits. [c][F0FF23]You Will Always Lose[-][/c], his second Special ability, strips buffs from all enemies before devastating them with damage that scales with debuffs, and cripples them with Speed Down and Accuracy reduction. With his Omicron active in Grand Arenas and Emperor Palpatine leading, this ability can Fracture multiple enemies.

Vader's first Unique ability, [c][F0FF23]I Am What Remains[-][/c], represents his constant suffering as he begins battle Burning and losing Health, but transforms that pain into power by granting all Empire allies stacking Offense whenever he takes Burning damage, in battles without any Galactic Legends. When paired with Emperor Palpatine as Leader, Vader gains Hatred and assists whenever Palpatine assists or uses Special abilities. His Grand Arenas Omicron (in battles without any Galactic Legends) spreads Hatred to all Empire allies and provides additional Speed stacking. His final ability, [c][F0FF23]You Didn't Kill Anakin Skywalker, I Did[-][/c], allows Vader to accumulate stacks of Vengeance throughout battle, eventually granting him bonus turns and inflicting Deathmark. He also ignores Taunt on his turns, applies Damage Over Time with his Special abilities, and utterly Demoralizes any enemy Anakin Skywalker he faces.

Unlock Darth Vader (Duel's End) in the upcoming [c][F0FF23]"WHAT REMAINS"[-][/c] Marquee event that [c][F0FF23]gives out daily rewards[-][/c] for the duration of the event! Darth Vader (Duel's End) is also one of the requirements (initially at 6 stars) to the final Tiers of the event for Maul (Hate-Fueled). To enter Tier III of the Maul event, Darth Vader (Duel's End) will need to be Era Level 75 or higher.
data.NEWSLETTER_DASH_RENDAR_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

Galaxy of Heroes is celebrating the 50th anniversary of LucasFilm with several new units from Legends! First up, the renown smuggler [c][F0FF23]Dash Rendar[-][/c]! This Scoundrel might be best known for the hefty 19-96 Kinetic Absorption Panels on his shoulders but, Dash has done everything from training to be an officer at the Imperial Academy when he was younger to becoming a master pilot while exploring the Outer Rim of the galaxy to even helping the Rebellion overthrow the Empire.

As a Scoundrel leader, Dash enhances his squad when they have the [c][F0FF23]Prepared[-][/c] buff. His Leader ability, [c][F0FF23]Prepared for Anything[-][/c], grants his Scoundrel allies additional bonuses based on their role while they have Prepared, and while in Grand Arena Championships, this ability allows allies to immediately regain Prepared if they lose it.

Unlock Dash Rendar in the new Marquee event, [i]Shadows Of The Empire[/i], and prepare for the culmination of our 50th anniversary celebration, [c][F0FF23]Starkiller's[-][/c] upcoming Legacy event!
data.NEWSLETTER_DASH_RENDAR_TITLE: In The Shadow Of The Empire
data.NEWSLETTER_DATA_CARD_PACK_CHANGES_DESC: We've heard your feedback! We have replaced the 1x and 10x Chromium and Aurodium packs with a 1x, 4x, and 8x Chromium Pack that contains ONLY characters and character shards! While we will no longer be giving away a free Chromium data card every few days, these new card choices give you a larger range of character specific options for collection and progression.
data.NEWSLETTER_DATACRON_SET_10_DESC: Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\nDatacron set 10, [c][F0FF23]Steadfast Resolve[-][/c], has different relic requirements than usual. The three levels of investment required to use the set are Relic 1, 3, and 5 (instead of the usual 3, 5, and 7). This is for this set and not necessarily all datacron sets moving forward.
data.NEWSLETTER_DATACRON_SET4_DESC: Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\nStarting with Datacron set 4, [c][F0FF23]Security Primer[-][/c], we are slowing down the release cadence for Datacrons in order to provide more time for players to unlock and digest the impact of each set of Datacrons to their roster. A new Datacron set will be releasing once every two months and each set will last four months. This also means there will only be 2 sets of Datacrons live at any given time instead of 3, making it easier to discover how all current Datacrons interact with each other and further reducing the overall complexity.
data.NEWSLETTER_DATACRONS_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

Today's Title Update introduces a new feature [c][F0FF23]Datacrons[-][/c]! Datacrons are a unique way to upgrade your entire squad with special temporary bonuses in Grand Arena Championships and Territory Wars. Each Set of Datacrons focus on a number of factions or characters and brings those squads to the next level with powerful abilities and stat boosts. New Sets of Datacrons will roll out regularly, and during any given month, there will be up to three different Sets of Datacrons live each with their own combination of perks.

The Exhibition for Datacrons is live now! Get Datacrons and upgrade materials from Conquest, Shipments and Territory Wars along with special Login Calendars with everything you need to get started!

See you on the Holotables!
data.NEWSLETTER_DEATH_TROOPER_PERIDEA_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

[c][F0FF23]Death Trooper (Peridea)[-][/c] is coming to the Holotables!

With their tanks and their bombs and their bombs and their guns, the Imperial Remnant stranded on Peridea were a tenacious group that proved difficult to keep down. Resurrected via the Great Mothers’ Majik, the Death Troopers on Peridea proved to be just as formidable as their Imperial counterparts, and were known for using any means necessary to bring down their target, including their teeth if the opportunity presented itself.

Death Trooper (Peridea) synergizes well with the [c][F0FF23]Blight[-][/c] effect introduced by Night Trooper, with both of these characters working well together on ideally an Imperial Remnant squad led by the upcoming [c][E7E7E7]Captain Enoch[-][/c] or alternatively with Nightsisters. Special ability, [c][F0FF23]Necrotic Tissue[-][/c], inflicts Tenacity Down on all enemies to help important debuffs land, and Unique ability, [c][F0FF23]In Your Head[-][/c], provides Turn Meter to Death Trooper (Peridea) when Blight is applied.

With an Omicron upgrade in the Territory Wars game mode, Special ability [c][F0FF23]Just a Little Nibble[-][/c] will [c][F0FF23]Siphon Critical Damage[-][/c] from the target enemy. Additionally, Basic ability [c][F0FF23]Firing by Rote[-][/c] and Necrotic Tissue will gain extra effects so Death Trooper (Peridea) can gain Siphon stacks to make these nibbles really chomp.

With this update, Imperial TIE Fighter pilot also receives the Imperial Remnant tag.

Unlock Death Trooper (Peridea) in the upcoming “UNDYING LEGION II” Marquee event that [c][E7E7E7]gives out daily rewards[-][/c] for the duration of the event and prepare for the upcoming [c][E7E7E7]Galactic Legend Ahsoka Tano[-][/c]!
data.NEWSLETTER_DENGAR_DESC: Dengar is the daily login character for June! Log in every day this month to earn enough character Shards to unlock this crude and slovenly bounty hunter.
data.NEWSLETTER_DEPA_BILABA_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

[c][F0FF23]Depa Billaba[-][/c] joins the holotables!

A former member of the Jedi Council, Depa Billaba was a practitioner of the aggressive Vaapad lightsaber form under the tutelage of Mace Windu. Her mastery of this technique allowed her to channel her inner darkness into strength, making her a formidable warrior. As the Jedi Master of Kanan Jarrus, (then known as Caleb Dume), she famously taught him “Nothing… and Everything” unknowingly preparing him for a galaxy where the Jedi are hunted to near extinction.

Depa's Basic ability, [c][F0FF23]Serene Blade[-][/c], deals Physical damage and, when used on her turn, inflicts Vulnerable on the target. Her first Special, [c][F0FF23]Vaapad Disciple[-][/c], inflicts Healing Immunity and deals impressive damage, while granting her Health Steal Up. If Jedi Master Mace Windu is the Leader, Depa calls him to assist twice while dealing even more damage.

[c][F0FF23]Will of the Council[-][/c], Depa's second Special, has potent effects if Jedi Master Mace Windu is leading the squad. It dispels enemy buffs, and helps Mace with his Investigation mechanic (see the Jedi Master Mace Windu kit for more on Investigation). Additionally, she interacts with Shatterpoint, consuming it for extra damage and then re-applying it so others can also take advantage of this potent debuff.

Depa's Unique ability, [c][F0FF23]Nothing and Everything[-][/c], provides offense and sustain, recovering Health and Protection whenever she is debuffed. With a full Jedi Vanguard team, she is constantly vigilant. If an unrevealed enemy happens to be defeated with stacks of Investigation, she helps the squad by giving them a head start when a new Investigation target gains stacks.

In Territory Battles, Jedi Vanguards gain massive stats and support mechanics that feed into constant Turn Meter gain and even Damage Immunity when they defeat an enemy.

Depa Billaba is a required unit for unlocking Jedi Master Mace Windu, so you’ll want to unlock Depa in the upcoming [c][E7E7E7]"TWILIGHT OF THE JEDI II"[-][/c] Marquee event. The Marquee event [c][E7E7E7]gives out daily rewards[-][/c] for the duration of the event!
data.NEWSLETTER_DISGUISED_CLONE_TROOPER_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

The [c][F0FF23]Disguised Clone Trooper[-][/c] is sneaking onto the Holotables!

In the aftermath of Order 66, Clone Troopers in disguised Jedi robes were deployed to eliminate any Jedi survivors returning to the Temple on Coruscant. Highly trained in ambush operations, these clones would take down unsuspecting Jedi before they got close enough to uncover their ruse.

The key to Disguised Clone Trooper's kit is the effect [c][F0FF23]Ruse[-][/c]. If he starts his turn while Stealthed, he gains Ruse until the end of that turn, triggering additional effects in his abilities. [c][F0FF23]Covert Assault[-][/c], his Basic, can Stun the enemy if he has Ruse. If the enemy is already Stunned or Ability Blocked and he has Lord Vader and/or other Dark Side Clone Troopers as allies, Disguised Clone Trooper dispels the target’s buffs and inflicts the [c][F0FF23]Order 66[-][/c] debuff.

His Special ability, [c][F0FF23]Well-Executed Ambush[-][/c], is an area attack gaining boosted damage from Damage Over Time and Ruse. It grants Dark Side Clones Advantage and has unique effects versus enemies with various tags- slowing Galactic Republic, reducing Jedi's offense, and preventing Light Side enemies from recovering Health.

[c][F0FF23]Clever Ruse[-][/c], his first Unique, revolves around Stealth mechanics. When Stealthed, at the start of his turn, he recovers Health and Protection and gains bonus Turn Meter. If he’s Stealthed, he gains Tenacity Up versus Jedi, and Dark Side Clone allies all gain Retribution when the enemy takes a turn. With the Omicron in the Territory Wars game mode, Ruse no longer expires and defeating enemies who had Order 66 gives a bonus turn to him, Lord Vader, and the rest of his Dark Side Clone squad.

Finally, [c][F0FF23]Decoy Squad Five[-][/c] gives offensive boosts and possible Stealth against the Galactic Republic. If he lacks Ruse, Disguised Clone Trooper can re-Stealth each turn. When Zeta'd, he deals Massive damage to any Order 66 target, with extra damage to Jedi and Light Side Unaligned Force Users based on his Relic Amplifier level.

Unlock the Disguised Clone Trooper in the upcoming [c][E7E7E7]"Executing Orders III"[-][/c] Marquee event that [c][E7E7E7]gives out daily rewards[-][/c]!
data.NEWSLETTER_DOCTOR_APHRA_DESC:
[c][F0FF23]Doctor Aphra[-][/c] has arrived to the holotables!

Aphra's doctorate may be in archaeology but her true passion is treasure hunting. An unpredictable nature leads her on chaotic adventures in which she must use her wits and inventions to come out on top (most of the time). From Darth Vader to Luke Skywalker, Aphra's colleagues have run the gamut, but her trusty droids have never let her down. Okay, there was that one time 0-0-0 and BT-1 led a crime syndicate on Son-Tuul and blackmailed her into serving them. But who's counting?

Aphra and her droids like debuffs, so she can siphon Potency from enemies and do damage based on her Potency with her special abilities [c][F0FF23]Dangerous Tech[-][/c] and [c][F0FF23]Rogue Archaeology[-][/c]. Her Leader ability [c][F0FF23]Suspended Doctorate[-][/c] and Unique ability [c][F0FF23]Droid Savant[-][/c] provide her with opening Turn Meter as well as Speed for her droids. Furthermore, they will also gain Turn Meter when they are critically hit or inflict a debuff, so they waste no time in their quest for destruction.

Her Omicron abilities are active in 5v5 Grand Arenas to complement her droids' Omicrons in 3v3 Grand Arenas so that the squad can exact a plethora of domination in that game mode. While her Omicrons are active she does even more damage based on her Potency, grants extra Speed and Turn Meter to herself and her droids, can protect her droids with Damage Immunity when they fall too low on Health, and exacts quick revenge by inflicting a slew of Damage Over Times for each relic level they have if they are defeated.

Add Doctor Aphra to your roster in the all new "ROGUE ARCHAEOLOGIST" Legacy Event. Create mayhem with her and her droids that will long be remembered!
data.NEWSLETTER_DOOKU_NUTE_DESC:
[i]"I'm not a traitor. I was never on your side. I'm called the enemy."[/i] - Count Dooku

As Darth Sidious finalized his plans for galactic domination, Count Dooku and Nute Gunray were executing their own dark machinations. On the holotables, [c][F0FF23]Nute Gunray’s[-][/c] reworked kit can manipulate the enemy team by granting his opponents a new ability, [c][F0FF23]Extortion[-][/c], which enables Nute to barter and cheat his way to victory in the name of the Trade Federation.

[c][F0FF23]Count Dooku[-][/c] will also be getting a rework in this update. With his new ability, [c][F0FF23]Master of Makashi[-][/c], Dooku leverages the ancient lightsaber form to [c][F0FF23]Riposte[-][/c] flawlessly. He will continue to punish opponents with deadly counter attacks while Shocking them into submission.

These two Separatists continue to foster dissent for the Republic and are secretly provoking the ultimate war between the two sides!
data.NEWSLETTER_DOOKU_NUTE_TITLE: We’d Be Happy to Receive the Ambassadors…
data.NEWSLETTER_DOUBLE_DROPS_PIRATE_KING_NAME: I Smell Profit! Triple Drops Await
data.NEWSLETTER_DOUBLE_DROPS_PIRATE_KING_SUMM:
If one drop is good, two are better, and three, well, that's just good business.

For a limited time, all Light Side Battles, Dark Side Battles, Mod Battles, Cantina Battles, and Fleet Battles will feature [b]DOUBLE DROPS[/b] for [b]24 HOURS[/b] on 09/20 and [b]TRIPLE DROPS[/b] for [b]24 HOURS[/b] on 09/21.

To claim this bounty, you’ll need the one and only [b]Pirate King Hondo Ohnaka[/b], unlocked and ready. Only he holds the key to this fortune!

Don’t let the galaxy’s profits slip away.
data.NEWSLETTER_DROID_BRAINS_CANTINA_DESC: For a limited time, Droid Brains have been added to Cantina Battle nodes as bonus drops! During this event, the drop rate on each node has been scaled to Cantina Energy.\n\nCantina Battles are rewarding bonus drops from 08/19/2023 through 08/22/2023.
data.NEWSLETTER_DROID_BRAINS_CANTINA_TITLE: Droid Brains are available on Cantina Battle nodes!
data.NEWSLETTER_DROID_SMUGGLING_2017_MESSAGE: Log in every Tuesday in January for the [c][FFD700]TRAINING DROID SMUGGLING[-][/c] event!\n\nGather a group of Scoundrels to steal a rival smuggler’s shipment of Training Droids. With 4 tiers of difficulty and rewards to choose from it might not be easy, but a successful heist today could mean the difference between victory or defeat tomorrow!
data.NEWSLETTER_DROID_SMUGGLING_2017_TITLE: Droid Smuggling Event Every Tuesday in January!
data.NEWSLETTER_DROID_SMUGGLING_MESSAGE: A new limited time event is here, [c][FFD700]TRAINING DROID SMUGGLING[-][/c]. Gather a group of Scoundrels and get ready to steal a rival smuggler’s shipment of Training Droids. Help your crew prepare for future missions now by taking on this event. With 4 tiers of difficulty and rewards to choose from it might not be easy, but a successful heist today could mean the difference between victory or defeat tomorrow.
data.NEWSLETTER_DROIDEKA_DESC:
[c][F0FF23]General Grievous[-][/c], the leader of the Separatist Droid army, has been upgraded with more than just a couple extra arms. His hatred for the Jedi Order drives him to victory at any cost, even if it means exploiting and sacrificing his Droid allies. In his newly reworked kit, Grievous now deals much of his damage based on his Max Health and he’s terrifying to fight against as he skitters across the battleground toward you.

Accompanying General Grievous’ changes is the rework of his electrostaff-wielding bodyguard, the [c][F0FF23]IG-100 MagnaGuard[-][/c]. This disruptive Droid Tank constantly Taunts and takes an extra turn before it is defeated. Its kit has been given a new Special ability and an updated Unique that boosts the survivability of both himself and General Grievous.

To complete the Droid Separatist team, the iconic [c][F0FF23]Droideka[-][/c] rolls onto the holotables! With twin blasters and a personal deflector shield, this destructive Droid Attacker punishes fast enemies and is a serious nuisance for the Jedi. Once in position, good luck punching through the Droideka’s shields with anything less than a cannon. Even then, the Droideka has the speed to evade or [c][F0FF23]Charge[-][/c] its enemies.

[c][F0FF23]The Droideka event, bundle, and packs unlock for players at level 60![-][/c]
data.NEWSLETTER_DROIDS_FIGHT_BACK_ANNOUNCEMEN:
Google Play Exclusive! 

It’s time for the Droids to fight back against the Jawas! No longer will they be sold for parts.

In this special event, you will face off against a team of 3 Jawas and will be required to have at least 3 Droids for your squad to battle them. The first Tier of the event will require your Droids to be 2-star, the second tier 4-star and the final tier 6-star.

The rewards for defeating the Jawas will be ability materials, droid character Shards and the chance to obtain the all-NEW 7-star Training Droid to level up your characters.

Be sure to collect your free Data Card each day during the event from the Store to obtain additional Credits and Training Droids to power-up your characters!
data.NEWSLETTER_DROIDS_FIGHT_BACK_EVENT_2017_: The Droids are back for a limited time to continue their fight against the Jawas! No longer will they be sold for parts.\n\nIn this event, you will face off against Jawas and will be required to have at least 3 Droids for your squad to battle them. Strategically use the new Repair Protocol power in this event only to help lead your droids to freedom! Earn training droids, xp, and character shards as you battle your way through the Jawa forces!
data.NEWSLETTER_DROIDS_FIGHT_BACK_EVENT_DESC:
Now for ALL Players! The Droids are back for a limited time to continue their fight against the Jawas! No longer will they be sold for parts. 

In this special event, you will face off against Jawas and will be required to have at least 3 Droids for your squad to battle them. There are now multiple tiers of the event, with a special version at level 80 to test your droids against multiple battles with Jawas. Strategically use the new Repair Protocol power in this event only to help lead your droids to freedom! 

Earn training droids, xp, and character shards as you battle your way through the Jawa forces, including the rare seven star training droids!
data.NEWSLETTER_EA_PLAY_TO_GIVE_DESC:
Celebrate giving back by playing our special 3-day event! EA will be making a contribution to charity in honor of you during this limited time event. So go ahead and Play to Give!

In order to participate you will need to be at least level 25 and have a squad of all female characters. You will have 5 attempts per day to battle across the galaxy against droids. Win and you'll not only be celebrating giving back but also earning credits and character shards.

So gear up and join others as we Play to Give!
data.NEWSLETTER_EA_STARWARS_TWITTER_DESC: Want the latest info while you can’t be in the game? Follow the official EA Star Wars Twitter account to be instantly notified of new characters, events, features and more.
data.NEWSLETTER_EBON_HAWK_DESC:
The [c][F0FF23]Ebon Hawk[-][/c] had many owners before it landed in the hands of a local crime lord named Davik Kang, but its most notable accomplishments come from the time with its next owner…

Piloted by Carth Onasi and T3-M4, the Ebon Hawk is a durable and potent reinforcement for any fleet scouring the galaxy for the location of the Star Forge, and this Dynamic-class freighter synergizes especially well with other Cargo ships. The new buff, [c][F0FF23]Chaff[-][/c], wreaks havoc by disrupting the enemy’s ability to Target Lock allies.

Starting March 8th, Ebon Hawk blueprints will be available as bonus rewards on all Fleet Battles nodes for a limited time!

Check out the forums for more details and see you on the holotables!
data.NEWSLETTER_ECHO_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes!

[c][F0FF23]Echo[-][/c] of Clone Force 99 has joined the Holotables! Echo started off as a clone trooper that liked to stick to the rules and do things by the book. He earned his nickname by compulsively repeating his orders and regulations but was captured in a daring raid on the Citadel and thought to be lost forever.

His comrade and commanding officer, Captain Rex, never had any doubt that he would survive and later found Echo captured and modified by the Separatists to provide clone battle strategies to the droid army. Once Echo was rescued from this terrible fate, his knowledge of the Separatist forces helped his squad stay [c][F0FF23]One Step Ahead[-][/c]. His Special ability, One Step Ahead, weakens his enemies, and increases target enemy's cooldowns by 1 if he also targets a Bad Batch ally. After recovering from his ordeal, Echo was no longer the clone trooper he used to be and joined the ranks of the Bad Batch as a trusted and unique member of Clone Force 99.

Unlock Echo in the all new Marquee event: [c][F0FF23]Clone Force 99 IV[-][/c]
data.NEWSLETTER_ECHO_TITLE: Your path is different, like ours.
data.NEWSLETTER_EIGHTH_BROTHER_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

[c][F0FF23]Eighth Brother[-][/c], a Terrelian Jango Jumper who once served the Jedi Order and later became a member of the Inquisitorius, is coming to the holotables! Eighth Brother tussled with Kanan Jarrus and hunted down enemies of the Empire before meeting his ultimate fate at the hands of Maul.

Staying on theme for the Inquisitorius faction, Eighth Brother makes use of the Purge debuff. It is worth noting that he can consume stacks of Purge to do extra damage and inflict Jedi enemies with a variety of debuffs. Eighth Brother has a plethora of ways to give him an edge in battle, be it by consuming Stealth to give himself buffs or inflicting foes with Accuracy Down, Blind, or Burning.

His Omicron Leader ability gives the Inquisitorius a boost in Territory Wars, where he causes all enemies to lose Max Health whenever a Jedi gains Taunt from a Unique ability, and can dispel Critical Hit Immunity from Jedi and inflict them with Vulnerable.

Add Eighth Brother to your roster by unlocking him in the all-new “[c][F0FF23]RUTHLESS EFFICIENCY IV[-][/c]” Marquee event, and prove your worth to the Empire!
data.NEWSLETTER_ELITE_COMBAT_EVENT_DESC:
Introducing an all-new, three part Event, ELITE COMBAT! In the first of three Events, head to Chopper Base as you team up with the Imperial Super Commando. The adventure continues at The Mandalorian Outpost as you fight alongside the ruthless Gar Saxon of Clan Vizsla to neutralize the growing Rebel threat.

The final Event gives players the opportunity to take the Gauntlet Starfighter into battle above Concord Dawn. Elite Combat unlocks at Level 20 and each event has four tiers of difficulty for levels 20, 40, 60, and 80. There are no restrictions on the characters you may put in your Squad, so be sure to bring your most powerful characters.

With the Super Commando and Imperial Viceroy of Mandalore at your side, do you have what it takes to bring glory to the Empire?
data.NEWSLETTER_EMBO_DESC: Bounty Hunters are back with a mysterious new mercenary that's ready for hire!\n\nIdentifiable by his distinct hat and renowned as one of the most skilled bounty hunters of all time, Embo is capable of assassinating even the most well protected targets. His combination of advanced fighting skills and relentless pursuit of his quarry makes him a terrifying pursuer.
data.NEWSLETTER_EMBO_TITLE_V2: New Bounty Hunter In Search Of Contracts
data.NEWSLETTER_EMPEROR_LUKE_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

[c][F0FF23]Sith Eternal Emperor[-][/c] and [c][F0FF23]Jedi Master Luke Skywalker[-][/c] will soon be joining the Holotables! Transform your roster with these Galactic Legends in their ultimate forms. Which path will you choose to lead your squad to victory?

Luke Skywalker started as a humble farm boy dreaming of bigger things and went on to become one of the most renowned Jedi to ever live. Rising to the rank of Jedi Master, Luke’s strong connection with the Force enabled him to overcome seemingly impossible challenges and solidified him as a legend.

Surrounded by mystery, the dark side has its own share of powerful Force users capable of incredible feats. Perhaps none are more feared than the Sith Eternal Emperor, whose mastery of the Force gave him access to abilities that some consider to be unnatural. Through years of deception, this dark lord was secretly planning to ensure the Sith rule for all time.

Just like the previous Galactic Legends, both can be viewed in the Journey Guide prior to their release. The first group of requirements are available now on the forums and in the Journey Guide. Watch the forums for the next group of requirements to unlock Sith Eternal Emperor and Jedi Master Luke Skywalker, and fulfill your destiny with two of the galaxy’s most powerful icons!
data.NEWSLETTER_EMPEROR_LUKE_EVENT_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

Galactic Legend [c][F0FF23]Jedi Master Luke Skywalker[-][/c] and [c][F0FF23]Sith Eternal Emperor[-][/c] are now available! You can find a complete list of the requirements to unlock either event in the Journey Guide. Both of these Galactic Legends have a unique transformation that powers them up to their Ultimate form. Will you choose to seek out the light side and assist the Jedi or fall to the dark side and be deceived by the allure of unlimited power?

Fighting for the light side and defending against the rising Sith menace is Luke Skywalker, a skilled teacher and Jedi Master, but few have been able to find him since he went into exile. Those who manage to locate him can learn the [c][F0FF23]Jedi Lessons[-][/c] and benefit from his [c][F0FF23]Inherited Teachings[-][/c]. Jedi Master Luke Skywalker can share his training with other Jedi in your squad and charge Luke's Ultimate whenever a Jedi ally gains Jedi Lessons. Once powered up, Luke uses his powers of Force projection to assist his squad and upgrade their lessons to the [c][F0FF23]Jedi Legacy[-][/c].

On the dark side, Sith Eternal Emperor has always been pulling the strings from behind the scenes. The Emperor gains power by [c][F0FF23]Deceiving[-][/c] his enemies, which prevents them from targeting Sith Eternal Emperor and charges his Ultimate transformation. After years of practicing the ways of the Sith, Palpatine has mastered the art of twisting the destiny of his foes and can entwine the fate of his enemies to provide himself the advantage. Once the Sith Eternal Emperor has transformed and becomes Restored, he can use his unlimited power to [c][F0FF23]Unravel the Destiny[-][/c] of his adversaries and crush all who oppose him.

Choose your path with the Force wisely and unlock these exciting new characters!

See you on the Holotables!
data.NEWSLETTER_EMPEROR_LUKE_EVENT_TITLE: A Jedi Master In Exile And The Return Of Sith Menace
data.NEWSLETTER_EMPERORPALPATINE_MYTHIC_DESC:
This month the Holotable grows darker with a new dark side Mythic event and character reworks.

Gather your Rebels and face Emperor Palpatine, or join forces with the Emperor and crush the Rebels in this new multi-tier Mythic event targeted at elder players. Succeed and earn rare rewards befitting a master of the Holotable.

Alongside this new Legendary Event, Emperor Palpatine and Darth Vader have seen various updates to their abilities!

Emperor Palpatine's [c][F0FF23]POWER OF THE DARK SIDE[-][/c] grants Offense Up on the final upgrade. [c][F0FF23]LET THE HATE FLOW[-][/c] grants Health Steal Up instead of Offense Up on the final upgrade. The new Zeta, [c][F0FF23]EMPEROR OF THE GALACTIC EMPIRE[-][/c], gives Empire and Sith allies Turn Meter when a debuff on an enemy expires. Finally, [c][F0FF23]CRACKLING DOOM[-][/c]'s new Zeta grants the Emperor Max Protection as well as additional Max Protection when he inflicts shock until the end of an encounter!

Darth Vader has gained a new Unique ability, [c][F0FF23]NO ESCAPE[-][/c]. This terrifying new ability gives Darth Vader additional speed at the start of each encounter for each Empire ally, Sith ally, Jedi enemy, and Rebel enemy. The Zeta of this new ability makes Darth Vader immune to Turn Meter reduction and he recovers Health after Damage Over Time effects on his enemies expire.

Rule the galaxy with fear and tyranny by adding these characters to your Squad today!
data.NEWSLETTER_EMPERORS_END:
The dark side is rising.

Assemble your Rebel squad and find out what it takes to complete the new [c][f0ff23]EMPEROR'S DEMISE[-][/c] event!

Join the battle and Seven Star the infamous leader of the Galactic Senate, Emperor Palpatine.
data.NEWSLETTER_EMPERORS_END_RETURNS:
The dark side is rising.

Get your Rebel squad ready for the [c][f0ff23]EMPEROR'S DEMISE[-][/c] event, returning December 23rd.

Join the battle and Seven Star the infamous leader of the Galactic Senate, Emperor Palpatine!
data.NEWSLETTER_EMPERORS_SHUTTLE_DESC:
We are introducing [c][F0FF23]Galactic Chase[-][/c], a new type of event! During a Galactic Chase, you can earn shards or blueprints for a new character or ship by playing a particular type of node (hard, Dark Side, Cantina, Fleet, etc.). These shards or blueprints will be bonus rewards, which means you don’t have to interrupt your regular play!

Starting on February 8th, blueprints for the [c][F0FF23]EMPEROR’S SHUTTLE[-][/c] will be available as a bonus reward on any Fleet Battles node for the following 5 days! Crewed by the Emperor himself and his Royal Guard, this versatile Dark Side Support ship boosts Empire and Sith allies' survivability while debuffing enemies. Head over to the Fleet Battles holotable and start earning this iconic ship!

Check out the forums for more details on this new event.
data.NEWSLETTER_EMPIRE_ASSAULT_EVENT_DESC_V3: Assault Battle: Military Might returns this weekend!\n\nBuild a party of Rebels and/or Clones and fight the Empire to earn credits, shards for empire characters, and piles of salvage. Pay special attention to the enemies you are facing in this very difficult challenge.
data.NEWSLETTER_EMPIRE_FACTION_DESC:
The EMPIRE is always formulating new strategies to crush the Rebel threat. General Veers is the Daily Login for May and heads the charge with a new EMPIRE faction rework introducing the "IMPERIAL TROOPER" faction!

With the addition of the new "IMPERIAL TROOPER" faction, debuting this month, Troopers will share a variety of unique abilities and advantages becoming a much more formidable force. General Veers can bring the full might of his Troopers to bear on the filthy Rebel scum with his incredible Trooper synergies. Collect General Veers and his cadre of Troopers to lead the assault on your Holotable adventures today!

For a full breakdown of all the changes, please refer to our forum post linked below: https://forums.galaxy-of-heroes.starwars.ea.com/discussion/105540/empire-faction-pass/
data.NEWSLETTER_ENDURANCE_TOUCHUP_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

The Galactic Republic Capital Ship [c][F0FF23]Endurance[-][/c] has received a rework to its kit! Commanded by Mace Windu, Endurance has a new suite of freshly upgraded abilities and is the cornerstone of a Clone Trooper focused Galactic Republic fleet.

With a greater emphasis on [c][F0FF23]Valor[-][/c], the updated Endurance fleet has much improved offensive and defensive capabilities. Endurance’s Unique now grants additional Defense and Offense for each allied Galactic Republic ship deployed at the start of battle (including the Capital Ship) and Valor also reduces the offensive capabilities of the enemy when attacking Clone Trooper ships. The upgraded Ultimate ability, [c][F0FF23]Convergence[-][/c], now grants your allies with Valor a bonus turn and calls your allies and itself to assist.

Take the helm of the reworked Endurance right now and lead the Clones to victory!
data.NEWSLETTER_ERA_BATTLES_ERA_OF_ANNIV_SUMM:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

[c][F0FF23]Era Battles[-][/c] are back!

We have two exciting Era Battles coming to you during the next Era! They are meant to test your Era of Anniversary units now that they have graduated to Legacy status. Each Era battle challenges a different sub-set of the characters, with the rewards being identical between the two, giving you twice as many opportunities to earn these fantastic rewards.

We start with Dark Decimation, which uses IG-90, Asajj Ventress (Dark Disciple), and Darth Vader (Duel’s End). Entry into each tier requires various levels of investment, ranging from 2-Stars all the way to Relic 9 and even Relic 10 for the best rewards. In order to enter and play Tiers 3 and higher of the event you will need to have unlocked Maul (Hate-Fueled). Maul can be brought into the fights in the upper tiers of this half of the event.

Next will come Light Liberation, which has the same entry requirements as Dark Decimation, only on a different set of characters: Stormtrooper Luke, Yoda & Chewie, and Inquisitor Barriss. While Maul (Hate-Fueled) will be required to enter Tiers 3 and higher of the event, but he will not be a playable unit.

The requirements and rewards for each tier in both events are as follows:

Playable characters (Dark Decimation): Maul (Hate-Fueled), IG-90, Asajj Ventress (Dark Disciple), Darth Vader (Duel’s End)

Playable characters (Light Liberation): Stormtrooper Luke, Yoda & Chewie, Inquisitor Barriss.

Tier 1
Entry: Owning 1 or more characters from the playable characters
Rewards:
5x Omega Materials
7x IG-90, Asajj Ventress (Dark Disciple), or Darth Vader (Duel's End) shards (For Dark Decimation)
7x Stormtrooper Luke, Yoda & Chewie, or Inquisitor Barriss shards (For Light Liberation)
1M Credits

Tier 2
Entry: Owning 1 or more characters from the playable characters at 4*
Rewards:
7x Omega Materials
7-10x IG-90, Asajj Ventress (Dark Disciple), or Darth Vader (Duel's End) shards (For Dark Decimation)
7-10x Stormtrooper Luke, Yoda & Chewie, or Inquisitor Barriss shards (For Light Liberation)
2M Credits

Tier 3
Entry: Owning Maul (Hate-Fueled) at 4 stars
Rewards:
10-15x IG-90, Asajj Ventress (Dark Disciple), or Darth Vader (Duel's End) shards (For Dark Decimation)
10-15x Stormtrooper Luke, Yoda & Chewie, or Inquisitor Barriss shards (For Light Liberation)
15-30x ArmaTek Salvage
10-15x Gear XII (Purple) Salvage (Excluding Mk 4 Zaltin Bacta Gel Salvage)
10-15x Kyrotech Salvage

Tier 4
Entry: Owning Maul (Hate-Fueled) at 5 stars
Rewards:
30x Fragment Signal Data
100x Carbonite Circuit Boards
5x Zeta Materials
OR
25x Incomplete Signal Data
100x Bronzium Wiring
5x Zeta Materials

Tier 5
Entry: Owning Maul (Hate-Fueled) at 6 stars
Rewards:
25x Flawed Signal Data 
50x Chromium Transistor
50x Aurodium Heatsink
200x Crystals
OR
25x Flawed Signal Data
15x Zinbiddle Cards
200 Crystals

Tier 6
Entry: Owning Maul (Hate-Fueled) at Relic 6
Rewards:
15x Impulse Detectors OR Aeromagnifiers
300 Crystals

Tier 7
Entry: Owning Maul (Hate-Fueled) at Relic 9
Rewards:
5-10x Gyrda Keypads OR Droid Brains
5x Omicron Materials
500 Crystals

Tier 8
Entry: Owning Maul (Hate-Fueled) at Relic 10, all other playable characters at Relic 9
Rewards:
5x Gyrda Keypads
5x Droid Brains 
5x Coaxial Servomotor
1000 Crystals
data.NEWSLETTER_ERA_OF_ANDOR_SUMMARY:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

[c][F0FF23]Era of Andor[-][/c] is coming to the Holotables!

The critically acclaimed series on Disney+, Andor, gave us thrilling and exciting moments over both seasons, and we’re dedicated to bringing you the best that Star Wars has to offer, so we’re adding seven characters straight from the show to the game over the next three months.

Luthen Rael was the first character we brought to Galaxy of Heroes, and that character continues to play a large role in the Rebel Fighter squad in the Era. Additionally, we are bringing in three powerhouses to rise against the Empire: Kleya, Vel, and Cinta.

Our first Marquee release is [c][F0FF23]Kleya[-][/c]. Kleya was Luthen’s partner on Coruscant, and handled communications with Rebel cells and agents via a fractal radio. She works great by Luthen’s side, as well as the other Rebel Fighters in the Era.

The second and third Marquee characters are [c][F0FF23]Vel[-][/c] and [c][F0FF23]Cinta[-][/c]. This dynamic duo stole our hearts (as well as each other’s) and they have incredibly strong synergy with one another, each gaining bonuses based off of things happening to the other.

A brand new sub-faction then comes with the fourth Marquee character, [c][F0FF23]Dedra Meero[-][/c]. The [c][F0FF23]ISB[-][/c] (short for Imperial Security Bureau) also includes the fifth and sixth Marquee units: [c][F0FF23]Major Partagaz[-][/c] and the [c][F0FF23]KX Security Droid[-][/c], with brand new and unique buffs and effects to emphasize their efforts in snuffing out the Rebellion, while pursuing their own ambitions through their Rank and Undermining their colleagues. 

Rounding out the five-person ISB squad are the Imperial Probe Droid and Director Krennic, also receiving the ISB faction tag and some flavorful improvements to their kits.

All this is leading up to the Journey Guide unit for the Era: [c][F0FF23]Cassian Andor (Undercover)[-][/c]. While the look of the unit is taken from when he stole the TIE Avenger on Sienar, the character’s kit celebrates many of his alternate identities. He makes a powerful Leader for the new Rebel Fighters, embodying the code-phrase “I have friends everywhere” into synergistic effects.

We hope you enjoy the Era of Andor! We’re excited to bring you these units and events pulled straight from the show over the next three months.
data.NEWSLETTER_ERA_OF_REVENGE_OF_THE_SITH_DE: Our next Era revisits the 20th Anniversary of Revenge of the Sith, introducing two new squads. First, [c][F0FF23]Dark Side Clones[-][/c] who work well with Empire but especially thrive when being led by none other than Lord Vader. Second, the defending [c][F0FF23]Jedi Vanguard[-][/c] squad who will be partially filled out by existing Jedi already obtainable.\n\nBoth squads will play through their respective experience in Revenge of the Sith Era Battles and all new marquee units will be required for the culmination of this Era, a legendary event for [c][F0FF23]Jedi Master Mace Windu[-][/c].
data.NEWSLETTER_ERA_OF_REVENGE_OF_THE_SITH_TI: Era of Revenge of the Sith
data.NEWSLETTER_ERA_OF_THE_CAVALRY_DESC:
The Cavalry has arrived!

Our next Era is focused around Season 3 of the Bad Batch, introducing an entirely new Bad Batch squad of 5 marquee units. Starting with Omega fully coming into her own as a leader and ending with an old friend, this squad brings a distinct playstyle from the existing Bad Batch units.

Collect these new units and keep your squad together!
data.NEWSLETTER_ESCAPE_FROM_JEDHA_DESC:
The ESCAPE FROM JEDHA EVENT has arrived and is available EXCLUSIVELY ON GOOGLE PLAY for a limited time! This special event is recommended for players Level 20 and above. Imperial forces block your way, so you will need to muster a squad capable of fighting your way off the planet. To assist you is Rogue One's K-2SO, a reprogrammed Imperial security Droid now turned Rebel agent.

K-2SO is a Rebel tank capable of Dazing and Taunting his enemies while having a chance to counter attack whenever he takes damage and will be a welcome member of your squad as you fight to escape the desert moon.

If successful, you will earn shards to level up K-2SO! Are you ready to fight the Imperial army and Escape from Jedha?

We wanted to thank you all for your feedback on our Mods release last week. Based on your feedback the team worked quickly to make adjustments last Friday to ensure Mods are a fun part of your overall game experience.
