data.NEWSLETTER_EWOK_EVENT_DESC:
The Ewoks have taken over the Cantina for the month of July and they're popping up everywhere!

Players can expect a Faction Pass for existing Ewoks, brand new Ewok Marquee Events, and random Ewok Double Drops showing up all over the Cantina. Collect new Ewoks and improve your existing Ewoks to participate in Flash Events later in the month.

What to watch for:

Ewok Faction Pass - Your favorite, existing fearless warriors are getting a boost to Damage, Survivability and Utility. New Ewok assist mechanics turn these loveable furballs into a new Holotable powerhouse.

New Ewoks – Three new Ewoks are coming to the game later this month. Get free character shards for each of the new Ewoks in their Marquee Events. Be on the lookout for a very special event where you can experience the 7-Star version of new Ewoks.

Double Drops - Ewoks have been spotted randomly popping up around the Cantina and spreading Double Drop cheer. Check back daily and see if your favorite Ewok has been spotted making mischief!

Flash Events - Power up your Ewoks all month long and prepare them for Ewok Flash Events. These events drop hard-to-get gear and other great rewards!
data.NEWSLETTER_EWOK_FACTION_DESC: The warriors of Endor get some help with a mighty faction pass. Sometimes help comes from unexpected places!\n\nChief Chirpa leads the Ewoks into battle with a revamped mass assist call and empowers them to call even more assists with his leader ability. The Ewok Elder has improved healing, more effective revives, and decreased cooldowns. The Ewok Scout now brings a powerful arsenal that includes increased damage, assist calls, and new critical hit synergies. Teebo's ability kit has NOT been updated with the Ewok Faction pass, but he synergizes even better with his newly reworked Ewok allies.
data.NEWSLETTER_EXECUTOR_DESC:
Hello Holotable Heroes,

The Bounty Hunters are getting a Capital Ship to lead them into battle on the Holotables! One of the largest and most powerful Imperial vessels ever created, the imposing [c][F0FF23]Executor[-][/c] led the way for the Empire at both the Battle of Hoth and Endor. Under Admiral Firmus Piett, the Super Star Destroyer struck fear in the hearts of enemies before it met it’s demise by plummeting into the Death Star.

In addition to the ability to destroy the enemy Capital Ship and stun all enemies, the Executor can dispel Outmaneuver and Stealth on enemies and debuffs from Bounty Hunter allies. The all new buff, [c][F0FF23]We Don't Need Their Scum[-][/c], creates some fun interaction between Empire and Bounty Hunter ships, and the Executor allows Bounty Hunters to inflict Target Lock on the targeted enemy whenever they deal damage via their Basic ability. Breach synergy is abundant, as all Bounty Hunter allies are called to assist against an enemy with Breach.  

Achieve dominance on the Holotables by adding the Executor to your ships roster through the all new Journey Guide Fleet Mastery event!
data.NEWSLETTER_EXECUTOR_TITLE: Bounty Hunters...We Don’t Need Their Scum
data.NEWSLETTER_EZRA_BRIDGER_EXILE_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

[c][F0FF23]Ezra Bridger (Exile)[-][/c] is coming to the Holotables!

After Purrgil transported Grand Admiral Thrawn’s Star Destroyer, Chimera, to another galaxy, Ezra Bridger found himself exiled on the planet of Peridea. Narrowly escaping Thrawn’s forces, Ezra ended up befriending a local tribe of Noti, protecting them from the ever present threats on the planet. Nearly a decade later, Sabine Wren was able to reunite with Ezra and the pair would face off against Thrawn’s Imperial Remnant forces alongside Ahsoka Tano.

A key piece of the upcoming [c][E7E7E7]Galactic Legend Ahsoka Tano[-][/c] squad, Ezra brings plenty to be reckoned with and a new faction tag for her squad - [c][E7E7E7]Spectre[-][/c]. He also introduces a new debuff [c][F0FF23]Exile[-][/c] that he starts battle with, but as he gains enough stacks of [c][F0FF23]Purrgil Migration[-][/c] through his Unique ability, [c][F0FF23]The Force Is My Ally[-][/c], it will be removed from him and applied to an enemy for the rest of battle so he can reunite with his friends. Many of his abilities work with Jedi and Unaligned Force Users, with extra benefits for Spectre.

His first Special ability, [c][F0FF23]Kanan’s Legacy[-][/c], dishes out defensive boosts for his allies, gives a bonus turn to one of them after calling them to assist, and can even provide Backup Plan to his Spectre allies. He also gains stacks of Resilient Defense, but enemies can’t assist or attack again against him, making these stacks tricky to get through quickly. His Unique ability, [c][F0FF23]Exile[-][/c], provides allies defensive stats while under Exile so they can weather the storm, then grants offensive stats once it’s removed so they can fully lean into their team and unleash.

Unlock Ezra Bridger (Exile) in the upcoming Conquest events!
data.NEWSLETTER_FACTION_PASS_SITH_DESC: We recently made a number of changes to characters who have the Sith label. This includes exciting changes to Darth Vader, Savage Opress, Darth Sidious, and more!\n\nFor a complete breakdown of all the changes made please visit the forums. (https://forums.galaxy-of-heroes.starwars.ea.com)
data.NEWSLETTER_FALCON_EVENT_PREVIEW_DESC: Han's Millennium Falcon is coming to the holotables! Piloted by Han Solo and Chewbacca, this ship is the target of an Imperial bounty. Gather your Bounty Hunter ships to hunt down this Legendary ship and earn the blueprints for [c][F0FF23]HAN'S MILLENNIUM FALCON[-][/c]. You will also need to own any valid Capital Ship of the correct star level to enter and complete this event.\n\nStay tuned for more news on the start of this exciting Legendary event!
data.NEWSLETTER_FENNEC_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

[c][F0FF23]Fennec Shand[-][/c], the notorious bounty hunter and assassin, has taken jobs across the galaxy since the fall of the Republic and continuing on through the events of The Mandalorian. She now makes her way to the Holotables!

Fennec worked for many of the top crime syndicates, and that experience shows in her kit, which synergizes with Bounty Hunters and Scoundrels. In addition to her Basic ability dealing multiple instances of damage, it also has the potential to grant her Offense Up. As an homage to her sniper skills, Fennec’s Special, “[c][F0FF23]I Don’t Miss[-][/c],” introduces the new debuff [c][F0FF23]Overconfident[-][/c], which actually works in her squad’s favor, as it increases the Offense, Speed, and Evasion of Dark Side Scoundrel allies, but at the cost of lowered Defense.

Like all Bounty Hunters in Galaxy of Heroes, Fennec Shand receives a Payout after completion of a contract. For Fennec, the payout comes in the form of increased Critical Chance and Critical Damage, along with the new buff [c][F0FF23]Seasoned Veteran[-][/c], which allows her to ignore Taunt and gain additional effects on her abilities.

Unlock Fennec Shand in the Tales From the Outer Rim VII Marquee Event!
data.NEWSLETTER_FENNEC_TITLE: A Dangerous Place To Be On Your Own
data.NEWSLETTER_FIFTH_BROTHER_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

[c][F0FF23]Fifth Brother[-][/c], an Inquisitor who served Darth Vader to hunt down the Rebellion before falling at the hands of Maul, is coming to the holotables!

Staying on theme for the Inquisitorius faction, Fifth Brother makes use of the Purge debuff to grant Inquisitorius allies Bonus Protection and inflict Fear on enemies. Fifth Brother also punishes non-Jedi enemies under a Jedi leader who gain bonus turn meter by inflicting them with the new effect [c][F0FF23]Provoked[-][/c]. Provoked is a debuff that grants a unit counter chance, but they will take damage and do reduced damage when they attack out of turn.

His Omicron Leader ability gives the Inquisitorius a boost in Territory Wars, where whenever an enemy gains bonus turn meter then allied Inquisitorius will also gain bonus turn meter. Additionally, non-Jedi under a Jedi leader who gain Retribution will lose Retribution and gain Expose instead.

Add Fifth Brother to your roster by unlocking him in the all-new “RUTHLESS EFFICIENCY V” Marquee event, and prove your worth to the Empire!
data.NEWSLETTER_FIN_UNIT_PROMO_DESC: Keep the pressure up with this resistance tank character inspired by Star Wars: The Force Awakens. Learn Finn's strategy in our forums today. https://forums.galaxy-of-heroes.starwars.ea.com/
data.NEWSLETTER_FINALIZER_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

The First Order's most notorious Star Destroyer, the [c][F0FF23]Finalizer[-][/c], has relentlessly pursued its enemies through the galaxy and is now available for Holotable combat.

Under the command of General Hux, this new Capital Ship's Ultimate ability is immediately available for deployment, beginning battle without a cooldown, and creating an early advantage for its allies. The Finalizer also introduces a new debuff, [c][F0FF23]Hunted[-][/c], which weakens and slows enemy ships, giving the First Order a powerful flagship to lead its fleet.

Rid the galaxy of the Resistance once and for all by unlocking Finalizer in the new [c][F0FF23]Advanced Fleet Mastery - General’s Command[-][/c]!
data.NEWSLETTER_FIRST_ORDER_OFFICER_UNIT_PROM: Manipulate turn meters with this First Order support character inspired by Star Wars: The Force Awakens. Learn the First Order Officer's strategy in our forums today. https://forums.galaxy-of-heroes.starwars.ea.com/
data.NEWSLETTER_FIRSTORDER_SPECIALFORCES_KYLO:
This month Kylo Ren is unmasked. This release includes his ship, the TIE silencer, the First Order Special Forces TIE Pilot and his ship, the First Order Special Forces TIE fighter. These units are perfect for crushing the Resistance!

Kylo Ren (Unmasked) gives the First Order a survivable Tank whose ability, [c][F0FF23]HALT[-][/c], can Stun his opponents for 2 turns. [c][F0FF23]SCARRED[-][/c] increases his survivability by reducing how much percent Health damage he takes and let him recover Health and Protection. Finally, his Leader ability, [c][F0FF23]MERCILESS PURSUIT[-][/c], gives First Order increased Speed, Critical Damage, and Turn Meter gain on Critical Hits.

His ship, the TIE silencer, is a ruthless attacker with the ability to Stun opponents who have 50% Turn Meter, or more. Additionally, this ship will gain stacks of Speed and Offense Up when damaging, or is damaged by, ships who have Target Lock.

The First Order SF TIE Pilot is an AoE attacker who inflicts Defense Down, gains Advantage, and focuses on disrupting opponents. His ship, the First Order SF TIE fighter, now brings consistent Target Lock for the First Order and, like its pilot, a significant source of AoE damage.

Kylo Ren (Unmasked) and the TIE silencer become the backbone of your First Order squad, while the First Order SF TIE Pilot and his TIE fighter bring more options to the First Order.

Now is the time to build your First Order squads for galactic domination!
First Order Fury: Kylo Ren (Unmasked) and the First Order SF TIE Pilot
data.NEWSLETTER_FLAWED_SIGNAL_DATA_LIGHT_0621: For a limited time, Flawed Signal Data has been added to Light Side and Dark Side Battle hard nodes as bonus drops! During this event, the drop rate on each node has been scaled to Energy.\n\nLight Side and Dark Side Battles are rewarding bonus drops from 06/21/2024 through 06/24/2024.
Flawed Signal Data is available on Light Side and Dark Side Battle nodes!
data.NEWSLETTER_FLEET_BATTLES_UPDATE_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

We’ve made several temporary changes to the Fleet Battles holotable in this update to make Gear XII+ salvage more accessible. 

We’ve updated the type of gear available from Fleet Battles to create a better distinction between what can be earned with regular Energy and Ship Energy. Normal Fleet Battles can now drop Gear XII+ salvage. This enables you to focus your Ship Energy on the Gear XII+ piece you want next, while using your regular Energy to earn lower-level gear. Since we want regular Energy to be the primary way to earn lower-level gear, as part of these changes, we have removed some non-Gear XII+ salvage from normal Fleet Battle nodes.

We have also changed Ship Energy so it accrues at the same speed and costs the same to refresh as regular Energy. You’ll earn Ship Energy twice as fast now (from 1 Ship Energy every 12 minutes to 1 every 6 minutes) and it will cost less to refresh with Crystals. 

Some of these changes may become permanent in the future but we will monitor their impact and announce any further changes. If you have questions or ideas to share, head over to the Official Forums, where you’ll also find the latest updates.

See you on the holotables!
data.NEWSLETTER_FLEET_BATTLES_UPDATE_TITLE: Changes to the Fleet Battles Table
data.NEWSLETTER_FO_EXECUTIONER_DESC:
This month introduces a merciless First Order melee attacker, the First Order Executioner. This brutal dark side unit brings additional damage to any First Order squad and is ideal when paired with Kylo Ren (Unmasked).

The First Order Executioner's basic, [c][F0FF23]JUDGEMENT[-][/c], will grant him Health Up for a single turn, while his Special, [c][F0FF23]DEATH SENTENCE[-][/c], will increase his Max Health if he doesn't kill his opponent (and various buffs if he does). All of these abilities feed in to his devastating Unique, [c][F0FF23]TOTAL ORDER[-][/c]: the First Order Executioner has bonus Offense equal to 5% of his Max Health.

Now is the time to bring your First Order squad to bear with the First Order Executioner!

data.NEWSLETTER_FURY_CLASS_INTERCEPTOR_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

Conquest volume 10 begins soon and blueprints for a new ship, the [c][F0FF23]Fury-class Interceptor[-][/c], will be available for a limited time in this mode! First seen in Bioware's acclaimed Star Wars: The Old Republic, the Fury-class Interceptor is the ship used in the storylines of Sith Warriors and Sith Inquisitors, and has been seen of late being flown by Darth Malgus. As such Malgus will be the pilot for this ship in Galaxy of Heroes, as we set the stage for a powerful new Sith fleet led by Darth Revan's Leviathan!

Fury-class Interceptor introduces an impactful new debuff [c][F0FF23]Suspense[-][/c] that prevents enemies from gaining buffs, and if they gain bonus Turn Meter, Protection Up, or recover Protection then they are inflicted with Defense Down. If it is dispelled then it will increase the enemy's cooldowns, and if it expires then Sith allies gain stacks of We Have Returned to increase their damage. The ship also has a variety of debuffs to help manage the enemies, while buffing its allies through new effects like [c][F0FF23]Stable Bulwark[-][/c] that boosts multiple stats and saves a ship the first time it would be defeated, and [c][F0FF23]Reinforced Determination[-][/c] which provides extra Defense per stack.

Earn Fury-class Interceptor blueprints during the upcoming Conquest events and unlock Darth Malgus through Proving Grounds! This ship will be required for the upcoming Journey Guide Fleet Mastery event for Leviathan, so gather your Sith to fight!
data.NEWSLETTER_GAC_DIVISION_UPDATES_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

Grand Arena Championship Divisions have received several changes to promote a more balanced and competitive experience. We have redistributed the number of players in Grand Arena Championship divisions to closely reflect the ratio of players that were originally in those divisions at the time of GAC’s launch. The number of squads required and prizing for league promotions has also been adjusted to closely resemble the divisions players were previously in. These changes maintain the level of difficulty you experienced previously and without affecting your rewards.

In addition to the above changes, the amount of required points scored to promote between divisions and leagues will be different for some divisions and leagues to account for the additional squad battles taking place amongst players in those divisions.

data.NEWSLETTER_GAC_UPDATE_DESC:
The [c][F0FF23]Grand Arena Championship[-][/c] has been updated with new Matchmaking, Rewards, and a more streamlined Tournament Ladder.

- New skilled-based rating system to match you against fair and comparable opponents

- Daily Crystal Rewards based on your current standing in Grand Arena

- Updated head-to-head scoring system to encourage active participation

Join now and battle with your entire Galaxy of Heroes roster in the newly reworked Grand Arena Championship! Check out the Official Forums for more information.
data.NEWSLETTER_GALACTIC_CHALLENGE_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

In this update, we’re proud to present [c][F0FF23]Galactic Challenges[-][/c]! This all-new game mode represents a huge step for Galaxy of Heroes, as it lays the foundation of our new content initiative, allowing us to generate fresh content, challenges, and feats on a regular basis going forward.

With Galactic Challenges, players will be presented with new battles that provide the opportunity to utilize many parts of their character and ship roster in a fun and meaningful way. Galactic Challenge events keep the game fresh and engaging by offering interesting and unique encounters that feature always-changing combinations of modifiers, locations, and conditions, along with multiple tiers of difficulty. Modifiers add a wide range of positive and negative effects to the battle, meaning you’ll have to mix up your strategies to succeed.

The best part? This is just the beginning. Galactic Challenges will lay a foundation that allows Capital Games to continue expanding the variety of content we are able to offer now and in the future. We’re all really excited at the studio and can’t wait for our passionate community of players to dive in!

See you on the Holotables!
data.NEWSLETTER_GALACTIC_CHALLENGE_TITLE: Are You Ready For A Galactic Challenge?
data.NEWSLETTER_GALACTIC_CONQUEST_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

The latest update to Galaxy of Heroes expands the Galactic War table with a new game mode, [c][F0FF23]Conquest[-][/c]! You will face increasingly difficult foes as you advance from sector to sector, but special [c][F0FF23]Data Disks[-][/c] and [c][F0FF23]consumables[-][/c] will help power up your squads along the way. You’ll need a variety of squads and your favorite combination of Data Disks to defeat some of your most difficult challenges yet! Complete feats and battles to improve your reward crate at the end of the event and for this Conquest, earn a very special ship, the [c][F0FF23]Razor Crest[-][/c]! Conquest begins with the first exhibition event on March 1st with another to follow closely thereafter.

Unlock the Razor Crest via the new Conquest mode and put it through the types of battles it’s become famous for enduring... not counting that whole thing on Tython. The famed transport has seen its fair share of adventure, from its start as a military patrol ship to being picked apart by Jawas and put back together by Din Djarin and Kuiil. 

With Breach and Bounty Hunter synergy, the Razor Crest stands ready to raise the faction’s competitiveness in ship battles. The new buff, [c][F0FF23]Reinforced Hull[-][/c], adds to the Razor Crest’s survivability, while cooldown reduction, calling allies to assist, and inflicting enemies with Marked ensures it packs a punch. 

Good luck in this month’s Conquest and see you on the Holotables!
data.NEWSLETTER_GALACTIC_GEAR_PACK_DESC: Need extra gear to get your remaining characters ready for Raids? The Galactic Gear Pack is now in the Store!\n\nFor a limited time you can get the gear you need, and have a chance to get exclusive Raid Gear.
data.NEWSLETTER_GALACTIC_LEGENDS_DESC:

A new type of character is joining the Holotables, [c][f0ff23]Galactic Legends[-][/c]! [c][f0ff23]Supreme Leader Kylo Ren[-][/c] and [c][f0ff23]Rey[-][/c] are the first Galactic Legends and are some of the most powerful units in Galaxy of Heroes. Each Galactic Legend has a unique [c][f0ff23]Ultimate ability[-][/c] that charges over the course of a battle, such as Rey's [c][f0ff23]Heir to the Jedi[-][/c] or Kylo's [c][f0ff23]Depths of Rage[-][/c]. These powerful abilities can aid a variety of different squads with incredible bonuses to turn the tide of battle.

Want to get started on either Rey or Supreme Leader Kylo Ren? Find all the requirements for either character in the Journey Guide. These events are available permanently once you qualify for them; you can unlock these new characters whenever you are ready.

data.NEWSLETTER_GAMORREAN_GUARD_DESC:
Greetings, 

A new character is now available in Guild Store, Gamorrean Guard. This aggressive tank can Taunt, Counter and inflict multiple Damage Over Time effects. 

Will you be adding Gamorrean Guard to your collection?
data.NEWSLETTER_GAS_EVENT_DESC:
[i]"A true leader always leads from the front."[/i] -Anakin Skywalker to Captain Rex

[c][f0ff23]Anakin Skywalker[-][/c] has been many things over the years; pod racer, droid builder, Jedi padawan and even a legendary pilot, but his confidence and his exceptional connection to the Force was clear to anyone who came in contact with him. Now a General in the Grand Army of the Republic, Skywalker fights to stop the growing Separatist threat along side the 501st Clone Troopers. 

As the Chosen One, and due to his mastery of the Force, Skywalker can unleash a barrage of abilities each turn. General Skywalker can take [c][f0ff23]Cover[-][/c] in the heat of battle and wait for the right moment to [c][f0ff23]Advance[-][/c] towards the enemy while his Clone allies lay down fire. Between the shower of [c][f0ff23]Furious Slashes[-][/c] and using [c][f0ff23]Sundering Strike[-][/c] to tear apart his enemy’s defenses, General Skywalker is a force to be reckoned with.

Unlock General Skywalker starting today in the [c][f0ff23]Epic Confrontation, Clash on Kamino[-][/c].
data.NEWSLETTER_GAS_EVENT_TITLE: A General of the Grand Army of the Republic
data.NEWSLETTER_GENERAL_KENOBI_DESC:
General Kenobi is now available to add to your collection! Acquiring this legendary Jedi Master will take not only your best efforts, but also the best efforts of your guild as he is only available as the Heroic Tier reward in the new Tank Takedown Raid.

General Kenobi was both a shrewd negotiator and tactician during the Clone Wars. These traits translate into him being an ideal leader for both Jedi and Clone squads, granting both increased health and defense to his allies. A front-line combatant, his “Lead the Charge” ability allows him to call all other buffed allies to join in his attacks. In addition to his substantial combat abilities, his negotiating skills enable him to not only dispel all debuffs from his squad, but also grant the opposite buffs for the next 2 turns. With an array of abilities and buffs, General Kenobi is a great addition to any squad!

Will you be adding this hero of the Republic to your collection?
data.NEWSLETTER_GENERAL_KENOBI_TITLE: General Kenobi now available in the Tank Takedown Raid!
data.NEWSLETTER_GENERAL_SYNDULLA_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

[c][F0FF23]General Syndulla[-][/c] is coming to the Holotables!

Hera Syndulla’s fight against the Empire started when she was a little girl growing up on Ryloth. Later on, she founded the Spectres, a Rebel cell operating out of her personal transport ship the Ghost. She would then lead Phoenix Squadron for the greater Rebellion, and finally was promoted to General shortly before the Battle of Yavin. She held this rank for all of the Galactic Civil War and into the era of the New Republic. In this time period she helped Ahsoka Tano in her quest to locate Grand Admiral Thrawn by reconnecting her with Sabine Wren. Finally, in defiance of her superiors in the New Republic, General Syndulla aided Ahsoka on Seatos, helping her and Huyang in their rescue of Sabine Wren.

General Syndulla enters the field as a Support for Galactic Legend Ahsoka Tano’s squad but can also work as a leader for Spectres while you work towards Ahsoka. Her Special ability, [c][F0FF23]Pulling Rank[-][/c], dispels debuffs on a Spectre ally and grants them Offense and Speed per debuff dispelled. This ability also introduces a new buff [c][F0FF23]Perfect Defense[-][/c] that functions as a combination of Defense Up and Tenacity Up. Her other Special, [c][F0FF23]I’m Not Just Going to Sit Around[-][/c], deals True damage to all enemies and inflicts the target enemy with Fracture.

[c][F0FF23]New Republic General[-][/c], her Leader ability, benefits both Spectres as well as Zeb by giving them extra defensiveness and opening Speed to get the battle rolling. Additionally, they can ignore taunt effects to target an enemy with Fracture so you can be sure to take them down.

Her Unique ability, [c][F0FF23]Unauthorized Mission[-][/c], provides extra damage for Spectres and extra Defense for them while someone else is taunting. This ability also provides stat bonuses when Perfect Defense expires based on their role. With an Omicron upgrade in the Territory Wars game mode, Spectre allies and Zeb gain Counter Chance and Potency, as well as more sustain and control for the battle.

This release also adds the [c][E7E7E7]final batch[-][/c] of Galactic Legend Ahsoka Tano requirements to the Journey Guide.

Unlock General Syndulla in the upcoming “LOST AND FOUND III” Marquee event that [c][E7E7E7]gives out daily rewards[-][/c] for the duration of the event, and prepare for the upcoming [c][E7E7E7]Galactic Legend Ahsoka Tano[-][/c]!
data.NEWSLETTER_GENERAL_TFA_UNIT_PROMO_DESC: New characters from Star Wars: The Force Awakens are now available! Collect and battle with Kylo Ren, Rey, Poe Dameron, Captain Phasma, Finn and the First Order Officer today. All six characters are available in Chromium Data Cards or as shard drops - View them in the characters screen to see where you can find them!
data.NEWSLETTER_GEONOSIAN_SPY_MISSION_DESC: Geonosian Spy is now available in Cantina Battles Stage 4 Mission D. This stealthy attacker provides great synergies with squads that can apply multiple debuffs to enemy units and take advantage of his “Silent Strike” ability which dispels both debuffs and buffs from the enemy target and Geonosian Spy but deals increasing damage for each effect removed. Additionally, his unique passive “Illicit Insect” gives him increased turn meter every time a Geonosian ally inflicts a negative status effect, ensuring that the Geonosian Spy can take advantage of weakened enemies.\n\nBe sure to add this cunning attacker to your collection and takedown your enemies one negative status effect at a time!
data.NEWSLETTER_GEONOSIAN_SPY_MISSION_TITLE: Geonosian Spy is now available in Cantina Battles Stage 4 Mission D!
data.NEWSLETTER_GEONOSIANS_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

The Geonosians are emerging from the hive with all-new tactics! [c][F0FF23]Sun Fac[-][/c], [c][F0FF23]Poggle the Lesser[-][/c], [c][F0FF23]Geonosian Spy[-][/c], and [c][F0FF23]Geonosian Soldier[-][/c] have all been reworked to make use of the Hive Mind buff and are ready to join forces in battle.

Each Geonosian has received some big changes to their kit, and while under the influence of Hive Mind, they gain even more deadly effects. With the [c][F0FF23]Geonosian Brood Alpha[-][/c] in the Leader slot, this squad really takes flight, attacking with a persistent swarm of assists while applying a whole host of debuffs to the enemy. This squad has evolved to a whole new level, and they're ready to take on brutal opponents in the Petranaki arena.

Find the full list of changes on the Official Forum. See you on the holotables!
data.NEWSLETTER_GL_AHSOKA_TANO_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

[c][F0FF23]Galactic Legend Ahsoka Tano[-][/c] has arrived on the Holotables!

With a long and storied history reaching back to the Clone Wars where she was the Padawan Learner of Anakin Skywalker and continuing all the way to the New Republic where she pursued Grand Admiral Thrawn into a different galaxy, Ahsoka Tano is one of the most prolific people in the Star Wars saga. Holding the life essence of the Daughter, Ahsoka is never far from her Morai companion. Once framed by Barriss Offee, she saw the cracks in the Jedi Order and refused their invitation back when it was shown she was innocent of the crimes. Her specialized training against the Clone Troopers she fought alongside enabled her to survive Order 66 and save her friend Rex. She eventually joined the Rebel Alliance as the mysterious Fulcrum where she fought against Inquisitors and eventually Darth Vader, learning the devastating truth of the person behind the mask. Her defeat at Seatos at the hands of Baylan Skoll was a chrysalis in her life, where she came to terms with Anakin’s fate and found renewed resolve in training Sabine Wren. She followed Morgan Elsbeth’s path to Peridea where she would face-off against Grand Admiral Thrawn’s remnant and his undying legion of Night Troopers, rescuing Ezra Bridger but finding herself stranded in a different galaxy.

Ahsoka lands as a Tank Galactic Legend to lead the squad of new Spectre units. With her Basic ability, [c][F0FF23]Aegis Charge[-][/c], Ahsoka generates bonus Protection for herself and increases the duration of Perfect Defense if she’s buffed with it. [c][F0FF23]Shatterstrike[-][/c], her first Special ability, inflicts Armor Shred and catches her opponent off guard by inflicting stacks of Off Balance. Her second Special ability, [c][F0FF23]Defiant Resolve[-][/c], bestows the new [c][F0FF23]Morai’s Wisdom[-][/c] buff on targeted Spectre allies and gives her an active Taunt. Her Leader ability, [c][F0FF23]Commander of the Wayward[-][/c], brings lost companions together with the [c][F0FF23]Reunited[-][/c] granted ability and can severely punish opponents who rely on Protection Up. [c][F0FF23]Daughter of Mortis[-][/c], her Unique ability, grants Ahsoka a percentage of Offense based on her Defense and protects her Spectre allies from Daze.

Her first Ultimate ability, [c][F0FF23]Worlds Apart[-][/c], tips the odds in Ahsoka’s favor by reducing the cooldown of ally abilities and increasing the cooldown of enemy abilities. Additionally, Spectre allies recover Health and Protection. Once used, this ability becomes unavailable and Ahsoka instead gains her second Ultimate ability, [c][F0FF23]Relentless Redoubt[-][/c], empowering her allies with the potent [c][F0FF23]Deflective Ward[-][/c] buff which reduces enemy damage to 1 and punishes any foe who focuses on her allies instead of Ahsoka herself.

Obtain Ahsoka Tano now through her event, [c][E7E7E7]I Am No Jedi[-][/c], which can be accessed via the Journey Guide! The recent update that prevents losing Galactic Legend tickets upon battle loss also applies for this event. Additionally, Ahsoka will get a tier in the recurring [c][E7E7E7]Ultimate Journey[-][/c] event the next time it returns.
data.NEWSLETTER_GL_HONDO_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

[c][F0FF23]Pirate King Hondo Ohnaka[-][/c] is plundering his way onto the Holotables!

The charismatic and opportunistic Weequay Pirate leader, Hondo Ohnaka, has taken command of a new motley crew of scoundrels. Always looking to make a profit, Hondo has proclaimed himself the Pirate King and rallied a band of Pirates under his self-appointed rule.

Hondo's [c][F0FF23]Ultimate ability[-][/c], [c][F0FF23]Mutual Gains (For Me)[-][/c], is a game-changing move that revives all his Pirate and Smuggler allies while punishing Jedi and Sith enemies with cooldown increases and potent offensive buffs, all while granting Hondo and his crew powerful new effects. The Tenuous Agreement debuff makes enemies deal reduced damage to Hondo's allies, while Favorable Terms provides Critical Chance, Offense, and Protection recovery boosts along with the ability to gain bonus turns for his allies when defeating debuffed foes.

Hondo's Basic ability, [c][F0FF23]Pistol Panache[-][/c], is a flurry of blaster fire that calls random Pirate allies to assist, with increasing damage output based on Profit stacks. His first Special, [c][F0FF23]Loot First, Ask Later[-][/c], Steals and redistributes enemy buffs while inflicting debuffs and granting stacking Mastery to enhance his crew's stats. [c][F0FF23]Charismatic Captain[-][/c], his second Special, provides healing, a dispel, and Turn Meter gain for the Pirate squad.

As the [c][F0FF23]Pirate King[-][/c] Leader, Hondo bolsters his crew's offensive capabilities while granting them immunity to detrimental effects like Fear, Shock, and Turn Meter removal. His first [c][F0FF23]Unique[-][/c], [c][F0FF23]It's Not Personal. It's Profitable[-][/c], capitalizes on the Profit mechanic, providing stacking offensive bonuses and damage reduction as the fight progresses.

Prepare to join Hondo's daring crew and claim your share of the spoils in the [c][E7E7E7]TALES OF THE PIRATE KING[-][/c] Galactic Legend event that has Hondo retelling his most famous appearances throughout history (note: not all of these appearances have been fact-checked).

data.NEWSLETTER_GRAND_ARENA_CHAMPIONSHIPS_DES:
Grand Arena Championships are beginning next week with the exhibition Championship! Compete with other Holotable Heroes and see your progress on the first-ever global leaderboards for individual players in Star Wars: Galaxy of Heroes. We’ll finally be able to answer the question: "Do you have what it takes to be the greatest in the galaxy?"

Reach higher Leagues in Championships by defeating opponents in Grand Arena and completing Feats. Feats are unique time-sensitive challenges that reward you for going above and beyond, and they're a great way to progress to new Leagues.

At the end of each Championship, you'll be able to receive your rewards, review your progress, and prepare for the next one. Your League icon – and of course, bragging rights – remains until the start of the next Championship. Then it resets and you can try again for an even higher position!

With the release of Grand Arena Championships, we're also adding the last slot of Gear XII pieces so you can upgrade your characters to Gear XIII. The new Gear XII finishers can be found in Grand Arena Championships and the new Territory Battle on Geonosis. Take your characters to new heights of power and dominate your opponents.

For the full details on Championships and Gear XII finishers, visit the forums.

Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\nReady your best squads and prepare to battle for glory, Grand Arena Championships returns on 10/2/2019! In Grand Arena Championships, players compete in several Grand Arena events over the course of multiple weeks to climb the ranks and earn awesome prizes. Face off against players with a similar roster and skill to be the best in the galaxy! Is your team strong enough to become the next Champion?
data.NEWSLETTER_GRAND_ARENA_DESC:
Get ready for some serious competition: Grand Arena is here! For the first time, Level 85 players across the game are paired in a 1-on-1 competition that is the ultimate test of skill.

-Use your collection of characters and ships to battle against a player with a similar collection

-Compete to win the most rounds in the event

-Earn Portraits for accomplishing great feats like Prestigious Quests

-Change your Squad Arena payout time twice a year
data.NEWSLETTER_GRAND_INQUISITOR_DESC:
The [c][F0FF23]Grand Inquisitor[-][/c] has arrived to the holotables!

Master of the Inquisitorius, the Grand Inquisitor is the highest ranking of all Inquisitors who reports directly to Darth Vader. Charged with hunting down Jedi who survived the Great Purge and other Force sensitives, Grand Inquisitor studied the ways of the Jedi in order to understand their fighting style but ultimately fell to Kanan Jarrus.

His leader ability, [c][F0FF23]Master Inquisitorius[-][/c], provides Inquisitorius allies with a variety of stat boosts based on their role. Jedi who attempt to evade the Inquisitorius are punished with damage through his unique ability, [c][F0FF23]Compassion Leaves a Trail[-][/c]. Grand Inquisitor also introduces a new debuff, [c][F0FF23]Torture[-][/c], that increases damage taken and lowers defense when attacked, all the while preventing bonus turn meter.

Grand Inquisitor's Omicron ability upgrades bring Inquisitors to new heights in Territory Wars. When these abilities are fully upgraded Purge will automatically be reapplied when it expires, Jedi enemies take damage when they gain Protection Up, and Grand Inquisitor has a chance to instantly defeat a Jedi enemy.

Gather your Inquisitorius for their training in the all new "DARK TIMES" Legendary Event. This event will only be around for a short time before it returns in the future, so don't miss your opportunity to impress your worth to Vader and lead the Inquisitorius to victory.
data.NEWSLETTER_GRAND_MOFF_TARKIN_DESC: Greetings, \n\nGrand Moff Tarkin is now available in the Arena Store. Strengthen your Empire squad and dominate the holotables with this powerful Support character.
data.NEWSLETTER_GRAND_MOFF_TARKIN_TITLE: Grand Moff Tarkin now available in the Arena Store
data.NEWSLETTER_GRAND_MOFF_WILHUFF_TARKIN_DES:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

Grand Moff Wilhuff Tarkin, architect of the Doctrine of Fear and the person who ordered the destruction of Alderaan, is a figure whose legacy is defined by ruthless precision and unwavering loyalty to the Empire.

We’re updating Grand Moff Tarkin’s kit to better position him as a leader for the new Dark Side Clone Troopers introduced in this era; after all, what better way to ensure these relics of the Clone Wars serve their purpose for the Empire?

His Basic, first Special ability, and Leader ability have all received mechanical updates that grant new synergy with Dark Side Clone Troopers, including a powerful new interaction that allows [c][F0FF23]Ultimate Firepower’s[-][/c] damage to trigger twice under the right conditions and a visual tracker for Potency gained from his Basic.

And finally, we’ve added a brand-new [c][F0FF23]3v3 Omicron[-][/c] for his Leader ability, giving you the opportunity to field two powerful 3v3 Dark Side Clone Trooper squads; one led by Lord Vader, and the other by Tarkin himself.

This update is live for all current and future owners of Tarkin. Add him to your roster today, and bring fear and destruction to those who dare oppose the Empire!
data.NEWSLETTER_GRAND_MOFF_WILHUFF_TARKIN_TIT: These Boots are Made for Tarkin

data.NEWSLETTER_GREAT_MOTHERS_DATACRON_DESC:
Greetings Holotable Heroes,

As a first time reward for the 7-star Tier of Great Mothers’ Marquee event, players will earn a one-of-a-kind Datacron at level 9 that targets Great Mothers. There is no other way to get a Great Mothers Datacron in the Rambunctious Rage Datacron set so make sure to grab it!

This datacron comes with pre-established stat bonuses, but a player can reroll these to random stat bonuses that are within the Rambunctious Rage set if they so desire using the same Datacron materials as that set.

While players have the ability to dismantle this Datacron, note that this is irreversible and there is no other way to get a Great Mothers Datacron at this time.

At the end of the lifetime of the Rambunctious Rage Datacron set, this Datacron will automatically dismantle along with the rest of the set.
data.NEWSLETTER_GREAT_MOTHERS_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

[c][F0FF23]The Great Mothers[-][/c] are coming to the Holotables!

The three Great Mothers of the Nightsisters, Klothow, Aktropaw, and Lakesis, spin, manipulate, and cut the threads of fates of allies and foes alike. Using their majik, this coven was instrumental in maintaining Grand Admiral Thrawn’s forces during his exile on the planet Peridea.

The Great Mothers are an Elite Marquee, indicating a higher power level than a typical marquee but at the same accessibility. Additionally, the Great Mothers are considered a Large character and will prevent the use of the ally slot or other large characters on the squad. Nightsisters, reign!

Their Leader ability [c][F0FF23]Threads of Destiny[-][/c], introduces the granted abilities of [c][F0FF23]Fate Weaving[-][/c], which inflicts [c][F0FF23]Doomed[-][/c] on an enemy, and [c][F0FF23]Gift of Shadows[-][/c] to grant [c][F0FF23]Blessed[-][/c] to a Nightsister ally. Their Basic ability, [c][F0FF23]Energy Threads[-][/c], reduces the Max Health of a targeted Doomed enemy and grants a Blessed ally with Stealth and Foresight, setting up for big damage from Nightsister Acolyte and Spirit. [c][F0FF23]To The Old Ways[-][/c], their Unique ability, provides many more instances of Stealth and Foresight for Nightsister allies, gives stacking damage and Protection recovery for themselves and Blessed allies when enemies are critically hit, and grants Turn Meter to Blessed allies when a Doomed enemy gains Turn Meter.

With Omicron upgrades in the Territory War game modes, the Unique and Leader abilities gain extra effects such as saving a Nightsister ally from initial defeat, boosting key stats, and inflicting Fear when a Doomed enemy is defeated. 

Unlock Great Mothers in the upcoming “VEIL OF SHADOWS II” Marquee event that [c][E7E7E7]gives out daily rewards[-][/c] for the duration of the event and prepare for the upcoming Epic Confrontation for [c][E7E7E7]Baylan Skoll[-][/c]!
data.NEWSLETTER_GREEF_CARA_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

Two new arrivals have showed up in the cantina and they look like they must be from the Outer Rim!

First up is [c][F0FF23]Cara Dune[-][/c], a veteran Rebel Shock Trooper who has reinvented herself as a mercenary since leaving military life behind. This tough, no-nonsense brawler hasn’t forgotten how to fight an enemy like the Empire and can be difficult to take down in battle. While Cara can find a place as a deadly ambusher on a Scoundrel squad, she’s equally at-home under a Rebel leader, defending her allies as a front-line combatant.

Also joining the Holotables is [c][F0FF23]Greef Karga[-][/c], a notorious scoundrel and the go-to-guy for connecting Bounty Hunters with clients on Nevarro. Greef is always trying to spot the most lucrative solution to whatever predicament he finds himself in, and his abilities reflect this. He prefers to hang back while other Bounty Hunters work to achieve their Payouts and he supports the squad with mass assist calls and frequent recovery of Health and Protection.

See you on the Holotables!
data.NEWSLETTER_GREEF_CARA_TITLE: Some Of My Favorite People Are Bounty Hunters

data.NEWSLETTER_GUILD_BANK_CURRENCY_CAP_DESC:
A new cap has been placed on the total amount of Guild Bank Coins that can be earned each day. The new cap is 30,000 Guild Bank Coins earned by a guild per day. Once the cap has been reached, any additional Guild Bank Coins earned by players that day will not be counted.

The new cap will still allow Guilds with a full roster of 50 to have each of their members contribute their full energy contribution each day (600/600).

The cap will reset every 24 hours.
data.NEWSLETTER_GUILD_BANK_CURRENCY_CAP_TITLE: New Cap: Daily Earned Guild Bank Coins
data.NEWSLETTER_GUNGAN_BOOMADIER_DESC:
Mesa greeting yousa Holotable Heroes,

Known for their accuracy and precision, the [c][F0FF23]Gungan Boomadiers[-][/c] have entered the holotables! Adding to the Gungan squad alongside Boss Nass and Captain Tarpals, the Boomadier brings a satchel full of boomas, small plasma bombs, to the battle.

During the Battle for Naboo Boomadiers played a key role in supporting their brethren on the field. Launching boomas into swarms of Trade Federation Battle Droids in an effort to stem the seemingly infinite waves of attackers, Boomadiers formed the backbone of the Gungan offense.

Like all Gungans, Boomadier looks to the Shield Generator supplied by Boss Nass to amp up his survivability. His Unique ability, [c][F0FF23]Grand Army Specialist[-][/c], gives him Defense Penetration and Offense, and, while the Shield Generator is active, ensures that enemies can’t be revived as well as giving himself a boost to his offensive output when he uses a Special ability. Boomadier’s Basic ability, [c][F0FF23]Catch This![-][/c], deals extra damage to Shocked enemies (well hello, Captain Tarpals!). [c][F0FF23]Cluster Booma[-][/c] really takes advantage of debuffed enemies through dealing extra instances of damage, and the [c][F0FF23]Horn of Otoh Gunga[-][/c] has the ability to recover stacks of Plasma Shielding on the Shield Generator as well as swapping Turn Meter with another Gungan ally.

Unlock the Gungan Boomadier in the upcoming “BATTLEFIELD: NABOO III” Marquee event, as well as [c][E7E7E7]earn daily rewards[-][/c] for the duration of the event. And don’t forget that Boomadier is required for the [c][E7E7E7]Legendary event for Jar Jar Binks[-][/c], as well as being part of one of the best squads for the [c][E7E7E7]Battle for Naboo raid[-][/c]!

data.NEWSLETTER_GUNGAN_PHALANX_DESC:
Mesa greeting yousa Holotable Heroes,

The penultimate piece to the Gungan squad, the [c][F0FF23]Gungan Phalanx[-][/c], is coming to the Holotables!

On the grassy plains of Naboo, the Gungan Phalanx used their energy shields to protect key battlefield elements from the onslaught of Battle Droid blaster fire, giving the Gungans a fighting chance against overwhelming odds, holding out until the droid control ship in orbit could be defeated.

In combat the Phalanx uses his personal electropole with his Basic ability, [c][F0FF23]Fierce Poke[-][/c]. This will not only inflict Defense Down but, when Phalanx attacks out of turn, give Protection Over Time to a Gungan ally. To control the battle, as well as protect the invaluable Shield Generator, the Special ability, [c][F0FF23]Heyo, Watch Out[-][/c], does area of effect damage and inflicts Tenacity Down, additionally it makes the Gungan Phalanx Taunt, ensuring he is the target of incoming attacks. Using their second Special ability, [c][F0FF23]Raise da Shield[-][/c], Phalanx will dispel himself of debuffs and give out a new buff [c][F0FF23]Shield Up[-][/c]. Shield Up is similar to Protection Up, adding bonus Protection to the target, the difference being it scales off of a unit’s Max Protection instead of their Health. [c][F0FF23]Let Mesa Help[-][/c] is Phalanx’s Unique ability, allowing them to reactively Taunt when the Shield Generator becomes the focus of enemy attacks. When Phalanx assists, this ability will give the ally who Phalanx is assisting Foresight for one turn, further ensuring the survivability of the squad.

Gungan Phalanx is bringing to Galaxy of Heroes the very first [c][E7E7E7]Omicron for the Galactic Challenge[-][/c] game mode. This ability is specifically designed to help tackle some of the more difficult feats in that game mode.

Gungan Phalanx will be unlockable in the upcoming “BATTLEFIELD: NABOO IV” Marquee event which follows our new, experimental, Marquee structure that [c][E7E7E7]gives out daily rewards[-][/c] for the duration of the event. Gungans will be the kings of the hill in the upcoming [c][E7E7E7]Battle for Naboo raid[-][/c], and the [c][E7E7E7]Legendary Jar Jar Binks[-][/c] will require Phalanx in order to unlock him in his event, so don’t miss out!
data.NEWSLETTER_HAN_ACTIVATED_DESC:
Congratulations to Yukikase! The first player in the world to unlock Han Solo from the Heroic Guild Raid. This smuggler turned Rebel hero was one of the great leaders of the Rebel Alliance. 

Han Solo is a hard hitting critical attacker that always shoots first. Han’s unique ability gives him a free attack at the start of combat that stuns his target before any other unit can take an action. Capable of buffing his entire team with his lucky nature (Critical Chance Up), dealing extra damage to slower enemies, and his unique shoot first ability, Han Solo is capable of turning the tide of battle from the very first shot. 

Join Yukikase in adding this Rebel hero to your Squad by defeating the Heroic Rancor Raid to collect his shards!
data.NEWSLETTER_HAN_ACTIVATED_TITLE: Congratulations Yukikase! First to Unlock Han Solo!
data.NEWSLETTER_HAN_SOLO_DESC:
Greetings,

Han Solo, one of the most iconic characters in the galaxy, is now available! Collect shards for this hero by clearing The Pit on Heroic tier. 

Han Solo's abilities will be hidden until the first player activates him. The first player to activate Han Solo will have their name featured prominently in an announcement for all players to see. 

Will you be the first to activate Han Solo? Is your Guild ready to defeat the Rancor on Heroic tier?
data.NEWSLETTER_HANS_MILLENNIUM_FALCON_DESC: She may not look like much, but you would be hard-pressed to find a more legendary ship than Han’s Millennium Falcon, which has eluded Star Destroyers, bested Darth Vader, and destroyed a Death Star -- all with a somewhat unpredictable hyperdrive. On the holotables, the Falcon is a Rebel Attacker that strengthens Home One and the Rebel fleet as a whole by enabling relentless assist calls. Piloted by Han Solo and Chewbacca, the Falcon also [c][F0FF23]Outmaneuvers[-][/c] its enemies with extra Evasion, and can't be targeted while other allies are present.
data.NEWSLETTER_HERO_REY_DESC:
Rey (Jedi Training) is arriving soon in Galaxy of Heroes! This Resistance hero is embarking on a journey that will change both her and the Galaxy. Rey (Jedi Training) enables many new strategies and is a powerful addition to any roster of heroes. Her powerful and devastating abilities synergize well with Resistance members, but can be used in many different squads.

This Resistance Hero will unlock through the Hero's Journey event as a Seven Star character. To unlock Rey (Jedi Training), players will require a Seven Star Rey (Scavenger), Finn, Veteran Smuggler Han Solo, Veteran Smuggler Chewbacca, AND BB-8. In celebration of the Hero's Journey event, we've brought back BB-8's Legendary Event.

We've updated BB-8's Legendary Event to include a new, additional event - the Mythic Event! Upon completing the Legendary "Pieces and Plans" Event, the Mythic "Pieces and Plans" Event will open to players and run for two days during the course of the Legendary Event. In the Mythic version, players will be able to replay the original Legendary Event final tier, play a new, more difficult tier where they can take any characters in, and a third tier that reverses the encounter! Best of all, the new Mythic Event is recurring - meaning everytime the Legendary Event returns, so does the Mythic Event.
data.NEWSLETTER_HERO_REY_TITLE: Rey's Hero's Journey and Introducing the Mythic Event
data.NEWSLETTER_HEROES_HOLIDAY_DESC: Celebrate the holidays with EA’s Star Wars games by joining the new Heroes Holiday community event! During our first ever community event, all eligible players must defeat Boba Fett in the Training Droid Challenge an average of two times per day on Sunday, Monday, and Thursday between Dec 23rd and January 1st. If our community can complete this challenge, all players will be given 10 shards for Rey! Are you ready to battle Boba Fett? Let the contest begin! More details available in the forums.
data.NEWSLETTER_HEROES_HOLIDAY_TITLE: The Heroes Holiday Community Challenge is here!

data.NEWSLETTER_HONDO_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

[c][F0FF23]Hondo Ohnaka[-][/c], notorious pirate with escapades spanning from the Clone Wars to the days of the Resistance, is coming to the holotables!

Known for serving himself above all else, Hondo introduces the first use of the [c][FFFFFF]Neutral[-][/c] alignment tag to the game. This alignment is distinct from Light and Dark side so will not count for either, but he will be available for use in all Territory Battles.

Hondo also introduces the [c][F0FF23]Captive[-][/c] debuff that sets an enemy's speed to zero (excluding Galactic Legends and Raid Bosses) and the longer the enemy stays captive, the more stats Hondo receives for his frustration of waiting for his [c][F0FF23]Ransom[-][/c] to be paid. Ransom provides bonuses to Hondo depending on how many stacks he has. In Grand Arenas with an Omicron upgrade on his Unique ability [c][F0FF23]That's Just Good Business,[-][/c] Hondo will gain additional stats when there is a Captive enemy and starts the battle with bonus turn meter.

Through his second Unique ability, [c][F0FF23]I Guess We Won't Be Friends[-][/c], Hondo makes sure he always gets his cut by gaining bonus turn meter whenever anyone does and will become stronger if all his allies have fallen and he is left to protect himself.

Add Hondo Ohnaka to your roster by unlocking him in the all-new “GOOD BUSINESS” Marquee event!
data.NEWSLETTER_HONDO_TITLE: Oh, The Stories I Could Tell. So Many of Them True.
data.NEWSLETTER_HONOR_GUARD_ZEB_DESC:
Karabast! Pirates are attacking Chopper Base and Zeb needs your squad's help to defend it in this limited-time Event.

Garazeb Orrelios, or Zeb for short, buffs his allies by providing Tenacity Up and attacks his foes with his Bash and Staggering Sweep abilities. Under the lead of Hera Syndulla, Zeb grants the Shrug Off ability to all members of Phoenix Squadron allowing them to recover Protection at the start of their turn.

Add this powerful Lasat to your collection by participating in the Honor Guard Event this month!
data.NEWSLETTER_HUNTER_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes!

The commanding officer of Clone Force 99 has joined the Holotables! The clone nicknamed [c][F0FF23]Hunter[-][/c] leads the elite but unconventional squad known as the [c][F0FF23]Bad Batch[-][/c] for the Grand Army of The Republic.

Hunter can lead a squad of Clone Troopers but doesn't usually work with the “regs” and prefers to have his Bad Batch allies at his side. He has chosen a different path compared to other clones and prefers covert tactics. Hunter ambushes his foes with [c][F0FF23]Shrouded Approach[-][/c], an ability that allows him and his Clone Trooper allies to gain Stealth while allies with the new Bad Batch faction tag also gain Critical Chance Up and Offense Up. Under Hunter’s leadership, Bad Batch allies have increased Max Health, Max Protection, and Potency and can take down those pesky clankers or Separatist enemies with ruthless efficiency.

Unlock Hunter in the all new Marquee event: [c][F0FF23]Clone Force 99 I[-][/c]
data.NEWSLETTER_HUNTER_TITLE: Maps can be wrong. Hunter never is.
data.NEWSLETTER_HUNTERS3_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

[c][F0FF23]Hunter (Mercenary)[-][/c] is coming to the Holotables!

After losing Tech, and Omega being captured by the Empire, Hunter and Wrecker took on the role of Mercenaries. They took jobs in pursuit of leads to learn where Omega was being held, using information in lieu of payment whenever possible.

Hunter’s Special ability, [c][F0FF23]Take a Shot[-][/c], Marks an enemy so allies can consistently attack a unit to gain Target Practice stacks and succeed at their rescue objective. [c][F0FF23]This Will Hurt[-][/c], his second Special, has a long cooldown but deals big damage and inflicts Protection Disruption and Shock as well as granting stacking Defense Penetration for Bad Batch allies.

His Unique ability, [c][F0FF23]Focus Co-operation[-][/c], provides multiple effects for both Marked enemies as well as Target Practice and refreshes the cooldown of This Will Hurt once a Bad Batch ally loses Captive. In the Territory Wars game mode with an Omicron upgrade, this ability has even more impact against Marked enemies, benefits for Hunter when he gains Target Practice, and allows for much more frequent use of This Will Hurt.

Unlock Hunter (Mercenary) in the upcoming “[c][E7E7E7]The Cavalry Has Arrived III[-][/c]” Marquee event that [c][E7E7E7]gives out daily rewards[-][/c] for the duration of the event!
data.NEWSLETTER_HUNTERS3_TITLE: If You Ever Need Us, We'll Be There
data.NEWSLETTER_HUYANG_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

[c][F0FF23]Huyang[-][/c] is coming to the Holotables!

An ancient droid that arrived at the Jedi Temple over twenty-five millennia ago in a noisy blue box, Huyang brings his knowledge of the Jedi and lightsabers to the Galaxy of Heroes battlefields. He has helped Padawans for generations in creating their first lightsabers, and most recently worked with Ahsoka Tano in her quest to find Grand Admiral Thrawn, and subsequently Ezra Bridger.

A rare Attacker Light Side Droid, Huyang brings damage to both the upcoming Ahsoka Tano squad as well as 50R-T led droids. [c][F0FF23]Auxiliary Grapplers[-][/c], his first special, unleashes a flurry of punches that do more damage per Spectre ally. The other special, [c][F0FF23]Stay Together[-][/c], provides key buffs like Damage Immunity for Light Side Droids and Spectre allies and calls a mass assist. In Territory Battles with an Omicron upgrade, this ability dispels all enemy buffs and ally debuffs, recovers Health and Protection for Light Side allies, and reduces the cooldown of Light Side Droid and Spectre abilities.

Huyang dishes out Jedi Lessons through his Unique ability, [c][F0FF23]Lightsaber Architect[-][/c], which also gives him [c][F0FF23]History of the Galaxy[-][/c] as allies lose Exile. This status upgrades twice to provide increasing Force Connection when Jedi, any Ahsoka, and Padawan Sabine Wren use an ability while they have Jedi Lessons.

Unlock Huyang in the upcoming “LOST AND FOUND II” Marquee event that [c][E7E7E7]gives out daily rewards[-][/c] for the duration of the event, and prepare for the upcoming [c][E7E7E7]Galactic Legend Ahsoka Tano[-][/c]!

data.NEWSLETTER_IDEN_VERSIO_CANTINA_TITLE: Iden Versio is available on Cantina nodes!
data.NEWSLETTER_IDEN_VERSIO_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

[c][F0FF23]Iden Versio[-][/c], the tenacious Imperial pilot who escaped the destruction of the Death Star during the Battle of Yavin, is landing on the holotables! A cunning mission planner, Iden was installed as the Commander of Inferno Squad and went to great lengths in her attempts to crush the Rebel Alliance.

Iden Versio is more than capable of calling the shots during battle, as evidenced by the fact her abilities often rely on the exclusion of other leaders in her squad. Iden strengthens Imperial Troopers, especially in Grand Arenas where her Omicron ability increases Imperial Trooper Health and Protection, and allows them to recover Health, Protection, and gain Turn Meter when enemy's attack out of turn. Iden also brings the new buff, [c][F0FF23]We Adapt, Or Die[-][/c], to the holotables, which can grant allies boosts to their Critical Chance, Offense, and Speed, as well as a self revive should the buffed ally be defeated. Iden’s resilience is also worth noting, given she revives with full Health and Protection if there is another active Imperial Trooper ally when she is defeated.

Unlock Iden Versio, the fan-favorite [i]Star Wars Battlefront II[/i] protagonist, by playing the all-new [c][F0FF23][i]Embers of the Empire[/i][-][/c] Marquee Event, and make today the day “the Rebellion dies!”
data.NEWSLETTER_IDEN_VERSIO_TITLE: They Have Hope. We Have Me.
data.NEWSLETTER_IG11_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

[c][F0FF23]IG-11[-][/c], the former assassin droid-turned-nurse, is coming to the holotables! As a nanny who takes a different approach to “tough love,” IG-11 is a steadfast protector of the Child and trusted colleague to Kuiil.

In addition to having a pack filled with ridiculously cute cargo, IG-11 brings some nursing skills to battle by granting allies additional Max Health. He also serves as a protector by Taunting and stealing the enemy's health to keep his allies safe. IG-11 adds even more utility to Droids and Scoundrels, as he assists during their turns and dispels debuffs.

Take IG-11 for a spin after unlocking him via Galactic Challenges!
data.NEWSLETTER_IG12_GROGU_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

[c][F0FF23]IG-12 & Grogu[-][/c] are coming to the Holotables! Constructed from the shell of the bounty hunter droid IG-11, IG-12 served as a vehicle to the diminutive Force-user. Grogu had access to the droid’s bacta spray which enabled him to heal his Mandalorian allies, and was able to communicate audibly through two buttons, Yes, and No.

IG-12 & Grogu bring plenty of support and healing for Light Side Mandalorians, especially The Mandalorian (Beskar Armor) and Bo-Katan (Mand’alor). Basic ability [c][F0FF23]No.[-][/c] and Special ability [c][F0FF23]No. No. No.[-][/c] debuff enemies to keep them subdued, while their Special ability [c][F0FF23]Yes.[-][/c] provides health and defense, and dispels debuffs.

Their Unique ability [c][F0FF23]Yes. Yes. Yes.[-][/c] has other Light Side Mandalorians assisting whenever IG-12 & Grogu use an ability, with different effects based on the ability used. This ability also gives IG-12 & Grogu the Scoundrel tag when under the leadership of The Mandalorian (Beskar Armor). With an Omicron upgrade in the Territory Wars game mode, IG-12 & Grogu receive more assists and can quickly step in to help an ally falling low on Protection.

Unlock IG-12 & Grogu during the upcoming “METAL MEDIATOR” Marquee event and prepare for the Epic Confrontation for Bo-Katan (Mand'alor) coming soon!
data.NEWSLETTER_IG90_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

[c][F0FF23]IG-90[-][/c] is coming to the Holotables!

IG-90 is the second character in the Era of Anniversary, inspired by the droid that helped launch Galaxy of Heroes ten years ago: IG-86.

A ruthlessly efficient assassin droid, IG-90 served as one of Doctor Aphra's more reliable companions during her various archaeological adventures and schemes. This deadly droid's precise targeting systems and advanced combat protocols made him an invaluable asset in both protection and offensive operations.

IG-90's Basic ability, [c][F0FF23]STATEMENT: Point Delivered[-][/c], showcases his deadly precision with multiple attacks while supporting his allies, particularly when paired with Doctor Aphra. His Special ability, [c][F0FF23]Devastating Barrage[-][/c], allows him to coordinate devastating attacks with other Dark Side Droids while providing tactical support by Marking an enemy and maintaining battlefield control with the Hacked Commando Droid.

Through his Unique ability [c][F0FF23]QUERY: Dead or Alive?[-][/c] and the Leader ability [c][F0FF23]Calculated Suppression[-][/c], IG-90 excels at supporting both Droid and Bounty Hunter teams, providing significant offensive capabilities while maintaining team survivability. In Territory Wars, he becomes even more formidable, offering powerful synergies with Doctor Aphra and providing crucial support to Scoundrel and Bounty Hunter allies.

Unlock IG-90 in the upcoming [c][E7E7E7]"SEEING RED"[-][/c] Marquee event that [c][E7E7E7]gives out daily rewards[-][/c] for the duration of the event! IG-90 is also one of the requirements (at 4 stars) to initially unlock the event for Maul (Hate-Fueled).
data.NEWSLETTER_IMPERIAL_SUPER_COMMANDO_UPDAT:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

[c][F0FF23]Imperial Super Commando[-][/c] has received a touchup to their kit! They will now have increased synergy with Dark Side Mandalorian allies, specifically Gar Saxon.

The following changes have been made to their abilities:

- [c][F0FF23]Upper Hand[-][/c] Unique ability now has the following effect: Whenever a dark side Mandalorian ally attacks out of turn, they deal additional True damage and recover 10% Protection. Whenever Imperial Super Commando or Gar Saxon attack out of turn, the other attacks as well (limit once per turn).
- The new Unique ability [c][F0FF23]Super Commando Beskar Armor[-][/c] reads: Imperial Super Commando and Gar Saxon gain +30% Defense, +50% Critical Avoidance, +20% Max Health, and +20% Max Protection. The first time either character would be defeated each encounter, they gain Damage Immunity for 1 turn, which can't be copied, dispelled, or prevented.
data.NEWSLETTER_IMPERIAL_TIE_BOMBER_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

The [c][F0FF23]Imperial TIE Bomber[-][/c] is making its way to the Holotables, ready to enforce the Empire's will on those who dare to rebel. Often serving in the first line of attack, TIE bombers drop vast quantities of munitions, delivering devastating attacks with frightening accuracy.

Although the TIE bomber is the first ship in Galaxy of Heroes to apply [c][F0FF23]Burning[-][/c], its main strength lies in being a defensive stalwart for Imperial factions. Crippling the enemy's offense and exhibiting bravado by taunting is all in a day's work as these crewless ships seek glory for the Empire. Add the TIE bomber to your fleet and show those Rebel scum the Empire will not tolerate insubordination.

Join the [c][F0FF23]Galactic Chase[-][/c] for the Imperial TIE Bomber and earn blueprints as a bonus reward on all [c][F0FF23]Cantina Battles[-][/c] nodes for a limited time starting June 4th!
data.NEWSLETTER_INCOMPLETE_SIGNAL_DATA_CANTIN: For a limited time, Incomplete Signal Data has been added to Cantina Battle nodes as bonus drops! During this event, the drop rate on each node has been scaled to Cantina Energy.\n\nCantina Battles are rewarding bonus drops from 06/21/2024 through 06/24/2024.
Incomplete Signal Data is available on Cantina Battle nodes!
data.NEWSLETTER_INQUISITOR_ASSAULT_BATTLE_DES: To prepare for the arrival of the Grand Inquisitor, the Inquisitorius are hunting down Force Users! A new assault battle, "[c][F0FF23]FANATICAL DEVOTION[-][/c]", is entering the event rotation. Gather your Inquisitors and head to the events table on 6/16.\n\nPurge the galaxy and remember... there are things more frightening than death.
data.NEWSLETTER_INQUISITOR_BARRISS_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

[c][F0FF23]Inquisitor Barriss[-][/c] is coming to the Holotables!

Once a compassionate Jedi healer and Ahsoka Tano's closest friend, Barriss Offee's disillusionment with the Jedi Order led her down a dark path. After her betrayal and imprisonment, she was eventually recruited into the Inquisitorius, where her healing abilities were twisted into tools of corruption and control. Now serving the Empire, she uses her knowledge of the Force to drain enemies and sustain her fellow Inquisitors.

Inquisitor Barriss' Basic ability, [c][F0FF23]Enfeebling Strike[-][/c], inflicts stacking Purge on enemies while healing Unaligned Force User allies and building her own Siphon. Her first Special ability, [c][F0FF23]Force Corruptor[-][/c], strips buffs from all enemies and Siphons Critical Damage from her primary target, with additional benefits when enemies have maximum Purge stacks. [c][F0FF23]Flicker of the Light[-][/c], her second Special ability, equalizes Health percentages among Unaligned Force User allies and provides substantial healing that scales with how much Purge has been consumed or resisted throughout the battle, while also sharing her Critical Damage with Inquisitorius Attackers.

Her Leader ability, [c][F0FF23]Those Left Behind[-][/c], grants Inquisitorius allies increased Health and sustained healing based on her own Max Health, while rewarding the team when enemies gain, resist, or are cleansed of Purge. In 3v3 Grand Arenas without Grand Inquisitor, this ability provides significant offensive bonuses and causes critical hits to apply Purge, while giving Second Sister Protection and frequent assists. Inquisitor Barriss' first Unique ability, [c][F0FF23]Reflexive Mercy[-][/c], prevents all revivals in battle and punishes enemies who critically hit her allies, while providing massive defensive bonuses when Ninth Sister is Taunting. Her final ability, [c][F0FF23]Patience[-][/c], grants her significant stat increases with a full Inquisitorius squad and allows her to gain Turn Meter when allies are critically hit, assists when allies damage enemies with Purge, and punishes enemies who attack her out of turn.

Unlock Inquisitor Barriss in the upcoming [c][F0FF23]"FROM LIGHT TO SHADOW"[-][/c] Marquee event that [c][F0FF23]gives out daily rewards[-][/c] for the duration of the event! Inquisitor Barriss is also one of the requirements (at 4 stars) to initially unlock the event for Maul (Hate-Fueled).
data.NEWSLETTER_INQUISITORIUS_UPDATE_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

Today’s Update introduces a new Unique ability [c][F0FF23]Patience[-][/c] to all Inquisitors! If all allies are Inquisitorius and there are at least 3 allies present, allies will gain additional Max Health, Max Protection, and Potency, will inflict Purge on enemies who attack out of turn, and will gain bonus Turn Meter whenever Purge is dispelled or is consumed. Additionally, each Inquisitor will receive a bonus specific to them as part of the Unique.

To celebrate the Inquisitorius, we are rerunning their Marquee events 4/28 - 5/10. These events cannot be completed again if they were already completed.

Go forth and bring glory to the Empire!

data.NEWSLETTER_JABBA_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

Galactic Legend [c][F0FF23]Jabba the Hutt[-][/c] is coming to Star Wars: Galaxy of Heroes! The first group of requirements to unlock Jabba the Hutt's event have been added to the Journey Guide.

Jabba the Hutt Requirements Group 1:

- Krrsantan - Relic 5
- Han Solo - Relic 8
- Gamorrean Guard - Relic 3
- Outrider - 7 stars
- Greedo - Relic 6

To prepare for his arrival, we are also introducing a new [c][F0FF23]Hutt Cartel[-][/c] tag that will be added to the following units: Boba Fett, Embo, Cad Bane, Greedo, Gamorrean Guard, and Mob Enforcer.
data.NEWSLETTER_JABBA_GL_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

Galactic Legend [c][F0FF23]Jabba the Hutt[-][/c] has slithered onto the Holotables! One of the most powerful crime lords in the galaxy, Jabba strikes fear with an ominous laugh.... and a pet Rancor.

His Leader ability, [c][F0FF23]His High Exaltedness[-][/c], provides multiple statistical and mechanical benefits for Bounty Hunter, Smuggler, and Hutt Cartel allies. He also provides important synergy to allies with [c][F0FF23]My Kind of Scum[-][/c] and can't be directly targeted by enemies while this buff is present in his squad.

Jabba utilizes the new buff, [c][F0FF23]Hired Muscle[-][/c], to bestow his allies with extra Tenacity and immunity to Daze and Fear (when in the presence of the mighty Jabba, what else could seem so fearsome?). Additional benefits are also provided based on the allies' role.

His Unique ability, [c][F0FF23]The Illustrious[-][/c], turns an enemy's benefit into a boon for his allies by providing bonus Turn Meter for his team whenever an enemy gains it for theirs.

Stay on Jabba's good side, because his Ultimate ability, [c][F0FF23]There Will Be No Bargain[-][/c], instantly defeats the target enemy and provides Health and Protection recovery for Bounty Hunter, Hutt Cartel, and Smuggler allies with Hutt Cartel allies also gaining bonus Turn Meter. Although they are not instantly defeated, raid bosses and Galactic Legends will still suffer dearly at the hands of Jabba's Ultimate when it is used against them.

Obtain Jabba the Hutt now through the all-new event [c][F0FF23]Greetings, Exalted One[-][/c], which can be accessed via the Journey Guide.
data.NEWSLETTER_JABBA_GL_TITLE: I Seek An Audience With Your Greatness
data.NEWSLETTER_JABBA_TITLE: Galactic Legend Jabba the Hutt is coming!
data.NEWSLETTER_JANGO_FETT_DESC:
Master assassin, father of Boba Fett, and one of the galaxy’s best Bounty Hunters, Jango Fett has joined the Holotables! Jango is a strong leader for any Bounty Hunter squad with his powerful attacks and amazing buffs for your entire team. Complete Jango’s Contract to give all allied Bounty Hunters an incredible buff: [c][f0ff23]BOUNTY HUNTER’S RESOLVE[-][/c] will revive your Bounty Hunters when they are defeated and allow them to ignore Taunt.

Cad Bane received a rework recently and now he’s getting his modified Rogue-class starfighter, Xanadu Blood! This stealthy support ship uses [c][f0ff23]BREACH[-][/c] to weaken its foes while protecting its allies. Form the ultimate Bounty Hunter fleet with Xanadu Blood, Slave I and the Hound’s Tooth.

There was another Bounty Hunter still looking for a Contract out in the galaxy, and she’s found it. The shapeshifter Zam Wesell has a few new tricks up her sleeve and maybe even a Thermal Detonator or two. Zam’s explosive new reworked kit means she loves to team up with anyone that can lob more detonators in the enemy squad’s direction. In addition, all characters that use Thermal Detonators received an upgrade: All Thermal Detonators can no longer be dispelled!
data.NEWSLETTER_JANGO_FETT_TITLE: Any Job for the Right Price
data.NEWSLETTER_JAPAN_GACHA_PACK_TITLEV2: Make your characters more powerful with the new Embersteel pack!
data.NEWSLETTER_JAR_JAR_BINKS_DESC:
Mesa greeting yousa Holotable Heroes,

The lovable jester from The Phantom Menace, [c][E7E7E7]Jar Jar Binks[-][/c], is coming to the Holotables!

Jar Jar Binks was an outcast Gungan who serendipitously ran into Qui-Gon Jinn and Obi-Wan Kenobi on Naboo during the Trade Federation’s invasion. This fast friendship led to the Jedi and Queen Amidala finding common ground between the Gungans and the Naboo, forming a formidable alliance that brought a new era of unity between the two residents of the planet.

Jar Jar is the final piece of the Gungan Squad, and requires all four other Gungans to be Relic 5 to unlock his Legendary event. Like Grand Inquisitor, Jar Jar’s event, [c][E7E7E7]Bombad General[-][/c], will consist of challenging encounters meant to put your Gungan squad and knowledge of their abilities to the test. These encounters are fun nods to the events of The Phantom Menace, meant to put a smile on your face as you go through them.

Jar Jar’s abilities each have a longshot chance at something special firing off, however much more likely against Separatist enemies. His Basic ability, [c][F0FF23]How Wude![-][/c], has a 1 in 10,000 chance of simply instantly defeating a random enemy. Additionally, How Wude! can inflict Deathmark, make an ally immune to damage, or give the squad Tenacity Up, but the effect is randomly determined when the ability is used.

His Special ability, [c][F0FF23]Wesa Warriors[-][/c], can inflict a new debuff, [c][E7E7E7]Frustration[-][/c] (a state of mind many people who have interacted with Jar Jar have found themselves in). Frustration prevents enemies from assisting or counter attacking, punishes gaining bonus Turn Meter by removing stacks of Recharge from the Shield Generator, and Ability Blocks them until they make another attack. Wesa Warriors can also alter debuffs on enemies into undispellable versions of themselves.

Jar Jar Binks’ Unique abilities ([c][F0FF23]Mesa Okeyday[-][/c] and [c][F0FF23]Mooie-Mooie, I Love You[-][/c]) play into his ability to find the positive outcome out of any situation, giving him Blind whenever he gains Foresight and then turning his attacks that miss into mass assists from the rest of the Gungan squad.

Jar Jar Binks completes the Gungan squad, and his event is only open for a limited time so make sure your Gungans are up to the task. The Gungan squad looks forward to taking on the Trade Federation in the [c][E7E7E7]Battle for Naboo[-][/c] raid, so fire up your shield generator and load your satchels full of boomas, okeyday?
data.NEWSLETTER_JAWA_ENGINEER_DESC:
Greetings, 

A new character is now available in Guild Store, Jawa Engineer. This unit is a high-speed Healer with a Critical Chance buff for both Jawas and Droids. 

Will you add this Jawa to your squad to form the ultimate Droid and Jawa synergy?
data.NEWSLETTER_JAWA_SCAVENGER_CHIEF_NEBIT_DE:
Chief Nebit and Jawa Scavenger are now available in Arena Shipments and Cantina Shipments, respectively.

Chief Nebit is a Jawa Tank and a natural choice for Jawa and Droid squads, granting them additional Critical Chance and the ability to lower the Critical Chance of their targets. His cunning also gives him the ability to call his allies to assist his attacks, grant stealth to his allies, and reduce their cooldowns. This synergy gives a great advantage to any Jawa or Droid in his squad.

Jawa Scavenger is a versatile Support who can inflict a variety of status effects on his enemies and buff his allies. Utilizing his ability, “Scrap Bomb”, Jawa Scavenger is able to detonate all Thermal Detonators and debuff affected enemies making them easy targets for his squad mates. In addition his unique ability, “Salvaged Equipment”, randomly grants Offense Up and Defense Up to his allies whenever he is stealthed.

Complete your Jawa party with these two desert dwellers!
data.NEWSLETTER_JEDI_FALLEN_ORDER_DESC:
Hello Holotable Heroes!

A Special Marquee Event (Trust Only in the Force) to welcome new players to the holotables is going on now.

During the event, you can play to unlock five Marquee Event characters (Cal Kestis, Cere Junda, Tarfful, Saw Gerrera, and Merrin). A bonus login calendar for additional items is also going to be available for new players to get you started on your journey. This login calendar is available to collect in the store starting at level 10 for new accounts.

Event requirements: 
- To be able to access the login calendar (CAL KESTIS WELCOME CALENDAR), players must be new installs at the time of the event.
- Marquee Events will become accessible starting at level 20. New players can access the event by collecting the login calendar for an XP boost.
- Marquee Events will be available for rewards to all players who do not already have 55+ shards of these heroes.

Event Start: 3.27.2025 11:00AM Pacific

Event End: 4.10.2025 11:00AM Pacific

Looking forward to seeing you on the holotables!

- STAR WARS™: Galaxy of Heroes team
