data.NEWSLETTER_JEDI_KNIGHT_CAL_KESTIS_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

[c][F0FF23]Jedi Knight Cal Kestis[-][/c], the persistent explorer and freedom fighter of the epic Jedi: Survivor game from Respawn, is coming to the holotables!

Cal works differently than any other character in the game, centering on changing his Lightsaber Configuration throughout battle. On each of his turn's, Cal must use his Basic ability [c][F0FF23]Less Civilized Age[-][/c] which grants him a bonus turn, where he will select [c][F0FF23]Double-Bladed[-][/c], [c][F0FF23]Dual-Wield[-][/c], or eventually [c][F0FF23]Crossguard[-][/c] for his Configuration based on the Special ability he uses. Double-Bladed lays down a spread of debuffs to manage enemies while Dual-Wield provides Cal and his allies with protective benefits.

Each Configuration provides a different passive bonus and which you choose is up to what situation you find yourself in during battle, but avoid staying with one Configuration too long because changing Configurations will accelerate your ability to use the Crossguard Configuration, which instantly defeats the first target enemy and does big single target damage!

His Omicron upgrades in Territory Battles make him reign supreme in that game mode. His Double-Bladed Special ability now applies Stun and Armor Shred to all enemies, his Crossguard Special ability ignores Protection and really cranks up the damage, and his Leader ability [c][F0FF23]Weight of the Galaxy[-][/c] amplifies the defensive abilities of his allies as well as opening Turn Meter and Frenzy. Use these overwhelming abilities in the Special Mission on Bracca to unlock Zeffo, the new Bonus Zone in the Rise of the Empire Territory Battle! On [c][F0FF23]Zeffo[-][/c], you’ll encounter exciting new enemies like Tomb Guardians and the relentless bounty hunters of the Haxion Brood.

Outside of Territory Battles, his Unique ability [c][F0FF23]Jedi Survivor[-][/c] protects Jedi from key weaknesses allowing players more flexibility with their powerful Jedi while in other game modes.

Unlock Jedi Knight Cal in the new limited time Hero’s Journey event!
data.NEWSLETTER_JEDI_KNIGHT_CAL_KESTIS_TITLE: It’s Time to Set You Free
data.NEWSLETTER_JEDI_KNIGHT_LUKE_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

Despite his humble beginnings as a Tatooine moisture farmer making runs to Tosche Station for power converters, we always knew [c][F0FF23]Luke Skywalker[-][/c] was destined for greater things. His victory over Jabba the Hutt was a mere hint at the strong bond Luke shared with the Force as a [c][F0FF23]Jedi Knight[-][/c], a lesson the Empire would later learn firsthand during the Battle of Endor. Luke's leader ability, [c][F0FF23]Return of the Jedi[-][/c], helps to restore balance to the Force by granting bonuses and dispelling negative effects from allies, while also setting all enemies to his base Speed.

Unlock [c][F0FF23]Jedi Knight Luke Skywalker[-][/c] by participating in the all new "[c][F0FF23]The Journey Continues - Jedi Knight Luke Skywalker[-][/c]" event.
data.NEWSLETTER_JEDI_KNIGHT_LUKE_REHEAT_DESC: Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\nJedi Knight Luke has been added to the Journey Guide and his event, The Journey Continues is back for a limited time! His quiet upbringing on Tatooine belied his destiny to become a Jedi Master but Luke faced many challenges as a Jedi Knight that shaped his connection with the Force. Feel like you could take on the whole empire by yourself? Unlock Jedi Knight Luke Skywalker and get ready for Galactic Legend, Jedi Master Luke Skywalker!
data.NEWSLETTER_JEDI_KNIGHT_LUKE_REHEAT_TITLE: Jedi Knight Luke Skywalker Joins the Journey Guide
data.NEWSLETTER_JEDI_MASTER_MACE_WINDU_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

A powerful Jedi Master and senior member of the Jedi Council, [c][F0FF23]Jedi Master Mace Windu[-][/c] brings new tactical mechanics to the holotables! As the commander of the elite Jedi Vanguard, Mace employs systematic investigation and revelation to dismantle formidable opponents.

His Leader ability, Solver, directs the squad to apply stacks of the new [c][F0FF23]Investigation[-][/c] effect, triggering other Jedi Vanguards’ abilities. Once a foe reaches 5 stacks, they become [c][F0FF23]Revealed[-][/c] - a devastating debuff that strips away their Critical Damage, and keeps them under a near-constant Expose, all the while allowing his squad to target the Revealed enemy by ignoring Taunt effects. 

[c][F0FF23]Shatterpoint[-][/c], Mace’s signature technique, returns on his Basic ability sharing the same name, and will reduce Vanguards’ cooldowns if the target was already inflicted with it. 

His first Special ability, [c][F0FF23]Decapitation Strike[-][/c], deals extra damage to enemy Leaders and Revealed foes while his second Special, [c][F0FF23]The Hammer of Ryloth[-][/c], punishes Investigated adversaries and dispels debuffs on his Jedi Vanguard squad.

His [c][F0FF23]Arrest Warrant[-][/c] Unique lets Mace bypass Taunt, deal bonus damage to Revealed enemies, and Vanguard Tanks Taunt when foes are Revealed. Mace’s Omicrons are in the Territory Wars  game mode, powering up Jedi Vanguards to be a top-tier team in that mode.

Face the greatest dangers in the galaxy with the upcoming [c][F0FF23]"BESET ON ALL SIDES"[-][/c] Legendary event to unlock [c][F0FF23]Jedi Master Mace Windu[-][/c]!
data.NEWSLETTER_JEDI_MASTER_OBI_WAN_EVENT_DES:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

Galactic Legend [c][F0FF23]Jedi Master Kenobi[-][/c] has joined the holotables!

Brimming with references to iconic Revenge of the Sith moments, Galactic Legend Jedi Master Kenobi has a kit that is as powerful as it is reverent to Episode III. Health and Protection recovery, Defense Penetration, Foresight, and Mastery, along with Speed and Health increases for allies are just the tip of the lightsaber. In addition to Galactic Republic characters, he also acts as a robust leader when paired with Light Side Unaligned Force Users.

When it comes to the opposition, Jedi Master Kenobi inflicts enemies with [c][F0FF23]Vulnerable[-][/c] and calls allies to assist, showcasing the intelligence and camaraderie he regularly displayed during battle.

Worthy of both the Jedi Master and Galactic Legend titles, if you’re not excited for this version of Obi-Wan, “then, you are lost!”
data.NEWSLETTER_JEDI_TRAINING_AAYLA_SECURA_DE: Gather up your party and prepare for a special 7-day Event to earn Jedi shards! data.NEWSLETTER_JG_DARTH_MALAK_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

Darth Malak's event, [c][f0ff23]Star Forge Showdown[-][/c], is now permanently playable in the Journey Guide for players who meet the requirements.

Darth Malak is a powerful Sith tank who uses Force Lightning to torture his enemies and drains their life in order to sustain himself. He tracked down the Star Forge under the orders of the Sith Emperor and eventually usurped the title of Dark Lord of the Sith from Revan, his old friend and Sith Master.

Head over to the Journey Guide to find out which characters and what gear you'll need to unlock his event.

See you on the holotables!
data.NEWSLETTER_JG_DARTH_MALAK_TITLE: Darth Malak now in the Journey Guide!
data.NEWSLETTER_JOCASTA_NU_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

[c][F0FF23]Jocasta Nu[-][/c] is coming to the Holotables!

Once the Chief Librarian for the Jedi Archives, after surviving the Purge Jocasta dedicated herself to preserving key Jedi knowledge. Don’t let her identity as a Librarian fool you - she wields the formidable [c][F0FF23]Lightsaber Rifle[-][/c] that uses her lightsaber as ammunition to fire powerful beams of energy before eventually exploding.

Jocasta Nu arrives as a key component to the new [c][FF00FF]Jedi Vanguard[-][/c] faction that will be filled out in the next Era with marquee units and a Legendary. She enters the fight with her lightsaber but as Jedi Vanguard allies use Special abilities she [c][F0FF23]transforms[-][/c] and wields the Lightsaber Rifle.

Her Basic ability will [c][F0FF23]spread certain debuffs[-][/c] that are on the target enemy to their allies and her Unique ability also spreads debuffs to enemies who debuff her. Her Special ability will dispel enemy buffs and accelerate her transform, then once she has transformed it will [c][F0FF23]Siphon Max Protection[-][/c] from the target enemy. Once she has transformed, if she is about to be defeated she attempts a [c][F0FF23]desperate move[-][/c] that can only save her if it defeats all enemies.

Her Omicrons apply to the Grand Arenas game mode, where her Special ability can [c][F0FF23]set an enemy’s Health to 66[-][/c] and her Basic ability spreads buffs that she has onto other allies. Additionally, her Unique Omicron will also accelerate her transformation by reducing the cooldown for any ally Vanguard ability used, not just Specials.

Unlock Jocasta Nu in the [c][E7E7E7]upcoming Conquest events[-][/c]!
data.NEWSLETTER_JOURNEY_GUIDE_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

Unsure how to unlock the greatest heroes and villains in the galaxy? The [c][F0FF23]Journey Guide[-][/c] is here to help - and it's available now! As part of this update, all existing Legendary, Journey, and Ancient Journey events have moved into the Journey Guide and are now replayable. Future versions of these events, as well as Epic Confrontations, will move into the Journey Guide sometime after their initial release. That means you can try many of these exciting events right now or any time you are ready!

The Journey Guide also reveals the newest type of character to the holotables: [c][F0FF23]Galactic Legends[-][/c]. The Galactic Legend designation will be reserved for the most famous and powerful characters in the galaxy, and the Journey Guide will be your path to unlocking them in future releases.

Speaking of Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker, the holotables have received some nefarious reinforcements in preparation for the conclusion of the Skywalker saga. The new [c][F0FF23]Sith Trooper[-][/c] is a powerful attacker with both Sith and First Order faction synergies. Alongside the Sith Trooper, [c][F0FF23]General Hux[-][/c] is also coming to the holotable. Both these new units heavily utilize Advantage and can quickly turn the tide of battle by bombarding the enemy with critical hits. General Hux can use Advantage to trigger a variety of beneficial effects for First Order allies, but watch out for his new Unique ability, [c][F0FF23]Dominance[-][/c], which stops his foes from counter-attacking while boosting the counter chance for his allies.

Earn these units in upcoming marquee events starting soon!
data.NEWSLETTER_JOURNEY_GUIDE_UPDATE_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

The Journey Guide has been updated with a streamlined experience and a brand new look! The Ships and Characters buttons have been combined into a single Collections button and you can now access the Journey Guide directly from the Cantina screen.

We have reorganized the Journey Guide into a gallery sorted by types of events and tiers of difficulty. Now you can quickly access all of the relevant information you need to unlock an exciting new character or ship. All requirements for each tier and the rewards are front and center so you can easily find what you need to complete your next battle.

In addition, there is a new option in the Journey Guide called [i]Begin Journey[/i] for each unit that will assist you in tracking its requirements. Once selected, you can find all the units needed for the entire event in a tab on the Collections screen and the units and gear required for the next step of the journey are clearly marked throughout the game with new icons.

We hope you enjoy the new streamlined Journey Guide experience! See you on the Holotables!
data.NEWSLETTER_JYN_ERSO_PVP_TOURNAMENT_DESC:
Rogue One's JYN ERSO has arrived, available as a reward in the new HERO OF THE REBELLION Squad Tournament! This tournament will take place on December 17th. You will need to be at least level 30 to have a chance to compete and win this iconic character.

Jyn Erso is a Rebel Attacker eager to bring the fight to the Empire. Her “Into the Fray” ability gives Rebel allies a Potency buff from the start of the encounter, with a chance to also inflict Expose whenever they inflict a debuff on enemies and recovering some Protection when they gain buffs. Not content to fight from the sidelines, Jyn leads from the front with her “Press the Attack” ability which deals damage to her enemy with a chance of giving her Advantage for 2 turns. If she finds her squad under fire, Jyn is also capable of utilizing a unique “Rebel Counterattack” ability, dealing AOE damage to her enemies, reviving a random Rebel ally, granting full Turn Meter to an ally of her choice!

Dominate the leaderboard in the Hero of the Rebellion tournament on December 17th to add Jyn Erso to your collection!

A Limited Time, Google Play Exclusive!
A reprogrammed Imperial security Droid turned Rebel agent, K-2SO is FREE to Google players! Collect him from the [i]Rogue One Heroes[/i] pack in the Store.

K-2SO is a Rebel tank capable of Dazing and Taunting his enemies while having a chance to counter attack whenever he takes damage. data.NEWSLETTER_KELLERAN_BEQ_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

[c][F0FF23]Kelleran Beq[-][/c] is coming to the Holotables! Known for training younglings before the fall of the Galactic Republic and renowned for his mastery of the lightsaber, he was the Jedi who heroically saved Grogu during Order 66 at the Jedi temple.

Kelleran works very well with other Galactic Republic Jedi, especially those not being used on a Galactic Legend squad. His Unique ability [c][F0FF23]The Sabered Hand[-][/c] pays homage to his lightsaber skills by converting some of his Health into Protection, then using that Protection to increase damage for himself and his allies through the [c][F0FF23]Padawan Lessons[-][/c] status effect and his Special ability [c][F0FF23]Jedi Bravery[-][/c].

Ever the protector, with an Omicron upgrade in the Territory Wars game mode while all allies are Galactic Republic and there are no Galactic Legends on his squad, his Leader ability [c][F0FF23]By The Will Of The Council[-][/c] gives big Defense to his allies while he is active yet keeps him alive while his allies have Protection.

Unlock Kelleran Beq during the upcoming “JEDI TEMPLE CHALLENGE” Marquee event and prepare for the Epic Confrontation for Bo-Katan (Mand'alor) coming soon!
data.NEWSLETTER_KIT_FISTO_CANTINA_MISSION_MES: Kit Fisto is now available in Cantina Battles Stage 4 Mission F! This Nautolan Jedi is a versatile attacker with a multi-attack, great counters and the ability to buff an entire team with Potency Up.\n\nWill you add this Jedi Master to your collection?
data.NEWSLETTER_KIT_FISTO_CANTINA_MISSION_TIT: Kit Fisto is now available in Cantina Battles!
data.NEWSLETTER_KIT_UPDATE_01_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

Rose Tico and Captain Phasma have been updated with Omicron Ability tiers! Both characters have a new tier added to one of their abilities that will boost their effectiveness in a specific game mode. The new top tier of each of these abilities will require the new Omicron material to unlock.

Rose Tico's Unique, [c][F0FF23]Valiant Spirit[-][/c], has been updated with a new tier that enhances Resistance allies in Grand Arena Championships. While in Grand Arena, Valiant Spirit will not only boost Rose's Offense for each Exposed enemy but will also apply this effect to Resistance squad mates. In addition, all Resistance allies will gain Turn Meter whenever a Resistance ally scores a critical hit while in Grand Arena.

Captain Phasma now has a new tier added to her Leader ability, [c][F0FF23]Fire at Will[-][/c], which boosts First Order squads while in Territory Wars. In this mode, Fire at Will provides Health and Protection recovery when a First Order ally attacks out of turn and stacking Offense and Turn Meter whenever a First Order ally gains Advantage.
data.NEWSLETTER_KIT_UPDATE_01_TITLE: Omicron Additions for Rose Tico and Captain Phasma
data.NEWSLETTER_KIT_UPDATE_02_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

Today's Update adds a new mode specific Omicron ability tier to Rebel Officer Leia Organa and Chief Nebit!

Rebel Officer Leia Organa's new Omicron tier on her Leader ability, [c][F0FF23]Battlefront Command[-][/c], increases the effectiveness of Rebels in Territory Battles and particularly during longer multi-encounter battles. Under this improved Leader ability, Rebel allies fully recover Health and Protection at the start of each encounter and whenever a Rebel ally is defeated. In addition, all friendly Rebels gain their Rebel ally's Offense when a Rebel ally is defeated.

Watch out! He's holding a thermal detonator! The Jawa squad explodes on to the Territory Wars map with Chief Nebit's freshly updated Leader ability, [c][F0FF23]Raiding Parties[-][/c]. In this mode, Jawas now dispel buffs whenever they deal damage to an enemy and inflicts Thermal Detonators for every buff dispelled. All those Thermal Detonator are really going to add up as Jawa allies recover Health and Protection, and gain Turn Meter whenever an enemy takes damage from a Thermal Detonator. When those Thermal Detonators explode, they also have a chance to apply another Thermal Detonator to keep the cycle going on and on!

Both of these Leader ability upgrades are now available for Omicron materials.
data.NEWSLETTER_KIT_UPDATE_02_TITLE: New Omicron Ability Tiers for Rebel Officer Leia Organa and Chief Nebit
data.NEWSLETTER_KIT_UPDATE_03_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

Today's Update adds an Omicron ability tier to Qui-Gon Jinn and Zam Wesell!

Wampa has a new Omicron tier added to his Unique ability, [c][F0FF23]Cornered Beast[-][/c], which powers up Wampa when deployed alone in Grand Arenas. Hi Holotable Heroes,

Mace Windu's kit has been updated with reworked abilities along with a new Special and Unique!

The debuff [c][F0FF23]Shatterpoint[-][/c] is the centerpiece of Mace’s updated kit. Attacking enemies with Shatterpoint reduces the target enemy's Attack, Defense, and Max Health for the rest of the encounter, and enables Mace to swap Turn Meter with Galactic Republic allies, stun his enemies, or recover his squad's Health and Protection depending on which ability he uses. This rework introduces a new buff, [c][F0FF23]Resilient Defense[-][/c], which works similarly to Taunt but only lasts for a certain number of attacks.

Mace also has a new Omicron ability tier which enables other Light Side allies to apply Speed Down and Shatterpoint to a random enemy while in Territory Wars. Additionally, in this mode all allies gain Turn Meter whenever an ally damages an enemy with Shatterpoint.

See you on the holotables!

data.NEWSLETTER_KIX_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

The last surviving Clone Trooper and newest member of Captain Ithano’s crew, Kix, is heading to the holotables.

We've got an unexpected new Pirate joining forces with Captain Ithano and the other Pirate gangs. Wearing decades-old Clone Trooper Phase I armor, Kix, the former medic of General Skywalker’s 501st, brings his skills in healing alongside a ruthless battlefield acumen to the Pirate squads!

This battle-hardened veteran really packs a punch when it comes to keeping his Pirate pals alive and kicking. His Basic ability, [c][F0FF23]Rapidfire Blast[-][/c], can dispel debuffs while granting Tenacity Up. Each critical hit also provides Health and Protection recovery.

As a Healer, where Kix really shines is with his incredible medical skills. His [c][F0FF23]Explosive Response[-][/c] Special ability lets him shake off all debuffs and then Steal Health and Protection-style buffs from the enemy to share with allies. If the target is Sith, he'll even increase their cooldowns, because why not make it extra difficult?

The headliner ability is Kix's [c][F0FF23]Emergency Medpac[-][/c]. This Special ability can revive a fallen Pirate ally at 50% health and protection, granting them Taunt if they are a tank or Stealth otherwise. On top of that, Pirate allies recover Health and Protection! The revive shenanigans only get crazier from there depending on Kix's Profit stacks, including granting Damage Immunity if his Profit is high enough.

His Unique ability, [c][F0FF23]Republic Medic Corps[-][/c], is an entire toolkit of support wizardry. Kix gets massive speed boosts for injured Pirates, Stealths himself when damaged, and provides all sorts of escalating bonuses like bonus Protection, turn meter gain, offense boosts, and even revive prevention if he has enough profit stacks!

Upgrade this with the Omicron ability and Kix becomes an absolute terror in Territory Wars. Revived allies get bonus turns, cooldown resets, and either Taunt or Stealth. If allies stay dead, the team gets stacking stat boosts. 

This grizzled clone is the ultimate Pirate life insurance policy. Earn Kix in the upcoming [c][E7E7E7]"TROUBLE ON THE HORIZON III"[-][/c] Marquee event as the Pirates continue to assemble their fearsome crew! Kix is also part of the second batch of requirements for Galactic Legend Pirate King Hondo Ohnaka (which is now in the Journey Guide), so make sure you're ready for his release at the end of the Era.
data.NEWSLETTER_KLEYA_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

[c][F0FF23]Kleya[-][/c] is coming to the Holotables!

As partner to Luthen Rael for most of her life, Kleya Marki has become an instrumental part of turning the rebellion into a Rebel Alliance. Using a secret fractal radio in the back of Luthen’s antiquities shop she coordinated Rebel cells and agents for years right under the Empire’s noses.

Kleya introduces a new mechanic used by both the Rebels and ISB in this Era: [c][F0FF23]Undermine[-][/c]. Undermine is a blue Status Effect that gives the affected unit +25 Speed, -25% Critical Avoidance and Critical Chance, and the inability to gain bonus Turn Meter. Additional effects triggered off Undermine are sprinkled throughout all the kits for the Era of Andor.

Kleya’s Basic ability, [c][F0FF23]What Revolution Looks Like[-][/c], shows exactly how deadly she is with a blaster, always critically hitting if all of her allies are Rebel Fighters, and dealing even more damage to Undermined enemies. She can inflict Undermine via her first Special ability, [c][F0FF23]I Know What I Want[-][/c], as well as call allies to assist, dealing even more damage to the enemy. [c][F0FF23]This Is Do or Die[-][/c], her second Special ability, deals damage to all enemies as well as Burning them. Additionally, there is an effect with your allied Luthen Rael that has a great chance of snatching victory from the jaws of defeat via the new buff [c][F0FF23]Rebel Network[-][/c].

Her Unique ability, [c][F0FF23]I Don’t Have Lately, I Have Always[-][/c], gives Kleya bonuses when Undermined enemies inflict debuffs on her, and she can’t be targeted if there is an active allied Luthen Rael. With her Omicron ability in 3v3 Grand Arenas, Kleya borrows the Axis and Curator effects that were first seen on Luthen, with some minor modifications. Pulling off the effect involving an allied Luthen Rael and Kleya’s Special ability This Is Do or Die becomes much easier as Kleya gets the cooldown reset and a bonus turn when the conditions are right.

Unlock Kleya in the upcoming [c][F0FF23]THE GALLERY OF SECRETS[-][/c] Marquee event that [c][F0FF23]gives out daily rewards[-][/c] for the duration of the event! Kleya is also one of the requirements (at 4 stars) to initially unlock the event for Cassian Andor (Undercover).

data.NEWSLETTER_KRAYT_DRAGON_HUNT_DESC:
Prepare yourselves, Holotable Heroes.

Sharpen your gaderffii, arm your whistling birds, and prime your thermal detonators! It's time to take on the fearsome, legendary leviathan of the Tatooine wastes in the newest raid to come to the holotables, the [c][F0FF23]Krayt Dragon Hunt[-][/c]. Inspired by its appearance in the second season of The Mandalorian, the [c][F0FF23]Krayt Dragon[-][/c] is a formidable foe that will assail your squads with its [c][F0FF23]Corrosive Venom Spray[-][/c], grind them down in its [c][F0FF23]Crushing Maw[-][/c], and even swallow them whole. Assemble your best squads of Hutt Cartel, Mandalorians, Tuskens, Jawas, and Old Republic characters as you and your guild work together to make the sands of Tatooine safer for those who call them home.

To accompany this raid's release, we have also reworked how guilds interact with raids. We've consolidated all [c][F0FF23]Raid Ticket[-][/c] currencies into one, and guilds now run one raid at a time, with rewards granted by each individual raid increased significantly to compensate. You'll no longer compete with your guild members for raid rewards but will work together to earn raid points for a collective reward at the end of the raid. In the Krayt Dragon Hunt, you'll also earn personal rewards as you earn points for your guild, so make sure to get those attempts in!

The Krayt Dragon Hunt is also the first raid to use our new system of [c][F0FF23]Difficulty Modifiers[-][/c], so players can take on a challenge appropriate to their squad's power level, whether that be Gear X or Relic 8. To celebrate the raid's release, we've also completely filled the coffers of every guild with the new, consolidated Raid Ticket currency, so jump into the new raid system and start earning rewards right away!
data.NEWSLETTER_KRENNIC_AND_DEATH_TROOPER_DES:
Two new characters have arrived, DIRECTOR KRENNIC and the DEATH TROOPER! These powerful Imperial characters have great synergy together and are specialized in taking out Rebels.

Director Krennic is a potent support character that uses powerful debuffs against his foes, including the all-new debuff STAGGER! This debuff is inflicted using his DEATH TROOPER ASSAULT ability, and removes 100% turn meter when the Staggered enemy takes damage. When Director Krennic uses his EXPERIMENTAL WEAPONRY ability, he will inflict a different type of debuff on each type of character, such as stunning Attackers, inflicting ability block on Healers, and placing Buff Immunity on Tanks.

Death Trooper is a powerful attacker and the perfect addition to a squad with Director Krennic in it. Whenever the Death Trooper scores a critical hit, he and Director Krennic recover Health. The DEATH TROOPER'S GRENADE ability removes all buffs from enemies and inflicts healing immunity on them, punishing squads that rely on buffs. TERMINATE is the Death Trooper’s most powerful ability, guaranteeing a critical hit if the enemy has any debuffs on them and making them unable to be revived if defeated by it once upgraded.

Unlock both of these powerful new units in the all-new SPECIAL OPERATIONS Marquee Event!
data.NEWSLETTER_KRENNIC_AND_DEATH_TROOPER_TIT: NEW CHARACTERS - Director Krennic and Death Trooper
data.NEWSLETTER_KRENNIC_EVENT_DESC:
Get ready to earn shards for Director Krennic and one of his Death Troopers in an all-new limited time event!

Throughout this four phase event, you will have the chance to play with Director Krennic and his Death Trooper, and later battle against them. If you manage to defeat Krennic and his Death Troopers, you will be rewarded with a chance to unlock them both!

These Special Operation events each have multiple tiers of difficulty and will be available starting at Level 20. These events can only be completed once.
data.NEWSLETTER_KRRSANTAN_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

[c][F0FF23]Krrsantan[-][/c], the vicious Wookiee warrior, is coming to the holotables!

Krrsantan is a Bounty Hunter Tank who specializes in protecting his Hutt Cartel allies. His Special ability [c][F0FF23]Dismember[-][/c] introduces a new debuff [c][F0FF23]Disarm[-][/c]. Disarm reduces a unit's Critical Damage and Offense and inflicts them with Damage Over Time whenever they use a Basic ability. Hutt Cartel allies stack Offense when critically hit through his Leader ability, [c][F0FF23]Formidable Ferocity[-][/c], and Krrsantan can gain Taunt and recover Health and Protection through his Special ability [c][F0FF23]Ferocious Fusillade[-][/c].

His Unique ability, [c][F0FF23]Champion of the Fighting Pits[-][/c], grants him additional Defense and Max Health, along with Health and Protection recovery when he loses Taunt. If all allies are Hutt Cartel, he also Taunts at the beginning of the encounter and will revive at the end of the allied Leader's turn the first time he is defeated. The Omicron for this ability focuses on Grand Arenas where he gains additional Max Protection and, if all allies are Hutt Cartel, he is immune to Ability Block and cooldown increase.

Add Krrsantan to your roster by unlocking him in the all-new “ONE INFAMOUS WOOKIEE” Marquee event!
data.NEWSLETTER_KUIIL_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

One of the Galaxy’s most mechanically-inclined ugnaughts, [c][F0FF23]Kuiil[-][/c], is making his way to the holotables! Although Kuiil had worked for years to escape Imperial servitude to find solace on Arvala-7, fate came calling with other plans. Soon Kuiil found himself rescuing a Mandalorian, reprogramming a menacing IG unit, and protecting an adorable, tiny green creature.

Kuiil’s Special ability, [c][F0FF23]I Have Spoken[-][/c], introduces the new [c][F0FF23]Mechanic’s Savvy[-][/c] buff, which works with Scoundrels and Droids. Scoundrels will benefit from increased Critical Damage perks, while Light Side Droids receive increased Offense and revive capabilities. One Droid in particular, IG-11, will help Kuiil during battle by ensuring he can’t be critically hit or Stunned while they stand together in arms.

Adding Kuiil to your collection of heroes is easier than facing off with a feral blurrg. For the first time ever, you’ll be able to unlock a new character by heading over to the Galactic Challenges.
data.NEWSLETTER_KYLE_KATARN_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

The Rebel Fighter and reluctant Jedi, [c][F0FF23]Kyle Katarn[-][/c], joins the holotables! Kyle Katarn always felt a connection to the Force during his time working as a covert Rebel agent. It took many years for Kyle to realize he was force-sensitive and, after facing down the Sith himself, he finally accepted his destiny of becoming a Jedi Knight. During battle, Kyle Katarn builds up his [c][F0FF23]Force Connection[-][/c] to gain a new buff, [c][F0FF23]Jedi Knight[-][/c], which grants his abilities additional effects and his allies increased Offense and Defense.

Kyle Katarn works well with Rebel Fighters or Jedi squads, and excels when used in Territory Battles. In this mode, his new debuff, [c][F0FF23]Force Influence[-][/c], which stops the enemy from counterattacking, assisting, or gaining buffs, can't be resisted.

While Kyle Katarn is not a leader himself, his unique, [c][F0FF23]Blue Milk Run[-][/c], powers up his Rebel Fighter allies and increase their Offense when they attack out of turn. While in Territory Battles, these bonuses and the bonuses from Jedi Knight are also extended to Jedi allies.

Confront the dark side and earn shards of Kyle Katarn in the all new Marquee event, Dark Forces!
data.NEWSLETTER_KYLE_KATARN_TITLE: This Should Be A Total Blue Milk Run
data.NEWSLETTER_KYLO_REN_UNIT_PROMO_DESC: Dominate the hologames with this First Order attacker character inspired by Star Wars: The Force Awakens. Learn Kylo's strategy in our forums today. https://forums.galaxy-of-heroes.starwars.ea.com/
data.NEWSLETTER_LANDO_ANNOUNCEMENT_DESC:
Greetings Heroes,

Shards for Lando Calrissian can now be obtained from Cantina Battles 1-E and 5-F.

We hope you all enjoy another way to collect Shards for Lando Calrissian!
data.NEWSLETTER_LANDO_L3_DESC:
To celebrate the release of the new film, Solo: A Star Wars Story, Young Lando Calrissian, L3-37 and Lando's Millennium Falcon join Young Han Solo, Vandor Chewbacca and Qi'ra on the Holotables! Power up these new units and complete the new Solo team.

Rounding out the [c][F0FF23]Prepared[-][/c] squad, Young Lando Calrissian and L3-37 bring their own spin to hustling the holotables. Young Lando deals more damage with his basic attack for each [c][F0FF23]Prepared[-][/c] ally. He can also grant his [c][F0FF23]Prepared[-][/c] buff to another ally while providing all other [c][F0FF23]Prepared[-][/c] allies with Speed Up. L3-37 can use [c][F0FF23]Prepared[-][/c] to gain stacking Max Health from her basic attack and can use [c][F0FF23]Prepared[-][/c] to grant health and protection to Scoundrel and Droid allies. L3-37 also brings her penchant for [c][F0FF23]Self-Modification[-][/c] to the table and can upgrade her Counter Chance, Critical Avoidance, and Defense over the course of battle.

Not only do these two new Scoundrels make excellent additions to the [c][F0FF23]Prepared[-][/c] squad, but they are also the crew for Lando's Millennium Falcon! This Millennium Falcon delivers a devastating new Reinforcement Ability to the holotable – when the Falcon enters combat it gains Critical Damage Up, copies all buffs on all other ships, and takes a turn for each reinforcement previously called! Collect and power up these all new characters in the final set of the Preparation Perfection Marquee event series!
data.NEWSLETTER_LANDO_L3_TITLE: Young Lando Calrissian, L3-37, and Lando's Millennium Falcon have arrived!
data.NEWSLETTER_LEIA_ORGANA_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

Galactic Legend [c][F0FF23]Leia Organa[-][/c] has arrived on the Holotables to lead the Rebellion! Raised as a Princess on the planet Alderaan, Leia would eventually use the cover of being a Senator while being a key member of the Rebel Alliance in their fight against the Empire. Leia found herself as a General in the Rebellion, leading troops in the field more often than from the command center.

Leia excels as a tactical leader and thrives best when used on Offense. Her Basic ability [c][F0FF23]Righteous Retribution[-][/c] and Special abilities [c][F0FF23]Rebel Ambush[-][/c] and [c][F0FF23]Tactical Offensive[-][/c] provide differing effects based on the target enemy’s role, and Tactical Offensive sets up for key big hits especially when used with Captain Drogan. These abilities also introduced [c][F0FF23]Ambush[-][/c] stacks to reduce Speed and eventually become [c][F0FF23]Ambushed[-][/c] to disabled enemy Protection and Protection effects!

Her Leader ability [c][F0FF23]I Know[-][/c] leans into her insightful leadership and control of the battlefield. Out of turn attacks from enemies do less damage and stack Mastery for non-Scoundrel Rebel allies, and cooldown manipulation is controlled to keep enemies from gaining an advantage. In addition to strong synergy with Burning, this ability also provides [c][F0FF23]Second Wind[-][/c] to keep a non-Scoundrel Rebel ally from being defeated when they lose Protection the first time.

[c][F0FF23]Forever our Princess[-][/c] rings true as her Unique ability, which highlights her identity as a key target for enemies to take out, a feat not so easily accomplished. When she is not damaged, she gains [c][F0FF23]Fearless[-][/c], which not only fuels her Ultimate ability but also stacks her Max Health and reduces enemy Mastery. Speaking of her Ultimate, [c][F0FF23]These are my Friends[-][/c] introduces Fracturing the entire enemy squad, and if it defeats anyone Rebel allies are revived ready to get back into the action.

Obtain Leia Organa now through the event [c][F0FF23]Rebel With A Cause[-][/c], which can be accessed via the Journey Guide!
data.NEWSLETTER_LEIA_ORGANA_TITLE: Somebody Has To Save Our Skins

data.NEWSLETTER_LEVIATHAN_DESC:
Hello Holotable Heroes,

Before his capture and subsequent memory-wipe by the Jedi Council of the Old Republic, Darth Revan led a powerful Sith Empire fleet from his flagship, [c][F0FF23]Leviathan[-][/c]. When the situation would warrant it, Darth Revan himself would lead boarding parties of Sith soldiers onto enemy capital ships while his squadrons engaged the enemy on the battlefield. His goal with these boarding actions was simple: cripple the enemy ship from within and lead his soldiers to a final showdown on the enemy’s bridge, wresting control of it and adding its firepower to his own fleet.

With the Raddus we had you destroying the enemy’s capital ship at the expense of your own. With Executor and Profundity, we allowed you to keep your capital ship while removing the enemy’s from the battlefield. Leviathan brings this escalation to the logical conclusion. What’s better than destroying the enemy capital ship? Taking it for yourself! Leviathan’s abilities will have you progressively taking over the enemy capital ship by first using [c][F0FF23]Sabotage the Hangars[-][/c] to destroy their next reinforcement, then using [c][F0FF23]Sabotage the Engines[-][/c] to slow it down, then finally using [c][F0FF23]Seize the Bridge[-][/c] to take full control of the ship for yourself (except for its Ultimate ability and their remaining reinforcements).

Achieve dominance on the Holotables by adding Leviathan to your ships roster through the all new Journey Guide Fleet Mastery event!
data.NEWSLETTER_LOBOT_UPDATE_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

[c][F0FF23]Lobot[-][/c] has received a rework to his kit! He will now have increased synergy with Light Side Droid allies when under a Light Side Droid Leader.

The following changes have been made to his abilities:

- "[c][F0FF23]Calculated Aggression[-][/c]" Basic ability now has a 100% Defense Down chance (previously 80%) and Light Droid allies gain Defense Up if the ally in the Leader slot is a Light Side Droid. If the enemy already had Defense Down, inflict Target Lock, and if they were already Target Locked, Lobot gains Foresight.

- "[c][F0FF23]Optimize[-][/c]" The text has been updated to reflect the functionality (no gameplay changes were made)

- "[c][F0FF23]Lobot-tech Headgear[-][/c]" The text has been updated to reflect the functionality and the name has been changed (no gameplay changes were made)

- "[c][F0FF23]Parallel Processing[-][/c]" Unique ability now gives an additional random Light Side Droid ally Foresight whenever one gains Foresight. Light Side Droid allies gain increased Critical Damage and Potency when debuffs are dispelled on them and whenever bonus Turn Meter is gained, Lobot gains Speed Up. While Lobot has Speed Up he has increased Critical Chance and removes Turn Meter when he uses his Basic ability.

- NEW: "[c][F0FF23]Cloud Computing[-][/c]" An additional Unique ability has been added to Lobot. This ability provides Lobot with the Droid tag when under a Light Side Droid Leader and inflicts Target Lock on enemies that inflict debuffs on Light Side Droid allies. Using Basic abilities against Target Locked enemies will call Lobot to assist and Light Side Droid allies with Foresight have increased Critical Chance and can inflict Speed Down.
data.NEWSLETTER_LOGIN_CALENDAR_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

Today's Title Update brings a number of changes to Galaxy of Heroes! One of the first things you will notice is an update to something you see everyday when you login to the game, the [c][F0FF23]Login Calendar[-][/c]! We have reworked the Login Calendar with a new look and now additional calendars can be activated for extra daily rewards. These Login Calendars can be free or purchasable and may coincide with special occasions or monthly themes.

You can activate multiple at a time and gather rewards from each calendar every day. Don’t forget to login each day to collect your rewards!

Check out the other newsletters for the rest of the changes that were released with this Title Update.
data.NEWSLETTER_LORD_OF_HUNGER_DESC:
Introducing the "Lord of Hunger", a 4 part Event! In the first 3 Events, fight alongside Darth Nihilus, the Sith Empire Trooper, and the Sith Assassin. In the final Event, bring your best squad to fight against them.

The Events unlock at level 20 with four tiers of difficulty at 20, 40, 60, and 80. There are no restrictions on the characters you may put in your squad, so bring your most powerful characters to earn shards for Darth Nihilus, Sith Empire Trooper, and the Sith Assassin.

Do you have what it takes to defeat The Lord of Hunger and add him to your collection?
data.NEWSLETTER_LORD_VADER_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

Galactic Legend [c][F0FF23]Lord Vader[-][/c] marches onto the Holotables! Having purged the weakness of Anakin Skywalker, the former Jedi is now the newest Lord of the Sith and apprentice to the vile Darth Sidious.

Rising from the ashes of the Republic, Lord Vader will provide the Empire faction with a dedicated Galactic Legend. With his anger fueling his attacks, Lord Vader is not to be underestimated. His Ultimate allows him to gain additional effects, ensures that enemies defeated during Lord Vader's turn can't be revived, and makes him immune to Ability Block.

In addition to increasingly more damaging attacks and massive synergy with both Empire and Dark Side Unaligned Force Users, Lord Vader can deal damage to all enemies while applying Daze and Damage Over Time. Lord Vader's attacks can't be evaded and he is immune to Turn Meter manipulation, all of which is just the beginning of his extensive and powerful kit. Cue the heavy breathing!

Obtain Lord Vader now through the all-new [c][F0FF23]Hero’s Fall[-][/c] event, which can be accessed via the Journey Guide. While it is the same structure as Jedi Master Kenobi’s Galactic Legend event, we feel the title “Hero's Fall” is only fitting for this event in contrast to the Hero's Journey events in our game.
data.NEWSLETTER_LORD_VADER_REQUIREMENTS_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

Galactic Legend [c][F0FF23]Lord Vader[-][/c] is coming to Star Wars: Galaxy of Heroes! The first group of requirements to unlock Lord Vader's event have been added to the Journey Guide.

Lord Vader Requirements Group 1:

Hunter - Relic 5
Tech - Relic 5
Wrecker - Relic 5
Tusken Raider - Relic 5
Padmé Amidala - Relic 8

Lord Vader Requirements Group 3 Sneak Peak:

General Skywalker - Relic 8
data.NEWSLETTER_LORD_VADER_REQUIREMENTS_TITLE: Galactic Legend Lord Vader's 1st Requirements Added To The Journey Guide
data.NEWSLETTER_LORD_VADER_ULTIMATE_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

With the Galactic Legend Lord Vader getting his retinue of Dark Side Clones, we are augmenting the way he gains Ultimate Charge.

Until now when debuffed Dark Side allies received damage Lord Vader gained 2% Ultimate Charge, increased to 3% if that ally was an Unaligned Force User.

With this update when debuffed Dark Side allies receive damage Lord Vader gains 2% Ultimate Charge, increased to 3% if that ally was an Unaligned Force User or Dark Side Clone Trooper when all other allies were Dark Side Clone Troopers at the start of battle.

This adjustment does not impact Lord Vader with his original units and greatly improves Lord Vader’s performance with the new Dark Side Clone Troopers. Go forth and Execute Order 66!
data.NEWSLETTER_LUKE_FLASH_EVENT_DESC: The month of May sees the introduction of our new Flash Events! Unlike other events, Flash Events only last one to four hours in each instance and repeat several times a day, so be sure to catch them when they launch! Flash Events difficulty and rewards are based off your account level. All initial runs of a Flash Event have more generous rewards, so be sure to participate early and often!\n\nOur first Flash Event takes you to the harsh desert planet of Tatooine. This lawless world holds many dangers and mysteries, especially for moisture farmers. To participate in this multi-tiered event, task Luke Skywalker with inspecting the perimeter of the farm as you join forces with Jawas to square off against marauding Tusken Raiders.
data.NEWSLETTER_LUTHEN_RAEL_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

[c][F0FF23]Luthen Rael[-][/c] is coming to the Holotables!

The mysterious runner of various spy networks and excellent monologue speaker, Luthen dedicated himself to the Rebellion despite knowing he would not see it fulfilled. Working with Mon Mothma, Saw Gerrera, and eventually recruiting Cassion Andor to the Alliance, he allied with many people but would also sacrifice others for his belief in the long term necessity for the fall of the Empire.

Deeply involved with the Rebellion in multiple ways, Luthen will adapt to the situation he is in. If Saw Gerrera is the Leader, Luthen will gain the Axis effect. Otherwise Luthen gains the Curator effect to reinforce Rebels such as Mon Mothma’s squad. As [c][F0FF23]Axis[-][/c], Luthen acts much more offensively, while as [c][F0FF23]Curator[-][/c] he focuses more on keeping his allies alive and supported.

Luthen summons a Rebel Commander to keep himself hidden, however his interaction with this summon also depends on which effect he has. As Axis, this summon becomes an Expendable Asset that is marked and benefits allies when defeated. As Curator, the summon is instead supported and prioritized being kept alive.

With Omicron upgrades in the Grand Arenas game mode, his Basic ability, [c][F0FF23]Tools of my Enemy[-][/c] provides him with Speed and reduces his enemy’s Defense, his Special ability, [c][F0FF23]What Do I Sacrifice?[-][/c], increases ally Offense and provides a way to ignore Taunt, and his Unique ability, [c][F0FF23]Dreams With Ghosts[-][/c], increases crucial stats for the team.

Unlock Luthen Rael in the upcoming Conquest events!
data.NEWSLETTER_MAGMATROOPER_ANNOUNCEMENT_DES:
Greetings Heroes,

The daily login and brand new character for March is the Magmatrooper from Star Wars Battlefront! Log in each day this month in order to obtain enough Shards to unlock him.

Be sure to play with your sound on when you have the Magmatrooper in your squad to hear the sound of his Thermal Imploder ability!
data.NEWSLETTER_MAGMATROOPER_ANNOUNCEMENT_TIT: Daily Login Character for March: Magmatrooper
data.NEWSLETTER_MAGMATROOPER_SHIPMENT_DESC: Greetings Heroes,\n\nThe Magmatrooper from Star Wars Battlefront is now available in Galatic War Shipments! We hope you all enjoy another way to collect Shards for Magmatrooper!
data.NEWSLETTER_MANDALORE_TB_DESC:
This is the way Holotable Heroes,

We are back continuing to explore the galactic map in the Rise of the Empire Territory Battle, discovering a new hyperspace route to [c][F0FF23]Mandalore[-][/c], the home planet of the Mandalorians that was brought under Imperial control shortly after the Empire’s inception.

Mandalore is home to heroes from all sides of the conflict, most notably Bo-Katan Kryze, Sabine Wren, and Din Djarin (aka the Mandalorian). The Mandalorian Clans form the backbone of their culture. The head of Clan Kryze, Bo-Katan, ruled Mandalore until she was overthrown by Gar Saxon of Clan Saxon who pledged the planet’s loyalty to the Galactic Empire.

Unlock Mandalore via the [c][F0FF23]Tatooine Special Mission[-][/c] requiring Relic 7 Bo-Katan (Mand’alor) and The Mandalorian (Beskar Armor) as you take down one of the fearsome Krayt Dragons on the desert planet. 25 successful completions of the mission in your guild are required to unlock access to Mandalore each Territory Battle.

Mandalore itself is home to multiple [c][F0FF23]Combat Missions[-][/c], two of which require Relic 8 characters and the third requiring a squad of Relic 9 characters led by [c][F0FF23]Bo-Katan (Mand’alor)[-][/c]. One of the Relic 8 missions will require [c][F0FF23]Dark Trooper Moff Gideon[-][/c], but beyond the minimum Relic levels there are no other restrictions on who you can bring. A Fleet mission will require a 7-star [c][F0FF23]Gauntlet Starfighter[-][/c].

Details on the units needed to fill the Operations, as well as the planet’s modifiers and Operation ability can be found in a post on our forums.

Mandalore continues our efforts to expand the Rise of the Empire Territory Battle while challenging your collection to bring to life the exciting moments you remember, so strap on your Beskar armor and fight like a Mandalorian. This is the way!
data.NEWSLETTER_MANDO_BESKAR_DESC:
Hello Holotable Heroes,

[c][F0FF23]The Mandalorian (Beskar Armor)[-][/c] is heading to the Holotables in spectacular, shiny fashion! From his meek beginnings as a foundling to his transformation into a fully Beskar-clad protector of the Child, Din Djarin embodies the toughness required to survive in the frontier of the Outer Rim. Whether they’re brought in warm or brought in cold, The Mandalorian always delivers his bounty.

Equipped with [c][F0FF23]Whistling Birds[-][/c], The Mandalorian (Beskar Armor) is prepared to lead Scoundrels into battle, while adding survivability to the faction by dispelling debuffs and equalizing Protection. His immunity to Ability Block and some help from a little, adorable friend add to an already impressive array at Mando’s disposal.

Unlock The Mandalorian (Beskar Armor) by heading to his Hero’s Journey, immediately and permanently available in the Journey Guide now!

This is the way.
data.NEWSLETTER_MANDO_DESC: Known to many as [c][F0FF23]the Mandalorian[-][/c], this mysterious man of few words works as a Bounty Hunter at the far edge of the galaxy. No one really knows where he came from or how he's so well-equipped for battle but few question his ability to bring in a target. Whether taking a [c][F0FF23]Swift Shot[-][/c] with his blaster pistol or readying his Amban sniper rifle to instantly disintegrate his enemy, the Mandalorian is always prepared to take on whatever gets in his way.\n\nUnlock the Mandalorian this week in the new event, [c][F0FF23]Tales From The Outer Rim[-][/c]!
data.NEWSLETTER_MANDO_TITLE: Bounty Hunting Is A Complicated Profession
data.NEWSLETTER_MARA_JADE_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

One of the most feared assassins of Legends, [c][F0FF23]Mara Jade, The Emperor's Hand[-][/c], is storming the holotables! As the Emperor's Hand, Mara Jade carried out missions some may have viewed as impossible against Rebels and corrupt Imperials alike. Even when tasked with the assassination of Luke Skywalker, Mara Jade never backed down as she pursued her objective with fervor.

As an Unaligned Force User, Mara Jade strengthens the Empire faction, particularly in Territory Wars where her Omicron ability powers up an Emperor Palpatine-led squad. Utilizing Stealth and Turn Meter to her advantage, Mara Jade also inflicts a bevy of debuffs on enemies, such as Daze, Offense Down, Shock, Stagger, Stun, Tenacity Down, Vulnerable, and - fittingly - Blind on Jedi Knight Luke Skywalker. Like Darth Talon, Mara Jade also gains the [c][F0FF23]Loyal Hand[-][/c] effect, as well as introducing [c][F0FF23]Useful Pawn[-][/c], an effect that gives her increased Critical Chance, Critical Damage, and Offense at the cost of making some of her allies weaker.

Add this powerful fan-favorite character from Legends to your roster through the all-new “[c][F0FF23]By The Emperor’s Hand[-][/c]” Marquee event, and unleash the ultimate predator on your holotable foes!
data.NEWSLETTER_MARAUDER_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

The Bad Batch’s ship, [c][F0FF23]Marauder[-][/c], is coming to the Holotables! This Omicron-class attack shuttle served as the Bad Batch's personal transport and gunship while the members of Clone Force 99 were hiding from the Republic.

Marauder is a powerful ally in the updated Endurance fleet which also received a rework with today’s update. Marauder helps spread Endurance’s [c][F0FF23]Valor[-][/c] buff to the entire fleet while Clone Trooper ships with Valor gain additional bonuses from Marauder’s abilities.

With two new unique buffs, [c][F0FF23]The Bad Batch[-][/c] and [c][F0FF23]Plan 99[-][/c], Marauder will be a tough ship to take down. [c][F0FF23]The Bad Batch[-][/c] increases its Offense and Defense, prevents this ship from being stunned, and reduces damage from percent Health effects. [c][F0FF23]Plan 99[-][/c] grants additional Defense and Tenacity and prevents the ship from being defeated once.

Unlock Marauder during the upcoming Galactic Chase event!
data.NEWSLETTER_MARCH_TW_UPDATE_DESC:
It’s time for Geonosians to get some new unique abilities, and for the return of the Clone Troopers in the next Territory War!

Geonosians are hunkering down and bringing out the big guns. The passive, [c][f0ff23]Industry of War[-][/c], will help keep these bugs alive with extra Health and Protection but using Special abilities will decrease the cooldown of [c][f0ff23]Heavy Artillery[-][/c], an ability that can destroy even the strongest opponents with ease.

Clone Troopers are back with [c][f0ff23]Army of the Galactic Republic[-][/c], which boosts damage and survivability while also dispelling debuffs on other Clone Trooper allies.

Check out the forums for more details on these abilities and see you on the holotables!
data.NEWSLETTER_MARROK_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

[c][F0FF23]Marrok[-][/c] is coming to the Holotables!

The mysterious former Inquisitor-turned-Mercenary was recruited by Morgan Elsbeth to help in her effort in recovering Grand Admiral Thrawn from his exile in a galaxy far, far away. Not much is known about Marrok, save for the fact that he is a ruthless combatant who wields the traditional double-bladed lightsaber of the Inquisitorius.

Marrok is part of the new Mercenary squad led by Baylan Skoll, however he also has synergy with his fellow Inquisitors. His [c][F0FF23]Soldier of Fortune[-][/c] Unique ability provides him with stacks of Soldier of Fortune when Mercenaries apply Purge and removes them when it is consumed. His other Unique ability, [c][F0FF23]Masked Hunter[-][/c], provides turn meter to Mercenary allies when their debuffs are resisted and Damage Immunity the first time they get low on health. It also gives Mercenaries the ability to apply Purge in order to synergize better with his kit. Furthermore, it allows Marrok to assist Mercenary Special abilities, which gets more potent as he gains more Soldier of Fortune stacks.

With an Omicron upgrade in the Territory Battles game mode, Marrok earns more Soldier of Fortune stacks at the beginning of battle, prevents revives while he’s active, and Inquisitorius allies become immune to percent Health damage effect (hello, Reva shards!)

Unlock Marrok in the upcoming “LIGHTSABER FOR HIRE II” Marquee event that [c][E7E7E7]gives out daily rewards[-][/c] for the duration of the event and prepare for the upcoming [c][E7E7E7]Epic Confrontation Baylan Skoll[-][/c]!

data.NEWSLETTER_MASTER_QUI_GON_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

[c][F0FF23]Master Qui-Gon[-][/c] is coming to the Holotables!

The maverick Jedi and former Padawan to Count Dooku, Qui-Gon Jinn found himself and his own apprentice embroiled in the dispute between the Trade Federation and the planet of Naboo. Stranded on Tatooine, their ship in need of a new hyperdrive, Master Qui-Gon took to the streets of Mos Espa and not only successfully won a new hyperdrive in a bet with a Toydarian junk dealer, but also the freedom of one of his slaves, the Force-sensitive Anakin Skywalker.

As the final piece of Queen Amidala’s squad, Master Qui-Gon brings in plenty of support to help keep the Queen and her decoy around while Padawan Obi-Wan deals out the damage. He willingly takes a chance to keep his allies safe in Stealth by using Special ability [c][F0FF23]Feel, Use your Instincts[-][/c]. Keeping an eye out for opportunities, his Special ability, [c][F0FF23]I’ll Take That Bet[-][/c], rolls a chance cube that can deal Special damage based on his increased Max Health and Queen's Protection, as well as spread Tenacity Up to his allies and Tenacity Down to his enemies if it goes his way (and it somehow tends to go his way….)

His Unique ability, [c][F0FF23]Stay Close to Me[-][/c], provides Queen Amidala with opening Turn Meter and Master Qui-Gon will assist Jedi who attack during his turn, such as his Padawan Obi-Wan. With an Omicron upgrade in the Territory Wars game mode, this ability can provide plenty of defensive capabilities for his squad as well as potential additional damage for out of turn attacks from his allies.

Master Qui-Gon will be unlockable in the upcoming “ALL THE QUEEN’S MEN II” Marquee event which follows our new experimental Marquee structure that[c][E7E7E7] gives out daily rewards[-][/c] for the duration of the event. Unlock Master Qui-Gon and prepare for the upcoming [c][E7E7E7]Battle for Naboo raid[-][/c]!
data.NEWSLETTER_MAUL_CONQUEST7_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

Conquest 7 returns with Maul from Season 7 of The Clone Wars! Turns out, [c][F0FF23]Maul[-][/c] didn’t die when a young Kenobi defeated him. He’s lost the title of Darth since he's no longer a Sith apprentice and thus also lost the Sith tag in-game. Maul is now an Unaligned Force User and will strengthen a number of Dark Side squads, but the real surprise here is that he has the Mandalorian tag! While not a Mandalorian by birth, his kit pays tribute to his time as the usurper of the throne of Mandalore. When Maul is in the Leader slot, he has the [c][F0FF23]Mand'alor[-][/c] status effect until he is defeated and then passes the mantle on to the character that defeated him.

Maul has had a rough time since we last saw him face off against Qui-Gon Jinn and is out for revenge. He has a new status effect called Anguish, which damages himself while boosting his Offense, enabling one of his abilities and providing additional effects. After all these years of rage and anguish, there is one thing Maul hates more than anything else: Kenooooobi! Maul gains extra stacks of Anguish whenever he faces off against any version of Kenobi in Star Wars: Galaxy of Heroes.

Reclaim your rightful place in the galaxy and earn Maul shards in the upcoming Conquest 7!

data.NEWSLETTER_MAUL_HATE_FUELED_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

[c][F0FF23]Maul (Hate-Fueled)[-][/c] is coming to the Holotables!

After his defeat at the hands of Obi-Wan Kenobi on Naboo, Maul survived through sheer hatred and the dark side of the Force, clinging to life in the depths of Lotho Minor. His body broken and replaced with crude spider-like mechanical legs fashioned from scrap, his mind shattered by years of isolation and torment, Maul became a creature of pure rage and vengeance. Driven by an all-consuming need for revenge against the Jedi who cut him down, this fractured shadow of his former self represents the terrifying power of hatred to sustain life beyond all reason.

Maul's Basic ability, [c][F0FF23]Fractured Fury[-][/c], inflicts stacking Bleed while building stacks of Edge of Madness, and once per encounter can Fracture an enemy during his turn. His first Special ability, [c][F0FF23]Relentless Malice[-][/c], deals damage to enemies multiple times while applying more Bleed, and at higher Edge of Madness thresholds deals devastating True damage based on his Max Health. With his Territory Wars Omicron active, this ability deals even more instances of damage and can reset the cooldown of his second Special ability, [c][F0FF23]Howl of the Broken[-][/c]. This ability calls all Dark Side Attacker allies to assist while inflicting Healing Immunity and Daze on all enemies, and inflicts Fear when Maul has sufficient Edge of Madness stacks. His Territory Wars Omicron spreads Bleed to all enemies, removes Turn Meter, and increases enemy cooldowns.

Maul's first Unique ability, [c][F0FF23]Hatred Sustains[-][/c], allows him to gain Edge of Madness stacks whenever he takes damage with a chance to gain massive Turn Meter, and prevents him from being instantly defeated. As his Health drops through specific thresholds, he gains cumulative bonuses through Web of Descent stages that increase his Offense, Speed, and Defense while preventing healing above those thresholds. His Territory Wars Omicron starts him with maximum Edge of Madness stacks and increases his chance to gain Turn Meter when damaged. His final ability, [c][F0FF23]Always Remember, I am Fear[-][/c], grants Maul scaling stats based on team composition, converts all his Protection into Max Health, and provides Hatred and Anguish at battle start. His attacks cannot be evaded or countered,  and without allied Galactic Legends present, he prevents revivals of enemies defeated by Dark Side allies while Marking and protecting the healthiest Unaligned Force User ally each turn.

Unlock Maul (Hate-Fueled) in his Journey Guide event starting on January 13th. See the Maul (Hate-Fueled) Event newsletter for the requirements needed to unlock and play the Journey Guide event.

data.NEWSLETTER_MAZ_KANATA_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

This year marks the 10th anniversary of The Force Awakens, and we’re celebrating by bringing [c][F0FF23]Maz Kanata[-][/c] to the Holotables!

The ancient and wise Maz Kanata has lived for over a thousand years, collecting secrets and amassing a fortune through her dealings across the galaxy. With the title of Pirate Queen she brings her formidable skills and experience to lead another crew of Pirates in search of fortune and glory.

Maz's Basic ability, [c][F0FF23]Steadfast Shot[-][/c], inflicts Healing Immunity and Pinned, which Sith enemies can’t avoid. Her first Special, [c][F0FF23]Eyes Everywhere[-][/c], dispels debuffs from her Pirate allies, and, if she has no Galactic Legend allies*, calls all Pirates to assist, granting them Turn Meter and cooldown reduction.

Her powerful [c][F0FF23]Keeper of Secrets[-][/c] Special ability steals Stealth from enemies, granting it to non-Tank Pirates. If she has no Galactic Legend allies**, it also Exposes enemies and increases cooldowns. With an Omicron upgrade in Grand Arenas without a Galactic Legend ally***, it steals extra Profit, increases enemy cooldowns, and can Deathmark enemies.

Maz's [c][F0FF23]Ancient Wisdom[-][/c] Unique removes the Profit cap on her allies and ensures her opponents have plenty of Profit for her allies to plunder. She then punishes enemies for losing their Profit by reducing their Offense and Speed. When upgraded with an Omicron in Grand Arenas, Maz gains Mastery from Profit and allows Pirate allies to deal True Damage with debuffs.

As the [c][F0FF23]Pirate Queen[-][/c] Leader, Maz makes her Pirate allies immune to Fear while granting them Foresight and Turn Meter. Her allies can ignore Protection, the squad takes reduced damage, and deals vastly increased damage to Sith enemies. An Omicron in Grand Arenas further empowers the Pirates with massive stat increases, Tenacity from critical hits, and the ability to instantly defeat Deathmarked non-Galactic Legend enemies.

Unlock the ancient and formidable Maz Kanata in the upcoming Conquest events and prepare another Pirate crew for the Order 66 raid!

* “What? Maz and I go way back! Why would she snub me like this?” - Hondo
** “Again? Maybe she just forgot. She is very old, you know.” - Hondo
*** “Ok, now I am taking this personally.” - Hondo

data.NEWSLETTER_MERRIN_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

[c][F0FF23]Merrin[-][/c] is coming to the holotables from the acclaimed Jedi: Fallen Order game! The last known surviving Nightsister on Dathomir, Merrin initially resisted Cal Kestis visiting her planet but eventually helped him defeat the fallen Jedi Master Taron Malicos.

Merrin leans into Plague and revives for Nightsisters, making them a difficult team to try to take out. Her Special ability,[c][F0FF23] Shadow Stride[-][/c], introduces a new status, [c][F0FF23]Magick Stealth[-][/c], which temporarily hides her from the active battle but upon return she dispels her sisters and revives a Nightsister ally. Her first Unique ability, [c][F0FF23]Last of the Nightsisters[-][/c], gives her a unique playstyle where she does not have any Speed, but rather gains all of her Turn Meter from her sisters being defeated or debuffed. An Omicron upgrade to this ability in the Grand Arenas game mode provides more Turn Meter as well as Plague inflicted to all enemies when she takes a turn.

Her second Unique ability, [c][F0FF23]Vengeful Bond[-][/c], helps Merrin dispel her allies, provides Protection recovery to Nightsisters when an enemy is damaged, and inflicts Plague on all enemies when a sister is revived.

Unlock Merrin in the new "STORIES OF SURVIVAL III" Marquee event and prepare for the upcoming Hero's Journey for Jedi Knight Cal Kestis! Merrin will also be required for a new Special Mission on Dathomir in the Rise of the Empire Territory Battle in an upcoming release.

data.NEWSLETTER_MOB_ENFORCER_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

[c][F0FF23]Mob Enforcer[-][/c] has received a rework to her kit! In addition to synergy with Hutt Cartel she will also change roles from a Tank to Support to better reflect her identity. 

The following changes have been made to her abilities:

- "[c][F0FF23]Dirty Fighting[-][/c]" Basic ability now has a 100% Defense Down chance (previously 80%) and inflicts additional debuffs when the ally in the Leader slot is Hutt Cartel and if the target already had Defense Down.
- "[c][F0FF23]Thermal Detonator[-][/c]" Special ability will now explode all Thermal Detonators on the target before applying one and has a chance to grant her a bonus turn.
- "[c][F0FF23]Underworld Moxie[-][/c]" Unique ability now grants her additional stat bonuses for each Hutt Cartel, Scoundrel, and Smuggler ally, as well as reducing the cooldown of "Thermal Detonator" when an ally falls below 30% Health.
data.NEWSLETTER_MOD_CALIBRATION_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

Our latest Title Update introduces a number of quality of life changes for Mods and a new feature, [c][F0FF23]Mod Calibration[-][/c]! Mod Calibration allows you to tune your Mods even further by transferring slices between stats to create the best Mod for your roster. Each Mk VI Mod can be Calibrated a limited number of times using the new currency, Micro Attenuators, and gives you the chance to improve your good Mods into great Mods.

Managing your Mods is easier than ever! Quickly explore your Mod inventory with new tools for batch upgrading and saving filters for Mods. The new Mod Enhance screen is now a one stop spot to slice, upgrade, sell, and now Calibrate your Mods.

There are a ton more Quality of Life improvements in this update that help you quickly find your most important Mods. We have highlighted Speed secondaries in the Store and batch manage views, added a new set of filter options, and show the average Slice Quality for each upgraded Mod.

All of these changes help open up managing Mods to more players while respecting the investment players have had in the system over the years. We hope you enjoy the new and improved Mods experience and would love to hear your feedback on the Official forums!

See you on the Holotables!
data.NEWSLETTER_MOD_CALIBRATION_TITLE: Title Update: Mod Calibration and Quality of Life

data.NEWSLETTER_MODS_UPDATE_DESC:
Mods 2.0 is here! Whether you're a Mod expert or you’re confused about where to get started, this update will vastly improve your Mods game. We’ve added many quality of life improvements, upgraded some of less used Mod stats and introduced a new feature, Slicing!

Improve your best Mods even more with Slicing! Slicing increases the rarity or tier of a Mod and boosts their stats. Earn Slicing materials from the all new Stage 9 Mod Battles.

Finding great Mods for each character is quick and simple with the new Mod Recommendations tool. You can also search through your mods or swap them between characters more easily than ever thanks to Mod Loadouts, Advanced Filters, and Sorting.

All that and so much more! Find the full list of patch notes on the Official Forum
data.NEWSLETTER_MOFF_GIDEON_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

[c][F0FF23]Moff Gideon[-][/c] has arrived to impose his will on the Holotables! The formidable Moff, once an officer in the Imperial Security Bureau and now wielder of the legendary Mandalorian Darksaber, uses his unique talents to lead Imperial Troopers into battle.

Always tactical and looking for every advantage, Moff Gideon controls the battlefield by utilizing AoE attacks, Turn Meter manipulation, and applying both Daze and a new debuff that leaves his foes [c][F0FF23]Demoralized[-][/c].

With the Darksaber in hand, Moff Gideon turns his attention to chasing down the Child. Use his unrelenting focus and astute battlefield knowledge to lead your squad of Imperial Troopers onto the Holotables and bring glory to the Empire by unlocking Moff Gideon in an all-new Marquee event. Long live the Empire!
data.NEWSLETTER_MON_MOTHMA_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

[c][F0FF23]Mon Mothma[-][/c], the Chancellor of the Alliance to Restore the Republic, is arriving on the Holotables! Mon Mothma's leadership and fearlessness propelled her to the top of the Empire’s “Most Wanted” list and served as an inspiration to all members of the Rebellion. Ever mindful of the consequences of war, but always willing to stand for justice, Mon Mothma is a welcome addition to Rebel squads as she uses the [c][F0FF23]Field Promotion[-][/c] ability to summon increasingly stronger Rebel units to battle.

Thankfully, many Bothans don’t have to die for you to add Mon Mothma to your band of Rebels. You can obtain this Rebel non-combatant leader by completing the new Marquee Event, [c][F0FF23]The Alliance Chancellor[-][/c]!
data.NEWSLETTER_MORGAN_ELSBETH_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

[c][F0FF23]Morgan Elsbeth[-][/c] is coming to the Holotables!

One of the few remaining Nightsisters after they were wiped out by the Separatists, Morgan sought revenge for her people. A skilled combatant with cunning ambition, she was a key ally for Grand Admiral Thrawn and led the search that would eventually find him stranded on Peridea. For the Empire, but even more so for Dathomir, she dedicated her life to give her people a second chance and Thrawn a way to escape.

Morgan comes in as another Tank for Nightsisters, especially setting the stage for a new team to be led by the upcoming [c][E7E7E7]Great Mothers[-][/c]. Her first Special ability [c][F0FF23]My Loyalty, My Life[-][/c] dispels all buffs on all enemies, recovers Health and Protection for Nightsister allies. If Morgan is Taunting, this ability also grants them Turn Meter and Tenacity Up. [c][F0FF23]Let None Pass[-][/c], her second Special, deals damage and calls all Nightsister allies to assist. With an Omicron upgrade in the Grand Arenas game mode, it also reduces Nightsister ally cooldowns, deals more damage, lays down debuffs on the target, and buffs her allies.

Her Unique ability [c][F0FF23]Preordained Destiny[-][/c] dishes out a ton of stats for her Nightsister allies, especially for Nightsisters gaining Foresight or Stealth. Morgan also protects her allies by taunting as well as through further boosts to their stats if she should fall. To keep this new Nightsister squad unique and not disrupt the existing powerful Talzin led Nightsisters, Morgan prevents revives.

Unlock Morgan Elsbeth in the upcoming “VEIL OF SHADOWS I” Marquee event that [c][E7E7E7]gives out daily rewards[-][/c] for the duration of the event and prepare for the upcoming Epic Confrontation for [c][E7E7E7]Baylan Skoll[-][/c]!
data.NEWSLETTER_NEST_DESC: To celebrate the release of the new Solo: A Star Wars Story film in theaters, Enfys Nest has arrived to the holotables! Use this powerful marauder to crush your enemies and scatter their squads.\n\nEnfys Nest is a new, powerful attacker that will bring powerful new offensive capabilities to your PvP squads. Nest has a penchant for using an enemy's defenses against them. Her basic attack, [c][f0ff23]Cut Through[-][/c], dispels all defensive buffs and [c][f0ff23]Sudden Impact[-][/c] will do extra damage if an enemy has any Protection. Always the opportunist, Nest's [c][f0ff23]Kinetite Charge[-][/c] will Daze her enemies and either boost Nest's Turn Meter or drain the enemy's based on their Health totals! Nest is also an elusive enemy, gaining stacking Protection for each hit she endures with her [c][f0ff23]Fighting Instinct[-][/c], while also stacking Critical Chance and Damage to turn the tables. This relentless warrior is an excellent addition to any Scoundrel squad!
data.NEWSLETTER_NEW_BAD_BATCH_DESC:
Hello Holotable Heroes!

A special event to welcome new and returning players to the holotables is going on now.

Celebrate the latest Era release of STAR WARS: The Bad Batch characters with a limited time event. During the event, players can collect the original Clone Force 99 Marquee Event characters to join the holotables: Hunter, Wrecker, Echo, Tech, and Omega.

A bonus login calendar containing freebies is also going to be available for new players to get you started on your journey. This is available to collect in the store starting at level 10 for new accounts.

Event requirements:
- To be able to access the login calendar (NEW BAD BATCH EVENT CALENDAR), players must be new installs at the time of the event.
- Marquee Events will become accessible starting at level 20. New players can access the event by collecting the login calendar for an XP boost.
- Marquee Events will be available for rewards to all players who do not already have 55+ shards of these heroes.

Event Start: 3.13.2025 11:00AM Pacific

Event End: 3.27.2025 11:00AM Pacific

-STAR WARS™: Galaxy of Heroes team
data.NEWSLETTER_NIGHT_TROOPER_DATACRON_DESC:
Greetings Holotable Heroes,

As a first time reward for the 7-star Tier of Night Trooper’s Marquee event, players will earn a one-of-a-kind Datacron at level 9 that targets Night Trooper. There is no other way to get a Night Trooper Datacron in the Unexpected Resurgence Datacron set so make sure to grab it!

This datacron comes with pre-established stat bonuses, but a player can reroll these to random stat bonuses that are within the Unexpected Resurgence set if they so desire using the same Datacron materials as that set.

While players have the ability to dismantle this Datacron, note that this is irreversible and there is no other way to get a Night Trooper Datacron at this time.

At the end of the lifetime of the Unexpected Resurgence Datacron set, this Datacron will automatically dismantle along with the rest of the set.
data.NEWSLETTER_NIGHT_TROOPER_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

Night Trooper is coming to the Holotables!

Nightsister Majik has given the Chimaera’s Imperial Stormtroopers a new lease on life, animating them into persistent foes that are difficult to fully put down. Still clad in the armor they were exiled with (albeit with an abundance of repairs done over the years), these soldiers continue to be fiercely loyal to their commander, Grand Admiral Thrawn.

Night Trooper and the upcoming Death Trooper (Peridea) both work extremely well with the new Imperial Remnant leader Captain Enoch, who is also coming soon. They are also options to use with Nightsisters, especially the Great Mothers. Night Trooper introduces two effects that will be useful for Enoch’s squad: [c][F0FF23]Blight[-][/c] and [c][F0FF23]Alert[-][/c]. Blight is a new debuff that is removed when a unit fully heals (however they have reduced Health Steal) and will deal damage whenever the unit loses Turn Meter from an enemy. Alert is a new buff that works somewhat as a positive form of Daze by increasing the amount of bonus Turn Meter gained when it’s gained and assisting allies when they use a Special ability.

Stack [c][F0FF23]Blight[-][/c] on Night Trooper using their Basic, [c][F0FF23]Shambling Shot[-][/c], then spread it to your target and bring a host of other nasty effects with their second Special, [c][F0FF23]Share My Suffering[-][/c]. Utilize their first Special, [c][F0FF23]March of the Undying[-][/c], to gain Alert. With their Unique, [c][F0FF23]Inevitable End[-][/c], Night Trooper further punishes enemies when they recover Health and has additional synergy with Blight. 

Unlock Night Trooper in the upcoming “UNDYING LEGION I” Marquee event that [c][E7E7E7]gives out daily rewards[-][/c] for the duration of the event and grants an [c][E7E7E7]exclusive datacron[-][/c] if your Night Trooper reaches 7*.

Unlock Night Trooper and prepare for the upcoming [c][E7E7E7]Galactic Legend Ahsoka Tano[-][/c]!
data.NEWSLETTER_NIGHTSISTER_EVENTS_DESC:
This month three new Nightsister allies will join their dark sisters on the Holotable. Along with these new additions, the existing Nightsisters have received a faction rework.

Mother Talzin is a powerful Nightsister witch that brings new abilities to her coven. Her ability, [c][F0FF23]DARK MAGICK[-][/c], inflicts the new unique stacking debuff, [c][F0FF23]PLAGUE[-][/c]. This new debuff can only be removed with healing and inflicts percent health damage while preventing enemies from dispelling debuffs!

Additionally, the new Nightsister Spirit ability, [c][F0FF23]POSSESSION[-][/c], will dispel all buffs on an enemy and Stun them. The Nightsister Zombie gains Taunt at the end of each of her turns and revives if she is defeated while any other Nightsister allies are active.

Mother Talzin will be obtainable in her Marquee event, "The Rituals of Revenge". Players can also find shards of Mother Talzin in the "Defense of Dathomir" event; fight Separatist enemy forces with your Nightsister squad as you defend Dathomir! Finally, take your strongest units in the "Ghosts of Dathomir" event and investigate rumors of the Dathomir undead. In the "Ghosts of Dathomir" event, you can earn shards of the Nightsister Zombie and the Nightsister Spirit.

"Defense of Dathomir" and the "Ghosts of Dathomir" events will be rare, recurring Special Events - so play as much as you can, while you can!
data.NEWSLETTER_NIGHTSISTER_EVENTS_TITLE: The Call from Beyond - Nightsisters Rise!
data.NEWSLETTER_NIHILUS_AND_SITH_DESC:
Now is the time of the Sith! Three new members of this order are now available to add to your collection: Darth Nihilus, Sith Assassin, and Sith Empire Trooper.

Darth Nihilus is a powerful support character that buffs his Sith allies and can instantly defeat an enemy after a number of rounds using the ability, ANNIHILATION. The Sith Assassin is able to stealth and uses powerful attacks to stun enemies, while the Sith Empire Trooper is able to taunt and ignores enemy protection when attacking.

Add these powerful characters to your squad and become truly feared at the holotables.
data.NEWSLETTER_NIHILUS_AND_SITH_TITLE: NEW CHARACTERS: Darth Nihilus, Sith Empire Trooper, Sith Assassin
data.NEWSLETTER_NIHILUS_TEASER_DESC: Prepare your best squads for the Lord of Hunger Event, coming this month!
