data.NEWSLETTER_NINTH_SISTER_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

The [c][F0FF23]Ninth Sister[-][/c], formerly a Jedi known as Masana Tide, is coming to the holotables to reinforce the Inquisitorius! Having survived Order 66, Masana became the Ninth Sister after being captured and tortured by the Empire until she cracked. Notably, Ninth Sister earned a permanent distinguishing feature, losing her left eye during a training session with Darth Vader.

Like Second Sister, Ninth Sister interacts with the [c][F0FF23]Purge[-][/c] debuff. She can use it to inflict Damage Over Time on her enemies while granting herself Heal Over Time, adding to her sustainability. Ninth Sister also has special callouts in her kit that make her extra powerful against Jedi enemies. In addition to inflicting debuffs on her foes, Ninth Sister utilizes Taunt to protect her allies, and gains Defense, Max Health, and Tenacity when surrounded by other Empire units.

Ninth Sister’s Omicron ability gives her additional utility in Territory Wars, where Empire allies gain Defense and all Inquisitorius allies are immune to Ability Block and Stun.

Unlock Ninth Sister in the all-new [c][F0FF23]Ruthless Efficiency II[-][/c] Marquee event.
data.NEWSLETTER_OLD_BEN_KENOBI_ANNOUNCEMENT_D:
Greetings,

Obi-Wan Kenobi (Old Ben) character Shards are now available from Cantina Battles 2-F and 6-B in addition to Chromium Packs. 

There are also two new characters available in Chromium Packs: Chief Chirpa and Magmatrooper.
data.NEWSLETTER_OLD_BOBA_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

[c][F0FF23]Boba Fett, Scion of Jango[-][/c] is coming to Star Wars: Galaxy of Heroes! This veteran Bounty Hunter is the first character to have mode specific abilities, like [c][F0FF23]Dangerous Reputation[-][/c], which greatly boosts himself and his squad's effectiveness in Territory Wars. Boba Fett, Scion of Jango uses his [c][F0FF23]Momentum[-][/c] during battle to grant his abilities additional effects and take down enemy squads with ruthless efficiency. You do not want to get between Boba Fett and his quarry.

Can't wait to get your hands on the highly prized Mandalorian armor? Earn shards of Boba Fett, Scion of Jango in the next Conquest event!

To help prepare players for the Guilds and Raids update at the end of this month we are releasing a special limited time event.

This event will require you to form a squad of 3 from a list of pre-selected characters each day of the week. There will be 3 difficulty levels for each day, rewarding Ability Materials and Credits upon completion. data.NEWSLETTER_OMEGA_DESC:
Hello Holotable Heroes,

[c][F0FF23]Omega[-][/c], the enhanced clone from Kamino, has made her way to the holotables to round out the Bad Batch faction. Her interest in Clone Force 99 eventually led to her joining the ragtag bunch...as well as her being the catalyst for an impromptu food fight. Although Omega often felt like a misfit, the Bad Batch embraced her and became the family she never had.

Under a Bad Batch lead, Omega gains Speed and Offense. When stealthed, she also assists Bad Batch allies when they use a Special ability. Her Special ability [c][F0FF23]Adaptive Learner[-][/c] introduces a new buff and new status effect to the game, [c][F0FF23]Target Practice[-][/c] and [c][F0FF23]Zeroed In[-][/c]. The buff grants damage bonuses while the status effect allows her to ignore Taunt on enemies affected by Zeroed In. Omega can also inflict Blind and Daze on enemies with her Basic ability, [c][F0FF23]Disarming Shot[-][/c].

Omega is the piece of the puzzle the Bad Batch didn’t know they needed, but accepted wholeheartedly. On the holotables, she adds some high single-target damage output to an already fun faction. Play the new marquee event to unlock Omega and complete your Bad Batch squad.
data.NEWSLETTER_OMEGA_EVENT_REDEPLOY_DESC:
The Omega Battles have returned! Starting this weekend, and for the next 3 weekends, you’ll be able to participate in events to earn the coveted Ability Material Omega.

The events have been modified some to allow you to bring additional squad members, and your enemies will be a little tougher since your characters have had time to power-up as well!

Jump in these events today and earn those rare Omega materials!
data.NEWSLETTER_OMEGA_FUGITIVE_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

[c][F0FF23]Omega (Fugitive)[-][/c] is coming to the Holotables!

Omega is a female clone of Jango Fett and a member of the Bad Batch. She was captured by the Empire and taken to Mount Tantiss, where dark experiments were taking place. It was here she would eventually escape along with the lurca hound Batcher and the ex-Bad Batch, ex-Imperial, Crosshair. After the escape, the facility found out she had a high M-Count and was the perfect test subject for Project: Necromancer. An incredibly high bounty was put on her capture and return, making her, and subsequently the rest of the Bad Batch, fugitives.

Omega leads an entirely new Bad Batch squad that heavily uses Stealth and introduces Rescue objectives, a way to save an ally from being defeated if you complete the objective in time. [c][F0FF23]Big Sister[-][/c], her first Special ability, provides plenty of sustainability for the squad while her second Special ability, [c][F0FF23]Our Way Out[-][/c], dishes out buffs and Turn Meter.

Her Leader ability, [c][F0FF23]Learn and Watch[-][/c], keeps Stealthed allies protected and rewards focusing an enemy down by providing Target Practice when enemies take consecutive hits. With an Omicron upgrade in the Grand Arenas game mode, enemies will also take damage based on their Max Health for each Target Practice stack present on your allies if they damage an ally while Exposed or with bonus Protection. Her Unique ability, [c][F0FF23]Odd Little Clone[-][/c], also utilizes Target Practice as her Rescue objective to get her out of Captive and prevent her from being defeated.

Unlock Omega (Fugitive) in the upcoming "[c][E7E7E7]The Cavalry Has Arrived I[-][/c]" Marquee event that [c][E7E7E7]gives out daily rewards[-][/c] for the duration of the event!

data.NEWSLETTER_OMICRONS_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

Mode specific abilities are coming to characters in Galaxy of Heroes! New units and some existing characters will have a new final tier added to their abilities that boosts those units to the next level in a specific mode. This new type of ability tier will require a unique material called [c][F0FF23]Omicron[-][/c]. However the effects contained in this tier are restricted to only being active in a specific game mode, like Grand Arena or Territory War. Omicrons are available primarily as rewards from Galactic Challenges, but can also be earned in Conquest and from Cantina nodes.

Omicrons allow users to create multiple diverse metas in the game and give characters interesting effects that are contained to specific game modes. For example Boba Fett, Scion of Jango has effects in his abilities that only activate in Territory War. In that game mode you will see a higher-performing Boba Fett if you have customized him by unlocking his Omicron abilities.

While many upcoming characters will have mode specific ability tiers, we will also be adding Omicron tiers to older characters at a slow but steady pace. By adding a new final Omicron tier to an existing ability, we are looking to improve these characters in specific game modes and reignite the excitement they brought to the game when they were first introduced. 

Check out the Official Forums for which characters will be updated and for additional details on mode specific abilities.
data.NEWSLETTER_OMICRONS_TITLE: New Mode Specific Ability Material: Omicron
data.NEWSLETTER_ORDER_66_RAID_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

Celebrate 20 years of Revenge of the Sith with the new featured [c][F0FF23]Order 66 raid[-][/c]! Lord Vader storms the Jedi Temple with his Dark Side Clone Troopers, ensnaring Jedi as he goes. 

You and your Guild arrive at the Jedi Temple after Operation Knightfall has commenced and the Jedi are fighting for their lives. Lord Vader has cornered some fleeing Jedi and they will be executed if not saved in time. Surrounded by Dark Side Clone Troopers, players must punch through their wall in order to distract Lord Vader and allow the Jedi an opportunity to run away. Not being able to save all the Jedi could draw Lord Vader’s gaze to you instead. 

Allowed characters for this raid include [c][F0FF23]the new Bad Batch squad, Dark Side Clones Troopers with Grand Moff Tarkin[-][/c], certain [c][F0FF23]Jedi Vanguard[-][/c], as well as upcoming [c][F0FF23]Pirates[-][/c]! Additionally, Jedi Master Mace Windu, Jocasta Nu, Kelleran Beq, Grand Moff Tarkin, CC-1119 “Appo”, and Omega (Fugitive) are Hero units that receive extra bonuses, making Jedi Master Mace Windu’s squad and upcoming Pirates perform extremely well. 

A new faction tag has been added to your roster to view eligible units.  

Hurry to the Jedi Temple!
data.NEWSLETTER_ORDER_66_RAID_TITLE: Do What Must Be Done, Lord Vader.
data.NEWSLETTER_OT_CHEWBACCA_DESC: This loveable, shaggy giant has fought in practically every major recent galactic conflict. He is a military strategist, skilled Dejarik player and an expert smuggler, known for his short temper but also his fierce loyalty to his friends. None other than the co-pilot of the Millennium Falcon, Chewbacca - as seen in the Original Trilogy - will be joining the Holotable!\n\nBounty Hunters will be on the lookout for this wanted Wookiee. Earn Chewbacca in a special Bounty Hunter event coming soon!
data.NEWSLETTER_OUTRIDER_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

Dash Rendar’s ship, the [c][F0FF23]Outrider[-][/c], is docking with the holotables! As a heavily modified YT-2400 light freighter, the Outrider was a top-notch smuggling vessel and (according to Dash himself) almost as famous as the Millennium Falcon.

The Outrider deals multiple instances of damage with its [c][F0FF23]Illegal Laser Cannons[-][/c] Basic and [c][F0FF23]Concealed Concussion Missiles[-][/c] Special abilities. In addition to damage, the Outrider can inflict enemies with Critical Damage Down and Target Lock, as well as dispel buffs and reduce Defense. Outrider lifts its allies by doling out Health and Protection Recovery, Speed Up, Tenacity Up, and Turn Meter, and dispelling debuffs.

Outrider introduces the new [c][F0FF23]Suprosa Supercomputer[-][/c] effect and the new [c][F0FF23]Data Transmission[-][/c] granted ability, which together provide Rebel allies with powerful bonuses based on their role.

Unlock the Outrider during the upcoming Galactic Chase event to add this ship to your fleet collection!
data.NEWSLETTER_PADAWAN_OBI_WAN_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

[c][F0FF23]Padawan Obi-Wan[-][/c] is coming to the Holotables!

Obi-Wan Kenobi's journey to become one of the most famed Jedi across the galaxy started with rebellious acts and more than a few broken rules. Few Jedi Masters wanted to take this headstrong human from Stewjon as a Padawan, but Grand Master Yoda knew of one such individual who could potentially take Obi-Wan's unorthodox behavior and hone it. Qui-Gon Jinn took this charge and under his watchful eye young Obi-Wan learned that sometimes the right words could sway the situation as expertly as a steady blade.

Obi-Wan and the upcoming Master Qui-Gon make a strong kernel for the new Queen Amidala squad. His Basic ability, [c][F0FF23]Practiced Aggression[-][/c], synergizes with Amidala’s Heal Over Time buffs by doing more damage for each stack he has. Critical hits synergize with multiple parts of his kit, such as his Special ability, [c][F0FF23]Redirected Blast[-][/c], which removes Turn Meter from his target enemy and temporarily gives him a great deal of Speed whenever he critically hits.

His Unique ability, [c][F0FF23]Nobility in Restraint[-][/c], introduces [c][F0FF23]Discipline[-][/c], a new effect that gives him even more Heal Over Time stacks and allows him to ignore Protection. This ability also has him assist Master Qui-Gon whenever he uses an ability, and he will unleash big damage if his Master should fall. With an Omicron upgrade in Conquests, Obi-Wan grants his allies beneficial stats, has a chance to interrupt each enemy turn, and dishes out a variety of buffs and debuffs to assist in completing feats.

Padawan Obi-Wan will be unlockable in the upcoming “ALL THE QUEEN’S MEN I” Marquee event which follows our new experimental Marquee structure that [c][E7E7E7]gives out daily rewards[-][/c] for the duration of the event. Unlock Padawan Obi-Wan and prepare for the upcoming [c][E7E7E7]Battle for Naboo raid[-][/c]!
data.NEWSLETTER_PADAWAN_OBI_WAN_LIGHT_DARK_06: For a limited time, Padawan Obi-wan Shards have been added to Light Side and Dark Side Battle Hard nodes as bonus drops! During this event, the drop rate on each node has been scaled to Energy.\n\nLight Side and Dark Side Battles are rewarding bonus drops from 06/21/2024 through 06/24/2024.
Padawan Obi-wan shards are available on Light Side and Dark Side Battle Hard nodes!
data.NEWSLETTER_PADAWAN_SABINE_WREN_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

[c][F0FF23]Padawan Sabine Wren[-][/c] is coming to the Holotables!

Sabine Wren found herself under the tutelage of Ahsoka Tano after the start of the Galactic Civil War, where she was trained as her Padawan Learner. After a falling out, Sabine and Ahsoka went their separate ways but eventually would reunite in an effort to locate Ezra Bridger, who disappeared alongside Grand Admiral Thrawn at the Battle of Lothal.

While she works well with her fellow Light Side Mandalorians, Sabine really excels with Galactic Legend Ahsoka Tano and brings big damage to that team. Her Special ability, [c][F0FF23]Frantic Strike[-][/c], inflicts Pinned and introduces a new debuff [c][F0FF23]Off Balance[-][/c] that acts as a combination of Expose and Stagger by losing both Health and Turn Meter when damaged by an attack. [c][F0FF23]Fallback Tactic[-][/c], her second Special, has more Critical Damage for each buff and debuff on the target enemy.

Through her Unique ability, [c][F0FF23]Sentinel of Lothal[-][/c], Sabine gains Ancestral Resolve while under a Mandalorian leader and Force Connection from her Spectre allies, especially her master, Ahsoka. As Sabine gains more Force Connection, she also ramps up her Critical Damage. With an Omicron upgrade in the Territory Wars game mode, Sabine deals even more damage through Force Connection stacks, Ahsoka uses her Ultimates faster, and Ezra gains Purrgil Migration faster.

This release also adds the [c][E7E7E7]third batch[-][/c] of Galactic Legend Ahsoka Tano requirements to the Journey Guide.

Unlock Padawan Sabine Wren in the upcoming “[c][E7E7E7]LOST AND FOUND I[-][/c]” Marquee event that [c][E7E7E7]gives out daily rewards[-][/c] for the duration of the event, and prepare for the upcoming [c][E7E7E7]Galactic Legend Ahsoka Tano[-][/c]!
data.NEWSLETTER_PADME_ANNOUNCEMENT_DESC: Padmé Amidala, the brave former Queen of Naboo turned tenacious Galactic Senator, is coming to the holotables! During the Clone Wars, Padmé’s quick thinking allowed her and her friends to repeatedly outsmart their enemies.\n\nEnter the Geonosis arena with a squad of Separatists to earn Padmé in the Legendary event, Aggressive Negotiations!
data.NEWSLETTER_PADME_LIVE_DESC:
[c][F0FF23]Padmé Amidala[-][/c], the courageous Queen-turned-Senator from Naboo, has arrived on the holotables! Don’t expect her to sit idly by while her planet (and the galaxy) are under attack from a threat far bigger than anyone realizes.

As a Senator during the Clone Wars, Padmé stayed true to her ideals with risky diplomatic missions for the Galactic Republic. Always willing to do what it took to defend democracy, Padmé could be counted on to dodge assassination attempts, commandeer a speeder, or rescue a Jedi or two.

This fearless diplomat is also an excellent shot with a blaster when need be. In battle, Padmé leads her Galactic Republic allies by using Protection Up to grant them [c][F0FF23]Courage[-][/c] and deal bonus damage. Take your Separatists into the Geonosis arena in the Aggressive Negotiations Legendary event to earn Padmé.
data.NEWSLETTER_PADME_LIVE_TITLE: No, I Call It Aggressive Negotiations
data.NEWSLETTER_PADWAN_OBI_WAN_DATACRON_DESC:
Greetings Holotable Heroes,

As a First Time reward for the 7-star Tier of Padawan Obi-Wan’s Marquee event, players will earn a one-of-a-kind Datacron at level 9 that targets Padawan Obi-Wan. There is no other way to get a Padawan Obi-Wan Datacron in the Together. As One. Datacron set so make sure to grab it!

This datacron comes with pre-established stat bonuses, but a player can reroll these to random stat bonuses that are within the Together. As One. set if they so desire using the same Datacron materials as that set.

While players have the ability to dismantle this Datacron, note that this is irreversible and there is no other way to get a Padawan Obi-Wan Datacron at this time.

At the end of the lifetime of the Together. As One. Datacron set, this Datacron will automatically dismantle along with the rest of the set.
data.NEWSLETTER_PAO_DESC:
The daily login character for April is the amphibious Drabata, Pao!

Pao has the ability to lower his enemies defense with his Sonic Grenade ability or bolster his allies Turn Meter with his special battle cry Sa’kalla! In addition to Pao’s abilities, he also has his cooldowns reduced each time a Rebel ally uses a basic attack.

Log in daily this month to unlock Pao!
data.NEWSLETTER_PAO_TITLE: Daily Login Character for April – PAO
data.NEWSLETTER_PAZ_VIZSLA_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

[c][F0FF23]Paz Vizsla[-][/c], warrior descendent of House Vizsla and wielder of very large blasters, is coming to the Holotables!

Upholding the honor of both his House and the Creed, Paz Vizsla is a stalwart Mandalorian warrior who protects those around him with determination and heavy firepower.

As he uses his Basic, [c][F0FF23]Stalwart Barrage[-][/c] and first Special, [c][F0FF23]Ancestral Broadside[-][/c], he builds stacks of [c][F0FF23]Heat[-][/c] which empower his abilities. Once he reaches max stacks of Heat, he instead generates [c][F0FF23]Overheat[-][/c] which further enhances his abilities and can be spent using his second special, [c][F0FF23]Vengeful Incineration[-][/c], to deal extra damage. This combined with his many defensive boosts and synergies with other Mandalorians, especially Light Side Mandalorians via his Unique ability, [c][F0FF23]Legacy of House Vizsla[-][/c], makes him a formidable fortress to break through.

Unlock Paz Vizsla during the upcoming “DEFENDER OF THE CREED” Marquee event and prepare for the upcoming Epic Confrontation for Bo-Katan (Mand'alor)!
data.NEWSLETTER_PHOENIX_FLASH_EVENT_DESC:
It's time to rise up in the Phoenix Squadron Flash Event! Earn gear and power up your [c][F0FF23]PHOENIX SQUADRON[-][/c] as you embark on a mission to Lothal to deal a blow to the [c][F0FF23]EMPIRE'S[-][/c] carefully laid plans. But be warned, this [c][F0FF23]REBEL[-][/c] show of force has not gone unnoticed. It's imperative that your Squadron engage in this mission and arise victorious as a looming threat is beginning to close in, keen to ensure that the Rebellion become the architects of their own demise.

These events come back every three days starting on June 9th and will appear at 10am, 2pm, 6pm, and 9pm (player local time).

The Rebellion is counting on you!
data.NEWSLETTER_PHOENIX_SQUADRON_REBELS_DESC:
Phoenix Squadron has arrived!

Throughout the month of March players will be able to partake in events to earn shards of characters from Star Wars Rebels™ such as Chopper, Hera, Kanan, Zeb, Ezra, and Sabine.

Participate in the first of the Rebels events on March 9th, Supply Sabotage, to unlock Hera and the amazing synergies she brings to the entire Phoenix faction!

Be sure to collect all of the members of Phoenix Squadron this month as you’ll need them to participate in a special Event in April featuring their ships, Ghost and Phantom II.

For complete details on Phoenix Squadron and their Events be sure to check out the blog at https://www.ea.com/games/starwars/galaxy-of-heroes/news/phoenix-squadron-has-arrived
data.NEWSLETTER_PHOENIX_SQUADRON_REBELS_TITLE: Characters from Star Wars Rebels™ are here!
data.NEWSLETTER_PILLARS_OF_WAR_DATACRON_DESC:
Hello, Holotable Heroes!

As part of the 10th Anniversary celebration for Star Wars: Galaxy of Heroes, we’re proud to introduce our latest Datacron Set: [c][ffff33]Pillars of War[-][/c]. This set shines a spotlight on the legends who helped shape the early days of the game, giving several classic squads new power to stand tall once again.

The core Datacrons feature major boosts for Darth Vader, Cad Bane, Ugnaught, Jedi Consular, and more. Each affix is designed to help these veterans rise to modern challenges while keeping their original play styles intact. To make this set more accessible, the Gear requirements for the core set have been reduced. Affixes now unlock at Gear 10, Gear 12, and Relic 1, instead of the usual Relic 1, 3, and 5. This change gives more players a chance to celebrate the anniversary with their favorite legacy characters.

Focused Datacrons in this set celebrate some of the earliest teams to rule the holotables. Expect to see familiar synergies return with a few new surprises!

- Captain Phasma leads a rejuvenated First Order squad with Geonosian Soldier and Scavenger Rey contributing flurries of assists and sharp strikes.
- Lando Calrissian teams up with Stormtrooper Han and the Wedge & Biggs duo for fast openings and devastating AoE damage.
- Boba Fett joins forces with Dengar and Zam Wesell to remind everyone that Bounty Hunters still rule the Outer Rim. 
- Finally, HK-47 takes the Leader role once again, joined by Poggle the Lesser, IG-86, IG-88, and Poe Dameron for a level of calculated destruction that is truly something to be...Feared.
data.NEWSLETTER_PIRATES_BONUS_DROPS_NAME: Bonus Drops? We're Pirates! We don't even know what that means!!!
data.NEWSLETTER_PIRATES_BONUS_DROPS_SUMMARY:
Bonus Drops? We're Pirates! We don't even know what that means!!!

Well, this time it means bonus drops, and they’re only for the prepared.

For a limited time, select PvE battles will feature [b]special bonus drops[/b] from 9/5/2025 to 9/7/2025.

To unlock these exclusive rewards, you’ll need the following characters at [b]Relic 3[/b]:
[b]Brutus, Kix, Captain Ithano, and Quiggold[/b].

Each character at R3 unlocks a unique bonus drop. Bring all four to maximize your haul.

The window will be brief. Relic up and be ready when the nodes go live.

Don’t miss it. Ready your squad!
data.NEWSLETTER_PIRATES_ERA_DESC:
Arrrgh! Our next Era is all about Pirates!

First, start celebrating 10 years since [c][F0FF23]The Force Awakens[-][/c] with Pirates familiar to Maz’s Cantina. This Pirate squad can be led by Captain Ithano or by the upcoming Conquest reward... [c][F0FF23]Maz Kanata[-][/c] herself! Second, we have Pirates seen in [c][F0FF23]Skeleton Crew[-][/c] who come to score their share of the profits.

Pirates will heavily interact with the status effect [c][40E0D0]Profit[-][/c], previously seen on Nute Gunray’s kit but used by Pirates in new unique ways. They also introduce a new mechanic, [c][40E0D0]Steal[-][/c], where they can Steal buffs from enemies then grant those buffs to allies and benefit in other ways when they pull it off.

All marquee units will be part of the requirements for the culmination of this Era... [c][F0FF23]Galactic Legend Pirate King Hondo Ohnaka[-][/c]!

Pirates also don’t let an opportunity pass them by and are allowed units in the Order 66 raid, with Maz and Hondo performing particularly well. 

The new Era rewards those who know the pirate code: assemble your crew, claim the loot.
data.NEWSLETTER_PLAYTOGIVE_2017_DESC: Games permeate all areas of our lives today – across multiple devices and platforms, and reach players of all ages and genders around the world. With millions of hours spent in play every day, games are a powerful platform for positive, inclusive connections. That is why EA is partnering with several charities to give back to our player communities and support a more inclusive environment in video games. Tap below to learn more about EA Play to Give 2017.
data.NEWSLETTER_POE_UNIT_PROMO_DESC: Soak up damage with this resistance tank character inspired by Star Wars: The Force Awakens. Learn Poe's strategy in our forums today. https://forums.galaxy-of-heroes.starwars.ea.com/
data.NEWSLETTER_POWER_FORMULA_CHANGE_DESC: The Power rating has long been a prominent display of a unit's general effectiveness. Though this rating is intended to be a useful way to identify how strong a unit is, it has become less and less effective for this purpose over time. This is primarily due to the formula being based entirely on the raw base stats of the unit, which doesn't account for all upgrades such as abilities.\n\nIn the interest of making the Power formula more reliable as a reference point for a unit's effectiveness, we've modified the formula to recognize every upgrade made to a unit. This change will result in your units appearing to have a much higher power, however this will NOT have any impact on their performance in combat. The changes are purely intended to be a shorthand representation of a unit's general effectiveness.
data.NEWSLETTER_PRACTICE_MAKES_PERFECT_EZRA_D:
Ezra Bridger is ready to continue his Jedi training at Chopper Base!

This young Jedi specializes in powerful, high-damage attacks to quickly dispatch his enemies. Under Hera Syndulla’s lead, Ezra grants other members of Phoenix Squadron a powerful stacking buff that increases their offense at the end of their turns if they aren’t debuffed.

Take part in the Practice Makes Perfect Event to unlock Ezra Bridger and his incredible Phoenix Squadron synergies!
data.NEWSLETTER_PRACTICE_MAKES_PERFECT_EZRA_T: PRACTICE MAKES PERFECT EVENT – Ezra Bridger
data.NEWSLETTER_PRINCESS_KNEESAA_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

[c][F0FF23]Princess Kneesaa[-][/c], the brave warrior Ewok who fought alongside the Rebel alliance in the Battle of Endor, is coming to the holotables!

The daughter of Chief Chirpa, Kneesaa brings Chirpa-led Ewoks back into relevance by providing extra damage for their death-by-papercut style gameplay. Kneesaa assisting Ewoks when they use a Special ability, these out-of-turn attacks deal True damage and inflict Damage Over Time, and Ewoks stack Offense when they are critically hit. She also shores up some of their current weaknesses by bolstering Ewoks against Daze and Stun, as well as Kneesaa gaining Turn Meter when another Ewok takes damage, additionally cleansing them to get them back into the fight.

With an Omicron upgrade in Territory Wars, Kneesaa starts the battle with 100% Turn Meter to really get things going, then she doesn’t stop as she reduces her cooldowns every time she attacks, including out of turn. Additionally, Kneesaa becomes fully immune to Daze and Stun. Finally, Ewoks will gain Turn Meter if any other debuffs try to shut them down.

Unlock Princess Kneesaa in the new “SPIRITS FROM THE FOREST MOON” Marquee event!
data.NEWSLETTER_PRINCESS_KNEESAA_MOD_061624_D: For a limited time, [b]Princess Kneesaa[/b] shards have been added to [b]Mod Battle nodes[/b] as bonus drops! During this event, the drop rate on each node has been scaled to Mod Energy.\n\nMod Battles are rewarding bonus drops from 06/16/2024 through 06/17/2024.
data.NEWSLETTER_PRINCESS_KNEESAA_MOD_061624_T: Princess Kneesaa shards are available on Mod Battle nodes!
data.NEWSLETTER_PRINCESS_LEIA_DESC: Princess Leia is now available in the Arena Store! This fearless Rebel leader is a powerful attacker type character with extra attacks and the ability to buff an entire team with Critical bonuses.\n\nWill you be adding one of the greatest leaders of the Rebel Alliance to your collection?
data.NEWSLETTER_PRINCESS_LEIA_TITLE: Princess Leia is now available in the Arena Store!
data.NEWSLETTER_PROFUNDITY_DESC:
Hello Holotable Heroes,

The Rebels are uploading precious information to a new Capital Ship on the Holotables! A pivotal fighter in the Battle of Scarif, Admiral Raddus succeeded in taking down the shield to receive the crucial Death Star plans that the Rebellion needed in their most desperate hour.

The [c][F0FF23]Profundity[-][/c] charges its Ultimate ability [c][F0FF23]Admiral, We Have the Plans[-][/c] by increasing its Download progress from other Rebel ships. When the Ultimate is activated, the Profundity will drop the Tantive IV which the enemy capital ship will not be able to resist and jump into lightspeed to follow, leaving its ships stranded on the battlefield. With potent Special abilities, [c][F0FF23]Unconventional Maneuver[-][/c] will inflict more debuffs as it deals more instances of damage and [c][F0FF23]The Rebel Fleet Has Arrived[-][/c] will inflict Marked on Stealthed enemies. Through the Unique ability [c][F0FF23]I Say We Fight[-][/c], all units are immune to Turn Meter manipulation and Rebel Cargo ships are immune to critical hits.

Achieve dominance on the Holotables by adding the Profundity to your ships roster through the all new Journey Guide Fleet Mastery event!
data.NEWSLETTER_PROFUNDITY_TITLE: He's Returned to His Ship. He's Going to Fight.
data.NEWSLETTER_PROTECTIONSTAT_DESC:
Protection provides Characters with additional survivability and first becomes available when a Character reaches [c][9341ff]Gear Lvl VII[-][/c].

When battling against a Character with Protection, the Protection meter must be depleted prior to affecting the Character's health.

Visit the forums for discussion on this new statistic!
data.NEWSLETTER_PUNISHING_ONE_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

[c][F0FF23]Punishing One[-][/c] is coming to the Holotables!

Piloted by Dengar, this Bounty Hunter ship is a modified JumpMaster 5000. Punishing One sports an asymmetrical profile and impressive firepower that perfectly suits Dengar’s style.

Punishing One flies into Executor’s starting lineup to give an edge in mirror matches as well as against Profundity. When enemies attack it out of turn (especially Light Side enemies like those pesky Rebels), the Unique ability [c][F0FF23]JumpMaster 5000[-][/c] recovers Health and Protection for Punishing One and reduces the cooldown of its Special ability, [c][F0FF23]Wanted: Dead[-][/c], which inflicts Deathmark. The Unique also prevents enemies from recovering Health or Protection while they have Deathmark.

Its Basic ability, [c][F0FF23]Quad Laser Cannon[-][/c], deals additional damage for each Breach, Marked, and Target Lock present on the enemy, and its Special ability, Disruptive Combo, dispels all buffs on enemies and then calls a Bounty Hunter ally to assist.

Unlock Punishing One in the upcoming “PUNISHING PURSUIT” Marquee event that [c][E7E7E7]gives out Punishing One blueprints, Dengar shards, and daily rewards[-][/c] for the duration of the event!
data.NEWSLETTER_PVP_ARENA_PAYOUTS_ADJUSTMENTS: Greetings,\n\nWe recently made an adjustment to the way Arena rewards work. Payouts for your rank in Squad Arena now reward 100 less Arena Tokens, but you will now receive 100 more when completing the daily challenge by participating in 3 Arena battles.
data.NEWSLETTER_PVP_TOURNAMENT_KICKOFF_EVENT_: Prepare your squads for the upcoming Squad Tournaments with a special limited-time Squad Tournament Kickoff Weekend! All weekend long you will receive DOUBLE DROPS on Light and Dark Hard battles, Mod Challenges and Cantina Battles! In addition, you will receive a 25% BONUS across all crystal packs in the store (one-time bonus for each pack)!\n\nTake advantage of this limited-time bonus weekend, and get your best squads ready to battle for the top of the leaderboards in our first PVP Squad Tournament! The new Squad Tournaments unlocks at level 30.
data.NEWSLETTER_QIRA_DESC: To celebrate the release of the new Solo: A Star Wars Story film in theaters, Qi'ra has arrived to the Holotables! Acquire, power up, and fight with this new Scoundrel leader. Use Qi'ra, Young Han Solo, and Vandor Chewbacca to maximize their powerful [c][f0ff23]Prepared[-][/c] abilities!\n\nQi'ra is a new Scoundrel leader that increases the faction's Critical Chance and helps with their recovery and sustain in a fight. Qi'ra's leader ability also increases Scoundrel's power by their Role. Attackers gain more Offense, Tanks gain Critical Avoidance, and Supports gain Speed. Qi'ra can also use [c][f0ff23]Prepared[-][/c] to dispel all buffs on her enemies! This resourceful Scoundrel is an excellent addition to any Scoundrel squad and can be used to devastating effect with other allies that use [c][f0ff23]Prepared[-][/c]!
data.NEWSLETTER_QUALITY_OF_LIFE_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

We made some big improvements to the Cantina since you last visited. The updated holotables contain many highly requested Quality of Life changes from you, the community! You’ll notice immediately that battles are much easier to see with an option that lets you toggle the way buffs and debuffs are shown. We have also added an exciting new feature for guild leaders that allows them to Sim a raid for their entire guild, speeding up the rewards for guilds who are already easily clearing The Pit.

There's so much more in this update but I can’t let you go without mentioning the new "Leader" tag for characters with Leader abilities. This means you have another useful way to filter your characters and decide who to focus on upgrading or who to use in your next Grand Arena!

Head over to the official Galaxy of Heroes forums for the full list of changes.
data.NEWSLETTER_QUEEN_AMIDALA_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

[c][F0FF23]Queen Amidala[-][/c] is coming to the Holotables! Elected Queen of the Naboo, she firmly fought for her people and democracy even in the face of the imposing Trade Federation as they blockaded her planet. She demonstrates an admirable commitment to doing the right thing as well as an iconic wardrobe comparable to none.

Queen Amidala summons a [c][F0FF23]Handmaiden Decoy[-][/c] through her Special ability, [c][F0FF23]Ascension Gun[-][/c], to Taunt and protect her allies with the buff [c][F0FF23]Queen’s Protection[-][/c] that provides useful stats such as Health, Protection, and Speed. Her Leader ability, [c][F0FF23]My Place is with My People[-][/c], provides synergy with Heal Over Time and Protection Over Time, increasing ally offensive stats per stack. This ability also punishes enemies for attacking out of turn by inflicting Damage Over Time, and also reduces the enemy’s offensive stats when they critically hit her or her squad.

With Omicron upgrades to her abilities [c][F0FF23]I am Queen Amidala[-][/c], [c][F0FF23]My Place is with My People[-][/c], and [c][F0FF23]Loyal Bodyguard[-][/c] in the Grand Arenas game mode, her team gains extra instances of Heal Over Time and Protection Over Time as well as more benefits from these stacks. Additionally, [c][F0FF23]Loyal Bodyguard[-][/c] will summon the Decoy at start of battle to ensure the team is set up safely.

Unlock Queen Amidala during the next Conquest events and prepare for the upcoming [c][E7E7E7]Battle for Naboo raid[-][/c]!
data.NEWSLETTER_QUIGGOLD_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

[c][F0FF23]Quiggold[-][/c] is setting sail and joining the Pirates on the Holotables!

A loyal First Mate to Captain Ithano, Quiggold is foremost a tank, but is also a formidable combatant and skilled ship's gunner. With his trusty deck sweeper cannon, he can clear the way for his Pirate allies to plunder and pillage.

Quiggold's [c][F0FF23]Deck Sweeper[-][/c] Basic ability Steals Taunt from his opponents, granting it to himself while inflicting Defense Down. If no Taunt is stolen, Quiggold will gain Taunt at the cost of 1 stack of Profit.

His Special ability, [c][F0FF23]Buccaneer[-][/c], Steals Foresight and Tenacity Up from enemies, sharing them with Pirate allies. It also deals damage and inflicts the Tenacity Down and Blind debuffs. If no buffs are stolen, Quiggold's allies gain sturdy Defense and Protection buffs.

Quiggold's first Unique, [c][F0FF23]First Mate[-][/c], allows him to pre-Taunt to start the battle, and grants potent stat increases based on his Pirate allies. When injured, Quiggold fortifies himself, and stacking Profit grants Bulwark, making him Stun-immune at high stacks.

His other Unique, [c][F0FF23]Prayer Necklace[-][/c], empowers Quiggold while Taunting by providing Retaliate stacks. In Territory Battles with his Omicron ability, he starts with ample Profit, granting massive defensive stats. Enemies defeated by his Pirate allies become unable to be revived and the first time any Pirate loses half health, they gain undispellable Damage Immunity for 2 turns.

Uncover Quiggold's treasures in the upcoming [c][E7E7E7]"TROUBLE ON THE HORIZON II"[-][/c] Marquee event as the Pirates continue to assemble their fearsome crew! Quiggold will also be a requirement for Galactic Legend Pirate King Hondo Ohnaka, so make sure you’re ready for his release at the end of the Era.
data.NEWSLETTER_QUIGGOLD_TITLE: How Much Do Pirates Pay For Corn?
