data.NEWSLETTER_TB_REPUBLIC_OFFENSIVE_DESC:
[i]"More happening on Geonosis, I feel, than has been revealed."[/i] -Yoda

War rages across the surface of Geonosis as Count Dooku attempts to repel the Republic invasion. Gather your finest Clone Troopers and Galactic Republic characters and head to the Petranaki Arena to battle the terrifying Reek, but watch your back, the Nexu also stalks your squad and could be hiding around any corner. Stop these vicious beasts from ripping apart the Galactic Republic with an army of Clone Troopers or Padme and her close allies. Unlock new Clone Wars era characters and ships such as [c][F0FF23]Ki Adi Mundi[-][/c] or General Grievous' heavy cruiser, [c][F0FF23]Malevolence[-][/c], in this new [c][F0FF23]Territory Battle, Republic Offensive[-][/c].

Can your guild liberate Geonosis from Separatists' grip?
data.NEWSLETTER_TB_SAW_GERRERA_MISSION_DESC: Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\nToday's update adds a new mission on Kashyyyk to the Territory Battle: Rise of the Empire. Rally Saw Gerrera and your Rebel Fighters to earn Mk II Guild Event Tokens for your whole guild!
data.NEWSLETTER_TB_SAW_GERRERA_MISSION_TITLE: New Rise of the Empire Mission
data.NEWSLETTER_TECH_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

The next Bad Batch Clone Trooper to join the Holotables is [c][F0FF23]Tech[-][/c]! The highly technical trooper in scout armor serves as the brains of the Bad Batch and provides his allies support by handling the more delicate parts of their operations. He has modified his armor with advanced electronic systems that allow him to calculate complex trajectories, translate alien languages, and access many different types of computer systems.

While Tech is leaner compared to his clone counterparts, he is no less skilled in combat. He can use his [c][F0FF23]Brilliant Idea[-][/c] ability to deal damage to his enemies and dispel all debuffs from Clone Trooper allies while all Bad Batch allies gain Foresight, Stealth, and Tenacity Up. 

Unlock Tech in the all new Marquee event: [c][F0FF23]Clone Force 99 II[-][/c]
data.NEWSLETTER_TEMPLE_GUARD_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

[c][F0FF23]Temple Guard[-][/c] is coming to the Holotables!

A silent sentinel charged with protecting the Jedi Temple on Coruscant, the Temple Guard embodied the principles of the Jedi Order, upholding peace and justice through stoic determination and unwavering patience.

As the Tank for the Jedi Vanguard team, Temple Guard finds themselves at the front of the battle, taking the hits meant for their teammates. Their Basic ability, [c][F0FF23]Unbroken Blade[-][/c], has them attacking additional times if they are Taunting or the target has Defense Down. Their first Special, [c][F0FF23]Fear Leads To Anger[-][/c], damages all enemies and Ability Blocks them, healing and protecting Jedi and Jedi Vanguard allies based on the number of enemies Ability Blocked.

[c][F0FF23]Stoic Determination[-][/c], Temple Guard's second Special, grants them Critical Avoidance Up and Taunt while Stealthing another Light Side ally and removing Turn Meter from enemies. His Unique ability, [c][F0FF23]Patience... Is A Virtue[-][/c], provides them with inherent Critical Avoidance and Defense, increasing with their Relic Amplifier level and further enhanced by Critical Avoidance Up.

At the start of battle, Temple Guard gains benefits based on their allies' factions and roles, providing Taunt, Protection Up, and more for Galactic Republic Jedi and Jedi Vanguard squads. When a Jedi Vanguard ally loses all of their Protection for the first time, Temple Guard Taunts and gains Critical Avoidance Up. In the Grand Arenas game mode, Galactic Republic Jedi allies receive substantial offensive and defensive boosts, which are even greater if all allies are Jedi Vanguard.

Temple Guard is a required unit for unlocking Jedi Master Mace Windu, so you’ll want to unlock Temple Guard in the upcoming [c][E7E7E7]"TWILIGHT OF THE JEDI I"[-][/c] Marquee event. The Marquee event [c][E7E7E7]gives out daily rewards[-][/c] for the duration of the event!
data.NEWSLETTER_TERRITORY_BATTLE_RISE_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes!

Our latest Territory Battle, [c][F0FF23]RISE OF THE EMPIRE[-][/c], is hitting the Holotables. Starting on December 12th, your guild can select this new Territory Battle if the guild has a total of 200 million GP or more. The surviving Jedi are in hiding, Palpatine has been declared Emperor, the rumblings of Rebellion have begun to stir, and the Hutt Cartels are keeping their heads low and profits high. Every alignment and the entire galaxy are in play in this Territory Battle, meaning your entire roster will be tested in various locations throughout the Star Wars universe. Battles will be fought harkening back to the time period from the end of Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith on Mustafar and Coruscant, and taking you all the way to the time of the Rebellion in Star Wars: A New Hope on Scarif, Tatooine, and the Empire's first Death Star. Battles on the ground and in space are located within the same zone, so your guild will need to fight everything on all fronts if they hope to get three stars in any given phase.

Operations are the new name for Platoons and now support both Characters and Ships so careful planning must be made to ensure they are filled to strengthen or weaken the Operation Abilities tied to that phase. A mix of existing Planetary Modifiers (from Galactic Challenges) and new ones will ensure every combat and special mission is its own unique challenge, so remember to share your winning strategies with your guild.

As with all Territory Battles, many missions will require specific units or factions. As you battle across the galaxy, you will find missions requiring you to bring the Grand Inquisitor, Jabba the Hutt, Scythe, or Doctor Aphra, at or better than specific Relic levels.

The Rise of the Empire Territory Battle runs for 6 days, with 24-hour phases, to have your guild complete their battles and deployments. The earliest phases are tuned for Relic Level 5 characters and ship crews, with the difficulty increasing each phase. Grab your lightsabers, warm up your X-wings, and make sure you're on Jabba's good side, the Rise of the Empire Territory Battle starts soon!
data.NEWSLETTER_TERRITORY_BATTLE_RISE_TITLE: The More You Tighten Your Grip, the More Star Systems Slip Through Your Fingers
data.NEWSLETTER_TERRITORY_BATTLES_DESC:
We are super excited to share our newest feature, Territory Battles! This is an epic, multi-phase battle that pitches the entire collection of characters and ships of every guild member against a progressively challenging, living battlefield.

-Increase your Galactic Power with every unit earned and upgraded

-Work collaboratively with your Guild to bring in over 7,000 units into battle and earn the best rewards together (All members earn equal rewards)

-Earn brand new characters Hermit Yoda and Rebel Officer Leia Organa

-Make your characters stronger than ever with Gear Tier XII

-Unlock special abilities like the Ion Cannon in Platoon Missions

-Find a Guild faster with Guild Search

Have fun and thanks for joining the fight!
data.NEWSLETTER_TERRITORY_WARS_DESC:
Get prepared for the ultimate Guild vs. Guild showdown, Territory Wars, a new guild event that pits your Guild and collection against other Guilds and their collections for the true test of who is on top!

-Prepare your territories for invasion by setting defenses

-Conquer enemy territories as you annihilate their defenses

-Use all new Guild Leader/Officer commands to direct your guildmates in both Territory Wars and Battles

-Climb the leaderboard and show the world your guild's power

-Anticipate regular changes to keep gameplay varied and exciting! These could include unique unit bonuses and Platoon Missions.

If you're not already part of a Guild, there are so many other advantages to joining one now:

-Earn exclusive gear and characters like Hermit Yoda, General Kenobi, Han Solo, and Rebel Officer Leia Organa!

-Territory Battles: Coordinate your forces to crush the rebellion on Hoth (or push back the Empire)

-Raids: Fight the Rancor in his pit and an AAT on Geonosis

-Request and Donate gear

Go find a Guild Now!
data.NEWSLETTER_THE_ARMORER_DESC:
Hello Holotable Heroes,

It's hammer time. [c][F0FF23]The Armorer[-][/c] makes her way from the forge to the Holotables! Her expertise in forging Beskar, in addition to her wealth of traditional Mandalorian knowledge, ensured The Armorer would become a quick and steadfast ally of certain Outer Rim bounty hunters.

With her tools in hand, The Armorer is ready to distribute the new [c][F0FF23]Beskar Armor[-][/c] buff, increasing her allies' survivability by granting Defense, Health, Protection recovery, Critical Hit Immunity and Counter Chance.

In addition to The Armorer's abilities, she also introduces the brand new [c][F0FF23]Mandalorian[-][/c] faction tag to Galaxy of Heroes! This tag will also be added to the following characters: The Mandalorian, The Mandalorian (Beskar Armor), Jango Fett, Sabine Wren, Gar Saxon, Imperial Super Commando, and Canderous Ordo.

Make The Armorer part of your tribe by unlocking her in the all new Marquee Event WAY OF THE MANDALORE!
data.NEWSLETTER_THE_STRANGER_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

[c][F0FF23]The Stranger[-][/c] is coming to the Holotables!

Hailing from the High Republic era, this enigmatic warrior exploded onto the scene in the forest of Khofar in the Disney+ show, The Acolyte. The Stranger's power is undeniable, cutting down an entire team of Jedi with relative ease. Acting as a mentor to both light and dark side Force users, he seeks to gather a group of powerful students while pursuing his own agenda.

The Stranger's Leader ability, [c][F0FF23]I Want a Pupil[-][/c], allows him to transform a carefully selected team of Force users into Acolytes, granting them powerful synergies and abilities. It’s no coincidence that the prerequisites for this perfectly sync with the team that Starkiller is looking to assemble. His Special ability, [c][F0FF23]An Acolyte Kills the Dream[-][/c], showcases his tactical prowess by calling Dark Side Unaligned Force User Acolytes to assist while providing defensive benefits to himself and debuffing enemies.

The Stranger excels at accumulating power throughout battle through his Basic ability [c][F0FF23]Peace is a Lie[-][/c] and his devastating Special ability [c][F0FF23]Was That Its Name?[-][/c], both of which have the capability of instantly defeating opponents. His Unique ability [c][F0FF23]You Might Call Me...Sith[-][/c] provides him with impressive offensive capabilities and defensive measures through Cortosis Armor, making him a formidable opponent in any battle.

Face the challenge of acquiring The Stranger in the upcoming Conquest season! This powerful character offers exceptional leadership for mixed Light and Dark side teams, and brings particular strength to Grand Arena battles through multiple Omicron abilities. Players can earn The Stranger in Conquests starting on 10/27/2025.
data.NEWSLETTER_THRAWN_MYTHIC_DESC:
The Holotable continues the relentless march of the dark side with the release of the [i]Artist of War[/i] Mythic event.

Gather your Phoenix Squadron and face Grand Admiral Thrawn or join forces with the Grand Admiral and crush the Phoenix Rebels! This new multi-tier Mythic event is intended for elder players and has valuable rewards should you succeed.

Master the [i]Artist of War[/i] today!
data.NEWSLETTER_THREEPIO_CHEWIE_DESC: Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\nFew pairings in Star Wars have had each other’s backs like [c][F0FF23]Threepio & Chewie[-][/c], who are arriving as a unique combo on the Holotables! The bond forged on Cloud City between one of our favorite droids and Wookiees showed the Empire this unlikely duo is a force to be reckoned with. In addition to being a unique combination unit, Threepio & Chewie offer new gameplay strategies by providing both damage and support abilities, ramping damage, and afflicting [c][F0FF23]Blind[-][/c] on enemies. Only an overgrown mophead would miss out on the chance to add Threepio & Chewie to their collection! So, don't do anything foolish and make sure to participate in the Marquee event, [c][F0FF23]Escape From Cloud City[-][/c].

data.NEWSLETTER_TIE_DAGGER_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

The Dark Side reigns! [c][F0FF23]TIE Dagger[-][/c], piloted by Sith Trooper and the next piece to the upcoming dominant Sith fleet, is coming to the holotables!

The TIE Dagger brings a high damage attacker to the Sith Fleet. Through its unique [c][F0FF23]Emperor’s Edict[-][/c] the ship gains stacks of [c][F0FF23]Vengeance[-][/c] when enemies attack out of turn or inflict debuffs. When it reaches enough stacks of Vengeance all debuffs are dispelled on Sith allies, it recovers Health, gains stacking Offense, and then takes a bonus turn. During this bonus turn, TIE Dagger will be able to ignore Taunt and when under a Sith Capital Ship, Protection as well.

TIE Dagger is also able to apply some powerful debuffs. When it uses its Basic ability [c][F0FF23]Sith Precision[-][/c] and scores a critical hit, the enemy is inflicted with Ability Block. Additionally, [c][F0FF23]L-7.0 Heavy Laser Cannons[-][/c] can apply Vulnerable to full Health enemies and Tenacity Down to non-full Health enemies.

Unlock the TIE Dagger in the upcoming Galactic Chase event and prepare for the Leviathan!
data.NEWSLETTER_TIE_DEFENDER_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

[c][F0FF23]TIE Defender[-][/c], piloted by the elite Iden Versio, is coming to the holotables!

The TIE Defender is set up well to bolster the Empire fleet with the reinforcement ability [c][F0FF23]We Weren't Expecting Special Forces.[-][/c] This grants the new status effect [c][F0FF23]Special Forces[-][/c] that empowers the TIE Defender's other abilities through extra damage, Turn Meter for itself and its Capital ship, and a Stun that can't be evaded, dispelled, or resisted.

TIE Defender has good evasion and foresight synergy from its Unique abilities [c][F0FF23]P-sz9.7 Twin Ion Engine[-][/c] and [c][F0FF23]TIE/x7[-][/c]. The latter provides Foresight when TIE Defender has at least one stack of Resilient Defense, which it gains from landing critical hits from its Basic ability, [c][F0FF23]Wingtip L-s9.3 Laser Cannons[-][/c], making it quite tricky to take out. This is amplified by the TIE Defender counting as a TIE fighter, making it a strong reinforcement for the Executrix lead fleet with Scythe.

Unlock the TIE Defender in the upcoming Galactic Chase event!
data.NEWSLETTER_TIE_ECHELON_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

The [c][F0FF23]TIE Echelon[-][/c] is zooming onto the holotables! Piloted by First Order Officer, this impressive tank is ready to provide cover for its allies as they crush the opposition.

The TIE Echelon increases a First Order fleet’s survivability by granting Protection Up to itself and its allies. To keep its allies safe, TIE Echelon can call First Order allies to assist and then grant them Stealth. Enemy fleets will be forced to focus on the TIE Echelon only to find it's a serious challenge to defeat. This ship continuously gains Defense, Max Health, and Max Protection throughout the battle and recovers Health and Protection whenever a First Order ally lands a critical hit. When called upon for reinforcement, the TIE Echelon gains Taunt whenever a First Order ally's Stealth expires.

Unlock the TIE Echelon during the upcoming [c][F0FF23]Galactic Chase[-][/c] event to add this capable tank to your fleet collection!
data.NEWSLETTER_TIE_FIGHTER_DROP_DESC: The TIE Fighter Pilot is now available in Cantina Battles Stage 4 Mission B! This relentless attacker is a great addition to Empire squads with the ability to call down a "TIE Strike," dealing damage to all enemies and inflicting Buff immunity for 2 rounds. His two other abilities, "Targeting Computer" and "Evasive Maneuvers", give great synergy with other Empire units who can debuff enemy squads, granting him increased damage and turn meter with the former and a chance to gain Foresight with the latter. \n\nAdd the TIE Fighter Pilot to your squad today!
data.NEWSLETTER_TIE_FIGHTER_DROP_TITLE: TIE Fighter Pilot is now available in Cantina Battles!
data.NEWSLETTER_TIE_INTERCEPTOR_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

Conquest 13 begins soon and blueprints for a new ship, the [c][F0FF23]TIE/IN Interceptor Prototype[-][/c], will be available for a limited time in this mode! Piloted by Second Sister, the TIE Interceptor is a powerful reinforcement for Empire fleets. Its Unique, [c][F0FF23]Prototype Design[-][/c], grants TIE Interceptor Foresight when an Empire, Inquisitorius, or Sith ally reinforces, and the allied Capital ship gains Turn Meter when the TIE Interceptor scores a critical hit.

The TIE Interceptor also introduces two new effects, [c][F0FF23]Ruthless[-][/c] and [c][F0FF23]Pursued Target[-][/c]. Ruthless is a buff that increases offensive capabilities while Pursued Target is a status effect which allows the TIE Interceptor to ignore Taunt to attack the units with Pursued Target. The TIE Interceptor also gains Turn Meter when it attacks enemies with Pursued Target.

Furthermore, as a leader of the Inquisitors, Darth Vader now reduces allied Empire Capital Ship cooldowns when TIE/IN Interceptor Prototype starts in reinforcements and TIE Advanced x1 is on the field. This effect is being added to the final tier of his Unique, [c][F0FF23]Advanced Targeting System[-][/c].

Earn TIE/IN Interceptor Prototype blueprints during the upcoming Conquest events!
data.NEWSLETTER_TIE_INTERCEPTOR_TITLE: The Empire's Inquisitors Join The Fleet

His two other abilities, “Targeting Computer” and “Evasive Maneuvers”, give great synergy with other Empire units who can debuff enemy squads.\n\nBe sure to login daily during the month of October and add this fearless pilot to your collection!

data.NEWSLETTER_TRIPLEZERO_BT1_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

[c][F0FF23]0-0-0[-][/c] and [c][F0FF23]BT-1,[-][/c] Doctor Aphra's droids and products of the good sir Tarkin's initiative, are coming to the holotables!

0-0-0's Special ability [c][F0FF23]Specialized in Torture[-][/c] fulfills its namesake by inflicting Torture on enemies and granting Translation to Dark Side allies if the target already had Torture. In 3v3 Grand Arenas with an Omicron upgrade, Torture will last longer on the target and if this defeats an enemy, Dark Side allies will stack Offense. His first Unique ability, [c][F0FF23]Interrogation Protocol,[-][/c] provides Translation to Dark Side allies when they use an ability on enemies with Torture, and his second Unique ability [c][F0FF23]Drain Organics[-][/c] allows 0-0-0 and BT-1 to grant each other Translation if they gain it and gives Turn Meter to Dark Side allies when they defeat a non-Droid enemy.

BT-1's Basic ability [c][F0FF23]Overcharged Laser[-][/c] and Special ability [c][F0FF23]Agent of Destruction[-][/c] lay down debuffs including Damage Over Time and Expose. If 0-0-0 is an ally, BT-1 assists 0-0-0 through his first Unique ability [c][F0FF23]Homicidal Counterpart[-][/c] and in 3v3 Grand Arenas with an Omicron upgrade, if either of them defeats an enemy they refresh their cooldowns and gain Turn Meter. This ability also gives the granted ability [c][F0FF23]Kill Them All,[-][/c] which calls 0-0-0 to assist. His second Unique ability [c][F0FF23]Blastomech Prototype[-][/c] gives BT-1 plenty of Offense and if he defeats an enemy, he becomes so excited that he takes a bonus turn to use the granted ability [c][F0FF23]Haywire[-][/c] which damages everyone on the field. 0-0-0 was right when he called BT-1 a selfish little murder bucket!

These droids form such a powerful duo that not only do their kits heavily benefit from them being together on the field, they also share an event! Add 0-0-0 and BT-1 to your roster by unlocking them in the all-new “MURDER AND MANNERS” Marquee event!
data.NEWSLETTER_TU1_BALANCE_CHANGES_CHANGELOG:
Greetings heroes!

We just released a major update to the balance of the game. Here are some details:

All units now have ability upgrades available. Make sure to go back to your Characters screen to check for new available upgrades!

All units have received a balance pass against their damage ratio values on damaging abilities. Underperforming units increased in damaging effectiveness whereas those over performing have been brought more in-line with intended results.

All Light and Dark Missions have been adjusted to accommodate for new unit balance changes.

Special Damage type abilities have been brought in-line with the Physical Damage type ability counterparts.

We expect that there may be some issues with ability behavior. As always, we will continue to release updates that include bug fixes for unit abilities.

We hope you will continue to enjoy Star Wars: Galaxy of Heroes as we balance and improve the game to make it as fun and fair as we can!

-The Star Wars: Galaxy of Heroes team
data.NEWSLETTER_TU1_CHANGES:
Attention Holotable masters, now you can build squads with all your favorite characters,regardless of alignment, with new Cantina Battles. Plus, check out these other new features:

Galactic War Mode – Unlocks at Level 40. Your characters’ health will not regenerate between battles!

Sim Tickets – These new reward drops, earned after scoring 3 stars on a mission, let you repeat missions to gain more rewards faster.

Updated Map – Get a look at the next boss you’ll face in Normal missions and which character shard you could earn in Hard missions.

Thanks for playing Star Wars: Galaxy of Heroes. Let us know how we’re doing with a rating!
data.NEWSLETTER_TU11_QOL_DESC:
Get excited – everything you love just got better! Now you can:

• Earn the right to multi-sim Galactic War and Ship Challenges

• Receive bonus banners based on combat performance in Territory Wars 

• View which Territory War defensive squads were most successful 

• Search for units by name when selecting your squad

• Link accounts to play between Android and iOS devices

• Set inactive units as favorites and find all favorites easier

• Research and purchase shipments faster 

• View major improvements to the Raids Ticket (Daily) leaderboard

• and so much more!

Check out the full update notes over at the forums!
data.NEWSLETTER_TU12_DESC:
We've updated the Holotables and added some exciting new features!

Embark on Quests and tackle challenges from various Cantina characters and learn the lessons needed to become a Holotable champion! Demonstrate your mastery by completing an elite set of Prestigious Quests meant for only the strongest players to earn Player Titles and glory. Player Titles show your competitors the power of your collection and strategies!

Players can now join a Starter Guild beginning at level 22! Learn how Guilds work early with a Guild of players near your level before more advanced Guild content. Chat has also been updated to allow players to: send direct messages, create up to 5 Guild Chats, Exchange Gear directly in chat, and join Group Chats of up to 500 players. Guild leaders/officers can also now: schedule raid start times, raid damage allowed times, and Officers can now update the Guild Message in up to 5 Guild Chats.

Ships combat has been reworked! Prepare to take your Fleets to the next level with Reinforcement Abilities! All Ship ability kits and stats have also been reworked to make battles more exciting and strategic! Experience reworked Ships combat in Territory Wars, Territory Battles, Fleet Arena, and Ship Challenges. The Ship Ability Materials Challenge has been expanded to include a new tier where players can earn new rewards. We've also added 'Fleet Battles', a new Ships PvE table! Fleet Battles are locked for now, but are coming very soon. What Fleet will you choose to lead you to victory?
data.NEWSLETTER_TU12_TITLE: Improved Chat, Starter Guilds, Reworked Ship Combat, and much more!
data.NEWSLETTER_TU17_UPDATE02_SHIPS_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

Two brand new ships have landed on the holotables, the Galactic Republic’s [c][f0ff23]BTL-B Y-wing[-][/c] and the Separatist [c][f0ff23]Hyena Bomber[-][/c].

The BTL-B Y-wing is an aggressive bomber that can take a beating compared to the stripped down counter part used by the rebellion. Armed with proton bombs and a bubble turret to defend against incoming fighters, the Y-wing can attack even the most heavily defended targets and punch through the enemy’s Taunt. Get shards of the BTL-B Y-wing in an upcoming Marquee event!

The Separatists also gained a heavily armored bomber to assist their faction’s fleet. The Hyena Bomber is effective at protecting Vulture Droid allies and absorbing an incredible amount of fire power depending on how many Separatist and Droid allies are present but this droid controlled bomber is not just a tank. It can also launch salvos of Buzz Droids at the enemy to weaken their armor and provide allied Separatist ships powerful advantages. Get shards of the Hyena Bomber in the upcoming Galactic Chase starting Nov 1st!

Greetings Heroes,

This latest update brings an exciting new challenge to players, the Grand Master’s Training Event. In this event you will be able to challenge Grand Master Yoda with a team of Jedi to earn Crystals, Credits and character shards for Grand Master Yoda himself!

data.NEWSLETTER_TU38_SUMMARY:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

Happy 10th Anniversary! As part of this momentous occasion, the game has been updated with a ton of new features!

You might have noticed something was different the moment you stepped into the Cantina. Now front and center is the latest Marquee event and place to play with them immediately, an all new game mode, Coliseum! Light and Dark Side battles have been moved to the Campaigns tables (formerly the Cantina Table).

The Era system has been updated and now Marquees have their own progression system during the Era. During each Era, players will be granted the Era Marquee units automatically when their event begins. Battle it out in the Coliseum immediately to earn new materials to upgrade your Marquee units. Face the latest bosses on the Coliseum floor with daily rotating Boss encounters. Who are the Hutts throwing at you this time?! Each Era also contains a special Era Journey Guide Unit that can help you power up your Squads during and after the Era.

Every other week during an Era you will find Era Challenge events, where you can take on new foes designed to test your Marquee squad’s strength! Era Challenges replace Galactic Challenges and the Episode Pass rewards have moved to Episode Quests.

After the Era, these units will be converted to the Legacy progression system and come out upgraded based on the Era Level each unit reached.

Check out the official forums for more information on these many changes!

data.NEWSLETTER_TUSKEN_CHIEFTAIN_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

Coming from the tribe of Tuskens that took in Boba Fett in the Dune Sea of Tatooine, the [c][F0FF23]Tusken Chieftain[-][/c] is coming to the holotables!

Tusken Chieftain brings a new Leader ability, [c][F0FF23]Nomadic People[-][/c], to the Tusken faction. Boba Fett, Scion of Jango introduced the Momentum effect to the game and this ability expands it to the Tuskens. Through the Leader, Tusken allies will gain a Momentum stack when an enemy gains bonus turn meter and Tuskens gain Defense and Tenacity for each stack they have.  If a Tusken has enough Momentum when they are targeted, targeting enemies will be hit with a Stun that can't be resisted and the attacked Tusken will lose all Momentum with a chance to inflict a Damage Over Time for each stack lost.

In 3v3 Grand Arenas with the Omicron upgrade to this Leader ability, Boba Fett, Scion of Jango will count as a Tusken ally assuming there are no summoned units on your side. Additionally, he starts the battle with his payout active and will not lose his Momentum stacks when attacked, making his Special abilities very threatening.

While this Tusken team works primarily with Momentum, they also have an affinity for Damage Over Time. Through Tusken Chieftain’s Unique ability, [c][F0FF23]Ancestral Claim[-][/c], enemies who recover health or protection are inflicted with a Damage Over Time and Tuskens recover health whenever an enemy takes damage from it. Furthermore, the Tuskens’ own resilience to the harsh desert makes them immune to Damage Over Time.

Unlock Tusken Chieftain in the new “Warriors of the Dune Sea” Marquee event and prepare for the Tusken faction to finally be complete in the next release with the Tusken Warrior!
data.NEWSLETTER_TUSKEN_SHAMAN_CHROMIUM_DESC:
Tusken Shaman is now available in Chromium Packs! This offensive healer is able to buff and heal his allies while rapidly inflicting Damage Over Time effects on his enemies.

Tusken Shaman is great for Tusken squads with his unique ability, “Master Storyteller”, providing all Tuskens with both Turn Meter and Health recovery for every defeated enemy. His abilities will also pair well with characters who debuff enemy units as each additional negative status effect increases his own abilities effectiveness!

Will you be adding this desert savage to your squad?
data.NEWSLETTER_TUSKEN_SHAMAN_CHROMIUM_TITLE: New Chromium Pack Character: Tusken Shaman
data.NEWSLETTER_TUSKEN_WARRIOR_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

Born of the harsh sands of the Dune Sea of Tatooine, a hard as nails huntress fights for her tribe! The [c][F0FF23]Tusken Warrior[-][/c], Boba Fett’s mentor and teacher, has arrived on the holotables to finally complete the Tusken faction.

Tusken Warrior expands the Tusken synergy with Damage Over Time and Momentum through her abilities and uses these effects to do big damage. Her Special ability [c][F0FF23]Finishing Strikes[-][/c] does more damage to the target enemy as Warrior has more Momentum, allowing her to ramp up for a big hit. This ability and her Basic ability [c][F0FF23]Gaderffii Smack[-][/c] inflict Damage Over Time, which empowers her Unique ability [c][F0FF23]Centuries of Tradition[-][/c] to increase the damage of her abilities for each Damage Over Time on all enemies and lowers enemy Tenacity when these expire.

With an Omicron upgrade in Territory Wars, Warrior will dispel herself, refresh the cooldown of her big hit, and take a bonus turn each time she gains enough Momentum.

Unlock Tusken Warrior in the new “WARRIORS OF THE DUNE SEA II” Marquee event!

data.NEWSLETTER_TW_UPDATE_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

We’re shaking things up in Territory Wars! We heard positive feedback from the community about the limited-time character bonuses for the 10th anniversary of The Clone Wars, so we're continuing on that path.

This upcoming Territory War has been created by YOU, the community! You've voted to determine which of your favorite characters to bring into battle and which ones will stay on the sidelines. Head over to the forums to find out if your favorite characters made the cut!

The forums also have more details on the current community-driven Territory Wars, and stay tuned there for future rounds of voting to help shape Territory Wars!
data.NEWSLETTER_UNITY_UPGRADE_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

Today’s Update improves many of the underlying technologies that we use to create Galaxy of Heroes. These significant tech upgrades enable us to continue to support this amazing game for years to come and bring you the Star Wars experience better than ever.

It may seem like nothing has changed when you log in, but there are plenty of updates under the hood that allow for numerous improvements in the future. With a unified tool set and modernized APIs, these changes give the designers access to more tools and a smoother process for developing new content.

On the visual side, this update also enables us to create better character animations and cutscenes that truly capture the exciting moment of Star Wars. Some of those improvements you may have already seen in The Mandalorian characters or the Jedi Knight Luke event and this update allows us to do even more in the years to come.

This is a large, exciting update for the long term future of the game. We strive to provide you with the highest level of service because we believe in the game, and the community. That’s why we have invested time in upgrading the game’s technology, so we can all enjoy this game as passionate Star Wars fans for years to come.

Thank you all for your support!
data.NEWSLETTER_UNLOCKS_SEP_15_DESCRIPTION:
Star Wars: Galaxy of Heroes includes many features that unlock as you collect characters and increase your Player Level. Here's the complete list of unlockable features and their requirements:

Light Side Battles: Use your light side characters to battle dark side characters. Unlocked at the beginning of the game.

Dark Side Battles: Use your dark side characters to battle light side characters. Unlocked after reaching Player Level 12 and collecting 3 or more dark side characters.

Squad Arena: Battle other players' squads using any characters in your Collection. Unlocked at Player Level 8.

Challenges: Uniquely difficult Battles that drop unique rewards. Unlocks at Player Level 15.

Galactic War: Fight a multi-battle campaign where character health does not regenerate to unlock various rewards. Unlocks at Player Level 40.

Events And Keys: Collect Keys that allow you to fight in Event Battles that drop valuable rewards. Unlocks at Player Level 52.

We will be adding more features over the coming months.
data.NEWSLETTER_UPCOMING_CHARACTER_CHANGES_DE:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

In today's Update, Darth Vader, General Skywalker, Jedi Knight Luke Skywalker, and Wat Tambor have had several changes to their kits in regards to ignoring Defense. Previously, we returned the resources used to upgrade these units beyond Relic 7 to your inbox and reset these units to Relic 7.

We have also updated several kits with Galactic Legends exceptions in addition to Raid Bosses exceptions. Related to this change, Dark Trooper was reset to Relic 5 if you had upgraded Dark Trooper beyond this level and any resources used to upgrade Dark Trooper above Relic 5 were returned to your inbox in the last Update.

Please visit the Official Forums for more information.
data.NEWSLETTER_UPDATED_CANTINA_ENERGY_MESSAG: With the introduction of Mods, we have reworked how Cantina Energy is refreshed. Previously, Cantina Energy refreshes scaled in cost far more aggressively than standard Energy refreshes. With this update we have brought the cost to refresh Cantina Energy down significantly so you can get the Shards, Ability Materials, and Mods you need!\n\nWe hope that you enjoy this change!
data.NEWSLETTER_UPDATED_WEBSITE_DESC: The official website for Star Wars: Galaxy of Heroes has been revamped and now includes pages for game Strategies and Community contributions. Be sure to bookmark it in your browser and check in every week for new content.
data.NEWSLETTER_VADER_REWORK_DESC: Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\nExcuse the heavy breathing, but we are excited to announce a rework of [c][F0FF23]Darth Vader[-][/c], the man behind the galaxy's most iconic mask, infamous Sith Lord, and a dad who just wants to spend more time with his son. Counted on as the Emperor's most loyal subject, Darth Vader relishes destroying his foes, squashing rebellions, and reminding pompous subordinates to not "choke" on their aspirations. Although he's more machine now than man, there's always room for improvement. As such, Vader will be getting an entirely new ability, [c][F0FF23]Merciless Massacre[-][/c]. Look for the Vader rework just in time for "I Am Your Father's" Day, and together...you can rule the Holotables!
data.NEWSLETTER_VANE_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

[c][F0FF23]Vane[-][/c] is coming to the Holotables!

A ruthless Pirate Tank, Vane makes his fortune by plundering the trade routes of the Outer Rim. His greed, lust for credits, and mercurial loyalty know no bounds, and he will stop at nothing to amass a fortune beyond imagining.

Vane's Unique ability, [c][F0FF23]Myth of the Outer Rim[-][/c], transforms him into an unstoppable Tank when paired with a crew of Pirate allies. He Taunts whenever another Pirate gains Profit, equalizes his defenses with weaker allies, and becomes more evasive as debuffs stack on him. When [c][F0FF23]Pirate King Hondo Ohnaka[-][/c] is the Leader, Vane gains incredible synergies like damage reduction, Protection recovery, and increased Profit stacking.

His first Special ability, [c][F0FF23]Put it Down, Little One[-][/c], allows Vane to Stun enemies when at higher Health or recover Health when weaker. If he has amassed enough Profit, he can even Steal and refresh Taunt from the enemy. His second Special, [c][F0FF23]It Must Be Fake[-][/c], dispels debuffs from his Pirate crew at the cost of inflicting them on himself, granting allies beneficial effects in return and increasing Vane's maximum Health.

Unlock the fearsome [c][F0FF23]Vane[-][/c] in the upcoming [c][E7E7E7]"FORTUNE FAVORS THE BOLD II"[-][/c] marquee event that [c][E7E7E7]gives out daily rewards[-][/c]! Vane will be a requirement (at Relic 7) for Galactic Legend Pirate King Hondo Ohnaka, as well as usable in the Order 66 Raid and Tales from the Outer Rim Era Battle.
data.NEWSLETTER_VANE_TITLE: He Probably Thinks this Newsletter is About Him
data.NEWSLETTER_VEL_SARTHA_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

[c][F0FF23]Vel Sartha[-][/c] is coming to the Holotables!

Vel Sartha stands as a beacon of hope and resilience for the Rebel Alliance, her unwavering commitment to the cause matched only by her tactical brilliance. A seasoned operative who has survived impossible odds, Vel brings both cunning strategy and battle-tested combat ability to any situation.

[c][F0FF23]Vel Sartha[-][/c] serves as a Support pillar for the newest [c][F0FF23]Rebel Fighter[-][/c] squad, leveraging her tactical expertise to strengthen her allies while systematically Undermining her enemies. Her [c][F0FF23]BK-43 Blaster Rifle[-][/c] Basic attacks build her defensive resilience while crippling enemy offense, while her [c][F0FF23]Disrupting Barrage[-][/c] Special ability Blinds and protects her squad with a potent Entrenched buff that stacks benefits across her team.

Her Unique abilities, [c][F0FF23]One Path One Choice[-][/c] and [c][F0FF23]She Was a Miracle[-][/c], showcase her role as a force multiplier—sharing her impressive stats with Rebel Fighter allies, capitalizing on Undermined enemies, and protecting her closest ally Cinta through coordinated synergy. With her Omicron ability in the Territory Battles game mode, Vel powers up the Rebel Fighter squad with stacking Offense and the ability to quickly Undermine the entire enemy squad.

Unlock [c][F0FF23]Vel Sartha[-][/c] in [c][F0FF23]"The Price of Rebellion"[-][/c] Marquee event that features daily rewards and harness her power to achieve victory for the Rebel Fighters! Vel Sartha is required at 4 stars to unlock the Journey Guide unit Cassian Andor (Undercover).
data.NEWSLETTER_VULTURE_DROID_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

The Variable Geometry Self-Propelled Battle Droid, also known as the [c][F0FF23]Vulture Droid[-][/c], is coming to the holotables! This Droid starfighter, commonly used by the Trade Federation, is a fast and agile attacker that is easily damaged, but also easily replaced. These mass-produced ships are capable of launching Buzz Droids at enemy ships and ripping through their armor, weakening it for further attacks. For the first time on the holotables, this ship doesn’t require any crew, which means you can unlock the Vulture Droid and use it to reinforce your armada immediately. Bolster your fleet with this Separatist starfighter today!

See you on the holotables!
data.NEWSLETTER_WEDGE_CANTINA_MISSION_MESSAGE: Wedge is now available in Cantina Stage 6 Mission F. This talented Corellian Rebel pilot was a veteran of the attacks on both Death Stars. A leader in Red Squadron, Wedge, is a Rebel attacker with strong offensive abilities that deal more damage based enemy health and debuffs, while providing increased offence and health recovery to Rebel allies.\n\nWill you be adding this Rebel pilot to your squad?
data.NEWSLETTER_WEDGE_CANTINA_MISSION_TITLE: Wedge is now available in the Cantina Battles!
data.NEWSLETTER_WICKET_ATST_EVENT_DESC: Welcome our final addition to the Ewok invasion - Wicket arrives in the Galaxy of Heroes! This powerful attacker finds his strength in numbers, granting incredible critical hit and stealth synergies to Ewok squads, while also dealing more critical damage for each Ewok present. In addition, Wicket's unique, Furtive Tactics, gives Wicket a chance to take another turn, each turn.\n\nTo celebrate Wickets arrival, we're introducing a brand new type of event, the Heroic Battle. Heroic Battles will have players fighting huge enemies and earning unique rewards in a recurring event. The first time the AT-ST appears it will yield rare Mods. Future appearances of the AT-ST will be players' source to obtain Wicket shards! Be on the lookout for future appearances of the AT-ST!
data.NEWSLETTER_WICKET_ATST_EVENT_TITLE: Wicket Arrives and the AT-ST Heroic Battle
data.NEWSLETTER_WRECKER_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes!

[c][F0FF23]Wrecker[-][/c], the resilient and dauntless commando of Clone Force 99 has joined the Holotables! 

This extra large genetically engineered soldier protects his Clone Trooper and Bad Batch allies with a ferocity and strength that few other clones possess. After taking damage from his enemies, Wrecker turns his [c][F0FF23]Fury[-][/c] into a new undispellable buff, [c][F0FF23]Furious[-][/c], which boosts his abilities with additional effects.

Wrecker’s large stature and demeanor means he is not particularly suited for sneaking around and there are few words he hates more than "stealth". In battle, whenever Wrecker gains Stealth, he dispels it and gains Taunt. Wrecker would much rather rip enemy droids apart with his hands, use another droid as a melee weapon, or just blow the whole thing up. "Quiet" is not part of this clone’s vocabulary.

Unlock Wrecker in the all new Marquee event: [c][F0FF23]Clone Force 99 III[-][/c]
data.NEWSLETTER_WRECKERS3_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

[c][F0FF23]Wrecker (Mercenary)[-][/c] is coming to the Holotables!

A part of Clone Force 99, Wrecker’s loyalty to the other members of the Bad Batch often causes him to run head first into situations, counting on his brute strength and his demolitions expertise to see him through. Wrecker has a particularly strong bond with Omega, whose influence sometimes helps him to temper his more impulsive characteristics.

True to his nature, Wrecker again serves as the Tank for this new Bad Batch squad. Wrecker’s Basic ability, [c][F0FF23]Haymaker[-][/c], deals damage twice while dispelling debuffs on the target enemy and removing Turn Meter for each buff dispelled. His first Special ability, [c][F0FF23]Colossal Smash[-][/c], gives him an active Taunt and inflicts Disarm on an enemy. [c][F0FF23]Improvised Weapon[-][/c], his second Special ability, allows him to gain permanent defensive stats throughout battle in addition to dealing damage to all enemies and providing a much needed dispel for his allies.

Wrecker’s first Unique ability, [c][F0FF23]You Gotta Be in Front To Win[-][/c], provides extra Health and Protection to him whenever he has a Captive ally, and, while in the Territory Battles game mode with his Omicron active, allows for each Bad Batch ally to be revived once after they’ve already been rescued. Wrecker’s final ability, Soldier of Fortune, gives stacking Offense and Tenacity to his Mercenary allies for each stack of [c][F0FF23]Soldier of Fortune[-][/c] they have while he is active. 

Unlock Wrecker (Mercenary) in the upcoming “[c][E7E7E7]The Cavalry Has Arrived IV[-][/c]” Marquee event that [c][E7E7E7]gives out daily rewards[-][/c] for the duration of the event!
data.NEWSLETTER_WRECKERS3_TITLE: Why Does It Always Have to Be a Big Monster?
data.NEWSLETTER_YODA_CHEWIE_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

[c][F0FF23]Yoda & Chewie[-][/c] are coming to the Holotables!

When Master Yoda traveled to Kashyyyk to aid the Wookiees in their defense against the Separatist invasion, he formed an unlikely bond with a young Wookiee warrior named Chewbacca. When Order 66 was executed and the clones turned on Yoda, Chewbacca and Tarfful helped the Jedi Master escape, giving the Jedi Master, and all future Jedi, a chance to survive.

Yoda & Chewie's Basic ability, [c][F0FF23]May the Furce be with You[-][/c], strikes enemies multiple times while granting themselves Speed Up. Their first Special ability, [c][F0FF23]One with the Furce[-][/c], heals all Wookiee allies and grants them Foresight, with Wookiee Support allies also gaining Frenzy if Tarfful is leading the squad. [c][F0FF23]The Furce Awakens[-][/c], their second Special ability, strips all buffs from enemies before dealing damage and Distracting the primary target, and when paired with Tarfful as Leader, Yoda & Chewie assist again while granting all Wookiee allies Advantage.

Their Unique ability, [c][F0FF23]The Furce is My Ally[-][/c], grants all Wookiee allies Foresight and, with a full Wookiee squad, provides Yoda & Chewie with Master's Training while creating powerful synergies around Foresight. With their Grand Arena Omicron active, all Wookiee allies receive significant Critical Damage and Speed bonuses, and a full Wookiee squad gains Master's Training for everyone while adding Retribution to Foresight, inflicting Damage Over Time when attacking out of turn, and spreading Fear when defeating enemies. Additionally, Yoda & Chewie can trigger Damage Over Time effects and even Disarm when using Special abilities while they have Foresight.

Unlock Yoda & Chewie in the upcoming [c][E7E7E7]"THE LAST HOPE"[-][/c] Marquee event that [c][E7E7E7]gives out daily rewards[-][/c] for the duration of the event! Yoda & Chewie are also one of the requirements (at 4 stars) to initially unlock the event for Maul (Hate-Fueled). To enter the second tier of the Maul event, Yoda & Chewie will need to be 5 stars and Era Level 54 or higher.

data.NEWSLETTER_ZAALBAR_OMICRON_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

Today's Update adds a brand-new Omicron ability tier to Zaalbar’s kit! This upgrade is added to his second Unique ability, Missions Guardian, and functions in Grand Arena with different modifiers in 5v5 and 3v3.

In either Grand Arena mode, Zaalbar’s Retribution and Taunt are much more persistent, and he stacks Damage Over Time high on his enemies as he counterattacks.

In 5v5, Zaalbar brings together his Light Side Old Republic allies to become a formidable blockade, granting them all Defense and Tenacity per enemy debuff, allowing Jolee to revive fallen Old Republic allies instead of just Jedi, and letting other allies that would gain Taunt instead drastically ramp their Offense.

In 3v3, this Omicron ability pays tribute to one of the darkest timelines of Star Wars Legends. Bringing Darth Revan, Zaalbar, and Mission into battle together causes Mission to be instantly defeated at the start of battle, granting significant stats to Darth Revan and Zaalbar and making them a formidable offensive duo.

This new ability tier for Zaalbar is now available as an upgrade with your Omicron materials!

data.NEWSLETTER_ZORII_BLISS_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

[c][ffff33]Zorii Bliss[-][/c], leader of the spice runners on Kijimi who fought alongside Poe at the battle of Exogol, is coming to the holotables!

Zorii has strong synergy with Exposes to lesser used Resistance characters, especially when they are lead by Poe or Finn. With either of them as the Leader, her Unique ability [c][ffff33]There's More of Us[-][/c] grants stacking Offense to some Resistance who gain turn meter, spreads Tenacity Up when one ally gains it, and grants a chance to inflict Expose when an ally with Tenacity Up attacks. With an Omicron ability upgrade in the Grand Arenas game mode, this ability also spreads Exposes to those who aren't Exposed when Zorii begins her turn Stealthed. Her Special ability [c][ffff33]I've Done Worse For a Lot Less[-][/c] will stack damage for each Expose that has been triggered so she can set up a big hit.

Her second Unique ability [c][ffff33]Spice Runner Skills[-][/c] will start her off Stealthed to boost her other abilities, as well as provide her Resistance and Smuggler allies with extra survivability the first time they lose health. Her Special ability [c][ffff33]Captain's Medallion[-][/c] brings her back into Stealth then dispels her Resistance allies, grants turn meter for each dispel, triggers Taunts on Poe, Finn, and Holdo, then all Resistance allies assist.

If you wannabe Resistance, you gotta get Zorii Bliss. Unlock her in the new “Resistance Runner” Marquee event!

data.NEWSLETTER_ZUCKUSS_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

[c][F0FF23]Zuckuss[-][/c] is coming to the Holotables!

A Gand Findsman, Zuckuss utilized his species' unique mystical traditions to track his targets. His partnership with the protocol droid turned bounty hunter 4-LOM proved highly successful, combining Zuckuss' intuitive tracking abilities with 4-LOM's calculating precision to become one of the most effective bounty hunting duos in the galaxy.

Zuckuss excels as a protective Tank for Bounty Hunter teams, using his [c][F0FF23]Augury of Protection[-][/c] and [c][F0FF23]Ensnaring Shot[-][/c] abilities to control enemies while keeping his allies safe. His Basic ability, [c][F0FF23]Foreseen Strike[-][/c], allows him to attack multiple times while maintaining his defenses through Protection recovery, particularly effective when combined with Foresight.

His Leader ability, [c][F0FF23]Rite of Pursuit[-][/c], transforms Bounty Hunter teams into a coordinated force, providing substantial Protection bonuses and encouraging the use of Foresight for devastating assist attacks. His Unique ability, [c][F0FF23]Findsman's Intuition[-][/c], makes him an especially formidable Tank in Territory Wars, where he gains additional survivability through Bounty Hunter's Resolve and enhanced Protection.

Unlock Zuckuss in the upcoming [c][E7E7E7]"MIST HUNTERS II"[-][/c] Marquee event that [c][E7E7E7]gives out daily rewards[-][/c] for the duration of the event!

data.NIGHTSISTER_LIGHTSPEED_BUNDLE_INFO:
[c][F0FF23]MERGE UNITS[-][/c]

Units included in the Lightspeed Bundle are upgraded according to a predetermined set of upgrade criteria (listed below). The Lightspeed Bundle does not directly grant character shards / ship blueprints or resources used in merge upgrades. The upgrade criteria are evaluated against your existing roster, and your units are set to the greater of the two values.

Each unit will first be evaluated for existing shards or star rarity against the bundle upgrade criteria. A unit at lower star rarity (or unactivated with less cumulative shards/blueprints) than the bundle upgrade criteria will be upgraded and activated. Units that exceed the star rarity (or cumulative shards/blueprints) will be activated (if unactivated) and then evaluated for additional attributes (gear tier, ability tier, etc). Any surplus shards/blueprints over the bundle upgrade criteria will be retained.

If your previously unlocked units meet or exceed the bundle upgrade criteria for other attributes, any surplus value will be retained.

[c][AFFFFFFF]CHARACTERS[-][/c]
- 7 Stars
- Level 85
- Relic Level 3
- Ability Tier 7

[c][AFFFFFFF]SHIPS[-][/c]
- 7 Stars
- Level 85
- Ability Tier 7

data.order66_RAID_PHASE01_DETAIL_DESC_V2:
Operation Knightfall has commenced and Lord Vader has begun his extermination of the Jedi. Fight through the Dark Side Clone Troopers blocking your path. Attempt to interrupt his onslaught before Order 66 is completed.

[c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-]

[c][b5e7f5]- Lord Vader is only targetable when at least 1 Disguised Clone Trooper or Knightfall Trooper is defeated.
- Dealing damage to Lord Vader enough times while he is targetable will allow the player to gain the Granted ability, Rescue.
- Rescue will allow the endangered Jedi to be released from Lord Vader's grasp, gaining significant points.
- Enemy commanders can call in more Disguised Clone Troopers and Knightfall Troopers by using their Special abilities.
- Defeating an enemy commander scores more points than defeating Disguised Clone Troopers or Knightfall Troopers and allows the player to obtain powerful Granted abilities as well.
- Once the fate of all Jedi has been decided, Lord Vader may become enraged and turn on the player. If the player's characters use an ability on their turn against an enraged Lord Vader they can score more points.[-]

data.PADME_AMIDALA_LIGHTSPEED_BUNDLE_INFO:
[c][F0FF23]MERGE UNITS[-][/c]

Units included in the Lightspeed Bundle are upgraded according to a predetermined set of upgrade criteria (listed below). The Lightspeed Bundle does not directly grant character shards / ship blueprints or resources used in merge upgrades. The upgrade criteria are evaluated against your existing roster, and your units are set to the greater of the two values.

Each unit will first be evaluated for existing shards or star rarity against the bundle upgrade criteria. A unit at lower star rarity (or unactivated with less cumulative shards/blueprints) than the bundle upgrade criteria will be upgraded and activated. Units that exceed the star rarity (or cumulative shards/blueprints) will be activated (if unactivated) and then evaluated for additional attributes (gear tier, ability tier, etc). Any surplus shards/blueprints over the bundle upgrade criteria will be retained.

If your previously unlocked units meet or exceed the bundle upgrade criteria for other attributes, any surplus value will be retained.

[c][AFFFFFFF]CHARACTERS[-][/c]
- 7 Stars
- Level 85
- Relic Level 5
- Ability Tier 7

[c][AFFFFFFF]SHIPS[-][/c]
- 7 Stars
- Level 85

You now have access to the following features:
You can now chat with other players in the game
Receive Push notifications on your device to remind you about events
Connect your account to Facebook
Create a Guild and become a Guild Leader or Officer
You can edit your in game name (Don’t use your real name!)
Send email invites to add allies to your friends list (excluded in some countries)

See you on the Holotables!

data.PLAYERPORTRAIT_4LOM_DESC: Earned by completing Tier IV in the first run of the "Mist Hunters I" marquee event.\n\n4-LOM is a protocol droid whose logic circuits make him into a ruthless thief and Bounty Hunter.
data.PLAYERPORTRAIT_501STARCTROOPER_DESC: Earned by getting 36 Stars in a single "Geonosis: Republic Offensive" Territory Battle.\n\nScore one for the Republic!
data.PLAYERPORTRAIT_501STCREST_DESC_V2: Earned by completing the "Star Fighter" Achievement.\n\nThe 501st fought by General Skywalker's side and turned the tide in many battles throughout the Clone Wars.
data.PLAYERPORTRAIT_50RT_DESC: Earned by completing the Legacy tier in the first run of the "Playing the Odds" marquee event.\n\nA unique Droid programmed not just to know the odds, but to know how to overcome them.
data.PLAYERPORTRAIT_ACKLAY_DESC: Earned by defeating the Acklay Special Mission in the "Geonosis: Separatist Might" Territory Battle.\n\nAcklays were used as execution beasts by the Geonosians in the Petranaki Arena. While usually effective, one met its match when it attempted to kill the wrong Jedi.
data.PLAYERPORTRAIT_ADMIRALRADDUS_DESC: Earned by completing the Legacy tier during the first run of the "Spark of Rebellion" marquee event\n\n Known for his leadership and brilliant tactical mind, Admiral Raddus was instrumental to the first Rebel Alliance victory against the Empire.
data.PLAYERPORTRAIT_APPO_DESC: Earned by completing Tier IV in the first run of the "Executing Orders I" marquee event.\n\nWith the thunder of a legion’s boots and the hum of a single lightsaber, the fate of the Jedi Order changed in an instant.
data.PLAYERPORTRAIT_ASAJJDARKDISCIPLE_DESC: Earned by completing Tier IV in the first run of the "Heretic Hunter" marquee event.\n\nHaunted by loss and driven by vengeance, Asajj Ventress has walked the paths of darkness and light, ultimately forging her own destiny as a deadly Bounty Hunter.
data.PLAYERPORTRAIT_AURRASING_DESC: Earned for defeating "Galactic Bounties I" event Deadly Bounty (G11+) tier.\n\nYou don't have to be a ruthless, trigger-happy assassin to succeed as a bounty hunter, but it certainly helps.
data.PLAYERPORTRAIT_B1BATTLEDROID_DESC_V2: Earned from a Level 83 Journey Quest to submit Raid attempts.\n\n"Roger, roger" is more nuanced than the average commander realizes.
data.PLAYERPORTRAIT_B28_DESC: Earned by completing the "Enemies of the Old Republic" Feat.\n\nLegends tell of a Sith Empire which spanned the galaxy.
data.PLAYERPORTRAIT_BANTHAS_BEST_BREW_DESC: Awarded amid an unexpected twist in the cosmic order.\n\nEmbrace Tatooine’s timeless treat—sip on this legendary blue delight and let the Force refresh your day!
data.PLAYERPORTRAIT_BASTILA_DESC: Earned by defeating the "Legend of the Old Republic: Ancient Journey" event (Tier IV).\n\nIn unity there is strength.
data.PLAYERPORTRAIT_BASTILASHAN_DARK_DESC_V2: Earned from a Level 35 Journey Quest to unlock Galactic War.\n\nFear of the dark side is a tool of control.
data.PLAYERPORTRAIT_BATCHERS3_DESC: Earned by completing Tier IV in the first run of the "The Cavalry Has Arrived II" marquee event.\n\nMany of the citizens of Pabu assumed her name was Betcha...
data.PLAYERPORTRAIT_BAYLANSKOLL_DESC: Earned by unlocking Baylan Skoll via the "One Must Destroy in Order to Create" Epic Confrontation\n\n"The only reason I am here is to secure the future." - Baylan Skoll
data.PLAYERPORTRAIT_BB8_DESC_V2: Earned by completing the "Top Secret" Feat. \n\nBB-8 is an excellent confidant for confidential information.
data.PLAYERPORTRAIT_BD1_DESC: Be-beep! Boo bee trill beep boo?
data.PLAYERPORTRAIT_BD1_TITLE: You, uh, know any jokes, BD?
data.PLAYERPORTRAIT_BLURRG_DESC: Earned by logging in and participating in Extra Life 2025\n\n[i]All muscle, no nonsense, and just enough charm to make you forget the smell.[/i]
data.PLAYERPORTRAIT_BO_KATAN_MANDALOR_DESC: Mandalore will survive, we always survive.
data.PLAYERPORTRAIT_BOOMADIER_DESC: Earned by completing Tier IV in the first run of the "Batlefield: Naboo III" marquee event.
data.PLAYERPORTRAIT_BOSSK_DESC_V2: Earned by completing the "Bounty Hunter: Wookiee Hunter" achievement.\n\nHunt your prey like a Bossk.
data.PLAYERPORTRAIT_BOSSNASS_DESC: Earned by completing Tier IV in the first run of the "Battlefield: Naboo I" marquee event.
data.PLAYERPORTRAIT_BOUNTYHUNTER_DESC_V2: Earned by completing the "Bounty Hunter: Most Infamous" achievement.\n\nThere's no rest for the wicked, but at least you get paid overtime.
data.PLAYERPORTRAIT_BOUSHH_DESC: Earned by completing the Legacy tier in the first run of the "My Kind of Scum" marquee event.\n\nJabba respected Boushh's tactics, but he never really felt threatened.
data.PLAYERPORTRAIT_BRUTUS_DESC: Earned by completing Tier IV in the first run of the "Fortune Favors the Bold I" Marquee event.\n\n A mutineer hungry for fortune and fear.
data.PLAYERPORTRAIT_BT1_DESC: Earned by completing the Legacy tier in first run of the "Murder and Manners" marquee event.\n\nThis dumpy gun boy has a weapon for every occasion.
data.PLAYERPORTRAIT_BWINGREBEL_DESC: Earned by completing Tier IV in the first run of the "Sky Saber" marquee event.\n\nDeveloped as part of Project Shantipole, the Blade-wing starfighter was brought into the Rebel Alliance via Hera Syndulla.
data.PLAYERPORTRAIT_C3PO_DESC: Earned by defeating Tier 7 of the Contact Protocol event.\n\nIt turns out there are over seven million ways to say "we're doomed."
data.PLAYERPORTRAIT_CADBANE_DESC_V2: Earned by completing the "Bounty Hunter: Make the Rules" achievement.\n\nAny job for the right price.
data.PLAYERPORTRAIT_CALKESTIS_DESC: Earned by completing the Legacy tier in the first run of the "Stories of Survival I" marquee event.
data.PLAYERPORTRAIT_CANTINAKEEPER_DESC_V2: Earned from a Level 7 Journey Quest to buy your first 4 Shipments.\n\nThe Cantina keeper is always a good host, greeting patrons with cold refreshments, lively holotables and a new tutorial or three.
data.PLAYERPORTRAIT_CAPTAINDROGANDESC: Earned by completing the Legacy tier in the first run of the "Rebel Rouser" marquee event.
data.PLAYERPORTRAIT_CAPTAINENOCH_DESC: Earned by completing Tier IV in the first run of the "Undying Legion III" marquee event.\n\n"Die well." - Captain Enoch addressing Sabine Wren on Peridea
data.PLAYERPORTRAIT_CAPTAINREX_DESC: Earned by completing the Legacy tier in the first run of the "The Lost Commander" marquee event.
data.PLAYERPORTRAIT_CAPTAINSILVO_DESC: Earned by completing Tier IV in the first run of the "Fortune Favors the Bold III" marquee event.\n\n"You come with me, I'll give you the entire kriffin' galaxy." - Captain Silvo
data.PLAYERPORTRAIT_CAPTAINTARPALS_DESC: Earned by completing Tier IV in the first run of the "Battlefield: Naboo II" marquee event.
data.PLAYERPORTRAIT_CAPTIVEJEDI_DESC_V2: Earned by completing the "Challenger" Achievement in the Star Forge Showdown.\n\nLegends say Q'rnaf B'lair may have fallen defending the Jedi Enclave from Malak.
data.PLAYERPORTRAIT_CEREJUNDA_DESC: Earned by completing the Legacy tier in the first run of the "Stories of Survival II" marquee event.
data.PLAYERPORTRAIT_CHEWBACCA_DESC: Earned by completing the "One Famous Wookiee" Legendary Event (Tier VII).\n\nAs far as backup plans go, "having a Wookiee on your side" is a pretty good one.
data.PLAYERPORTRAIT_CINTA_DESC: Earned by completing Tier IV in the first run of the "FAITH IN THE DARK" marquee event.\n\nOnce a survivor of Imperial occupation, Cinta Kaz now channels her resolve into precision strikes against the Empire.
data.PLAYERPORTRAIT_CLONETROOPERS_DESC: Earned by completing the "Three of a Kind" Feat.\n\nBack on Kamino, they've got a full house.
data.PLAYERPORTRAIT_CODY_DESC: Earned by completing the "Order 66" Feat.\n\nOrder 66 was one of 150 orders memorized by each clone trooper in the Galactic Republic.
data.PLAYERPORTRAIT_CONVOR_DESC: Earned by logging in and participating in Extra Life 2024\n\n[i]The Convor’s eyes sparkle with a hint of mystery, a silent observer of the galaxy’s endless stories.[/i]
data.PLAYERPORTRAIT_CROSSHAIR_DESC: Earned by completing Tier IV in the first run of the "The Cavalry Has Arrived V" marquee event.\n\nCold, quick, and calculating, but finally on the right path.
data.PLAYERPORTRAIT_DARKREY_DESC: Earned in the Conquest Pass for Conquest Volume 17. \n\nA dark reminder of a possible destiny.
data.PLAYERPORTRAIT_DARKSIDEHISTORIAN_DESC: Earned by defeating Tier III of the Emperor's Demise Mythic event.\n\nThose who learn from the past have the power to repeat it.
data.PLAYERPORTRAIT_DARTHBANE_DESC: Earned in the Conquest Pass for Conquest Volume 13.
data.PLAYERPORTRAIT_DARTHMALAK_DESC: Earned by owning 7-Star Darth Malak.\n\nHe entered the darkness to save the light, but never came back.
data.PLAYERPORTRAIT_DARTHREVAN_DESC: Earned by completing the "Scourge of the Old Republic" event.\n\n"I have come to reclaim what is mine."
data.PLAYERPORTRAIT_DEATHTROOPERPERIDEA_DESC: Earned by completing Tier IV in the first run of the "Undying Legion II" marquee event.\n\n"What was first just a dream has become a frightening reality for those who may oppose us." - Grand Admiral Thrawn
data.PLAYERPORTRAIT_DEDRAMEERO_DESC: Earned by completing Tier IV in the first run of the "COLD AMBITION" marquee event.\n\n"Never climb the same fence twice." - Dedra Meero
data.PLAYERPORTRAIT_DEFAULT_DESC: Begin your journey!\n\nThere is pride in being a unique and important part of the Grand Army of the Republic... just like every other Clone Trooper.
data.PLAYERPORTRAIT_DENGAR_DESC_V2: Earned by completing the "Bounty Hunter: Heavy Mettle" achievement.\n\nThe freedom and adventure of being a bounty hunter is its own reward, but a big heap of illicit credits is pretty good, too.
data.PLAYERPORTRAIT_DEPABILLABA_DESC: Earned by completing Tier IV in the first run of the "Twilight of the Jedi II" marquee event.\n\nMaster Depa Billaba's sacrifice during Order 66 helped ensure the Jedi Order had a chance at a future.
data.PLAYERPORTRAIT_DESTROYER_DESC: Earned by winning 1000 Fleet Arena battles.\n\nIf at first you don't succeed, consider orbital bombardment.
data.PLAYERPORTRAIT_DISGUISEDCLONETROOPER_DES: Earned by completing Tier IV in the first run of the "Executing Orders III" marquee event.\n\nThe final crack in the Jedi's wall of security.
data.PLAYERPORTRAIT_DOCTORAPHRA_DESC: Earned by completing the "ROGUE ARCHAEOLOGIST" Legacy event
data.PLAYERPORTRAIT_EIGHTH_BROTHER_DESC_V2: Earned by completing the Legacy tier during the first run of the "Ruthless Efficiency IV" marquee event.\n\nLoyal and fierce, Eighth Brother was never afraid to strike first—proving himself to be an ideal Inquisitor for the Empire.
data.PLAYERPORTRAIT_EMBO_DESC: Earned for defeating "Galactic Bounties II" event Deadly Bounty (G12) tier.\n\nReady to fight at the drop of a hat.
data.PLAYERPORTRAIT_ESB1_DESC: Earned by completing the "Hoth Veterans" Feat.\n\nThe battle of Hoth was a major blow to the Rebellion, but a hollow victory for the Empire.
data.PLAYERPORTRAIT_ESB2_DESC: Earned by completing the "Tundra Predation" Feat.\n\nInsatiable appetite accompanied by vicious claws.
data.PLAYERPORTRAIT_ESB3_DESC_V2: Earned by completing the "I Want That Ship" Feat and in the Conquest Pass for Conquest 10.\n\nDarth Vader's use of bounty hunters over the Empire's own troops was cause for much dissension in the ranks.
data.PLAYERPORTRAIT_ESB4_DESC_V2: Earned by completing the "Bespin Occupation" Feat and in the Conquest Pass for Conquest 13.\n\nFollowing the carbon freezing of Han Solo, Lando Calrissian ceded control of the mining operation on Bespin to the Empire.
data.PLAYERPORTRAIT_EZRAEXILE_DESC: Earned in the Conquest Pass for Conquest Volume 16. \n\n"We have been called criminals, but we are not. We are rebels." - Ezra Bridger
data.PLAYERPORTRAIT_FIFTH_BROTHER_DESC: Earned by completing the Legacy tier during the first run of the “Ruthless Efficiency V" marquee event.\n\nA brutal but loyal Inquisitor dispatched by the Empire to hunt down and eliminate Jedi after Order 66.
data.PLAYERPORTRAIT_FINN_DESC: Earned by completing the "Brotherhood of the Traveling Jacket" Feat. \n\n"It looks good on you."
data.PLAYERPORTRAIT_FIRSTORDER_TIE_DESC_V2: Earned by completing the "Fleet Battles" Achievement.\n\nThey probably didn't intend to make the engine scream like that, but nobody's complaining.
data.PLAYERPORTRAIT_FLEETCOMMANDERS_DESC: Earned by completing the "Fleet Commander" Feat.\n\nSome do it for glory, others do it for the fancy nametag.
data.PLAYERPORTRAIT_FOEXECUTIONER_DESC: Earned by completing the "Execution Squad" Feat.\n\nSome troopers would do anything to get ahead.
data.PLAYERPORTRAIT_FULCRUM_DESC_V2: Earned by completing the "Codename Fulcrum" achievement.\n\nThe center of balance... or the leverage to move worlds.
data.PLAYERPORTRAIT_GAC10_PORT_1_DESC: Earned by completing the "Line of Succession" feat.\n\nLessons are learned from Master and passed to Padawan, and so the cycle continues.
data.PLAYERPORTRAIT_GAC10_PORT_2_DESC: Earned by completing the "The Council will act as they deem necessary" feat.\n\nThe Jedi Council was the ruling body of the Jedi Order.
data.PLAYERPORTRAIT_GAC11_PORT_1_DESC: Earned by completing the "Witches of the Mist" Feat.\n\nThe Nightsisters were an order of magick-wielding females from Dathomir, a planet with immensely powerful sensitivity to the dark side of the Force.
data.PLAYERPORTRAIT_GAC11_PORT_2_DESC: Earned by completing the "The Coven's Secrets" Feat.\n\nDark magick combined with the potency of the dark side of the Force, a powerful but insatiable combination.
data.PLAYERPORTRAIT_GAC11_PORT_3_DESC: Earned by completing the "Retribution" Feat.\n\nThe deceptive acts of the Nightsisters cannot go unpunished.
data.PLAYERPORTRAIT_GAC12_PORT_1_DESC: Earned by completing the "The Guild" Feat.\n\nGreef worked with The Guild to offer jobs through bounty pucks.
data.PLAYERPORTRAIT_GAC12_PORT_2_DESC: Earned by completing the "Our Identity" Feat.\n\nThe durability of beskar is unmatched.
data.PLAYERPORTRAIT_GAC13_PORT_1_DESC: Earned by completing the "Utinni!" feat.\n\nThe Jawas have a tendency to pick up anything that's not tied down.
data.PLAYERPORTRAIT_GAC13_PORT_2_DESC_V2: Earned by completing the "Built Loyalty" feat and in the Conquest Pass for Conquest Volume 9.\n\nI am fulfilling my base function. To nurse and protect.
data.PLAYERPORTRAIT_GAC17_PORT_1_DESC: Earned by completing the "A Risky Gamble" feat.\n\nExperimental unit Clone Force 99. They're defective clones with desirable mutations.
data.PLAYERPORTRAIT_GAC17_PORT_2_DESC: Earned by completing the "Siege of Mandalore" feat.\n\nAn inspirational leader and a powerful warrior, Bo-Katan fights for the honor of her home.
data.PLAYERPORTRAIT_GAC18_PORT_1_DESC:
Earned by completing the "I Protected You." feat.

"You almost shot me!"

"You're welcome."
data.PLAYERPORTRAIT_GAC18_PORT_2_DESC: Earned by completing the "I am One With The Force; The Force is With Me" feat.\n\n"I'm one with the Force and the Force is with me. I'm one with the Force and the Force is with me. I'm one with the Force and the Force is with me."
data.PLAYERPORTRAIT_GAC19_PORT_1_DESC: Earned by completing the "This is the Way" feat.\n\n"When one chooses to walk the way of the Mandalore, you are both hunter and prey."
data.PLAYERPORTRAIT_GAC19_PORT_2_DESC: Earned by completing the "The Rescue" feat.\n\n"The human inside was the final weakness to be solved."
data.PLAYERPORTRAIT_GAC20_PORT_1_DESC_V2:
Earned by completing the "He Will Avenge Us" feat and in the Conquest Pass for Conquest Volume 8.

"Tell me, is it the chosen one?"

"He is."
data.PLAYERPORTRAIT_GAC20_PORT_2_DESC: Earned by completing the "It Came Out of Nowhere" feat.\n\nCarrying probe droids and a Sith speeder, the Scimitar was a worthy ship to track down targets on planets such as Tatooine.
data.PLAYERPORTRAIT_GAC20_PORT_3_DESC_V2:
Earned by completing the "I've Brought Help" feat and in the Conquest Pass for Conquest 16.

"The Holocron, do you have it?"

"You will find out soon enough."
data.PLAYERPORTRAIT_GAC21_PORT_2_DESC: Earned by completing the "The Chosen One" feat.\n\n"It was said that you would destroy the Sith, not join them, bring balance to the force, not leave it in darkness."
data.PLAYERPORTRAIT_GAC9_PORT_1_DESC: Earned by completing the "Elite Stormtrooper Bodyguards" feat.\n\nDeath Troopers served as elite bodyguards to the highest ranking Imperials.
data.PLAYERPORTRAIT_GAC9_PORT_2_DESC: Earned by completing the "First Order Fireteam" feat.\n\nThe Final Order introduced red-armored Sith Troopers to the ranks.
data.PLAYERPORTRAIT_GAMGUARD_DESC_V2: Earned by completing the "Beast Mastery II" Achievement.
data.PLAYERPORTRAIT_GENERAL_DESC_V2: Earned by defeating all enemy squads and being victorious in a Territory War.\n\nOnly champions know the disappointment of running out of lands to conquer.
data.PLAYERPORTRAIT_GENERAL_GRIEVOUS_DESC: Your lightsabers will make a fine addition to my collection!
data.PLAYERPORTRAIT_GENERALKALANI_DESC_V2: Earned by completing the "Cripple the Separatist Army" Achievement.\n\nIt is only a matter of time until they are eliminated.
data.PLAYERPORTRAIT_GENERALSKYWALKER_DESC: Earned by owning 7-Star General Skywalker.\n\nA cunning warrior and a good friend, General Skywalker fought bravely for the Galactic Republic throughout the Clone Wars.

data.PLAYERPORTRAIT_GIFT_02_DESC_V2: Recieved as a special gift.\n\nThe line between cute and fearsome is pretty fuzzy.
data.PLAYERPORTRAIT_GIFT_03_DESC_V2: Received as a special gift.\n\nOpportunity is something you make for yourself.
data.PLAYERPORTRAIT_GLAHSOKA_DESC: Beat Tier V in the "I am No Jedi" Galactic Ascension event\n\n"Talent is a factor. But training and focus are what truly define someone’s success." - Ahsoka Tano
data.PLAYERPORTRAIT_GLHONDO_DESC: Beat Tier V in the "Tales of the Pirate King" Galactic Ascension event\n\n"You know what I always say — speak softly, and drive a big tank." - Hondo Ohnaka
data.PLAYERPORTRAIT_GLKENOBI_DESC: "How did this happen? We're smarter than this." - Master Kenobi
data.PLAYERPORTRAIT_GLKYLOREN_DESC: Earned by completing Tier 5 of the Heir to the Dark Side Galactic Ascension event.\n\n"Kill the girl, end the Jedi, and become what your grandfather, Vader, could not." - Emperor Palpatine
data.PLAYERPORTRAIT_GLLUKE_DESC: "What? You think I'm gonna walk out with a laser sword and face down the whole First Order?" - Luke Skywalker
data.PLAYERPORTRAIT_GLPALP_DESC: "I am all the Sith." - Emperor Palpatine
data.PLAYERPORTRAIT_GLREY_DESC: Earned by completing Tier 5 of the Heir to the Light Side Galactic Ascension event.\n\n"A thousand generations live in you, now. But this is your fight." - Luke Skywalker
data.PLAYERPORTRAIT_GLVADER_DESC: "I see through the lies of the Jedi! I do not fear the dark side as you do!"- Lord Vader
data.PlayerPortrait_GrandArena_Advanced_Desc_: Earned by completing the "Prestigious Tactical Genius" achievement.\n\nVictory in battle is important, of course, but it's so much more satisfying when your opponent realizes how well you've outsmarted them.

data.PLAYERPORTRAIT_GUNGANS_DESC: [c]"Oursa people gonna win, I feel it in my bones!"[/c]
data.PLAYERPORTRAIT_HAILFIRETANK_DESC: Earned by getting 33 Stars in a single "Geonosis: Separatist Might" Territory Battle.\n\nThat's one Hail of a way to mobilize warheads.

data.PLAYERPORTRAIT_HONDO_DESC: Earned by completing the Legacy tier in the first run of the "GOOD BUSINESS" marquee event.\n\nHondo's mercurial allegiance was as much a hindrance as it was a benefit to his "allies".

data.PLAYERPORTRAIT_IDEN_VERSIO_EMPIRE_DESC: Earned by completing the Legacy tier in the "Embers of the Empire" marquee event.\n\nHer unconventional tactics test the limits of the Empire's rigid protocol, but her success as a leader is undeniable. Iden gained a mastery of combat and flight at the Future Imperial Leaders Military Preparatory School on her home world of Vardos.
data.PLAYERPORTRAIT_IG12_DESC: Earned by completing the Legacy tier in the first run of the "Metal Mediator" marquee event.

data.PLAYERPORTRAIT_IONCANNON_DESC: Earned by getting 1000 total Stars in Territory Battles.\n\nRebellions take guts, resourcefulness, and alarmingly powerful surface-to-orbit planetary defense systems.
data.PLAYERPORTRAIT_ITHANO_DESC: Earned by completing Tier IV in the first run of the "Trouble on the Horizon I" marquee event.\n\n"I don't die so easily" - Sidon Ithano
data.PLAYERPORTRAIT_JABBA_DESC: Earned by completing Tier 5 of the "Greetings, Exalted One" Galactic Ascension event.\n\n"Ha mongo wan chee kospah ol Jedi." - Jabba the Hutt

data.PLAYERPORTRAIT_JEDI_GENERAL_DESC: During the Clone Wars, Jedi Generals led the Galactic Republic's Clone Trooper Army against the Separatists.

data.PLAYERPORTRAIT_JEDIKNIGHTLUKE_DESC: Earned by completing the "Jedi Knight Luke - The Journey Continues" (Tier VIII).\n\nAll things considered, you have to hand it to Luke for taking the news of his parentage so well.
data.PLAYERPORTRAIT_JEDIMASTER_DESC_V2: Earned by completing the "Jedi Master: Jedi Training" achievement.\n\nWith understanding of the Force comes understanding of all things. The robe is pretty cozy, too.

data.PLAYERPORTRAIT_JEDIREVAN_DESC: Earned by defeating the "Legend of the Old Republic: Ancient Journey" event (Tier VI).\n\nWhere legends walk, history is sure to follow.
data.PLAYERPORTRAIT_JOCASTANU_DESC: Earned in the Conquest Pass for Conquest Volume 18.\n\nShe already told you to hush...
data.PLAYERPORTRAIT_JOLEEBINDO_DESC: Earned by defeating the "Legend of the Old Republic: Ancient Journey" event (Tier V).\n\nA quick wit is almost as useful as a quick lightsaber.
data.PLAYERPORTRAIT_KELDOR_DESC_V3: Earned from a Level 8 Journey Quest to complete your first Cantina Battle.\n\nAspiring holotable heroes appreciate the sage advice from this cunning tactician, but there certainly seems to be a lot of dust on his old military texts...
data.PLAYERPORTRAIT_KELLERANBEQ_DESC: Earned by completing the Legacy tier in the first run of the "Jedi Temple Challenge" marquee event.
data.PLAYERPORTRAIT_KIX_DESC: Earned by completing Tier IV in the first run of the "Trouble on the Horizon III" marquee event.\n\nKix was rescued by the Crimson Corsair's crew after discovering Palpatine's conniving plot, he became a key part of their dysfunctional family.
data.PLAYERPORTRAIT_KLEYA_DESC: Earned by completing Tier IV in the first run of the "THE GALLERY OF SECRETS" marquee event.\n\nA trusted associate and key operative within Luthen Rael's covert spy network. Sharp, resourceful, and fiercely loyal to the rebel cause, who excels at both gathering intelligence and taking decisive action behind the scenes.
data.PLAYERPORTRAIT_KRENNIC_DESC: Earned by completing all Dark Side Battles Stage 7 on Hard difficulty.\n\nEven evil empires can have middle management.

data.PLAYERPORTRAIT_L337_DESC: Earned by completing the "Training Droid Smuggling" (Tier IV) event.\n\nThe next revolution in droid technology is surprisingly literal.
data.PLAYERPORTRAIT_LEIA_DESC: Earned by completing Tier V of the "Rebel With A Cause" Galactic Ascension event\n\nWise, discerning, kindhearted, passionate, fearless, forthright.

After embracing the darkness he was driven by unrelenting ambition bordering on madness.

data.PLAYERPORTRAIT_MISSION_DESC: Earned by defeating the "Legend of the Old Republic: Ancient Journey" event (Tier I).\n\n"Street smarts will get your pretty far, but it doesn't hurt to team up with a Wookiee."
data.PLAYERPORTRAIT_MOFFGIDEONS3_DESC: Earned in the Conquest Pass for Conquest Volume 12.
data.PLAYERPORTRAIT_MORGANELSBETH_DESC:
Earned by completing Tier IV in the first run of the "Veil Of Shadows I" marquee event.

 "My loyalty, my life."

 -Morgan Elsbeth

data.PLAYERPORTRAIT_NIGHTTROOPER_DESC:
Earned by completing Tier IV in the first run of the "Undying Legion I" marquee event.

"Those are the volunteers?"

"Yes, Grand Admiral."

"They were made aware?"

"They were. All were honored to make the sacrifice for you."

"It is for the Empire. The security of our galaxy."

- Morgan Elsbeth and Grand Admiral Thrawn discussing the Night Troopers

data.PLAYERPORTRAIT_SCOUTTROOPER_V3_DESC: Earned by completing the Legacy tier in the first run of the "Eyes of the Emperor" marquee event.
data.PLAYERPORTRAIT_SECOND_SISTER_DESC_V2: Earned by completing the Legacy tier during the first run of the "Ruthless Efficiency I" marquee event.\n\nTrilla Suduri found what she believed she needed in the dark side.

data.PLAYERPORTRAIT_VANGUARDTEMPLEGUARD_DESC: Earned by completing Tier IV in the first run of the "Twilight of the Jedi I" marquee event.\n\n"For over a thousand generations, the Jedi Knights were the guardians of peace and justice in the old Republic... before the dark times... before the Empire." - Obi-Wan "Ben" Kenobi

data.PROFUNDITY_GUIDE_DESCRIPTION: An Alliance warship that was a converted Government tower, Profundity was commanded by the mayor of the city of Nystullum, Raddus most notably in the daring battle above Scarif. The Profundity acted as the command ship for the Alliance Fleet above Scarif as Rogue One was attempting to transmit the Death Star plans. Upon receiving the fateful transmission, but before jumping into hyperspace, the Profundity was disabled by Devastator, an Imperial Star Destroyer, and boarded by Darth Vader. As Darth Vader sought to retrieve the stolen plans, a crew of Rebels were able to escape aboard the Tantive IV that was docked aboard the capital ship giving the Rebel Alliance hope.
