Accelerate your squad’s readiness at lightspeed and stand prepared when Profundity arrives to lead the rebellion!\n\nPurchase limit: 1
data.PROFUNDITY_LIGHTSPEED_I_INFO:
[b]MERGE UNITS[/b]

Units included in the Lightspeed Bundle are upgraded according to a predetermined set of upgrade criteria (listed below). The Lightspeed Bundle does not directly grant character shards / ship blueprints or resources used in merge upgrades. The upgrade criteria are evaluated against your existing roster, and your units are set to the greater of the two values.

Each unit will first be evaluated for existing shards or star rarity against the bundle upgrade criteria. A unit at lower star rarity (or unactivated with less cumulative shards/blueprints) than the bundle upgrade criteria will be upgraded and activated. Units that exceed the star rarity (or cumulative shards/blueprints) will be activated (if unactivated) and then evaluated for additional attributes (gear tier, ability tier, etc). Any surplus shards/blueprints over the bundle upgrade criteria will be retained.

If your previously unlocked units meet or exceed the bundle upgrade criteria for other attributes, any surplus value will be retained.

[b]CHARACTERS[/b]
- 7 Stars
- level 85
- Relic Level 7
- Ability Tier 7

[b]SHIPS[/b]
- 7 Stars
- Level 85
- Ability Tier 7

data.PROGRESSIONEVENT_JARJARBINKS_SUMMARY: Once banished from Otoh Gunga, Jar Jar Binks stumbled his way into a senatorship due to his heroics during the Battle of Naboo. Though he is known for being clumsy, the well-intentioned Gungan always seemed to find a way to make things right. Binks played a pivotal role as an ambassador, negotiator, and sometimes combatant during the Clone Wars.\n\nJar Jar's legacy is one of shifting scales – from outcast to Senate and back again, but he ultimately was able to trip his way into leaving a mark on the galaxy.

data.PROGRESSIONEVENT_MAULHATEFUELED_SUMMARY: Consumed by hate after being cut down by Obi-Wan Kenobi, Maul survived through sheer will and rage; constructing a twisted, spider-like body from the scrap around him. data.Protocol_Jedi_Knight_2_QUEST_DESC: Rumors had it that a JEDI KNIGHT was invincible. I'm not so sure: all the reason to ensure two of the most famed Jedi are fully powered-up on the Holotable!

data.Protocol_Jedi_Master_2_TASK_DESC_2: Get Qui-Gon Jinn to Gear XII
data.Protocol_Jedi_Master_3_QUEST_DESC: Only a JEDI MASTER can face General Grievous. You must face him with a full squad of Jedi.\n\nI predict the odds... oh nevermind, you'll sm-sm-smash!
data.Protocol_Jedi_Master_3_QUEST_REWARDS: You sliced and diced those holo-foes into bits and bytes!\n\nGreat work! Just a little more to earn JEDI MASTER!
data.Protocol_Jedi_Master_3_TASK_DESC_1: Defeat 200 Sith with Grand Master Yoda
data.Protocol_Jedi_Master_4_QUEST_DESC: This is the final challenge before becoming a JEDI MASTER.\n\nYou'll need two squads of geared Jedi, be ready to lead your armies to success!
data.Protocol_Jedi_Master_4_QUEST_REWARDS: You earned the title JEDI MASTER! I'll get the Kalpa sea-thread cake ready to celebrate.\n\nThe cake costs credits and tip is expected. Congratulations!!!
data.Protocol_Jedi_Master_4_TASK_DESC_1: Get 10 Jedi to Gear tier XII
data.Protocol_Level_Characters_10_QUEST_DESC: The Cantina Keeper said you have to keep up with your Training.\n\nI suppose this is better than serving drinks to the Cantina.
data.Protocol_Level_Characters_10_QUEST_REWAR: If you see that Astromech tell him to stay out of my charging station.
data.Protocol_Level_Characters_11_QUEST_DESC: Greetings Mol Eliza, my name is B7-N5 human-cyborg relations.\n\n... what? Of course I remember your name. My memory processors are functioning perfectly.
data.Protocol_Level_Characters_11_QUEST_REWAR: Take these rewards so I do not have to carry them.
data.Protocol_Level_Characters_3_QUEST_DESC: It's not-not-not my fault.\n\nYou have to earn training droids faster than you spend them.
data.Protocol_Level_Characters_3_QUEST_REWARD: You'll never catch up to the other Holotable players if you don't keep... leveling up... your characters.
data.Protocol_Level_Characters_4_QUEST_DESC: Keep your top 5 characters at a high level to excel in Cantina Battles\n\nAn oil bath is a luxury you cannot comprehend.
data.Protocol_Level_Characters_4_QUEST_REWARD: That Hutt keeps bragging about how he's the best Fleet Arena player in the Cantina...
data.Protocol_Level_Characters_5_QUEST_DESC: The best way to win is to train five characters up to your player level.\n\nNot that you'll listen to me anyways.
data.Protocol_Level_Characters_5_QUEST_REWARD: Keep training your characters to win Holo battles.
data.Protocol_Level_Characters_6_QUEST_DESC: Train characters to excel in Holotable battles.\n\nIf I may, Holotables in this cantina have been known to flicker... my theory is that they reset occasionally.
data.Protocol_Level_Characters_6_QUEST_REWARD: A reset for a Droid, however, is not a good idea.
data.Protocol_Level_Characters_7_QUEST_DESC: Train characters to level 40 to prepare for Galactic War.\n\nThe Galactic War table pits you against the squads of other players.
data.Protocol_Level_Characters_7_QUEST_REWARD: At this rate, you’ll land me in the scrap heap… or my master will sell me to junk traders.
data.Protocol_Level_Characters_8_QUEST_DESC: I suggest a new strategy: Let the other Holotable players win.
data.Protocol_Level_Characters_8_QUEST_REWARD: If you see Fey Zara, let her know I'm overdue for maintenance.
data.Protocol_Level_Characters_9_QUEST_DESC: That Hutt spilled Bantha milk on me, now I need maintenance.
data.Protocol_Level_Characters_9_QUEST_REWARD: Someone should teach him some manners.
data.Protocol_Level_Characters_QUEST_REWARDS: Congratulations! You'll need to train characters often to win more difficult battles!
data.Protocol_Mod_Store_QUEST_DESC: Collect Mods and assign them to key characters.\n\nIf you need help assigning Mods go talk to Dr. M'ak Nar.
data.Protocol_Mods_2_QUEST_DESC: Have you seen my Speed Data-Bus? It was right here?
data.Protocol_Mods_2_QUEST_REWARDS: Are you sure these are all your mods? Is one of them a Speed Data-Bus?
data.Protocol_Mods_3_QUEST_DESC: Don’t short-circuit, but you need to know that the Ships Room of the Cantina is only for players at level 65 or higher.
data.Protocol_Mods_3_QUEST_REWARDS: Garudda the Hutt can be ruthless, watch your step in the Ships room.
data.Protocol_Mods_4_QUEST_DESC: Upgrade Mods to unlock their maximum power.\n\nI've had some special modifications of my own.
data.Protocol_Mods_4_QUEST_REWARDS: You voided your warranty by upgrading too much and must now reset.\n\nI jest. I am working on my humor module, but perhaps it too needs an upgrade!
data.Protocol_Mods_5_QUEST_DESC: Fey once modded me for Speed so I could serve customers faster.\n\nI think she removed them during my recharge cycle.
data.Protocol_Mods_5_QUEST_REWARDS: Acquire Mods to boost your favorite characters.
data.Protocol_Omega_2_QUEST_DESC: Max out your character's abilities with Omega materials.\n\nI will be rooting for Garudda the Hutt in the next Territory War.
data.Protocol_Omega_2_QUEST_REWARDS: Well, maybe you beat Garudda the Hutt, but that still does not make us friends.
data.Protocol_Omega_3_QUEST_DESC: Do you hear that? Sounds like a stray Loth-cat.
data.Protocol_Omega_3_QUEST_REWARDS: I will never understand why your lot keeps pets.
data.Protocol_Omega_QUEST_REWARDS: I am not your personal event coordinator.
data.Protocol_Open_Data_Card_QUEST_DESC: Open a Data Card in the store if you think you can figure that out.\n\nSome data cards are free. Open data cards for Gear, Credits, Character Shards and more.
data.Protocol_Open_Data_Card_QUEST_REWARDS: Save some Data Cards for the rest of us!
data.Protocol_Promote_2_QUEST_DESC: Promoting a character helps your progress in any table you use them in.\n\nThe Squad Arena table has been crowded lately, I wonder why.
data.Protocol_Promote_2_QUEST_REWARDS: Do try to get along with the other customers.
data.Protocol_Promote_3_QUEST_DESC: Choose your favorite characters and focus on getting shards for them to speed up Promotion.\n\nI was once promoted to inventory manager...
data.Protocol_Promote_3_QUEST_REWARDS: Unlike your characters, a Droid's promotion isn't always a good thing.
data.Protocol_Promote_4_QUEST_DESC: I most certainly do not need your help.\n\nI'm operating perfectly within my parameters.
data.Protocol_Promote_4_QUEST_REWARDS: I'm fluent in over 6 million languages and I still find Holotable players puzzling.
data.Protocol_Promote_5_QUEST_DESC: I scrub the Holotables every day and you lot keep spilling everywhere.
data.Protocol_Promote_5_QUEST_REWARDS: Third class Droids get no respect.
data.Protocol_Promote_6_QUEST_DESC: My master is upset about a confrontation that took place in the Cantina last night.
data.Protocol_Promote_6_QUEST_REWARDS: Could you keep an eye out for Fey Zara?
data.Protocol_Promote_Jedi_Consular_QUEST_REW: Now that you know how to promote a character, try to save it in your memory banks - if you can!
data.Protocol_Refresh_Cantina_Energy_2_QUEST_: Reactor leaks have been known to cause brief Holotable outages.
data.Protocol_Refresh_Cantina_Energy_2_TASK_D: Refresh or Claim Cantina Energy 10 times
data.Protocol_Refresh_Cantina_Energy_QUEST_RE: By my calculations this is your 100th quest completed.
data.Protocol_Refresh_Energy_QUEST_REWARDS: Take it from a Droid, missing energy recharge cycles ends up wasting Energy.
data.Protocol_Shard_Shop_2_QUEST_DESC: By my calculations you have amassed extra shards, trade them in at the Shard Shop to acquire Gear and Characters.
data.Protocol_Shard_Shop_2_QUEST_REWARDS: My master is big into recycling, no wasted Shards in this Cantina.
data.Protocol_Shard_Shop_QUEST_DESC: Nobody tells me anything, I just know how to listen carefully.
data.Protocol_Shard_Shop_QUEST_REWARDS: You get the pleasure of benefitting from my attentiveness.
data.Protocol_Sim_Battles_14_QUEST_DESC: Sim four battles to gain quick rewards.\n\nWhile you're doing that, I'll get an automated oil bath and de-carbonization buffing...
data.Protocol_Sim_Battles_14_QUEST_REWARDS: You're back already? I haven't even started my oil bath cause of you.\n\nAs you can see, simming a battle earns rewards way faster.
data.Protocol_Sim_Battles_9_QUEST_REWARDS: Sim Tickets don't grow on trees, you know! Use your sim tickets to earn the most important rewards quickly.
data.Protocol_Training_1_QUEST_REWARDS: Oh my!\n\nYou managed to complete the Quest -- here are your rewards!
data.Protocol_Upgrade_Abilities_2a_QUEST_REWA: I guess your memory banks haven't failed yet.
data.Protocol_Upgrade_Abilities_3_QUEST_DESC: I am the Droid you’re looking for.
data.Protocol_Upgrade_Abilities_3_QUEST_REWAR: Wait, is there another Droid you're looking for?
data.Protocol_Upgrade_Abilities_4_QUEST_DESC: Revisit the stores if you’re stuck, many contain gear to help you along.
data.Protocol_Upgrade_Abilities_4_QUEST_REWAR: Give me Mk III, I really want to upgrade my Droid abilities.\n\nWhat, you thought I didn't have a holotable squad?
data.Protocol_Upgrade_Abilities_5_QUEST_DESC: My servos squeaking?!\n\nCould you spare some materials for an upgrade?
data.Protocol_Upgrade_Abilities_5_QUEST_REWAR: Don’t short-circuit, here are your rewards.
data.Protocol_Upgrade_Abilities_7_QUEST_DESC: Greetings, my name is B7-N5, human-cyborg relations.\n\nHah, my memory processors appear to be functioning.
data.Protocol_Upgrade_Abilities_7_QUEST_REWAR: Take these items so I do not have to carry them.

data.R2D2_LIGHTSPEED_BUNDLE_II_INFO:
[b]MERGE UNITS[/b]

Units included in the Lightspeed Bundle are upgraded according to a predetermined set of upgrade criteria (listed below). The Lightspeed Bundle does not directly grant character shards / ship blueprints or resources used in merge upgrades. The upgrade criteria are evaluated against your existing roster, and your units are set to the greater of the two values.

Each unit will first be evaluated for existing shards or star rarity against the bundle upgrade criteria. A unit at lower star rarity (or unactivated with less cumulative shards/blueprints) than the bundle upgrade criteria will be upgraded and activated. Units that exceed the star rarity (or cumulative shards/blueprints) will be activated (if unactivated) and then evaluated for additional attributes (gear tier, ability tier, etc). Any surplus shards/blueprints over the bundle upgrade criteria will be retained.

If your previously unlocked units meet or exceed the bundle upgrade criteria for other attributes, any surplus value will be retained.

data.RESISTANCE_LIGHTSPEED_BUNDLE_INFO:
[c][F0FF23]MERGE UNITS[-][/c]

Units included in the Lightspeed Bundle are upgraded according to a predetermined set of upgrade criteria (listed below). The Lightspeed Bundle does not directly grant character shards / ship blueprints or resources used in merge upgrades. The upgrade criteria are evaluated against your existing roster, and your units are set to the greater of the two values.

Each unit will first be evaluated for existing shards or star rarity against the bundle upgrade criteria. A unit at lower star rarity (or unactivated with less cumulative shards/blueprints) than the bundle upgrade criteria will be upgraded and activated. Units that exceed the star rarity (or cumulative shards/blueprints) will be activated (if unactivated) and then evaluated for additional attributes (gear tier, ability tier, etc). Any surplus shards/blueprints over the bundle upgrade criteria will be retained.

If your previously unlocked units meet or exceed the bundle upgrade criteria for other attributes, any surplus value will be retained.

[c][AFFFFFFF]CHARACTERS[-][/c]
- 7 Stars
- Level 85
- Relic Level 5
- Ability Tier 7

data.ROGUE_ONE_LIGHTSPEED_BUNDLE_I_INFO:
[c][F0FF23]MERGE UNITS[-][/c]

Units included in the Lightspeed Bundle are upgraded according to a predetermined set of upgrade criteria (listed below). The Lightspeed Bundle does not directly grant character shards / ship blueprints or resources used in merge upgrades. The upgrade criteria are evaluated against your existing roster, and your units are set to the greater of the two values.

Each unit will first be evaluated for existing shards or star rarity against the bundle upgrade criteria. A unit at lower star rarity (or unactivated with less cumulative shards/blueprints) than the bundle upgrade criteria will be upgraded and activated. Units that exceed the star rarity (or cumulative shards/blueprints) will be activated (if unactivated) and then evaluated for additional attributes (gear tier, ability tier, etc). Any surplus shards/blueprints over the bundle upgrade criteria will be retained.

If your previously unlocked units meet or exceed the bundle upgrade criteria for other attributes, any surplus value will be retained.

[b]CHARACTERS[/b]
- 7 Stars
- Level 85
- Relic Level 5
- Ability Tier 7

data.SCYTHE_LIGHTSPEED_INFO:
[c][F0FF23]MERGE UNITS[-][/c]

Units included in the Lightspeed Bundle are upgraded according to a predetermined set of upgrade criteria (listed below). The Lightspeed Bundle does not directly grant character shards / ship blueprints or resources used in merge upgrades. The upgrade criteria are evaluated against your existing roster, and your units are set to the greater of the two values.

Each unit will first be evaluated for existing shards or star rarity against the bundle upgrade criteria. A unit at lower star rarity (or unactivated with less cumulative shards/blueprints) than the bundle upgrade criteria will be upgraded and activated. Units that exceed the star rarity (or cumulative shards/blueprints) will be activated (if unactivated) and then evaluated for additional attributes (gear tier, ability tier, etc). Any surplus shards/blueprints over the bundle upgrade criteria will be retained.

If your previously unlocked units meet or exceed the bundle upgrade criteria for other attributes, any surplus value will be retained.

[b]CHARACTERS[/b]
- 7 Stars
- Level 85
- Relic Level 5
- Ability Tier 7

[b]SHIP[/b]
- 7 Stars
- Level 85
- Ability Tier 7

data.SEPARATIST_ASSAULT_GIFTABLE_DESC: Gift this bundle to unleash Separatist power with shards for STAP, B1 Battle Droid, Nute Gunray, B2 Super Battle Droid, Droideka, and IG-100 MagnaGuard - priming their team for battle!\n\nRequirements: Receiving Player must be level 25 or above.
data.SEPARATIST_ASSAULT_GIFTABLE_TEXT: Equip your allies for the [b]Naboo Raid[/b] with essential shards for STAP, B1 Battle Droid, Nute Gunray, and more! Gift strength and strategy now!
data.SEPARATIST_CHAMPION_PACK_DESC:
Prepare for the next Grand Arena Championship with General Grievous and his Separatist squad. This pack contains shards for General Grievous, B1 Battle Droid, B2 Super Battle Droid, IG-100 MagnaGuard, and Nute Gunray, ideal for those looking to expand their Grand Arena Championship roster.

Each pack guarantees at least 5 shards for General Grievous, 10 shards for B1 Battle Droid, 10 shards for B2 Super Battle Droid, 10 shards for IG-100 MagnaGuard, and 10 shards for Nute Gunray. There is also 30% chance to get 2x shards, and 10% chance to get 4x shards!

Purchase limit: 3
data.SEPARATIST_COMMANDER_BUNDLE_DESC: Charge into battle at the head of a droid army with this limited time bundle of General Grievous' Shards and Gear Salvage. This separatist commander excels at leading dark side droids, and is a required character in the quest for Galactic Legend Kenobi!\n\nPurchase Limit: 2
data.SEPARATIST_COMMANDER_BUNDLE_TEXT: For a limited time, General Grievous shards are available in Packs and Bundles in the store!
data.SEPARATIST_COMMANDER_LIGHTSPEED_DESC: Instantly command devastating Separatist strength with General Grievous and his flagship Malevolence. Grievous arrives battle-hardened at 7 Stars, Level 85, Relic 7, Ability Tier 7, alongside his fearsome Capital Ship at 7 Stars, Level 85, and Ability Tier 7. Dominate fleet arenas immediately!\n\nPurchase limit: 1
data.SEPARATIST_COMMANDER_LIGHTSPEED_INFO:
[c][F0FF23]MERGE UNITS[-][/c]

Units included in the Lightspeed Bundle are upgraded according to a predetermined set of upgrade criteria (listed below). The Lightspeed Bundle does not directly grant character shards / ship blueprints or resources used in merge upgrades. The upgrade criteria are evaluated against your existing roster, and your units are set to the greater of the two values.

Each unit will first be evaluated for existing shards or star rarity against the bundle upgrade criteria. A unit at lower star rarity (or unactivated with less cumulative shards/blueprints) than the bundle upgrade criteria will be upgraded and activated. Units that exceed the star rarity (or cumulative shards/blueprints) will be activated (if unactivated) and then evaluated for additional attributes (gear tier, ability tier, etc). Any surplus shards/blueprints over the bundle upgrade criteria will be retained.

If your previously unlocked units meet or exceed the bundle upgrade criteria for other attributes, any surplus value will be retained.

[b]CHARACTERS[/b]
- 7 Stars
- Level 85
- Relic Level 7
- Ability Tier 7

[b]SHIP[/b]
- 7 Stars
- Level 85
- Ability Tier 7
data.SEPARATIST_COMMANDER_LIGHTSPEED_TEXT: General Grievous and his Malevolence flagship arrive battle-ready! Obtain General Grievous at 7 Stars, Relic 7, Ability Tier 7 and Malevolence at 7 Stars and Ability Tier 7! Crush your enemies without delay!

- 10 shards for Jango Fett plus enough salvage material for his finisher!

data.SHADOWS_OF_THE_EMPIRE_LIGHTSPEED_BUNDLE_:
Unleash the power of [b]Emperor Palpatine[/b] and [b]Grand Admiral Thrawn[/b] today with this rare opportunity. Each offer propels your units forward, granting you immediate access to Emperor Palpatine's or Grand Admiral Thrawn's Journey Guide event!

Purchase limit: 1

[c][F0FF23]MERGE UNITS[-][/c]

Units included in the Lightspeed Bundle are upgraded according to a predetermined set of upgrade criteria (listed below). The Lightspeed Bundle does not directly grant character shards / ship blueprints or resources used in merge upgrades. The upgrade criteria are evaluated against your existing roster, and your units are set to the greater of the two values.

Each unit will first be evaluated for existing shards or star rarity against the bundle upgrade criteria. A unit at lower star rarity (or unactivated with less cumulative shards/blueprints) than the bundle upgrade criteria will be upgraded and activated. Units that exceed the star rarity (or cumulative shards/blueprints) will be activated (if unactivated) and then evaluated for additional attributes (gear tier, ability tier, etc). Any surplus shards/blueprints over the bundle upgrade criteria will be retained.

If your previously unlocked units meet or exceed the bundle upgrade criteria for other attributes, any surplus value will be retained.

[c][AFFFFFFF]CHARACTERS[-][/c]
- 7 Stars
- Level 85
- Relic Level 3
- Ability Tier 7

[c][AFFFFFFF]SHIPS[-][/c]
- 7 Stars
- Level 85
- Ability Tier 7

Unlock Emperor Palpatine and Admiral Thrawn Today!

data.SHIPS_BOBA_FETT_SLAVEI_TEXT: Become the most infamous Bounty Hunter in the Galaxy with the BOUNTY HUNTER BUNDLE! Get 4* Boba Fett (or shards to upgrade) and his feared ship: Slave I. Includes materials to immediately level up both Ship and Crew. Head to the Store NOW!
data.Ships_Bounty_Hunter_1_QUEST_DESC: So you want to be a BOUNTY HUNTER? You'll need a collection of the galaxy's deadliest mercenaries.\n\nWant to step up?
data.Ships_Bounty_Hunter_1_QUEST_REWARDS: So you think you're good enough to earn the title BOUNTY HUNTER?\n\nHrmf, nice start but let's see you keep it up!
data.Ships_Bounty_Hunter_1_TASK_DESC_1: Get Boba Fett to Gear tier XII
data.Ships_Bounty_Hunter_1_TASK_DESC_3: Defeat 50 Wampas with Boba Fett present
data.Ships_Bounty_Hunter_2_QUEST_DESC: They say Greedo once worked for Jabba the Hutt himself.\n\nTo earn the title BOUNTY HUNTER, you'll need this cunning Rodian in your collection!
data.Ships_Bounty_Hunter_2_QUEST_REWARDS: You've got to be quick on the draw to be a BOUNTY HUNTER!
data.Ships_Bounty_Hunter_2_TASK_DESC_1: Get Greedo to Gear tier XII
data.Ships_Bounty_Hunter_3_QUEST_DESC: Armed with mechanical aim and 360-degree target tracking, no target escapes the fearsome IG-88.\n\nHe was one of the best BOUNTY HUNTERS in the galaxy! Destroy!
data.Ships_Bounty_Hunter_3_QUEST_REWARDS: Nice tracking. You're finding your targets with assassin droid IG-88.\n\nYou may just be a BOUNTY HUNTER yet!
data.Ships_Bounty_Hunter_3_TASK_DESC_1: Get IG-88 to Gear tier XII
data.Ships_Bounty_Hunter_3_TASK_DESC_3: Win 12 Battles with IG-88 in Territory Battles
data.Ships_Bounty_Hunter_4_QUEST_DESC: This changeling BOUNTY HUNTER could alter her appearance.\n\nShe once took a bounty on a Senator from Naboo...
data.Ships_Bounty_Hunter_4_QUEST_REWARDS: You know how to take care of BOUNTY HUNTER business with Zam!\n\nYou're halfway to your title - maybe you should just give up!
data.Ships_Bounty_Hunter_4_TASK_DESC_1: Get Zam Wesell to Gear tier XII
data.Ships_Bounty_Hunter_4_TASK_DESC_2_V2: Complete Galactic Bounty I event tier IV
data.Ships_Bounty_Hunter_5_QUEST_DESC: Dengar was a rough and tumble bounty hunter, rushing into brutal close-quarters fighting, unlike lighter-stepped strategic hunters like Boba Fett and Cad Bane.
data.Ships_Bounty_Hunter_5_QUEST_REWARDS: Dengar's sheer destructive force and firepower was a reckoning for those he hunted.\n\nIf you keep going, you're almost to your title!
data.Ships_Bounty_Hunter_5_TASK_DESC_1: Get Dengar to Gear tier XII
data.Ships_Bounty_Hunter_5_TASK_DESC_3: Win 5 Territory War attacks with Dengar
data.Ships_Bounty_Hunter_6_QUEST_DESC: Cad Bane was one of the top BOUNTY HUNTERS during the Clone Wars.\n\nWith custom twin blaster pistols, rocket boots, and explosives, he was a match to any quarry.
data.Ships_Bounty_Hunter_6_QUEST_REWARDS: Holotable Jedi are scurrying like womprats from your deadly Cad Bane!\n\nHar har har! If you continue, you're almost at the title BOUNTY HUNTER!
data.Ships_Bounty_Hunter_6_TASK_DESC_1: Get Cad Bane to Gear tier XII
data.Ships_Bounty_Hunter_6_TASK_DESC_2: Finish off 200 enemies with Cad Bane
data.Ships_Bounty_Hunter_6_TASK_DESC_3: Defeat 500 Jedi with Cad Bane present
data.Ships_Bounty_Hunter_7_QUEST_DESC: As a feared BOUNTY HUNTER, Bossk's hunting instincts aided him in his profession.\n\nHe was especially renowned for hunting Wookiees. There's always a bigger Wookiee!
data.Ships_Bounty_Hunter_7_QUEST_REWARDS: I don't believe it!  Hrmf, I reluctantly congratulate you!\n\nYou earned the title BOUNTY HUNTER! Show it off in the cantina and inspire much envy!
data.Ships_Bounty_Hunter_7_TASK_DESC_1: Get Bossk to Gear tier XII
data.Ships_Bounty_Hunter_7_TASK_DESC_3: Win 50 Squad Arena battles with Bossk
data.Ships_PvE_QUEST_DESC: Do you like the band? They play requests for me, probably cause I'm the best Ships player.
data.Ships_PvE_QUEST_REWARDS: Haha, you think you can beat me in ships, delusions of grandeur.
data.Ships_PvP_QUEST_REWARDS: How many Capital Ships do you even have?

This unique offer is designed to maximize your progress and power up your squad.\n\nPurchase limit 1

data.SIGNAL_AMPLIFIER_UPGRADE_KIT_DESC: Unlock the next tier of Relic upgrades! Obtain a potent mix of Flawed, Incomplete, and Fragmented Signal Data—essential components that empower your Relics to reach new heights. These are the key to accelerating your Relic upgrades and enhancing your heroes’ strength. Ignite your upgrade journey and transform your legacy!\n\nPurchase Limit: 2
data.SIGNAL_AMPLIFIER_UPGRADE_KIT_TEXT: Elevate your Relics with a potent blend of Signal Data – the key to unlocking advanced upgrades and dominating the battlefield!
data.SIGNAL_BOOST_PACK_DESC:
Fuel your Relic growth with this Pack of vital Signal Data to unlock your upgrades! This pack awards varying amounts of each of the following Signal Data types: Fragmented Signal Data, Incomplete Signal Data, and Flawed Signal Data.

For each item, there is a [b]50%[/b] chance of receiving 30 items; a [b]40%[/b] chance of receiving 50 items; and a [b]10%[/b] chance of receiving 75 items. Each Item's quantity is determined independently.

Purchase this valuable pack before it leaves the Store!

Purchase Limit: 1
data.SIGNAL_BOOST_PACK_TEXT: For a limited time, Packs containing all forms of Signal Data are available in the store! Grab these to upgrade your Relics quickly today!

This 30-day calendar offers up to 100 Fragmented Signal Data, 100 Incomplete Signal Data, and 100 Flawed Signal Data!

Make sure you claim the rewards every 24 hours!

data.SIGNAL_BOOST_REWARDS_CALENDAR_TEXT: Collect up to 100 Fragmented Signal Data, 100 Incomplete Signal Data, and 100 Flawed Signal Data with this 30-day calendar! Don't miss out on this limited-time offer!

data.SIGNAL_DATA_ASCENSION_DESC_V2: Power up your forces with each purchase and claim your next reward!

Open the Supreme Relic Cache and instantly secure vital relic upgrade materials: 25 Flawed, 25 Incomplete, and 25 Fragmented Signal Data! Each Cache also includes one bonus roll with a chance to earn powerful salvage, rare materials, and jackpot-level rewards:

data.SIGNAL_DATA_MASTERY_I_DESC: Take your Relics to new heights with this bundle! When you purchase this bundle, you’ll gain access to a follow-up bundle, SIGNAL DATA MASTERY II! data.SITH_ETNERAL_EMPEROR_LIGHTSPEED_I_INFO:
[c][F0FF23]MERGE UNITS[-][/c]

Units included in the Lightspeed Bundle are upgraded according to a predetermined set of upgrade criteria (listed below). The Lightspeed Bundle does not directly grant character shards / ship blueprints or resources used in merge upgrades. The upgrade criteria are evaluated against your existing roster, and your units are set to the greater of the two values.

Each unit will first be evaluated for existing shards or star rarity against the bundle upgrade criteria. A unit at lower star rarity (or unactivated with less cumulative shards/blueprints) than the bundle upgrade criteria will be upgraded and activated. Units that exceed the star rarity (or cumulative shards/blueprints) will be activated (if unactivated) and then evaluated for additional attributes (gear tier, ability tier, etc). Any surplus shards/blueprints over the bundle upgrade criteria will be retained.

If your previously unlocked units meet or exceed the bundle upgrade criteria for other attributes, any surplus value will be retained.

[b]CHARACTERS[/b]
- 7 Stars
- Level 85
- Relic Level 5
- Ability Tier 7

data.SMUGGLERS_LIGHTSPEED_BUNDLE_INFO:
[c][F0FF23]MERGE UNITS[-][/c]

Units included in the Lightspeed Bundle are upgraded according to a predetermined set of upgrade criteria (listed below). The Lightspeed Bundle does not directly grant character shards / ship blueprints or resources used in merge upgrades. The upgrade criteria are evaluated against your existing roster, and your units are set to the greater of the two values.

Each unit will first be evaluated for existing shards or star rarity against the bundle upgrade criteria. A unit at lower star rarity (or unactivated with less cumulative shards/blueprints) than the bundle upgrade criteria will be upgraded and activated. Units that exceed the star rarity (or cumulative shards/blueprints) will be activated (if unactivated) and then evaluated for additional attributes (gear tier, ability tier, etc). Any surplus shards/blueprints over the bundle upgrade criteria will be retained.

If your previously unlocked units meet or exceed the bundle upgrade criteria for other attributes, any surplus value will be retained.

[b]CHARACTERS[/b]
- 7 Stars
- Level 85
- Relic Level 5
- Ability Tier 7

data.SPECIALABILITY_MAZKANATA02_TIER_04_DESC:
Maz Steals Stealth from all enemies. If Stealth was Stolen, grant Stealth to all non-Tank Pirate allies and reset its duration.

If all allies are Pirates and there are no Galactic Legend allies at the start of battle, inflict all enemies with 3 stacks of Expose for 2 turns.

This attack can't be evaded or resisted.
data.SPECIALABILITY_MAZKANATA02_TIER_05_DESC:
Maz Steals Stealth from all enemies. If Stealth was Stolen, grant Stealth to all non-Tank Pirate allies and reset its duration.

If all allies are Pirates and there are no Galactic Legend allies at the start of battle, inflict all enemies with 3 stacks of Expose for 2 turns and the target enemy's cooldowns are increased by 1.

This attack can't be evaded or resisted.
data.SPECIALABILITY_MAZKANATA02_TIER_06_DESC_:
Maz Steals Stealth, resets its duration, and grants it to all non-Tank Pirate allies and she Steals 1 stack of Profit that she granted to enemies from each enemy until the end of the encounter.

If all allies are Pirates and there are no Galactic Legend allies at the start of battle, inflict all enemies with 3 stacks of Expose for 2 turns and the target enemy's cooldowns are increased by 1.

This attack can't be evaded or resisted.
data.SPECIALABILITY_MAZKANATA02_TIER_07_DESC_:
Maz Steals Stealth, resets its duration, and grants it to all non-Tank Pirate allies and she Steals 1 stack of Profit that she granted to enemies from each enemy until the end of the encounter.

If all allies are Pirates and there are no Galactic Legend allies at the start of battle, inflict all enemies with 3 stacks of Expose for 2 turns and the target enemy's cooldowns are increased by 1.

This attack can't be evaded or resisted.

[c][E7E7E7]While in Grand Arenas and there are no Galactic Legend allies:[-][/c] If all allies were Pirates at the start of battle, Maz Steals an additional stack of Profit that she granted to enemies from each enemy until the end of encounter, and all enemies have their cooldowns increased by 1 instead.

If target enemy had lost all 5 stacks of Profit given from Maz, Deathmark them until the end of encounter, which can't be copied or dispelled. If the enemy already had Deathmark, set target enemy to 100 Max Health until the end of encounter. If target enemy was a Galactic Legend, inflict them with Armor Shred instead, which can't be dispelled, until the end of encounter.

data.SPECIALABILITY_SATELESHAN01_TIER_02_DESC:

data.SPECIALABILITY_SATELESHAN01_TIER_05_DESC:
Deal Physical damage to target enemy and Stun them for 2 turns. Satele Taunts for 2 turns, which can't be dispelled. If both Jedi Knight Revan and Bastila Shan are allies, this Stun can't be evaded or resisted.

If target enemy is Marked, all Old Republic Jedi allies gain 100% Defense Penetration and Offense (stacking) for 2 turns.

If Satele has Defense Up and Tenacity Up, she dispels them and gains Perfect Defense for 2 turns, which can't be copied, dispelled, or prevented.

All Old Republic allies also gain Fearless for 2 turns, which can't be copied, dispelled, or prevented.
data.SPECIALABILITY_SATELESHAN01_TIER_06_DESC:
Deal Physical damage to target enemy and Stun them for 2 turns. Satele Taunts for 2 turns, which can't be dispelled. If both Jedi Knight Revan and Bastila Shan are allies, this Stun can't be evaded or resisted. If the target enemy is already Stunned, remove 100% of their Turn Meter, which can't be resisted.

If target enemy is Marked, all Old Republic Jedi allies gain 100% Defense Penetration and Offense (stacking) for 2 turns.

If Satele has Defense Up and Tenacity Up, she dispels them and gains Perfect Defense for 2 turns, which can't be copied, dispelled, or prevented.

All Old Republic allies also gain Fearless for 2 turns, which can't be copied, dispelled, or prevented.
data.SPECIALABILITY_SATELESHAN01_TIER_07_DESC:
Deal Physical damage to target enemy and Stun them for 2 turns. Satele Taunts for 2 turns, which can't be dispelled. If both Jedi Knight Revan and Bastila Shan are allies, this Stun can't be evaded or resisted. If the target enemy is already Stunned, remove 100% of their Turn Meter, which can't be resisted.

If target enemy is Marked, all Old Republic Jedi allies gain 100% Defense Penetration and Offense (stacking) for 2 turns.

If Satele has Defense Up and Tenacity Up, she dispels them and gains Perfect Defense for 2 turns, which can't be copied, dispelled, or prevented.

If there are no allied Galactic Legends, all Jedi allies gain a stack of Jedi Lessons for 3 turns (max 3 stacks), which can't be copied, dispelled, or prevented. All Old Republic allies also gain Fearless for 2 turns, which can't be copied, dispelled, or prevented.

Gain [c][ffff33]Merciless[-][/c] and take a bonus turn after this one. All enemies gain [c][ffff33]Merciless Target[-][/c], which can't be evaded or resisted. When Darth Vader uses an ability, Merciless Target is removed from the target enemy and Darth Vader takes a bonus turn. Darth Vader can ignore taunt effects when targeting enemies with Merciless Target.

[c][ffff33]Merciless:[-][/c] +50% Offense (does not stack with Offense Up), +50% Critical Chance, and +50% Critical Damage; immune to Fear, Stun, and Turn Meter manipulation and Darth Vader's bonus turns do not trigger other characters' effects based on bonus turns or Turn Meter gain

data.STARKILLER_LIGHTSPEED_BUNDLE_INFO:
[c][F0FF23]MERGE UNITS[-][/c]

Units included in the Lightspeed Bundle are upgraded according to a predetermined set of upgrade criteria (listed below). The Lightspeed Bundle does not directly grant character shards / ship blueprints or resources used in merge upgrades. The upgrade criteria are evaluated against your existing roster, and your units are set to the greater of the two values.

Each unit will first be evaluated for existing shards or star rarity against the bundle upgrade criteria. A unit at lower star rarity (or unactivated with less cumulative shards/blueprints) than the bundle upgrade criteria will be upgraded and activated. Units that exceed the star rarity (or cumulative shards/blueprints) will be activated (if unactivated) and then evaluated for additional attributes (gear tier, ability tier, etc). Any surplus shards/blueprints over the bundle upgrade criteria will be retained.

If your previously unlocked units meet or exceed the bundle upgrade criteria for other attributes, any surplus value will be retained.

data.TERRITORYABILITY_WAR_ALLHANSONDECK_DESC:
Granted to: [c][F0FF23]Han[-][/c]
Each Han takes a bonus turn at the start of the encounter. During this turn, each Han ignores Taunts and can only use his Basic ability, but it will Stun the target for 1 turn. This Stun can't be evaded or resisted. Additionally, each active Han grants a bonus to all other Han allies:
- [c][f0ff23]Captain Han Solo:[-][/c] +50% Max Health, and other Han allies can’t be defeated while Captain Han is active
- [c][f0ff23]Han Solo:[-][/c] +50% Critical Damage, and other Han allies have +35% counter chance while Han Solo is active
- [c][f0ff23]Stormtrooper Han:[-][/c] +50% Max Protection, and other Han allies grant 10% Turn Meter to all other Han allies when damaged by an attack while Stormtrooper Han is active
- [c][f0ff23]Veteran Smuggler Han Solo:[-][/c] +50% Health Steal, and other Han allies take a bonus turn whenever any Han ally is defeated while Veteran Smuggler Han is active
- [c][f0ff23]Young Han Solo:[-][/c] +50% Offense, and other Han allies have +35% chance to assist other Han allies while Young Han is active (limit once per Han per turn)
data.TERRITORYABILITY_WAR_BUFF_FIRSTORDER_DES: Whenever any First Order ally suffers a Debuff or attacks with Advantage, they gain 5% Critical Damage and Potency (stacking) for the rest of the battle.
data.TERRITORYABILITY_WAR_BUFF_GRIEVOUS01_DES: Granted to: [c][F0FF23]General Grievous[-][/c] \nGeneral Grievous has +300% Offense. At the start of each turn, if Grievous is below 100% Health, he dispels all debuffs on himself and grants Taunt to the other healthiest Droid ally until the end of the turn. When a Droid ally is defeated for the first time in battle, Grievous dispels all debuffs on himself, resets all ability cooldowns, and gains 3 bonus turns.
data.TERRITORYABILITY_WAR_BUFF_MACEWINDU01_DE: Granted to: [c][F0FF23]Mace Windu[-][/c] \nMace Windu has +100% Max Health, +480% Max Protection, +100% Counter Chance, and is immune to Shock, Daze and Stun. Additionally, when attacking Sith with his basic attack Mace deals +1000% damage. Whenever Mace suffers damage, Inflict Expose on all enemies for 2 turns which can't be evaded. If Jango Fett has Expose, Mace Windu's attacks will instantly defeat him (Damage Immunity does not prevent this effect).
data.TERRITORYABILITY_WAR_BUFF_TROOPER01_DESC: At the start of battle, Imperial Troopers gain 5 stacks of [c][ffff33]Endless Ranks[-][/c]. When an enemy is defeated, all Imperial Troopers gain 1 stack of [c][ffff33]Endless Ranks[-][/c], up to 10 stacks.\n\n[c][ffff33]Endless Ranks[-][/c]: When an Imperial Trooper is defeated, they consume 1 stack of [c][ffff33]Endless Ranks[-][/c] from all Imperial Trooper allies, revive with 100% Health and 100% Protection, reset all their cooldowns, and gain a bonus turn
data.TERRITORYABILITY_WAR_COUNTDOOKU_MYSTERY_: Granted to: [c][F0FF23]Count Dooku[-][/c] \nForce Lightning ignores Protection and deals bonus damage equal to 80% of the target's Max Health if they are already Shocked. Whenever Count Dooku uses his Basic attack reduce the cooldown of Force Lightning by 1.
data.TERRITORYABILITY_WAR_CUP01_DESC: Granted to: [c][F0FF23]Coruscant Underworld Police[-][/c] \nCoruscant Underworld Police gains 500% Potency, 300% Max Health and deals 1000% more damage with his Basic attack when attacking Scoundrels. Whenever Coruscant Underworld Police inflicts Stun, he gains Protection Up (50%, stacking) for 2 turns.
data.TERRITORYABILITY_WAR_GEONOSIAN_SWARM_DES: Granted to: [c][F0FF23]Geonosians[-][/c] \nWhenever an ally uses an ability during their turn, all other Geonosians assist if they gained a buff this turn, dealing 200% more damage.

Granted to: [c][F0FF23]Geonosian Ships[-][/c]\nWhenever an ally uses an ability during their turn, all other Geonosians that gained a buff this turn assist, dealing 200% more damage (max 1 assist per ally per turn).
data.TERRITORYABILITY_WAR_INDUSTRYOFWAR_ACTIV: Granted to: [c][F0FF23]Geonosians[-][/c] \nCall heavy artillery to destroy target enemy and another random enemy, which can't be evaded.  When a Geonosian ally uses an ability, they reduce this ability's cooldown by 1. This cooldown can't be reduced any other way, is shared across all Geonosian allies, and starts on cooldown.
data.TERRITORYABILITY_WAR_INDUSTRYOFWAR_PASSI: Granted to: [c][F0FF23]Geonosians[-][/c] \nAt the start of battle, Geonosians gain 75% Max Health and 100% Max Protection for each other Geonosian ally. When a Geonosian ally uses an ability, they gain Foresight for 1 turn.
data.TERRITORYABILITY_WAR_UNSTABLEBATTERIES_D:
Granted to: [c][F0FF23]Droids[-][/c] 
Droids deal 100% more damage with attacks not based on Health, but have a 15% chance to be destroyed when damaged by an attack. Droids destroyed this way can't be revived.

Whenever a Droid is destroyed by Unstable Batteries, they deal damage to each enemy equal to 80% of that enemy's Max Health and inflict Burning for 1 turn, which can't be evaded or resisted. This damage can't defeat enemies.

B1 Battle Droid can't be destroyed by Unstable Batteries, but can still trigger the Max Health damage and inflict Burning for 1 turn when it is damaged by an attack.

data.THE_PRINCESSES_LIGHTSPEED_BUNDLE_INFO:
[b]MERGE UNITS[/b]

Units included in the Lightspeed Bundle are upgraded according to a predetermined set of upgrade criteria (listed below). The Lightspeed Bundle does not directly grant character shards / ship blueprints or resources used in merge upgrades. The upgrade criteria are evaluated against your existing roster, and your units are set to the greater of the two values.

Each unit will first be evaluated for existing shards or star rarity against the bundle upgrade criteria. A unit at lower star rarity (or unactivated with less cumulative shards/blueprints) than the bundle upgrade criteria will be upgraded and activated. Units that exceed the star rarity (or cumulative shards/blueprints) will be activated (if unactivated) and then evaluated for additional attributes (gear tier, ability tier, etc). Any surplus shards/blueprints over the bundle upgrade criteria will be retained.

If your previously unlocked units meet or exceed the bundle upgrade criteria for other attributes, any surplus value will be retained.

[b]CHARACTERS[/b]
- 7 Stars
- Level 85
- Relic Level 5
- Ability Tier 7

data.THEMANDALORIANBESKARARMOR_GUIDE_DESCRIPT: Rescued from certain death at the hands of Separatist battle droids by a group of Mandalorians, Din Djarin became a foundling, growing up steeped in Mandalorian ways and traditions. data.THIRDSISTER_GUIDE_DESCRIPTION: The Third Sister was a member of the Inquisitorius tasked with hunting down Jedi that survived Order 66. As a youngling named Reva during Order 66, she witnessed, and experienced first-hand, the ruthlessness exhibited by the fallen Jedi Anakin Skywalker, now known as Darth Vader, in the Jedi Temple on Coruscant. After being left for dead in the temple, she would eventually find a new life and identity as the Third Sister in the Inquisitorius. Her knowledge of Darth Vader's former identity helped drive her to seek revenge against him by attempting to capture his former master, Obi-Wan Kenobi, to draw out Vader and lower his guard.

data.TIEIN_INTERCEPTOR_LIGHTSPEED_BUNDLE_DESC: Prepare for battle with the TIE/IN Interceptor Lightspeed Bundle, featuring the swift and deadly TIE/IN Interceptor, piloted by the relentless Second Sister. This bundle unlocks and upgrades Second Sister and TIE/IN Interceptor Prototype to 7-star. Second Sister will be instantly upgraded to Relic 5 and all of her abilities to Tier 8. TIE/IN Interceptor Prototype will be fully unlocked to 7-star and all abilities upgraded to Tier 8.\n\nPurchase limit: 1
data.TIEIN_INTERCEPTOR_LIGHTSPEED_BUNDLE_INFO:
[c][F0FF23]MERGE UNITS[-][/c]

Units included in the Lightspeed Bundle are upgraded according to a predetermined set of upgrade criteria (listed below). The Lightspeed Bundle does not directly grant character shards / ship blueprints or resources used in merge upgrades. The upgrade criteria are evaluated against your existing roster, and your units are set to the greater of the two values.

Each unit will first be evaluated for existing shards or star rarity against the bundle upgrade criteria. A unit at lower star rarity (or unactivated with less cumulative shards/blueprints) than the bundle upgrade criteria will be upgraded and activated. Units that exceed the star rarity (or cumulative shards/blueprints) will be activated (if unactivated) and then evaluated for additional attributes (gear tier, ability tier, etc). Any surplus shards/blueprints over the bundle upgrade criteria will be retained.

If your previously unlocked units meet or exceed the bundle upgrade criteria for other attributes, any surplus value will be retained.

[b]CHARACTERS[/b]
- 7 Stars
- Level 85
- Relic Level 5
- Ability Tier 8

data.TUSKEN_CONSUMABLE_OVERCHARGED_DESC_V2:
Tusken allies gain 50% Max Health and Defense, and 20 Speed. At the start of the encounter, the weakest enemy is inflicted with [c][FFFF33]Ambushed![-][/c] until defeated and the healthiest ally gains Taunt for 3 turns. Whenever a Tusken ally damages an enemy with Ambushed!, all Tusken allies gain 2 stacks of Momentum for 3 turns. Whenever an enemy with Ambushed! is defeated, the weakest enemy is inflicted with Ambushed! until defeated. If Taunt is dispelled during the enemy's turn, Tusken allies gain 15 stacks of Momentum, their cooldowns are refreshed, and they gain 100% Turn Meter. Tusken allies gain 1% Offense, Defense, Critical Damage for the rest of the encounter whenever they gain Momentum.

[c][FFFF33]Ambushed!:[-][/c] Tusken allies can ignore Taunt to target this enemy.
Max Duration: 1 battle

data.TUSKEN_LIGHTSPEED_BUNDLE_INFO:
[c][F0FF23]MERGE UNITS[-][/c]

Units included in the Lightspeed Bundle are upgraded according to a predetermined set of upgrade criteria (listed below). The Lightspeed Bundle does not directly grant character shards / ship blueprints or resources used in merge upgrades. The upgrade criteria are evaluated against your existing roster, and your units are set to the greater of the two values.

Each unit will first be evaluated for existing shards or star rarity against the bundle upgrade criteria. A unit at lower star rarity (or unactivated with less cumulative shards/blueprints) than the bundle upgrade criteria will be upgraded and activated. Units that exceed the star rarity (or cumulative shards/blueprints) will be activated (if unactivated) and then evaluated for additional attributes (gear tier, ability tier, etc). Any surplus shards/blueprints over the bundle upgrade criteria will be retained.

If your previously unlocked units meet or exceed the bundle upgrade criteria for other attributes, any surplus value will be retained.

[b]CHARACTERS[/b]
- 7 Stars
- Level 85
- Relic Level 5
- Ability Tier 7

data.TUTORIAL_RAID_KRAYTDRAGONHUNT_GRANTEDABI: In the [c][ffff33]KRAYT DRAGON HUNT[-][/c], there are two Granted abilities you want to use at appropriate times.

[c][ffff33]Fire Ballista[-][/c] deals damage to the Krayt Dragon and attempts to inflict a number of debuffs. Because the Krayt Dragon is immune to these debuffs, they instead reduce its [c][ffff33]Defiance[-][/c]! Keeping its Defiance under control is important to the survival of your characters.

You'll notice there are Bundles of Explosives on the battlefield. [c][ffff33]Replant Explosives[-][/c] replaces up to 2 of these bundles. There can't be more than 3 set at once, so use this wisely to refresh them after they've gone off!
data.TW_BONUS_ABILITY_CLONETROOPER_DESC: At the start of battle, Clone Troopers gain 50% Health, 50% Protection, 50% Offense, and 50% Defense for each Clone Trooper ally. Clone Troopers gain 100% Critical Chance and 100% Critical Damage while they have no debuffs. When they attack out of turn, Clone Troopers dispel all debuffs on other Clone Trooper allies, dispel all buffs on the target enemy, and gain 20% Turn Meter.

data.TW_BONUS_ABILITY_JAWAS_DESC_V3: Jawas have 50% chance to Stun the target enemy when they use an ability, which can't be evaded. Jawas gain 20% Offense for each Stunned enemy. After Jawas use a Basic attack on a Stunned enemy, they Shock them for 2 turns and call all other Jawa allies to assist. Ruthless Salvager allows each Jawa that assists up to 6 assists per turn.

data.ULTIMATEABILITY_GLAHSOKATANO01_DESC:
Requires 100% [c][FFA500]Ultimate Charge[-][/c] to activate.

[c][FFA500]Ultimate Charge:[-][/c] Ahsoka Tano gains 30% Ultimate Charge whenever an ally uses Reunite, 30% Ultimate Charge whenever Huyang gains any version of History of the Galaxy, 6% Ultimate Charge whenever she uses a Special ability, and 6% Ultimate Charge whenever an ally with Morai's Wisdom uses a Special ability.

Reset the cooldown of all allies, and set the cooldown of all enemies to their max, which can't be resisted.

Spectre allies recover 50% Health and Protection. Remove Exile from a random ally, and a random Spectre ally who didn't already have it gains Morai's Wisdom until the end of battle which can't be copied, dispelled, or prevented. Ezra Bridger (Exile) gains 10 stacks of Purrgil Migration.

Target enemy is Exiled for 2 turns, which can't be copied, dispelled, or resisted.

This ability transforms into [c][ffff33]Relentless Redoubt[-][/c].

[c][ffff33]Relentless Redoubt:[-][/c] Requires 50% [c][FFA500]Ultimate Charge[-][/c] to activate.

The other strongest Spectre ally gains [c][ffff33]Deflective Ward[-][/c], which can't be copied, dispelled, or prevented until the end of the encounter.

Whenever an ally with Deflective Ward takes damage from an enemy, Deflective Ward expires and the enemy who damaged them is inflicted with 2 stacks of Off Balance for 1 turn, which can't be resisted, and if they weren't Stealthed, [c][ffff33]Deflective Target[-][/c]. Whenever Ahsoka uses an ability during her turn, Deflective Target is removed from the target enemy and Ahsoka takes a bonus turn. If the target did not have Deflective Target, it is removed from all remaining enemies. Ahsoka can ignore taunt effects when targeting enemies with Deflective Target. Whenever Ahsoka is damaged by an enemy, at the end of that turn she dispels Deflective Ward from a random ally.

- [c][FFA500]50% Ultimate Charge:[-][/c] Ahsoka recovers 25% Health and Protection, and all Light Side allies gain 10% Mastery until the end of battle
- [c][FFA500]75% Ultimate Charge:[-][/c] Ahsoka recovers an additional 25% Health and Protection, and all Light Side allies gain an additional 20% Mastery until the end of battle; the strongest and weakest other Spectre ally who didn't already have it gain Deflective Ward which can't be copied, dispelled, or prevented until the end of the encounter; inflict Ability Block on target enemy for 1 turn, which can't be evaded or resisted
- [c][FFA500]100% Ultimate Charge:[-][/c] Ahsoka recovers an additional 50% Health and Protection, all Light Side allies gain an additional 30% Mastery until the end of battle, and all other Spectre allies who didn't already have it gain Deflective Ward which can't be copied, dispelled, or prevented until the end of the encounter; inflict Ability Block on target enemy for 1 turn, which can't be evaded or resisted

[c][ffff33]Deflective Ward:[-][/c] Damage received is reduced to 1

[c][ffff33]Deflective Target:[-][/c] Ahsoka can ignore taunt effects to target this character, and takes a bonus turn after using an ability while targeting this unit; dispels if this character Stealths

data.ULTIMATEABILITY_GLHONDO_DESC:
Requires 100% [c][FFA500]Ultimate Charge[-][/c] to activate.

[c][FFA500]Ultimate Charge:[-][/c] Pirate King Hondo Ohnaka gains 1% Ultimate Charge whenever a Pirate ally gains a stack of Profit and 2% Ultimate Charge whenever a Pirate ally uses an ability that Steals buffs.

All Pirate and Smuggler allies are revived with 100% Health. All enemies lose 25% Turn Meter, doubled for Jedi and Sith, which can't be resisted. Jedi and Sith enemies also have their cooldowns increased by 2. Enemies gain Critical Damage Up, Defense Up, and Offense Up for 2 turns.

Pirate King Hondo then inflicts [c][ffff33]Tenuous Agreement[-][/c] on all enemies for 2 turns, which can't be copied, dispelled, evaded, or resisted, and grants [c][ffff33]Favorable Terms[-][/c] to all Pirate allies for 2 turns, which can't be copied, dispelled, or prevented.

[c][ffff33]Tenuous Agreement:[-][/c] +10 Speed; deal 30% less damage to characters with Favorable Terms

[c][ffff33]Favorable Terms:[-][/c] +20% Critical Chance and Offense; recover 10% Protection at the start of this character's turn; gain a bonus turn and grant allied Pirate King Hondo Ohnaka 2 stacks of Profit when defeating an enemy with Tenuous Agreement

Whenever an enemy damages a character with Favorable Terms, they are inflicted with one stack of Off Balance for 2 turns, which can't be evaded, and Pirate King Hondo Ohnaka gains 2 stacks of Profit.
data.ULTIMATEABILITY_GLLEIA_DESC:
Requires 100% [c][FFA500]Ultimate Charge[-][/c] to activate.

[c][FFA500]Ultimate Charge:[-][/c] Gain 4% Ultimate Charge whenever an enemy's turn or Leia's turn ends while Leia has a stack of Fearless, and 1% whenever a Rebel ally deals damage while they have Call to Action.

Deal True damage to all enemies equal to 30% of Leia's Max Health (90% against enemies who are Ambushed), remove 100% Turn Meter, inflict Ambush on all enemies for 1 turn who don't already have it and, if all allies are Rebels, Fracture all enemies until the end of Leia's next turn or she is defeated which can't be copied, dispelled, or resisted.

All Rebel allies recover 100% Health and Protection and gain Tenacity Up for 3 turns which can't be dispelled or prevented, and other Rebel allies gain 50 Speed for 2 turns. If this ability defeats an enemy, revive all defeated Rebel allies and they recover full Health and Protection, all non-Scoundrel Rebel allies gain 30% Mastery until the end of the encounter, and other Rebel allies gain an additional 50 Speed for 2 turns.

This ability can't be countered or evaded.
data.ULTIMATEABILITY_GLREY_DESC:
Requires 100% [c][FFA500]Ultimate Charge[-][/c] to activate

[c][FFA500]Ultimate Charge:[-][/c] Rey gains 6% Ultimate Charge at the start of every character's turn.

Until the end of Rey's next turn, she enters a defensive stance and damage Light Side allies receive is reduced to 1. While in this stance, Rey can't act, has 30% less Speed, is immune to all detrimental effects, and can't be defeated. Upon activating this ability again, she deals true damage (ignores defense, but can't critically hit) to the enemy team split among them and all [c][FFA500]Ultimate Charge[-][/c] is consumed. This attack can't be countered or evaded.
data.ULTIMATEABILITY_GRANDMASTERLUKE_DESC:
Requires 100% [c][FFA500]Ultimate Charge[-][/c] to activate

[c][FFA500]Ultimate Charge:[-][/c] Jedi Master Luke Skywalker gains 8% Ultimate Charge whenever a Jedi ally gains Jedi Lessons or the duration of all their current stacks of Jedi Lessons is reset.

Jedi Master Luke Skywalker transforms into Jedi Master Luke Skywalker (Heroic) and dispels Jedi Lessons from all Jedi allies.

Dispel all debuffs on all Jedi allies and reset the cooldowns of their Special abilities. All Jedi allies gain Critical Chance Up and Critical Damage Up for 2 turns and gain Jedi Legacy and 35% Offense until the end of battle.

When Luke transforms, the max cooldown for [c][ffff33]They Grow Beyond[-][/c] and [c][ffff33]Efflux[-][/c] is reduced by 2.
data.ULTIMATEABILITY_JABBATHEHUTT_DESC:
Requires 100% [c][FFA500]Ultimate Charge[-][/c] to activate.

[c][FFA500]Ultimate Charge:[-][/c] Jabba the Hutt gains 3% Ultimate Charge whenever an ally with My Kind of Scum starts their turn or uses a Special ability. If an ally with My Kind of Scum defeats an enemy, or Jabba uses his Basic ability during his turn, he gains 6% Ultimate Charge.

Jabba the Hutt instantly defeats target enemy (excluding raid bosses and Galactic Legends). Enemies defeated by this ability can't be revived.

Bounty Hunter, Hutt Cartel, and Smuggler allies recover 100% Health and Protection. Hutt Cartel allies gain 50% Turn Meter.

There Will Be No Bargain on Galactic Legends: Dispel buffs, inflict Armor Shred until the end of the encounter, deal true damage to target enemy, and Stun other enemies for 1 turn, which can't be resisted.

There Will Be No Bargain on raid bosses: Deal true damage to target enemy equal to 30% of Jabba's Max Health 5 times and Stun all other enemies for 1 turn, which can't be resisted.

This ability can't be countered or evaded.
data.ULTIMATEABILITY_JEDIMASTERKENOBI_DESC_V2:
Requires at least 50% [c][FFA500]Ultimate Charge[-][/c] to activate

[c][FFA500]Ultimate Charge:[-][/c] Jedi Master Kenobi gains Ultimate Charge when he uses his abilities. If Jedi Master Kenobi is the Leader, he also gains 3% Ultimate Charge when another Light Side ally uses a Basic ability, doubled during their turn.

If at the start of battle there was a Light Side Unaligned Force User ally that is also Galactic Republic, all Jedi allies ignore Protection when targeting a Sith enemy and Sith enemies can't counter attack for the rest of battle. Dispel all debuffs on Light Side allies. All other Light Side allies gain a percentage of Mastery (stacking) equal to the amount of Ultimate Charge used with this ability, doubled at 100% Ultimate Charge, until the end of the encounter.

If less than 100% Ultimate Charge was used, Jedi Master Kenobi gains the [c][ffff33]High Ground[-][/c] buff for 2 turns, which can't be copied, dispelled, or prevented. All Galactic Republic allies gain Protection Up (20%) for 3 turns which can't be dispelled or prevented.

If 100% Ultimate Charge was used, Jedi Master Kenobi gains the High Ground buff for 5 turns, which can't be copied, dispelled, or prevented. All Light Side allies recover 60% Health and Protection, and all Galactic Republic allies gain Protection Up (50%) for 3 turns which can't be dispelled or prevented.

[c][ffff33]High Ground:[-][/c] Deals 35% more damage with out of turn attacks; +100% Counter Chance; -35% Speed; can't gain Ultimate Charge

data.ULTIMATEABILITY_LORDVADER_DESC_V4:
Requires at least 65% [c][FFA500]Ultimate Charge[-][/c] to activate.

[c][FFA500]Ultimate Charge:[-][/c] Lord Vader gains Ultimate Charge when he uses Dark Harbinger. If Lord Vader is the Leader, when debuffed Dark Side allies receive damage he gains 2% Ultimate Charge, increased to 3% if that ally was an Unaligned Force User. If all other allies are Dark Side Clone Troopers at the start of encounter, Lord Vader gains 3% Ultimate Charge whenever a debuffed Dark Side Clone Trooper ally takes damage.

Lord Vader gains 50% of other Dark Side allies' current Mastery (stacking) until the end of the encounter, then they lose that much. Empire and Dark Side Unaligned Force User allies don't lose Mastery from this ability.

If 100% Ultimate Charge was used, Lord Vader instead gains 75% Mastery from this ability, dispels all debuffs on himself, takes a bonus turn, reduces his cooldowns by 1, and gains Ashes of the Republic for 5 turns, which can't be copied, dispelled, or prevented.

These Mastery gains will only trigger if the character has more than 0 Mastery.

[c][ffff33]Ashes of the Republic:[-][/c] Lord Vader's abilities gain additional effects; enemies defeated while this is active can't be revived; Lord Vader is immune to Ability Block, Healing Immunity, and Shock; can't gain Ultimate Charge
data.ULTIMATEABILITY_SITHPALPATINE_DESC_V2:
Requires 100% [c][FFA500]Ultimate Charge[-][/c] to activate

[c][FFA500]Ultimate Charge:[-][/c] Sith Eternal Emperor gains 2% Ultimate Charge whenever a Deceived enemy uses an ability. If Sith Eternal Emperor is the leader, he also gains 8% Ultimate Charge whenever a Linked enemy uses an ability.

Sith Eternal Emperor gains Mastery equal to his current Mastery until the end of battle and transforms into Sith Eternal Emperor (Restored). If he is the leader, all other Dark Side allies gain Mastery equal to their current Mastery until the end of battle. Remove Deceived from all Deceived enemies and inflict Deceived until the end of encounter on those enemies, which can't be copied, dispelled, or resisted.

This attack can't be evaded.

data.UNIQUEABILITY_AAT_WEAPON01_DESC:
This unit is immune to Turn Meter reduction effects and its weapons may attack and be attacked independently. When this weapon system is disabled, it will reboot after some time, but if all weapon systems are offline simultaneously, this unit will be become Toppled and grant Morale bonuses to the attacking party:

Morale I: All attacking units gain +100% Defense Penetration.
Morale II: Attacking units gain +25% Speed if all three of the AAT's weapon systems were disabled within one of its turns.
Morale III: All attacking units gain +50% Critical Damage if any of them suffered a direct hit from the Main Cannon and survived until the AAT was Toppled.

When the AAT recovers from Topple, Morale bonuses are lost, and the AAT and its side cannons gain 100% Turn Meter.

data.UNIQUEABILITY_CALKESTIS01_TIER_05_DESC:
At the start of battle, all Unaligned Force User allies gain 30% Max Health and 30% Tenacity. Whenever an ally is critically hit, they and Cal recover 5% Health and Protection. If the ally is also a Light Side or Dark Side Unaligned Force User they and Cal gain Protection Up (10%, stacking, max 50%) for 2 turns.

For each Special ability used by each other character, Cal gains a stack of [c][ffff33]Persistence[-][/c], which can't be copied dispelled or prevented.

[c][ffff33]Persistence:[-][/c] At the start of his turn, Cal does the following based on the number of stacks of Persistence that he has:

[c][ffff33]- 10+ stacks:[-][/c] He and all Unaligned Force User allies gain Foresight for 2 turns
[c][ffff33]- 20+ stacks:[-][/c] He and all Unaligned Force User allies gain Defense Up and Protection Up (30%) for 2 turns
[c][ffff33]- 30 stacks:[-][/c] He inflicts Ability Block and Buff Immunity on all enemies for 2 turns, which can't be evaded or resisted, and all allies gain 50% Turn Meter, this effect is doubled for Light Side Unaligned Force Users; stacks of Persistence are reset

data.UNIQUEABILITY_CAPITALEXECUTOR01_DESC:
Bounty Hunter allies have +10% Max Health, Max Protection, and Offense, and ignore Taunt on Crewless or Droid ships. At the start of battle, Bounty Hunter allies gain Tenacity Up for 2 turns, and Empire allies gain [c][ffff33]We Don't Need Their Scum[-][/c] for the rest of the battle, which can't be copied, dispelled, or prevented.

Whenever a Bounty Hunter ally deals damage with a Basic ability, they inflict Target Lock on the target enemy for 1 turn. The first time allies inflict Target Lock 20 times on enemies, each active enemy, enemies who are called in from Reinforcements, or summoned, are inflicted with Breach and Target Lock. These effects can't be dispelled, evaded, or resisted, and last until the end of the battle.

[c][FFCC33]Reinforcement Bonus:[-][/c] Reinforcements gain Breach Immunity and Chaff for 2 turns

[c][ffff33]We Don't Need Their Scum:[-][/c] Immune to Turn Meter manipulation; whenever a Bounty Hunter ally is defeated, recover 25% Health and Protection; TIE Advanced x1 instead recovers 10% Health and Protection

At the start of battle, Bounty Hunter allies gain Tenacity Up for 2 turns, and Empire allies gain [c][ffff33]We Don't Need Their Scum[-][/c] for the rest of the battle, which can't be copied, dispelled, or prevented. Enemies attacking out of turn deal 50% less damage to Tank allies. Whenever an enemy reinforces, Bounty Hunter allies gain Evasion Up for 1 turn. Whenever an ally applies Breach to an enemy, they dispel all debuffs on themselves.

Whenever a Bounty Hunter ally deals damage with a Basic ability, they inflict Target Lock on the target enemy for 1 turn. The first time allies inflict Target Lock 20 times on enemies, dispel Breach Immunity and Chaff from all enemies, then each active enemy, enemies who are called in from Reinforcements, or summoned, are inflicted with Breach and Target Lock. These effects can't be prevented, dispelled, evaded, or resisted, and last until the end of the battle.

[c][FFCC33]Reinforcement Bonus:[-][/c] Reinforcements gain Breach Immunity and Chaff for 2 turns

[c][ffff33]We Don't Need Their Scum:[-][/c] Immune to Turn Meter manipulation; whenever a Bounty Hunter ally is defeated, recover 25% Health and Protection; TIE Advanced x1 instead recovers 10% Health and Protection

At the start of battle, the Finalizer gains 10 Speed for each other active First Order ally until the end of its first turn. All First Order allies active at the start of battle have +20% Max Health and have their Reinforcement abilities activated (debuffs from these abilities will not be inflicted).

First Order allies recover 10% Health when they critically hit an enemy. If a First Order ally defeats a Hunted enemy, that ally gains 10% Critical Damage (stacking, max 5 stacks) until the end of the battle.

[c][FFCC33]Reinforcement Bonus:[-][/c] Reinforcements gain Advantage for 2 turns. If the Reinforcement is First Order they also gain 25% Critical Damage until the end of battle and the Finalizer gains 30% Turn Meter.

Whenever Captain Tarpals scores a critical hit, remove 1 stack of Recharge from allied Shield Generator. Gungan allies gain 5% Defense Penetration for 1 turn (stacking) for each stack of Recharge removed from allied Shield Generator.

Captain Tarpals gains 1% Turn Meter whenever an enemy is inflicted with a debuff. Whenever a debuffed enemy attacks Captain Tarpals, he counter attacks.

If there is an active allied Shield Generator: At the start of Captain Tarpals' turn dispel all debuffs on himself, ignore Taunt, and whenever he attacks out of turn, inflict Buff Immunity for 1 turn.
data.UNIQUEABILITY_CAPTAINTARPALS01_TIER_07_D:
At the start of battle, Captain Tarpals loses 75% Max Health and gains that much Max Protection. Whenever Captain Tarpals attacks out of turn, deal bonus True damage equal to 5% of his Max Protection, which can't be evaded, and he and the weakest other Gungan ally recover 10% Protection.

Whenever Captain Tarpals scores a critical hit, remove 1 stack of Recharge from allied Shield Generator. Gungan allies gain 5% Defense Penetration for 1 turn (stacking) for each stack of Recharge removed from allied Shield Generator.

Captain Tarpals gains 1% Turn Meter whenever an enemy is inflicted with a debuff. Whenever a debuffed enemy attacks Captain Tarpals, he counter attacks.

If there is an active allied Shield Generator: At the start of Captain Tarpals' turn dispel all debuffs on himself, ignore Taunt, and whenever he attacks out of turn, inflict Buff Immunity for 1 turn.

[c][e7e7e7]While in Territory Battles:[-][/c] At the start of each encounter Captain Tarpals gains 20% Offense for each active Gungan ally, and all Gungan allies gain Critical Damage Up for 2 turns and 100% Max Protection until the end of the encounter.

At the start of each Gungan ally's turn, they remove 1 stack of Recharge from the allied Shield Generator.

The first time each Gungan ally falls below 50% Health, they recover 100% Health and Protection. At the start of Captain Tarpals' turn, if he has more than 50% Max Protection all Gungans gain Offense Up for 2 turns, otherwise they gain Defense Up for 2 turns.

Whenever a Gungan ally is Dazed or Stunned they dispel it, reset their cooldowns, and gain a bonus turn. Whenever Captain Tarpals scores a critical hit add a stack of Plasma Shielding to the allied Shield Generator.

data.UNIQUEABILITY_DEDRAMEERO01_TIER_06_DESC:
At the start of battle, if all allies are ISB, Dedra gains 35% Tenacity and 50% Turn Meter.

Whenever other ISB allies trigger Expose on an enemy on their turn, Dedra Undermines that ISB ally for 1 turn. Additionally, if Dedra is Rank 3, whenever an ISB ally uses a Special ability against an enemy with Expose, they inflict Torture on the target enemy for 2 turns at the end of the turn, which can't be copied or dispelled. 

Whenever Dedra Undermines an ISB ally, she recovers 10% of her Max Health and gains Overconfident for 2 turns. Whenever an Undermined ISB ally takes a turn, she gains 10% Turn Meter. Whenever an ISB ally's Undermine debuff expires, they gain Overconfident for 2 turns. While Dedra has Overconfident, she is immune to Taunt effects.
data.UNIQUEABILITY_DEDRAMEERO01_TIER_07_DESC:
At the start of battle, if all allies are ISB, Dedra gains 35% Tenacity and 50% Turn Meter.

Additionally, if Dedra is Rank 3, whenever an ISB ally uses a Special ability against an enemy with Expose, they inflict Torture on the target enemy for 2 turns at the end of the turn, which can't be copied or dispelled. 

Whenever Dedra Undermines an ISB ally, she recovers 10% of her Max Health and gains Overconfident for 2 turns. Whenever an Undermined ISB ally takes a turn, she gains 10% Turn Meter. Whenever an ISB ally's Undermine debuff expires, they gain Overconfident for 2 turns. While Dedra has Overconfident, she is immune to Taunt effects.

[c][E7E7E7]While in 3v3 Grand Arenas:[-][/c] At the start of battle, Dedra Exposes all enemies for 2 turns and gains 30% Max Health. While ISB allies are Undermined, they have +80% Offense and Defense. When ISB allies gain Undermined, if they are already below 50% Health or drop below 50% Health (limit once per Undermined), they gain Protection Up and Tenacity Up (20%) until they are no longer Undermined. Whenever Dedra Undermines an ISB ally below 50% Health, she gains Potency Up for 2 turns.

This is a one-on-one duel with special mechanics.

Both you and your opponent first pick a duel ability and then use Saber Clash to resolve the effects of the duel round. The first to 3 duel points wins the bout and is given a chance to deal damage to the enemy with Saber Strike.

Defeat the enemy to win the duel.

Whenever Nest is damaged by an attack, she gains +20% Critical Chance and 30% Bonus Protection (stacking). This Bonus Protection increases by an additional 30% each time. Both bonuses expire and reset at the end of her next turn.

Whenever an enemy loses a buff or debuff, Nest gains +2% Critical Damage (stacking) until the end of the encounter.

Nest can't gain more than 5 stacks of Profit.

data.UNIQUEABILITY_EZRAEXILE01_DESC:
At the start of battle, all Light Side allies gain Foresight for 2 turns, all Spectre allies gain Tenacity Up for 2 turns, and Ezra is [c][ffff33]Exiled[-][/c] for the rest of battle, which can't be copied, dispelled, or resisted.

At the start of Ezra's turn, he gains 2 stacks of Resilient Defense (max 4).

The first time each ally is Exiled, they also gain 10% Critical Chance, 30% Defense, and 50% Max Health and Protection for the rest of battle.

The first time each ally loses Exile, they gain 10% Critical Chance, 30% Critical Damage, Offense, and Potency, and 10 Speed.

[c][ffff33]Exile:[-][/c] Can't attack, gain buffs, or gain other positive effects during another character's turn; Raid bosses and Galactic Legends instead can't gain buffs, and any characters who damage them gain Crit Damage Up and Health Steal Up for 1 turn

data.UNIQUEABILITY_HAXIONBOUNTYDROID01_DESC:
Haxion Brood Bounty Droid has 4 stacks of Cannon Fodder, 25% of its base Max Health and Max Protection, is immune to Max Health and Max Protection changes and can't be defeated or destroyed while it has more than one stack of Cannon Fodder.

If Haxion Brood Bounty Droid would be defeated while it has 2 or more stacks of Cannon Fodder, instead dispel all debuffs on it, reduce the number of Cannon Fodder stacks by 1 and recover 100% Health and Protection.

When all stacks of Cannon Fodder expire, Haxion Brood Bounty Droid is destroyed. They can't be revived or critically hit.

data.UNIQUEABILITY_HUNTERS301_TIER_07_DESC:
At the start of encounter, all Bad Batch allies gain 50% Max Protection. Whenever an enemy is Marked, all Bad Batch allies recover 7% Health. Whenever a Marked enemy is damaged by a Bad Batch ally, if the ally with lowest Turn Meter is Bad Batch, they gain Speed Up for 1 turn. Whenever Marked expires on an enemy, Daze them and inflict Healing Immunity for 1 turn. At the start of the Marked enemy's turn, inflict Offense Down on them for 1 turn, which can't be evaded. Whenever a Marked enemy is defeated, Expose all enemies for 2 turns and reduce the cooldown of This Will Hurt by 5.

If Hunter has 15 or more stacks of Target Practice, he gains a bonus turn when Marked expires on enemies. Whenever Hunter gains a stack of Target Practice, reduce the cooldown of This Will Hurt by 1. While a Bad Batch ally is Captive, Bad Batch allies deal an additional instance of damage to the target enemy on their turn. While Hunter has 40 or more stacks of Soldier of Fortune, enemies are inflicted with Buff Immunity for 1 turn whenever their buffs are dispelled. When a Bad Batch ally loses Captive, reset the cooldown of This Will Hurt.

[c][e7e7e7]While in Territory Wars:[-][/c] At the start of encounter Hunter has This Will Hurt available. When Hunter gains a stack of Target Practice, reduce This Will Hurt's cooldown by 5. If there are no Galactic Legends, while a Bad Batch ally is Captive, Bad Batch allies deal an additional instance of damage to the target enemy on their turn, which can't be evaded. Whenever a Marked enemy takes a turn, reduce their Max Health by 10% (stacking) until the end of the encounter (excludes Galactic Legends).

While Huyang has [c][ffff33]History of the Galaxy, Part Three:[-][/c] ally Jedi, any Ahsoka Tano, and Padawan Sabine Wren gain Force Connection whenever they use an ability until the first time Huyang is defeated

data.UNIQUEABILITY_JOCASTANU02_DESC:
When Jocasta Nu transforms, she loses the abilities By the Book, Shhh! Quiet!, and It Does Not Exist, and gains three new abilities.

[c][ffff33][Basic] It Belongs in a Museum:[-][/c] Deal Special damage to target enemy. If they had Defense Down or Tenacity Down, inflict that debuff on all enemies for 1 turn. Gain Critical Damage Up for 1 turn.

[c][ffff33]Zeta Upgrade:[-][/c] While she is Jocasta Nu (Rifle): If they had Defense Down, Expose, or Tenacity Down, inflict that debuff on all enemies for 1 turn, and she gains the opposite buff for 1 turn; if they had Vulnerable, deal additional damage based on 10% of her Max Protection then recover 25% Protection; gain 5 Siphon until the end of the encounter

[c][ffff33]Omicron Upgrade:[-][/c] [c][e7e7e7]While in Grand Arenas and she is Jocasta Nu (Rifle):[-][/c] On her turn, grant each Jedi Vanguard ally every dispellable buff she has for 1 turn

[c][ffff33][Special] My Turn:[-][/c] If all allies are Jedi Vanguard, dispel all buffs on all enemies. Deal Special damage to target enemy. Gain Speed Up for 1 turn.

[c][ffff33]Zeta Upgrade:[-][/c] While she is Jocasta Nu (Rifle): Deal bonus True damage equal to 100% of her current Protection to target enemy, which can't be evaded, then lose all current protection; Jocasta Nu Siphons Max Protection from the target enemy, which can't be resisted; If the target enemy is defeated by this ability, gain Max Protection equal to the target enemy's Max Protection; gain 100% bonus Protection for 1 turn

[c][ffff33]Omicron Upgrade:[-][/c] [c][e7e7e7]While in Grand Arenas, if all allies are Jedi Vanguard, and she is Jocasta Nu (Rifle):[-][/c] Dispel all debuffs on all allies; set the target enemy's Max Health to 65 (excluding Galactic Legends and Raid Bosses) until the start of their turn

[c][ffff33][Special] It's Up to You Now:[-][/c] Deal Special damage equal to 50% of Jocasta's Max Protection to all enemies. If any enemies are defeated, Jedi Vanguard allies recover 100% Health and Protection and all enemies are Breached for 2 turns, which can't be evaded or resisted.

data.UNIQUEABILITY_MARROK01_TIER_06_DESC:
At the start of battle, Marrok gains 30% Max Health and Max Protection, and 50% Potency.

At the start of his turn, Marrok inflicts Defense Down for 1 turn on a random enemy with Purge, which can't be resisted. Whenever another Mercenary ally uses a Special ability, Marrok will assist.

Whenever Marrok scores a critical hit, all Mercenary allies gain 5% Offense (stacking, max 100%) until the end of the encounter. Whenever an enemy resists a debuff from a Mercenary ally, all Mercenary allies gain 10% Turn Meter. Whenever another Mercenary ally uses an ability on their turn, inflict a stack of Purge on the target enemy, which can't be resisted. Whenever a Mercenary ally reaches 20% Health for the first time, they gain Damage Immunity for 1 turn.

While Marrok has 20 or more stacks of Soldier of Fortune, whenever he attacks out of turn, reduce the Offense of the target enemy by 20% until the end of their next turn. If Marrok has 40 or more stacks of Soldier of Fortune, whenever he attacks out of turn, apply additional 3 stacks of Purge on all enemies and using Desperate Getaway will Expose all enemies for 2 turns.
