data.NEWSLETTER_MAJOR_PARTAGAZ_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

[c][F0FF23]Major Partagaz[-][/c] is coming to the Holotables!

A rigorous ISB officer who commands through precision and doctrine, Major Partagaz believes that order and discipline are the foundation of power. His strategic brilliance and unwavering authority make him a formidable leader on the battlefield.

Major Partagaz is an ISB Tank who excels at coordinating his squad while systematically weakening enemies. His Basic ability, [c][F0FF23]Thesis Please[-][/c], inflicts Health Down and calls an ISB ally to assist with bonus damage scaling off his Rank. His Special ability, [c][F0FF23]Authority Is Brittle[-][/c], calls all ISB allies to assist and recover resources, applies Target Lock to all enemies if the squad is pure ISB, and grants his allies Retaliate and Rank-based buffs that persist for the rest of battle.

As a Leader, Major Partagaz's [c][F0FF23]Calibrate Your Enthusiasm[-][/c] establishes ISB dominance from the start. He inflicts Speed Down and Potency Down on all enemies, grants ISB allies massive stat bonuses that scale with Rank, and ensures they deal increased damage to Target Locked enemies while ignoring Taunt effects at Rank 3. In [c][F0FF23]Grand Arenas[-][/c], he begins at maximum Rank, and his allies gain repeated recovery windows when they fall below 30% Health.

His Unique ability, [c][F0FF23]Security is an Illusion[-][/c], makes him untargetable if his squad is pure ISB and steadily weakens all enemies' Potency through debuff application. Whenever enemies gain defensive buffs like Foresight or Stealth, he dispels them and Exposes the target with stacks equal to his Rank. He also generates Offense for all ISB allies at the start of each turn and can escape if he becomes the last combatant.

His Unique ability, [c][F0FF23]Chain of Command[-][/c], introduces a Rank system that empowers ISB allies. The squad starts at Rank 2 if pure ISB, and all ISB allies gain stacking counter chance whenever any ISB ally uses a Special ability. Each defeated enemy increases Rank, while each defeated ally decreases it.

Unlock [c][F0FF23]Major Partagaz[-][/c] in the upcoming [c][F0FF23]"The Doctrine of Precision"[-][/c] Marquee event that gives out daily rewards for the duration of the event! Major Partagaz is also one of the requirements (at 4 stars) to initially unlock the event for Cassian Andor (Undercover).

data.RED_WLSB_DARTHSIDIOUS_INFO:
[c][F0FF23]MERGE UNITS[-][/c]

Units included in the Lightspeed Bundle are upgraded according to a predetermined set of upgrade criteria (listed below). The Lightspeed Bundle does not directly grant character shards / ship blueprints or resources used in merge upgrades. The upgrade criteria are evaluated against your existing roster, and your units are set to the greater of the two values.

Each unit will first be evaluated for existing shards or star rarity against the bundle upgrade criteria. A unit at lower star rarity (or unactivated with less cumulative shards/blueprints) than the bundle upgrade criteria will be upgraded and activated. Units that exceed the star rarity (or cumulative shards/blueprints) will be activated (if unactivated) and then evaluated for additional attributes (gear tier, ability tier, etc). Any surplus shards/blueprints over the bundle upgrade criteria will be retained.

If your previously unlocked units meet or exceed the bundle upgrade criteria for other attributes, any surplus value will be retained.

- 5 Stars
- Level 1
- Ability Tier 1

data.NEWSLETTER_KX_SECURITY_DROID_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

[c][F0FF23]KX Security Droid[-][/c] is coming to the Holotables!

KX-series security droids serve as the Empire’s heavy enforcers, designed to impose order through strength and intimidation. These towering units execute Imperial directives without hesitation, acting as relentless guardians of ISB operations. 

[c][F0FF23]KX Security Droid[-][/c] joins the ISB as a Tank built around Overcharge and Rank mechanics, growing stronger as battle progresses while maintaining control of the battlefield. [c][F0FF23]Baton Deployed[-][/c] builds Overcharge and restores Health and Protection, converting full stacks into an unavoidable Shock. [c][F0FF23]Please Do Not Resist[-][/c] converts his defensive strength into Offense, strikes all enemies, and establishes control with Taunt and defensive buffs. [c][F0FF23]Controlled Operation[-][/c] increases his survivability as Overcharge builds, punishes enemies who critically hit him or defeat allies, and ties into ISB mechanics like Target Lock, Undermine, and Rank. Finally, [c][F0FF23]Chain of Command[-][/c] governs his Rank progression, rewarding him for maintaining Taunt and attacking out of turn with increased damage and counter attacks.

Unlock KX Security Droid in the upcoming [c][F0FF23]STILL RESISTING?[-][/c] Marquee event that [c][F0FF23]gives out daily rewards[-][/c] for the duration of the event! KX Security Droid is also a requirement (at 6 stars) to upgrade Cassian Andor (Undercover) to 6 Stars in his Journey Guide event.

data.TUSKEN_LIGHTSPEED_BUNDLE_II_INFO:
[c][F0FF23]MERGE UNITS[-][/c]

Units included in the Lightspeed Bundle are upgraded according to a predetermined set of upgrade criteria (listed below). The Lightspeed Bundle does not directly grant character shards / ship blueprints or resources used in merge upgrades. The upgrade criteria are evaluated against your existing roster, and your units are set to the greater of the two values.

Each unit will first be evaluated for existing shards or star rarity against the bundle upgrade criteria. A unit at lower star rarity (or unactivated with less cumulative shards/blueprints) than the bundle upgrade criteria will be upgraded and activated. Units that exceed the star rarity (or cumulative shards/blueprints) will be activated (if unactivated) and then evaluated for additional attributes (gear tier, ability tier, etc). Any surplus shards/blueprints over the bundle upgrade criteria will be retained.

If your previously unlocked units meet or exceed the bundle upgrade criteria for other attributes, any surplus value will be retained.

[b]CHARACTERS[/b]
- 7 Stars
- Level 85
- Relic 7
- Ability Tier 7

data.UNIQUEABILITY_COBBVANTH02_DESC_V2:
[c][ffff33]Deputize (Jawa):[-][/c] Recover 100% Health and Protection. Gain 25% Defense, Max Health, and Offense, 25 Speed, and the Constable tag for the rest of battle. Inflict a Thermal Detonator on all enemies for 2 turns.

At the start of a Constable ally's turn, if there is an active Jawa ally, inflict a Thermal Detonator on all enemies for 2 turns. Whenever a Thermal Detonator deals damage to an enemy, Constable allies recover 10% Health and gain 100% Offense for 1 turn. Enemies with a Thermal Detonator deal 25% less damage.

Limit one use per battle.

[c][ffff33]Deputize (Tusken):[-][/c] Recover 100% Health and Protection. Gain 25% Defense, Max Health, and Offense and 25 Speed, and the Constable tag for the rest of battle. The strongest enemy without Ambushed is Ambushed for the rest of the encounter, which can't be dispelled, evaded, or resisted.

All Constable allies gain 10 Momentum for 3 turns. Whenever a Constable ally is targeted by an enemy and they have at least 10 stacks of Momentum, consume all stacks of Momentum and Stun all attacking enemies for 1 turn, which can't be resisted.

Whenever Constable allies use an ability while they have at least 10 stacks of Momentum, deal bonus True damage equal to 25% of the target enemy's Max Health, then consume all stacks of Momentum. Constable allies gain 5 Momentum for 3 turns at the end of their turn if there is an active Tusken ally.

Limit one use per battle.

data.FTUE_TU40_CAMPAIGN_LIGHT_01: Time for your first real battle in our [c][f0ff23]LIGHT SIDE CAMPAIGN[-][/c]! Only Light Side characters can be used here. Go ahead and pick the first mission.
data.FTUE_TU40_CAMPAIGN_LIGHT_02: You'll pick units for your [c][f0ff23]SQUAD[-][/c] on this screen as your collection grows.\n\nBut enough talk! Let's [c][f0ff23]BATTLE[-][/c]!
data.FTUE_TU40_COMBAT_STATUS_EFFECTS_01: This character has a [c][f0ff23]STATUS EFFECT[-][/c]. You'll soon learn what the icons mean, but you can tap and hold on the icon for details.
data.FTUE_TU40_COMBAT_STATUS_EFFECTS_01_PC: This character has a [c][f0ff23]STATUS EFFECT[-][/c]. You'll soon learn what the icons mean, but you can click and hold on the icon for details.
data.FTUE_TU40_COMBAT_TOOLS_01: One must have mastery of their tools to attain victory!\n\nThis button adjusts [c][f0ff23]GAME SPEED[-][/c], which makes units animate more quickly without increasing the battle timer. A tactical benefit!
data.FTUE_TU40_COMBAT_TOOLS_02: If you are confident in your victory, this button activates [c][f0ff23]AUTO-BATTLE[-][/c]. Your units will act on their own, without your input. The settings menu has additional auto-battle options.
data.FTUE_TU40_COMBAT_TOOLS_03: This button collapses or expands the [c][f0ff23]STATUS EFFECT[-][/c] display over the heads of your units. You can also toggle icons for each individual unit by tapping them.
data.FTUE_TU40_COMBAT_TOOLS_03_PC: This button collapses or expands the [c][f0ff23]STATUS EFFECT[-][/c] display over the heads of your units. You can also toggle icons for each individual unit by clicking them.
data.FTUE_TU40_COMBAT_TOOLS_04: Finally, the [c][f0ff23]TURN ORDER[-][/c] tracker can show you which unit is going next in combat. Units that gain bonus [c][f0ff23]TURN METER[-][/c] can jump the line, though!
data.FTUE_TU40_CONQUEST_01: You've shown true skill, but are you ready for [c][f0ff23]CONQUEST[-][/c]? If you have it in you to push to the end, you will earn valuable [c][f0ff23]CONQUEST CRATES[-][/c].
data.FTUE_TU40_CONQUEST_DIFFICULTY_01: Prove your worth by completing easier difficulties before attempting harder ones! You can preview the challenges that await you before committing to a difficulty.
data.FTUE_TU40_CONQUEST_SECTORS_01: Here you can see the [c][f0ff23]SECTORS[-][/c] that unlock in sequence. Tap on the info button to see what awaits you, and once you're ready, [c][f0ff23]COMMIT[-][/c] to the challenge!
data.FTUE_TU40_CONQUEST_SECTORS_01_PC: Here you can see the [c][f0ff23]SECTORS[-][/c] that unlock in sequence. Click on the info button to see what awaits you, and once you're ready, [c][f0ff23]COMMIT[-][/c] to the challenge!
data.FTUE_TU40_DATACRONS_AFFIXES_MECHANICS_01: At last. Your first [c][f0ff23]BONUS MECHANIC[-][/c]. Note that these only affect units within a certain [c][f0ff23]SCOPE[-][/c]: Alignment, Faction, or possibly a single Character.
data.FTUE_TU40_DATACRONS_AFFIXES_MECHANICS_02: This Scope restricts what bonus mechanics are available at higher Levels.\n\nSelect this next level and I will demonstrate.
data.FTUE_TU40_DATACRONS_AFFIXES_MECHANICS_03: As you can see, the subsequent Scope has narrowed.\n\nMost Datacrons let you [c][f0ff23]RE-ROLL[-][/c] a bonus mechanic if the next one is not unlocked. I will demonstrate when you attempt it.
data.FTUE_TU40_DATACRONS_AFFIXES_STATS_01: Extraordinary.\n\nAttaching this Datacron to a squad applies this bonus stat to all characters in the squad, provided the [c][F0FF23]ENTIRE SQUAD[-][/c] satisfies its requirements.
data.FTUE_TU40_DATACRONS_AFFIXES_STATS_02: Upgrading Datacrons unlocks a range of bonus stats and bonus mechanics for your squad.\n\nTap here for information on this Datacron set.
data.FTUE_TU40_DATACRONS_AFFIXES_STATS_02_PC: Upgrading Datacrons unlocks a range of bonus stats and bonus mechanics for your squad.\n\nClick here for information on this Datacron set.
data.FTUE_TU40_DATACRONS_AFFIXES_STATS_03: Explore this screen for information on possible bonus mechanics. I can calculate millions of potential outcomes, but those listed here should be manageable for you.
data.FTUE_TU40_DATACRONS_ENEMY_SQUAD_01: It appears your opponent has a Datacron equipped. How exciting.
data.FTUE_TU40_DATACRONS_ENEMY_SQUAD_02: You can long press on an equipped Datacron to get more information about how it will affect the battle.\n\nI suggest taking extra care in this fight, but you do what you like.
data.FTUE_TU40_DATACRONS_INVENTORY_04: Use Datacrons to improve an entire squad with [c][F0FF23]BONUS STATS[-][/c] and [c][F0FF23]BONUS MECHANICS[-][/c]. We should examine the one you found.
data.FTUE_TU40_DATACRONS_INVENTORY_05: As I expected, you neglected to activate it. Upgrading Datacrons requires specific resources. [c][F0FF23]UNLOCK[-][/c] this one when you can. I will wait... patiently.
data.FTUE_TU40_DATACRONS_REROLLING_01: When re-rolling, select the bonus mechanic you want to use. The one on the left is always the one you had before, in case you dislike the other results.
data.FTUE_TU40_DATACRONS_REROLLING_02: Once a Datacron is [c][f0ff23]FULLY UPGRADED[-][/c], any level can be re-rolled. This includes [c][f0ff23]STAT BOOSTS[-][/c] as well as bonus mechanics.
data.FTUE_TU40_DATACRONS_UNLOCK_01: I see you've collected your first [c][F0FF23]DATACRON[/c][-][/c]. I admit that these are fascinating objects, but I expect you require instruction.
data.FTUE_TU40_ERA_INVENTORY_01: [c][f0ff23]ERAS[-][/c] are thematic celebrations of stories across the history of the galaxy, and where your real story begins! Your [c][f0ff23]ERA INVENTORY[-][/c] highlights new and upcoming units on the holotables in the current Era!
data.FTUE_TU40_ERA_LEVEL_01: While featured in an Era, your Era Units have a single [c][f0ff23]ERA LEVEL[-][/c] instead of separate level, gear, and ability upgrades. It is faster and easier to upgrade them using [c][f0ff23]ERA LEVEL MATERIALS[-][/c].
data.FTUE_TU40_ERA_LEVEL_02: When the Era ends, they move into your full collection while keeping any upgrades you've given them. It is efficient to take advantage of their time in the spotlight. I suppose you'll try your best.
data.FTUE_TU40_EVENTS_01: Welcome to the [c][f0ff23]EVENTS[-][/c] board! Limited-time engagements are posted here, offering valuable rewards.\n\nKeep an eye on their countdown timers!
data.FTUE_TU40_EVENTS_02: I have personally devised a number of [c][f0ff23]CHALLENGES[-][/c] that change the rules of engagement to put your full collection to the test.\n\nDon't worry, I'll go easy on you to start.
data.FTUE_TU40_GALACTIC_POWER_01: [c][f0ff23]GALACTIC POWER[-][/c] represents the total power of all characters and ships in your collection. Continue collecting and upgrading to increase it!
data.FTUE_TU40_GUILD_CREATION_01: Starting a new guild is a big responsibility, but if you'd like to, you can create one here. You can customize both how it appears to other players and any requirements to become a member.
data.FTUE_TU40_GUILD_CREATION_02: Your [c][f0ff23]GUILD NAME[-][/c] and [c][f0ff23]GUILD MESSAGE[-][/c] must be appropriate for all ages! I can tolerate the occasional bar fight, but not foul language!
data.FTUE_TU40_GUILD_EXCHANGE_01: The [c][f0ff23]GUILD EXCHANGE[-][/c] lets you see what gear requests have been made by other members of your guild. Donate to their requests here, or go to your Character Inventory to request your own.
data.FTUE_TU40_GUILD_GIFTING_01: From the Gifts tab, you can send gifts to your guild mates! It's a great way to build a community in your guild.
data.FTUE_TU40_GUILD_INVITE_ALLIES_01: These are your [c][f0ff23]ALLIES[-][/c]! Select one to [c][f0ff23]INVITE[-][/c] them to your guild.
data.FTUE_TU40_GUILD_MANAGEMENT_01: Here you can see your guild's [c][f0ff23]ROSTER[-][/c]. The Guild Leader and Officers can also manage the guild here. Tap on a Guild Member to view their profile.
data.FTUE_TU40_GUILD_MANAGEMENT_01_PC: Here you can see your guild's [c][f0ff23]ROSTER[-][/c]. The Guild Leader and Officers can also manage the guild here. Click on a Guild Member to view their profile.
data.FTUE_TU40_GUILD_MANAGEMENT_02: The Guild Leader has exclusive permission to [c][f0ff23]EDIT[-][/c] the Guild’s logo, message, and invite settings. Guild Officers and Members may only view this information.
data.FTUE_TU40_GUILD_MANAGEMENT_OFFICERS_01: Here you can see your guild's [c][f0ff23]ROSTER[-][/c]. Tap on a Guild Member to view their profile, where you can also [c][f0ff23]PROMOTE[-][/c], [c][f0ff23]DEMOTE[-][/c], or [c][f0ff23]REMOVE[-][/c] them from the Guild.
data.FTUE_TU40_GUILD_MANAGEMENT_OFFICERS_01_P: Here you can see your guild's [c][f0ff23]ROSTER[-][/c]. Click on a Guild Member to view their profile, where you can also [c][f0ff23]PROMOTE[-][/c], [c][f0ff23]DEMOTE[-][/c], or [c][f0ff23]REMOVE[-][/c] them from the Guild.
data.FTUE_TU40_GUILD_MANAGEMENT_STARTER_01: Here you can see your guild's [c][f0ff23]ROSTER[-][/c]. Tap on a Guild Member to view their profile.
data.FTUE_TU40_GUILD_MANAGEMENT_STARTER_01_PC: Here you can see your guild's [c][f0ff23]ROSTER[-][/c]. Click on a Guild Member to view their profile.
data.FTUE_TU40_GUILD_RECOMMENDATIONS_01: This is a list of guilds that are [c][f0ff23]ACTIVELY RECRUITING[-][/c] new players. You can [c][f0ff23]JOIN[-][/c] any of these, but if none interest you, the [c][f0ff23]REFRESH[-][/c] button will give you more suggestions.
data.FTUE_TU40_GUILD_SEARCH_01: This is [c][f0ff23]GUILD SEARCH[-][/c] where you can look for different guilds to join!\n\nGuilds that will be a good match for you are automatically surfaced here.
data.FTUE_TU40_GUILD_SEARCH_02: You can [c][f0ff23]JOIN[-][/c] them or [c][f0ff23]REQUEST AN INVITE[-][/c] from this screen.\n\nYou can also look for guilds by name or use [c][f0ff23]ADVANCED SEARCH[-][/c] to find guilds that meet your desired criteria.
data.FTUE_TU40_GUILD_STARTER_01: For now, I put you in our [c][f0ff23]STARTER GUILD[-][/c], called [c][f0ff23]MURDER OF PORGS[-][/c], but this is just to get you going. You should join a real guild as soon as you can!
data.FTUE_TU40_GUILD_UNLOCK_01: You're ready to join a [c][f0ff23]GUILD[-][/c]! That's where you can team up with other players to fight in [c][f0ff23]RAIDS[-][/c] or massive [c][f0ff23]TERRITORY BATTLES[-][/c], and battle other guilds in [c][f0ff23]TERRITORY WARS[-][/c].
data.FTUE_TU40_HYPERDRIVE_BUNDLE_01: Nice move getting the Hyperdrive Bundle! There are some extra Journey Quests waiting for you to help set you up for more success!
data.FTUE_TU40_JOURNEY_QUESTS_00: Our Holotable system includes [c][f0ff23]QUESTS[-][/c] that will help get you get up and running.\n\nLet's look at your first one.
data.FTUE_TU40_LEADER_ABILITIES_01: Ah, you have a character with a [c][f0ff23]LEADER ABILITY[-][/c] in the first slot, or [c][f0ff23]LEADER SLOT[-][/c]. How clever. They grant bonuses to the others in the squad.
data.FTUE_TU40_LEADER_ABILITIES_02: This icon shows which characters in your squad benefit from the Leader ability, and by how much. Ideally, the circle is full, representing full benefits.
data.FTUE_TU40_MOD_BATCH_MANAGEMENT_01: [c][f0ff23]BATCH MANAGE[-][/c] allows you to sell and upgrade many mods all at once. Use a saved filter to speed up your mod workflow.
data.FTUE_TU40_MOD_BATCH_UPGRADING_01: [c][f0ff23]REVEAL ALL SECONDARY STATS[-][/c] automatically upgrades mods to the minimum level with all four secondary stats revealed. This is useful when upgrading multiple mods of different rarities.
data.FTUE_TU40_MOD_BATTLES_01: You're ready for [c][f0ff23]MOD BATTLES[-][/c], I see. Spend your daily [c][f0ff23]MOD ENERGY[-][/c] here to earn [c][f0ff23]MODS[-][/c], which are critical to character power.
data.FTUE_TU40_MOD_BATTLES_02: Might as well see how you do. If you can handle this battle, you'll earn your first Mod.
data.FTUE_TU40_MOD_ENHANCEMENT_01: [c][f0ff23]ENHANCE MOD[-][/c] allows you to upgrade, slice, calibrate, and sell an individual mod all in one convenient location.\n\nStars forbid that anything be inconvenient for you.
data.FTUE_TU40_MOD_ENHANCEMENT_SLICING_01: Slicing a mod always makes it stronger, but details matter. Each secondary stat is visualized here. The bigger the bar, the closer the stat is to its maximum possible value.
data.FTUE_TU40_MOD_ENHANCEMENT_SLICING_02: Additionally, [c][f0ff23]SLICE QUALITY[-][/c] averages a secondary stat's slices into a percentage value. A higher value means the stat is closer to peak performance.
data.FTUE_TU40_MOD_FILTERS_01: Mod Filters help you find mods that meet your exact stat and attribute needs. Filter for mods with specific stats, with all secondary stats revealed, or with a preferred slice count or slice quality.
data.FTUE_TU40_MOD_FILTERS_02: Additionally, you can save mod filters, so you can quickly retrieve mods when equipping, selling, or upgrading.\n\nIt didn't used to be this way. You have it easy.
data.FTUE_TU40_MOD_INVENTORY_01: Well, that was a surprise. You just earned a [c][f0ff23]MOD[-][/c]. You should probably put it on a character.
data.FTUE_TU40_MOD_INVENTORY_02: Characters must be level 50 or higher to use Mods. Tap here to see if you've managed to get any eligible ones.
data.FTUE_TU40_MOD_INVENTORY_02_PC: Characters must be level 50 or higher to use Mods. Click here to see if you've managed to get any eligible ones.
data.FTUE_TU40_MOD_INVENTORY_03: You continue to outpace my low expectations. Let's assign the Mod you just earned to this character.
data.FTUE_TU40_MOD_INVENTORY_04: Every character has 6 Mod slots that require Mods of the same shape. I assume you can at least remember shapes?\n\nLet's assign this one now.
data.FTUE_TU40_MOD_INVENTORY_05: Now tap here to select the correct Mod.\n\nI hope I will not have to hold your hand next time.
data.FTUE_TU40_MOD_INVENTORY_05_PC: Now click here to select the correct Mod.\n\nI hope I will not have to hold your hand next time.
data.FTUE_TU40_MOD_REROLLING_01: [c][f0ff23]MOD CALIBRATION[-][/c] lets you re-attempt slicing a Mod's secondary stats. Start by selecting a stat for removal. Obviously you should choose a stat you don't want.
data.FTUE_TU40_MOD_REROLLING_02: Calibration removes a random slice from your selected stat and applies it to a new random stat. It is a volatile process, and may re-select the same stat.\n\nWith a stat selected, tap here.
data.FTUE_TU40_MOD_REROLLING_02_PC: Calibration removes a random slice from your selected stat and applies it to a new random stat. It is a volatile process, and may re-select the same stat.\n\nWith a stat selected, click here.
data.FTUE_TU40_MOD_REROLLING_03: The process also requires [c][f0ff23]MICRO ATTENUATORS[-][/c], and there is a limit on how many times a Mod can be calibrated. This limit increases by slicing the Mod.
data.FTUE_TU40_MOD_SETS_01: Somehow you've managed to complete your first [c][f0ff23]MOD SET[-][/c]. Complete sets provide significant boosts to character stats.
data.FTUE_TU40_MOD_SETS_02: Some sets require 2 Mods while others need 4. Set bonuses increase when Mods are upgraded to level 15, and they stack, so 3 of the same set provides 3x the bonus. Understand? Good.
data.FTUE_TU40_MOD_SLICING_01: [c][f0ff23]MOD SLICING[-][/c] is a useful method of increasing the stats of your Mods at the cost of Credits and Mod Salvage.
data.FTUE_TU40_MOD_SLICING_02: When you [c][f0ff23]SLICE[-][/c] a Mod, it increases its tier and one of its secondary stat rolls. Each secondary stat has a maximum of 5 rolls.
data.FTUE_TU40_MOD_SLICING_03: When you slice a Tier A mod--yes, those are the yellow ones, good for you--it will become a golden Tier E mod, increasing all of its stats.
data.FTUE_TU40_MOD_UNLOCK_01: You unlocked [c][f0ff23]MODS[-][/c]! "Bev" will meet you at the [c][f0ff23]MOD BATTLES CAMPAIGN[-][/c] to tell you about them.
data.FTUE_TU40_MOD_UPGRADES_01: [c][f0ff23]UPGRADE[-][/c] a Mod to increase its [c][f0ff23]PRIMARY STAT[-][/c]. Every 3 levels, it will instead gain a new [c][f0ff23]SECONDARY STAT[-][/c] or increase an existing one.
data.FTUE_TU40_MOD_VIEWS_ADVANCED_01: Here you can see your Mods with more detail. Tap a Mod to view its stats.
data.FTUE_TU40_MOD_VIEWS_ADVANCED_01_PC: Here you can see your Mods with more detail. Click a Mod to view its stats.
data.FTUE_TU40_MOD_VIEWS_ADVANCED_02: Now tap a Mod in your inventory to compare their stats on the right. I expect even you can succeed at this.
data.FTUE_TU40_MOD_VIEWS_ADVANCED_02_PC: Now click a Mod in your inventory to compare their stats on the right. I expect even you can succeed at this.
data.FTUE_TU40_MOD_VIEWS_ADVANCED_03: In Advanced view you can also peruse your entire Mod inventory and use filters to find specific Mods.
data.FTUE_TU40_MOD_VIEWS_ADVANCED_04: Assigning a Mod to an empty slot is a trivial task for me.\n\nRemoving one is more difficult, requiring [c][f0ff23]CREDITS[-][/c] before it can be reassigned.
data.FTUE_TU40_MOD_VIEWS_ADVANCED_05: Mods are earned throughout the Cantina, but primarily in [c][f0ff23]MOD BATTLES[-][/c]. I suggest you get more, but I'm only the foremost expert on these things.
data.FTUE_TU40_MOD_VIEWS_BASIC_01: There are two ways to view a character's mods: [c][f0ff23]BASIC[-][/c] view and [c][f0ff23]ADVANCED[-][/c] view.
data.FTUE_TU40_MOD_VIEWS_BASIC_02: Basic view suggests [c][f0ff23]MOD SETS[-][/c] that are likely to be useful on a character. You can quickly assign Mods this way, but these are only suggestions.
data.FTUE_TU40_MOD_VIEWS_BASIC_03: If you're capable of thinking for yourself, you can switch to the [c][f0ff23]ADVANCED[-][/c] view.
data.FTUE_TU40_QUESTREMINDER_EULA_01: Hey there, wondering what to do next? Keep checking your [c][f0ff23]QUESTS[-][/c]!\n\nBy the way, if you plan to order anything, I need to check your identicard...
data.FTUE_TU40_RAIDS_DETAILS_01: Once you [c][f0ff23]START A RAID[-][/c], each Guild Member joins in the fight.\n\nNon-Heroic Tiers have a 3-day [c][f0ff23]TIME LIMIT[-][/c] and characters who are defeated in battle are refreshed the next day.
data.FTUE_TU40_RAIDS_DETAILS_STARTER_01: Unlock new raids by joining a player-run guild, and graduate from your Starter Guild. New raids are more challenging, and provide more valuable rewards!
data.FTUE_TU40_RAIDS_NONLEGACY_UNLOCK_01: Ah, your Guild has unlocked Raids beyond the Sith Triumvirate! These Raids limit the allowed units and number of submitted attempts, which do not refresh each day.
data.FTUE_TU40_RAIDS_NONLEGACY_UNLOCK_02: The Raid Points you earn are added to both a [c][f0ff23]GUILD REWARDS[-][/c] track and a [c][f0ff23]PERSONAL REWARDS[-][/c] track. Guild Rewards are granted to all participants at the end of the Raid. Personal Rewards are yours alone, and can be claimed right away!
data.FTUE_TU40_RAIDS_NONLEGACY_UNLOCK_03: Attempting higher [c][f0ff23]DIFFICULTY LEVELS[-][/c] is the best way to earn more points! They add new [c][f0ff23]MODIFIERS[-][/c] to combat and a [c][f0ff23]MULTIPLIER[-][/c] to the points you earn, as well as increasing the [c][f0ff23]MAXIMUM[-][/c] number of points you can earn in an attempt.
data.FTUE_TU40_RAIDS_NONLEGACY_UNLOCK_04: You can choose the Difficulty Level you want with each attempt you make. However, there are requirements that every unit in your squad must satisfy to attempt that Difficulty Level.
data.FTUE_TU40_RAIDS_OFFICERS_02: Only a Guild Leader or Officer can use Raid Tickets to start a Raid. Once a Raid starts, each Guild Member joins automatically. Schedule Raids to be started automatically by using [c][f0ff23]RAID SETTINGS[-][/c]!
data.FTUE_TU40_RAIDS_UNLOCK_01: Welcome to [c][f0ff23]GUILD RAIDS[-][/c]!\n\nThese Raids require every player in the Guild to [c][f0ff23]WORK TOGETHER[-][/c] in order to attain victory against enemies like the flesh-eating [c][f0ff23]RANCOR[-][/c].
data.FTUE_TU40_RAIDS_UNLOCK_02: Spend [c][f0ff23]600 TOTAL ENERGY[-][/c] to earn 600 Raid Tickets [c][f0ff23]EVERY DAY[-][/c]. These Tickets are used to start Raids. More Tickets means more Raids!
data.FTUE_TU40_SCAVENGER_02: [c]"Hey there! The name's Rillik, nice to meetcha. (Not "that rude little Jawa," Bev!) You've got a bantha-load of spare gear there. I'll smash any piece you don't want for scrap."[/c]
data.FTUE_TU40_SCAVENGER_03: [c]"That's a good start, but we'll need more to get anything done here. Tap the quantity button to increase how many you grab at once."[/c]
data.FTUE_TU40_SCAVENGER_03_PC: [c]"That's a good start, but we'll need more to get anything done here. Click the quantity button to increase how many you grab at once."[/c]
data.FTUE_TU40_SHARD_SHOP_01: Fey requested that I attempt enthusiasm. One of your units has reached 7 Stars. You may now access the [c][f0ff23]SHARD STORE[-][/c], where extra unit shards are converted into [c][f0ff23]SHARD STORE TOKENS[-][/c]. Hooray.
data.FTUE_TU40_SHIP_ACTIVATE_NO_PILOT_01: I am admittedly impressed that you have collected enough [c][f0ff23]BLUEPRINTS[-][/c] to activate a [c][f0ff23]SHIP[-][/c].
data.FTUE_TU40_SHIP_ACTIVATE_NO_PILOT_02: Of course, this ship's [c][f0ff23]CREW[-][/c] is not activated yet. Typical. Go and do that first, and then return.
data.FTUE_TU40_SHIP_ACTIVATE_NO_PILOT_03: Now that the crew is activated, let's [c][f0ff23]ACTIVATE[-][/c] your new [c][f0ff23]SHIP[-][/c], and I can be done here.
data.FTUE_TU40_SHIP_ACTIVATE_WITH_PILOT_01: I am admittedly impressed that you have collected enough [c][f0ff23]BLUEPRINTS[-][/c] to activate a [c][f0ff23]SHIP[-][/c]. Let us do that now, and I can be done here.
data.FTUE_TU40_SHIP_ARENA_01: [c][f0ff23]FLEET ARENA[-][/c] is where you test your Ships against other players. As with Squad Arena, you will earn rewards in your Inbox every day based on your Fleet Arena rank!
data.FTUE_TU40_SHIP_CAMPAIGN_01: The [c][f0ff23]FLEET BATTLES[-][/c] campaign is open! Use your ships in a series of battles to earn rewards like ship ability materials and unit shards exclusive to this campaign.
data.FTUE_TU40_SHIP_CHALLENGES_01: The [c][f0ff23]SHIP CHALLENGES[-][/c] I've devised give rewards to improve your ships, along with character and ship ability materials. Be sure to complete them along with your other challenges each day!
data.FTUE_TU40_SHIP_COMBAT_REINFORCEMENTS_01: [c][f0ff23]CALLING REINFORCEMENTS[-][/c] from your Capital Ship is like any other ability, though it usually begins on cooldown. Select a [c][f0ff23]SHIP[-][/c] to reinforce the battle!
data.FTUE_TU40_SHIP_COMBAT_REINFORCEMENTS_02: All ships trigger their [c][F0FF23]REINFORCEMENT ABILITY[-][/c] when they reinforce the battle. Here you can call in [c][F0FF23]SLAVE 1[-][/c], and the feared bounty hunter Boba Fett will join the battle!
data.FTUE_TU40_SHIP_COMBAT_TARGET_LOCK_01: This ship is [c][f0ff23]TARGET LOCKED[-][/c], making it more susceptible to attacks. Some abilities gain bonuses against Target-Locked ships.
data.FTUE_TU40_SHIP_INVENTORY_01: While you haven't unlocked [c][f0ff23]FLEET BATTLES[-][/c] yet, some of the characters you've been collecting act as [c][f0ff23]CREW[-][/c] on the [c][f0ff23]SHIPS[-][/c] you will use!
data.FTUE_TU40_SHIP_LOANER_COMBAT_01: Winning a [c][f0ff23]FLEET BATTLE[-][/c] requires destroying all active enemy [c][f0ff23]SHIPS[-][/c] with the exception of the enemy's unstoppable [c][f0ff23]CAPITAL SHIP[-][/c].
data.FTUE_TU40_SHIP_LOANER_COMBAT_02: Capital Ships have a massive influence on the course of battle. Use a [c][f0ff23]CAPITAL SHIP ABILITY[-][/c] to aid an ally [c][f0ff23]SHIP[-][/c] now!
data.FTUE_TU40_SHIP_LOANER_COMBAT_03: Tap on an ally [c][f0ff23]SHIP[-][/c] to use this ability.
data.FTUE_TU40_SHIP_LOANER_COMBAT_03_PC: Click on an ally [c][f0ff23]SHIP[-][/c] to use this ability.
data.FTUE_TU40_SHIP_LOANER_COMBAT_04: Now is the time to strike! Use Defiant Volley to finish them!
data.FTUE_TU40_SHIP_LOANER_INTRO_01: I believe you're ready to dip your S-foils into [c][f0ff23]FLEET BATTLES[-][/c]. I have a few [c][f0ff23]SHIPS[-][/c] of my own that I can lend you until your own are up and running.
data.FTUE_TU40_SHIP_TRAINING_EVENTS_01: [c][f0ff23]FLEET COMMANDER TRAINING[-][/c] events help you earn [c][f0ff23]SHIPS[-][/c] and their [c][f0ff23]CREW[-][/c] in preparation for [c][f0ff23]FLEET BATTLES[-][/c]. There are multiple tiers, so keep checking back as you unlock new ones.
data.FTUE_TU40_SHIP_UNLOCK_01: You've excelled in [c][f0ff23]FLEET COMMANDER TRAINING[-][/c], and you're fully prepared for [c][f0ff23]FLEET BATTLES[-][/c]. New Fleet options are available at the [c][f0ff23]CAMPAIGNS[-][/c], [c][f0ff23]EVENTS[-][/c], and [c][f0ff23]ARENA[-][/c] tables.
data.FTUE_TU40_SHIP_UNLOCK_02: I've spoken with Fey, and she's agreed to give you a [c][f0ff23]SHIP POWER UP PACK[-][/c] to help you get started. Bev didn't think you deserved it, but I never listen to her.
data.FTUE_TU40_SHIP_UNLOCK_03: This pack contains materials to help you enhance your [c][f0ff23]SHIPS[-][/c].
data.FTUE_TU40_SHIP_UNLOCK_04: Now you'll be ready to power up your new [c][f0ff23]FLEETS[-][/c].
data.FTUE_TU40_SIM_TICKETS_01: I should introduce you to Shar. He takes care of rowdy customers for me, but he's also a strategic genius on the holotables! I'll let him tell you about [c][f0ff23]SIM TICKETS[-][/c].
data.FTUE_TU40_SIM_TICKETS_02: It is an honor to meet a new friend of Fey's. You are showing real potential on the holotables by earning a [c][f0ff23]3-STAR VICTORY[-][/c].
data.FTUE_TU40_SIM_TICKETS_03: Use Sim Tickets on any 3-starred battle to instantly replay it and earn rewards! However, you must still spend Energy to sim a battle. Why don't you try it now?
data.FTUE_TU40_SQUAD_ARENA_01: Oho! You unlocked the [c][f0ff23]SQUAD ARENA[-][/c]! It appears it is time for you to face some real opponents!
data.FTUE_TU40_SQUAD_ARENA_02: Do well here to earn [c][f0ff23]SQUAD ARENA TOKENS[-][/c] sent to your inbox every day. Spend your winnings in the [c][f0ff23]ARENA STORE[-][/c]! Good luck!
data.FTUE_TU40_SQUAD_INVENTORY_01: Save squads to your [c][f0ff23]SQUAD INVENTORY[-][/c] to organize them and access them easily. There are recommended squads for events or unit unlocks. Your biological memory needs all the help it can get.
data.FTUE_TU40_SQUAD_SUGGESTIONS_01: As you require direction, [c][f0ff23]SQUAD SUGGESTIONS[-][/c] display allies that synergize with this character. You may also [c][f0ff23]COPY[-][/c] these squads to your own squad list.
data.FTUE_TU40_TB_DEPLOYING_01: Most phases have multiple territories. During each phase, each unit can only be deployed to [c][f0ff23]1 TERRITORY[-][/c] at a time!
data.FTUE_TU40_TB_DEPLOYING_02: Let's [c][f0ff23]SELECT ALL[-][/c] your available units for the moment, although it's best to not deploy units until you have attempted all of the missions that you can in each phase.
data.FTUE_TU40_TB_DEPLOYING_03: Deployed units grant [c][f0ff23]TERRITORY POINTS[-][/c] equal to their [c][f0ff23]GALACTIC POWER[-][/c], but once deployed to a Territory they can only be used in that Territory until the next phase.
data.FTUE_TU40_TB_GUILD_SCREEN_01: Are you ready for your first [c][f0ff23]TERRITORY BATTLE[-][/c]? Your guild must work together to push as far as you can, earning [c][f0ff23]EQUAL REWARDS[-][/c] for all guild members.
data.FTUE_TU40_TB_MAP_01: The currently active Territories in this phase are higlighted.\n\nTap to [c][f0ff23]SELECT A TERRITORY[-][/c].
data.FTUE_TU40_TB_MAP_01_PC: The currently active Territories in this phase are higlighted. Click to [c][f0ff23]SELECT A TERRITORY[-][/c].
data.FTUE_TU40_TB_MAP_02: Complete [c][f0ff23]MISSIONS[-][/c] and [c][f0ff23]DEPLOY UNITS[-][/c] to a Territory to earn [c][f0ff23]TERRITORY POINTS[-][/c] for your guild. Each Territory displays your Guild's activity and progress.
data.FTUE_TU40_TB_MAP_03: Acquiring Territory Points earns [c][f0ff23]STARS[-][/c]. Your guild must earn at least [c][f0ff23]1 STAR[-][/c] in a Territory to progress to the next one, and can earn up to [c][f0ff23]3 STARS[-][/c] in each Territory per phase.
data.FTUE_TU40_TB_MISSIONS_01: In [c][f0ff23]COMBAT MISSIONS[-][/c] you face multiple waves of enemies, earning Territory Points for each completed wave. You get only [c][f0ff23]ONE ATTEMPT[-][/c] on each mission per phase, so choose your units wisely!
data.FTUE_TU40_TB_MISSIONS_SPECIAL_01: [c][f0ff23]SPECIAL MISSIONS[-][/c] are similar to Combat Missions, but allow only one attempt per Territory Battle. They don't refresh in the next phase even if your guild remains in the same Territory.
data.FTUE_TU40_TB_MISSIONS_SPECIAL_02: Instead of Territory Points, you can earn rewards for your entire guild like [c][f0ff23]GUILD EVENT TOKENS[-][/c] or shards for [c][f0ff23]EXCLUSIVE CHARACTERS[-][/c].
data.FTUE_TU40_TB_PLATOONS_01: Completing [c][f0ff23]PLATOONS[-][/c] can improve your odds of victory in missions. They require specific units with [c][f0ff23]MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS[-][/c]. Each player may deploy up to [c][f0ff23]10 UNITS[-][/c] from their roster in each one.
data.FTUE_TU40_TB_STATS_01: Succeed or fail as a guild! Equal rewards are given to all who participated. It's easy to see everyone's [c][f0ff23]STATS[-][/c], so everyone is accountable!
data.FTUE_TU40_TB_SUMMARY_01: [c][f0ff23]TERRITORY BATTLES[-][/c] run for [c][f0ff23]6 DAYS[-][/c] and have [c][f0ff23]MULTIPLE PHASES[-][/c] to complete.\n\nEvery character and ship in your roster is key to your victory!
data.FTUE_TU40_TB_TIMER_01: Each phase has a [c][f0ff23]TIME LIMIT[-][/c]. Your units are [c][f0ff23]REFRESHED[-][/c] when the phase starts. Your guild continues fighting in any Territory where no Star was earned in the previous phase.
data.FTUE_TU40_TB_UNLOCK_01: You are now eligible for [c][f0ff23]TERRITORY BATTLES[-][/c], a cooperative mode where your guild battles through multiple phases of challenging enemies to earn [c][f0ff23]EQUAL REWARDS[-][/c] for all guild members!
data.FTUE_TU40_TRAINING_DROID_01: Nice work! You got a [c][f0ff23]TRAINING DROID[-][/c], used to upgrade your characters.\n\nOur droid expert, "Bev," will help you out with that.
data.FTUE_TU40_TW_ENEMY_DEFENSES_01: Command your units to [c][f0ff23]ATTACK[-][/c] here. Once a unit is used to attack, it can't be used elsewhere for the rest of the Territory War, so [c][f0ff23]CHOOSE WISELY[-][/c]!
data.FTUE_TU40_TW_ENEMY_DEFENSES_02: Successful attacks earn [c][f0ff23]BANNERS[-][/c]. [c][f0ff23]CONQUERING[-][/c] a Territory completely earns a large amount of banners for your guild.
data.FTUE_TU40_TW_ENEMY_DEFENSES_03: Ah, the front lines. Sometimes I miss them. Select an enemy squad to attack! Good luck, and [c][f0ff23]MAY THE FORCE BE WITH YOU[-][/c]!
data.FTUE_TU40_TW_PHASE_ATTACK_01: The [c][f0ff23]ATTACK PHASE[-][/c] has begun!\n\nIt's time to go on the offensive!
data.FTUE_TU40_TW_PHASE_PREVIEW_01: Behold the [c][f0ff23]TERRITORY WAR[-][/c] holo-battlefield. This is where you and your guild will take on opposing guilds!
data.FTUE_TU40_TW_PHASE_PREVIEW_02: [c][f0ff23]DEFEND[-][/c] your guild's [c][4286f4]BLUE TERRITORIES[-][/c] on the left.
data.FTUE_TU40_TW_PHASE_PREVIEW_03: [c][f0ff23]ATTACK[-][/c] your opponent's [c][f44256]RED TERRITORIES[-][/c] on the right. Turn the opposing guild into Bantha fodder!
data.FTUE_TU40_TW_PHASE_PREVIEW_04: Use the [c][f0ff23]PREVIEW PHASE[-][/c] to coordinate battle strategy with your guild. Once you join, your roster is [c][f0ff23]LOCKED[-][/c], but you can leave and re-join to [c][f0ff23]UPDATE[-][/c] your roster with any changes.
data.FTUE_TU40_TW_PHASE_SETUP_01: The [c][f0ff23]SETUP PHASE[-][/c] has begun!\n\nAssemble [c][f0ff23]DEFENSES[-][/c] on your guild's Territories!
data.FTUE_TU40_TW_PHASE_SETUP_02: Tap a Territory to [c][f0ff23]DEFEND[-][/c]!\n\nDefenses can only be set during the Setup Phase.
data.FTUE_TU40_TW_PHASE_SETUP_02_PC: Click a Territory to [c][f0ff23]DEFEND[-][/c]!\n\nDefenses can only be set during the Setup Phase.
data.FTUE_TU40_TW_SET_DEFENSES_01: Command your units to [c][f0ff23]DEFEND[-][/c] here. Once a unit is placed on defense, it can't be used elsewhere for the rest of the Territory War, so [c][f0ff23]CHOOSE WISELY[-][/c]!
data.FTUE_TU40_TW_UNLOCK_01: The time has come for you to join your guild in [c][f0ff23]TERRITORY WARS[-][/c]! Fight an epic battle against an opposing guild for phenomenal [c][f0ff23]RARE REWARDS[-][/c].
data.FTUE_TU40_UNIT_TRAINING_01: I suppose I must suffer through explaining unit upgrades to another new arrival. Very well. I am B7-N5, or as Fey calls me, "Bev."
data.FTUE_TU40_UNIT_TRAINING_02: Fey tells me you recovered a [c][f0ff23]TRAINING DROID[-][/c] from your first holotable battle. Let's use it now to increase this character's level.
data.FTUE_TU40_UNIT_TRAINING_03: Tap the plus sign to train this character to Level 2. Training costs Credits, and Training Droids are assigned automatically.
data.FTUE_TU40_UNIT_TRAINING_03_PC: Click the plus sign to train this character to Level 2. Training costs Credits, and Training Droids are assigned automatically.
data.FTUE_TU40_UNIT_TRAINING_04: Tap here to finish this upgrade. Don't think about it too hard.
data.FTUE_TU40_UNIT_TRAINING_04_PC: Click here to finish this upgrade. Don't think about it too hard.
data.FTUE_TU40_UNIT_TRAINING_05: Somehow you've acquired enough Credits and [c][f0ff23]ABILITY MATERIALS[-][/c] to upgrade this character's ability. Please do it yourself and spare my circuits the effort.
data.FTUE_TU40_UNIT_TRAINING_06: Characters require [c][f0ff23]GEAR[-][/c] upgrades to increase their power. This green plus icon indicates you have gear to equip. I should think that is obvious.
data.FTUE_TU40_UNIT_TRAINING_07: You have enough character shards to [c][f0ff23]PROMOTE[-][/c] this character to a new Star level.\n\nI do hope you can take it from here.
data.FTUE_TU40_WELCOME_01: Welcome to [c][f0ff23]FEY'S CANTINA[-][/c]! That is to say: my cantina. The name's Fey Zara. I own the place and work behind the bar.
data.FTUE_TU40_WELCOME_RETURNING_PLAYER_01: Hey there! We just reopened after renovations. How do you like the new look? Also, I finally had enough of that trash-talking Hutt. He still hangs around, but I revoked his holotable privileges. My bar, my rules!

data.MISSION_TU40_CANTINABATTLE_1A_DESC: A former Jedi seeks refuge after he is discovered by the Inquisitorius.
data.MISSION_TU40_CANTINABATTLE_1B_DESC: The unrelenting Second Sister hunts a rogue Force user through an Imperial excavation.
data.MISSION_TU40_CANTINABATTLE_1C_DESC: One of the last surviving Nightsisters animates an army of zombies against interlopers.
data.MISSION_TU40_CANTINABATTLE_1D_DESC: A fallen Jedi seeks ancient knowledge in the tomb of a Zeffo Sage.
data.MISSION_TU40_CANTINABATTLE_1E_DESC: The Wookiee chieftain Tarfful assists Rebel partisans in the defense of his homeworld.
data.MISSION_TU40_CANTINABATTLE_1F_DESC: The Ninth Sister leads the Imperial forces from their enormous refinery complex.
data.MISSION_TU40_CANTINABATTLE_1G_DESC: Darth Vader tears through Fortress Inquisitorius in pursuit of infiltrating Jedi.
data.MISSION_TU40_CANTINABATTLE_2A_DESC: The streets of the Corellian underworld are an especially difficult place to grow up.
data.MISSION_TU40_CANTINABATTLE_2B_DESC: Imperial forces hunt down and arrest scoundrels and lawbreakers.
data.MISSION_TU40_CANTINABATTLE_2C_DESC: The Empire transports a valuable shipment of coaxium through the icy mountains.
data.MISSION_TU40_CANTINABATTLE_2D_DESC: Imperial shipping routes are under constant threat of pirate raids.
data.MISSION_TU40_CANTINABATTLE_2E_DESC: Scoundrels meet to carouse and play sabacc at Fort Ypso.
data.MISSION_TU40_CANTINABATTLE_2F_DESC: The Pyke Cartel maintains a controlling interest in the spice industry.
data.MISSION_TU40_CANTINABATTLE_2G_DESC: A droid uprising in the mines acts as cover for a daring heist.
data.MISSION_TU40_CANTINABATTLE_3A_DESC: The Inquisitorius arrive in force to hunt for a rumored Jedi in hiding.
data.MISSION_TU40_CANTINABATTLE_3B_DESC: Reva, the Third Sister, places a bounty on a fugitive Jedi.
data.MISSION_TU40_CANTINABATTLE_3C_DESC: The Fifth Brother orders a lockdown of Fortress Inquisitorius.
data.MISSION_TU40_CANTINABATTLE_3D_DESC: Darth Vader personally takes command of an Inquisitor investigation.
data.MISSION_TU40_CANTINABATTLE_3E_DESC: A traumatic past is the source of the Third Sister's burning hatred.
data.MISSION_TU40_CANTINABATTLE_3F_DESC: Desperate for revenge, Reva pursues a new target at a modest moisture farm.
data.MISSION_TU40_CANTINABATTLE_3G_DESC: An enraged Darth Vader pursues his ultimate quarry.
data.MISSION_TU40_CANTINABATTLE_4A_DESC: Planet-hopping hopefuls pass through Fort Ypso on their way to greater adventures.
data.MISSION_TU40_CANTINABATTLE_4B_DESC: Darth Vader leads a strike team to recover valuable tech from an old droid factory.
data.MISSION_TU40_CANTINABATTLE_4C_DESC: A team of bounty hunters executes a daring raid on an Arquitens-class cruiser.
data.MISSION_TU40_CANTINABATTLE_4D_DESC: Krrsantan diverts the attention of Imperial troopers occupying a former Rebel base.
data.MISSION_TU40_CANTINABATTLE_4E_DESC: Doctor Aphra and her droids are sent on an infiltration mission to Theed.
data.MISSION_TU40_CANTINABATTLE_4F_DESC: Luke Skywalker and Doctor Aphra encounter projections of Jedi Masters in an ancient temple.
data.MISSION_TU40_CANTINABATTLE_4G_DESC: An auction held by the Crimson Dawn attracts all manner of high-profile attention.
data.MISSION_TU40_CANTINABATTLE_5A_DESC: A gang of Nikto toughs protect a mysterious bounty of great significance.
data.MISSION_TU40_CANTINABATTLE_5B_DESC: Jawas tend to be quick opportunists and shrewd negotiators.
data.MISSION_TU40_CANTINABATTLE_5C_DESC: An Imperial Remnant officer plans to deliver a hostage to his superiors.
data.MISSION_TU40_CANTINABATTLE_5D_DESC: Fennec Shand pursues an astronomical bounty on a Force-sensitive child.
data.MISSION_TU40_CANTINABATTLE_5E_DESC: A Mandalorian covert takes to the streets of the city to cover an ally's escape.
data.MISSION_TU40_CANTINABATTLE_5F_DESC: The Mandalorian Din Djarin and his allies defend the city from the Imperial Remnant.
data.MISSION_TU40_CANTINABATTLE_5G_DESC: The ruthless Moff Gideon lays siege to Nevarro City with his troops.
data.MISSION_TU40_CANTINABATTLE_6A_DESC: Tusken raiders lay an ambush on the hunt for a Krayt Dragon bounty.
data.MISSION_TU40_CANTINABATTLE_6B_DESC: A Mandalorian raid on a Gozanti-class freighter turns ugly fast.
data.MISSION_TU40_CANTINABATTLE_6C_DESC: Morgan Elsbeth's forces instill fear in a town of oppressed citizens.
data.MISSION_TU40_CANTINABATTLE_6D_DESC: The famed bounty hunter Boba Fett recovers his lost armor.
data.MISSION_TU40_CANTINABATTLE_6E_DESC: Imperial Dark Troopers conduct a lightning raid on ancient Jedi ruins.
data.MISSION_TU40_CANTINABATTLE_6F_DESC: A motley crew of bounty hunters seeks information on the location of an Imperial ship.
data.MISSION_TU40_CANTINABATTLE_6G_DESC: Moff Gideon and his legion of Dark Troopers make their last stand.
data.MISSION_TU40_CANTINABATTLE_7A_DESC: The Pyke Syndicate runs an extensive operation out of the city of Mos Espa.
data.MISSION_TU40_CANTINABATTLE_7B_DESC: Boba Fett joins a tribe of Tuskens in an assault against the Pyke Syndicate.
data.MISSION_TU40_CANTINABATTLE_7C_DESC: Fennec Shand recruits muscle for the new daimyo of Mos Espa.
data.MISSION_TU40_CANTINABATTLE_7D_DESC: The Armorer keeps the new forge of the Children of the Watch well hidden.
data.MISSION_TU40_CANTINABATTLE_7E_DESC: Luke Skywalker begins training a brand-new Jedi student.
data.MISSION_TU40_CANTINABATTLE_7F_DESC: Cad Bane doggedly pursues a bounty for the Pyke Syndicate.
data.MISSION_TU40_CANTINABATTLE_7G_DESC: Boba Fett and Din Djarin take a stand against rival crime lords.
data.MISSION_TU40_CANTINABATTLE_8A_DESC: Bo-Katan Kryze leads a rescue mission deep into Mandalorian ruins.
data.MISSION_TU40_CANTINABATTLE_8B_DESC: A pirate crew threatens the peaceful equilibrium of Nevarro City.
data.MISSION_TU40_CANTINABATTLE_8C_DESC: Carson Teva works to rally allies to the defense of Nevarro's citizens.
data.MISSION_TU40_CANTINABATTLE_8D_DESC: Mandalorians return to Nevarro City to liberate it from invading oppressors.
data.MISSION_TU40_CANTINABATTLE_8E_DESC: Imperial Supercommandos defend a hidden Imperial Remnant base.
data.MISSION_TU40_CANTINABATTLE_8F_DESC: The new Mand'alor leads her people against the remnants of the Empire.
data.MISSION_TU40_CANTINABATTLE_8G_DESC: Moff Gideon, in a suit of Dark Trooper armor, proclaims himself ruler of Mandalore.
data.MISSION_TU40_CANTINABATTLE_9A_DESC: The Valley of the Jedi is a nexus for the spirits of Jedi through the ages.
data.MISSION_TU40_CANTINABATTLE_9B_DESC: A Jedi apprentice and her teacher face internal struggle as they uncover the mysteries of the Sith.
data.MISSION_TU40_CANTINABATTLE_9C_DESC: A Sith apprentice is unleashed into a TIE fighter factory as a training exercise.
data.MISSION_TU40_CANTINABATTLE_9D_DESC: There is a tale of Darth Vader and a secret apprentice who challenged the Emperor himself.
data.MISSION_TU40_CANTINABATTLE_9E_DESC: Scoundrels across the galaxy compete to claim a notorious and valuable bounty.
data.MISSION_TU40_CANTINABATTLE_9F_DESC: Stories tell of a Sith apprentice trained more than a century after the Battle of Yavin.
data.MISSION_TU40_CANTINABATTLE_9G_DESC: Legends of the Old Republic say the fallen Jedi Revan waged a constant war on his own duality.
data.MISSION_TU40_DARKSIDEBATTLE_HARD_1A_DESC: Padme Amidala oversees the Galactic Republic effort to track Separatist leaders.
data.MISSION_TU40_DARKSIDEBATTLE_HARD_1B_DESC: Outnumbered Jedi negotiate their own terms of release with an overbearing pirate warlord.
data.MISSION_TU40_DARKSIDEBATTLE_HARD_1C_DESC: The attempted heist of a holocron is uncovered in the Jedi Temple Archives.
data.MISSION_TU40_DARKSIDEBATTLE_HARD_1D_DESC: Generations of Jedi have traveled to Ilum to find Kyber crystals for their lightsabers.
data.MISSION_TU40_DARKSIDEBATTLE_HARD_2A_DESC: Jedi Padawans battle a parasitic Geonosian plague on a Republic medical station.
data.MISSION_TU40_DARKSIDEBATTLE_HARD_2B_DESC: The Coruscant Guard spearhead the investigation of a bombing at the Jedi Temple.
data.MISSION_TU40_DARKSIDEBATTLE_HARD_2C_DESC: Jedi investigate the underworld for clues to the identity of the bomber they seek.
data.MISSION_TU40_DARKSIDEBATTLE_HARD_2D_DESC: A trial at the Jedi Temple accuses the wrong Jedi before the true culprit is revealed.
data.MISSION_TU40_DARKSIDEBATTLE_HARD_2E_DESC: The Galactic Republic begins an offensive on Mandalore to free it from its tyrannical usurper.
data.MISSION_TU40_DARKSIDEBATTLE_HARD_2F_DESC: Clone troopers of the 501st advance to the throne room of the capital city of Sundari.
data.MISSION_TU40_DARKSIDEBATTLE_HARD_3A_DESC: General Skywalker takes command of Clone Force 99 for a secret mission into Separatist territory.
data.MISSION_TU40_DARKSIDEBATTLE_HARD_3B_DESC: The Bad Batch attempts an escape from Tipoca City in the midst of an Imperial assault.
data.MISSION_TU40_DARKSIDEBATTLE_HARD_3C_DESC: In the face of pending obsolescence, clone troopers chafe under Imperial commands.
data.MISSION_TU40_DARKSIDEBATTLE_HARD_3D_DESC: Rebel partisans disrupt a mercenary mission to recover Imperial intelligence.
data.MISSION_TU40_DARKSIDEBATTLE_HARD_3E_DESC: A faction of clone troopers provide sanctuary in hiding for their brothers who defect from the Empire.
data.MISSION_TU40_DARKSIDEBATTLE_HARD_3F_DESC: Clone Force 99 defends their youngest member from an Imperial kidnapping attempt.
data.MISSION_TU40_DARKSIDEBATTLE_HARD_4A_DESC: Early members of Phoenix Cell wage a guerilla war against the Empire.
data.MISSION_TU40_DARKSIDEBATTLE_HARD_4B_DESC: Phoenix Cell agrees to take on a smuggling job in order to pay off a gambling debt.
data.MISSION_TU40_DARKSIDEBATTLE_HARD_4C_DESC: Rebels infiltrate an Imperial Star Destroyer and encounter fierce resistance inside.
data.MISSION_TU40_DARKSIDEBATTLE_HARD_4D_DESC: Lost veterans of the Clone Wars are recruited to the Rebel cause.
data.MISSION_TU40_DARKSIDEBATTLE_HARD_4E_DESC: A young princess of Alderaan orchestrates the Rebel "acquisition" of Imperial ships.
data.MISSION_TU40_DARKSIDEBATTLE_HARD_4F_DESC: Former Jedi and a headstrong apprentice face an unstoppable force at a long-lost Sith temple.
data.MISSION_TU40_DARKSIDEBATTLE_HARD_5A_DESC: Rebel agents stage a jailbreak on an Imperial prison to rescue an inconsistent ally.
data.MISSION_TU40_DARKSIDEBATTLE_HARD_5B_DESC: Phoenix Cell assists in protecting a high-value political target from the Empire's assassins.
data.MISSION_TU40_DARKSIDEBATTLE_HARD_5C_DESC: Rebel forces at Chopper Base stage a last-ditch defense against an Imperial assault.
data.MISSION_TU40_DARKSIDEBATTLE_HARD_5D_DESC: A deposed Mandalorian princess returns to Sundari to reclaim her birthright.
data.MISSION_TU40_DARKSIDEBATTLE_HARD_5E_DESC: A Jedi is remembered for his sacrifice for a new apprentice and compassion for his old master.
data.MISSION_TU40_DARKSIDEBATTLE_HARD_5F_DESC: Phoenix Cell and their allies attempt to break the Empire's grip on Lothal once and for all.
data.MISSION_TU40_DARKSIDEBATTLE_HARD_6A_DESC: A Rebel splinter cell methodically plots the heist of an Imperial payroll shipment.
data.MISSION_TU40_DARKSIDEBATTLE_HARD_6B_DESC: Cassian Andor infiltrates a Sienar factory to steal a powerful, prototype TIE fighter.
data.MISSION_TU40_DARKSIDEBATTLE_HARD_6C_DESC: The Ghorman Front is assisted by Rebel partisans in their resistance against the Empire.
data.MISSION_TU40_DARKSIDEBATTLE_HARD_6D_DESC: Luthen Rael sacrifices everything to ensure that critical information reaches the Rebellion.
data.MISSION_TU40_DARKSIDEBATTLE_HARD_6E_DESC: Rebel leaders gather to debate the significance of new, disturbing intelligence.
data.MISSION_TU40_DARKSIDEBATTLE_HARD_6F_DESC: Members of disparate Rebel factions take refuge and wonder at what the future might hold.
data.MISSION_TU40_DARKSIDEBATTLE_HARD_7A_DESC: The disgraced Guardians of the Whills remain in Jedha City to cause trouble for the Empire.
data.MISSION_TU40_DARKSIDEBATTLE_HARD_7B_DESC: Saw Gerrera's partisans wage a guerrilla war against the Empire's occupation.
data.MISSION_TU40_DARKSIDEBATTLE_HARD_7C_DESC: Rebel forces storm the beaches around the Scarif Citadel Complex Tower.
data.MISSION_TU40_DARKSIDEBATTLE_HARD_7D_DESC: The Force is with the Rebellion's attack on the Empire's data vault.
data.MISSION_TU40_DARKSIDEBATTLE_HARD_7E_DESC: Admiral Raddus receives a transmission from the Scarif vault and delivers hope to the Rebellion.
data.MISSION_TU40_DARKSIDEBATTLE_HARD_7F_DESC: Rebel forces in and around the Citadel Complex Tower keep up the fight to the very end.
data.MISSION_TU40_DARKSIDEBATTLE_HARD_8A_DESC: There is a tale of a former Sith Lord who returned to the light thousands of years ago.
data.MISSION_TU40_DARKSIDEBATTLE_HARD_8B_DESC: The underworld of Taris was once a popular destination for gambling on arena battles.
data.MISSION_TU40_DARKSIDEBATTLE_HARD_8C_DESC: In the stories, a captured Old Republic soldier helped a crew of heroes escape Taris.
data.MISSION_TU40_DARKSIDEBATTLE_HARD_8D_DESC: Legends tell that as Revan followed the light, his true strength lay in his loyal allies.
data.MISSION_TU40_DARKSIDEBATTLE_HARD_8E_DESC: Some say that the repentant Revan saved the Jedi Bastila Shan from the dark side thousands of years ago.
data.MISSION_TU40_DARKSIDEBATTLE_HARD_8F_DESC: In the days of the Old Republic, the Jedi Master Satele Shan upheld the legacy of her heroic parentage.
data.MISSION_TU40_DARKSIDEBATTLE_HARD_9A_DESC: Ahsoka Tano returns to Capital City to ask for help from a former padawan.
data.MISSION_TU40_DARKSIDEBATTLE_HARD_9B_DESC: New Republic agents uncover Imperial treachery at a Corellian shipyard.
data.MISSION_TU40_DARKSIDEBATTLE_HARD_9C_DESC: Members of Spectre Cell convene with new allies to search for a missing friend.
data.MISSION_TU40_DARKSIDEBATTLE_HARD_9D_DESC: Traumatic memories cloud Ahsoka Tano's mind with uncertainty and fear.
data.MISSION_TU40_DARKSIDEBATTLE_HARD_9E_DESC: The New Republic Senate is petitioned for aid in stopping the return of an old threat.
data.MISSION_TU40_DARKSIDEBATTLE_HARD_9F_DESC: Ahsoka Tano undertakes the rescue of a stranded ally at the cost of self-exile.
data.MISSION_TU40_DARKSIDEBATTLE_NORMAL_1A_DE: Jedi on a diplomatic mission are ambushed on a Trade Federation ship.
data.MISSION_TU40_DARKSIDEBATTLE_NORMAL_1B_DE: Naboo security forces defend against an invasion of the capital city of Theed.
data.MISSION_TU40_DARKSIDEBATTLE_NORMAL_1C_DE: The Jedi Council gathers to discuss the discovery of a vergence in the Force.
data.MISSION_TU40_DARKSIDEBATTLE_NORMAL_1D_DE: Queen Amidala and Boss Nass form an alliance in the face of invasion.
data.MISSION_TU40_DARKSIDEBATTLE_NORMAL_1E_DE: Captain Tarpals rallies the Gungans on the Great Grass Plains of Naboo.
data.MISSION_TU40_DARKSIDEBATTLE_NORMAL_1F_DE: Master Qui-Gon and his Padawan deal with a malicious infiltrator in the Naboo palace.
data.MISSION_TU40_DARKSIDEBATTLE_NORMAL_2A_DE: Anakin Skywalker chases a fleeing assassin through the busy streets of Coruscant.
data.MISSION_TU40_DARKSIDEBATTLE_NORMAL_2B_DE: Obi-Wan Kenobi trawls the Jedi Archives for the location of a mysterious planet.
data.MISSION_TU40_DARKSIDEBATTLE_NORMAL_2C_DE: While tracking the origin of a mysterious dart, Obi-Wan walks into an ambush.
data.MISSION_TU40_DARKSIDEBATTLE_NORMAL_2D_DE: An attempted rescue on Geonosis goes awry, as the rescuers are captured themselves.
data.MISSION_TU40_DARKSIDEBATTLE_NORMAL_2E_DE: A Jedi strike force attacks the Petranaki Arena, putting a stop to a planned execution.
data.MISSION_TU40_DARKSIDEBATTLE_NORMAL_2F_DE: Jedi forces lose ground and become surrounded in the Petranaki Arena.
data.MISSION_TU40_DARKSIDEBATTLE_NORMAL_2G_DE: Republic Clone troopers reinforce their Jedi allies in battle.

data.ALL_HANS_ON_DECK_LIGHTSPEED_II_INFO:
[b]MERGE UNITS[/b]

Units included in the Lightspeed Bundle are upgraded according to a predetermined set of upgrade criteria (listed below). The Lightspeed Bundle does not directly grant character shards / ship blueprints or resources used in merge upgrades. The upgrade criteria are evaluated against your existing roster, and your units are set to the greater of the two values.

Each unit will first be evaluated for existing shards or star rarity against the bundle upgrade criteria. A unit at lower star rarity (or unactivated with less cumulative shards/blueprints) than the bundle upgrade criteria will be upgraded and activated. Units that exceed the star rarity (or cumulative shards/blueprints) will be activated (if unactivated) and then evaluated for additional attributes (gear tier, ability tier, etc). Any surplus shards/blueprints over the bundle upgrade criteria will be retained.

If your previously unlocked units meet or exceed the bundle upgrade criteria for other attributes, any surplus value will be retained.

[b]CHARACTERS[/b]
- 7 Stars
- Level 85
- Relic Level 7
- Ability Tier 7

data.DATACRON_CHARACTER_KIADIMUNDI_001_DESC:
If the ally in the Leader slot is not a Galactic Legend, the following effects are active:

Once per battle, when Ki-Adi-Mundi switches to Ataru form, instantly defeat target enemy.

Once per battle, when Ki-Adi-Mundi switches to Makashi form, revive a random defeated ally.
data.DATACRON_CHARACTER_LUTHENRAEL_002_DESC: Whenever a summoned ally is damaged, all allies gain 20% Offense for 1 turn (stacking) and 20% Turn Meter
data.DATACRON_CHARACTER_MACEWINDU_001_DESC: Whenever Mace Windu gains Turn Meter, he gains 5% Max Health (stacking, max 200%) until the end of the encounter. While Mace Windu has Resilient Defense and Shatterpoint is removed, inflict Shatterpoint on a random enemy until the end of the encounter.\n\nWhenever an enemy is inflicted with Shatterpoint, Mace Windu recovers 10% Health. Whenever Mace Windu uses an ability on a Stunned enemy, reduce the cooldown of Smite by 1.
data.DATACRON_CHARACTER_PALPATINE_EMPEROR_001: The first time Emperor Palpatine is defeated, if there is an active ally, the enemy who defeated him is instantly defeated.\n\nWhenever Shock or Stun expires from an enemy, inflict Buff Immunity, 1 stack of Damage Over Time, and Healing Immunity on all enemies for 1 turn.
data.DATACRON_FACTION_GALACTICREPUBLIC_003_DE: At the start of battle, if there are no Galactic Legend allies, whenever a Galactic Republic ally with Protection Up assists, if there are no enemies with Protection Disruption, they inflict Protection Disruption on the target enemy for 1 turn, which can't be dispelled, evaded, or resisted. While Galactic Republic allies have Protection Up they gain 50% Accuracy, counter chance, Critical Chance, Critical Damage, and can ignore Taunt effects.
data.DATACRON_FACTION_SITH_001_DESC_V2: Whenever an enemy is inflicted with Fear, Pain, or Shock, Sith allies gain 5% Offense stacking until the end of battle.

data.DIN_DJARIN_LIGHTSPEED_BUNDLE_II_DESC: Walk the way of the Mandalorian and assemble a battle-ready crew! This Lightspeed Bundle upgrades The Mandalorian, IG-11, Cara Dune, Kuiil, and Greef Karga to 7 Stars, Level 85, Ability Tier 7, and Relic 7, bringing together a hardened squad ready to take on any challenge. This is the way.\n\nPurchase limit: 1
data.DIN_DJARIN_LIGHTSPEED_BUNDLE_II_INFO:
[b]MERGE UNITS[/b]

Units included in the Lightspeed Bundle are upgraded according to a predetermined set of upgrade criteria (listed below). The Lightspeed Bundle does not directly grant character shards / ship blueprints or resources used in merge upgrades. The upgrade criteria are evaluated against your existing roster, and your units are set to the greater of the two values.

Each unit will first be evaluated for existing shards or star rarity against the bundle upgrade criteria. A unit at lower star rarity (or unactivated with less cumulative shards/blueprints) than the bundle upgrade criteria will be upgraded and activated. Units that exceed the star rarity (or cumulative shards/blueprints) will be activated (if unactivated) and then evaluated for additional attributes (gear tier, ability tier, etc). Any surplus shards/blueprints over the bundle upgrade criteria will be retained.

If your previously unlocked units meet or exceed the bundle upgrade criteria for other attributes, any surplus value will be retained.

[b]CHARACTERS[/b]

- 7 Stars
- Level 85
- Relic Level 7
- Ability Tier 7
data.DIN_DJARIN_LIGHTSPEED_BUNDLE_II_TEXT: Stand with The Mandalorian (Beskar Armor) and assemble a powerful crew! This Lightspeed Bundle instantly unlocks and upgrades the required characters to 7 Stars, Level 85, Ability Tier 7, and Relic 7, giving you a squad ready to make an immediate impact on the Holotables.

data.EVENT_MARQUEE_R5D4_M01_DESC:
[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]
- Are [c][F0FF23]NOT SHARED[-][/c] between tiers

[c][24ccf4]Rewards:[-][/c]
- Features first time and repeatable rewards
- Refreshes daily until event ends

[c][24ccf4]Borrowed:[-][/c]
- Captain Carson Teva

[c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]
- R5-D4's Basic ability, [c][F0FF23]The Red One[-][/c], deals damage to target enemy and inflicts Damage Over Time.
- His first Special ability, [c][F0FF23]Tactical Support[-][/c], dispels all debuffs on New Republic allies and grants Retaliate to all allies.
- With his second Special ability, [c][F0FF23]Bad Motivator[-][/c], R5-D4 deals True damage to all enemies equal to his Max Health. This ability can't be evaded or resisted. 
- His Unique ability, [c][F0FF23]Built for Adventure[-][/c], grants Rebel allies Max Protection at the start of encounter. If all allies are New Republic, he is immune to Ability Block and Cooldown Increase.

[c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]
- While in Territory Wars with all non-Galactic Legend New Republic allies, R5-D4's Omicron on [c][F0FF23]Built for Adventure[-][/c] dramatically enhances his kit.
- The cooldown of his second Special, [c][F0FF23]Bad Motivator[-][/c], is reduced at the start of encounter and every time it's used.
- Whenever R5-D4 inflicts Damage Over Time, all allies gain Max Health. When [c][F0FF23]Bad Motivator[-][/c] is used, all enemies' cooldowns are increased to their maximum. 
- Whenever Retaliate expires on an ally, all stacks of Damage Over Time on all enemies are triggered. Whenever an ally is defeated, the weakest active ally gains Damage Immunity.
- [c][ffff33]NOTE:[-][/c] For demonstrative purposes, this battle is being simulated as if it was in the Territory Wars game mode and with R5-D4's Omicron enabled.

data.EVENT_MARQUEE_R5D4_SUMMARY: Play as [c][ffff33]R5-D4[-][/c], the heroic astromech droid whose selfless act of sacrifice ultimately helped the Rebellion defeat the Empire.\n\nEarn R5-D4 shards and other galactic rewards in this special Marquee event with all tiers featuring both first time and daily rewards.

data.NEWSLETTER_ERA_LEVELS_AND_LOANED_UNITS_S:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

With the arrival of the [c][F0FF23]Era of the New Republic[-][/c] to the Holotables, we have some significant changes to how Eras will work going forward.

First off, the [c][F0FF23]Era Level cap is being raised from 95 to 135[-][/c]. This change brings with it two significant improvements. First off, in the early days of the event, you’ll be progressing through Era levels faster than ever before. Secondly, exiting the Era will see improved Legacy conversions. Previously the highest you could get in a Legacy conversion was Relic 6 for a maxed-out EL 95 character. Now, a maxed-out EL 135 character has a Legacy conversion of Relic 8.

Additionally [c][F0FF23]four new tiers are being added to the Coliseum[-][/c], allowing more frequent tier clears and faster progress throughout the Era in this mode.

Next we have [c][F0FF23]Loaned Units[-][/c]. Characters in Galaxy of Heroes are meant to work alongside other characters in squads. Sometimes those other characters are from outside the Era. Loaned Units will give you a glimpse of a character’s potential alongside theirfuture squadmates in the Legacy roster. Each Era we will identify several characters as Loaned Units, and they will be available to you throughout the Era. These are temporary Era versions of Legacy characters meant to be used alongside the Era characters in modes likeColiseum and Era Challenges. You don’t need to own the Legacy versions of these characters, and even if you happen to own the character in question, it uses the temporary Era version. 

Loaned Units will get more powerful throughout the Era, and universally. You don’t need to choose which Loaned Units get leveled up, all of them will! This allows you to concentrate on powering up the Era-specific characters to achieve new Coliseum high scores, and conquer higher and higher Feats in Era Challenges.

The list of units that will be available to all players as Loaned Units in the Era of the New Republic is:

Death Trooper
Scout Trooper
Stormtrooper
TIE Fighter Pilot
Snowtrooper
General Syndulla
Mon Mothma
Captain Drogan
Chopper
Cara Dune
The Mandalorian (Beskar Armor)
Cad Bane
Embo
Gamorrean Guard
Greedo
Mob Enforcer

The Era of the New Republic brings many other quality of life improvements to Galaxy of Heroes. Check out the patch notes on our official forums for the latest info.
data.NEWSLETTER_ERA_OF_THE_NEW_REPUBLIC_SUMMA:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

[c][F0FF23]Era of the New Republic[-][/c] is coming to the Holotables!

While the Battle of Jakku marked the official end of the Empire, the Imperial Remnant remained a threat to the galaxy for years following. The New Republic, formed shortly after the Empire’s defeat at Endor, used elements such as the Adelphi Rangers to help hunt down the remaining Imperial Warlords who continued to threaten the galaxy.

The Era kicks off with the heroic droid [c][F0FF23]R5-D4[-][/c]. This red-accented astromech droid heroically sacrificed his motivator on Tatooine to enable R2-D2 to continue with his secret mission. In the years that followed, R5-D4 joined up with the Rebel alliance, partnered with Captain Carson Teva, and eventually wound up with The Mandalorian and Grogu, helping the pair retake Mandalore from Remnant control.

The next character is [c][F0FF23]Zeb Orrelios (New Republic Pilot)[-][/c]. Zeb was once part of Hera Syndulla's Rebel cell, and then eventually his penchant for smashing Imperial heads made him the perfect addition to the Adelphi Rangers. He brings with him to Galaxy of Heroes his natural agility and the bo-rifle, a traditional Lasat weapon that is deadly in either its melee or rifle configuration.

[c][F0FF23]Colonel Ward[-][/c] was a New Republic commander with one job: bring down the Imperial Warlords that threaten the security of the galaxy. An accomplished pilot in her own right, Col. Ward oversaw the operations at Adelphi Base, giving assignments to bounty hunters like The Mandalorian and Grogu to hunt down Imperial Warlords.

Then we have [c][F0FF23]Captain Carson Teva[-][/c]. Captain Teva was an X-wing pilot and friend to General Syndulla, Zeb, and even the Mandalorian covert on Nevarro. This veteran of the Rebellion against the Empire will lead the brand new New Republic squad, sharing his battle experience with his teammates in Galaxy of Heroes.

The Anzellans find themselves teaming up with Grogu himself to aid the New Republic with the unit appropriately named [c][F0FF23]Grogu & Anzellans[-][/c]. This unit has three of the diminutive aliens teaming up with Grogu on their hover-cart, where they used their mechanical jury-rigging and Grogu’s ability with the Force to aid the New Republic squad in bringing down the mightiest of foes.

The final unit of the Era is the [c][F0FF23]Imperial Snowtrooper Commander[-][/c]. This Imperial Remnant is a Tank and a Leader to other Remnants, giving you even more options for putting together Imperial Remnant squads. Additionally, the existing Snowtrooper will be getting the Imperial Remnant tag, allowing those cold-hearted troopers to be a part of Snowtrooper Commander’s squad if desired.

The Journey Guide unit for the Era will be the one and only [c][F0FF23]Rotta the Hutt[-][/c]. Like previous Eras, unlocking this unit will require having all the previous marquee characters from the New Republic Era at 4*. To improve the unit will require those same characters at 5*, 6*, and finally 7*/EL [b]125[/b] (see the Loaned Units newsletter for more information on the new Era Levels.).

Additionally, later this year, the newest Galactic Legend will require units from the New Republic Era as part of their requirements. So now there’s even more reason to make sure you pick them up!

We hope you enjoy the Era of the New Republic and seeing new fan-favorite characters come to life in Star Wars: Galaxy of Heroes over the next three months.
data.NEWSLETTER_R5_D4_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

[c][F0FF23]R5-D4[-][/c] is coming to the Holotables!

R5-D4, or the “Red One” as he is known to most, is the astromech droid whose sudden malfunction changed the course of galactic history. Though often remembered for a single moment on Tatooine, this droid eventually joined the Rebellion, working alongside their pilots to help take down the Galactic Empire. In Star Wars: Galaxy of Heroes, R5-D4 steps forward as a key Support unit (and first member) of a powerful New Republic squad, bringing disruption, durability, and a surprising amount of battlefield influence.

R5-D4’s kit revolves around spreading Damage Over Time and creating pressure through enemy cooldown manipulation. With abilities that punish enemies for recovering and reward allies for coordinated play, R5-D4 steadily builds momentum across the encounter. [c][F0FF23]Tactical Support[-][/c] enhances allies based on their roles, allowing Attackers to bypass defenses, Tanks to hold the line, and Supports to avoid being critically hit.

At the center of the kit is [c][F0FF23]Bad Motivator[-][/c], a high-risk ability that converts Protection into explosive damage and dramatically shifts the flow of battle. While it can be risky to use, it opens windows for aggressive plays and synergizes with R5-D4’s broader cooldown reduction mechanics. [c][F0FF23]Built for Adventure[-][/c] ties everything together, enabling consistent assist calls, stacking defensive bonuses, and powerful scaling effects in Territory Wars via the Omicron ability.

R5-D4 is one of the requirements, at 4 stars, to initially unlock the Journey Guide unit for the Era, [b]Rotta the Hutt[/b]. He will also be a requirement for the [b]Galactic Legend[/b] being released later this year. Unlock R5-D4 in the upcoming [c][F0FF23]RED, LET’S GO[-][/c] Marquee event, where you can kick off the Era of the New Republic with a bang using this unconventional but impactful droid.

data.PADME_AMIDALA_LIGHTSPEED_BUNDLE_II_INFO:
[b]MERGE UNITS[/b]

Units included in the Lightspeed Bundle are upgraded according to a predetermined set of upgrade criteria (listed below). The Lightspeed Bundle does not directly grant character shards / ship blueprints or resources used in merge upgrades. The upgrade criteria are evaluated against your existing roster, and your units are set to the greater of the two values.

Each unit will first be evaluated for existing shards or star rarity against the bundle upgrade criteria. A unit at lower star rarity (or unactivated with less cumulative shards/blueprints) than the bundle upgrade criteria will be upgraded and activated. Units that exceed the star rarity (or cumulative shards/blueprints) will be activated (if unactivated) and then evaluated for additional attributes (gear tier, ability tier, etc). Any surplus shards/blueprints over the bundle upgrade criteria will be retained.

If your previously unlocked units meet or exceed the bundle upgrade criteria for other attributes, any surplus value will be retained.

This Lightspeed Bundle upgrades Dash Rendar, Kyle Katarn, Darth Talon, and Mara Jade, The Emperor’s Hand to 7 Stars, Level 85, Ability Tier 7, and Relic 7, delivering a high-impact squad ready to take control of the battlefield.\n\nPurchase limit: 1
data.STARKILLER_LIGHTSPEED_BUNDLE_II_INFO:
[c][F0FF23]MERGE UNITS[-][/c]

Units included in the Lightspeed Bundle are upgraded according to a predetermined set of upgrade criteria (listed below). The Lightspeed Bundle does not directly grant character shards / ship blueprints or resources used in merge upgrades. The upgrade criteria are evaluated against your existing roster, and your units are set to the greater of the two values.

Each unit will first be evaluated for existing shards or star rarity against the bundle upgrade criteria. A unit at lower star rarity (or unactivated with less cumulative shards/blueprints) than the bundle upgrade criteria will be upgraded and activated. Units that exceed the star rarity (or cumulative shards/blueprints) will be activated (if unactivated) and then evaluated for additional attributes (gear tier, ability tier, etc). Any surplus shards/blueprints over the bundle upgrade criteria will be retained.

If your previously unlocked units meet or exceed the bundle upgrade criteria for other attributes, any surplus value will be retained.

[b]CHARACTERS[/b]
- 7 Stars
- Level 85
- Relic Level 7
- Ability Tier 7

While Snowtrooper Commander is not Taunting, whenever another Imperial Remnant ally is damaged by an enemy, Snowtrooper Commander gains 30% Turn Meter.

While Snowtrooper Commander has Protection, all Imperial Remnant allies have 100% Critical Avoidance and Tenacity.

While Snowtrooper Commander is Taunting, whenever he is damaged by an enemy, all Imperial Remnant allies gain 10% Defense Penetration (stacking, max 100%) until the end of battle and whenever he is inflicted with a debuff, all other Imperial Remnant allies gain 5% Turn Meter.

While Snowtrooper Commander is not Taunting, whenever another Imperial Remnant ally is damaged by an enemy, Snowtrooper Commander gains 30% Turn Meter.

While Snowtrooper Commander has Protection, all Imperial Remnant allies have 100% Critical Avoidance and Tenacity.

data.LEADERABILITY_MAJORPARTAGAZ_TIER_07_DESC:
At the start of battle, Major Partagaz inflicts Potency Down and Speed Down on all enemies for 2 turns. ISB allies gain 50% bonus Protection, 30 Speed, and ISB allies that are Rank 3 ignore Taunt effects on their turn until the end of battle. At the start of their turn, ISB allies have +25% Critical Chance, Defense, and Tenacity if they are Rank 1. These bonuses are doubled if they are Rank 2 and quadrupled if they are Rank 3.

Whenever an enemy recovers Protection, all ISB allies gain 5% Offense (stacking) until the end of battle. ISB allies deal 5% more damage when targeting a Target Locked enemy, and recover 5% Health and Protection. ISB allies inflict Speed Down for 2 turns whenever they attack out of turn.

[c][E7E7E7]While in Grand Arenas and all allies are ISB[-][/c]: Major Partagaz starts the battle at Rank 3 and gains 50 Speed. Whenever an allied ISB Support gains Retaliate, they also gain 20% bonus Protection for 1 turn and whenever an ISB ally is damaged, Major Partagaz gains 15% turn meter. The first time each ally falls below 30% Health, they recover 30% Health and Protection, ISB Support allies Stealth for 1 turn and ISB Tank allies Taunt for 1 turn.

data.NEWSLETTER_ZEB_ORRELIOS_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

[c][F0FF23]Zeb Orrelios (New Republic Pilot)[-][/c] is coming to the Holotables!

The strong arm of the Ghost crew returns with renewed purpose during the early days of the New Republic. After years of fighting alongside the Rebellion, Zeb continues his service as a dedicated protector, bringing his signature combat style and unwavering loyalty to New Republic operations to our Galaxy of Heroes.

Zeb Orrelios (New Republic Pilot) is a New Republic Tank that specializes in defensive tactics that frustrate enemy Accuracy while drawing fire away from his less survivable allies. His [c][F0FF23]Suppressive Barrage[-][/c] has opponents missing their shots with debilitating Accuracy penalties, while [c][F0FF23]Devastating Sweep[-][/c] strips enemy buffs and forces the entire opposing squad to focus their attacks on him through undispellable Provokes. His battlefield flexibility shines through [c][F0FF23]Tactical Reversal[-][/c], which dispels enemy Taunts while establishing his own defensive presence and providing role-specific team buffs paired with matching enemy debuffs when coordinating with his New Republic allies.

His [c][F0FF23]Lasat Enforcer[-][/c] passive emphasizes Evasion and survivability, scaling with New Republic squad composition while granting Protection Up to his team. The Omicron upgrade transforms him into a defensive juggernaut in [c][F0FF23]3v3 Grand Arenas[-][/c], featuring extreme Evasion mechanics and powerful synergies with Captain Carson Teva and R5-D4.

Zeb Orrelios (New Republic Pilot) is a requirement (at 4*) for unlocking the Journey Guide event for [b]Rotta the Hutt[/b], and will be a requirement for this year’s [b]Galactic Legend[/b]. Unlock Zeb in the upcoming [c][F0FF23]“TRAINING OPERATIONS”[-][/c] Marquee event and add this resilient Tank to your New Republic roster!

[c][F0FF23]MERGE UNITS[-][/c]

Units included in the Lightspeed Bundle are upgraded according to a predetermined set of upgrade criteria (listed below). The Lightspeed Bundle does not directly grant character shards / ship blueprints or resources used in merge upgrades. The upgrade criteria are evaluated against your existing roster, and your units are set to the greater of the two values.

Each unit will first be evaluated for existing shards or star rarity against the bundle upgrade criteria. A unit at lower star rarity (or unactivated with less cumulative shards/blueprints) than the bundle upgrade criteria will be upgraded and activated. Units that exceed the star rarity (or cumulative shards/blueprints) will be activated (if unactivated) and then evaluated for additional attributes (gear tier, ability tier, etc). Any surplus shards/blueprints over the bundle upgrade criteria will be retained.

If your previously unlocked units meet or exceed the bundle upgrade criteria for other attributes, any surplus value will be retained.
