data.RETURNING_USER_NEWSLETTER_GROUPA_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

It's great to have you back in Fey's Cantina! We have put together the [c][F0FF23]Renewal Experience[-][/c] to make sure your return is off to a strong start.

As part of your [c][F0FF23]Renewal Rewards[-][/c], you should have already received Crystals, LSTs, Training Droids, Credits, and Cantina Energy, along with three Renewal Calendars packed with Ability Material Zetas, Omicrons, Prestige, PvE Energy, and Crystals.

Keep an eye out for the new [c][F0FF23]Renewal Quests[-][/c] tab in the Quest view, where a fresh set of quests will unlock each day over the course of 30 days. Whether it's completing Daily Quests or earning Raid Tickets, every quest comes with valuable rewards including Gear, Ability Materials, Crystals and Lightspeed Tokens at key milestones. All quests will be available by Day 30, and you'll have 5 additional days to finish them.

The Lightspeed Tokens you earn from Renewal Quests unlock Kylo Ren, Captain Phasma, Kylo Ren (Unmasked), General Hux, and Sith Trooper at Relic 3, assembling the First Order roster you need to unlock [c][F0FF23]BB-8[-][/c] through his Journey Guide event.

As you settle back in, head to the [c][F0FF23]Store[-][/c] for a selection of exclusive offers waiting for you, including two free Calendars. The 7-Day Renewal Cantina Energy Calendar unlocks a week after your return, and the 14-Day Renewal Bounty Calendar unlocks a week after that.

To supercharge your comeback, a Crystal Bundle, two 7-Day Renewal PvE Energy Calendars, and a 14-Day Renewal Crystal Calendar are also available for purchase in the [c][F0FF23]Store[-][/c] for a limited time.

We hope you enjoy everything the [c][F0FF23]Renewal Experience[-][/c] has to offer and have a great time back on the Holotables!

May the Force be with you!

Keep an eye out for the new [c][F0FF23]Renewal Quests[-][/c] tab in the Quest view, where a fresh set of quests will unlock each day over the course of 30 days. Whether it's completing Daily Quests or earning Raid Tickets, every quest comes with valuable rewards including Gear, Ability Materials, Crystals and Lightspeed Tokens at key milestones. All quests will be available by Day 30, and you'll have 5 additional days to finish them.

The Lightspeed Tokens you earn from Renewal Quests unlock Kylo Ren, Poe Dameron, Rey (Scavenger), Captain Phasma, Finn, Kylo Ren (Unmasked), Veteran Smuggler Han Solo, General Hux, Veteran Smuggler Chewbacca, and Sith Trooper at Relic 3, assembling both the First Order and Resistance rosters you need to unlock [c][F0FF23]BB-8[-][/c] and [c][F0FF23]Rey (Jedi Training)[-][/c] through their respective Journey Guide events.

As you settle back in, head to the [c][F0FF23]Store[-][/c] for a selection of exclusive offers waiting for you, including two free Calendars. The 7-Day Renewal Cantina Energy Calendar unlocks a week after your return, and the 14-Day Renewal Bounty Calendar unlocks a week after that.

To supercharge your comeback, a Crystal Bundle, two 7-Day Renewal PvE Energy Calendars, and a 14-Day Renewal Crystal Calendar are also available for purchase in the [c][F0FF23]Store[-][/c] for a limited time.

We hope you enjoy everything the [c][F0FF23]Renewal Experience[-][/c] has to offer and have a great time back on the Holotables!

May the Force be with you!

data.501ST_LEGION_LIGHTSPEED_INFO:
[c][F0FF23]MERGE UNITS[-][/c]

Units included in the Lightspeed Bundle are upgraded according to a predetermined set of upgrade criteria (listed below). The Lightspeed Bundle does not directly grant character shards / ship blueprints or resources used in merge upgrades. The upgrade criteria are evaluated against your existing roster, and your units are set to the greater of the two values.

Each unit will first be evaluated for existing shards or star rarity against the bundle upgrade criteria. A unit at lower star rarity (or unactivated with less cumulative shards/blueprints) than the bundle upgrade criteria will be upgraded and activated. Units that exceed the star rarity (or cumulative shards/blueprints) will be activated (if unactivated) and then evaluated for additional attributes (gear tier, ability tier, etc). Any surplus shards/blueprints over the bundle upgrade criteria will be retained.

If your previously unlocked units meet or exceed the bundle upgrade criteria for other attributes, any surplus value will be retained.

data.NEWSLETTER_COLONEL_WARD_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

[c][F0FF23]Colonel Ward[-][/c] is coming to the Holotables!

A veteran officer and Support unit for the New Republic, Colonel Ward specializes in coordinating battlefield pressure and exposing enemy weaknesses for her allies to exploit. Whether directing fire from the front lines or supporting operations from the cockpit of her starship, Ward excels at keeping enemy forces pinned down while New Republic squads maintain momentum through constant counterattacks and coordinated retaliation.

Ward’s kit is built around punishing enemies who interfere with New Republic defenses. She spreads debuffs like Evasion Down, Burning, Healing Immunity, and Expose while enabling allies to capitalize on counterattacks and out of turn effects. Her Special ability, [c][F0FF23]New Republic's Most Wanted[-][/c], disrupts hidden enemies by stripping Stealth and Marking those targets, while her second Special ability applies broad pressure across the entire enemy team.

Her Unique ability, [c][F0FF23]New Republic Officer[-][/c], ties the kit together with strong synergy for Taunting allies, Healers, and Supports. Ward steadily builds offensive pressure through Retaliate and On the Run mechanics, rewarding teams that maintain control of the battlefield over extended encounters. In Grand Arenas, her Omicron further strengthens New Republic squads with additional On the Run pressure and scaling stat boosts.

[c][F0FF23]Colonel Ward[-][/c] is a requirement (at 4*) for unlocking the Journey Guide event for [b]Rotta the Hutt[/b], and will be a requirement for this year’s [b]Galactic Legend[/b]. Unlock Colonel Ward in the upcoming [c][F0FF23]“EYES ON THE OUTER RIM”[-][/c] Marquee event and add this cunning Support to your New Republic roster!

data.LUTHEN_RAEL_LIGHTSPEED_DESC: Instantly elevate Luthen Rael to Relic 5, Ability Level 7, and 7-Star with this Lightspeed Bundle! Unlock full potential and lead your squad to victory!\n\nPurchase limit: 1
data.LUTHEN_RAEL_LIGHTSPEED_INFO:
[c][F0FF23]MERGE UNITS[-][/c]

Units included in the Lightspeed Bundle are upgraded according to a predetermined set of upgrade criteria (listed below). The Lightspeed Bundle does not directly grant character shards / ship blueprints or resources used in merge upgrades. The upgrade criteria are evaluated against your existing roster, and your units are set to the greater of the two values.

Each unit will first be evaluated for existing shards or star rarity against the bundle upgrade criteria. A unit at lower star rarity (or unactivated with less cumulative shards/blueprints) than the bundle upgrade criteria will be upgraded and activated. Units that exceed the star rarity (or cumulative shards/blueprints) will be activated (if unactivated) and then evaluated for additional attributes (gear tier, ability tier, etc). Any surplus shards/blueprints over the bundle upgrade criteria will be retained.

If your previously unlocked units meet or exceed the bundle upgrade criteria for other attributes, any surplus value will be retained.

data.NEWSLETTER_CAPTAIN_CARSON_TEVA_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

[c][F0FF23]Captain Carson Teva[-][/c] is coming to the Holotables!

A veteran pilot and trusted marshal of the New Republic, Captain Carson Teva spent years patrolling the Outer Rim in the difficult years following the fall of the Empire. Known for his calm judgment and willingness to operate beyond strict protocol when necessary, Teva became a reliable ally to those resisting growing Imperial threats in the shadows. His experience coordinating fighters and local defenders makes him a natural fit for leading New Republic forces into battle.

Captain Teva’s Leader ability, [c][F0FF23]Captain of the Adelphi Rangers[-][/c], turns counterattacks into constant pressure against the enemy team, spreading stacks of the new On the Run debuff while empowering New Republic allies with Defense Penetration, Offense, and Retribution. Enemies struggle to escape coordinated retaliation, as Captain Teva’s squad will be triggering the effects of their Basic abilities when used during the opponent's turns. In Territory Battles, Teva dramatically improves the survivability and offensive pressure of full New Republic squads while overwhelming enemies through relentless attacks out of turn.

[c][F0FF23]Keeping the Peace[-][/c] and [c][F0FF23]Unauthorized Operation[-][/c] reinforce Teva’s role as a tactical leader. He coordinates assists, punishes enemies who rely on debuffs or excessive Speed, and works closely with his trusty astromech droid R5-D4 to keep his squad active and aggressive.

[c][F0FF23]Captain Carson Teva[-][/c] is a requirement (at 4*) for unlocking [b]Rotta the Hutt[/b] in the Journey Guide event, and will be a requirement for this year’s [b]Galactic Legend[/b]. Unlock Captain Teva in the upcoming [c][F0FF23]“CLASSIFIED INFORMATION”[-][/c] Marquee event and add this seasoned New Republic marshal to your roster.
data.NEWSLETTER_CINTA_KAZ_DESC_V2:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

[c][F0FF23]Cinta Kaz[-][/c] is coming to the Holotables!

After her family was massacred by stormtroopers, she became a fierce believer in the Rebellion's cause. Cinta Kaz brings determination and tactical cunning to every engagement. Her unwavering commitment to the fight and her bond with her squad make her a formidable presence on the battlefield.

[c][F0FF23]Cinta Kaz[-][/c] is a Rebel Fighter Attacker who specializes in hit-and-run tactics and debuff amplification. Her Basic ability, [c][F0FF23]Blaster Burn[-][/c], deals damage and inflicts Defense Down, which becomes permanent if the target is Undermined. Her Special ability, [c][F0FF23]Fight To The Death[-][/c], creates a debuff chain: Breach leads to Ability Block, which leads to Deathmark, and Undermined enemies can't resist it.

Her Unique ability, [c][F0FF23]Blooded, Fearless Warrior[-][/c], makes her the heart of Rebel Fighter teams. Whenever she uses an ability while Stealthed, she Exposes her target and she assists her Rebel Fighter allies against Undermined enemies. While in [c][F0FF23]Territory Wars[-][/c] with her Omicron ability, Cinta gains massive survivability through Stealth and defensive stats, and enemies that damage her become Undermined, or suffer Healing Immunity if they are already Undermined. Additionally, she and her Rebel Fighter allies gain increased stats for each Undermined foe, and recover Health and Protection whenever a Deathmarked enemy is defeated. 

Her second Unique ability, [c][F0FF23]You're The Only Reason I'm Here[-][/c], deepens her synergy with [c][F0FF23]Vel Sartha[-][/c]. Cinta and Vel recover Health and Protection whenever Cinta damages enemies, and if Vel is present, Cinta regains Stealth and Offense whenever her Stealth is dispelled, creating a relentless offensive cycle.

Unlock [c][F0FF23]Cinta Kaz[-][/c] in the upcoming [c][F0FF23]FAITH IN THE DARK[-][/c] Marquee event that [c][F0FF23]gives out daily rewards[-][/c] for the duration of the event! Cinta is also one of the requirements (at 4 stars) to initially unlock the event for Cassian Andor (Undercover).

data.RESISTANCE_VANGUARD_LIGHTSPEED_INFO:
[c][F0FF23]MERGE UNITS[-][/c]

Units included in the Lightspeed Bundle are upgraded according to a predetermined set of upgrade criteria (listed below). The Lightspeed Bundle does not directly grant character shards / ship blueprints or resources used in merge upgrades. The upgrade criteria are evaluated against your existing roster, and your units are set to the greater of the two values.

Each unit will first be evaluated for existing shards or star rarity against the bundle upgrade criteria. A unit at lower star rarity (or unactivated with less cumulative shards/blueprints) than the bundle upgrade criteria will be upgraded and activated. Units that exceed the star rarity (or cumulative shards/blueprints) will be activated (if unactivated) and then evaluated for additional attributes (gear tier, ability tier, etc). Any surplus shards/blueprints over the bundle upgrade criteria will be retained.

If your previously unlocked units meet or exceed the bundle upgrade criteria for other attributes, any surplus value will be retained.

data.DATACRON_CHARACTER_PAPLOO_002_DESC:
Paploo Taunts for 2 turns at the start of battle, which can't be dispelled. If there were no Galactic Legends at the start of battle, allies ignore Taunt effects while Paploo is Taunting.

Whenever Paploo uses a Special ability, allies gain 50% Defense and Offense (stacking, max 300%) and recover 25% Health and Protection.

data.DATACRON_CHARACTER_TALIA_001_DESC: Whenever Nightsister allies use a Special ability on an enemy with any stacks of Plague, all other Nightsister allies assist, a random enemy is inflicted with 1 stack of Plague which can't be resisted, and the cooldown for Water of Life is reduced by 1.\n\nIf Mother Talzin is the ally in the Leader slot at the start of battle, at the start of each Nightsister ally's turn all Plagued enemies are Marked for 1 turn.

data.DATACRON_CHARACTER_TUSKENSHAMAN_001_DESC: The first time a Tusken ally inflicts a debuff each turn, they gain 5 stacks of Heal Over Time and the target enemy is inflicted with 2 stacks of Damage Over Time for 2 turns.\n\nThe first time an ally loses any stacks of Momentum each turn, they gain 1 stack of Momentum for 3 turns, 2 stacks of Heal Over Time for 2 turns, trigger all allies' stacks of Heal Over Time, and trigger all enemies' stacks of Damage Over Time.
data.DATACRON_CHARACTER_UGNAUGHT_002_DESC:
At the start of battle, if Hondo Ohnaka and Ezra Bridger are allies and there are no other allies, gain the following effects:

- At the start of each turn, if Hondo Ohnaka has more stacks of Ransom than Ugnaught, Ugnaught and Ezra gain 2 stacks of Ransom (stacking, max 50) which can't be copied, dispelled, or prevented, and all allies gain 25% Defense and Offense (stacking) for the rest of battle. These increases persist through defeat.

- Whenever Ezra Bridger assists, he gains Dramatic Entrance for 1 turn, the strongest ally who doesn't already have it gains Frenzy until the start of their next turn, and the weakest ally who doesn't already have it gains Tactical Genius for 1 turn.

- Whenever Ugnaught uses his Basic ability, dispel all debuffs on all allies, then all allies assist a total of 6 times. Whenever Ugnaught uses a Special ability, dispel all enemy buffs and Fracture the target enemy until the start of Ugnaught's next turn or until Ugnaught is defeated.

- At the start of battle, all allies gain 400% bonus Protection and Backup Plan for the rest of battle. Whenever an ally takes damage, all allies recover 30% Health.

- At the start of battle, if Ugnaught is on Offense, allies gain 50% Evasion until the end of battle. If there are no Galactic Legends, they gain an additional 50% Evasion.

data.NEWSLETTER_GROGU_ANZELLANS_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

Not every hero charges into battle blaster-first. [c][F0FF23]Grogu & Anzellans[-][/c] bring a different kind of Support to the Holotables, combining Grogu's growing Force abilities with the ingenuity of talented Anzellan mechanics. As a Light Side Healer for Mandalorian and New Republic squads, they specialize in keeping allies operational, disrupting enemy plans, and turning battlefield setbacks into opportunities.

Grogu & Anzellans specialize in sustaining their team through powerful healing and utility effects. Their first Special ability, [c][F0FF23]Tune Up[-][/c], equalizes ally Health before providing defensive bonuses and additional recovery for Mandalorian and New Republic allies. Their second Special ability, [c][F0FF23]Strapped In[-][/c], disrupts enemy plans by dispelling buffs while granting Dramatic Entrance and Heal Over Time effects to allies. They can also empower key New Republic allies by reducing cooldowns and granting Retribution while simultaneously slowing enemy momentum through cooldown increases and On the Run.

Their first Unique ability, [c][F0FF23]Bad Baby![-][/c], bolsters New Republic squads with increased durability through bonus Health, Protection, and Deflective Ward. Grogu & Anzellans also excel at countering control effects, helping allies recover from debilitating debuffs while providing additional Health recovery whenever key defensive effects are removed. In Grand Arenas, they become even more difficult to pin down, gaining additional survivability for their squad and Untargetable after using Special abilities.

Their second Unique ability, [c][F0FF23]Din Grogu[-][/c] showcases Grogu's growing connection to the Force. He disrupts enemies with Distract and On the Run while steadily building Force Connection throughout the encounter, growing stronger as the battle progresses.

[c][F0FF23]Grogu & Anzellans[-][/c] are a requirement (at 4*) for unlocking [b]Rotta the Hutt[/b] in the Journey Guide event, and will be a requirement for this year’s [b]Galactic Legend[/b]. Unlock Grogu & Anzellans in the upcoming [c][F0FF23]“SMALL BUT MIGHTY”[-][/c] Marquee event and add this unlikely crew of mischief-makers to your New Republic roster!
data.NEWSLETTER_LEIA_JEDI_TRAINING_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

[c][F0FF23]Leia (Jedi Training)[-][/c] is coming to the Holotables!

After the fall of the Empire, Leia Organa continued her Jedi training under the guidance of her brother, Luke Skywalker. A vision of her son’s future convinced her to step away from completing her Jedi path, but the lessons she learned and the connection she forged with the Force remained an important part of her journey.

[c][F0FF23]Leia (Jedi Training)[-][/c] is an Attacker who thrives alongside Jedi Master Luke Skywalker, growing stronger throughout battle as she gains Jedi Lessons and deepens her connection to the Force. Her Basic ability, [c][F0FF23]Tactical Strike[-][/c], helps her adapt as the battle unfolds, gaining Jedi Lessons against faster enemies and unleashing additional attacks against slower foes, while her Special ability, [c][F0FF23]Instinct of the Force[-][/c], allows her to pressure enemies and capitalize on opportunities created by her fellow Jedi. 

As battles progress, Leia becomes an increasingly valuable ally through her Unique abilities, [c][F0FF23]The Unchosen Path[-][/c] and [c][F0FF23]Disciple of the Force[-][/c]. She supports Jedi allies with Protection recovery, bonus turns, and powerful team-wide benefits while lifting Jedi Master Luke Skywalker to reach his full potential. Her second Special ability, [c][F0FF23]The Final Lesson[-][/c], adapts to different opponents while accelerating Luke's Ultimate Charge, creating a powerful partnership between master and student that rewards dedicated Jedi squads.

While in Grand Arenas, Leia further enhances Jedi teams through additional survivability, anti-revive effects, and powerful synergy with Jedi Master Luke Skywalker. Unlock [c][F0FF23]Leia (Jedi Training)[-][/c] through the upcoming Conquest event and strengthen one of the galaxy's most iconic Jedi pairings.
data.NEWSLETTER_ROTTA_THE_HUTT_KIT_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

[c][F0FF23]Rotta the Hutt[-][/c] arrives on the Holotables as a powerful new Light Side Attacker and Leader for Hutt Cartel squads. Once known as Jabba's young heir, Rotta has grown into a formidable presence in his own right, capable of leading Hutt Cartel forces into battle or standing alone against overwhelming odds. Rotta brings a relentless fighting style built around Bleeds, Thermal Detonators, and overwhelming durability.

As a Hutt Cartel Leader, Rotta empowers his allies through [c][F0FF23]A Legacy Reforged[-][/c], granting significant boosts to survivability, offensive capabilities, and battlefield control. His leadership rewards Hutt Cartel teams for applying Bleeds and Thermal Detonators, keeping allies healthy while generating Turn Meter throughout the battle. Combined with his Unique ability, [c][F0FF23]Pedunkee Mufkin[-][/c], Rotta creates a resilient squad that shrugs off disruption, punishes enemy debuffs, and keeps pressure on opponents through constant recovery and bonus turns.

Rotta is equally dangerous when fighting alone. His [c][F0FF23]Cleave the Unworthy[-][/c] steadily weakens enemies over the course of battle while increasing his own Speed, allowing him to snowball into an unstoppable threat. His first Special ability, [c][F0FF23]Knock 'Em Dead[-][/c], blankets enemy teams with Bleeds and Off Balance before setting up devastating follow-up attacks, while his second Special ability, [c][F0FF23]Showboat[-][/c], triggers accumulated damage effects, Stuns opponents, and can instantly defeat weakened enemies. When entering battle without allies, Rotta gains tremendous bonuses to Health, Protection, and durability, transforming him into a true solo powerhouse capable of taking on entire squads by himself.

While in Grand Arenas, Rotta further enhances Hutt Cartel teams with powerful Thermal Detonator synergies, bonus Protection, and relentless offensive momentum. Unlock [c][F0FF23]Rotta the Hutt[-][/c] through his upcoming Journey Guide event, [c][F0FF23]"CHAMPION OF THE PIT"[-][/c], and unleash him as a one-Hutt wrecking crew. To learn more about the characters required for his event, check out the Rotta the Hutt Journey Guide Event Requirements newsletter.

data.UNIQUEABILITY_JEDILEIA01_TIER_07_DESC:
At the start of battle, Leia has -50 Speed. Whenever she attacks out of turn, she gains a stack of Force Connection until the end of encounter. Leia gains 50 Speed whenever she gains a stack of Jedi Lessons  (stacking, max 150). Whenever another Jedi ally attacks out of turn, Leia assists (once per turn).

If Jedi Master Luke Skywalker is the ally in the Leader slot: Leia (Jedi Training)'s attacks will critically hit, if possible.

Whenever she attacks out of turn, Jedi Master Luke Skywalker gains 10% Max Protection (stacking, max 100%) until the end of battle.

When Jedi Master Luke Skywalker uses Heroic Stand, revive all Jedi allies with 100% Health and Protection and grant them Jedi Legacy until the end of battle. If no ally is defeated, all Jedi allies recover 100% Health and Protection.
data.UNIQUEABILITY_JEDILEIA02_TIER_07_DESC:
If Jedi Master Luke Skywalker is the ally in the Leader slot, Jedi allies have +100% Max Protection until the first time Leia (Jedi Training) is defeated. While Jedi Master Luke Skywalker is Taunting, whenever a non-Tank Jedi ally is damaged twice consecutively, that ally gains Stealth for 1 turn. Whenever an ally with Jedi Legacy uses an ability, the ally in the Leader slot gains 8% Ultimate charge. Whenever a Jedi ally damages an enemy, that ally recovers 20% Protection.

Whenever a Jedi ally uses Inherited Teachings for the first time, they gain a bonus turn. While a Jedi ally has more than 50% Health, their attacks ignore 50% of enemy's Protection. If they have equal to or less than 50% Health, their attacks have 100% Health Steal.

data.NEWSLETTER_ERA_BATTLES_NEW_REPUBLIC_SUMM:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

The next [c][F0FF23]Era Battles[-][/c] are coming!

We have two more Era Battles coming to you during the next Era! They are meant to test your Era of the New Republic units now that they have graduated to Legacy status. Each Era battle challenges a different sub-set of characters, with the rewards being identical between the two, giving you twice as many opportunities to earn these fantastic rewards.

We start with Shattered Empire, which uses Captain Carson Teva, R5-D4, and Zeb Orrelios (New Republic Pilot). Entry into each tier requires various levels of investment, ranging from 2-Stars all the way to Relic 9 and even Relic 10 for the best rewards. data.NEWSLETTER_SNOWTROOPER_COMMANDER_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

[c][F0FF23]Snowtrooper Commander[-][/c] is coming to the Holotables!

Following the Empire's collapse, scattered Imperial forces fought to maintain control of what remained of the Empire. Snowtrooper Commanders led small groups of Imperial units in some of the galaxy's harshest environments, helping maintain order and discipline among the Imperial Remnant's remaining forces.

[c][F0FF23]Snowtrooper Commander[-][/c] is a Tank and Leader built to protect Imperial Remnant allies while turning enemy pressure into opportunities for his squad. His Basic ability, [c][F0FF23]T-21B Blaster Rifle[-][/c], applies Vulnerable and helps Imperial Remnant allies capitalize on weakened enemies, while his first Special ability, [c][F0FF23]Hunker Down[-][/c], allows him to establish a strong defensive position and reinforce both Empire and Imperial Remnant allies. As enemies focus their attacks on Snowtrooper Commander, Imperial Remnant allies gain increased Defense Penetration and Turn Meter, allowing them to build momentum while he absorbs the enemy's attention.

His second Special ability, [c][F0FF23]Rifle Butt[-][/c], disrupts enemy plans by Stunning enemies while helping allies leverage Snowtrooper Commander's high Defense. It also helps protect vulnerable Imperial Remnant allies by concealing them with Stealth, making it more difficult for opponents to target the squad's key damage dealers. Meanwhile, his Unique ability, [c][F0FF23]Whiteout Conditions[-][/c], rewards Imperial Remnant allies for operating from the shadows, strengthening the squad whenever Snowtrooper Commander draws enemy attention or absorbs hostile attacks. Together, these abilities create a defensive core that enables Imperial Remnant squads to outlast and overwhelm their opponents.

As a Leader, [c][F0FF23]Warlord's Enforcer[-][/c] greatly improves the durability of Imperial Remnant allies while hindering enemies that attack out of turn or resist the squad's debuffs. With his Omicron in the 3v3 Grand Arenas game mode, Snowtrooper Commander further enhances Imperial Remnant teams with powerful Stealth synergies, additional survivability, and escalating battlefield pressure that grows throughout the encounter.

[c][F0FF23]Snowtrooper Commander[-][/c] is a requirement (at 6* and Era Level 110) for [b]Rotta the Hutt[/b] in the Journey Guide event to promote Rotta to 6*, and will be a requirement for this year’s [b]Galactic Legend[/b]. Unlock [c][F0FF23]Snowtrooper Commander[-][/c] in the upcoming [c][F0FF23]"IMPERIAL VANGUARD"[-][/c] Marquee event and bring a steadfast defender to your Imperial Remnant roster!

data.DATACRON_CHARACTER_BB8_001_DESC: At the start of battle, if all other allies are Droids, all allies gain the Resistance tag until the end of battle. At the start of battle, Resistance allies gain Secret Intel for 2 turns. Whenever an ally gains Secret Intel, Resistance allies gain 10% Critical Chance (stacking, max 100%) and Critical Damage (stacking, max 100%) until the end of the encounter. The first time a Resistance ally falls below 50% Health, BB-8 resets the cooldown of Illuminated Destiny. Whenever BB-8 uses a Special ability, inflict Buff Immunity on a random enemy for 2 turns, which can't be resisted.
data.DATACRON_CHARACTER_BISHOP_001_DESC: Whenever Colonel Ward inflicts a debuff on an enemy, she gains 30% Potency and Max Health (each stacking, max 150%) until the end of the encounter. Whenever a New Republic ally damages an Exposed enemy, that ally recovers 30% Protection and inflicts Ability Block on that enemy for 2 turns, which can't be resisted. Whenever Colonel Ward uses New Republic's Most Wanted, the target ally gains a bonus turn.
data.DATACRON_CHARACTER_CARSONTEVA_001_DESC: Carson Teva gains 30% Offense (stacking, max 150%) each time he counterattacks until the end of the encounter. Carson Teva can't be defeated while other allies are active. Whenever Carson Teva uses Keeping the Peace, a New Republic Tank ally assists. The first time each enemy reaches 5 stacks of On the Run, New Republic allies gain 50% Turn Meter until the end of battle. Carson Teva recovers 30% Health and Protection and gains 30% Critical Damage (stacking, max 180%) until the end of battle.
data.DATACRON_CHARACTER_DARKREY_001_DESC: Whenever Rey (Dark Side Vision) inflicts Fear, reduce the cooldowns of First Order allies by 1. Whenever Rey (Dark Side Vision) uses Malevolent Lineage, if all enemies are Shocked, deal bonus damage equal to 20% of their Max Health to all enemies, which can't be evaded. While Rey (Dark Side Vision) is Untargetable, she gains 20% Offense and First Order allies gain 20% Critical Damage.
data.DATACRON_CHARACTER_GOPHERANTS_001_DESC: Whenever Grogu & Anzellans uses Strapped In, the target New Republic ally also gains Critical Hit Immunity for 2 turns and 30% Turn Meter. Whenever Grogu & Anzellans uses Tune Up, New Republic allies also gain Protection (50%) and Speed Up for 2 turns. Whenever an enemy gains a stack of On the Run, Grogu & Anzellans gains 1 additional stack of Force Connection. Whenever an enemy with Force Influence uses an ability, that enemy deals bonus True damage equal to 30% of their Max Health to themselves, which can't be evaded.
data.DATACRON_CHARACTER_KYLORENUNMASKED_001_D: Whenever Kylo Ren (Unmasked) takes damage while Taunting, he gains 10% Defense (stacking, max 100%) and Max Health (stacking, max 100%) until the end of the encounter, and First Order allies gain 10% Offense (stacking, max 100%) until the end of the encounter. Whenever Kylo Ren (Unmasked) attacks out of turn, he inflicts Offense Down on target enemy for 2 turns. Whenever Kylo Ren (Unmasked) Stuns an enemy, increase that enemy's cooldowns by 1 and First Order allies gain Offense Up for 2 turns.
data.DATACRON_CHARACTER_R5D4_001_DESC: Whenever R5-D4 gains Retaliate, he also gains Defense Up and Potency Up for 2 turns. Whenever a New Republic ally counterattacks an enemy, that ally inflicts 2 stacks of Damage Over Time on that enemy for 2 turns, which can't be resisted. Whenever an enemy with Damage Over Time uses an ability, the ally in the Leader slot gains 30% Offense (stacking, max 210%) and reduces the cooldown of Bad Motivator by 5 until the end of the encounter.
data.DATACRON_CHARACTER_RACCOON_001_DESC: Rotta the Hutt's solo effects are active even when he has allies. Whenever Rotta the Hutt critically hits, he gains 10% Critical Chance (stacking, max 100%) until the end of the encounter. Whenever Rotta uses Knock 'Em Dead, if any enemy is inflicted with Off Balance, Hutt Cartel allies recover 15% Health and Protection. Whenever Rotta defeats an enemy, he gains 10% Offense (stacking, max 80%) until the end of the encounter.
data.DATACRON_CHARACTER_RANGERZEB_001_DESC: While Zeb Orrelios (New Republic Pilot) is Taunting, New Republic allies are immune to Ability Block, Daze, and Stun, can't be instantly defeated, and take 30% less damage. Whenever Zeb Orrelios (New Republic Pilot) loses Taunt, he gains Taunt for 1 turn. The first time Zeb Orrelios (New Republic Pilot), Carson Teva, R5-D4, Colonel Ward or Grogu & Anzellans falls below 50% Health, that ally gains Damage Immunity for 2 turns and New Republic allies gain 30% Turn Meter.
data.DATACRON_CHARACTER_REMNANTSNOWCOMMANDER_: At the start of Snowtrooper Commander's turn, he gains 15% Defense for each active Imperial Remnant ally for 1 turn. The first time each Imperial Remnant ally is defeated, Snowtrooper Commander revives that ally with 30% Health and Protection. Whenever an Imperial Remnant ally inflicts Ability Block on an enemy, that ally also inflicts Buff Immunity on that enemy for 2 turns. Whenever Snowtrooper Commander uses Rifle Butt, he inflicts Fracture until the start of Snowtrooper Commander's next turn or Snowtrooper Commander is defeated, which can't be copied, dispelled, or evaded.
data.DATACRON_FACTION_FIRSTORDER_004_DESC: At the start of battle, First Order allies gain 20% Health Steal, Offense, and Retribution for 1 turn. Whenever a First Order ally counterattacks, that ally gains 10% Critical Damage (stacking, max 50%) until the end of the encounter. Whenever a First Order ally Stuns an enemy, First Order allies recover 10% Health and Protection.
data.DATACRON_FACTION_RESISTANCE_004_DESC: Whenever a Resistance ally falls below 50% Health for the first time, that ally gains Protection Over Time (50%) for 2 turns. Whenever a Resistance ally scores a critical hit, that ally gains 10% Health Steal (stacking, max 100%) until the end of the encounter. Whenever any Resistance ally assists, that ally gains 15% Turn Meter. Whenever a Resistance ally defeats an enemy, Resistance allies gain 10% Critical Damage (stacking, max 150%) until the end of the encounter.
data.DATACRON_FACTION_RESISTANCE_005_DESC: Whenever a Resistance ally falls below 50% Health for the first time, they gain Protection Over Time (50%) for 2 turns. Whenever a Resistance ally scores a critical hit, they gain 5% Health Steal (stacking, max 25%) until the end of encounter. Whenever a Resistance ally defeats an enemy, Resistance allies gain 10% Critical Damage (stacking, max 50%) until the end of encounter.

[c][23C8F5]Lore:[-][/c]
-Yoda confronts his darker half, a dark half that represents the path not taken. Does Yoda have the strength to stand up to this corruption, or will his willpower waver and fall in the face of overwhelming darkness?

[c][23C8F5]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]
- Grand Master Yoda shifts between [c][F0FF23]Peace[-][/c], [c][F0FF23]Justice[-][/c], and [c][F0FF23]Guardian[-][/c] Stances at the start of each of his turns.
- Each Stance can only be damaged by a specific attack. Watch Grand Master Yoda's current Stance carefully and choose your action accordingly.
- Using the wrong attack will trigger a powerful counterattack and inflict additional penalties, making future turns more difficult.
- If Yoda (Dark Side Vision) cannot use the correct attack, consider using [c][F0FF23]Bide[-][/c] to recover Health and inflict the enemy with Healing Immunity before passing the turn. Be aware that using Bide will also Stun Yoda (Dark Side Vision), so use it when the tradeoff is worthwhile.
- Success depends on matching the correct ability to each Stance, managing cooldowns efficiently.
data.EVENT_MEESALESS_MASSACRE_TIER02_ERA_DESC:

[c][23C8F5]Lore:[-][/c]
-Imperial Stormtroopers have breached the hull of the Rebel blockade runner, causing the atmosphere to quickly escape. Our hero, Starkiller (Luke Concept), has donned a breath mask and faces off against the lightsaber and shield wielding Stormtroopers in an effort to escape the clutches of the Empire.

[c][23C8F5]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]
- At the start of each Stormtrooper (Concept)'s turn, [c][F0FF23]Air Supply[-][/c] is reduced for each buff that Stormtrooper has.
- If [c][F0FF23]Air Supply[-][/c] reaches 0%, the battle will end in defeat. Carefully manage enemy buffs to slow the loss of Air Supply.
- Starkiller (Luke Concept) can ignore [c][F0FF23]Taunt[-][/c], allowing him to target priority enemies regardless of active tanks.
- Pay close attention to the [c][F0FF23]TURN METER[-][/c] of each Stormtrooper (Concept) and decide which enemies need to be targeted before they take their turns.
- Starkiller (Luke Concept) can also inflict [c][F0FF23]Shared Fate[-][/c] as if Commander Luke Skywalker were in the leader slot, allowing damage dealt to spread rapidly across the enemy team.
- Proper timing of [c][F0FF23]Shared Fate[-][/c] and buff control will be key to preserving your Air Supply and defeating all enemies!

[c][23C8F5]Lore:[-][/c]
-In a throne room on Mount Tantiss, Mara Jade and Luke Skywalker face off against a clone of Luke made from the hand he lost on Cloud City. Mara Jade still hears the echoing last command from the Emperor: Kill Luke Skywalker, a command she has thus far resisted...

[c][23C8F5]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]
- Luuke Skywalker can only take damage while afflicted with [c][F0FF23]Blind[-][/c], [c][F0FF23]Off-Balance[-][/c], [c][F0FF23]Stagger[-][/c], or [c][F0FF23]Stun[-][/c].
- Use Mara Jade Skywalker and Jedi Knight Luke Skywalker's abilities carefully to stack the required debuffs on Luuke Skywalker before attempting to attack him.
- Pay close attention to which debuffs are currently active on Luuke Skywalker and plan your turns accordingly.
- Timing and debuff management are the key to victory, keep Luuke Skywalker controlled long enough for Mara Jade Skywalker to strike the decisive blow!

[c][23C8F5]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]
- In order to defeat each enemy, they must be affected by a specific debuff. Jaxxon must have Massively Overpowered , Viper must have Target Lock, and Cal Kestis has to be Manipulated when they are defeated.
- Defeating an enemy without their required debuff will cause them to revive.
- Pay close attention to enemy Health and avoid defeating targets before the proper debuff has been applied. Managing damage output and timing your abilities correctly will be essential to completing the encounter.
- One of the biggest challenges will be applying [c][F0FF23]Target Lock[-][/c] to Viper. Wait for Viper to inflict [c][F0FF23]Target Lock[-][/c], then use Yoda (Dark Side Vision) to transfer or spread the debuff back onto Viper before finishing her off.

data.NEWSLETTER_ERA_OF_MYTHS_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

[c][F0FF23]Era of Myths & Legends[-][/c] is coming to the Holotables!

Throughout Star Wars history, there have always been stories that exist just beyond the boundaries of the galaxy we know. Legends passed between fans, alternate paths never taken, concept art brought to life, and characters whose popularity grew into something much larger than their original appearances. The Era of Myths & Legends celebrates these unforgettable stories, bringing some of Star Wars' most fascinating untold destinies and fan-favorite legends to Galaxy of Heroes over the coming months.

Our first Marquee release is [c][F0FF23]Mara Jade Skywalker[-][/c]. One of the most beloved characters from Star Wars Legends, Mara Jade's journey from Emperor's Hand to Jedi Master has captivated fans for decades. She arrives ready to bring her unique perspective and powerful Force abilities to the Holotables.

The second Marquee character is [c][F0FF23]Yoda (Dark Side Vision)[-][/c]. Drawn from one of the most intriguing alternate possibilities in Star Wars history, this version of Yoda explores what might have happened had one of the Jedi Order's greatest Masters fallen to the dark side.

Next comes [c][F0FF23]Starkiller (Luke Concept)[-][/c], a character pulled directly from early concept explorations of Luke Skywalker. Inspired by Ralph McQuarrie's original artwork, he offers a glimpse into a version of Star Wars that almost was while reimagining one of the franchise's most iconic heroes. Following him is the fourth Marquee character, [c][F0FF23]Stormtrooper (Concept)[-][/c], which continues that celebration of Star Wars history by bringing one of the earliest visual interpretations of the Empire's soldiers into the game.

No Era of Myths & Legends would be complete without one of Star Wars' most unexpected fan favorites. [c][F0FF23]Jaxxon[-][/c], the green Lepi smuggler from the original Marvel Star Wars comics (and self-admitted real deep cut), hops into the Holotables with all the charm and adventure that made him a cult classic among fans.

Our final Marquee character is [c][F0FF23]The Ronin[-][/c]. Inspired by Star Wars: Visions, this wandering warrior walks a path unlike any other, blending familiar Star Wars themes with a striking interpretation of the galaxy far, far away.

All of this leads to the Journey Guide character for the Era: [c][F0FF23]Darth Jar Jar[-][/c]. This unexpected Sith Lord has become one of the galaxy's most memorable alternate-universe characters. Now, players will have the opportunity to unlock Darth Jar Jar and unleash the dark power lurking behind that familiar Gungan grin. Unlocking Darth Jar Jar will require having all the previous marquee characters from the Era of Myths & Legends at 4*. To improve the unit will require those same characters at 5*, 6*, and finally 7*/EL 125

We hope you enjoy the Era of Myths & Legends! From beloved Legends characters and classic concept art to alternate destinies, we're excited to bring some of Star Wars' most iconic and unexpected stories to the Holotables over the coming months!
data.NEWSLETTER_MARA_JADE_SKYWALKER_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

[c][F0FF23]Mara Jade Skywalker[-][/c] is coming to the Holotables!

Once the Emperor's most trusted Hand, Mara Jade forged a new destiny after the fall of the Empire. Guided by Luke Skywalker, she left her past behind to become a Jedi Master, eventually standing beside him as both a trusted ally and his wife while continuing to carve her own path as one of the Order's most formidable warriors. One of the most beloved characters from Star Wars Legends, Mara Jade Skywalker embodies the balance she found on her journey to the light.

[c][F0FF23]Mara Jade Skywalker[-][/c] is an Attacker who excels alongside Jedi Knight Luke Skywalker, rewarding coordinated attacks and relentless offensive pressure. Her Basic ability, [c][F0FF23]Two Halves[-][/c], showcases the pair's seamless teamwork, allowing them to strike in tandem and build momentum through coordinated follow-up attacks, while her first Special ability, [c][F0FF23]I Always Play Fair[-][/c], weakens enemy defenses and empowers Jedi allies to press the advantage. Together, Mara and Luke create a formidable partnership that grows stronger as the battle unfolds.

Her second Special ability, [c][F0FF23]The Last Command[-][/c] rewards Jedi allies for fighting together, becoming increasingly devastating as they launch coordinated attacks throughout the battle. Meanwhile, her Unique ability, [c][F0FF23]A Galactic Union[-][/c] reinforces Mara's role as a relentless attacker, granting powerful benefits to Jedi allies while strengthening her synergy with Jedi Knight Luke Skywalker. Their combined abilities create a highly mobile Jedi squad capable of maintaining constant pressure through teamwork and well-timed assist attacks.

While in Grand Arenas, Mara Jade Skywalker gains additional survivability, battlefield control, and powerful tools that target the enemy Leader, making her a formidable force against non-Galactic Legend squads. Unlock [c][F0FF23]Mara Jade Skywalker[-][/c] in the upcoming [c][F0FF23]"THE LAST COMMAND"[-][/c] Marquee event and reunite one of Star Wars Legends' most iconic Jedi partnerships on the Holotables!

data.NEWSLETTER_ERA_OF_MYTHS_UPDATE_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

As we prepare for the upcoming Era, we wanted to share an early look to help everyone plan their progression and make the most of the rewards available throughout the event. The information below is based on our current plans and may be adjusted as the Era progresses.

[b]Journey Guide Event Updates[/b]

Tier 2 of the Journey Guide Event once again rewards:
- 6,700 Mk VII Aurek Ability Modules
- 330 Mk VII Masterwork Performance Core

This should allow you to take 6 characters from Era Level 110 to Era Level 116.

[b]Marquee Event Updates[/b]

We've also made several adjustments to lower the rewards available during the first three Marquee events of the Era so that they’re more in line with the progression of the remaining Marquee events. For more detailed information on these changes, please refer to our post on the official forums.

We're excited to kick off the Era of Myths & Legends and can't wait to share everything we have in store over the coming months. We hope these updates help you prepare for the adventures ahead, and we'll see you on the Holotables!

data.NEWSLETTER_YODA_DARK_SIDE_VISION_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

[c][F0FF23]Yoda (Dark Side Vision)[-][/c] is coming to the Holotables!

During his journey to uncover the mysteries of the Force, Yoda was confronted with a terrifying vision of the darkness lurking within himself. This vision imagines one of the Jedi Order's greatest Masters embracing the power he spent a lifetime resisting, transforming his wisdom into a tool for domination rather than enlightenment.

[c][F0FF23]Yoda (Dark Side Vision)[-][/c] is a Sith Healer who strengthens his allies by turning the enemy's greatest advantages against them. His Basic ability, [c][F0FF23]Force Fisticuffs[-][/c], strikes twice, Dazes the target, and restores Health and Protection to Sith allies, with a chance to Stun enemies that were already Dazed. Meanwhile, [c][F0FF23]Consume, I Will[-][/c] damages all enemies, cleanses debuffs from Sith allies by transferring them to Yoda, then passes those debuffs to a target enemy before dispelling them from himself. Rather than relying on brute force, Yoda steadily erodes his opponents strength while reinforcing the resilience of his Sith companions.

His second Special ability, [c][F0FF23]Hear Me, You Will[-][/c] empowers a chosen Sith ally with Dark Master's Training while shrouding Yoda in Stealth and reinforcing the entire team with sustained healing effects, further strengthening Sith allies as the battle unfolds. Meanwhile, his first Unique ability, [c][F0FF23]Learn the Darkness, You Will[-][/c], grants Yoda Dark Master's Training at the start of battle and enhances all allies who receive it, allowing them to strip buffs with their Basic abilities, apply Buff Disruption with their Specials, recover Protection at the end of their turns, and take reduced damage from enemies attacking out of turn. His second Unique ability, [c][F0FF23]You are Weak... POWERLESS[-][/c], further bolsters Yoda's defenses while accelerating him whenever Sith allies are afflicted with debuffs, weakening enemy recovery, and sharing his growing Defense with the rest of the team as the battle progresses.

While in Territory Battles, Yoda (Dark Side Vision) greatly increases the durability of Sith squads, allowing them to resist control effects, share Dark Master's Training more easily, and steadily overpower even the toughest enemies. Yoda (Dark Side Vision) will be required at 4 stars and Era Level 90 to unlock [b]Darth Jar Jar[/b] in the [c][F0FF23]"TERRIBLE TINGS"[-][/c] Journey Guide event. Unlock [c][F0FF23]Yoda (Dark Side Vision)[-][/c] in the upcoming [c][F0FF23]"A DARK REFLECTION"[-][/c] Marquee event and witness one of the Force's darkest possibilities brought to life on the Holotables!

data.UNIQUEABILITY_JAXXON01_TIER_07_DESC_V2:
Jaxxon has +20% Critical Chance, Max Health, and +20 Speed. If any version of Lando Calrissian is an active ally, Jaxxon and every version of Lando gain 50% Critical Chance, Critical Damage, Max Health, and all allies are immune to Speed Down for 1 turn.

Whenever a Prepared ally loses Prepared, they gain Prepared. Whenever a Scoundrel ally gains Prepared, they gain 30% bonus Protection and Defense Penetration (stacking) until the end of battle.

At the start of each encounter, Scoundrel allies gain Prepared if they didn't have it and take a bonus turn.

Enemies defeated by Scoundrel allies can't be revived.

data.UNIQUEABILITY_OMEGAS301_DESC_V2:
Omega (Fugitive) has +5 Speed.

If Omega (Fugitive) is in the Leader slot, the first time each ally Omega (Fugitive), Batcher, Hunter (Mercenary), Wrecker (Mercenary), and Crosshair (Scarred) would be defeated:

- Remove all buffs and debuffs and they are inflicted with 10 stacks of Captive until the end of battle
- While Captive, they can't be targeted, they are immune to all damage, recovery, buffs, and debuffs, and they lose 1 stack of Captive whenever an ally takes a turn
- Bad Batch allies can contribute to their Rescue Objective
- If their Rescue Objective is met before they lose all stacks of Captive, they lose Captive and recover 100% Health and Protection; otherwise, they are instantly defeated
- If all allies are Captive this way, they immediately fail their Rescue Objective

data.EZRA_BRIDGER_EXILE_LIGHTSPEED_BUNDLE_INF:
[b]MERGE UNITS[/b]

Units included in the Lightspeed Bundle are upgraded according to a predetermined set of upgrade criteria (listed below). The Lightspeed Bundle does not directly grant character shards / ship blueprints or resources used in merge upgrades. The upgrade criteria are evaluated against your existing roster, and your units are set to the greater of the two values.

Each unit will first be evaluated for existing shards or star rarity against the bundle upgrade criteria. A unit at lower star rarity (or unactivated with less cumulative shards/blueprints) than the bundle upgrade criteria will be upgraded and activated. Units that exceed the star rarity (or cumulative shards/blueprints) will be activated (if unactivated) and then evaluated for additional attributes (gear tier, ability tier, etc). Any surplus shards/blueprints over the bundle upgrade criteria will be retained.

If your previously unlocked units meet or exceed the bundle upgrade criteria for other attributes, any surplus value will be retained.

- 7 Stars
- Level 85
- Relic Level 7
- Ability Tier 7

data.NEWSLETTER_STARKILLER_LUKE_CONCEPT_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

[c][F0FF23]Starkiller (Luke Concept)[-][/c] steps out of legend and onto the Holotables!

Long before Luke Skywalker became the hero audiences know today, the character was envisioned very differently during the earliest stages of Star Wars' development. Inspired by Ralph McQuarrie's iconic concept artwork, Starkiller (Luke Concept) celebrates one of the franchise's earliest creative ideas, paying tribute to the original surname and visual design that eventually evolved into Luke Skywalker. This unique interpretation offers a glimpse into a version of Star Wars that almost was.

[c][F0FF23]Starkiller (Luke Concept)[-][/c] is a Support who thrives alongside Commander Luke Skywalker, enhancing Rebel allies by amplifying their critical strikes and enabling powerful follow-up attacks. His Basic ability, [c][F0FF23]Laser-Sword Strike[-][/c], strips away enemy buffs, while his first Special ability, [c][F0FF23]Son of the Suns[-][/c] introduces the Shared Fate effect, allowing damage dealt to a single enemy to ripple across the opposing squad. Together with Commander Luke Skywalker, the pair create devastating opportunities to pressure multiple enemies at once.

His second Special ability, [c][F0FF23]The Grip of Tython[-][/c] disrupts the enemy team with Ability Block while reinforcing Rebel allies by dispelling debuffs and increasing their Offense through stacking bonuses. Meanwhile, his Unique ability, [c][F0FF23]The Force of Others[-][/c] transforms Commander Luke Skywalker's Rebel squad into an even greater threat by rewarding critical hits, spreading Guard to additional allies, and creating new opportunities to control the flow of battle through Shared Fate.

While in Grand Arenas, Starkiller (Luke Concept) further enhances Rebel teams by granting Rebel allies Defense Penetration on out-of-turn attacks, improving their survivability and maintaining pressure on enemies afflicted with Shared Fate. He is required at 4 stars for the upcoming [c][F0FF23]"TERRIBLE TINGS"[-][/c] Journey Guide event to unlock [b]Darth Jar Jar[/b] and will be needed at 5 stars and Era Level 95 to promote Darth Jar Jar to 5 stars during the Era.

Unlock [c][F0FF23]Starkiller (Luke Concept)[-][/c] in the upcoming [c][F0FF23]"ANCIENT RECKONING"[-][/c] Marquee event and discover one of Star Wars' earliest visions brought to life on the Holotables!

Units included in the Lightspeed Bundle are upgraded according to a predetermined set of upgrade criteria (listed below). The Lightspeed Bundle does not directly grant character shards / ship blueprints or resources used in merge upgrades. The upgrade criteria are evaluated against your existing roster, and your units are set to the greater of the two values.

A unit at lower star rarity (or unactivated with less cumulative shards/blueprints) than the bundle upgrade criteria will be upgraded and activated. Units that exceed the star rarity (or cumulative shards/blueprints) will be activated (if unactivated) and then evaluated for additional attributes (gear tier, ability tier, etc). Any surplus shards/blueprints over the bundle upgrade criteria will be retained.

data.NEWSLETTER_STORMTROOPER_CONCEPT_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

[c][F0FF23]Stormtrooper (Concept)[-][/c] steps out of Star Wars history and onto the Holotables!

Based on Ralph McQuarrie's iconic early concept artwork, Stormtrooper (Concept) brings one of the original visions for the Empire's soldiers to life. Long before the familiar white armor and blaster rifles became synonymous with Imperial might, these early designs depicted armored enforcers wielding distinctive shields and laser-swords. As part of the Era of Myths & Legends, this classic concept joins Galaxy of Heroes as a tribute to the artwork that helped define the look and feel of Star Wars.

[c][F0FF23]Stormtrooper (Concept)[-][/c] is a Tank built to stand at the front of Imperial Trooper squads, protecting allies while punishing enemies who dare attack him. His Basic ability, [c][F0FF23]Enforcer's Blade[-][/c], grants him Defense Up and allows him to recover Health and Protection if he is buffed, while [c][F0FF23]Linebreaker[-][/c] Stuns the target enemy and bolsters the Imperial Trooper line with protective effects, while also opening windows for Attacker allies to capitalize and push the assault forward.

His Unique ability, [c][F0FF23]Alderaan Prison Security[-][/c], turns Stormtrooper (Concept) into a relentless protector for Imperial Trooper squads. While he is Taunting, he becomes even harder to bring down and strikes back at anyone who tries to focus him. He also keeps his fellow Troopers safer, bolstering their defenses and stepping in to shield the first ally who begins to falter. In Grand Arenas, his presence becomes even more disruptive, helping the squad endure longer, punishing control effects by dispelling Daze and granting Turn Meter, and maintaining pressure by allowing allies to call another random ally to assist.

Stormtrooper (Concept) will be required at 4 stars to unlock Darth Jar Jar in the "TERRIBLE TINGS" Journey Guide event and at 7 stars and Era Level 125 to access the final tier of the event. Unlock [c][F0FF23]Stormtrooper (Concept)[-][/c] in the upcoming [c][F0FF23]"BLADE AND BASTION"[-][/c] Marquee event and command one of Star Wars' earliest Imperial designs on the Holotables!

data.EVENT_MEESALESS_MASSACRE_TIER01_ERA_DESC:
[c][ACFEFF][c][23C8F5]Victory Counts:[-][/c]
- Unlimited (1x rewards only)

[c][23C8F5]Borrowed:[-][/c]
- Yoda (Dark Side Vision) (EL: 130)

[c][23C8F5]Lore:[-][/c]
- Yoda confronts his darker half, a dark half that represents the path not taken. Does Yoda have the strength to stand up to this corruption, or will his willpower waver and fall in the face of overwhelming darkness?

[c][23C8F5]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]
- Grand Master Yoda shifts between [c][F0FF23]Peace[-][/c], [c][F0FF23]Justice[-][/c], and [c][F0FF23]Guardian[-][/c] Stances at the start of each of his turns.
- Each Stance can only be damaged by a specific attack. Watch Grand Master Yoda's current Stance carefully and choose your ability accordingly.
- Using the wrong attack will trigger a powerful counterattack and inflict additional penalties.
- If Yoda (Dark Side Vision) cannot use the correct attack, consider using [c][F0FF23]Bide[-][/c] to recover Health and inflict the enemy with Healing Immuity before passing the turn. Be aware that using Bide will also Stun Yoda (Dark Side Vision), so use it when the tradeoff is worthwhile.
- Success depends on matching the correct ability to each Stance, managing cooldowns efficiently.
data.EVENT_MEESALESS_MASSACRE_TIER02_ERA_DESC:
[c][ACFEFF][c][23C8F5]Victory Counts:[-][/c]
- Unlimited (1x rewards only)

[c][23C8F5]Borrowed:[-][/c]
- Starkiller (Luke Concept) (EL: 130)

[c][23C8F5]Lore:[-][/c]
- Stormtroopers have breached the hull of the Rebel blockade runner, causing the atmosphere to quickly escape. Our hero, Starkiller (Luke Concept), has donned a breath mask and faces off against the lightsaber and shield wielding Stormtroopers in an effort to escape the clutches of the Empire.

[c][23C8F5]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]
- At the start of each Stormtrooper (Concept)'s turn, [c][F0FF23]Air Supply[-][/c] is reduced for each buff that Stormtrooper has.
- If [c][F0FF23]Air Supply[-][/c] reaches 0%, the battle will end in defeat. Carefully manage enemy buffs to slow the loss of Air Supply.
- Starkiller (Luke Concept) can ignore [c][F0FF23]Taunt[-][/c], allowing him to target priority enemies regardless of active tanks.
- Pay close attention to the [c][F0FF23]TURN METER[-][/c] of each Stormtrooper (Concept) and decide which enemies need to be targeted before they take their turns.
- Starkiller (Luke Concept) can also inflict [c][F0FF23]Shared Fate[-][/c] as if Commander Luke Skywalker were in the leader slot, allowing damage dealt to spread rapidly across the enemy team.
- Proper timing of [c][F0FF23]Shared Fate[-][/c] and buff control will be key to preserving your [c][F0FF23]Air Supply[-][/c] and defeating all enemies!
data.EVENT_MEESALESS_MASSACRE_TIER03_ERA_DESC:

- Mara Jade Skywalker (EL: 130)
- Jedi Knight Luke Skywalker (EL: 130)

[c][23C8F5]Lore:[-][/c]
-In a throne room on Mount Tantiss, Mara Jade and Luke Skywalker face off against a clone of Luke made from the hand he lost on Cloud City. Mara Jade still hears the echoing last command from the Emperor,"Kill Luke Skywalker", a command she has thus far resisted...

[c][23C8F5]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]
- Luuke Skywalker can only take damage while afflicted with 2 or more of the following debuffs:[c][F0FF23]Blind[-][/c], [c][F0FF23]Defense Down[-][/c], [c][F0FF23]Stagger[-][/c], [c][F0FF23]Stun[-][/c], [c][F0FF23]Vulnerable[-][/c].
- Use Mara Jade Skywalker and Jedi Knight Luke Skywalker's abilities carefully to stack the required debuffs on Luuke Skywalker before attempting to attack him.
- Pay close attention to which debuffs are currently active on Luuke Skywalker and plan your turns accordingly.
- Timing and debuff management are the key to victory, keep Luuke Skywalker controlled long enough for Mara Jade Skywalker to strike the decisive blow!

data.EVENT_MEESALESS_MASSACRE_TIER04_ERA_DESC:
[c][ACFEFF][c][23C8F5]Victory Counts:[-][/c]
- Unlimited (1x rewards only)

[c][23C8F5]Borrowed:[-][/c]
- Darth Jar Jar (EL: 130)
- Rey (Dark Side Vision) (EL: 130)
- Yoda (Dark Side Vision) (EL: 130)

[c][23C8F5]Lore:[-][/c]
- Shuffling off the disguise of a goofy sidekick, Darth Jar Jar takes the reigns as the dark mastermind in a universe that reimagines characters from across a rebuilt galaxy.

[c][23C8F5]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]
- In order to defeat each enemy, they must be affected by a specific debuff. Jaxxon must have [c][F0FF23]Massively Overpowered[-][/c] , Viper must have [c][F0FF23]Target Lock[-][/c], and Cal Kestis has to be [c][F0FF23]Manipulated[-][/c] when they are defeated.
- Defeating an enemy without their required debuff will cause them to revive.
- One of the biggest challenges will be applying [c][F0FF23]Target Lock[-][/c] to Viper. Wait for Viper to inflict [c][F0FF23]Target Lock[-][/c], then use Yoda (Dark Side Vision) to transfer or spread the debuff back onto Viper before finishing her off.
- Jaxxon will receive [c][F0FF23]Massively Overpowered[-][/c] when Darth Jar Jar, Rey (Dark Side Vision) and Yoda (Dark Side Vision) have [c][F0FF23]Dark Master's Training[-][/c].
- If Darth Jar Jar, Rey (Dark Side Vision) or Yoda (Dark Side Vision) are defeated, the battle will end in defeat.

Bounty Hunter Mercenary allies have +100% Defense Penetration and Max Health. Whenever a Bounty Hunter Mercenary ally takes a bonus turn, their cooldowns are reduced by 1 and whenever they use an ability on that turn, they Stun the target enemy for 1 turn and they deal an additional instance of damage to target enemy for each bonus turn that ally has gained (max 4), which can't be evaded.

While an enemy is inflicted with Embo & Keibu's Captive, Bounty Hunter Mercenary allies gain Ransom until end of battle whenever the following happens, which can't be copied, dispelled, or prevented:

- Gain 2 stacks whenever an enemy gains a dispellable buff

Otherwise, the Captive enemy is inflicted with Torture for the rest of the encounter, which can't be dispelled, evaded, or resisted.

data.NEWSLETTER_DARTH_JAR_JAR_EVENT_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

[c][F0FF23]Darth Jar Jar[-][/c] is coming to the Holotables!

One of Star Wars' most unexpected alternate visions finally arrives in Galaxy of Heroes. A long-hidden Sith identity revealed, Darth Jar Jar transforms the galaxy's most underestimated Gungan into a calculating master of manipulation. Behind every clumsy stumble lies careful planning, every accident conceals intent, and every move brings his enemies one step closer to defeat.

[c][F0FF23]Darth Jar Jar[-][/c] is a Sith Leader who doesn't simply command the battlefield; he quietly reshapes it around his enemies. His Basic ability, [c][F0FF23]Mesa Going to Hurt Yousa[-][/c] weakens the opposition with Shock and Tenacity Down while strengthening Sith allies, but his true plan begins with [c][F0FF23]Yousa People Gonna Die[-][/c]. By Manipulating a chosen enemy, Darth Jar Jar turns them into an unwitting pawn, using their own actions to spread chaos throughout the opposing squad. Before his enemies realize they're playing into his hands, the battle has already begun to unravel.

That deception reaches its peak through [c][F0FF23]Letten the Haten Flow[-][/c], where Darth Jar Jar Siphons Max Protection from his opponents to empower his Sith allies, transforming the enemy's greatest advantages into his own. His Unique ability, [c][F0FF23]The Phantom Menace[-][/c], and Leader ability, [c][F0FF23]Da Force Shall Freein Mesa[-][/c] reward careful planning rather than reckless aggression, orchestrating a web of Marks and Manipulation to unleash carefully timed counter plays. Whether empowering Darth Sidious, directing Darth Maul toward priority targets, or baiting enemies into costly mistakes, Darth Jar Jar ensures every Sith ally plays their part in his grand design.

While in Grand Arenas, Darth Jar Jar's schemes become even more oppressive as his Manipulated victims fuel the strength of the entire Sith squad while attempts to control his allies are swiftly turned back on their attackers. Unlock [c][F0FF23]Darth Jar Jar[-][/c] in the upcoming [c][F0FF23]"TERRIBLE TINGS"[-][/c] Journey Guide event and discover what happens when the galaxy's greatest fool reveals himself to be its greatest threat.
data.NEWSLETTER_EMBO_KEIBU_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

[c][F0FF23]Embo & Keibu[-][/c] are coming to the Holotables!

Decades after making a name for himself as one of the galaxy's most formidable bounty hunters during the Clone Wars, Embo remained on the hunt. Taken directly from The Mandalorian and Grogu, this version of the renowned Kyuzo bounty hunter unites him with his loyal anooba companion, Keibu. Older, experienced, and no less dangerous, the pair brings a lifetime spent pursuing the galaxy's most elusive quarry to Galaxy of Heroes.

[c][F0FF23]Embo & Keibu[-][/c] lead a Bounty Hunter Mercenary squad that turns bonus turns into a deadly game of pursuit. Their Basic ability, [c][F0FF23]Anooba Ambush[-][/c], inflicts the target with Bleed while feeding Turn Meter back to Embo & Keibu, and their first Special ability, [c][F0FF23]Kyuzo Hat Trick[-][/c], gives Embo & Keibu the tools to crack Tanks or punch through less durable opponents. With a full Bounty Hunter Mercenary squad, these attacks can hand bonus turns directly to Embo & Keibu's fellow hunters, letting the right Mercenary leap into action exactly when they're needed.

Their second Special ability, [c][F0FF23]Flush Out the Quarry[-][/c], is where the hunt truly begins. Embo & Keibu can take an enemy Captive while marking another for Ambush, setting the stage for their Leader ability, [c][F0FF23]Business Is Business[-][/c], to turn the enemy's actions against them. While Embo & Keibu hold an enemy Captive, enemy buffs, dispels, and out-of-turn attacks build Ransom. Collect enough before Embo & Keibu's next turn and the Captive is released and left Exposed. Come up short, and the quarry is Tortured for the rest of the encounter. Meanwhile, every bonus turn taken by Embo & Keibu's crew becomes increasingly dangerous, reducing cooldowns, Stunning targets, and adding additional attacks as the hunt continues.

Completing Embo & Keibu's Contract unlocks the granted ability, [c][F0FF23]Smoke and Shadow[-][/c], giving the pair a chance to disappear from sight, tend to an injured ally, and leave enemies who attacked their crew with reduced Offense. Their Unique ability, [c][F0FF23]Soldier of Fortune[-][/c], gives Embo & Keibu another resource to exploit as enemy buffs are stripped away, providing additional Offense for Bounty Hunter Mercenary allies while allowing Embo & Keibu to trade accumulated stacks for Protection recovery and greater Critical Damage.

As a Conquest character, Embo & Keibu bring a new Leader to the Bounty Hunter Mercenary squad with tools for Grand Arenas, Territory Battles, and Territory Wars. Choose your quarry, collect your Ransom, and make sure the galaxy remembers the most important rule of bounty hunting: business is business.
data.NEWSLETTER_EMBO_KEIBU_TITLE: No Country for Old Bounty Hunters
data.NEWSLETTER_JAXXON_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

[c][F0FF23]Jaxxon[-][/c] is bounding his way onto the Holotables!

First appearing in Marvel's original Star Wars comics, Jaxxon is one of the galaxy's most memorable rogues. The green Lepi adventurer earned a reputation for quick reflexes, quicker wit, and an uncanny knack for finding trouble alongside Lando Calrissian and his fellow Scoundrels. Decades later, this fan-favorite Legends character finally bounds into Galaxy of Heroes, bringing his trademark charm—and plenty of firepower—with him.

[c][F0FF23]Jaxxon[-][/c] is an Attacker who keeps Scoundrel squads moving with rapid-fire attacks and strong Prepared synergies. His Basic ability, [c][F0FF23]Blaster's Up, Doc[-][/c], rewards Prepared allies by giving them Turn Meter, while [c][F0FF23]Hop 'Til You Drop[-][/c] throws key enemies Off Balance before they have a chance to respond. Whether darting around the battlefield or opening the door for his allies, Jaxxon thrives in the middle of the action.

His second Special ability, [c][F0FF23]Fluffle Shuffle[-][/c] delivers a burst of damage that becomes even more dangerous when his allies have Prepared. Meanwhile, his Unique ability, [c][F0FF23]Starship Down[-][/c] celebrates Jaxxon's long-standing friendship with Lando Calrissian, rewarding the duo with powerful bonuses while reinforcing the entire Scoundrel squad. Even when the odds catch up to him, Jaxxon has one more trick up his sleeve, slipping away into Stealth before jumping right back into the fight.

While in Territory Battles, Jaxxon turns Scoundrel squads into an even greater force through enhanced Prepared synergies, increased survivability, and explosive opening turns that keep opponents on the back foot.

Jaxxon will be required at 4 stars to unlock [b]Darth Jar Jar[/b] in the upcoming [c][F0FF23]"TERRIBLE TINGS"[-][/c] Journey Guide event and at 7 stars and Era Level 125 to access the final tier of the event. Unlock [c][F0FF23]Jaxxon[-][/c] in the upcoming [c][F0FF23]"ACTION JAXXON"[-][/c] Marquee event and welcome one of the most unexpected heroes from Star Wars Legends to your Scoundrel roster!

data.NEWSLETTER_ERA_BATTLES_MYTHS_LEGENDS_DES:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

The next [c][F0FF23]Era Battles[-][/c] are coming!

We have two more Era Battles coming to you during the next Era! They are meant to test your Era of Myths & Legends units now that they have graduated to Legacy status. Each Era battle challenges a different sub-set of characters, with the rewards being identical between the two, giving you twice as many opportunities to earn these fantastic rewards.

We start with Mirrored Paths, which uses Darth Jar Jar, Stormtrooper (Concept), The Ronin, and Yoda (Dark Side Vision). Entry into each tier requires various levels of investment, ranging from 2-Stars all the way to Relic 9 and even Relic 10 for the best rewards. In order to enter and play Tiers 3 and higher of the event you will need to have unlocked Darth Jar Jar. Darth Jar Jar can also be used across all tiers of this half of the event.

Next will come Echoes of Legend, which has the same entry requirements as Mirrored Paths, only on a different set of characters: Mara Jade Skywalker, Jaxxon, and Starkiller (Luke Concept). While Darth Jar Jar will be required to enter Tiers 3 and higher of the event, he will not be a playable unit.

data.NEWSLETTER_THERONIN_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

[c][F0FF23]The Ronin[-][/c] arrives on the Holotables!

Inspired by the acclaimed Star Wars: Visions anthology, The Ronin walks a solitary path through the galaxy, carrying the weight of a mysterious past and an unwavering resolve. Neither bound by the traditions of the Jedi nor the ambitions of the Sith, this wandering warrior follows his own code, accompanied only by his loyal droid, R5-D56.

[c][F0FF23]The Ronin[-][/c] is a Sith Attacker who excels at dismantling resilient enemies through precise strikes and relentless pressure. His Basic ability, [c][F0FF23]Wandering Steel Hums[-][/c], builds stacking damage for his Special ability while granting Offense Up, steadily increasing his lethality over the course of the battle. Meanwhile, his Special ability, [c][F0FF23]Oaths Buried Beneath Silence[-][/c] delivers heavy damage against enemies with Resilient Defense or Taunt, inflicts Armor Shred and Bleed, and Siphons Critical Damage to further empower the Ronin and his droid companion.

His Unique ability, [c][F0FF23]Mercy Left Behind[-][/c] builds toward a powerful turning point in battle, as the Ronin gradually sheds Boiling Point stacks until R5-D56 is summoned to the field. When paired with a Gungan Sith Leader and Sith Healer, The Ronin burns through Boiling Point stacks rapidly, allowing R5-D56 to join the fight as early as the first turn. Once active, R5-D56 complements the Ronin with the ability to inflict more stacks of Bleed, Shock the enemy, and use powerful Siphon effects that steal Critical Chance from enemies while fueling the duo's offensive potential. Together, they steadily build strength, punishing enemies who rely on defensive effects and creating openings for Sith allies to capitalize on weakened foes.

While in Territory Wars, the Ronin and R5-D56 become an even more dangerous partnership, rewarding Sith squads with increased Turn Meter gains, heightened damage output, and the ability to steadily strip power from their foes with Siphon while accelerating their own squad. He is required at 4 stars for the upcoming [c][F0FF23]"TERRIBLE TINGS"[-][/c] Journey Guide event to unlock [b]Darth Jar Jar[/b].

Unlock [c][F0FF23]The Ronin[-][/c] in the upcoming [c][F0FF23]"A WANDERER'S BLADE"[-][/c] Marquee event and bring this legendary swordsman and his loyal companion to your Sith roster!

data.NEWSLETTER_ADELPHI_RANGER_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

[c][F0FF23]Adelphi Ranger[-][/c] is patrolling her way onto the Holotables!

Stationed in the untamed expanses of the Outer Rim, the rangers operating out of Adelphi Base serve as the fledgling New Republic's frontline shield and peacekeeping force. Patrolling lawless sectors far beyond the oversight of the Core Worlds, these vigilant pilots and ground scouts keep a watchful eye over remote territories, stepping directly into harm's way to protect isolated settlements and maintain order in an uncertain galaxy.

Our [c][F0FF23]Adelphi Ranger[-][/c] is a steadfast Tank designed to control the flow of combat, absorb incoming fire, and build defensive momentum through [c][F0FF23]Bulwark[-][/c]. Her Basic ability, [c][F0FF23]Practiced Shot[-][/c], inflicts Defense Down while accumulating Bulwark on her own turn, or punishing hostile aggression by inflicting Daze when firing during enemy turns. When her squadron requires immediate cover, her first Special ability, [c][F0FF23]Sentinel's Strike[-][/c], forces enemy attention onto her with Taunt while calling all New Republic allies to assist and restoring hefty Protection when deployed under the leadership of Captain Carson Teva.

Her second Special ability, [c][F0FF23]Adelphi Cavalry[-][/c], brings in heavy fire support by stripping all enemy buffs, striking every foe with Physical damage, and inflicting an undispellable stack of [c][F0FF23]On the Run[-][/c] while reinforcing her New Republic allies with multiple stacks of Bulwark. Through her Unique ability, [c][F0FF23]Rodian Ranger[-][/c], she acts as Captain Carson Teva’s ultimate bodyguard: so long as no Galactic Legends are present, Carson Teva can't be defeated while she is Taunting. She grants Riposte to New Republic allies that gain Retribution, rewards squad counterattacks with extra Bulwark, and draws fire from Droid allies by intercepting their Taunts, granting them Outmaneuver, and Taunting in their stead.

While in Grand Arenas, Adelphi Ranger’s Omicron elevates New Republic squads to elite defensive powerhouses. New Republic allies gain massive additional Health and Protection, and the entire team recovers 50% Health and Protection whenever she Taunts, loses Taunt, or calls in [c][F0FF23]Adelphi Cavalry[-][/c]. Furthermore, pairing her with [c][F0FF23]R5-D4[-][/c] supercharges the squad: other allies taking hits while she is Taunting rapidly reduces the cooldown of [c][F0FF23]Bad Motivator[-][/c], which when used triggers team-wide dispels, locked Healing Immunity, targeted Marked debuffs on enemy Supports and Healers, and a devastating 9 stacks of [c][F0FF23]On the Run[-][/c] on the weakest foe.

[c][F0FF23]Adelphi Ranger[-][/c] will be a requirement at Era Level 74 (Relic 7) for this year’s [b]Galactic Legend[/b]. Unlock [c][F0FF23]Adelphi Ranger[-][/c] in the upcoming [c][F0FF23]"GREEN RANGER"[-][/c] Marquee event and bring unwavering protection to your New Republic roster!

data.NEWSLETTER_ERA_THE_MANDALORIAN_AND_GROGU:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

[c][F0FF23]Era of The Mandalorian and Grogu[-][/c] is coming to the Holotables!

This specialized single-episode "Mini-Era" is centered entirely on the highly anticipated release of Galactic Legend [c][F0FF23]The Mandalorian and Grogu[-][/c]. Unlike our standard 12-week, three-episode Eras, this event runs on a condensed 4-week timetable specifically designed to highlight this Galactic Legend arrival. Galactic Legend [c][F0FF23]The Mandalorian and Grogu[-][/c] will not be an Era character, and will be immediately usable in Legacy content like Grand Arenas, Territory Battles, and Territory Wars. Following this Mini-Era, the game will return to our normal 12-week schedule.

Galactic Legend Event & Timer Notice:

• The Galactic Legend event timer displayed in-game will appear inaccurate as an overall event duration. This timer actually indicates the remaining time available to enter the event using Era Level requirements.
• Once this timer expires, the event will temporarily conclude. A new permanent run of the event will launch shortly after the era ends, featuring standard Legacy Relic requirements.
• Note that the bespoke Datacron for Galactic Legend The Mandalorian and Grogu awarded from the event will also be removed from rewards once this era concludes. Players who acquired the datacron will still be able to use it until it expires as usual. 

Marquees & Leveling:

• Two Marquee units will be released during this Mini-Era on the standard two-week cadence and are required at Era Level 74 to unlock Galactic Legend The Mandalorian and Grogu.
• To enable you to max out your characters within the shorter 4-week window, we have changed the Era Level requirements so that you can reach your desired Gear and Relic tiers at a much lower Era Level than in previous eras. (For this era only.) However, there will still be Era Levels that require specific Star rarities to hit them. The maximum Era Level during this era will be 75 (requiring 7-stars on the character), which will convert to Relic 8 and ability level 8. 
• Since the level requirements are much easier for this era, Mk VII and Mk VIII materials are required for era unit levels 66–75.

Coliseum Boss & Economy:

• The maximum tier for the Coliseum Boss is capped at Tier 8.
• Additional Era Currency has been added to Tiers 7 & 8 of the Coliseum Bosses exclusively for this era.

Loaned Units & Calendar:

• Loaned Units are tailored specifically for this condensed window to ensure smooth progression.
• The Loaned Unit Era Level Increase Calendar has been shortened to 26 days, still granting a total of 54 loaned unit era level increases.

End-of-Era Conversion

• The End-of-Era Conversion table seen in game is temporarily incorrect as it still points to 135 levels.
• The max Era Level 75 will convert to Relic 8 and ability level 8. Other level conversions can be found in a post on our official forums.

For more detailed information on these changes, please refer to our post on the official forums.

See you on the Holotables!
Era of The Mandalorian and Grogu Economy Updates

When all stacks of Mercenary Battalion expire, Mercenary Guard Droid is immediately destroyed. Mercenary Guard Droid is immune to Damage Over Time and their Max Health and Max Protection can't be increased.

When Mercenary Guard Droid takes damage, they dispel all debuffs on themselves and lose 6 stacks of Mercenary Battalion (max 18 per turn). If they are Taunting, lose 3 stacks instead. At the start of Mercenary Guard Droid's turn, they gain 3 stacks of Mercenary Battalion. Mercenary Guard Droid has +5 stacks of Mercenary Battalion for each Relic Amplifier level they have. Mercenary Guard Droid can't gain Spare Parts and can't be revived.

[c][ffff33]Mercenary Battalion:[-][/c] Each stack grants Mercenary Guard Droid +0.5% Potency and Mercenary allies +0.5% Critical Avoidance and Defense
