data.UNIQUEABILITY_THERONIN01_TIER_07_DESC_V2:
At the start of battle, The Ronin gains 10 stacks of [c][ffff33]Boiling Point[-][/c], which can't be copied or dispelled. At the start of each of his turns, he dispels 1 stack. If there is a Gungan Sith ally in the Leader slot, dispel an additional 5 stacks. If there is a Sith Healer ally, dispel an additional 5 stacks. When Boiling Point expires, summon R5-D56.

The Ronin has +50% Critical Damage. Whenever a Manipulated enemy begins their turn, The Ronin gains Advantage for 1 turn. At the start of his turn, he gains 25% Critical Damage (stacking) for each enemy with Resilient Defense, Stealth, or Taunt until the end of his turn.

Whenever The Ronin or R5-D56 scores a critical hit, both gain 3 Siphon until the end of the encounter. When R5-D56 is summoned, The Ronin gains 30% Defense Penetration and Max Health until end of battle and all Sith allies gain 100% Bonus Protection for 1 turn. Whenever an enemy attacks out of turn, The Ronin gains 10% Turn Meter.

[c][ffff33]Boiling Point:[-][/c] When stacks reach zero, R5-D56 is summoned.

[c][e7e7e7]While in Territory Wars, all allies are non-Galactic Legend Sith:[-][/c] While R5-D56 is active, The Ronin gains 50 Speed. While The Ronin is active, R5-D56 gains 50% Offense. Whenever The Ronin attacks the enemy in the Leader slot, he gains Alert and Speed Up for 2 turns. Whenever a Manipulated enemy starts their turn, The Ronin and R5-D56 gain 5 Siphon until the end of the encounter.

The first time allies gain Emergency Powers, they gain 50% Defense Penetration for the rest of the encounter. Whenever an enemy with Bleed gains Resilient Defense, Stealth, or Taunt, they lose 10% Max Health (stacking) and The Ronin gains 10% Turn Meter.

- Yoda confronts his darker half, a dark half that represents the path not taken. Does Yoda have the strength to stand up to this corruption, or will his willpower waver and fall in the face of overwhelming darkness?

[c][23C8F5]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]

data.GLMANDOGROGU_GUIDE_DESCRIPTION: Orphaned by the Clone Wars, the young Din Djarin was raised as a foundling by the strict Mandalorian sect known as the Children of the Watch. After the Galactic Civil War, he made a name for himself as a mercenary and bounty hunter, though few knew his real name, knowing him as "The Mandalorian" or "Mando." On a job that would change everything, Djarin was sent to recover an unknown asset that turned out to be Grogu, a Force-sensitive child of an unknown species and a survivor of Order 66. From that day on their fates were intertwined, as the two faced dangers from pirates, strange beasts, the Imperial Remnant, and even the Hutt Cartel. In time, Djarin grew to consider Grogu his adopted son, as Grogu considered him a father in turn.

data.NEWSLETTER_GL_MANDO_AND_GROGU_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

[c][F0FF23]Galactic Legend The Mandalorian and Grogu[-][/c] are arriving on the Holotables!

Capturing the legendary duo just moments before their assault on the twins' palace on Nal Hutta, this version of Din Djarin and Grogu brings the full might of their unbreakable bond and lethal arsenal to Galaxy of Heroes. Outfitted with dual blades, flamethrowers, and heavy explosive charges, Mando carves through enemy lines with relentless physical precision while Grogu channels chaotic telekinetic Force power to disrupt enemy formations, strip vital defenses, and protect his allies.

[c][F0FF23]The Mandalorian and Grogu[-][/c] take the frontline as a Light Side Galactic Legend Attacker and Leader designed to head a New Republic squad. Their presence dictates the pace of battle by spreading un-dispellable stacks of [c][F0FF23]On the Run[-][/c] across the opposing squad. Through their Unique ability, [c][F0FF23]Bound by Creed[-][/c], the pair operates in continuous synergy: Grogu takes a turn, ignoring Taunt, and then Mando follows up with a turn of his own.

With Mando’s Basic ability, [c][F0FF23]Twin Strike[-][/c], The Mandalorian attacks twice with stacking Offense and Retribution, generating rapid Contract progress and applying un-dispellable stacks of [c][F0FF23]On the Run[-][/c]. When preceded by Grogu's ability, [c][F0FF23]Force Splinter[-][/c], this attack inflicts Fear to completely stop the target in their tracks. Grogu can alternatively use [c][F0FF23]And Then the Young Protect the Old[-][/c] to clear debuffs from an ally, restore Health and Protection, and empower New Republic teammates with Retribution, Potency Up, and Retaliate.

Mando’s first Special ability, [c][F0FF23]The Old Protect the Young[-][/c], inflicts area-of-effect damage, Provoking enemies while distributing tailored defensive buffs across New Republic roles. Mando’s second Special ability, [c][F0FF23]Bring You In Warm or Cold[-][/c], unleashes a flamethrower and pistol shot that inflicts Burning, heavy stacks of [c][F0FF23]On the Run[-][/c], and Armor Shred on burning foes. Depending on the abilities Grogu uses on his turn, this ability can transform into an unavoidable execution attack that ignores defense or blankets the opposing team with locked Healing Immunity.

Under their Leader ability, [c][F0FF23]Clan of Two[-][/c], New Republic allies gain massive increases to Max Health, Speed, Mastery, and Potency. Bounty Hunter and New Republic allies advance their Contract through counterattacks, unlocking Mastery and Speed gains for New Republic allies while allowing the whole squad to permanently ignore Taunt after activating their Ultimate ability. Enemy revives and instant defeats are severely penalized, turning the enemy's aggressive tactics into immediate advantages for your squad.

Their Ultimate ability, [c][F0FF23]Fire Up the Drives[-][/c], turns the tide of battle with overwhelming force. When triggered, the duo dispels debuffs from all New Republic allies, fully restores their Health and Protection, resets all other New Republic ally cooldowns, and awards them with immediate bonus turns alongside stacking Mastery and Offense. Furthermore, the first non-Galactic Legend or Raid Boss enemy to reach 10 stacks of [c][F0FF23]On the Run[-][/c] is instantly defeated.

Unlock [c][F0FF23]The Mandalorian and Grogu[-][/c] in their all-new Galactic Ascension event, [c][F0FF23]“THIS IS THEIR WAY”[-][/c], accessible via the Journey Guide! As a classic Galactic Legend event, they will be immediately available to deploy across all legacy modes, including Grand Arena Championships, Territory Wars, and Territory Battles.

This is the way.

data.NEWSLETTER_MERCENARY_GUARD_DROID_B1_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

[c][F0FF23]Mercenary Guard Droid (B1)[-][/c] is marching its way onto the Holotables!

As seen in [i]The Mandalorian and Grogu[/i], not all battle droids were deactivated when the Clone Wars came to an end. In the lawless shadows of the post-Imperial era, enterprising syndicates, criminal gotras, and legendary bounty hunters have scavenged, upgraded, and reprogrammed surviving B1 units into formidable personal security forces. Stripped of their original Separatist programming and outfitted with modified military hardware, these mercenary enforcers now bring their overwhelming swarm tactics and ruthless firepower to the Holotables!

[c][F0FF23]Mercenary Guard Droid (B1)[-][/c] is an ablative Tank designed to shield Bounty Hunter Mercenary squads and overwhelm enemy lines through sustained frontline pressure. Its Basic ability, [c][F0FF23]Modified E-10 Blaster Rifle[-][/c], inflicts damage while granting Offense Up to Bounty Hunter Mercenary allies. When paired with any allied version of [c][F0FF23]Embo[-][/c] in the Leader slot, that Embo assists and gains Speed Up, establishing a rapid offensive rhythm right from the opening turn. Its Special ability, [c][F0FF23]Overhead Smash[-][/c], delivers single-target damage and Blinds the target, while providing Protection Up to Bounty Hunter Mercenary allies.

True to its battle droid lineage, the Mercenary Guard Droid (B1) operates via a specialized version of the B1 Battalion mechanic outlined in [c][F0FF23]Mercenary Gotra[-][/c]. Entering combat with 1 Health and no Protection, it can't be defeated while stacks of [c][F0FF23]Mercenary Battalion[-][/c] remain. When fielded under [c][F0FF23]Embo & Keibu[-][/c], its starting Battalion size doubles, and the first time its strength dips to 20 or lower, it immediately gains a reinforcement of 100 stacks.

Its second Unique ability, [c][F0FF23]Droid Mercenary[-][/c], automatically grants it the Bounty Hunter tag if the ally in the Leader slot is [c][F0FF23]Embo & Keibu[-][/c] (in battles with no Galactic Legends), opens the encounter with an unpreventable Taunt, and provides a substantial Defense boost to other Bounty Hunter Mercenary allies. Additionally, whenever the Mercenary Guard Droid (B1) uses an ability, it Taunts or gains bonus Battalion stacks if it is already Taunting. Through [c][F0FF23]Soldier of Fortune[-][/c], it leverages its Relic Amplifier levels into stacking Defense Penetration and Tenacity for allies on their turns, scaling higher each time it absorbs damage while Taunting.

While in 3v3 Grand Arenas, its Omicron upgrade turns Bounty Hunter Mercenaries into an ironclad defensive unit. Allies receive additional Defense and the first time any Bounty Hunter Mercenary ally drops below 25% Health, they instantly recover full Health and gain Damage Immunity, effectively shutting down opening blitzes and keeping your contracted squad in the fight.

[c][F0FF23]Mercenary Guard Droid (B1)[-][/c] will be a requirement at Era Level 74 (Relic 7) for this year’s [b]Galactic Legend[/b]. Unlock [c][F0FF23]Mercenary Guard Droid (B1)[-][/c] in the upcoming [c][F0FF23]"MERCENARY PROTOCOL"[-][/c] Marquee event and add an unyielding frontline protector to your underworld squad!

data.RED_WLSB_K2SO_INFO:
[c][F0FF23]MERGE UNITS[-][/c]

Units included in the Lightspeed Bundle are upgraded according to a predetermined set of upgrade criteria (listed below). The Lightspeed Bundle does not directly grant character shards / ship blueprints or resources used in merge upgrades. The upgrade criteria are evaluated against your existing roster, and your units are set to the greater of the two values.

Each unit will first be evaluated for existing shards or star rarity against the bundle upgrade criteria. A unit at lower star rarity (or unactivated with less cumulative shards/blueprints) than the bundle upgrade criteria will be upgraded and activated. Units that exceed the star rarity (or cumulative shards/blueprints) will be activated (if unactivated) and then evaluated for additional attributes (gear tier, ability tier, etc). Any surplus shards/blueprints over the bundle upgrade criteria will be retained.

If your previously unlocked units meet or exceed the bundle upgrade criteria for other attributes, any surplus value will be retained.

[b]CHARACTERS[/b]
- 5 Stars
- Level 1
- Ability Tier 1

data.ULTIMATEABILITY_GLMANDOGROGU_DESC:
Requires 100% [c][FFA500]Ultimate Charge[-][/c] to activate

[c][FFA500]Ultimate Charge:[-][/c] Gain 2% Ultimate Charge whenever a New Republic ally counterattacks, inflicts Retaliate damage, or Provoked enemy counterattacks. Gain 5% Ultimate Charge whenever a New Republic ally gains Dramatic Entrance, and gain 10% Ultimate Charge whenever an enemy is defeated while inflicted with On the Run.

Deal Physical damage to all enemies and dispel all debuffs on all allies, and all New Republic allies recover 100% Health and Protection. All other New Republic allies gain a bonus turn, their cooldowns are reset, and they gain 50% Mastery and Offense for the rest of the encounter.

The next time On the Run is reset on an enemy (excluding Galactic Legends and Raid Bosses), they're instantly defeated and The Mandalorian and Grogu gain a bonus turn. Enemies (excluding Galactic Legends and Raid Bosses) who are immune to Instant Defeat effects instead have their Protection disabled and are inflicted with Healing Immunity which can't be dispelled or prevented, and they lose 50% Defense, Offense, and Speed for the rest of battle.

This attack can't be countered or evaded.
data.UNIQUEABILITY_CARADUNE01_TIER_07_DESC_V2:
While Stealthed, Cara Dune has +100% Critical Chance and +50% Critical Damage. When Cara Dune loses Taunt, she gains Stealth for 1 turn at the start of her next turn.

If the allied Leader is a New Republic Galactic Legend at the start of battle:

- Gain 50% Defense, Max Health, and Offense
- Taunt for 2 turns whenever another New Republic Tank ally loses Taunt; Stealth for 2 turns whenever another New Republic Tank ally Taunts
- When using Bar Room Brawler, she loses Stealth and Taunts for 2 turns
- When she Stealths, Cara Dune recovers 30% Health and Protection and has +100% Offense until she loses Stealth
- When she Taunts, Cara Dune dispels all debuffs on herself and has +100% Defense until she loses Taunt
data.UNIQUEABILITY_GLMANDOGROGU01_DESC:
The Mandalorian and Grogu are immune to Ability Block.

At the start of battle and every other turn, The Mandalorian and Grogu gain and may only use the Granted abilities [c][FFFF33]Force Splinter[-][/c] and [c][FFFF33]And Then the Young Protect the Old[-][/c]. During this turn, they ignore Taunt effects and take a bonus turn whenever they use one of these Granted abilities. If they use the same Granted ability two times in a row, that ability becomes Blocked for 1 turn.

Whenever The Mandalorian and Grogu use an ability against an enemy with Damage Immunity or deals 0 or 1 damage, they gain 10% Offense (stacking) for the rest of the encounter.

Gain 2% Ultimate Charge whenever a New Republic ally counterattacks, inflicts Retaliate damage, or Provoked enemy counterattacks. Gain 5% Ultimate Charge whenever a New Republic ally gains Dramatic Entrance, and gain 10% Ultimate Charge whenever an enemy is defeated while inflicted with On the Run.

[c][FFFF33]Force Splinter:[-][/c] Deal Physical damage to the target enemy and dispel all buffs on them.

Inflict Defense Down for 2 turns to the target enemy.

Inflict Buff Immunity for 2 turns to the target enemy, which can't be dispelled, evaded, or resisted.

[c][FFFF33]And Then the Young Protect the Old:[-][/c] Dispel all debuffs on the target ally and they recover 15% Health and Protection.

If the target ally is New Republic, they deal 50% more damage next turn, and gain Potency Up and Retribution for 2 turns.

If the target ally is a New Republic Tank, they gain Taunt for 2 turns.

If the target ally is The Mandalorian and Grogu, they gain Critical Damage Up and Retaliate for 3 turns.

data.ERA_ARENA_INFO_DETAILS:
In the Era Arena, use your Era and Loaned Units to battle others and earn banners. Your highest banner count from any single battle each day will be recorded to the leaderboard. Leaderboard ranking is determined by highest cumulative banner count, and ties in banner count are broken by whichever player first reached it. The leaderboard resets each week when you receive your weekly rewards.

After the first day of each Era, opponents' squads will match what was used in their best battle from the previous day. This includes the Era Level and Overcharge selections at the time of battle. If a player does not battle for a day, their defensive squad will stay the same.

Opponent matchmaking can be refreshed a limited number of times, which resets after making an attempt and at the start of each day.

data.BAYLAN_SKOLL_LIGHTSPEED_INFO:
[c][F0FF23]MERGE UNITS[-][/c]

Units included in the Lightspeed Bundle are upgraded according to a predetermined set of upgrade criteria (listed below). The Lightspeed Bundle does not directly grant character shards / ship blueprints or resources used in merge upgrades. The upgrade criteria are evaluated against your existing roster, and your units are set to the greater of the two values.

Each unit will first be evaluated for existing shards or star rarity against the bundle upgrade criteria. A unit at lower star rarity (or unactivated with less cumulative shards/blueprints) than the bundle upgrade criteria will be upgraded and activated. Units that exceed the star rarity (or cumulative shards/blueprints) will be activated (if unactivated) and then evaluated for additional attributes (gear tier, ability tier, etc). Any surplus shards/blueprints over the bundle upgrade criteria will be retained.

If your previously unlocked units meet or exceed the bundle upgrade criteria for other attributes, any surplus value will be retained.

[b]CHARACTERS[/b]
- 7 Stars
- Level 85
- Relic Level 8
- Ability Tier 7

data.EVENT_STRATEGY_TIPS_WHERE_STARDUST_FALLS:
- Defeating a Stormtrooper increases the damage your units deal to the AT-ST, but causes all remaining enemies except the AT-ST to recover to full Health.
- Use Moroff and Edrio Two Tubes' second Special abilities to inflict Healing Immunity and prevent enemies from recovering Health.
- Prioritize keeping all of your units alive, if any ally is defeated, the battle will end in defeat.
- The key to this tier is using Healing Immunity to manage enemy Health recovery while defeating Stormtroopers to increase your damage against the AT-ST. Carefully time your attacks and protect your allies.

- The enemy units cannot be defeated until all Explosives have been planted in each encounter. Focus on surviving and setting the explosives instead of trying to defeat the enemies.
- Try to use Sergeant Melshi's first Special whenever it is available to reduce the cooldown of [c][F0FF23]Plant Explosives[-][/c], allowing you to set the explosives sooner.
- If Sergeant Melshi is defeated before [c][F0FF23]Plant Explosives[-][/c] is used 3 times, the battle will end in defeat.
- The key to this tier is using Sergeant Melshi's first Special to get [c][F0FF23]Plant Explosives[-][/c] ready as quickly as possible, while protecting your allies until the explosives are planted.

- Whenever a rebel ally has their Stealth dispelled or takes damage, the enemies gain a stack of [c][F0FF23]Alarm[-][/c]. If [c][F0FF23]Alarm[-][/c] reaches 10 stacks before the enemies are defeated, the battle will end in defeat.\n- The longer the battle lasts, the more opportunities there are for the enemies to gain Alarm stacks. Try to defeat the enemies before the stacks get too high.\n- The key to this tier is using Bail Organa drawing attention away from the Rebels while carefully managing [c][F0FF23]Alarm[-][/c] stacks until all enemies are defeated.

- Director Krennic can't be defeated until Jyn Erso uses [c][F0FF23]Hope[-][/c].
- The main objective is to reach 100% [c][F0FF23]Upload Progress[-][/c] and use [c][F0FF23]Hope[-][/c].
- Jyn gains [c][F0FF23]Spark of Rebellion[-][/c] whenever she uses her Special 1. When Jyn gains Spark of Rebellion, [c][F0FF23]Upload Progress[-][/c] is increased.
- [c][F0FF23]Upload Progress[-][/c] can also be increased by dealing damage to Krennic while he is Breached. Look for opportunities to apply [c][F0FF23]Breach[-][/c] and continue building [c][F0FF23]Upload Progress[-][/c].
- Cassian can't gain turn meter and uses [c][F0FF23]Cover Fire[-][/c] every 2 turns, attacking Krennic multiple times, inflicting him with [c][F0FF23]Tenacity Down[-][/c], and granting Jyn [c][F0FF23]Tenacity Up[-][/c].

[b]MERGE UNITS[/b]

Units included in the Lightspeed Bundle are upgraded according to a predetermined set of upgrade criteria (listed below). The Lightspeed Bundle does not directly grant character shards / ship blueprints or resources used in merge upgrades. The upgrade criteria are evaluated against your existing roster, and your units are set to the greater of the two values.

Each unit will first be evaluated for existing shards or star rarity against the bundle upgrade criteria. A unit at lower star rarity (or unactivated with less cumulative shards/blueprints) than the bundle upgrade criteria will be upgraded and activated. Units that exceed the star rarity (or cumulative shards/blueprints) will be activated (if unactivated) and then evaluated for additional attributes (gear tier, ability tier, etc). Any surplus shards/blueprints over the bundle upgrade criteria will be retained.

If your previously unlocked units meet or exceed the bundle upgrade criteria for other attributes, any surplus value will be retained.

data.NEWSLETTER_EDRIO_TWO_TUBES_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

[c][F0FF23]Edrio Two Tubes[-][/c] is fighting his way onto the Holotables!

Driven from his conquered homeworld of Yar Togna by the Galactic Empire, Edrio, alongside his eggmate Benthic, sought retribution against the regime that displaced their people. Hardened by relentless guerrilla warfare, he serves as a ruthless mercenary sniper willing to deploy extreme measures and heavy ordnance to shatter Imperial oppression.

[c][F0FF23]Edrio Two Tubes[-][/c] is an aggressive Rebel Fighter/Mercenary Attacker designed to supercharge Saw Gerrera squads through coordinated [c][F0FF23]Explosive Trap[-][/c] detonations, heavy debuffs, and escalating critical strikes. His Basic ability, [c][F0FF23]Cybermerc[-][/c], stacks Critical Chance for Rebel Fighter allies on critical hits, while peeling away stacks of Explosive Trap during his turn. When wide-scale havoc is required, his first Special ability, [c][F0FF23]Drop the Proton Bombs[-][/c], blankets enemies in Damage Over Time debuffs. Under Saw Gerrera’s lead, this attack strips Explosive Trap stacks or inflicts locked stacks if Saw has already set the trap.

His second Special ability, [c][F0FF23]For Yar Togna[-][/c], delivers an unerring strike that inflicts Healing Immunity, ignores Protection on its first use, and deals doubled damage against Empire targets. Saw then assists against enemies with Explosive Trap to remove stacks. While it starts on cooldown, enemy turns hasten its recharge, granting Two Tubes an immediate bonus turn once ready. Meanwhile, his Uniques reward aggressive play: [c][F0FF23]No Pain All Gain[-][/c] grants massive stat bonuses, Cooldown Increase Immunity, and Turn Meter when traps detonate, while [c][F0FF23]Soldier of Fortune[-][/c] converts his Relic levels and critical hits into ramping buffs for Mercenary allies.

While in Territory Wars, [c][F0FF23]For Yar Togna[-][/c] is primed right from the start of battle. Rebel Fighter allies gain boosted Offense, Potency, and Tenacity, while Two Tubes' critical hits allow Rebel Fighter Mercenaries to ignore Taunt and grant the team immunity to Healing Immunity. Against enemies afflicted with Explosive Trap, Two Tubes deals amplified damage and prevents defeated Empire foes from reviving—ensuring Imperial targets stay eliminated for good.

Two Tubes is required at 4 stars and Era level 90 for the upcoming [c][F0FF23]"WHERE STARDUST FALLS"[-][/c] Journey Guide event to unlock [b]Jyn Erso (Undercover)[/b] during the Era. Unlock [c][F0FF23]Edrio Two Tubes[-][/c] in the upcoming [c][F0FF23]"THE LAST STAND"[-][/c] Marquee event and bring relentless heavy ordnance to your Rebel Fighter roster!
data.NEWSLETTER_ERA_OF_ROGUE_ONE_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

Celebrating the 10th anniversary of Rogue One: A Star Wars Story, the [c][F0FF23]Era of Rogue One[-][/c] is coming to the Holotables!

In the darkest days of Imperial oppression, courageous individuals from across the galaxy banded together against impossible odds to ignite the spark of rebellion. From hardened frontline soldiers and daring pilots to cunning spies and visionary leaders, their sacrifice proved that rebellions are built on hope. The Era of Rogue One honors these pivotal heroes, bringing the defining figures and gripping conflicts of the early Alliance to Galaxy of Heroes over the coming months.

Our first Marquee release is [c][F0FF23]Edrio Two Tubes[-][/c]. A seasoned Tognath mercenary and trusted sharpshooter of Saw Gerrera’s Partisans, Edrio brings his fierce marksmanship and relentless guerrilla tactics to bear against the Empire.

The second Marquee character is [c][F0FF23]Moroff[-][/c]. Towering over the battlefield, this heavily armed Gigoran mercenary unleashes devastating heavy-weapons fire to break enemy lines and protect his Rebel allies.

Next comes [c][F0FF23]General Merrick[-][/c], the daring commander of Blue Squadron whose starfighter tactics and valiant leadership over Scarif turned the tide in the Alliance's most desperate battle.

Following him is the fourth Marquee character, [c][F0FF23]General Draven[-][/c], head of Alliance Military Intelligence. Tasked with the grim realities of espionage, he frequently made the cold, uncompromising calls that others hesitated to make for the survival of the Rebellion.

Our fifth Marquee character is [c][F0FF23]Sergeant Melshi[-][/c], a seasoned Alliance pathfinder who fearlessly led the ground infiltration team on the Citadel Tower, risking everything to secure the galaxy's future.

Our final Marquee character is [c][F0FF23]Bail Organa[-][/c]. A founding architect of the Rebel Alliance, Senator Organa operated in secret within the Imperial Senate for years, providing critical leadership, political cover, and strategic resources to unite disparate resistance movements into a galactic Alliance.

Every rebellion begins with a spark, and every sacrifice leaves an enduring legacy. At the heart of this Era stands our Journey Guide character, [c][F0FF23]Jyn Erso (Undercover)[-][/c]. The [c][F0FF23]WHERE STARDUST FALLS[-][/c] event honors not only the desperate mission that exposed the Death Star's fatal flaw, but the heartbreaking sacrifice of Jyn herself, the beloved "Stardust" who gave everything so the galaxy could have hope. To unlock Jyn Erso (Undercover) requires all of the previous marquee characters from the Era of Rogue One at 4* and [c][F0FF23]Edrio Two Tubes[-][/c] Era Level 90. In addition, further participation in the event will require specific units at designated Era Levels: [c][F0FF23]Sergeant Melshi[-][/c] at 5* and Era Level 95, and [c][F0FF23]Bail Organa[-][/c] at 6* and Era Level 110. For the fourth and final tier, you will need all 6 Marquee characters at 7* and Era Level 125.

We hope you enjoy the Era of Rogue One! From daring rebel spies and seasoned guerrilla fighters to high-ranking Alliance commanders and senators, we're excited to bring this defining chapter of Star Wars history to the Holotables over the coming months!

Power up General Grievous, Geonosian Spy, Sun Fac, Geonosian Soldier, Geonosian Brood Alpha & Poggle The lesser and the separatist fleet to [b]7★, Ability Tier 7 & Relic Level 7.[/b] Assemble the core ships of the Malevolence fleet, swarm your enemies with Buzz Droids, and bring the power of the Separatists to the battlefield!\n\nPurchase limit: 1
data.SEPARATIST_LIGHTSPEED_INFO:
[b]MERGE UNITS[/b]

Units included in the Lightspeed Bundle are upgraded according to a predetermined set of upgrade criteria (listed below). The Lightspeed Bundle does not directly grant character shards / ship blueprints or resources used in merge upgrades. The upgrade criteria are evaluated against your existing roster, and your units are set to the greater of the two values.

Each unit will first be evaluated for existing shards or star rarity against the bundle upgrade criteria. A unit at lower star rarity (or unactivated with less cumulative shards/blueprints) than the bundle upgrade criteria will be upgraded and activated. Units that exceed the star rarity (or cumulative shards/blueprints) will be activated (if unactivated) and then evaluated for additional attributes (gear tier, ability tier, etc). Any surplus shards/blueprints over the bundle upgrade criteria will be retained.

If your previously unlocked units meet or exceed the bundle upgrade criteria for other attributes, any surplus value will be retained.

[b]CHARACTERS[/b]
- 7 Stars
- Level 85
- Relic Level 7
- Ability Tier 7

[b]SHIPS[/b]
- 7 Stars
- Level 85
- Ability Tier 7

data.TANO_LEGACY_LIGHTSPEED_INFO:
[b]MERGE UNITS[/b]

Units included in the Lightspeed Bundle are upgraded according to a predetermined set of upgrade criteria (listed below). The Lightspeed Bundle does not directly grant character shards / ship blueprints or resources used in merge upgrades. The upgrade criteria are evaluated against your existing roster, and your units are set to the greater of the two values.

Each unit will first be evaluated for existing shards or star rarity against the bundle upgrade criteria. A unit at lower star rarity (or unactivated with less cumulative shards/blueprints) than the bundle upgrade criteria will be upgraded and activated. Units that exceed the star rarity (or cumulative shards/blueprints) will be activated (if unactivated) and then evaluated for additional attributes (gear tier, ability tier, etc). Any surplus shards/blueprints over the bundle upgrade criteria will be retained.

If your previously unlocked units meet or exceed the bundle upgrade criteria for other attributes, any surplus value will be retained.

[b]CHARACTERS[/b]
- 7 Stars
- Level 85
- Relic Level 9
- Ability Tier 8

[b]SHIPS[/b]
- 7 Stars
- Level 85
- Ability Tier 8

data.UNIQUEABILITY_BISHOP01_TIER_06_DESC_V3:
Whenever a Healer or Support ally is damaged by an enemy ability while an ally is Taunting, Ward inflicts the enemy with Evasion Down for 1 turn.

Whenever the enemy dispels Retaliate on any ally, New Republic allies gain 10% Offense (stacking, max 50%) when attacking enemies out of turn. Whenever allies trigger Expose out of turn, they gain Critical Damage Up for 1 turn. Whenever Ward uses X-Haul Fly-by, if any enemies have On the Run, all New Republic allies assist the next time any ally counterattacks.

If all allies were New Republic at the start of battle: Whenever a Taunting Tank ally is damaged, the enemy that damaged them is Ability Blocked for 1 turn. If there is an allied New Republic Galactic Legend or there are no other Galactic Legends in the battle, whenever a Healer or Support ally is damaged by an enemy ability while an ally is Taunting, increase all cooldowns of the enemy who damaged them by 1 (excluding raid bosses and Galactic Legends) and the enemy gains 1 stack of On the Run until the end of the encounter.
data.UNIQUEABILITY_BISHOP01_TIER_07_DESC_V3:
Whenever a Healer or Support ally is damaged by an enemy ability while an ally is Taunting, Ward inflicts the enemy with Evasion Down for 1 turn.

Whenever the enemy dispels Retaliate on any ally, New Republic allies gain 10% Offense (stacking, max 50%) when attacking enemies out of turn. Whenever allies trigger Expose out of turn, they gain Critical Damage Up for 1 turn. Whenever Ward uses X-Haul Fly-by, if any enemies have On the Run, all New Republic allies assist the next time any ally counterattacks.

If all allies were New Republic at the start of battle: Whenever a Taunting Tank ally is damaged, the enemy that damaged them is Ability Blocked for 1 turn. If there is an allied New Republic Galactic Legend or there are no other Galactic Legends in the battle, whenever a Healer or Support ally is damaged by an enemy ability while an ally is Taunting, increase all cooldowns of the enemy who damaged them by 1 (excluding raid bosses and Galactic Legends) and the enemy gains 1 stack of On the Run until the end of the encounter.

[c][E7E7E7]While in Grand Arenas[-][/c]: At the start of battle, all New Republic allies gain 10% Potency and Tenacity for each New Republic ally until the end of battle.

If all allies are New Republic at the start of battle, enemies start the battle with 2 stacks of On the Run until the end of the encounter. If there is an allied New Republic Galactic Legend or there are no other Galactic Legends in the battle, whenever enemies gain a stack of On the Run, Ward inflicts them with an additional stack of On the Run (once per enemy per turn) until the end of the encounter. When enemies take damage from On the Run, they are also Exposed for 1 turn.
data.UNIQUEABILITY_CARSONTEVA01_TIER_07_DESC_:
At the start of each encounter, all New Republic Tank allies gain Retribution for 1 turn, which can't be dispelled. Teva gains 30% Max Health, Max Protection, and Offense. Whenever a New Republic ally is inflicted with a debuff, inflict Critical Chance Down and Potency Down on all enemies that didn't already have it for 1 turn, also inflict Accuracy Down on all Empire enemies that didn't already have it for 1 turn (limit once per turn).

At the start of each enemy's turn (excluding Galactic Legends), if they have 300 Speed more than Carson Teva, they are inflicted with Speed Down for 1 turn, which can't be resisted. Whenever a New Republic ally gains Advantage, all New Republic allies gain 5% Critical Chance and Critical Damage (stacking, max 100%) until the end of battle.

Whenever R5-D4 uses a Special ability, reduce the cooldown of Keeping the Peace by 1. Whenever an ally uses a Special ability on an enemy with at least one stack of On the Run, they gain Advantage. If there is an allied New Republic Galactic Legend or there are no other Galactic Legends in the battle, whenever a New Republic ally evades, inflict target enemy with a stack of On the Run (stacking, max 10) until the end of the encounter.
data.UNIQUEABILITY_COLISEUMBOSS01_ENDLESS_DES:
When this unit would be defeated, it recovers 100% Health.

After enemies take 10 consecutive turns, this unit gains 30% Offense and 200 Speed for the rest of battle and takes a bonus turn, and all buffs are dispelled on all enemies.

Damage this unit deals is increased as it takes turns. Damage this unit receives is decreased as it takes turns. After this unit takes 20 turns, the battle ends.

This unit is immune to Ability Block, Buff Disruption, Daze, Distracted, Fear, Health Down, Shock, Stagger, and Stun, as well as cooldown increase.

data.UNIQUEABILITY_MARAJADESKYWALKER01_TIER_0:
Mara Jade Skywalker has +30% Critical Chance and Critical Damage, and whenever she attacks out of turn, she gains Protection Up (50%) for 2 turns. Whenever a Jedi ally with Resilient Defense uses their Basic ability, Mara Jade assists. data.UNIQUEABILITY_VEL02_TIER_07_DESC_V2:
At the start of the encounter, Vel has +35% Accuracy. Whenever Cinta or Vel are attacked by an Undermined enemy, Vel gains a stack of Resilient Defense (max 8 stacks) for 2 turns.

Whenever an Undermined enemy attacks Cinta, she recovers 10% Protection and Vel gains 10% Turn Meter. Whenever Vel uses a Basic ability on an Undermined enemy, Cinta assists.

Whenever an enemy attacks Cinta, at the start of Vel's turn, that enemy is Exposed until the end of the turn. The first time Vel falls below 50% Health, she and Cinta reset their cooldowns and equalize their Health and Protection.
data.UNIQUEABILITY_ZAALBAR02_TIER_08_DESC_V2:
Zaalbar has +25% Critical Avoidance. If Mission Vao is an ally, she also gains this bonus. When any other ally falls below 100% Health, Zaalbar gains Retribution and Taunt for 2 turns. At the start of each of his turns, Zaalbar and Mission recover 10% Protection for each stack of Damage Over Time on enemies.

[c][E7E7E7]While in Grand Arenas:[-][/c] Zaalbar gains Retribution and Taunts for 1 turn at the start of battle, at the start of his turn, and whenever he loses Retribution or Taunt. Whenever he attacks out of turn, inflict a stack of Damage Over Time for 2 turns on all enemies, which can’t be evaded or resisted. After the start of encounter, enemies can't gain Defense Up or Stealth.

[c][E7E7E7]While in 5v5 Grand Arenas, if all allies are Light Side Old Republic and the Leader is not a Jedi:[-][/c] Allies are immune to Daze and Expose. At the start of each turn allies gain 20% Defense and Tenacity for each enemy debuff until the end of the turn. Whenever another ally Taunts, they dispel it, take a bonus turn, and gain 400% Offense (stacking) until the end of the encounter or the start of a Galactic Legend's turn. Whenever an enemy gains bonus Turn Meter, they are inflicted with a stack of Damage Over Time for 2 turns, which can’t be evaded or resisted. If Jolee Bindo is an ally, That Looks Pretty Bad revives all defeated allies. These bonuses persist if Zaalbar is defeated.

[c][E7E7E7]While in 3v3 Grand Arenas, if Darth Revan and Mission Vao are allies and there is no enemy Galactic Legend:[-][/c] Zaalbar and Mission gain the Sith Empire tag until the end of battle. Mission gains a bonus turn at the start of battle. Until the start of that turn she can't be targeted by enemies. At the start of that turn she is instantly defeated and grants her Critical Chance, Critical Damage, Offense, and Speed to Zaalbar and Darth Revan in addition to their own until the end of battle. These effects persist through defeat. Zaalbar and Darth Revan gain Guard until Zaalbar is defeated. Once per turn, Darth Revan assists whenever Zaalbar uses an ability.
